2025-06.daily_overview: On the first day of June, which coincided with Children’s Day and Sunday, Song Yajing’s family had a picnic gathering with her close friend’s family in Zhongshan Park, spending a day full of childlike fun and sincere conversation. In the morning, they shopped and prepared. In the afternoon, chatting on the lawn let her temporarily set aside the anxiety of running the shop and feel the warmth of friendship amid the trivialities of parenting and everyday life. After returning home in the evening, she still kept up her evening walk and reviewed the health habits of the past period.

events.name: Morning walk habit review.
events.description: After getting up early, Song Yajing sat at the small balcony table, pulled up the walking records on her phone, and did a brief review of the daily walks over the past 19 days (May 13 to 31). She noticed that her sleep quality had clearly improved, breast tenderness had eased, and her mood was much more stable. She shared her feelings with her husband Chen Zhiqiang in the family WeChat group, and the two decided to turn the evening walk from a short-term trial into a long-term habit. They initially planned to keep it up in June and gradually increase the walking time from 20 minutes to 25 minutes.

events.name: Final check of the store's soft décor and first podcast experience.
events.description: Taking advantage of the sunny morning, Song Yajing brought her phone and drove to the store on Zhongshan Road to do a final check on the cozy soft furnishings completed before June. She adjusted the positions of a few ornaments and the angles of the spotlights, confirming that the overall atmosphere was soft and comfortable. On the way to and from the store and while doing some light tidying, she tried wearing earphones to listen to a business-and-baking podcast. At first she found the constant stream of information uncomfortable, but she decided to give herself a few days to get used to this new way of absorbing knowledge.

events.name: Shopping for Children's Day picnic supplies
events.description: Around 10 a.m., Song Yajing first went to the supermarket to buy drinks, fruit, sandwiches, and snacks for the picnic, then went to her usual bakery to pick up her daughter's favorite strawberry Swiss roll. At home, she gathered a picnic mat, a parasol, wet wipes, and Xuanxuan's bucket, shovel, and other outdoor toys, making sure everything was ready.

events.name: Three-family picnic gathering at Zhongshan Park.
events.description: Song Yajing drove with her daughter Xuanxuan to Zhongshan Park and found a parking spot near a shaded lawn close to the children's playground. Before long, Li Meiling's family and Zhao Li and her daughter arrived one after another. The three families spread out picnic mats and laid out the food and drinks each had brought. The children quickly began chasing and playing on the grass, while the three mothers chatted and kept an eye on them, guiding the kids to dig sand and build forts in the sandpit.

events.name: The first purely emotional exchange between best friends
events.description: While the children played on the slide and in the sandpit, Song Yajing, Li Meiling, and Zhao Li sat around a picnic mat, snacking and talking about the real difficulties of raising children. Li Meiling talked about having severe pregnancy reactions with her second child and the heavy pressure of end-of-term work. Zhao Li, for the first time, opened up about the hardships of raising her daughter alone, even mentioning a past experience when she almost lost custody. Song Yajing also shared her anxiety about her daughter's upcoming school transition. For the first time, the three of them talked about nothing related to shop management or business; the conversation focused purely on family, exhaustion, and support, and their friendship deepened through this honesty.

events.name: Picnic wrap-up and reluctant farewells
events.description: After 4 p.m., the children had grown a little tired. Song Yajing, Li Meiling, and Zhao Li folded up the picnic mat, carefully cleaned up the trash on the grass, and packed the remaining food to take home. When they parted, the children waved their little hands and agreed to play together again, and the three mothers reminded one another to take care of their health. Each then drove away, feeling satisfied and a little reluctant to leave.

events.name: Return home, tidy up, and take an evening walk around Yundang Lake.
events.description: After returning home, Song Yajing sorted the leftover food into the refrigerator, cleaned the picnic mat and utensils, and put Xuanxuan's toys back in their places. Around 6 p.m., when it was still light, she took her daughter Xuanxuan for a walk as usual along the Yundang Lake trail. The gentle lake breeze carried away the day's bustle. Holding hands, the mother and daughter chatted about the older girl from Zhao Li's family they had just met, feeling calm and warm.

2025-06.daily_overview: An ordinary Monday, the shop operated as usual, but Song Yajing was still immersed in the aftertaste of yesterday's picnic. Taking advantage of the quiet morning in the shop, with guidance from her best friend Wang Jia, she tried to open the Kuaituantuan mini program, taking the first step in testing the online business, though she felt somewhat uneasy. During an evening walk, she chatted with her daughter about fun things at kindergarten, and ended the busy day with meditation at night.

events.name: Discussed with Wang Jia about activating Kuaituantuan.
events.description: After arriving at the store in the morning, Song Yajing sorted the newly arrived summer clothes while contacting her close friend Wang Jia in Shenzhen via WeChat voice messages. The two talked about how many peers had recently started community group buying. Wang Jia strongly suggested that Song Yajing open a Kuaituantuan mini program to test the waters of online business. With the mindset of trying a new channel, Song Yajing had Wang Jia remotely guide her through registration.

events.name: Opening Kuaituantuan and listing the first batch of products
events.description: During a break from receiving customers at the store, Song Yajing sat behind the counter and focused on her phone, gradually completing the registration and certification for the Kuaituantuan mini-program, and listed the first batch of selected influencer-style dresses at affordable prices, hoping to attract online customers. She was still a little insecure when announcing it in the community group, but thinking that Wang Jia would help analyze the data, she decided to give it a try.

events.name: Video call with mother to share Children's Day anecdotes.
events.description: After lunch, during a brief lull at the shop, Song Yajing made a WeChat video call to her mother and excitedly shared the details of yesterday's picnic and the adorable way Xuanxuan was digging in the sand at the park. Her mother, Lin Xiuying, on the other end of the video, was grinning from ear to ear and reminded her not to forget to give the shop a simple tidy-up after the Dragon Boat Festival. The mother and daughter chatted for more than twenty minutes before hanging up.

events.name: Evening walk and parent-child interaction.
events.description: Around 6 p.m., Song Yajing took her daughter for a walk along the tree-lined path near the residential complex. The mother and daughter chatted about the fun things at kindergarten during the day, and the aroma of neighbors' cooking occasionally drifted through the evening streets.

events.name: Evening guided meditation
events.description: At 10 p.m., after Xuanxuan fell asleep with her father, Song Yajing opened the Tide app and did a 10-minute guided meditation. She followed the voice to relax the muscles throughout her body. From time to time, the browsing data from the Kuaituantuan backend flashed through her mind, but deep breathing gradually calmed her down, and she fell asleep looking forward to the new business.

2025-06.daily_overview: The enthusiasm for the online business was dampened the very next day—Song Yajing received a large number of return requests one after another, because the influencer-style dresses ran small and seriously mismatched the body shapes of the local customer base. She spent the whole day tallying the return data and contacting customers to apologize. In the evening, she took her daughter for a walk in the rain, feeling quite heavy-hearted, but through reflection she gained a valuable lesson about online product selection.

events.name: She encountered an online return rush.
events.description: On June 3, return notifications kept popping up in the Kuaituantuan backend. From the moment Song Yajing arrived at the store in the morning, she was frantically processing refund requests and checking the returned clothes. She found that most of the returns were for the viral dresses that had been listed the previous day. Customer feedback about the sizing running small and the fabric not matching the photos made her realize that her judgment of the online user profile had been off. She entered each return reason into her phone notes one by one; by evening, nearly twenty items were backlogged for return.

events.name: Missed lunch break due to handling returns; migraine set in.
events.description: Because the return issue took up the entire morning and afternoon, Song Yajing completely forgot her usual after-lunch nap. Around three in the afternoon, she felt a throbbing pain in her temples and realized her body was protesting. She quickly stopped what she was doing, dug out the cooling balm she always carried from her bag, applied it to her forehead, and drank some warm water, which finally relieved it a bit. This small episode made her understand more deeply the importance of keeping a regular schedule.

events.name: Walking around Yundang Lake in the rain and processing emotions
events.description: In the evening, a fine shower began to fall. Song Yajing put a small raincoat on Xuanxuan, held a large umbrella, and went for their usual walk by Yundang Lake. Raindrops rippled across the lake surface. She held her daughter's hand and walked slowly, much calmer than in the morning, and began to rationally think about the root cause of this trial-and-error. Xuanxuan pointed excitedly at an egret in the rain and shouted; the child's innocence momentarily lifted her stress.

start_state.mood: A little uneasy, sensing that the first online attempt might not go well

2025-06.daily_overview: The return crisis continued to escalate. That evening, with Wang Jia's remote data analysis and encouragement, Song Yajing decisively adjusted her strategy—taking down the viral item and switching to safer basic styles and discounted lucky bags. Although this decision caused some loss of initial investment, it promptly stopped the return trend and also made her think systematically for the first time about the essential differences between online and offline product selection. Evening walks and nighttime meditation became anchors for stabilizing her emotions, but staying up late simplified her pre-bedtime stretching and meditation.

events.name: Wang Jia's remote data analysis and strategic suggestions
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing sent screenshots of her conversations with customers and back-end data to Wang Jia. Using her lunch break, Wang Jia analyzed them remotely via video call and pointed out that the target customers for the viral influencer dresses were slim young women, while Song Yajing's existing community was mainly local mothers, whose body shapes and clothing needs differed greatly. Wang Jia suggested immediately taking down the high-risk influencer styles and instead promoting basic tops, wide-leg pants, and packaged discounted lucky bags to reduce mismatched customer expectations.

events.name: Adjusted Kuaituantuan inventory overnight.
events.description: After taking the advice, Song Yajing did not go home immediately after closing that night. Instead, she edited the product pages in the store. She took down the influencer-style dresses, retook photos of several loose-fitting, well-received basic T-shirts and sweatpants from inventory and uploaded them, and also launched several blind-box lucky bags to attract trial purchases at clearance prices. By the time she finished, it was past nine in the evening, and she hurriedly packed up and went home.

events.name: Simplified bedtime stretching and meditation.
events.description: It was almost ten o'clock when she got home. Song Yajing felt her neck and shoulders tight, but she really didn't have the energy to finish the entire stretching and meditation routine. She only did five simple neck rotations and shoulder circles before lying straight down on the bed. She played a 5-minute guided breathing exercise on the Tide app, and almost fell asleep along with the audio, spending only half her usual relaxation time.

start_state.mood: Anxious but forcing herself to stay cheerful, she decided to seek help

events.description: After closing the store and returning home, Song Yajing helped Xuanxuan wash up and then went into the bedroom early. She turned off the main light, left only a small night light on, and sat on a cushion by the bed for 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation. This time, she deliberately guided herself to feel the rise and fall of her breathing in her chest and the softness of the muscles near her breasts, and was pleasantly surprised to find that the faint swelling pain she had noticed earlier was almost imperceptible. As she breathed deeply, the tension from days of hard work gradually melted away.

events.name: Shared a Kuaituantuan link in the regular customer group.
events.description: In the afternoon, during a lull while several regular customers were trying on clothes, Song Yajing casually introduced Kuaituantuan to them, saying it had some everyday basics she had specially picked that were unlikely to be the same as what other people wore. Customers could browse photos and place orders online, then pick up in store. The regulars responded enthusiastically, scanning the QR code to save it on the spot, and also gave her feedback on the styles. This made her stop seeing the online business merely from a “trial-and-error” perspective and gradually reposition it as an “extension of service.”

events.name: Selecting a hearing aid for her father
events.description: Before bed, Song Yajing carefully selected an easy-to-operate behind-the-ear hearing aid for her father, Song Minghui, through an e-commerce platform, made an appointment for the weekend to have it adjusted in the store, and planned to pair it with a handwritten letter as a Father's Day gift.

start_state.location: At home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: The drizzly morning was a little lazy, but the body memory after meditation gave her a calm foundation.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: My body feels more comfortable, and I am becoming more at ease in exploring the business, all while looking forward to preparing a gift for my father.

2025-06.daily_overview: Today was the day of Song Yajing's breast re-examination. In the morning, she received good results at Zhongshan Hospital. Following the doctor's advice, she began taking a daily multivitamin and also forwarded the health reminder to her close friend. In the early morning, she walked alone by Yundang Lake, recording the subtle changes of nature in words, her heart filled with gratitude for her body's recovery.

events.name: Morning walk and recording of water lilies by the lake.
events.description: After getting up early, Song Yajing booked a hospital outpatient appointment, then went for a walk in Yundang Lake Park. She noticed that the water lilies in the lake were blooming especially full and lush, and different species of trees had borne tender green fruit. She took photos while writing in her memo: 'In the morning by the lake, the water lilies sway gently in the ripples, as if saying—slow down, and you will see.' She sent this passage and the photos to her close friends' group chat, encouraging Li Meiling and Wang Jia to also notice the natural beauty around them.

events.name: Made an appointment and went to the hospital for a follow-up.
events.description: At 8 a.m., Song Yajing booked an outpatient appointment in advance with the Breast Surgery Department of Zhongshan Hospital Affiliated to Xiamen University through the hospital app. Around 9 o'clock, she left her home on South Hubin Road in Siming District, drove about twenty minutes to the hospital, picked up her number at the registration desk, and then went to the breast surgery waiting area.

events.name: Breast re-examination and doctor's advice
events.description: The doctor carefully re-examined her breast hyperplasia area by palpation. After comparing with the May physical examination records, she was told that no medication was needed and that her condition was currently good. The doctor advised her to maintain regular exercise and a positive mood, and recommended daily vitamin E supplements to help maintain breast health.

events.name: Buying medicine and starting to take vitamin E every day
events.description: After the consultation, Song Yajing bought a box of multivitamin tablets containing vitamin E at the pharmacy on the first floor of the hospital. She carefully put the pill box in her bag, took the first tablet on the spot with mineral water, and set a daily 21:00 medication reminder in her phone calendar. She sent her husband a message: 'The follow-up went smoothly, remember to remind me to take the vitamins every day.'

events.name: Health reminder and sharing with a close friend
events.description: After returning home, Song Yajing sent a screenshot of the doctor's advice summary to her close friends' WeChat group, specifically reminding Li Meiling and Zhao Li to also pay regular attention to breast health. She wrote: "Hey everyone, today's follow-up visit: the doctor said staying active and keeping a good mood works better than any medicine. Let's keep each other accountable!" The group quickly received a string of heart emojis.

start_state.location: At home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: She felt both calm and slightly nervous about the follow-up results, but the morning light helped her stay optimistic.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: Greatly relieved by the health verification and filled with gratitude.

2025-06.daily_overview: This day was filled with immense joy and real-world worries—when news arrived that her daughter Xuanxuan had been selected by lottery for a high-quality private elementary school, the whole family rejoiced, but the high tuition also made the couple urgently adjust their family budget. In the evening conversation between the couple, financial pressure instead turned into a stronger bond. Store expenses were tightened, the monthly family budget was redrawn, and their gratitude and promises before bed deepened their mutual trust.

events.name: Good news arrived about our daughter's advancement in school.
events.description: On the morning of June 13, Song Yajing checked on her phone and found that her daughter Xuanxuan had been admitted to a high-quality private elementary school in Siming District. She had to confirm it several times before she could believe it. Overjoyed, she called her husband at work, and the two cheered together on the phone. After hanging up, she sat alone in the store, her eyes slightly red, half from pride and half from the heavy premonition of tuition fees that immediately welled up.

events.name: Evening couple discussion on financial plans
events.description: That evening, while Xuanxuan was reading picture books in the living room, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang closed the bedroom door to seriously discuss the tuition issue. Facing the new education expense of 30,000 to 40,000 yuan per year, Chen Zhiqiang pondered for a moment and then proactively offered to cut down his leisure gaming time, apply to take on more off-site technical projects at his company, and use project subsidies to cover part of the shortfall. Song Yajing felt both guilty and deeply moved, and said softly, 'We'll get through this together.'

events.name: Tightening the shop's expense budget.
events.description: The economic measures were not limited to one move. That evening, Song Yajing opened the store's electronic ledger and reviewed this month's procurement expenditures item by item, deleting or postponing several non-essential decoration and restocking plans. She sent a WeChat message to the store clerk, Xiaomei, briefly explaining the situation and saying that for the next period they should appropriately tighten the purchasing budget and focus on clearing existing inventory. Xiaomei quickly replied, "Understood, we'll think of a way together."

events.name: Setting the family's new monthly budget
events.description: After talking through the overall direction, Song Yajing took out the family ledger, and the couple together reallocated the proportions of monthly savings and various expenses, listing fixed expenses such as future tuition and insurance separately to ensure they were set aside on time every month. Chen Zhiqiang wrote down a few numbers on paper. The image of their heads together gave Song Yajing, beneath the pressure, a reassuring feeling of working side by side.

events.name: Gratitude and promises between the couple before bed.
events.description: Before going to bed, Song Yajing leaned on her husband's shoulder and said earnestly, "Thank you for always thinking so far ahead for us." Chen Zhiqiang gently put his arm around her and did not say much, but both knew that this family was moving from simple warmth toward a more mature mutual support.

start_state.location: At home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Nervous and expectant about her daughter's school admission results.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: A mix of emotions—joy, stress, gratitude, and determination intertwined.

state.daily_exercise: In the evening, took my daughter for a brisk walk around the residential complex for about 20 minutes, to help her burn off energy during a mood swing.

2025-06.daily_overview: Saturday's schedule was full and productive. In the morning, Song Yajing and her daughter continued their watercolor class and finished a fruit platter still-life painting together. In the afternoon, at the shop, she looked back at the record of her collapse in April, quietly building up her resolve to discuss insurance with her husband, and she also signed up for an English speaking workshop to prepare for an overseas trip. In the evening, she wrote a long letter to her father, planted herbs on the balcony with her daughter and husband, and then took on the challenge of making French macarons, followed by a serious discussion about family insurance. At night, she completed her meditation and health check-in.

events.name: Mother-daughter fruit platter watercolor class.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Song Yajing took Xuanxuan to her watercolor class. The theme of this class was sketching a fruit platter from life. Xuanxuan drew a plate of brightly colored strawberries and oranges that was vivid and lifelike; Song Yajing also carefully painted a golden pineapple, recalling her father cutting pineapples in her childhood as she painted. The teacher's praise boosted the confidence of both mother and daughter. When Song Yajing shared the works on Moments, she wrote: "Looks like we might have another mother-daughter class on weekends in the future."

events.name: While reviewing health records, she began to develop an awareness of insurance.
events.description: In the afternoon, when the shop was a bit quiet, Song Yajing took out of her bag her April outpatient records from when she fell ill due to overwork and her May physical examination report for breast hyperplasia, and laid them side by side on the counter. Looking at these two documents, a wave of fear welled up in her heart: if she or her husband were to collapse, this little family had no safety net at all. That thought became the starting point for a serious discussion with her husband about insurance in the evening.

events.name: Sign up for an English speaking workshop.
events.description: After dealing with shop matters in the evening, Song Yajing thought of the goal she had set at the beginning of the year—"take the family on an overseas trip within three years." She opened the page for the online intensive spoken English workshop she had saved earlier, completed registration and payment, and checked the class schedule. The first class was scheduled for June 21.

events.name: Handwrote a long letter to her father
events.description: In the evening, during the wait for her husband to bring their daughter home, Song Yajing took out letter paper and sat at the desk in the study to write a two-page long letter to her father, Song Minghui. In the letter, for the first time, she expressed in words her heartache over her father's declining hearing and her fear of her parents growing old, and her handwriting trembled slightly with emotion. She decided to mail the letter together with the hearing aid tomorrow.

events.name: Decided to take on French macarons and started preparing
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing saw Master Chen post a set of beautiful finished French macaron photos and a detailed tutorial in a baking WeChat group. The colors and the frilly edges made her both envious and eager to try, and the goal she had set at the beginning of the year—"learn to make more complicated French desserts"—surfaced. She immediately replied in the group, "Master Chen, I want to take on this challenge!" Then, following the tutorial, she listed the required ingredients: almond flour, powdered sugar, egg whites, caster sugar, and food coloring. She placed an order online with a baking supplies store for the almond flour and food coloring, expecting it to arrive tomorrow, and planned to officially try baking for the first time the day after tomorrow (the 16th).

events.name: Serious discussion about family insurance gaps
events.description: After dinner, Xuanxuan watched cartoons in the living room. Song Yajing took her husband Chen Zhiqiang back to the bedroom, spread the notes she had read that afternoon on the bed, and solemnly pointed out that the family currently had no commercial insurance at all—if anything happened to the breadwinner, it would be unbearable. Her husband was silent at first, but his expression turned serious after reading his wife's notes. They agreed that they needed to add critical illness insurance and women's disease insurance as soon as possible, and decided to contact the bank account manager Lin Xiaofeng next Monday to ask about insurance channels.

events.name: Building the balcony herb garden together and the watering dispute.
events.description: Yesterday, Song Yajing had a sudden idea and decided to build a balcony herb garden with her daughter. At six this evening, Song Yajing brought the mint that her daughter had gotten from Auntie Zhang yesterday to the balcony, and the family of three started planting. Xuanxuan was responsible for filling the long planter with potting soil using a small trowel and carefully burying the seeds. Chen Zhiqiang installed the wall-mounted planter brackets on the balcony, while Song Yajing watered the plants and followed a short video tutorial online. Unexpectedly, because she was overexcited, Song Yajing poured several watering cans in a row, making the potting soil overly wet, and the mint began to turn yellow the next day. The whole family had to look up information together and learn the watering principle of 'see dry, see wet'. Xuanxuan also drew a watering record chart and stuck it next to the planter. This little episode taught everyone patience and the correct way to care for plants.

events.name: Evening meditation and taking vitamin E on time
events.description: Before going to sleep, Song Yajing did her last meditation of the week as usual, reviewing the past few days' walks, nature observations, and gradually richer family interactions. She noticed that the breast tenderness had clearly eased and her body felt lighter, so she wrote down next week's goals in her health journal. Before meditating, she did not forget to take a multivitamin from the pillbox and swallow it. The reminder on her phone calendar rang on time, and she checked in with satisfaction.

start_state.location: At home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Beneath the ease of Saturday lay a faint unease about family security.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: Emotions surged while writing the letter, but I regained warmth in the harmony of the whole family building an herb garden together.

state.daily_exercise: In the evening, helping the plantation move potting soil was equivalent to light physical activity, followed by a brief stretch at night.

2025-06.daily_overview: On Father’s Day, Song Yajing sent a hearing aid and a handwritten letter to Quanzhou, completing an emotional breakthrough with her father. After the morning church Mass, she took the spiritual journal from Aunt Lin and turned to a new page of spiritual recording. She considerately encouraged her husband to take their daughter to the science museum for some special father-daughter time, while she herself took a rare full afternoon nap, deliberately pressing pause on her constant tension. In the evening, the family went out to celebrate their daughter’s academic advancement. During an evening walk, she wrote her first spiritual journal entry, and her bedtime meditation settled her gratitude.

events.name: Morning Mass and receiving the spiritual journal.
events.description: After getting up early, Song Yajing first took vitamin E, then went alone to church for the Sunday morning Mass. The members of the Bible study group sat in a circle and especially thanked God for Xuanxuan's school advancement. After Mass, Aunt Lin Xiuying stopped her, handed her an elegantly plain notebook called Spiritual Diary, and said gently: This is a notebook I specially prepared for you. May you record your daily gratitude, and the Lord will protect you. Song Yajing's eyes became slightly moist, she accepted it solemnly, and thought to herself that when she got back home she would copy the spiritual reflections from her phone over the past few days into the notebook.

events.name: Send out the Father's Day gift and letter.
events.description: After Mass ended, Song Yajing took the package containing the handwritten letter and the adjusted hearing aid to a nearby courier point, and deliberately chose insured shipping. While filling out the form, she pictured her father's eyes lighting up after putting on the hearing aid, and a sour yet warm feeling surged in her heart. After sending it, she told her father in the family group chat to keep an eye out for a package in the next couple of days, without mentioning the contents at all.

events.name: Encourage special father-daughter time.
events.description: At breakfast, Song Yajing suggested that her husband Chen Zhiqiang take Xuanxuan to the science and technology museum for the day on Father's Day, so the father and daughter could have a meaningful holiday together. Chen Zhiqiang had wanted to rest at home, but seeing his wife's earnest eyes, he smiled and agreed. Xuanxuan hopped off to pick out a small backpack for going out. Song Yajing prepared a water bottle and snacks for them, then stood at the door watching the father and daughter head out hand in hand, feeling a different kind of fulfillment in her heart.

events.name: Self-pause and a long afternoon nap.
events.description: After her family went out, the house suddenly fell quiet. Instead of assigning herself chores or work as usual, Song Yajing went back to the bedroom, drew the curtains, and let herself sleep completely relaxed for the whole afternoon. She slept from before noon until past three in the afternoon. It was the first time in months she had pressed the pause button without any guilt. When she woke up, the sunlight outside was already slanting, and she felt that the fatigue accumulated over several days had been greatly repaired. Her sleep quality was extremely high, with nearly 2 hours of deep sleep.

events.name: A small family dinner celebrating the school advancement
events.description: In the evening, to fulfill the promise of celebrating their daughter's academic success, Song Yajing and her husband took Xuanxuan to a parent-child restaurant. They ordered Xuanxuan's favorite tomato pasta and fried chicken wings, and gave her a deluxe edition of The Little Prince as encouragement for her advancement. Xuanxuan hugged the gift tightly and said, “Thank you, Mom and Dad.” Song Yajing captured the moment with her phone. The warmth of family diluted the economic pressure.

events.name: Podcast inspires business thinking
events.description: After returning from the restaurant, Song Yajing cleaned the kitchen while listening to a podcast and happened to hear a niche brand owner share the idea—"Rather than clearing stock with lucky bags, build trust with basic pieces"—which made her see things in a new light and immediately reminded her of her previous Kuaituantuan lesson. While her family wasn't paying attention, she jotted down in her phone notes: "Don't rush to clear inventory online; first build trust with basic pieces, and keep the content authentic." This insight gave her clear direction for the upcoming community operations.

events.name: Evening lakeside walk and the opening of a spiritual journal
events.description: At 6:30 in the evening, the summer sunset was especially brilliant. Song Yajing took Xuanxuan for a 30-minute walk by Yundang Lake, deliberately slowing down for mindful walking and feeling the contact between her soles and the ground. After returning home, she settled her daughter in, sat at her desk, opened her "Spiritual Journal," and wrote the first entry: "I am grateful for the joy of receiving the hearing aid today, grateful that my husband is willing to take our daughter to spend Father's Day, and grateful that I have learned to let my body rest. May the Lord continue to protect this family and help us wisely face the changes ahead." After writing, she closed the notebook, her heart at peace.

events.name: Stretching, meditation, and vitamin E before bed.
events.description: Even though she had taken a nap in the afternoon, Song Yajing still insisted on completing her bedtime routine. She did 10 minutes of gentle stretching, then used the Tide app for a 10-minute meditation, praying especially for her father and family. At 9 p.m., the medication alarm went off. She confirmed that she had already taken vitamin E that morning and marked it as done on the calendar. Because of the long afternoon sleep, she fell asleep a little later than usual that night, but her heart was at peace.

start_state.mood: Full of a sense of ritual, ready to pass on love to her father and husband

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: The ease after rest, the fulfillment of beginning to record inspiration with the pen, and the keen interest in a new baking challenge.

2025-06.daily_overview: On the store's regular day off, Song Yajing spent the whole day at home trying to make French macarons but failed. Her humorous sharing of the failure unexpectedly sparked interaction in the community group. In the evening, she was deeply moved by her father's choked-up call of gratitude. After breakfast, she took her usual vitamin E and started a new day.

events.name: Morning routine and school drop-off
events.description: After getting up at 7 a.m., she first did a brief gratitude prayer, then prepared a low-sugar breakfast for her daughter Chen Lexuan and took her to kindergarten. On the way home, she listened to a podcast episode about basic-item strategies for niche brands on her phone and jotted down a few display ideas she could borrow. During breakfast, she did not forget to take a vitamin E capsule—a habit she had developed after her breast follow-up examination.

events.name: First macaron attempt ended in a total disaster.
events.description: Starting at 9:30 a.m., Song Yajing made three attempts at French macarons in her own kitchen. The first batch was severely hollow because the meringue was under-whipped; the second batch developed cracks on the surface because the oven's top heat was too high; the third batch barely produced feet but collapsed into flat discs. She placed the three failed batches side by side on the kitchen counter and took close-up photos from multiple angles with her phone, intending to ask Master Chen for guidance. Between the three attempts, she couldn't resist tasting a few ugly macaron shells, and the sugar intake made her somewhat regretful.

events.name: Humorously shared the fail photo.
events.description: At around 3 p.m., Song Yajing first sent the failed photos to her baking teacher, Master Chen, on WeChat, describing in detail the state of the meringue and the oven temperature settings. She then posted the same images to the Yajing Life Studio community group with the self-deprecating caption 'Macarons: Bite me if you can,' which instantly amused the group members. Several housewives who usually lurked also shared their own baking mishaps, and group interaction was nearly three times higher than usual. She also privately messaged fellow baking enthusiast Mrs. Liu, who sent a photo of the chocolate cake she had burnt last year, and the two encouraged each other.

events.name: A grateful phone call from father.
events.description: A little after 5 p.m., her father Song Minghui called from Quanzhou, his voice choking up at one point. He said the new hearing aid let him clearly hear his granddaughter's voice after many years, and he had put the long letter Song Yajing wrote for Father's Day under the glass desktop, where he could see it every day. Song Yajing held the phone with reddened eyes and promised to bring Xuanxuan back to Quanzhou to stay for a few days during summer vacation, and also planned to visit her older sister Song Yawen along the way.

events.name: Evening walk and meditation journal.
events.description: After dinner the rain stopped. Song Yajing took her daughter for a 20-minute walk in the community garden, listening to Xuanxuan talk about funny things at kindergarten while taking deep breaths. After returning home and putting her daughter to bed, she did a 10-minute mindfulness meditation on the balcony, then wrote in her diary how she felt that day: her right shoulder was slightly sore, but her overall energy was good. The scale showed 49.3 kg, slightly up from yesterday, and she attributed it to tasting the baked goods.

end_state.mood: Moved by the depth of fatherly love, and although the baking failed, she felt relaxed by making fun of herself; her heart was warm before bed.

2025-06.daily_overview: A day of advancing both work and family: in the morning, she confirmed at the store that the basic-styles strategy was working; during her lunch break, she hurriedly chose a graduation gift for her daughter; in the afternoon, she tried making macarons again but still failed, yet she turned her frustration into motivation with humorous hand-drawn illustrations; in the evening, she handled two major matters: the kindergarten graduation ceremony and the insurance consultation. After an evening walk, the scale showed a drop, which was some consolation.

events.name: Small win for the store's basic-item strategy
events.description: At 9 a.m. sharp, she arrived at the store. The shop assistant Xiao Mei reported that the repurchase rate for the basic T-shirts and shirts launched last week had risen noticeably, and one regular customer bought three in different colors in one go. Song Yajing took the opportunity to adjust the window display, showcasing the basics with accessories, and took photos of the outfits to post on Kuaituantuan as a reference for customer outfit photos. During a break at work, she took a vitamin E capsule and reminded herself to drink more water.

events.name: Lunch break: buying graduation gifts.
events.description: During her lunch break, she went alone to a nearby shopping mall and carefully picked out a leather growth album and a dress printed with a cartoon doctor pattern as a souvenir for her daughter's kindergarten graduation. She also bought a few colored markers, planning to let Xuanxuan draw pictures on the album's title page herself. Since she had only eaten half a sandwich, she felt a little hungry, but worried that buying gifts would take time, so she did not eat more.

events.name: Second macaron failure and the birth of the fail card.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Song Yajing returned home, adjusted the recipe, and tried again. Unexpectedly, this time the egg whites were over-whipped, and when she folded in the almond flour, the batter deflated rapidly. The piped rounds spread into thin sheets in the oven, with surfaces cracked like a turtle shell. She didn't know whether to laugh or cry. She drew a hand-painted failure record card with colored pencils — a fierce-looking macaron with the words "I'll try one last time" written next to it — and planned to keep it as a memento. She sent the photo to Master Chen, who suggested calibrating the oven temperature before trying again.

events.name: Contact the kindergarten and schedule the insurance appointment.
events.description: At 8 p.m., she first asked the kindergarten head teacher via WeChat about the exact time, procedure, and what parents needed to prepare for the graduation ceremony, and volunteered to help decorate the venue as a parent volunteer. Then she called the insurance broker recommended by her husband's colleague, who gave a detailed introduction to a family protection package, and the two agreed on Saturday morning for an in-depth discussion at home. After the call, she briefly reported to her husband, who expressed support.

events.name: Evening lakeside walk and meditation journal
events.description: At 6:30 p.m., mother and daughter strolled along the Yundang Lake footpath for 25 minutes, and Xuanxuan picked up fallen frangipani flowers along the way. After returning home, Song Yajing did her usual 10-minute meditation. Before bed, she especially noted in her diary: Today I fell asleep more than ten minutes sooner than yesterday, my sleep quality continues to improve, and my weight is 49.1kg, perhaps because I ate less at lunch.

start_state.mood: After sleeping enough, I feel refreshed and ready to dive into the new week's work.

2025-06.daily_overview: It was the day when their daughter's enrollment was officially settled. In the morning, Song Yajing had pleasant interactions with regular customers at the store. After noon, she completed registration and received the admission notice, her mood swinging between joy and the pressure of tuition fees. In the afternoon, a video chat with her mother brought her comfort. During an evening walk, she silently planned the family's expenses for the second half of the year. Meditation before bed restored her calm.

events.name: Store daily routine and interactions with regular customers
events.description: After arriving at the store in the morning, regular customer Vivian came to pick up the reserved floral dress. While trying it on, the two chatted about their daughters' education. Vivian recommended a children's time management chart, and Song Yajing immediately noted it in her phone memo. Meanwhile, she also packed the previous day's Kuaituantuan lucky-bag orders and asked Xiaomei to send them out in the afternoon. Before leaving the store, she redeemed bank points, adding a small income to the family ledger.

events.name: Register her daughter for school enrollment
events.description: At 11 a.m., she left the store and went to the admissions office of the private primary school, carrying the household registration booklet, birth certificate, and other materials. After waiting in line for about half an hour, she successfully completed the registration procedures, paid part of the first semester's fees as a deposit, and received the admission letter printed with the school badge with both hands. As she walked out of the school gate, she let out a long breath and sent a WeChat message to her husband: “Xuanxuan’s elementary school is finally settled.”

events.name: An afternoon of both joy and pressure
events.description: After returning home, Song Yajing placed the admission notice somewhere conspicuous in the living room, sat down, and quietly did the math: tuition plus the new average monthly expense of school-run transportation and after-school care would exactly need to be covered by her husband's project subsidy. She made herself a cup of fruit tea, opened her electronic ledger, and re-adjusted her monthly budget starting in July. Just then, her mother Lin Xiuying sent a video call asking about enrollment progress. Song Yajing held the admission notice up to the camera, and the two laughed together across the screen. Her mother reminded her to take care of herself and not worry too much.

events.name: Evening walk, meditation, and diary writing.
events.description: At 4:30 p.m., during the time after her daughter got out of school, the mother and daughter took a leisurely 15-minute walk in the community garden, then sat on a bench and did five minutes of mindful meditation. Song Yajing noticed that the gardenias in the garden had bloomed, and their fragrance was refreshing. When writing in her diary that evening, she specially wrote: 'Today there was both good news and heavy responsibility, but seeing Xuanxuan's smiling face made everything worth it. Weight 49.2 kg, maintained well.'

2025-06.daily_overview: A slightly plain but solid day. In the morning, I finished the new product display at the store; in the afternoon, I systematically studied macaron principles; in the evening, I felt worried after a close friend's vulnerable confession; during the evening walk, I ran into neighbor Aunt Zhang and chatted for a while; after meditating before bed, I fell asleep with a prayer for my friend.

events.name: Adjustment of the store's summer clothing display.
events.description: When she arrived at the store in the morning, a new batch of dresses happened to arrive. Song Yajing and Xiaomei rearranged the window display and the main in-store display stand according to color gradients, and moved several slow-selling old styles to the clearance area. During a break, she opened the Kuaituantuan backend and found that the return rate for the basic lucky bag had dropped from 30% in the first week to 5%, and she breathed a sigh of relief. Xiaomei was especially proactive today, and Song Yajing privately considered giving her a bonus next month.

events.name: Macaron theory and systematic learning
events.description: In the afternoon, alone at home, she opened the video tutorial recommended by her baking teacher, Master Chen. She watched and carefully recorded in a dedicated notebook the three states of meringue, the effect of folding technique on deflating, and the temperature offset correction value for her own oven. She planned to calibrate the oven with a thermometer before the next attempt. After watching the tutorial, she also took out the baking books she had bought before and reread the macaron chapter.

events.name: Comforting her pregnant best friend remotely.
events.description: At 5 p.m., just as she was about to leave to pick up her daughter, she suddenly received a long string of tearful voice messages from Li Meiling, pouring out how severe her second pregnancy morning sickness was—she couldn't eat and still had to grade final exam papers, feeling completely overwhelmed. Song Yajing immediately replied by voice: "When I was pregnant with Xuanxuan, it was the same for me. I threw up until the fifth month; if you hold on a few more weeks, it will get better." She also promised to bake her some soda crackers over the weekend to relieve the morning sickness. After hanging up, she silently prayed for her best friend in her heart.

events.name: Evening walk around Yundang Lake and chatting with neighbors
events.description: After dinner, the rain stopped. Mother and daughter went for a walk by the lake as usual, and this time they walked the full 30 minutes. On the way, they ran into their neighbor Aunt Zhang, who was also out for a stroll. Aunt Zhang enthusiastically shared some pickled sour plums she had made, saying they were good for relieving summer heat. Song Yajing smiled and thanked her, and promised to go to her home on the weekend to learn the recipe. After the walk, she wrote in her diary: "Today the breast tenderness has almost disappeared. On the third week of the low-sugar diet, my body feels lighter and lighter. Weight: 49.4kg."

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Calm and orderly, starting the new day according to routine.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: Worry about a friend lingers in her mind, but her heart stays calm thanks to regular self-care.

2025-06.daily_overview: The community marketing unexpectedly struck a chord, and the insurance consultation took a key step forward. In the morning, she used podcast quotes to connect with younger customers; in the afternoon, she met with an advisor and got a clear protection plan; in the evening, the couple further strengthened their rapport while discussing finances together. Because they were absorbed in the discussion, they went to bed a little later than usual.

events.name: Sharing golden quotes in the community and on WeChat Moments.
events.description: After arriving at the store in the morning, Song Yajing lightly edited an insight she had heard on a podcast a few days earlier from a niche brand founder about 'building trust through staple pieces,' paired it with actual photos of the store's basic items, and posted it to Moments and the customer community. Many young customers commented, 'The boss really gets it,' and a few post-95s customers privately messaged to ask about styling. Song Yajing patiently replied to each one. Her phone buzzed all morning, and community engagement hit a new monthly high.

events.name: Lucky bag clearance and order processing
events.description: Taking advantage of the light morning foot traffic, she and Xiaomei took new photos of the popular influencer-style dresses that had piled up from returns on Kuaituantuan earlier in the month, repriced them, made them into a lucky bag link for 99 yuan for two items, and put them on Kuaituantuan. In the community, she explained that these styles fit petite figures better, to avoid returns caused by sizing again. She also specifically reminded Xiaomei to proactively recommend more suitable styles to customers with fuller figures.

events.name: Meeting with insurance advisor
events.description: After contacting bank account manager Lin Xiaofeng at noon, she quickly scheduled a meeting with insurance advisor Li Ming at the community café at 2 p.m. Based on the family income and expenses provided by Song Yajing, Li Ming gave her two proposal documents: a critical illness insurance with a sum insured of 500,000 yuan, annual premium 7,600 yuan, covering until age 70, and a 200,000 yuan female-specific disease supplementary insurance with an annual premium of 1,500 yuan. As she listened, Song Yajing carefully noted key terms such as waiting period and waiver clauses. After Li Ming left, she sat alone in the café for another half hour, photographed the proposals, and sent them to her husband.

events.name: Late-night discussion between husband and wife about safeguards.
events.description: At 9 p.m., after their daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing spread the two plans on the coffee table and discussed them item by item with her husband Chen Zhiqiang. After a moment of reflection, Chen Zhiqiang said, "I'm the main breadwinner in the family. Buy 500,000 yuan of critical illness coverage for me first, and then you add that women's policy. That combination is more solid." This suggestion happened to match what her older sister Song Yawen had said on the phone earlier. Song Yajing solemnly wrote beside the plan: "Prioritize critical illness insurance for the male head of household." They talked late into the night and decided to buy the insurance as soon as possible.

events.name: Evening parent-child walk and meditation
events.description: At 6 p.m., she took her daughter for a 20-minute brisk walk around the neighborhood and bought a bag of bayberries at the fruit shop on the way. After returning home, she soaked the bayberries in salt water and then did meditation in the bedroom. In her bedtime journal she wrote: 'The tenderness in my right breast did not appear at all this month. It seems low-sugar eating and walking really help. My weight dropped to 49.0 kg, maybe because my appetite has been average lately.'

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Full of energy, both expectant and a little anxious about today's insurance consultation

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: Her financial management weak points are being addressed step by step, and the couple’s unity gives her an unprecedented sense of security.

2025-06.daily_overview: A packed yet rich Saturday: in the early morning, she declined Zhao Li's yoga invitation, but it planted a seed of interest; the watercolor painted by mother and daughter together captured family warmth; the family protection insurance intention was completed in one go; the debut English oral class, though nerve-wracking, was a step out of her comfort zone; and the parent-child time by the lake in the evening gently closed the day.

events.name: Morning yoga invitation from Zhao Li
events.description: At 7 a.m., Song Yajing was woken up by a phone call from Zhao Li, who invited her to an outdoor yoga class at Bailuzhou Park. Still sleepy and thinking about her morning watercolor class, Song Yajing politely declined, saying, 'I'll definitely go next week.' After hanging up, she remembered how relaxed her body felt after the early-morning yoga class on June 7, and decided to officially put this exercise on her schedule.

events.name: Watercolor course final parent-child art project
events.description: At 9:30 in the morning, mother and daughter arrived at the community art center on time. The theme of the last class was 'My Weekend'. Song Yajing and Xuanxuan divided the work — Xuanxuan drew the figures' outlines, and Song Yajing helped mix colors and paint the background. In the end, they completed a charmingly naive work, 'Our Weekend', in which the family of three was having a picnic on the grass, with mint-flavored clouds floating in the sky. The teacher praised Xuanxuan on the spot for great improvement in her line drawing.

events.name: Signing of family insurance purchase intention
events.description: When she hurried home after her watercolor class, the insurance broker was already waiting downstairs with the formal application form. Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang checked the terms item by item in the living room, and decided to arrange 500,000 yuan of critical illness insurance with her husband as the primary insured, add 200,000 yuan of female-specific disease insurance for Song Yajing herself, and supplement the whole family with a million-yuan medical insurance and accident insurance. The couple signed the insurance intent form on the spot and set the first premium payment for June 23.

events.name: First session of the English Speaking Workshop.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Song Yajing closed the bedroom door, put on headphones, and joined the online English speaking workshop. The course simulated a hotel check-in scenario. The teacher had everyone take turns speaking, but she was so nervous that she kept her microphone muted for half the class and only dared to type in the chat box. After the class, she pulled out her notes and, facing the mirror, repeated "I'd like to check in, please." Her odd pronunciation made Xuanxuan, who pushed the door open and came in, giggle.

events.name: Lakeside parent-child walk and shopping
events.description: At 5 p.m., she took her daughter for a walk along the shore of Yundang Lake for about 25 minutes. A passing mobile fruit cart caught her eye, so she bought some bayberries and lychees. The mother and daughter sat on a lakeside bench and did a few minutes of deep-breathing meditation. After returning home, Song Yajing wrote in her diary: 'Today I said my first complete English sentence. Even though I said it to the mirror, it's a start. My weight is 49.5 kg, and the watercolor class and English class made this weekend especially fulfilling.'

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Slept in until waking naturally on the weekend; thought about the watercolor and English classes with a blend of anticipation and mild nervousness.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: The awkwardness of personal growth mixed with the satisfaction of completing family tasks—tired but fulfilled

2025-06.daily_overview: Faith Life Day: In the morning, she prayed for the whole family at church and participated in sharing at a Bible study group. In the afternoon, she successfully baked a low-sugar pumpkin fa gao and regained her confidence. Later, she had a video call with her older sister about insurance and parenting, and in the evening, a video call with her parents in Quanzhou brought their hearts closer. The emotional connections throughout the day made her feel fulfilled.

events.name: Sunday Mass and Bible reading group
events.description: At 8:30 a.m., the whole family dressed neatly and went to the Catholic church in Siming District. During Mass, Father Wang Mingde encouraged everyone to “entrust the burdens of the family” to God. Song Yajing closed her eyes and prayed silently for her husband's safety at work, her daughter's adjustment to school, and the safe pregnancy of her best friend Li Meiling. After Mass, she stayed for the Bible reading group. Fellow churchgoer Aunt Lin Xiuying gave her a new Spiritual Diary notebook and encouraged her to write down her thoughts every day. Song Yajing gratefully accepted it and planned to start using it that day.

events.name: First try at pumpkin steamed cake was a success
events.description: At 2 p.m., Song Yajing decided to switch to a lower-difficulty recipe to change her mood. She mashed the steamed pumpkin, added cake flour, sugar substitute, and yeast, and strictly followed the recipe's proportions. An hour later, when she opened the steamer, the soft, golden sponge cake gave off a light sweet aroma and had a uniform, springy texture. She took a photo of the cross-section with her phone and sent it to her mother Lin Xiuying, proudly writing: 'I finally succeeded!' At dinner, the whole family enjoyed the sponge cake, and Xuanxuan gave a thumbs-up too.

events.name: Had an in-depth video chat with my elder sister Song Yawen.
events.description: At 4 p.m., her elder sister Song Yawen video-called from Shenzhen, and the two chatted for nearly an hour. Song Yawen was very supportive of her younger sister's decision to buy insurance and shared an insurance claim case from her own company. When the topic turned to parenting, Song Yawen suggested sending Xuanxuan to swimming lessons during the summer to build up her health. Song Yajing thought it was a good idea and immediately looked up information on nearby swimming pools.

events.name: Video call with parents in Quanzhou
events.description: At 6 p.m., the family of three sat around the phone for a video call with her parents in Quanzhou. Her father demonstrated his skillful movements in adjusting the volume of his hearing aid, and even specially took out the long Father's Day letter Song Yajing had written from under the glass plate on his desk and waved it in front of the camera; her mother happily announced that her knees no longer ached and that she had rejoined the square-dancing team, and reminded Song Yajing to prepare Xuanxuan's favorite meat zongzi in advance before coming back during summer vacation. After the call, Song Yajing's eyes became slightly moist, and she wrote down her gratitude in her Spiritual Journal.

events.name: Evening walk and weekly journal summary
events.description: After dinner, the rain stopped, and Song Yajing walked mindfully alone around the neighborhood for 20 minutes. After returning home and settling her daughter down to sleep, she wrote this week's gratitude list in her new spiritual journal: Dad adapting to his hearing aid, the family security plan about to be finalized, and Xuanxuan's progress in watercolor painting. Before going to sleep, she weighed herself at 49.3 kg, which she thought was the normal weight rebound from the steamed sponge cake.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Sunday morning is peaceful and soothing; she prepares to go to church with a grateful heart.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: Deeply nourished by faith and family love, feeling tender yet resolute at heart.

2025-06.daily_overview: The day the family protection plan was officially finalized. In the morning, she completed the key payment. Xiaomei took unexpected leave, keeping her busy in the store all day. At noon, she shared the relief of having it settled with her husband. In the afternoon, she handled packages and made an initial exploration of an autumn collaboration. In the evening, she went to bed early due to fatigue.

events.name: Insurance premium payment and contract confirmation.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Song Yajing went alone to ICBC, transferred the total annual premium of 7,600 yuan to the insurance company via mobile banking, and sent a screenshot to insurance consultant Li Ming for confirmation. Li Ming quickly sent back the official electronic policy. After carefully checking the insured person's information, coverage amount, and policy period, she long-pressed the image and saved it to her encrypted album. As she walked out of the bank, she felt a huge weight lifted off her shoulders.

events.name: Told her husband she was safe.
events.description: After leaving the bank, she made a brief call to Chen Zhiqiang, who was on a business trip out of town: “The premium has been deducted. From today on, you have a 500,000-yuan protective umbrella.” On the other end of the line, her husband was silent for two seconds, then said in a low voice, “Thank you for your hard work.” Song Yajing smiled and replied, “I’ve added armor for myself too.” Across the phone, both felt a heavy sense of security and support.

events.name: Running the shop alone and interacting with customers.
events.description: She had originally planned to arrive at the store at noon, but because Xiao Mei had to take leave due to an urgent family matter, Song Yajing arrived at the store at 10 a.m. and ran it alone all day. While receiving customers, she organized Kuaituantuan orders and also found time to photograph the newly arrived autumn clothing samples. During this time, a regular customer, Vivian, came by the store, and the two chatted about family and parenting for more than half an hour. Because she had been standing and walking for a long time, her calves felt a little sore.

events.name: Autumn collaboration and express package handling
events.description: At 3 p.m., she opened the autumn co-branded sample garment catalog sent by Zheng Kai from Hangzhou. She was especially taken with the silhouettes of two trench coats and one wool skirt, and immediately discussed color improvements and the minimum order quantity with Zheng Kai over WeChat. They initially agreed to go to Hangzhou in early July to see samples in person. Afterward, she packed the day's lucky bag orders by herself and contacted a courier for pickup.

events.name: Early bedtime and a short meditation.
events.description: At 6:30 p.m., she closed the store and went home. She was really too tired to go for a walk, so she just had a simple dinner. After settling her daughter down, she did 10 minutes of meditation in the bedroom and felt her tense nerves relax. Before bed, she wrote in her diary: “Today I ran the store alone, twice as tiring as usual, but once the insurance was settled, it felt like a weight had been lifted from my heart. Weight 49.4kg, have a good rest.” Then she turned off the light and went to sleep at 22:20.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: The goal is clear: today I will finally close the book on this important insurance matter.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: The family's most basic safety net has been woven, and an unprecedented sense of certainty wells up.

2025-06.daily_overview: Baking and Archiving Day: In the morning, work was handled efficiently at the store; in the afternoon, she prepared a heartfelt gift for her best friend with cute cookies and a "fail card"; she also received encouragement from Mrs. Liu. In the evening, she solemnly filed the insurance documents, and at night, the couple's words "we are one" brought the warmth of home to its peak.

events.name: Morning routine at the shop
events.description: After arriving at the store, Song Yajing posted the desired styles from Zheng Kai's autumn sample collection to the community for feedback, and two long-time customers directly wanted to book them. While noting down the customers' sizes, she taught Xiaomei how to use the new template to register pre-sale orders. Around noon, she also found time to go home and take out the butter that had been thawed the night before to bring it to room temperature. Xiaomei returned to work today, and Song Yajing breathed a sigh of relief.

events.name: Low-sugar butter cookies and a baking-failure record card.
events.description: Starting at 1 p.m., she kneaded low-sugar butter dough according to a simplified recipe, pressed out star and heart shapes with molds, and put them in the oven. During the 30 minutes of baking, she carefully hand-drew a cartoon fail record card — with a cracked macaron shedding wide noodle tears and a speech bubble beside it saying 'I'll be back' — preparing to send it with the cookies to her best friend Li Meiling, who was stuck at home with morning sickness. At that moment, she received a photo of a successful macaron from Mrs. Liu, sent from Hangzhou, with the message 'You'll succeed soon too.' Encouraged, Song Yajing took a photo and thanked her in return.

events.name: Insurance contract filing and electronic ledger setup.
events.description: After the cookies came out of the oven and cooled, Song Yajing took out the printed electronic insurance policy received the day before and put it, along with her husband's premium payment receipt, into the Family Protection transparent section of the family important documents box. Then she opened the family electronic ledger, created a new Insurance Special page, filled in the payment dates, amounts, and coverage periods for the critical illness insurance, women's specific disease insurance, and million-dollar medical insurance one by one, and set up a monthly automatic reminder.

events.name: A solemn thank-you between husband and wife
events.description: In the evening, Chen Zhiqiang returned home from a business trip. Song Yajing showed him the file box and electronic ledger. After carefully looking through them, her husband suddenly held her hand solemnly and said, "Thank you for everything you've done for this family." Song Yajing's eyes welled up, and she replied, "We are one." The two leaned quietly on the sofa for a while, no more words needed.

events.name: Evening walk and health tracking
events.description: Before dinner the rain stopped, and the family of three rarely had the chance to take a 15-minute slow walk together in the neighborhood. Song Yajing deliberately had her husband hold their daughter's hand and walk ahead, while she watched their backs from behind and felt extremely at ease. Before going to bed, she meditated as usual and wrote in her diary: 'My shoulders and neck are a bit tense today, but my heart is at ease. Weight: 49.5kg, steadily recovering.'

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Motivated by the impending sense of family security, she was especially methodical in her work.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: The unspoken understanding between husband and wife filled her heart with quiet joy.

2025-06.daily_overview: A day of baking for friendship. In the morning, I handled business at the store and had warm interactions with regulars. After lunch, Aunt Zhang came by to talk about baking tips. In the afternoon, everything from shopping to baking to packing went smoothly in one go, and I mailed a jar of low-sugar cookies and a card about a baking fail to my best friend's school, using real warmth to fight distance and busyness.

events.name: Morning customer interaction at the shop
events.description: When she arrived at the store, she saw that a middle-aged customer who had visited last week sent a WeChat message saying that her daughter had been praised by the teacher for wearing that floral dress at the school talent show, and she came specially to thank her. Song Yajing was delighted and took the opportunity to ask her to take a customer photo and post it to the community, and gave her a 10% off membership coupon. Afterwards, she checked the stock of cake flour and sugar substitute and found it was low, so she planned to go to the supermarket at noon to replenish.

events.name: Buy low-sugar ingredients at the supermarket
events.description: After closing the shop in the morning, she stopped by the nearby grocery supermarket and carefully selected cake flour, sugar substitute, unsalted butter, and a box of fresh blueberries. While checking out, she noticed the supermarket had set up a new health food shelf. She stood there for a while, noting down two seasoning brands for low-sugar desserts. When she got home, her neighbor Aunt Zhang was watering flowers downstairs and, seeing her carrying lots of bags, offered to help carry them upstairs.

events.name: Aunt Zhang visiting and baking exchange
events.description: At 1 p.m., Aunt Zhang came over with homemade mung bean cakes. Song Yajing had just tied on her apron and was about to bake cookies. Aunt Zhang shared the secret of flaky pastry crust passed down from her mother, and Song Yajing carefully wrote it down in her notebook. The two chatted about everyday things while baking cookies, and Aunt Zhang also agreed to teach her how to make traditional Hokkien pies. Song Yajing felt that talking with the older generation gave her more patience for cooking.

events.name: Making and packaging low-sugar butter cookies.
events.description: After seeing Aunt Zhang off, she continued making the cookies. This time she specially grated a little lemon zest into the cookie batter to enhance the flavor, and the whole house filled with a fragrant aroma while baking. After the cookies came out of the oven and cooled, she picked the twenty most intact-looking pieces and put them in an airtight glass jar. Around the jar she tied a handwritten card with twine that read, “To Meiling: Failure is the lunchbox of success. Eat this jar first, and then laugh at me.” She sprinkled the remaining cookie crumbs over her yogurt as her own afternoon snack.

events.name: Sent a warm care package by courier
events.description: At 4 p.m., she carefully placed the sealed jar and the hand-drawn failure record card into a cardboard box, stuffed it with bubble wrap, and personally took it to the courier station near the community, where she filled in Li Meiling's school address. On the package seal, she drew a simple smiley face with a red marker, took a photo of the box, and sent a WeChat message to Li Meiling ahead of time: "Tomorrow a failed artist will send you something."

events.name: Evening walk and end-of-day reflection.
events.description: After dinner, she walked for 20 minutes by Yundang Lake with her daughter. On the way, her daughter picked up a heart-shaped stone and said she wanted to give it to Aunt Li. After meditating at home, she wrote in her diary: 'The feeling of proactively caring about a friend is so much better than waiting to be cared for. Today, while baking cookies, I found myself humming a tune without realizing it. Weight: 49.3kg, maybe down a bit because of tasting the cookies.'

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Keep thinking about her close friend's difficulties, wanting to convey her concern through concrete actions.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: A sense of fulfillment from doing something for a friend welled up; although her body was a little tired, her spirit was recharged.

2025-06.daily_overview: In the morning, the store calmly handled a surprise inspection; in the afternoon, meditation at home made up for the disappointment of the canceled walk. The warmest moment was the delighted interaction when her best friend received the cookies, which made an ordinary Thursday afternoon sparkle. In the evening, her husband suggested going to the seaside on the weekend, and the family of three began to look forward to it.

events.name: The store successfully passed the temporary inspection
events.description: Around 10 a.m., staff from the local market supervision office suddenly came to the shop for a routine inspection, mainly checking the business license, purchase vouchers, and fire-fighting equipment. Xiaomei was a little flustered at first, but Song Yajing calmly took out the file box that had been organized long ago and led the inspectors to check the expiration dates of the fire extinguishers. The whole process passed smoothly in less than twenty minutes, and the inspectors also praised the shopping environment in the shop. Afterwards, Xiaomei said admiringly, "Boss, you are really steady." Song Yajing smiled: "After going through a lot, you become calm."

events.name: Meditate in the afternoon instead of taking a walk.
events.description: Because the afternoon was overcast and stuffy, seeming about to rain, and the morning inspection had drained some of her energy, Song Yajing gave up her planned evening walk and instead did a deep, long meditation at home for 25 minutes. She lit lavender essential oil and focused on her breathing. After finishing, she felt her whole pace had slowed down. She also trimmed the mint on the balcony while she was at it.

events.name: Li Meiling's moved reply and mutual agreement to share
events.description: At 3:10 p.m., her phone vibrated repeatedly. Li Meiling not only sent a photo of the opened cookie jar, but also a voice message with a teary voice: “This is so you—even when you fail, you still manage to make me laugh.” The two of them laughed together over the failed-baking-record-card idea on WeChat. Li Meiling also showed a photo of her own burnt cupcake from last time, and they agreed on the spot that from now on, all baking failures must be shared with each other and not hidden. Song Yajing felt warm inside, feeling that friendship doubled the meaning of baking.

events.name: Husband suggested a weekend beach plan.
events.description: At dinner, Chen Zhiqiang noticed that his wife looked a bit tired, so he proactively suggested taking their daughter to the beach along Huandao Road on Saturday morning to play in the sand, and they could also visit the nearby art museum in the afternoon. Song Yajing gladly agreed and immediately checked the tide table and parking information. When their daughter heard they were going to the seaside, she was so excited she ate a few extra bites of rice. This small family plan made the whole evening feel relaxed.

events.name: Evening shared reading with my daughter and journaling
events.description: At 8:30 pm, Song Yajing, unusually, didn't pick up her phone to handle her community groups. Instead, she leaned against the headboard and read a chapter of "Little Pea in First Grade" to her daughter. After her daughter fell asleep, she wrote in her diary: "Today my body didn't move much, but my best friend and I had a good laugh across the distance in our hearts—that counts as exercise too. Weight is 49.5 kg, steadily climbing back up. Tomorrow is the graduation ceremony, so I need to be well-rested."

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Feeling good, ready to take on Thursday's daily routine.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: A casual warm response from friends greatly enhanced the happiness of this day.
