2025-06.daily_overview: This was daughter Chen Lexuan's first graduation ceremony in her life. From the careful preparations in the early morning to the pride and tears at the ceremony, from the warmth of the family dinner to the empathetic celebration among the mothers in the community group, everything today revolved around watching her go and sending blessings. Because of the emotional release and social interaction, bedtime was delayed.

events.name: Busy morning preparations
events.description: At 7 a.m., Song Yajing changed Xuanxuan into the carefully chosen doctoral gown, carefully adjusting the bow tie and cap tassel, while her husband checked the battery level of the video equipment. Xuanxuan spun around in front of the mirror several times, asking over and over, 'Mommy, do I look like a real PhD?' Before leaving, Song Yajing put the small gifts she had prepared for the three main teachers—handwritten thank-you cards and hand cream sets—into the canvas tote bag. She hastily ate a couple of bites of egg for breakfast; she was a bit nervous.

events.name: At the graduation ceremony: pride and tears
events.description: At 8:30, the family of three arrived at the Siming District Experimental Kindergarten, signed in early, and took their seats. When Xuanxuan walked onto the stage as the children's representative and recited the graduation poem in her clear, crisp voice, Song Yajing held up her phone to record the entire time, but her eyes grew increasingly blurry. When her daughter read 'Thank you, Mom and Dad, for sending me to school,' her tears dropped onto the screen. Her husband silently handed her a tissue and gently patted her on the back. During the whole ceremony, she alternated between smiling and wiping away tears.

events.name: A hug and a commemorative photo together.
events.description: After the ceremony, the children hugged freely on the grass. Song Yajing, quick-eyed but slow-handed, captured the moment of Xuanxuan hugging her best friend tightly, both with tears at the corners of their eyes. Then she asked a parent to help take a solo photo of Xuanxuan in her doctoral gown, and also pulled her husband and daughter together with the homeroom teacher for a group photo with especially bright smiles. The scene was busy, and she felt some back soreness.

events.name: Family celebration lunch.
events.description: At noon, the family of three went to the previously reserved family-friendly restaurant and ordered the daughter's favorite tomato pasta and mango pudding. During the meal, Song Yajing and her husband raised their glasses to toast Xuanxuan on her graduation and discussed the summer schedule and preparations before starting elementary school. Xuanxuan excitedly showed off her graduation certificate again and again, saying she wanted to hang it on the wall by her little bed. Song Yajing didn't have much appetite and only ate most of a plate of pasta.

events.name: Mothers in the community resonated and were moved to tears.
events.description: Back home in the afternoon, Song Yajing chose a candid photo of Xuanxuan hugging another child from hundreds of photos, did some simple color grading, and posted it to the Yajing Lifestyle Club community with the caption "Watching you go is a mom's required course." Unexpectedly, the post was like a switch: dozens of mothers shared photos and heartfelt stories of their own children's graduations, and red packet rain instantly poured down in the group. A regular customer commented: "What I buy from you isn't just clothes — it's the ups and downs of being a mom." Song Yajing's eyes reddened again when she read this, and she replied with thanks one by one until late at night.

events.name: Small evening family celebration and video sorting.
events.description: At 8 p.m., Song Yajing took the low-sugar yogurt cake she had ordered in advance out of the fridge, lit the candles, and sang for her daughter. After dinner, the family sat on the sofa and watched the recording of the graduation ceremony. When Xuanxuan saw her own recitation segment, she shyly covered her face and hid in her father's arms. Before bed, Song Yajing copied all the photos and videos into a dedicated folder and named it Xuanxuan · First Graduation Memory.

events.name: Brief meditation and emotional journaling
events.description: Late at night, after settling everything, she did only a short 5-minute meditation to calm her mind, then opened her diary and wrote: 'Only today did I learn that letting go is not losing; it is making love bigger. Daughter, congratulations on upgrading from a kindergarten little eagle to an elementary school pilot. Weight 49.2 kg. I used a lot of energy today, but my heart is full.' It was past 23:30 when she went to sleep.

start_state.mood: Woke up early, excited and unwilling to part, feeling a swirl of mixed emotions.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road

2025-06.daily_overview: A settling day after the climax. In the early morning, the outdoor yoga with Zhao Li fulfilled a promise and brought physical and mental relaxation. In the morning, the watercolor painting created by mother and daughter was selected for the community gallery, an unexpected delight. In the afternoon, a work review and a vulnerable deep conversation with an old friend made her re-examine her support network. In the evening, the family walked by the seaside, fulfilling the plan from the previous two days, gentle and healing.

events.name: Morning outdoor yoga appointment
events.description: At 6:40 a.m., Song Yajing went to Egret Isle Park at Zhao Li’s invitation to attend an outdoor yoga class. Her movements were still a bit stiff, but the morning breeze and birdsong made her feel especially relaxed. Zhao Li praised her for making much more progress than last time, and they agreed to practice together every other week. After yoga, the two had rice porridge and small side dishes at a breakfast shop next to the park. Song Yajing felt her body had awakened and was in a great mood. After returning home, she took a shower and felt refreshed.

events.name: Joy of the watercolor class graduation exhibition and selection
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., the community art center held the graduation exhibition for the watercolor class. When Song Yajing walked with Xuanxuan to the exhibition wall, she was surprised to find that their mother-daughter collaborative piece "Our Weekend" and another painting "Mint on the Balcony" had both been selected by the teacher and placed in the most prominent position, with a small label beside the paintings reading "Song Yajing & Chen Lexuan". Xuanxuan excitedly tugged her mother's hand and jumped up, but Song Yajing suddenly felt like crying — she realized that these moments of companionship undisturbed by work were far more precious than any technique.

events.name: Continuing to validate the basic styles strategy on Kuaituantuan.
events.description: When she got home at noon, Song Yajing kept her promise from a week ago to check. She opened the Kuaituantuan backend and found that the conversion rate of the basic lucky bag was nearly 40% higher than that of the influencer style, with no new returns. She took screenshots of several sets of comparison data and wrote self-deprecatingly in her work notes: “This is a middle-aged person's practical reading — don't listen to empty talk, look at the data.”

events.name: Replying one by one to the warm feedback in the community group.
events.description: In the afternoon, she browsed the community chat log, took screenshots of the graduation remarks the mothers shared yesterday, and saved them to a dedicated album. She sent a private message to specifically thank the regular customer who had said, 'What I bought were the joys and sorrows of life.' The other party quickly replied that her son had also just entered primary school this year, and the two agreed to exchange parenting tips next semester. Then she organized the questions from several mothers, preparing to share parenting insights in the next community livestream.

events.name: In-depth phone call with Wu Xiaoli
events.description: At 3 p.m., high school classmate Wu Xiaoli took the initiative to call and congratulate Xuanxuan on graduation. After a few pleasantries, the conversation naturally drifted into their respective lives. Wu Xiaoli admitted that the Shenzhen internet company she worked for was reorganizing its business lines, and she worried every day about being laid off. Song Yajing also talked about her anxiety over the store's online transformation and the financial pressure of raising children. For the first time, the two dropped the facade of "doing well" over the phone and candidly shared the helplessness of middle-aged life. When the call ended, both felt a strange sense of relief. Song Yajing silently added Wu Xiaoli's name to her daily prayer list.

events.name: Family walk along the seaside on Huandao Road
events.description: At 5 p.m., they fulfilled the family plan from the day before, and the family of three drove to the seaside on Huandao Road. Xuanxuan ran barefoot on the beach while Song Yajing and her husband strolled hand in hand along the coastline. They watched the sunset dye the sea gold as their daughter built a sandcastle nearby. Song Yajing captured the peaceful scene with her phone, feeling grateful inside. After about 40 minutes of walking, they had a simple dinner at a nearby seafood stall and got home close to 8 p.m.

events.name: Wrapping up with journaling and meditation
events.description: At 9 p.m., after reading a bedtime story to her daughter, Song Yajing completed her meditation and wrote in her diary: “Today’s yoga made me discover that my body can be more flexible, and Xiaoli’s phone call made me understand that vulnerability is not frightening. Weight 49.4kg; after walking along the beach, I feel light all over.”

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road

2025-06.daily_overview: A new family tradition was born. In the morning, the proposal for a “quarterly parent-child new experience” was unanimously passed at the breakfast table. Later, we braved the rain to go to the church and the bookstore. In the afternoon, we went through our daughter's old things and mulled over summer plans, bought materials for July experiments at the supermarket, and in the evening the whole family curled up on the sofa listening to the rain and reading.

events.name: Family breakfast and the establishment of a new routine.
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, a light rain pattered outside the window. Song Yajing made her signature Minnan misua soup, and the family of three sat around the dining table. She mentioned how she felt about her watercolor painting being selected by a gallery yesterday, and suggested that from now on they try at least one new activity together each quarter to unlock shared experiences, such as pottery, camping, or learning to cook a dish from another country. Her husband and daughter clapped in agreement, and the three immediately set the first activity of the summer vacation as a parent-child pottery class, agreeing to book it next weekend.

events.name: Rainy church and prayers for growth
events.description: At 9 a.m., the couple held an umbrella and took their daughter to church. After Mass, Song Yajing went to see Father Wang Mingde alone and asked him to give a special blessing for her daughter's upcoming elementary school life. The priest gently placed his hand on Xuanxuan's head and said a brief prayer. The little girl closed her eyes, curious and serious. Song Yajing stood beside them with her palms together, silently giving thanks.

events.name: Selecting primary school books at a bookstore
events.description: After leaving the church, the family stopped into the Xinhua Bookstore next door. Song Yajing picked out a set of the pinyin version of Mi Xiaoquan's School Diary and a character tracing book for her daughter, while Chen Zhiqiang chose a children's encyclopedia. Xuanxuan walking toward the cash register with three books in her arms already had the look of a young elementary school student. Song Yajing also took a photo with her phone and sent it to the family group chat.

events.name: Sorting out her daughter's old clothes and donating them.
events.description: After the rain stopped in the afternoon, Song Yajing brought down two large boxes of clothes that Xuanxuan had outgrown from the attic. She folded the few little dresses with special sentimental value—including the christening gown from infancy and her first kindergarten uniform—and put them in storage bags. The rest she washed, folded neatly, and planned to take to the church charity collection point next week. While sorting through them, she couldn't help looking at old photos and sighed with her husband about how fast time flew. Her daughter ran over and said she wanted to keep the dress with the little rabbit for her doll, so Song Yajing smiled and cut off a small piece of fabric to satisfy her.

events.name: Buy baking ingredients for July at the supermarket
events.description: At 4 p.m., Song Yajing went to the supermarket alone. This time she deliberately bought an oven thermometer, a silicone macaron mat, and a bag of almond flour for baking, preparing to take on macarons again in July. She also bought unsweetened cocoa powder and vanilla extract, planning to try new flavors. On the way home, she sent a message to Master Chen: "Equipment upgrade complete. Please advise me, Master, in July!"

events.name: Evening parent-child reading and meditation
events.description: At 8 PM, mother and daughter leaned back on the sofa and opened the newly purchased Mi Xiaoquan's School Diary for the first time. Xuanxuan giggled while recognizing pinyin. After putting her daughter to sleep, Song Yajing completed her meditation and wrote in her diary: 'All the busyness and touching moments of June have finally settled in this quiet rainy day. Weight 49.6 kg, back to the level at the beginning of the month. I feel great. I'm going to start preparing for the school adjustment in July.'

2025-06.daily_overview: A month-end workday bridging the past and the future. In the morning, the shop review confirmed that the half-day model was running smoothly. In the afternoon, she handled insurance and financial matters and reviewed a fulfilling June. In the evening, after meditation and a parent-child story, she prepared for bed and began planning adjustment arrangements for starting elementary school in July. Before sleeping, she received a thank-you voice message from Li Meiling, drawing a warm close to June.

events.name: Monthly work review with Xiaomei.
events.description: After arriving at the store at 9 a.m., Song Yajing deliberately closed the store for an hour and sat down with Xiaomei for a formal monthly review. She first fully affirmed Xiaomei's ability to independently handle return disputes and customer maintenance, then together they reviewed the data to see how the half-day work model was performing—although afternoon foot traffic was slightly lower than in the morning, the conversion rate had actually improved a bit, showing that Xiaomei was fully capable of managing the store on her own. Song Yajing jotted down in her notebook, 'Consider giving Xiaomei a performance bonus or promoting her to store manager at the end of the year,' and encouraged her to continue providing product selection suggestions. Xiaomei was deeply encouraged.

events.name: Setting aside insurance funds and reviewing finances
events.description: When she returned home at noon, Song Yajing followed the new setting in her electronic ledger and transferred 633 yuan from June's household income into the specially established insurance reserve account, and marked next month's premium deduction date on the calendar. Then she opened the overall household income and expense sheet and briefly calculated the June shop profit, her husband's salary, and the final net loss from the Kuaituantuan trial-and-error. The loss was kept within budget, and the transition to basic styles was already showing signs of profitability, so she took a satisfied deep breath. In the afternoon, she also sorted out all of this month's electronic bills and archived them to the cloud drive.

events.name: June life review and July planning draft
events.description: In the afternoon, while her daughter was over at neighbor Aunt Zhang's house playing, Song Yajing opened her spiritual journal and health diary and reviewed the whole of June: her daughter's graduation, the insurance policy being finalized, the baking failure turning into community assets, the start of English classes, maintaining friendship with her best friend, a family walk by the sea, a new yoga attempt... On a new page, she wrote a July priority list: ① Hangzhou shopping trip in early July and face-to-face talk with Zheng Kai about the autumn collaboration; ② habit adjustment and school supply preparation for Xuanxuan before starting primary school; ③ daily English shadowing practice; ④ scheduling the summer visit to relatives in Quanzhou; ⑤ adjusting Xiao Mei's summer shift schedule; ⑥ second systematic attempt at macarons. After writing, she felt clear about her direction.

events.name: Evening walk and parent-child bedtime story.
events.description: At 6:30 pm, the sky cleared up, and the mother and daughter took a relaxing 20-minute walk in the neighborhood. Song Yajing deliberately walked behind her daughter, observing her greet other children in the community, and silently marveled at how fast she was growing. At 8:30 pm, after Song Yajing read a chapter of "Little Pea in First Grade" to Xuanxuan, her daughter hugged her neck and said, "Mom, will you take me to school every day when I start elementary school?" She answered seriously, "Yes, Mom promises you." After her daughter fell asleep, she did about 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation.

events.name: Received a voice message from her best friend before going to bed
events.description: At nearly 22:30, her phone lit up with a voice message from Li Meiling. She said the cookies had long been finished, today's prenatal check-up went smoothly, and she especially thanked Song Yajing for being there for her during the hardest time. At the end of the voice message, she said: “When your Xuanxuan starts elementary school, maybe our two children will end up at the same school.” Song Yajing listened with a smile and replied with a hugging emoji. At the end of her diary, she wrote: “Goodbye, June. July, I am ready. Weight 49.6 kg, just right.” Then she turned off the light and slept peacefully at 22:45.

2025-01.daily_overview: During the New Year holiday, Song Yajing did not open her shop. While sorting out the store accounts at home, she unexpectedly found that revenue had fallen for three straight months. A serious afternoon conversation with her husband turned into a joint decision that night to begin the online transition—a day marked by both anxiety and resolve.

events.name: Noticed a drop in revenue and began to calculate.
events.description: In the morning, her husband took their daughter out to play. Song Yajing was alone in the study, going through the store's transaction statements for the fourth quarter of 2024. After adding up the months with a calculator, she confirmed that revenue had declined by about 15% cumulatively from October to December. She frowned, and unease rose in her heart. She rechecked the purchase costs and fixed expenses and confirmed that it was not a bookkeeping oversight.

events.name: Couple's financial discussion and transition decision
events.description: In the afternoon, after her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing spread the reports on the living room coffee table and frankly told her husband Chen Zhiqiang about the store's difficulties. The two seriously analyzed the reasons: consumption habits shifting online and declining foot traffic on the pedestrian street. Chen Zhiqiang suggested using short videos and community groups to drive traffic. Song Yajing was initially afraid of the unfamiliar field, but her husband proactively promised to teach her step by step in his spare time after work, and suggested controlling the scale of investment first to protect the family's basic life. After weighing the options repeatedly, Song Yajing gritted her teeth and nodded, and the two reached an initial consensus.

events.name: The online transformation strategy has officially launched
events.description: After dinner, the couple listed the three-step transformation plan on the whiteboard in the study: learning to shoot, trying short videos, and activating the community. Song Yajing honestly admitted her fear of the camera and unfamiliarity with technology. Chen Zhiqiang opened Douyin to show several small shop outfit accounts, using examples to illustrate the feasibility, and they agreed to start the first lesson this Saturday. Song Yajing noted down the key points in her phone memo. Although she didn't sleep well, she now had a sense of direction.

events.name: Stress eating.
events.description: Late at night, after her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing sat alone at the dining table, feeling empty from the pressure of the transition. She took a piece of tiramisu from the fridge and unconsciously ate most of it. Guilt and anxiety interwove, leading her to sleep late.

events.name: Winter clothing categorization and storage preparation
events.description: In the morning, after taking her daughter to kindergarten, Song Yajing hurried home before opening the store. She divided all the winter coats, sweaters, and down jackets in the wardrobe into three piles by adult/child and frequency of wear. She set aside the children's clothes her daughter had clearly outgrown and outdated styles not worn in the past two years, and packed them in vacuum compression bags.

events.name: Made a division-of-labor plan for online learning

Chen Zhiqiang created a shared memo list on his phone so the two could keep track.

events.name: Used clothing recycling order submitted

2025-01.daily_overview: After closing the store on Saturday, Song Yajing, under her husband's hands-on guidance, filmed and published the first clothing short video of her life. Although the numbers were unremarkable, the reassuring feeling of taking the first step filled the day with the excitement of learning and trying.

events.name: Starting the first online lesson
events.description: In the afternoon, the shop had few customers. Song Yajing asked the clerk Xiaomei to mind the store, while she sat in the rest area, opened the first basic photography course recommended by her husband on her phone, and jotted down key points in a notebook as she watched. For the first time, she systematically learned about shot sizes, camera movement, and use of natural light.

events.name: Prepare props and equipment for filming
events.description: After closing the shop and returning home, Song Yajing followed her husband's checklist. She found a dusty phone tripod in the study's storage room and adjusted its height to chest level. Then she picked out three new spring outfits from the wardrobe—a floral print dress, a blazer-and-shorts set, and a knit cardigan—and paired them with shoes and accessories, placing them by the sofa.

events.name: Learning composition and light-and-shadow techniques
events.description: Chen Zhiqiang drew a simple rule-of-thirds diagram in the notes app on his phone, then moved the floor lamp in the living room to demonstrate how side light and front light affect the texture of clothing, and asked Song Yajing to take a few test shots for comparison. Song Yajing suddenly realized that she had never paid attention to the direction of light when taking product photos before.

events.name: Practicing in front of the camera for the first time
events.description: Song Yajing put on a floral dress and stood in front of her phone. At first her body was stiff and her eyes darted away. Chen Zhiqiang kept encouraging her to relax, showing her how to turn naturally and toss her hair. After five retakes, Song Yajing was finally able to smoothly perform the standing display, spin, and hands-in-pockets pose.

events.name: Used CapCut to complete the first short video edit.
events.description: Chen Zhiqiang took the phone, opened CapCut, and taught step by step how to split useless clips, adjust speed, and add the "Spring Outing" beat-sync BGM and the shop watermark. Song Yajing leaned close to the screen, nodding as she watched, and finally tried it herself. After revising three times, she exported the 15-second finished video, nervous with sweaty palms.

events.name: Publish the first video and observe the feedback.
events.description: With her husband's help, Song Yajing wrote the title "Spring Outfits for Petite Women | The Secret to Looking 5 cm Taller," added hashtags such as #XiamenClothingStore #TallerOutfits, and uploaded it to Douyin and Xiaohongshu. After posting, she refreshed every few minutes. Seeing a few likes and a comment saying "Looks good," she happily called her husband over to look.

events.name: Evening review and follow-up planning
events.description: Before bed, the two leaned against the headboard to review: over 30 views and 5 likes. Chen Zhiqiang said it was normal and that only persistence could build up results. Song Yajing used the memo app on her phone to note today's takeaways (composition, lighting, editing), and wrote down next week's goals: shoot real-scene outfits in the store, then learn the picture-in-picture function. She marked every Saturday afternoon on her calendar as 'Video Practice Time'.

events.name: Stayed up late due to excitement from filming
events.description: After lying down, Song Yajing was still immersed in the excitement of her first shoot. She picked up her phone again and scrolled through fashion blogger videos for half an hour, studying their transitions and filters, and only forced herself to sleep in the early hours of the morning.

2025-01.daily_overview: Monday: routine trip to the store to organize inventory and put out new merchandise. During work breaks, Song Yajing reviewed her notes on short-video shooting, and proactively scheduled coffee with Aunt Lin, a fellow church member, as a day to find an outlet for her feelings.

events.name: Store new arrivals and display adjustments.
events.description: After dropping off her daughter in the morning, Song Yajing went to the store and unpacked the new spring styles that had arrived last week together with Xiaomei, re-ironed and hung them, and put the featured piece on the mannequin by the entrance. She tried adjusting the color order of the adjacent racks using the color-matching knowledge she had learned the day before, and felt that the display did indeed look more pleasing to the eye.

events.name: Review the filming notes and practice briefly
events.description: When the store was quiet in the afternoon, Song Yajing took out her phone notes to review the three composition methods, and secretly shot a B-roll clip of the store's plants to practice camera movement. Xiaomei saw her and teased, 'The boss is going to become an internet celebrity!' The two of them burst out laughing.

events.name: Contact fellow church member Lin Xiuying to arrange a meeting.
events.description: In the evening, after handling customer WeChat inquiries, Song Yajing tapped on Aunt Lin's WeChat avatar. She first sent photos from the church activity to break the ice, then expressed her wish to meet and talk. The two quickly agreed to meet on Wednesday afternoon at 'Grace Coffee' near Zhongshan Road. After making the appointment, Song Yajing felt a faint sense of relief at being about to be listened to.

events.name: Received a call from the bank client manager.
events.description: In the afternoon while at the store, bank account manager Lin Xiaofeng called to recommend a fixed-term wealth management product. Because the store's cash flow was tight, Song Yajing briefly discussed with her husband and decided not to invest for now, continuing to focus on running the business.

start_state.location: Home on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen
start_state.mood: The calm under Monday's routine busyness

end_state.location: Home bedroom on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Song Yajing handled orders in the store while preparing for the next day's coffee chat, and also tried to draft ideas for the next video. Her fear of online content began to loosen a little.

events.name: Brainstorming the theme for the next video
events.description: In the morning when there were few customers, Song Yajing stood behind the cash register scrolling through the homepage of a local fashion account on Xiaohongshu, referring to how others showed details, and decided that the next video would focus on “three ways to wear a trench coat,” noting down the scenes and matching pieces she needed.

events.name: Handle wholesale orders and restocking.
events.description: In the afternoon, a regular WeChat customer placed a bulk order for 6 base-layer tops of the same style in different colors. Song Yajing immediately contacted supplier Susan to restock. Susan said stock for this style was tight and suggested a substitute. The two discussed it over a WeChat voice call for ten minutes and finally settled on a plan.

events.name: Mentally prepare for tomorrow's heart-to-heart talk.
events.description: After putting her daughter to bed, Song Yajing sat at the dressing table for a while, rehearsing in her mind the conversation with Aunt Lin tomorrow. She planned to candidly share her anxiety about the shop and her worries about her daughter's transition from kindergarten to primary school, and silently recited a familiar Bible passage to seek strength.

events.name: Baking failure
events.description: Before bed, she wanted to bake a tray of matcha cookies to bring to Aunt Lin the next day, but she didn’t control the heat well and burned the edges, so she had to throw them away. Wasting the ingredients made her a little disappointed, and it was nearly midnight by the time she finished cleaning the kitchen.

start_state.mood: Cautious anticipation

end_state.location: Home bedroom on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen.
end_state.mood: Ready to confide, but the baking failure brought some frustration.

2025-01.daily_overview: In the afternoon, a heart-to-heart coffee chat with fellow church member Auntie Lin let Song Yajing release her pent-up anxiety. In the evening, a warm parent-child craft session recharged her in her daughter's laughter. It was a day of emotional healing.

events.name: Keep the appointment for coffee and a heart-to-heart with Aunt Lin
events.description: After instructing Xiaomei to mind the shop at noon, Song Yajing walked to Grace Coffee. Aunt Lin was already sitting in a corner seat, smiling and waving. The two ordered a latte and a hot black tea. Song Yajing talked about her helplessness over the declining shop revenue and then mentioned the pressure of choosing a primary school for her daughter in two years, her voice choking up at one point. Aunt Lin patted her hand like a mother and shared a story from her younger days when her husband lost his job and she got through the hard times by making clay figures at a street stall. She also read out a passage from Matthew, Chapter 6, urging her not to worry about food and clothing. The conversation brought tears to Song Yajing's eyes, but she felt much lighter inside.

events.name: Say goodbye to Aunt Lin and return home
events.description: The conversation lasted nearly two hours. When she left, Aunt Lin gave her a small holy medal as a charm. Song Yajing walked back to the shop along the small street lined with mango trees, her steps much lighter than when she arrived.

events.name: Set up the parent-child craft area.
events.description: After picking up her daughter in the evening, Song Yajing first moved the odds and ends off the coffee table, spread out newspapers, took the new picture book Reunion, colored craft paper, safety scissors, and glue sticks from the study, and set up two small stools. Xuanxuan clapped her hands excitedly and said she wanted to make a lantern.

events.name: Parent-child reading together and making lanterns.
events.description: The mother and daughter squeezed together on the sofa. Song Yajing read the passage about making tangyuan during the New Year from 'Reunion' to her daughter in a mix of Hokkien and Mandarin. Xuanxuan listened intently. After reading the picture book, they folded and cut red craft paper to create the rough shape of a lantern. Song Yajing did the fine cutting, while her daughter drew bunnies and stars on it with crayons and stuck on a sequin. The mother and daughter worked together in perfect harmony.

events.name: Hummed a Minnan nursery rhyme and wrapped up.
events.description: During the making, Song Yajing naturally hummed 'Dianzi Dian Dingding', and her daughter followed along in a sweet childlike voice. The atmosphere was warm. When cleaning up, Xuanxuan carefully placed the still-damp lantern on the sideboard and urged her mother to bring it to the shop tomorrow to hang up. Song Yajing kissed her daughter on the forehead and promised her.

events.name: Learned about the church charity sale event.
events.description: When the coffee date ended, Aunt Lin invited Song Yajing to participate in the church's charity bazaar next month, suggesting she could donate some of her store's inventory. Song Yajing felt it was a good opportunity both to do good and to promote her store, so she decided to join.

start_state.location: Home on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen
start_state.mood: Weighed down with worries and in need of someone to talk to

end_state.location: Home bedroom on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen.
end_state.mood: The relief of being understood, and warmth filling the heart.

2025-01.daily_overview: Song Yajing used the last bit of time to book train tickets to Hangzhou and contact her best friend about staying over, while also making arrangements for the shop's operations over the next few days. Her anticipation for the trip was mixed with a faint sense of nervousness.

events.name: Book high-speed rail tickets and contact Zhao Min.
events.description: After opening the store in the morning, Song Yajing checked on her phone for high-speed rail trains from Xiamen North to Hangzhou East for the next afternoon, chose a window seat, and completed the payment. She then told her best friend Zhao Min on WeChat her arrival time. Zhao Min readily agreed to let her stay and said she would take her to try the pian'er chuan noodles near her home. Song Yajing sent a grateful emoji, feeling both anticipation and a little inferior about meeting her best friend from the e-commerce world.

events.name: Delegate store matters to Xiaomei.
events.description: During lunch together, Song Yajing spread out the delivery list for the next two days and the list of customers to contact for Xiaomei, telling her that if she came across styles she was unsure about, she should keep the items aside and wait for Yajing to decide. She also specially hung the newly made handmade lantern beside the cash register and explained that it was Xuanxuan's work and should be taken care of.

events.name: Prepared travel luggage and family arrangements
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing took a small suitcase down from the top of the wardrobe and packed two changes of clothes, a salon notebook, and a power bank. Chen Zhiqiang confirmed that he could take half a day off tomorrow to pick up their daughter, and gave an extra set of spare house keys to neighbor Aunt Zhang just in case. Before their daughter went to bed, Song Yajing told her specially that Mommy would be away on a business trip for two days. Although Xuanxuan was a little reluctant, she nodded understandingly.

events.name: Review basic e-commerce concepts again
events.description: Before bed, Song Yajing leaned against the headboard and skimmed a few introductory articles on private domain traffic and community fission on her tablet. Though she only half-understood them, it warmed up her knowledge for the salon the day after tomorrow.

events.name: A small incident while packing luggage
events.description: When packing, she found a mark from a watercolor pen on her favorite beige scarf, made by Xuanxuan. Song Yajing felt annoyed for a moment, but seeing her daughter's sleeping face softened her heart. She simply wiped it with a wet tissue and still put it into the suitcase.

start_state.mood: A slight excitement and unease before traveling

end_state.location: Home bedroom on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen.
end_state.mood: All ready; feeling both excited and afraid of being disappointed about the trip to Hangzhou.

2025-01.daily_overview: In the morning, she booked the dinner for next week's wedding anniversary; in the afternoon, she took the high-speed rail to Hangzhou alone. Seeing the daily life of an e-commerce influencer at her close friend Zhao Min's home, a sense of inferiority and anxiety quietly grew in her heart.

events.name: Reserve an anniversary dinner at a Western restaurant
events.description: Before going out, Song Yajing made a reservation through the official account of her usual Western restaurant, Lujiang Impression, for a window seat for two on the evening of January 15, and noted it was a wedding anniversary. The restaurant replied that they would gift a dessert. She was satisfied and sent a screenshot of the reservation to Chen Zhiqiang with the note: 'No matter how busy work is, we still need time for the two of us.'

events.name: Taking the high-speed rail to Hangzhou.
events.description: In the afternoon, Chen Zhiqiang took her to Xiamen North Station. After boarding the train with her suitcase, Song Yajing leaned against the window and watched the winter fields of southern Fujian recede behind her. Her mind was full of vague imaginings about the e-commerce salon, and inside her there was a tangle of the restlessness of wanting to change and the nervousness of fearing she could not learn it.

events.name: Arrived in Hangzhou and stayed at Zhao Min's home
events.description: In the evening, she arrived at Hangzhou East Railway Station. Zhao Min drove over to pick her up, and they chatted about college memories along the way. Zhao Min's home is in a quiet residential complex in Shangcheng District. The interior is simply furnished and full of the vibe of an e-commerce practitioner—whiteboards on the wall written with various GMV targets. Song Yajing was settled in the guest room. As she listened to Zhao Min talk about how a recent livestream had achieved 600,000 yuan in sales, she kept a smile on her face, but inside she compared it with her own store's dismal performance and felt a strong sense of inferiority and self-doubt.

events.name: Late-night chat with Zhao Min.
events.description: After eating the noodles Zhao Min had cooked, the two curled up on the sofa and chatted. Zhao Min shared her journey from being a Taobao customer service representative to operations director, and encouraged Song Yajing not to think too far ahead, but to start by producing every piece of content well. Song Yajing nodded, but she was still full of self-doubt about whether she could do it. Late at night, lying in an unfamiliar bed, she tossed and turned, unable to sleep.

events.name: Watch a movie on the high-speed rail for self-motivation.
events.description: On the high-speed train, Song Yajing watched a women's workplace movie on her phone. The protagonist's story of building a business from scratch gave her silent encouragement, reminding herself that the purpose of this trip was to learn and that she could not back down.

start_state.location: Home on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen
start_state.mood: Nervous yet hopeful mood before departure

end_state.location: Guest room at Zhao Min’s home, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou
end_state.mood: Inferiority and anxiety reached a recent peak; she felt she was far behind.

2025-01.daily_overview: She attended the e-commerce salon all day. Song Yajing, who had gone with a pilgrim's mindset, had cold water poured on her during the hands-on session when she found she couldn't even understand the backend settings. She felt deeply frustrated and discouraged, but her ability to withstand pressure was quietly growing.

events.name: Attending an e-commerce salon for theoretical learning.
events.description: Early in the morning, Zhao Min took her to the venue. The morning lecture topics were the underlying logic of livestream traffic and tiered community operations. Song Yajing listened very carefully, taking nearly ten pages of notes, and particularly agreed with the viewpoint of "leveraging trust from acquaintances to drive first orders."

events.name: Communicated with unfamiliar trainees during lunch.
events.description: During lunch, a female shop owner at the same table who also runs a women's clothing store mentioned that she had reached monthly sales of 5,000 yuan through WeChat Moments pre-sales. Song Yajing proactively added her on WeChat, and the two briefly exchanged thoughts on product selection difficulties. The other woman suggested she start with an internal purchase group for regular customers.

events.name: Suffered a major setback during the hands-on practice session.
events.description: In the afternoon, she entered a hands-on workshop. The instructor asked participants to set up a livestream preview in a simulated backend on the spot and write a sales pitch. Faced with a screen full of jargon (DSR, UV, GPM) and complicated function buttons, Song Yajing had no idea where to start. She tried several times but made mistakes each time. The young trainees around her finished quickly. Staring at her lagging screen, her cheeks burned as a deep sense of frustration welled up.

events.name: Returned dejectedly after the salon ended.
events.description: In the evening, when the event ended, Song Yajing took the subway alone in the light rain back to Zhao Min's home. Along the way, she repeatedly regretted her helplessness during the hands-on practice session and even began to doubt whether the trip to Hangzhou had been a mistake. Zhao Min noticed her low spirits, so that evening she deliberately bought dessert to comfort her and suggested that she focus on only one or two platforms instead of trying too many.

events.name: Zhao Min's dessert therapy
events.description: In the evening, Zhao Min brought back the tiramisu that Song Yajing likes. The two chatted about funny college stories while eating. Zhao Min shared her own awkward experiences when she first entered the industry, making Song Yajing understand that everyone starts out as a beginner, and her mood eased.

start_state.location: Zhao Min's home, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou
start_state.mood: With morbidly low self-esteem but still holding hope for studying.

end_state.location: Zhao Min's home, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou
end_state.mood: Severe frustration, self-doubt, but it also stirred up a refusal to give up.

state.daily_exercise: About 4,500 steps walking to and from the venue

2025-01.daily_overview: The lunch with former colleague Zheng Kai was the turning point of her trip to Hangzhou. She received practical advice and sample support for starting with an acquaintance-based community. As she boarded the high-speed train home that afternoon, she once again felt courage to start from small actions gathering in her heart.

events.name: Had lunch with former colleague Zheng Kai and received advice.
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing said goodbye to Zhao Min and dragged her luggage to an agreed small restaurant to meet Zheng Kai. Zheng Kai was wearing a designer-style black jacket and spoke as bluntly as always. After listening to her experience of the salon setback, he told her directly that she didn't need to do livestreaming right now, and instead suggested focusing on WeChat communities and short videos, starting with long-time customers who trusted her. He then called his studio colleague on the spot and arranged to send her several sets of new-season designer women's clothing samples to take back to Xiamen to test the market.

events.name: Received the sample delivery commitment from Zheng Kai
events.description: After dinner, Zheng Kai asked a colleague to pack up three sets of samples and deliver them to the restaurant, telling Song Yajing to take them home, take photos, and post them to the group to see the response; if they sold well, she could restock. Song Yajing was touched and thanked him, feeling that Zheng Kai's suggestion was like a beam of light shining into her confidence, which had been battered to pieces over the past few days.

events.name: Take the high-speed rail back to Xiamen
events.description: In the afternoon, dragging a suitcase heavier than when she came (stuffed with samples and local specialties from Zhao Min), she boarded the high-speed train back to Xiamen. The rain outside the window had stopped. Song Yajing opened her notebook in her seat and reorganized all the useful suggestions and reflections from the past two days into bullet points, resolving to take action immediately upon returning to Xiamen — the first step being to take photos and post them in the group chat to build anticipation.

events.name: Returned home and had a brief conversation with her husband
events.description: Got home after 8 p.m.; her daughter was already asleep. Chen Zhiqiang reheated the meal. As she ate, Song Yajing briefly talked about her experience in Hangzhou and showed her husband the fabric and tailoring of Zheng Kai's samples. Her husband affirmed what she had gained and encouraged her to start the community warm-up tomorrow.

events.name: Minor couple's quarrel and reconciliation
events.description: Feeling too tired, Song Yajing complained that her husband had only cooked instant noodles, which was not nutritious. Her husband was silent, and the atmosphere became tense for a while. Before going to bed, her husband voluntarily apologized, said he understood her stress, and promised to share more household chores in the future. Song Yajing also apologized, and the two reconciled.

start_state.location: Zhao Min's home, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou
start_state.mood: Low after the setback, but faintly looking forward to meeting Zheng Kai.

end_state.location: Home bedroom on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen.
end_state.mood: Regained a small, concrete direction for action, and anxiety eased.

state.daily_exercise: About 5,000 steps of walking at the high-speed rail station and around the city.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Monday, Song Yajing rested at home. After systematically sorting through what she had gained from the Hangzhou trip, she and her husband finalized the specific division of work for the community warm-up and the short-video trial late at night, and confirmed the logistics of Zheng Kai's samples. For the first time, the transformation path became clear and actionable.

events.name: Resting at home and reorganizing notes
events.description: After sending her daughter to school in the morning, Song Yajing did not go to the shop (leaving it entirely to Xiaomei). Instead, she sat at her sun-drenched desk and reorganized the dozen-plus pages of notes from Hangzhou into three categories: things to do immediately (community warm-up), things to learn (editing skills), and things to shelve for now (live streaming), marking them with different-colored highlighters. After finishing, she felt her thoughts were much clearer.

events.name: Extract key actionable takeaways
events.description: She highlighted what Zheng Kai and Zhao Min both mentioned about "starting with a community of regular and familiar customers," plus the e-commerce salon lesson about "building trust with real outfit photos." She decided to give up the unattainable livestream and devote herself wholeheartedly to reviving her WeChat community.

events.name: Confirm the final transformation strategy with my husband late at night.
events.description: After putting their daughter to sleep in the evening, Song Yajing shared her organized thoughts with Chen Zhiqiang. The two compared household expenses and possible time commitments, and finally settled on the goals for this phase: use Zheng Kai's samples to launch the first warm-up pre-sale in the group within the week, while maintaining at least one short-video practice session per week. Chen Zhiqiang promised to continue handling technical guidance, and Song Yajing would be responsible for content and customer communication.

events.name: Contact Zheng Kai to confirm sample logistics.
events.description: After finalizing the strategy, Song Yajing immediately messaged Zheng Kai on WeChat to confirm the specific style names of the three sample sets and the tracking numbers of the packages already sent, and told him that the receiving address was the store. Zheng Kai replied, 'It will arrive tomorrow morning,' and included the wholesale reference price for each set of clothes. Song Yajing saved the pricing information, ready to take photos tomorrow and then list them in the community group.

events.name: Frustrated while learning video editing
events.description: In the afternoon, I tried editing a simple travel vlog with CapCut, but after an hour it still wasn't going smoothly. Frustrated, I threw down the stylus pen. After calming down, I picked it up again and sighed that online skills are not built in a day, so I decided to rest tonight.

start_state.location: Home on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen
start_state.mood: After returning, I need time to process; my thoughts are a bit scattered.

end_state.location: Home bedroom on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen.
end_state.mood: The grounded feeling after sorting out her goals made her anxiety drop significantly, but the failed editing left a small sense of frustration.

state.daily_exercise: Mild activity at home, about 1,500 steps. Prolonged sitting caused soreness in the lower back; applied a medicated plaster to relieve it.

2025-01.daily_overview: Designer Zheng Kai's samples arrived at the store as scheduled. Song Yajing quickly took photos, edited them, and posted them in the community as a teaser. The mom group members responded enthusiastically, and several regular customers expressed interest in buying. On the road to transformation, she received her first real positive feedback.

events.name: Sign for and quality-check Zheng Kai's samples.
events.description: At 10 a.m., the courier delivered the package from Hangzhou. Song Yajing and Xiaomei opened it together. The three items were a French-style balloon dress, an elaborately embroidered blouse, and a knit vest with wide-leg pants. The fabric and workmanship were more refined than she had expected. She carefully checked the stitching and buttons, and there were no flaws.

events.name: Take photos of the samples from multiple angles
events.description: Taking advantage of the good natural light in the store, Xiao Mei held a reflector while Song Yajing used her phone to take flat-lay, hanging, and close-up detail shots of the clothes (neckline, hem, fabric texture). She then imported them into Meitu to fine-tune the brightness, add warm tones, and apply the store logo watermark.

events.name: Post a teaser in the community and collect feedback.
events.description: She posted the edited nine-grid photo to the "Yajing Life Gallery" group, along with a sincere introduction: "Ladies, a designer friend in Hangzhou sent over new spring styles. Take a look and see which ones you like. If enough people are interested, Yajing will go negotiate a better price ~" Within five minutes, a regular customer @-mentioned her asking about fabric and price, and another mother directly said she wanted to reserve the vest set. Song Yajing replied while jotting down their intentions, and soon half a page of her small notebook was filled.

events.name: Track interested parties and follow up privately
events.description: In the afternoon, customer traffic gradually picked up. Based on interactions in the group and private messages, Song Yajing summarized the most popular items and separately messaged customers who had shown clear interest, informing them of the expected pre-sale discount. A regular customer, Vivian, sent a private message saying she wanted to stock up on two pieces for spring. Song Yajing happily promised to notify her as soon as they arrived.

events.name: The couple shared their joy before bed.
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing excitedly showed her husband the booking records. They leaned against the headboard and talked about possible future developments until late at night. Chen Zhiqiang promised to help her shoot short videos on the weekend, and Song Yajing's confidence gradually grew.

events.name: Stress eating
events.description: While hurriedly replying to messages in the afternoon, Song Yajing unconsciously ate two small pieces of tiramisu and drank a large glass of fruit tea. After realizing it, she felt a little regretful, but comforted herself that today was worth celebrating.

start_state.mood: A slightly expectant daily state

end_state.location: Home bedroom on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen.
end_state.mood: Joy from the successful community warm-up, confidence beginning to take root, but her lower back ached from standing too long.

2025-01.daily_overview: Even amid her busy schedule, she made sure to keep some couple time for their wedding anniversary. That evening, after leaving their daughter with a neighbor, Song Yajing and her husband rekindled the warmth of their early romance over a candlelit dinner, adding a soft comma to a stressful two weeks.

events.name: During the day, tended the store as usual and handled community matters.
events.description: In the morning, after Song Yajing arrived at the store, she continued following up on yesterday's pre-sale leads. A customer who had been hesitant placed a formal order for a shirt, and she immediately noted it down and thanked her. In between, she took the time to carefully hang the lantern her daughter had made next to the fitting room, feeling it added a New Year atmosphere to the store.

events.name: She entrusted her daughter to her neighbor, Aunt Zhang.
events.description: In the afternoon, she closed the shop early, went home, bathed Xuanxuan and changed her into clean clothes, then took a box of the butter cookies she had baked last night and knocked on the neighbor Aunt Zhang’s door. Aunt Zhang took Xuanxuan, smiled, and told her to go enjoy her date. Xuanxuan also waved and said goodbye obediently.

events.name: Having a wedding anniversary dinner with her husband.
events.description: In the evening, Chen Zhiqiang drove Song Yajing to the 'Lujiang Impression' Western restaurant. They sat by the window, with the lights of Gulangyu outside. They started by talking about the awkwardness of their first Western meal when dating, and laughed out loud. Chen Zhiqiang raised his red wine glass and sincerely thanked her for everything she had done for the family and the store, saying he would support her no matter how the transition turned out. During the meal, he took out a carefully prepared gift of pearl earrings. Song Yajing was so moved that her eyes turned red, and she felt all the pressure had been worth it.

events.name: Take a walk after the meal and pick up her daughter
events.description: After dinner, the two of them walked a short stretch along the seaside boardwalk, and the sea breeze blew away some of the alcohol smell. After returning to the building, Song Yajing went to Aunt Zhang’s home to pick up her daughter. Xuanxuan had already fallen asleep, and when she was gently picked up, she murmured “Mommy.” Song Yajing thanked Aunt Zhang, carried her daughter back to their bedroom, and her heart was filled with tenderness and strength.

start_state.location: Home on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen
start_state.mood: Slightly looking forward to the anniversary, work pace slowed a little.

end_state.location: Home bedroom on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen.
end_state.mood: A sense of peace surrounded by love, inner strength recovering, but obvious physical fatigue.

2025-01.daily_overview: An ordinary workday filled with work and family responsibilities. In the morning, Song Yajing watched the store while designing promotional materials for the first online pre-sale and contacting suppliers to confirm samples; in the afternoon, she handled insurance renewal matters, and only after repeatedly confirming with her husband and best friend did she feel at ease paying; in the evening, her sister suddenly confirmed she would visit on the weekend, which made her look forward to the upcoming reunion but also vaguely feel that her schedule had become tighter.

events.name: Get up early to prepare breakfast for daughter and take her to kindergarten
events.description: At 7:00 in the morning, Song Yajing got up quietly, prepared a small bowl of wontons and milk for her 5-year-old daughter Chen Lexuan, braided her daughter's hair, and reminded her to listen to her teacher at kindergarten. Then she took her daughter's hand and walked her to the kindergarten near the residential complex. After returning, she did some simple housework and prepared for the day's work.

events.name: After arriving at the store, she tidied the displays and updated the inventory records.
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., Song Yajing arrived at Shop No. 36 on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, opened the door to let in air, and adjusted the window mannequin outfits with Xiaomei, changing them into the early-spring light jackets that had just arrived at the store. Then she sat at the cashier counter and checked the winter clothing inventory against her account book, calculating cash flow as she considered which styles needed restocking and which were to be discounted after the New Year.

events.name: Design promotional images for the first online presale and contact suppliers to confirm
events.description: Taking advantage of the quiet morning period with fewer customers, Song Yajing took out her phone and photographed two designer samples sent by Zheng Kai — a floral chiffon shirt and a pair of cigarette pants. She used a photo editing app to adjust the colors and added the text 'Yajing's Selection · First Presale.' She then called Zheng Kai, who was far away in Hangzhou, via WeChat to confirm one by one the shirt's fabric composition, the available stock quantities for the pants in five sizes, and the minimum wholesale price, and agreed on a logistics arrangement where Zheng Kai would ship on her behalf.

events.name: Posted a pre-sale notice in the customer group and observed reactions.
events.description: At 3 p.m., Song Yajing posted a carefully edited preview in the 'Yajing Lifestyle Pavilion' WeChat group, with the pictures she had made in the morning, explaining that these two styles were designer-brand exclusives in limited quantities, and the official group buying would start at 8 p.m. tomorrow. After the message was sent, people in the group gradually @-mentioned her asking about sizes and colors. She replied to each one patiently, feeling both excited and afraid the event would fall flat.

events.name: Received the insurance renewal notice and went home to discuss it with my husband.
events.description: At 5 p.m., Song Yajing saw the notice from the insurance company in her phone email about renewing the comprehensive family insurance policy, with an annual premium of 5,800 yuan covering auto insurance, home property insurance, and accident insurance. In the evening, after picking up her daughter and returning home, she handed her phone to her husband Chen Zhiqiang when he got off work. The two sat on the living room sofa and briefly discussed it, agreeing that their family protection could not lapse and deciding to renew.

events.name: Consulted her best friend Wang Jia to confirm the insurance terms for the shop's property.
events.description: Because the insurance policy included home contents insurance, Song Yajing was unsure whether the goods in her store inside the commercial building were covered. After dinner, she contacted her close friend Wang Jia, a product manager in Shenzhen, via WeChat voice message. Wang Jia carefully reviewed the electronic policy documents and confirmed that the store property, not being part of the residence, was not covered under the family policy, and suggested she consult separately about commercial insurance. Song Yajing breathed a sigh of relief—at least she had a clear picture.

events.name: Used the family savings card to pay the insurance renewal fee.
events.description: At 9 p.m., Song Yajing opened the banking app and transferred 5,800 yuan from the family savings card to pay the insurance premium in one lump sum. The network froze for two seconds during the payment, and her heart tightened, but then it showed the payment was successful. She took a screenshot and sent it to Chen Zhiqiang, and the two briefly confirmed it on WeChat.

events.name: Confirm the weekend visit itinerary with my sister Song Yawen.
events.description: Before going to bed, Song Yajing received a screenshot of a high-speed rail ticket from her sister Song Yawen, showing train G1602 on January 18 arriving at Xiamen North Station at 1:45 p.m. The sisters talked on WeChat voice call for more than ten minutes and agreed to go to Zhongshan Road together to buy spring clothes for her daughter Lexuan. Song Yawen also said she would bring a little gift she had bought in Shenzhen. After hanging up, Song Yajing marked the plan for that afternoon on her calendar and felt a wave of warmth in her heart.

events.name: Before bed, she browsed fashion news and baking recipes.
events.description: Before falling asleep, Song Yajing lay half-propped against the headboard and scrolled through Xiaohongshu for twenty minutes. She watched a few short videos on spring outfits, then came across an improved no-bake tiramisu recipe and saved it, thinking she could make it for her mother when she visits Xiamen in a few days.

start_state.location: In the bedroom at home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen.
start_state.mood: Slightly tired but in decent spirits; she was preoccupied with the online pre-sale, with a faint sense of tension

end_state.mood: After handling the insurance and advance-sale preparations, the tense string in her mind relaxed a little. Thinking that her older sister would come on the weekend, she felt a trace of anticipation and fell asleep relatively peacefully.

state.daily_exercise: Morning and evening, she walked to pick up and drop off her daughter, about 40 minutes in total, 5,000 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning to light rain, 12-15°C

2025-01.daily_overview: The first online pre-sale day officially launched, and Song Yajing was on edge all day. After arriving at the store in the morning, she did the final link test, and at 8 p.m. the group-buy started on time. Within just a few hours, she received 5 orders. Though the number was small, it made her truly feel the viability of the online channel. At the same time, the electronic policy for the insurance renewal also arrived, providing another year of protection for the family’s financial risk, and she breathed a small sigh of relief.

events.name: After taking her daughter to school, she arrived at the shop early to prepare for the presale.
events.description: After sending her daughter to kindergarten at 7:30 in the morning, Song Yajing arrived at the shop half an hour earlier than usual. She and Xiaomei re-ironed two pre-sale samples, took some close-up photos of the collars and cuffs with her phone, and used her memo app to list the size chart and pre-sale rules, making sure the evening launch would go off without a hitch.

events.name: Officially release the pre-sale link and reply to inquiries in real time
events.description: At exactly 8 p.m., Song Yajing sent the presale link and detailed illustrated instructions in the 'Yajing Lifestyle Studio' group, launching two designer sample items: a floral chiffon shirt and cigarette pants, with promotional prices and estimated shipping times marked separately. The group immediately became lively. She stayed nervously by her phone, quickly replying to questions about whether the sizes ran true and whether the fabric was sheer, her fingers slightly sweating as she typed.

events.name: Recorded 5 pre-sale orders and confirmed each one via private message.
events.description: About two hours after the group buy opened, Song Yajing had received 5 orders. She took out a dedicated pre-sale record notebook and wrote down each customer's nickname, style, size and color, then sent a private message to each customer to confirm the information, along with a word of thanks. One regular customer, Vivian, ordered two pieces and specifically said she would recommend them to her colleagues.

events.name: Interacting with walk-in customers between cashier duties.
events.description: During the day the store operated as usual. Several tourists came in during the morning and afternoon; one young girl tried on a sweater vest and paid without hesitation. Song Yajing neatly folded the clothes and bagged them, then took the opportunity to invite her to scan the QR code and join the group chat, saying there was a designer pieces pre-sale that night. The girl smiled and joined.

events.name: Received the electronic insurance policy and archived it.
events.description: A little after 3 p.m., she received the electronic policy from the insurance company on her phone. Song Yajing carefully checked the policyholder, the insured, and the coverage period, confirming that the renewal was successful and the coverage would remain valid through January 2026. She downloaded the PDF file to both her phone and laptop, and also backed it up in her WeChat Favorites, feeling as if a weight had been lifted from her mind.

events.name: In the evening, shared the pre-sale results with her husband.
events.description: Around 10 p.m., after putting their daughter to sleep, Chen Zhiqiang returned to the living room, and Song Yajing excitedly handed him the pre-sale record book. Chen Zhiqiang smiled and patted her head, saying, “The first step is taken—great.” The two sat on the sofa and briefly reviewed customer feedback. Chen Zhiqiang suggested making a short video to introduce sizes next time, and Song Yajing nodded and made a note.

events.name: Browsing the preschool-to-primary-school forum before bed to ease a bit of anxiety.
events.description: After washing up and lying in bed, Song Yajing remembered that her sister was coming tomorrow and might bring up Xuanxuan's school enrollment again. She couldn't help opening the browser on her phone to search for "Siming District primary school enrollment policy", read a few posts on a local forum, and learned about the catchment areas and registration times of several popular primary schools. Her anxiety seemed to be covered by a thin veil, and she suppressed it for the time being, then fell into a dazed sleep.

start_state.mood: Nervous and expectant, as if about to face a small test, but in higher spirits than the past few days

end_state.mood: The reassuring feeling from the modest presale results eased the anxiety of the past few days, and she had a slight smile on her lips before going to bed

state.daily_exercise: Walking to pick up and drop off my daughter and moving around the shop, totaling about 5,000 steps

date_attribute.weather: Partly cloudy, 13-19°C

2025-01.daily_overview: A day of beauty and anxiety intertwined. In the morning, Song Yajing studied the arrangements for the next day's primary school open day with her husband at the shop, and urgently finished shipping the pre-sale orders. In the afternoon, she welcomed her elder sister, who had come from Shenzhen. The two sisters shopped along Zhongshan Road to pick out clothes for Xuanxuan, but the pleasant atmosphere was broken when her sister reminded her about school choice. That night, the suppressed anxiety turned into a nightmare. She dreamed that the shop went bankrupt, and after waking with a start, she could not fall back asleep for the rest of the night.

events.name: Check the open day information for the two primary schools in advance and discuss the itinerary with her husband.
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing sat at the dining table in the living room, opened the official websites of Siming District Experimental Primary School and the Primary School Affiliated with the Foreign Language School on her laptop, and confirmed the specific time, required documents, and transportation route for the next day's Parent Open Day. Chen Zhiqiang brewed two cups of tea and sat down beside her. The two of them discussed the compact itinerary over a map, planning to go to the Experimental Primary School first tomorrow and then rush to the Foreign Language School in the afternoon, and jotted down a few questions on a sticky note, such as class size and after-school extended care services.

events.name: Going to the store to organize pre-sale orders and place a formal purchase order with Zheng Kai
events.description: At 10 a.m., Song Yajing hurried to the store, organized the five pre-sale orders from the previous night into a table, and sent it to Zheng Kai via WeChat, noting the size and delivery address for each style, and asking him to ship them directly from Hangzhou on her behalf. At the same time, she asked Xiaomei to find the matching packaging bags and dust bags in the store's warehouse in case they needed to send out any packages themselves. She also posted a thank-you message in the community, adding, 'There will be more new styles after the New Year, so stay tuned.'

events.name: Went to Xiamen North Station to pick up my older sister Song Yawen.
events.description: At 1:40 p.m., Song Yajing drove the family's white Toyota Corolla to the underground parking lot of Xiamen North Station and met her sister Song Yawen at the exit, who was pulling a small carry-on suitcase. As soon as they saw each other, the two sisters warmly linked arms. Song Yawen complimented her on looking better than in their last video call. Song Yajing smiled and said, 'I've been busy with the online transformation lately, so I haven't been sleeping well.'

events.name: Shopping for spring clothes for her daughter with her sister at a children's clothing store on Zhongshan Road.
events.description: The elder sister suggested they just go for a stroll and buy some new clothes for Xuanxuan while at it. The two walked to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street and went into three children's clothing stores in a row. Song Yawen picked up a pink hoodie and held it up against Xuanxuan, while Song Yajing took a fancy to a pair of denim overalls. During the fitting, Song Yawen casually mentioned that school district housing in Shenzhen had skyrocketed, and that her friends were scrambling to get their kids into school. She turned to Song Yajing and said seriously, "Xuanxuan will be starting elementary school soon. You need to plan early. The competition for good schools in Siming is no less fierce than in Shenzhen." Song Yajing's originally relaxed mood instantly clouded over.

events.name: The two sisters sat and chatted in a street-side drink shop.
events.description: Midway through shopping, the two each ordered a cup of fruit tea and sat outside the drink shop chatting. Song Yawen shared some foreign trade market updates, saying orders showed signs of recovery this year, but also lamented that the overall environment was unstable. Song Yajing then talked about her attempt at community pre-sales. Her sister encouraged her, "Take it slow, at least the direction is right," but the conversation unconsciously circled back to children's education, and that invisible pressure kept washing over them like the tide.

events.name: In the evening, arrange for her sister to stay overnight at home and discuss school selection with her husband.
events.description: At 6 p.m., Song Yajing settled her sister into the guest bedroom, then went into the kitchen to heat up a few home-style dishes. At the dinner table, Chen Zhiqiang chatted with Song Yawen for a while about her work in Shenzhen. After dinner, her sister went back to the room to rest. Song Yajing pulled her husband aside on the balcony and quietly told him about the school district housing and competitive pressure her sister had mentioned during the day. Chen Zhiqiang comforted her not to be too anxious, but both realized that this matter could not be put off any longer.

events.name: Woke up from a nightmare and couldn't sleep until late at night
events.description: After falling asleep, Song Yajing had a chaotic dream—all the clothing racks in the shop were empty, the fluorescent lights flickered, and the landlady, Sister Li, stood at the door urging her to pay the rent. She woke with a start, her back covered in cold sweat, her heart racing. She turned on her side to look at her phone: 3:12 a.m. She kept her eyes open until the sky outside was dimly lit, her heart as heavy as if a stone were pressing on it, as she kept thinking about the shop, the child, and money, her mind unable to stop.

start_state.mood: The weekend morning was a bit relaxed; she looked forward to her sister's arrival, but felt vaguely uneasy about the school selection topic.

end_state.mood: Fear and anxiety peaked, unable to sleep at night, and the whole person felt fragile and lost.

state.daily_exercise: Walked about 8,000 steps while shopping; did effective daily activity but felt mentally exhausted.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, 10-18°C

2025-01.daily_overview: The day began under the shadow of insomnia, but was made full and action-driven by the intensive school visits and her mother's arrival. In the morning she and her husband first visited the Experimental Primary School, then rushed nonstop in the afternoon to the Foreign Language Affiliated Primary School, carefully taking notes and comparing. In the evening, her mother arrived in Xiamen from Quanzhou, and the warmth of family gave her exhausted self a new burst of energy. That day, regarding their daughter's future direction, the family finally shifted from anxiety to substantive planning.

events.name: Early in the morning, she frankly shared her anxiety with her husband and had an initial discussion about school selection direction.
events.description: Just as dawn was breaking, Song Yajing simply got up. Seeing her husband was also awake, she poured out everything about her nightmare from the night, her voice trembling slightly. Chen Zhiqiang held her hand and said, 'Let's take it step by step; going to see the school today is the first step.' The two chatted calmly in the living room for half an hour in the early morning, and initially agreed to stop worrying aimlessly and instead start systematically gathering information, treating school selection as a project.

events.name: In the morning, went to Siming District Experimental Primary School to attend the Parents' Open Day.
events.description: At 9 a.m., the couple arrived at the Experimental Primary School on time. After registering at the school gate, they followed the guide teacher to visit the teaching building, playground, library, and cafeteria. Song Yajing noticed the smart blackboards in the classrooms and the students' artwork, while Chen Zhiqiang chatted with another father about the workload of the upper grades. Song Yajing filled her notebook with dense notes on the enrollment scope, previous years' applicant numbers, and advancement rates, and gained an immediate favorable impression of the public school's standardized management.

events.name: At noon, ate and talked at a fast-food restaurant outside school
events.description: After leaving the Experimental Primary School, the two had a simple lunch at a nearby Shaxian Snacks. Song Yajing looked through her notes and felt that although the school had good facilities, the class sizes were a bit large, while Chen Zhiqiang placed more importance on the distance from home. As they ate, they exchanged first impressions and agreed to focus on asking about the English curriculum when they visited the Foreign Language School in the afternoon.

events.name: In the afternoon, went to the Foreign Language Affiliated Primary School for a visit and ran into a fellow churchgoer.
events.description: At 2 p.m., they went to the Primary School Affiliated with the Foreign Language School. The school places more emphasis on bilingual education and club activities; the hallways were covered with students' English handwritten posters and photos from the International Culture Festival. Song Yajing was especially interested in a baking club classroom equipped with an oven. During the visit, she also ran into her fellow church member Lin Xiuying, who had come with her grandson to look at the school. The two briefly shared their worries about choosing a school, and Auntie Lin comforted her, saying not to worry; the best school is the one that suits the child. After talking with a few current parents, she learned that admissions are competitive and require an interview, which added a bit more pressure, but she still carefully wrote this down in her notebook.

events.name: Sorting out the school comparison table after returning home in the evening
events.description: When she got home at 5 p.m., Song Yajing, despite her fatigue, listed the pros and cons of the two schools on two A4 sheets. For the Experimental Primary School, she focused on cost-effectiveness and school culture; for the Foreign Language School, she emphasized its distinguishing features and broader vision. Given her daughter's lively and active nature, she tentatively made the Experimental Primary School her first choice, with the Foreign Language School as a backup. Chen Zhiqiang read it and nodded in agreement. They finally had an interim conclusion.

events.name: Go to Xiamen Station to pick up Lin Xiuying and get her settled.
events.description: At 6:30 in the evening, Song Yajing drove alone to Xiamen Railway Station. Her mother, Lin Xiuying, got off the bullet train with a large canvas bag full of homemade sausages and pickled vegetables. As soon as they met, her mother smiled and said, "Your father insisted I bring these. He also said he's been a bit hard of hearing lately and asked me to tell you not to worry too much." Song Yajing felt a tightness in her chest. She took the bag and walked arm in arm with her mother home in the twilight, a reassuring feeling of being cared for welling up in her heart.

events.name: In the evening, the family enjoyed the flavors of home brought by Mom
events.description: In the evening, her mother took charge of the kitchen: she sliced and steamed the sausages they had brought and stir-fried a green vegetable. Song Yajing’s family of three generations sat around the dining table. Chen Zhiqiang chatted with his mother-in-law about the recent car repairs, while Xuanxuan kept putting food into her bowl. The room was filled with the aroma of home cooking and laughter. At the table, Song Yajing set aside all her stress for the moment and simply enjoyed this rare sense of security.
