start_state.mood: Dizzy and foggy-headed from insomnia, still carrying the lingering fear of nightmares and deep anxiety over school choice.

end_state.mood: Despite physical fatigue, the gains from action and her mother's company calmed her heart a lot. Anxiety was wrapped in concrete plans, and she felt much more at ease when falling asleep than the previous night.

state.daily_exercise: Visited two campuses on foot one after another, walking about 12,000 steps in total.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast with light rain, temperature 11-14°C

2025-01.daily_overview: Although it was a workday, her mother's presence gave the day some cozy holiday warmth. In the morning, Song Yajing used her compensatory leave to make tiramisu for her mother, earning praise and a suggestion about opening the shop. But that suggestion triggered the couple's first argument over business investment that evening. Fortunately, after calm negotiation, they decided to test the waters on a small scale and spend money on a testing opportunity. That day, she began to find a new balance with her husband on business decisions, moving beyond her roles as a pure housewife and shop owner.

events.name: Making tiramisu for mother and sharing baking time together.
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing did not go to the store; she let Xiaomei handle opening and minding the store. She put on an apron and made tiramisu in her home kitchen using a modified recipe: beating eggs, mixing the cheese filling, layering ladyfingers soaked in coffee one by one, and finally dusting cocoa powder on top. Her mother, Lin Xiuying, leaned against the kitchen door watching, occasionally handing her a bowl and telling her how she used to make a mess of the kitchen too when she was learning to make cakes. After the cake was chilled and set, Song Yajing cut two pieces. Mother and daughter sat at the dining table, tasting it with hot tea. Her mother was full of praise and said, 'It tastes better than the ones sold in shops.'

events.name: Her mother suggested adding a beverage corner to the store
events.description: While tasting the cake, her mother suddenly said, "You make cakes so well and you often drink coffee too, why not set up a small corner in the shop where customers can have a drink while browsing clothes? A lot of shops do that now." Song Yajing was startled at first, then her eyes lit up. She felt the idea could both make use of her baking hobby and keep customers in the store longer, so she immediately began sketching a simple layout for the corner with her mother on a napkin.

events.name: In the afternoon, went to the store to work and observe in-store customer traffic.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Song Yajing hurried back to the shop to replace Xiaomei for her lunch break. Fewer people were out shopping in the rain, so she took the lull to pace around the store, imagining where she could place a coffee machine and measuring the corner against the wall. A few customers came in, glanced around quickly, and left, which made her feel that the drink experience could really become a differentiating highlight.

events.name: In the evening, she excitedly proposed the drink corner plan to her husband.
events.description: After dinner and putting her daughter to bed, Song Yajing drew her mother's idea and her own concept on paper and excitedly showed it to Chen Zhiqiang, who was looking at his phone on the sofa, saying that a simple corner makeover, a small coffee machine, and a few extra cups would not cost much.

events.name: The couple argued over renovation costs and compromised
events.description: Chen Zhiqiang looked at the sketch carefully and made a rough estimate with the calculator on his phone. He found that including simple renovation, equipment, materials, and possible losses from closing the store, it would cost at least 20,000 yuan. His expression darkened, and he said that the online transformation was already occupying funds, the store's cash flow was still in recovery, and the risk was too great. Song Yajing felt he was always pouring cold water on her ideas, and her voice rose. The two went back and forth, their tones growing increasingly urgent. It was their first real argument about business investment since opening the store. After more than ten minutes of deadlock, Chen Zhiqiang calmed down first and proposed a compromise: first spend about 3,000 yuan on an Italian espresso machine to try, without renovation, just using the existing countertop, and invest more only if it works. Song Yajing felt wronged but knew this was already a concession, so she nodded silently.

events.name: The couple browsed online together to choose a coffee machine model
events.description: After the quarrel, the atmosphere was still a bit tense, but the two of them leaned together on the sofa and opened an e-commerce platform to browse Italian semi-automatic espresso machines. Chen Zhiqiang looked at pump pressure and boiler from a technical perspective, while Song Yajing cared about appearance and ease of use. In the end, they saved several models within a budget of 2,500-3,500 yuan and agreed to decide which one tomorrow.

start_state.mood: After yesterday's high pressure, having her mother by her side made her feel relaxed; she woke up in the morning with a feeling of compensatory companionship.

end_state.mood: Feeling down after the argument, but also relieved because a testing plan was reached; the impact of the first intense couple quarrel added a bit of adjustment and reflection to my mind

state.daily_exercise: Tidied up in the shop and went out to buy coffee beans, etc., with about 4,500 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning sunny, 12-17°C

2025-01.daily_overview: A day with full marks for execution. In the morning, after settling her daughter and the shop, Song Yajing went straight to the appliance store. After repeated comparisons, she chose a silver Italian espresso machine; then she stopped on the way to buy coffee beans, paper cups, and other supplies and returned to the shop. She set up a small drink corner in the corner with her own hands and successfully made the first espresso. From planning to completion it took only most of a day, and the gloom from last night's quarrel was swept away by hands-on action.

events.name: After taking her daughter to school, she had a brief discussion with her mother.
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing took her daughter to kindergarten, then went home and had breakfast with her mother. When her mother heard she had decided to buy a coffee machine to test, she said yes repeatedly and also shared her past experience of carrying coffee in a thermos. Song Yajing smiled and agreed, feeling more confident.

events.name: Comparing prices on e-commerce platforms to choose a coffee machine
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., Song Yajing sat on the living room sofa, opened Taobao and JD.com on her phone, and compared the prices, features, and reviews of several coffee machines she had saved the night before. She was leaning toward a DeLonghi semi-automatic coffee machine, which was relatively simple to operate and priced at 2,999 yuan. She sent a few screenshots to Chen Zhiqiang, who replied with an emoji saying "Okay, buy it." Only then did she make up her mind.

events.name: Went alone to the Gome Electronics Store in Siming District to buy a coffee machine.
events.description: At 10:30 in the morning, Song Yajing drove to a Gome appliance store in Siming District and went straight to the small home appliance section. She lingered for a long time in front of the Delonghi, Philips, and a domestic brand's demo machines, and asked the sales assistant to demonstrate milk frothing. Considering the store's voltage and after-sales service, she ultimately chose that Delonghi Italian espresso machine and paid by card at the mall. When paying, the cashier recommended an extended warranty service; she hesitated for a moment but declined, thinking every bit saved counts.

events.name: Stopped by the food ingredients store on the way to buy coffee supplies
events.description: After leaving the appliance mall, she remembered that the store where she had previously bought baking ingredients was nearby, so she drove over. In the store, she picked out a bag of Ethiopian coffee beans, a bottle of caramel syrup, a box of paper cups with lids and wooden stirrers, and also bought two bottles of flavored syrup as backup. The shopkeeper recognized her and voluntarily offered her a small discount.

events.name: Return to the store to set up a simple beverage prep area.
events.description: At 1 p.m., Song Yajing returned to the shop carrying the coffee machine and supplies. Xiaomei helped her clear an old table in a corner against the wall, plugged it in, and set the coffee machine on it. She then found a small shelf from the storeroom to hold syrup and paper cups, and covered the table with a cloth printed with small flowers. And just like that, the drink corner was born, complete and looking the part.

events.name: First time operating the coffee machine to make an espresso
events.description: After finishing the setup and washing her hands, Song Yajing carefully followed the instructions to grind the coffee beans, tamp the grounds, attach the portafilter, and press the button to extract. The first shot of espresso flowed out as a dark brown liquid. She picked it up and took a sip—rich crema, mellow and bitter taste, and the machine was running normally. She let Xiaomei taste it too, and the two smiled at each other, as if the little corner had suddenly come to life.

events.name: In the evening, her mother came to the store to look at the drink corner and give suggestions.
events.description: At 5 p.m., her mother Lin Xiuying walked over to the store and instantly spotted the coffee machine in the corner, praising it repeatedly. She suggested adding a small blackboard with 'Today's Special' to improve the atmosphere. Song Yajing thought it was a good idea and immediately wrote 'Signature Latte' on the blackboard with chalk.

start_state.mood: Last night's awkwardness has been put aside; I feel eager and a little excited to set up the beverage corner.

end_state.mood: After making a real commitment, she felt a sense of satisfaction and achievement, felt that the quarrel with her husband had forced out her initiative, and slept soundly at night.

state.daily_exercise: Went out shopping and arranged the storefront, walking about 7,000 steps in total

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, ample sunshine, temperature 13-18°C.

2025-01.daily_overview: On the first day of the drink corner's trial operation, Song Yajing was both nervous and excited. Early in the morning, she stocked all the materials—coffee beans, milk, and so on—and adjusted the equipment. After opening, she proactively offered sample cups to customers. To her surprise, the response was warmly enthusiastic: several regular customers said that drinking coffee while choosing clothes felt like being in a boutique concept store. At the end of the day, although revenue had not jumped, the positive feedback on the customer experience gave her great confidence in this little corner.

events.name: Arrive at the store early to prepare ingredients for the trial run of the drinks corner
events.description: At 8:30 in the morning, Song Yajing went straight to the store, cleaned the coffee machine and coffee grinder, and put whole milk in the small fridge. She neatly arranged tasting cups on a tray, and borrowed an embroidered tablecloth from her mother to lay over the beverage area, making the corner feel cozier.

events.name: Offer customers free coffee samples when they enter the shop.
events.description: After opening at 10 a.m., whenever a customer came in, Song Yajing would smile and say, 'Today we have free handmade lattes, you can try one.' She skillfully pulled espresso with the coffee machine, frothed milk, made a simple heart shape, and handed over tasting cups. Several young girls happily took photos and posted them on Moments, praising the owner's skill.

events.name: Exchanged experiences with regular customer Vivian about drinks and outfit coordination.
events.description: In the afternoon, Vivian, a regular customer, came by specially. While trying on the newly arrived knitwear, she slowly sipped her latte and said, “This feels wonderful, like a boutique in Korea.” Song Yajing took the opportunity to ask her what price range she would find acceptable and what flavors she preferred if they officially launched drinks. Vivian gave serious suggestions and added that if they had steady supply, she would be willing to bring her colleagues.

events.name: Record customer feedback and collect suggestions for improvement.
events.description: During a break in the busy work, Song Yajing used her notebook to jot down a few keywords: the paper cups should be replaced with nicer ones, add a caffeine-free option, and serve cold drinks in summer. She also specifically asked a few older customers. One aunt suggested adding some cookies, and Song Yajing immediately thought of her own baking skills.

events.name: Received neighbor Auntie Zhang and gained an unexpected suggestion
events.description: At 4 p.m., neighbor Zhang Xiuying happened to pass by and came in to look around. After tasting the latte, she nodded approvingly, but pointed out that the table was a bit unsteady and could easily spill, suggesting adding a non-slip pad. Song Yajing immediately made a note and gave Aunt Zhang a takeout Americano. Aunt Zhang also mentioned that the community had recently been promoting mutual assistance among small and micro businesses and suggested Song Yajing could join, perhaps gaining some promotional resources.

events.name: After closing, clean the equipment and count used supplies.
events.description: After the store closed at 7 p.m., Song Yajing and Xiaomei cleaned the coffee machine's brew head, steam wand, and grinder, and put the opened milk in the refrigerator. She estimated that today's tastings used about half a pound of coffee beans and 6 liters of milk, a manageable cost. Looking at the gleamingly clean machines, she thought to herself that this first step had probably been the right one.

start_state.mood: With the nervousness and excitement of a product interview, afraid customers wouldn't like it, but with even more expectation deep down.

end_state.mood: Wrapped in positive feedback from customers, she felt relaxed and happy. Most of her long-standing anxiety about business innovation was dissolved by the warm experience of the day.

state.daily_exercise: Walked back and forth serving in the store, about 9,000 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, 12-16°C

2025-01.daily_overview: This was a key operating day just before the Spring Festival. In the morning, Song Yajing and Xiao Mei reviewed the trial operation data for the beverage corner, decided to adjust the recipe, and planned the formal service process. In the afternoon, she designed the Spring Festival promotional poster and warmed up tomorrow's 'spend 500 yuan and get a free drink' event via WeChat Moments and customer groups. It was a busy day, with all her energy devoted to making the final business day a spectacular finish.

events.name: Discussed the trial operation results with Xiaomei and decided on adjustments
events.description: After opening the store at 10 a.m., Song Yajing called Xiaomei over to the beverage corner and flipped through yesterday's logbook. The two agreed: for the official launch, the Americano would be priced at 15 yuan and the latte at 20 yuan, but for tomorrow's promotion they would still be given away as freebies; based on feedback, the tasting coffee's strength would be slightly reduced, and a vanilla syrup option would be added. Xiaomei proactively offered to take care of cleaning the beverage area tomorrow, and Song Yajing nodded in approval.

events.name: Prepared the ingredients and materials for the promotional giveaway drinks ahead of time
events.description: After adjusting the recipe, Song Yajing went to buy more paper cups, anti-scalding cup sleeves, and fruit tea bags (prepared for customers who don't drink coffee). She also counted the winter clothing inventory in the store and decided to make several knee-length coats and sweaters the main promotional items, attaching "New Year Special" price tags. During the shopping trip, she found that the bakery she usually went to had closed, so she took a detour to another one, which delayed her by half an hour.

events.name: Print promotional posters and set up the store
events.description: In the afternoon, she used the store’s color printer to print out several A3 posters, on which was written in an elegant handwritten style: “Welcome the New Spring · Spend 500 yuan or more and get a free specialty drink,” along with small pictures of lattes and Americanos. She put the posters on the store’s glass door and beside the cash register, and also asked Xiaomei to write the event details on the small blackboard outside the fitting room.

events.name: Sent event notifications via WeChat Moments and customer groups
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing took photos of the decorated poster and drinks corner with her phone, wrote an enthusiastic caption, and posted them to her personal WeChat Moments and the Yajing Life Studio WeChat group, especially reminding everyone that tomorrow would be the last day of business before Chinese New Year and that some winter styles were on clearance with sizes running out. Within less than half an hour of posting, more than a dozen people in the group replied, 'We'll definitely go tomorrow,' and some regular customers also sent private messages to reserve styles.

events.name: In the evening, at home, making Spring Festival crafts with her daughter
events.description: After work, when she got home, her mother and daughter Xuanxuan were already cutting window decorations out of red paper in the living room. Song Yajing washed her hands and joined them, teaching her daughter to cut a simple 'Spring' character. Xuanxuan accidentally cut off a small corner and pouted as if about to cry. Song Yajing quickly comforted her and taped it back together, saying 'Now it's unique.' Seeing her mother and daughter so happy, much of her work fatigue melted away, and she secretly looked forward to making a strong final push tomorrow.

start_state.mood: Full of energy, with clear goals, and completely in battle-ready mode.

end_state.mood: A sense of reassurance from being well prepared, a hint of nervous anticipation about tomorrow’s performance, but overall positive and motivated

state.daily_exercise: Store arrangement and walking around while shopping, about 6,000 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Clear and sunny, temperature 14-19°C.

2025-01.daily_overview: It was the last business day before Spring Festival and also the real-world test day for the beverage corner promotion. From morning to evening, customers came in an endless stream, many attracted by the buy-more-get-a-drink offer and winter clothing discounts. Song Yajing and Xiaomei were run off their feet. When they closed up, the day's revenue actually set a new record for nearly three months. With this pleasant surprise, she sorted out the accounts and goods, temporarily closed the store, and went home to pack for returning to Quanzhou for the Chinese New Year with her husband.

events.name: Go to the shop early in the morning to make final preparations and preheat the equipment.
events.description: At 8 a.m., Song Yajing left her daughter with her mother and hurried to the shop. She turned on the coffee machine to preheat it, arranged the flowers Xiaomei had brought into a vase and placed it by the checkout counter, and stuck the handmade paper cuttings she had made last night on the mirror frame of the fitting room. The shop immediately took on a New Year atmosphere.

events.name: Warmly welcomed customers and promoted the sales campaign
events.description: After opening at 10 a.m., regular customers who had heard the notice began streaming in. Song Yajing helped customers choose and try on clothes while introducing the 'spend 500 yuan and get a drink of your choice' promotion. She noted each eligible customer's drink selection, then made the drinks herself and handed them over. During the noon rush, she even had Xiao Mei pause sales to help froth milk; she was so busy she didn't even have time to drink water. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang specially brought a bowl of satay noodles to the shop at noon, and she hurriedly ate a few bites before going back to work.

events.name: Completed multiple transactions and reached a new high in sales over the past three months.
events.description: The peak was from 3 p.m. to 5 p.m. Several customers bought multiple items at once, both trying out spring clothing and scooping up winter clearance. Song Yajing carefully recorded every transaction and gave away more than forty cups of complimentary lattes and Americanos. At closing time, she couldn't wait to calculate the revenue and found it was nearly double the single-day total from last week, setting the highest record since last November. She was so excited that she hugged Xiaomei and jumped.

events.name: After closing, sort out accounts and inventory and shut the shop
events.description: After seeing off the last customer at 7:30 pm, Song Yajing counted the cash and tallied the QR-code payments, checked inventory, gathered the remaining winter clothes and hung them in one area, and covered the new spring styles with dust covers. She discovered that one of her favorite earrings was missing, lost at some point, and felt a little disappointed, but the feeling was soon washed away by joy. She and Xiaomei turned off the lights, locked the drawers, and finally pulled down the rolling shutter door. She stood outside the store, took a photo of the storefront and posted it in the group chat: “See you next year! Thank you all for your support throughout the year!”

events.name: Went home and packed luggage with her husband for returning to Quanzhou for the Chinese New Year.
events.description: Arrived home at 8:30 pm, and her mother had already prepared dinner. After eating, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang took out clothes for the trip back to Quanzhou from the wardrobe and packed them into travel bags. She deliberately placed the thermal underwear bought for her parents, the hearing aid brochure for her father (a brand she looked up online last night), and the pastries and New Year gift boxes prepared for relatives in a separate luggage bag. Their daughter Xuanxuan also stuffed her picture books and toys into her small backpack. The whole family was busy and excited.

start_state.mood: In high spirits, like a warrior preparing for a decisive battle, with a hidden joy for the upcoming holiday.

end_state.mood: The immense satisfaction and relaxation from record-high revenue, along with the anticipation of returning to her parents' home for the New Year, made this one of the most relaxed and pleasant moments of the month.

state.daily_exercise: All-day standing service and walking, with step count as high as 11,000 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Partly cloudy to sunny, temperature 12-17°C.

2025-01.daily_overview: The first day of officially turning on vacation mode. In the morning, Song Yajing went to the store one last time for final cleaning and tidying, pulled the main switch, and completely closed the shop for Chinese New Year. In the afternoon, she went to the supermarket to buy New Year gift boxes to bring back to Quanzhou. In the evening, she quietly baked tiramisu and cookies at home, enjoying pure hobby time. After a busy month, she finally relaxed slowly amid the aroma of cream and powdered sugar, her mood gradually expanding into warmth like dough in an oven.

events.name: Go to the store for final cleaning and officially close up for the holiday
events.description: At 9 a.m., Song Yajing came to the store alone and opened the rolling shutter door for a final airing. She wiped the dust off the cash register and shelves with a cloth, thoroughly cleaned the coffee machine, emptied the water tank, and covered it with a dust cloth. After checking that all power was off, she stood quietly in the store for a moment and softly said to the empty shop, 'You've worked hard. Let's do our best next year.' Then she pulled down the rolling shutter door, locked it, and put the key in her bag.

events.name: Go to a large supermarket to buy Chinese New Year goods to bring back to Quanzhou.
events.description: At noon she went home and simply had a bowl of shacha noodles. At 2 p.m. she drove to Carrefour supermarket. Pushing a shopping cart, she picked out a box of Tieguanyin tea for her father, a skincare gift set for her mother, and a few packs of Xiamen specialty pies and dried pork slices to give to relatives. Passing the liquor section, she remembered her husband liked to drink, so she took a bottle of Kinmen Kaoliang. At checkout there were two full large bags. Because her cart accidentally bumped into the cart of a customer behind her, she apologized quickly, and the other person smiled kindly. She contentedly loaded the things into the trunk.

events.name: In the evening, she carefully made tiramisu and cookies at home.
events.description: After dinner, Song Yajing tied up her hair, put on an apron, and turned the kitchen into a private bakery. She first made tiramisu, adding an extra layer of cocoa powder this time, and put it in the refrigerator to set. Then she baked two trays of cookies with butter, cake flour, and dried cranberries. Midway, she took a call from her sister to confirm the New Year gifts, and got distracted; the first tray of cookies stayed in the oven for two extra minutes and the edges were slightly burnt. Muttering to herself, she picked out the burnt ones and baked another tray. The sweet aroma from the oven filled the whole house. Her daughter Xuanxuan ran in to watch, stole a bite of a hot cookie, and blew on it because it was scalding. Song Yajing laughed and brushed the crumbs off her hand, her heart full of tenderness.

events.name: Confirmed tomorrow's arrangements to return to Quanzhou with her mother and husband.
events.description: During a break in baking, she discussed the next day's itinerary with her mother and husband. They decided to rest at home for the morning, leave after lunch, and arrive in Quanzhou around 3 or 4 in the afternoon. Chen Zhiqiang checked the tire pressure and fuel level and set up the navigation. Her mother called her father in Quanzhou to tell him their arrival time, and on the phone her father happily said he would prepare her favorite vinegar pork. Before going to bed, Song Yajing also sent a WeChat message to her best friend Wang Jia, asking about their return time to Quanzhou and gathering plans. The two agreed that the three of them would get together on the 31st.

start_state.mood: Completely disconnected from work, her mind and body still carrying the afterglow of a just-finished battle, she felt content and at peace.

end_state.mood: Completely relaxed in the rich aroma of baking, looking forward to a smooth trip tomorrow and reuniting with family back home.

state.daily_exercise: Walking around the supermarket; standing for about 2 hours while baking; about 5,000 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, 9-16°C

2025-01.daily_overview: Homecoming Day. After lunch, the whole family packed the car with New Year goods and luggage, and drove along the Shenhai Expressway toward Quanzhou. Arriving at her parents' home in Licheng District in the evening, the familiar streets and her parents' smiling faces instantly turned Song Yajing back into the adored daughter. Three generations sat around the table for dinner, chatting about family matters, and the pressure that had been building up was gently wrapped in family affection.

events.name: In the morning, packed New Year goods and desserts at home
events.description: After getting up at 8:30 in the morning, Song Yajing carefully packed the tiramisu she made yesterday into an insulated bag, put the cookies in a nice tin, and neatly placed them in the large duffel bag along with the New Year goods bought at the supermarket. She also took time to pack a separate small bag of Xuanxuan’s change of clothes and checked several times that she had brought her daughter’s picture books and tablet to deal with the boredom on the road.

events.name: The whole family drove their own car along the Shenhai Expressway back to Quanzhou
events.description: At 12:30 p.m., Chen Zhiqiang drove, Song Yajing sat in the passenger seat, and her mother and Xuanxuan sat in the back, with the trunk packed full. The car drove smoothly onto the Shenhai Expressway. After about an hour and a half, they rested at a service area for fifteen minutes. Xuanxuan clamored for ice cream; Song Yajing coaxed her by saying Grandma would buy some when they got back to Quanzhou, but in the end she still bought a grilled sausage. Song Yajing watched the winter fields flash by outside the window and chatted with her mother about celebrating the New Year as a child. Her mood was as smooth as the road.

events.name: Arrived at my parents' home in Licheng District, Quanzhou in the evening
events.description: At 4 p.m., the car turned into a quiet alley on Xinhua North Road in Licheng District and stopped in front of an old residential building. Her father, Song Minghui, was already looking around downstairs and waved when he saw the car. Song Yajing jumped out of the car and called, "Dad!" Her father took the bag from her hand and said again and again, "It's good that you're back." After entering the house, her mother, Lin Xiuying, had already set out the bowls and chopsticks, and a table of steaming home-cooked dishes gave off a familiar smell.

events.name: Distribute New Year goods and desserts, and have dinner together.
events.description: Song Yajing brought the tin cookies and tiramisu to the table as dessert, and also took out the thermal underwear and tea she had bought for her parents. Her father put on his reading glasses and carefully looked at the clothing label, muttering, 'Spending money again,' but his eyes looked happy. At the dinner table, she chatted with her husband and parents about the store's promotion and funny things her daughter did in kindergarten, while her father talked about recent happenings at the community senior activity center. The family talked and laughed, with a warm atmosphere. The vinegar pork her father made was a bit salty. Song Yajing said with a smile, 'Dad, you put too much salt in.' Her father laughed and said, 'I'm old, I can't taste accurately.'

events.name: In the evening, chatted with her parents and helped them settle in for the night
events.description: After dinner, Song Yajing helped her mother wash the dishes and listened in the kitchen as her mother talked about which neighbor's child in Quanzhou had also opened a shop. In the evening, she bathed her daughter, settled her to sleep with grandma in one room, and stayed with her husband in the small room she had lived in since childhood. Lying on the narrow bed, smelling the distinctive camphor wood scent of the house, she felt a deep sense of peace. Before sleeping, she noticed the pillowcase was still the one she had used in middle school. Feeling emotional for a moment, she chatted with her husband about some childhood memories.

start_state.mood: With the joy of being eager to return home and a slight sense of hurry while packing, overall relaxed and excited.

end_state.location: Parents' home in Licheng District, Quanzhou
end_state.mood: The sense of security from returning to her family of origin enveloped her; the anxiety of the past several days was temporarily set aside, leaving her soft and calm inside.

state.daily_exercise: Packed my luggage in the morning, and in the evening took a walk with my father downstairs, about 4,000 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, temperature 8-15°C
date_attribute.holiday: None (but the day before Chinese New Year's Eve)

2025-01.daily_overview: The day before Chinese New Year's Eve was busy but fulfilling with the New Year atmosphere in her hometown. Song Yajing immersed herself in the traditional rituals of helping her mother prepare New Year goods and putting up Spring Festival couplets with her father. Her husband helped fix small items around the house, while her daughter became the joy of her maternal grandparents. She didn't think about the store all day, simply enjoying pure family work and laughter. In the evening, she also found time to go to the nearby food market to buy extra flowers and firecrackers as a final touch for the next day's New Year's Eve dinner.

events.name: In the morning, accompanying mother to the wet market to buy ingredients for the Chinese New Year's Eve dinner
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, Song Yajing and her mother each carried cloth bags and walked to the traditional market in Licheng District. The stalls were filled with fresh oysters, live shrimp, and various vegetables. Her mother, familiar with the place, picked and chose expertly, while Song Yajing followed behind helping carry the bags. They bought peanut sauce and alkaline noodles needed for shacha noodles, and also pre-ordered a freshly slaughtered free-range chicken that morning to make soup. On the way, they ran into Aunt Zhang, an old neighbor not seen for years. After exchanging a few pleasantries, Aunt Zhang said Song Yajing looked more and more like her mother when she was young.

events.name: Putting up Spring Festival couplets with her father and cleaning the courtyard
events.description: At 10 a.m., her father took out the Spring Festival couplets written a few days earlier by a community calligraphy enthusiast. Song Yajing helped hold the paste basin. Father and daughter worked together, one brushing paste and the other putting up the couplets, and red 'fortune' characters were pasted on the front door and room doors. A gust of wind nearly blew off the freshly pasted horizontal scroll; her father quickly pressed it down with his hand and joked, 'The God of Wealth is anxious to get in.' Then she picked up a broom and swept the courtyard and balcony clean, sweeping the old year's dust out the door while murmuring, 'Bad luck, sweep it all away.'

events.name: Husband Chen Zhiqiang checked and repaired the household appliances and TV signal.
events.description: Around lunchtime, Chen Zhiqiang noticed the TV signal in the living room was a bit snowy, so he brought a ladder to check the signal cable on the wall and reconnected it. He also fixed the kitchen faucet that had been dripping all along. Her father watched from the side and kept praising his son-in-law for being handy. Song Yajing served tea and handed him tools, acting as a qualified assistant.

events.name: In the afternoon, help marinate the New Year dishes and steam Quanzhou bowl cakes.
events.description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing tied on an apron and joined her mother in the kitchen. She marinated the sliced pork belly with soy sauce and five-spice powder and arranged it in a bowl. Following her mother's method, she also mixed rice batter, poured it into small bowls, and steamed them into smiling bowl cakes with cracks on top, symbolizing prosperity for the coming year. One bowl didn't crack open, and her mother joked, “This means Yajing's store will open chains in the future, so let's save this one first.” The kitchen was filled with steam and aroma, and mother and daughter kept smiling at each other.

events.name: In the evening, bought flowers and firecrackers to decorate the home.
events.description: At 5 p.m., Song Yajing went out with her daughter. At a flower shop near home, they bought two bunches of silver willow and gladiolus, and at a grocery store they bought several strings of red firecrackers and sand poppers for children. Xuanxuan pointed at a bunch of pink silver willow and said, "It looks like Mommy's skirt." After returning, she put the flowers in a vase in the living room and hung the firecrackers on the balcony to dry. Xuanxuan clung to her legs, looking eager to try the sand poppers, and Song Yajing promised her they could play with them tomorrow.

start_state.mood: Woke up in the familiar old home, roused by the excitement of the upcoming Chinese New Year, full of energy.

end_state.mood: Physical exhaustion could not drown out her inner fulfillment. The sight of the whole family, old and young, working together to welcome the new year gave her a long-lost sense of completeness.

state.daily_exercise: Shopping, cleaning, and taking the stairs up and down; about 8,000 steps

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, temperature 7-14°C

2025-01.daily_overview: New Year's Eve. From the symphony of kitchen activity in the morning to making dumplings and watching the Spring Festival Gala with the whole family in the evening, Song Yajing was immersed in the rituals of the traditional festival. But at the reunion dinner, her father's words—'My hearing is getting worse and worse; I'm afraid I'll be a burden to you later'—pierced her heart like a thin needle, giving her a hint of sadness amid the liveliness. The urgency of being a child and the responsibility of being a parent intertwined strangely on New Year's Eve. While staying up for the new year, she silently made a wish: to keep the shop running well and to take better care of her parents sooner.

events.name: Making a traditional Minnan New Year's Eve dinner with her mother in the morning.
events.description: At 7 in the morning, Song Yajing and her mother were already busy in the kitchen. Yajing was in charge of making the satay soup base: she stir-fried shrimp heads to render the red oil, then blended in peanut sauce and chili sauce, filling the whole house with the distinctive aroma of southern Fujian. Her mother wrapped Quanzhou-style meat zongzi while Yajing helped by soaking glutinous rice and slicing shiitake mushrooms. The chicken soup in the pot simmered, the red crabs sat on the cutting board waiting to be steamed, and one dish after another gradually took shape.

events.name: The whole family made dumplings together and chatted about everyday things.
events.description: At 4 p.m., the kneading board and fillings were spread out on the living room table, and the whole family of five sat around making dumplings. Chen Zhiqiang rolled the wrappers—not quite round but decent-looking. Xuanxuan played with the dough nearby and insisted on making one herself, but it came out looking like a "baozi," which made everyone laugh. Her father slowly wrapped dumplings one by one, each uniform in shape. When they talked about Song Yajing's shop, her father said, "It's better to be steady in your work; don't take risks," and she nodded in agreement.

events.name: New Year's Eve reunion dinner and the topic of father's hearing
events.description: At 6 p.m., a table full of hearty dishes was set, and everyone raised their glasses to celebrate. Midway through the meal, her husband Chen Zhiqiang talked with her father about the pension reform mentioned in recent news. Her father suddenly sighed and said that his left ear had been losing hearing badly lately—he had to turn the TV up very loud to hear it clearly, and he was afraid of becoming a burden to his children. Song Yajing's chopsticks stopped in midair; looking at her father's graying temples, her throat tightened. She quickly put down her chopsticks and said, “Dad, don't think about that. We'll take you to the hospital for a thorough checkup after the New Year. Hearing aids work very well now.” Her father smiled and waved his hand, but the weight had already settled in her heart. After dinner, she quietly downloaded a hearing test app on her phone and had her father try it. The results showed a clear decline in mid-to-high frequency hearing, which strengthened her resolve to take her father to see a doctor.

events.name: Video-called her older sister Song Yawen to confirm the arrangements for returning home.
events.description: At 8 p.m., after the Spring Festival Gala started, Song Yajing made a WeChat video call to her elder sister. The sisters exchanged New Year greetings. Her sister said she would drive from Shenzhen back to Quanzhou on the morning of the second day of the new year and would bring a seafood gift box. Song Yajing reminded her to drive safely and said she had prepared a special tiramisu for her to try. Before hanging up, her sister specifically urged, "Regarding Dad's ear problem, arrange it as soon as possible after you return to Xiamen—don't put it off." Song Yajing agreed repeatedly.

events.name: Late-night New Year's vigil and preparing gifts for visiting relatives tomorrow
events.description: After the Spring Festival Gala ended, it was almost midnight. Song Yajing and her husband packed the cigarette, liquor, and pastry gift boxes to be brought to the relatives of her father's hometown the next day, and put labels with the recipients' titles on the bags to avoid mix-ups. Outside, sporadic firecrackers could be heard. She stood on the balcony and glanced at the old city in the night, silently praying: may the family be safe, and may the new year see the store running steadily. Before bed, she quietly told her husband about her father's situation. Chen Zhiqiang held her hand and said, "We'll share the burden together."

start_state.mood: Excited yet with the solemnity of a festival, like heading to an important gathering of a big extended family.

end_state.mood: Moved by the topic of her father's health, her joy was mixed with solemnity and a hint of bitterness about the future, but family cohesion made her feel supported.

state.daily_exercise: Busy standing in the kitchen for several hours, about 5,000 steps

date_attribute.weather: Clear blue skies, temperature 8-16°C

2025-01.daily_overview: The first day of the Lunar New Year was full of ritual. Early in the morning, the whole family went to church for the New Year Mass, where Song Yajing prayed devoutly for the shop and her parents' health; afterward, they drove to the village in her father's hometown to visit relatives and friends, and received a lot of sincere encouragement at the dinner table with her cousins. Amid the excitement, an old junior high school classmate, Zhang Wei, sent a wry smile emoji in the class group chat, revealing the hardships of the workplace and making her more aware of the storms of adult life during the Spring Festival joy.

events.name: Sent Chinese New Year greetings to the junior high school class group in the morning.
events.description: After getting up and washing up, Song Yajing sat on the sofa, opened WeChat, and went into the long-silent junior high school class group. She sent a message: 'Happy New Year, classmates. I wish everyone a great Year of the Dragon and all the best,' along with a firework emoji. People in the group replied with wishes one after another. Zhang Wei, who had been lurking for a long time, surfaced and replied with a 'Happy New Year' followed by a wry smile emoji.

events.name: Zhang Wei revealed that the project was cut, showing workplace pressure.
events.description: Song Yajing sent Zhang Wei a private message asking why he was smiling bitterly. Zhang Wei briefly said that before the Chinese New Year, the company had canceled the project their team had spent most of the year on, and after the new year he might have to look for a new job. His tone was helpless. Song Yajing comforted him with a few words, sent a hug sticker, and could not help thinking of the transformation risks her own shop faced, sighing: in the adult world, everyone has their own difficulties.

events.name: The whole family went to the Catholic church to attend the Spring Festival Mass.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Song Yajing's family and her parents arrived at the Catholic church in the old city of Quanzhou. The church was decorated with flowers and red silk. Father Wang Mingde celebrated Mass to pray for blessings for the New Year. Lin Xiuying, a fellow parishioner, also came and nodded to Song Yajing. Song Yajing knelt on the pew and prayed devoutly, thanking God for the past year's protection, and silently wishing for the store's transformation, her parents' health, and her daughter's school advancement. When the hymn sounded, she felt her heart was cleansed.

events.name: Drove to the village in her father's hometown to visit relatives and friends.
events.description: Around 10:30 after Mass, the whole family drove to the village where her father grew up, on the outskirts of Quanzhou. The relatives had already gathered in the courtyard of the old house, with several square tables set with snacks and tea. Everyone exchanged New Year greetings. Song Yajing took Xuanxuan to pay New Year calls to several great-uncles and great-aunts, giving them red envelopes and the cookies she had brought. The elders asked about her clothing store and said, "It's amazing to be your own boss," encouraging her to do well. A female cousin also said she would introduce friends to her store to buy clothes.

events.name: Had a hearty lunch with cousins at noon.
events.description: Lunch was authentic Minnan farmhouse cuisine: sandworm jelly, oyster omelette, and vinegar pork filled the table. Song Yajing chatted and ate with several cousins' wives. Some worked in factories, others stayed home taking care of the kids. Hearing about Song Yajing's online pre-sales and drink corner, they found it novel and envied her courage to think and act. Song Yajing said modestly, "Still in the trial stage—if it succeeds, I'll invite you all to Xiamen." The atmosphere was warm and lively.

events.name: Return to parents' home in Quanzhou in the afternoon to rest and recharge
events.description: At 3 p.m., she left the village. After returning to her parents' home, Song Yajing first put her daughter down for a nap. While sleeping, her daughter turned over and nearly fell off the bed. Yajing caught her with quick reflexes and broke out in a cold sweat. Later, she sat in the room, opened the notes app on her phone, and briefly wrote down the insights she had gained from Zhang Wei's matter and the encouragement from her cousins: Don't put all your eggs in one basket; the store transformation should be done steadily. When the economic environment is bad, you should cherish the current stability even more. After closing her phone, she leaned against the headboard and dozed for a while.

start_state.mood: Carrying the sacred feeling and joy of the first day of the new year, while also feeling a faint resonance with her classmate's situation.

end_state.mood: Feeling lifted by family love and also receiving signals of external pressure, I have become more firmly cautious and optimistic.

state.daily_exercise: Walked to the church and around the village in my hometown, about 6,000 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, 9-17°C

2025-01.daily_overview: On the second day of Chinese New Year, they returned to their parents' home for a reunion, which was also a rare gathering of the two sisters' families. Song Yawen's family came from Shenzhen, bringing fresh foreign trade information and e-commerce operation ideas; Song Yajing shared her recent research on choosing a school for Xuanxuan. The two sisters stayed by their parents' side, feeling as if they were back in childhood, exchanging thoughts on being mothers and pursuing careers. In the evening, back at her parents' home, Yajing found time to sketch out a renovation plan for the store's drink corner after the New Year. The holiday's emotional recharge was turning into planning energy for the future.

events.name: In the morning, prepared tea snacks at home to host her sister's family
events.description: At 8 a.m., Song Yajing helped her mother tidy up the living room, setting out sunflower seeds, tangerines, and the leftover bowl cake from yesterday. She deliberately took the tiramisu she had made a few days earlier out of the fridge to bring it to room temperature, as a surprise for her sister. Her father brewed a large pot of Tieguanyin tea and waited for their eldest daughter's family.

events.name: Older sister Song Yawen's family arrived and paid their New Year's greetings.
events.description: At 10:30 in the morning, Song Yawen and her husband and their 8-year-old son walked in carrying large and small bags. The two sisters smiled and hugged as soon as they met, and the children quickly started playing together. Song Yajing gave her nephew a lucky money red envelope, and her sister gave Xuanxuan a Disney stationery gift set bought in Shenzhen. The parents stood to the side, their eyes slightly red as they watched both daughters return with their families. The seafood gift box that the older sister brought contained dried squid that Yajing had loved as a child, and she opened it right away and ate a few strips.

events.name: Family reunion lunch to discuss career and education plans
events.description: Lunch was still sumptuous. During the meal, Song Yawen talked about the cross-border e-commerce model that Shenzhen's foreign trade had been engaging with this year, and suggested that Song Yajing try attaching links to short videos. Song Yajing then took out the comparison table of the Experimental Primary School and the Foreign Language School saved on her phone and showed it to her sister. The two sisters put their heads together and discussed for a long time. The elder sister thought the Experimental Primary School's cost-effectiveness and stability were more suitable for Xuanxuan's personality, but she also supported her in learning more. The two agreed to keep exchanging information after the New Year. Song Yawen also suggested that when she took their father to have his ears checked after the New Year, she could also register for a specialist appointment.

events.name: Said goodbye after afternoon tea and agreed to meet again during summer vacation
events.description: At 3 p.m., her older sister's family prepared to return to Shenzhen. Song Yajing packed a tin box of homemade cookies and cut pieces of tiramisu with ice packs and pressed them into her sister's hands to eat on the way. Their mother held both daughters' hands and repeatedly told them to take care of their health. As the car started, her nephew accidentally knocked over a bottle of water. Song Yajing hurriedly grabbed tissues to wipe the car interior, while thinking of embarrassing moments from her daughter's childhood. She waved goodbye, reluctant but fulfilled.

events.name: Took an evening walk with her husband and brainstormed the renovation of the drink corner
events.description: After seeing her sister off, Song Yajing and her husband took a walk in the park near her parents' house, pushing their daughter's little scooter. She told her husband about the short video product links her sister had mentioned, then turned back to the drink corner, saying she wanted to make the corner a bit more stylish—after the New Year, she would lay some wood-grain adhesive film and add a small bookshelf with a few fashion magazines. Chen Zhiqiang did not object and only said, "When you get back, measure the dimensions first so you don't buy the wrong materials."

events.name: In the evening, draw a sketch of the drink corner renovation in a notebook.
events.description: After the family had gone to bed at night, Song Yajing sat at her desk, opened her notebook, and carefully drew a top view of the beverage corner with a ruler and pencil: the coffee machine position, cup rack, small blackboard, and even the cable routing for the power strip. She listed the materials she might need to buy: self-adhesive wall stickers, a desk lamp, and a magazine rack. As she drew, she suddenly felt a pang of loneliness, but then she thought of her husband's support and felt motivated again. After closing the notebook, she had a clear picture of the adjustments after the new year.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to reuniting with my sister, with my heart full of topics I want to talk about.

end_state.mood: The emotional recharge from the sisters' reunion was significant, filling her with ideas and motivation for the post-holiday plan and leaving her in a bright mood.

state.daily_exercise: Evening walk for about 40 minutes, approximately 6,500 steps

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, 10-16°C

2025-01.daily_overview: On the last days of the Spring Festival holiday, it was a day for best friends to get together. Song Yajing, Li Meiling, who had returned to Quanzhou for the New Year, and Wang Jia strolled along Zhongshan Road and had afternoon tea, chattering away just like their teenage years. Wang Jia's suggestions on improving community operations were very rewarding for her. In the evening, Song Yajing went back to her parents' home for a final reunion dinner, packed her luggage, and prepared to drive back to Xiamen the next morning. This month felt like a mix of war and feast, and at last she felt she could make a smooth transition into the new February.

events.name: In the morning, she entrusted her daughter to her mother and then went to meet her best friend.
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing fed Xuanxuan, handed her daughter to her mother to look after, and said she would not be back for lunch. Her mother nodded and told her to go and enjoy herself. She changed into the new sweater her sister had given her, picked up her handbag, and arranged to meet Li Meiling and Wang Jia at the entrance of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

events.name: Went shopping on Zhongshan Road in Quanzhou with Li Meiling and Wang Jia
events.description: At 11 a.m., the three childhood friends met at the familiar street corner. Li Meiling smiled as soon as she saw her: “You look much better than in the video.” They strolled slowly along Zhongshan Road, shop by shop. Song Yajing tried on a vintage hair clip, Wang Jia took a liking to a scarf, and Li Meiling picked out a dinosaur toy for her son. As they walked, Li Meiling talked about funny stories involving her students, Wang Jia complained about her shrunken year-end bonus, and Song Yajing shared the educational advice her sister had given her. It was free and easy, with laughter all the way.

events.name: At the coffee shop, Wang Jia gave suggestions on community operations.
events.description: Around 1 p.m., the three walked into an artsy café and ordered caramel macchiatos and tiramisu. Song Yajing mentioned her attempt at community pre-sales. Wang Jia put down her cup and said seriously that she could post outfit tips at a fixed time every day to build user habits, and then use a mini program for chain group-buying. She also recommended a simple tool called 'Shimo Docs' for collecting customer preference data, and demonstrated the basic operations on the spot. Song Yajing immediately wrote down these points on her phone and said gratefully, 'No wonder you're a big shot in the internet industry.'

events.name: After the three said goodbye, Song Yajing went for a walk alone and decided on a whim to wash her hair.
events.description: At 4 p.m., the close friends each went home. Song Yajing did not rush back. Instead, she strolled alone for a while in the alleys near Zhongshan Road, watched the elderly playing chess by the roadside, and bought a cup of stone flower jelly to soothe her throat. When she passed a hair salon, she decided on a whim to go in and have her hair washed, enjoying half an hour of relaxation. The head massage relieved much of the fatigue that had built up over the past days. She recalled the panic she felt at the beginning of the year when the shop's revenue was sliding, and now she had an online direction, a drinks corner, and goals for her daughter's schooling. Although there was still uncertainty ahead, her heart was no longer as empty as before.

events.name: Return to parents' home to have dinner with the family
events.description: At 5:30 in the evening, she returned to her parents' home. Her husband was helping her father trim potted plants on the balcony, and her mother was in the kitchen making her favorite satay noodles. Song Yajing washed her hands, joined her mother in the kitchen, and told her about the day's experiences. At the dinner table, her father advised her to drive carefully back to Xiamen tomorrow, and her mother put a piece of braised pork belly in her bowl, telling her not to focus only on the store but also take care of her health. Song Yajing's nose tingled slightly, and she agreed to everything.

events.name: In the evening, pack luggage for the return trip and sort out thoughts
events.description: After dinner, Song Yajing packed the red envelopes she had received over the past few days and the stationery gift box from her sister into her suitcase, then wrapped the sausages and meat zongzi her mother had pressed on her in plastic bags. While tidying up, she found that her mother had secretly put 2,000 yuan in cash in her cosmetics bag. Her eyes reddened, but she said nothing. Standing by the window, she took a night photo of the old city of Quanzhou and posted it on Moments with the caption, "Recharged, ready to set off again." After packing, she leaned against the headboard and wrote a few short lines in her diary: In January, I had sleepless nights, cried, and argued with Zhiqiang, but I also opened the store's online business for the first time, ran around so seriously for Xuanxuan's future for the first time, and tasted the bitterness of father growing old for the first time... But thankfully, the family is together. February, let's go. She closed the notebook, turned off the light, and soon fell into a peaceful sleep.

start_state.mood: The relaxation of the holiday and the excitement of meeting her close friend soon were intertwined, full of childlike joy.

end_state.mood: Completed the final social and family recharge of the Spring Festival, feeling calm and resolute inside, with flexible expectations for returning to daily work and the challenges ahead.

state.daily_exercise: Walking while shopping, about 10,000 steps, with about 30 minutes of strolling.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, hot

2025-08.daily_overview: On the first day of August, Song Yajing started the new month with a morning brisk walk, then handled financial reservations and balcony herbs, commuted by electric scooter for the first time, and in the evening tried creative baking with homegrown herbs, gaining a strong sense of accomplishment.

events.name: Morning brisk walk of 3 km.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Song Yajing woke up naturally. After a quick wash, she went to Hubin South Road Community Park and completed a 3-kilometer brisk walk at a steady pace, with a pace of about 8 minutes per kilometer, recording the data with the app. On the way home, she bought breakfast ingredients.

events.name: Complete the August family insurance allocation
events.description: In the early morning, Song Yajing opened the family electronic ledger and, according to the special insurance plan, set aside the payable premium from this month's income with a clear mark, ensuring the August policy would not lapse.

events.name: Repotting balcony herbs and making care cards.
events.description: After breakfast, Song Yajing carefully repotted the overgrown basil, mint, and other herb seedlings on the balcony into several small terracotta pots, and wrote a small care card by hand for each pot with the plant's name, light requirement, and watering frequency, planning to bring them to the active customers in the shop's community.

events.name: First electric scooter commute
events.description: Around 9 o'clock, Song Yajing rode her newly purchased electric scooter for the first time, setting off from home on Hubin South Road and riding along familiar streets to the boutique clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. Short rides were much more flexible than driving; she felt the breeze along the way and arrived at the store smoothly.

events.name: Routine store operations and tidying
events.description: After opening the shop, she checked the inventory situation at the end of July, replied to online customer messages, and fine-tuned the in-store displays together with shop assistant Xiaomei to free up display space for the upcoming autumn purchases.

events.name: First attempt at mint tiramisu and rosemary cookies
events.description: After closing the shop and returning home in the evening, Song Yajing picked fresh mint and rosemary from the balcony and, following a recipe she had saved for a long time, tried making mint tiramisu and rosemary cookies for the first time in her own kitchen. The cookies were crisp, and although the tiramisu was not perfect, it let her experience the pleasure of cooking with herbs and the sense of accomplishment from self-sufficiency.

events.name: Evening family time and preparations for the next day
events.description: In the evening, she shared the trial cookies with her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan. Her daughter especially liked the rosemary cookies. Afterward, Song Yajing checked her WeChat messages with Susan, the supplier in Guangzhou, and made initial arrangements for the purchasing trip two days later. Before bed, she did 15 minutes of stretching and meditation.

start_state.mood: Clear plans, high spirits.

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and satisfied, delighted with my first vanilla baking experience

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk of 3 km, electric scooter commute of 2.5 km.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with increasing clouds in the afternoon

2025-08.daily_overview: This was a day of intense internal and external clashes. In the morning, the community group was buzzing over vanilla. In the afternoon, the landlord extended an olive branch for expansion. Late at night, after a heart-to-heart with her husband and going over the accounts, she rationally declined and bought high-speed rail tickets to Guangzhou. In the early morning, she went for a brisk walk with her husband, kicking off a busy weekend.

events.name: Weekend morning brisk walk for couples
events.description: On Saturday, she got up a little later than usual. At 7:00, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang went to the community park for a 2.5-kilometer power walk. They chatted and adjusted their pace, and her husband praised her for being noticeably fitter now.

events.name: Second batch: scooter commuting and listening to podcasts on the way.
events.description: Song Yajing rode her electric scooter to the shop for the second day in a row. She put on her earphones and listened to a podcast about women's entrepreneurship, arriving at Zhongshan Road at an unhurried pace—even more relaxed than driving.

events.name: Preparing mint tea for the regular customer recommended by Vivian
events.description: In the morning, Vivian, a regular customer, came to the shop specially with two friends. Song Yajing brewed a pot of green tea and mint drink by hand with chilled mint leaves, and enthusiastically mentioned that the mint was grown on her own balcony. The customers were full of praise, and one of them immediately said she wanted to try growing mint at home too.

events.name: Gave away an herb potted plant and unexpectedly sparked a 'Balcony Spring Colors' chain
events.description: Song Yajing placed the small potted herbs she had divided the day before next to the counter, wrote a small sign saying "Gift for active community members", and notified several customers she often interacted with one by one. Unexpectedly, the customers who received the potted plants posted photos and thanks in the customer WeChat group, quickly triggering a "Balcony Spring Scenes" themed chain. Dozens of group members vied to show off their own plants, and the group was lively all day.

events.name: Landlord Sister Li showed her around the shop and raised the idea of expanding
events.description: In the afternoon, the landlady, Sister Li, brought a friend to look around the shop. Then she tactfully pointed to the newly vacated shop next door and asked Song Yajing if she was interested in renting it out and knocking through to expand. Song Yajing looked at the familiar storefront and felt a momentary stir inside, but only cautiously said she needed to discuss it with her husband and did not reply immediately.

events.name: Late at night, she and her husband went over the family's big accounts and rationally rejected expansion.
events.description: After closing the shop and returning home, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang spread out the electronic ledger in the study and laid out all their family accounts: their daughter would start primary school in September, so they needed to reserve 100,000 yuan in working capital; the shop still had a 60,000 yuan loan to repay; the travel fund was still zero; and spare cash was not abundant. After repeated calculations, they finally agreed—first, build up the family safety cushion, and do not take on expansion risk. That night, Song Yajing called Sister Li and politely declined the offer to lease the neighboring storefront, citing financial pressure. After hanging up, she breathed a long sigh of relief and instead felt an unprecedented sense of being settled.

events.name: Initial idea for a dedicated family protection savings fund
events.description: After declining the expansion, the couple continued their discussion in the living room. They reviewed their current income and expenses, and for the first time formally proposed setting up a dedicated emergency savings fund to cope with possible future fluctuations, laying the psychological and numerical foundation for formulating the next concrete plan.

events.name: Pack luggage and book train tickets to Guangzhou
events.description: After the business discussion, Song Yajing briskly opened the wardrobe, packed a two-day, one-night business trip outfit to Guangzhou, and copied the purchase list into her phone memo. Then she confirmed with her supplier Susan on WeChat the time to meet on the afternoon of August 3 at Shisanhang, and immediately booked an early high-speed rail ticket from Xiamen to Guangzhou on 12306. Before bed, she only did a simple stretch.

start_state.mood: Feeling good and looking forward to sharing with the community

end_state.mood: Grounded and clear-minded after making a major decision, full of drive for the Guangzhou trip.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk of 2.5 kilometers; commuted by electric scooter.

date_attribute.weather: Guangzhou will be mostly cloudy with occasional showers

2025-08.daily_overview: Set off in the early morning, took the high-speed rail alone to Guangzhou to start autumn purchasing. In the afternoon, visited Shisanhang with supplier Susan to pave the way for autumn selections. Although I missed Sunday Mass, I prayed briefly at the hotel in the morning and rested simply in the evening to recharge.

events.name: Woke up early, took a ride, and had a brief prayer at the hotel.
events.description: Got up at 5:30 in the morning, and her husband saw her off at Xiamen North Railway Station. Since she was rushing for the train and couldn't attend Mass, Song Yajing quietly read a passage of the Gospel on her phone and said a short prayer before leaving the hotel. She boarded the high-speed train at 6:40.

events.name: Take the early high-speed train to Guangzhou
events.description: During the four-plus-hour drive, she browsed fashion news apps and also dozed off for a few minutes.

events.name: Meeting with Susan and visiting the Shisanhang stalls
events.description: After arriving in Guangzhou at noon, she went directly to the Shisanhang Wholesale Market to meet Susan. Over a quick meal, the two exchanged views on Xiamen summer customer preferences. Then they visited five or six long-term partner stalls, feeling the fabrics and browsing autumn sample garments, gaining an initial sense of the popular colors and silhouettes of trench coats, knitwear, and skirts.

events.name: Initially screen and record candidate products.
events.description: Song Yajing used her phone to take photos and record item numbers of dozens of styles she was interested in, and noted down fabric composition, wholesale prices, and minimum order quantities in her pocket notebook, fully preparing the information for tomorrow's second-round selection and negotiation.

events.name: Evening solo review and family video call
events.description: In the hotel in Guangzhou, Song Yajing organized her afternoon selection notes into a spreadsheet on her phone, then had a video call with her husband and saw her daughter showing off the painting she had drawn today in front of the camera. After chatting about family matters, she briefly mentioned her feelings about tonight's selection to her husband, and he encouraged her to trust her own eye.

start_state.mood: Excited and nervous, worried about missing the train but staying organized.

end_state.mood: Though tired, she was satisfied with the initial screening results of the autumn goods and missed her family.

state.daily_exercise: Walking and shopping (covering longer distances inside the market).

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, with light showers in the evening

2025-08.daily_overview: Guangzhou procurement reached fever pitch; she spent the whole day at Shisanhang selecting autumn new styles, negotiating and finalizing each one. In the evening, she had a video call with her husband and finalized a monthly 4,000 yuan family security savings plan, moving financial security from idea to practice.

events.name: Selected more than 30 styles of autumn women's clothing at Shisanhang throughout the day
events.description: With Susan accompanying her the whole way, Song Yajing started at 9 a.m. and visited one by one the stalls screened yesterday, re-examining and comparing each knit top, trench coat, and skirt she liked, repeatedly confirming the fabric, workmanship, and color differences, and finally finalized an order of more than 30 new autumn styles.

events.name: Negotiate bulk discounts and logistics arrangements store by store
events.description: Song Yajing used her years of status as a regular customer to patiently negotiate a 3% to 5% bulk discount with each stall owner, and confirmed a unified shipping arrangement — all goods would be sent together to Xiamen through a long-term logistics line, which saved freight costs and made it easy to take stock after arrival.

events.name: In the evening, had a video call with her husband to finalize the family security fund plan
events.description: In the evening at the hotel in Guangzhou, Song Yajing had a crucial video call with her husband Chen Zhiqiang. They refined their earlier discussion and finally decided that from this month they would set aside a fixed 4,000 yuan per month as a family safety fund, to be used for emergencies first, not consumption. Song Yajing persuaded her husband to include part of his salary in automatic transfers, and the couple worked out a savings plan that could be implemented immediately. The plan was finalized on the call.

events.name: Organize the day's orders and update the purchase list
events.description: After agreeing on the financial plan with her husband, Song Yajing entered all the order details finalized during the day into a spreadsheet on her phone, marked each paid deposit and logistics milestone, and sent it to Susan for a synchronized backup to ensure both of them had the same information. Before bed, she did simple stretches to relax her feet.

start_state.mood: Focused, with clear goals.

end_state.mood: Physically tired but mentally resolved; substantial progress was made on both the inventory and family finance fronts.

state.daily_exercise: Extensive walking at the wholesale market.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning sunny

2025-08.daily_overview: In the morning, she video-called her husband and worked with him to open a dedicated contingency fund account, building a foundation for the family's ability to withstand risks. Then she went to the fashion trade fair alone to take in trend information. In the afternoon, she took the high-speed rail back to Xiamen and arrived home at dusk for a family reunion. Her weight had risen slightly because she had eaten out for several days.

events.name: Remote collaborative opening of a dedicated family security fund account
events.description: Early in the morning, Song Yajing started a WeChat video call with her husband Chen Zhiqiang from a hotel in Guangzhou. Her husband was at the ICBC branch in Siming District, Xiamen. Song Yajing verified her identity online and gave verbal authorization. Together they opened a dedicated family security fund account and set up an automatic monthly transfer of 4,000 yuan from part of his salary. Chen Zhiqiang proactively cooperated by handing over part of his salary card to complete the authorization. Song Yajing felt warm inside across the screen, and the family's ability to withstand risks was thus solidified.

events.name: Visited the Guangzhou International Clothing & Accessories Expo.
events.description: After finishing the bank business, Song Yajing went alone to the Pazhou Exhibition Center to visit the Guangzhou International Garment and Accessories Expo. Because she had been rushing around for days, she rested for half an hour at the café in the exhibition hall to recharge before continuing to browse. She carefully studied the season's cutting-edge silhouettes, fabrics, and color trends, and lingered a little longer at the sustainable fabric and China-chic design booths, gathering plenty of new inspiration that she could incorporate into her boutique.

events.name: Take the high-speed rail back to Xiamen
events.description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing boarded a high-speed train from Guangzhou South Station back to Xiamen. During the few hours on the way, she organized the several hundred photos she had taken this time, deleting blurry and duplicate ones, and filed key trend images into different inspiration folders.

events.name: Returning home for a family reunion and a small episode with the excited daughter.
events.description: Arriving at Xiamen North Station in the evening, her husband and daughter came to meet her. Her daughter rushed over and hugged her, chattering about the fun things that happened at home over the past two days. After getting home, the daughter was overly excited that her mother was back and kept clinging to her asking to read picture books together, and it was nearly 9:30 before she was coaxed to sleep. Song Yajing relaxed after taking a shower, but because her daughter had been fussy about sleep, her own falling asleep was slightly delayed.

start_state.mood: Though tired, she was clear about the goal and knew this was the final task.

end_state.mood: Satisfied, relaxed, and inwardly secure because the family's financial foundation has been built and the shopping yielded abundant results.

state.daily_exercise: Walking in the exhibition hall.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, temperature rising.

2025-08.daily_overview: The first day back at the store passed smoothly as I organized the Guangzhou haul and received regular customers. I resumed my morning brisk walk, and also noticed news about a developing typhoon, quietly making a mental note.

events.name: Resume brisk morning walks
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Song Yajing set foot on the park running track again and completed a 2.8 km brisk walk. Her body felt a bit heavy, but because she hadn't exercised for a few days due to a business trip, she deliberately slowed her pace to 9 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer to get back into rhythm.

events.name: Organize in-store samples and new product orders
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing hung up and ironed the dozen or so sample garments she had brought back from Guangzhou, sorting them by category. She checked the order list and the logistics tracking numbers sent by suppliers with Xiaomei, and arranged for Xiaomei to enter the expected arrival style numbers into the inventory system in advance, making room for the large-scale display for the September fall new arrivals.

events.name: Iced mint tea is once again a customer favorite
events.description: In the afternoon, regular customer Vivian came into the store with another close friend. Song Yajing took the mint leaves she had washed fresh in the morning out of the refrigerator and made two glasses of iced mint tea for them. The three chatted while drinking. The friend was full of praise for the mint tea and immediately said she wanted to buy a few mint seedlings to take home and grow. Song Yajing smiled and agreed to propagate more cuttings and give them to her next time.

events.name: Noticed the news that a typhoon was forming.
events.description: During a break in her busy day, Song Yajing saw on her phone weather app that a tropical cyclone had formed on the ocean surface east of the Philippines and its path might head toward the coast of Fujian. She also saw several fellow church members sharing meteorological science articles on Moments, made a mental note of it, and planned to keep watching.

start_state.mood: Returning to daily routine, relaxed and bright

end_state.mood: Relieved that the store was back on track, she quietly began to keep an eye on the typhoon's path.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk of 2.8 kilometers; commuted by electric scooter

date_attribute.weather: Hot and muggy; the outer cloud bands of a typhoon appeared in the afternoon.

2025-08.daily_overview: As Typhoon Haikui approached, Song Yajing kept the shop running while starting preparations. Her morning brisk walk felt a bit strenuous due to the muggy heat. In the evening, she video-chatted with her close friend Zhao Min about the typhoon and everyday topics, and went to bed a little late.

events.name: Morning brisk walk in the muggy weather
events.description: Left at 6:30; the air was unusually hot and muggy. Song Yajing insisted on completing 2.5 kilometers, but her pace dropped to 10 minutes per kilometer. After returning home, she took a shower and finally recovered.

events.name: Monitor typhoon path and early discussion
events.description: When she got up in the morning, Song Yajing saw that the Xiamen Meteorological Observatory had upgraded the tropical cyclone to Typhoon Kalmaegi, predicting that its path might directly affect southern Fujian. At breakfast, she briefly discussed it with her husband Chen Zhiqiang. The two agreed that if the warning was upgraded, they would prepare in advance.

events.name: Daily store operations while also making reinforcement contingency plans
events.description: After opening the store, Song Yajing greeted the scattered customers while mentally calculating the store's typhoon preparedness supplies—windbreak boards, sandbags, and reserves. She deliberately had Xiaomei, the shop assistant, count the existing reinforcement tools in the corner of the warehouse so that she knew exactly what was on hand.

events.name: Forwarded the typhoon alert for the first time in the community group
events.description: During the lunch break, Song Yajing forwarded a widely shared typhoon preparedness reminder in the shop’s customer group and the church fellowship group, telling everyone to check doors and windows and charge power banks in advance. Many neighbors in the group responded, reminding each other to stock up on dry food.
