events.name: Video call with best friend Zhao Min in the evening
events.description: At 9 p.m., college best friend Zhao Min called via video and they chatted for nearly an hour, mainly worrying about the typhoon and sharing about their recent lives. After hanging up, Song Yajing looked at weather information for a while and went to sleep at nearly 11:30.

start_state.mood: Slightly worried about the typhoon, but not panicked.

end_state.mood: I know what I'm doing. I've gotten mentally prepared and made preliminary material preparations for the typhoon.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk of 2.5 kilometers; commuted by electric scooter.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy in the morning; after noon, a typhoon made landfall with violent winds and heavy rain.

2025-08.daily_overview: Typhoon Haiou hit head-on, and Song Yajing transformed into a calm hostess and community leader. In the morning, she urgently reinforced the shop; at noon, she returned home to work side by side on typhoon prevention, and delivered supplies to neighbors living alone; in the evening, she gave a live voice broadcast in the community group, creating a strong sense of cohesion. Due to the heavy physical exertion, she went to bed early on the typhoon night.

events.name: Received an orange typhoon warning and decided to suspend business.
events.description: Around 10 a.m., Song Yajing received a push notification from the meteorological station about an orange typhoon warning in her shop, predicting that Typhoon Kalmaegi would make landfall in the evening. She immediately decided to close the shop early and turned all her attention to disaster prevention.

events.name: With Xiaomei, comprehensively reinforce the store
events.description: Song Yajing and shop assistant Xiaomei acted quickly: first, they placed a 'Temporarily Closed' sign at the store entrance and guided several unaware customers to leave as soon as possible. Then the two carried out wind protection boards from the warehouse and firmly fixed the street-facing display windows with screws and tape; together they moved electronic equipment such as the cash register and computers to high shelves, and boxes of new clothing were also moved to the middle storage shelves and tightly covered with waterproof canvas; finally, they worked together to stack sandbags densely at the bottom of the door gaps to prevent rainwater from flowing in. After finishing, they checked repeatedly, turned off the main power, locked the store door, and then each hurried home.

events.name: Posted an urgent typhoon alert in the community group
events.description: Before leaving the store, Song Yajing had already issued a serious typhoon emergency notice in the customer group and the church fellowship group, attaching safety tips and telling everyone that the store was temporarily closed and that they should not go out unless necessary.

events.name: Completed home typhoon preparedness together with husband
events.description: Rushed home at noon. Song Yajing immediately worked with her husband Chen Zhiqiang to move the potted plants of various sizes from the balcony indoors, checked the door and window locks one by one, and reinforced the glass with tape. The two cooperated seamlessly and had the house properly protected in less than an hour.

events.name: Purchase emergency supplies and buy an extra set for neighbor Aunt Zhang
events.description: After completing the family protection measures, the couple drove to a supermarket near the community and bought emergency supplies such as bottled water, instant noodles, power banks, and candles. Before checking out, Song Yajing thought of Aunt Zhang, who lived alone next door, so she picked up an identical set of supplies and, on the way back, delivered them to Aunt Zhang's home, reminding the elderly woman to keep doors and windows closed and to call anytime if anything came up.

events.name: Prepare for the evening community voice livestream
events.description: After returning home in the afternoon, the rain outside grew heavier. Song Yajing tested the voice livestream feature on her phone, organized the disaster-avoidance points accumulated during the day, and reviewed The Snail and the Oriole with her daughter Chen Lexuan in the living room. The mother and daughter agreed to sing to the uncles and aunties in the group in the evening. Then she posted a preview in the customer group about the 8 PM voice livestream.

events.name: Typhoon night community voice livestream—sharing experiences and offering mutual support.
events.description: At 8 pm, it was already windy and rainy outside. Song Yajing started a voice livestream in the customer group on time. She first greeted the group members, then shared practical experience on door and window reinforcement, emergency supplies preparation, and electrical safety using specific examples from her own home. In the middle of the livestream, she invited her daughter Chen Lexuan to sing 'Snail and the Oriole' together. The tender childish voice spread through the phone to every participant, instantly softening the tense atmosphere.

events.name: During the livestream, a customer sent a greeting red packet, and she donated it to the flood prevention fund on the customer's behalf.
events.description: During the livestream, members of the group sent short videos of the wind and rain outside their own windows, reminding one another to stay safe. Several regular customers and fellow church members sent caring red envelopes. Song Yajing solemnly announced in the livestream that, on behalf of the community, she would donate the full amount of all red envelopes received that night to the community's flood-control emergency fund. She immediately took screenshots of each red envelope and made them public. This move won a round of likes.

events.name: Ended the livestream and got the family settled.
events.description: At nearly 21:00, the live stream ended in a heartwarming atmosphere. Song Yajing reminded everyone again to continue to stay safe and announced that she would follow up on donation feedback tomorrow. After putting down her phone, she and her husband had a simple dinner with their daughter, using the desk lamp prepared in advance, safely getting through the most violent stretch of the typhoon's passage. Extremely exhausted, she skipped stretching and meditation and lay down to rest directly.

start_state.mood: Alert and calm, ready to act.

end_state.mood: Although exhausted, she felt deeply gratified and reassured that she could take care of those around her and bring the community together.

state.daily_exercise: Reinforcing the shop and carrying supplies (considerable physical exertion)

date_attribute.weather: Overcast with scattered showers in the morning, turning partly cloudy in the afternoon.

2025-08.daily_overview: On the first morning after the typhoon passed, Song Yajing checked the safety of her home and store, initiated a community safety check-in chain and mutual aid, fulfilled her donation promise, and booked a diving experience for the next day. She skipped her morning brisk walk but rode a kick scooter to clean up.

events.name: Checked the safety of the home and the store.
events.description: Early in the morning, Song Yajing first checked every corner of the house to confirm there was no water seepage or damage; then she cycled to the shop on Zhongshan Road, saw that the reinforcement measures were intact with only a few traces of rainwater. She took photos of the scene and felt relieved.

events.name: The community launched a "report safe" chain and disaster mutual aid.
events.description: Back home, Song Yajing started a 'reporting you're safe' chain in the customer group, asking group members to report their household situation in a few words. After tallying the replies, she found that two neighboring households reported flooding and power outage. She immediately coordinated group members nearby who were able to help to deliver power banks and hot food to those two households. The community's mutual-aid tradition was formally established through this action.

events.name: Coordinate with the flood control fund and publicly disclose the donation receipts.
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing called the person in charge of the community flood control emergency fund to confirm that the total amount of the red packets she had donated on everyone's behalf last night had arrived in full. She then posted a screenshot of the donation receipt in the community group, sincerely thanked the group members again for their kindness, and carefully recorded the organizational experience from the livestream in her phone's notes.

events.name: Call to book a trial diving experience.
events.description: During a break, Song Yajing remembered the diving experience recommended by her friend earlier, so she called a diving club near Wutong Wharf, booked an introductory diving session for the afternoon of August 10, and confirmed the time, price, and one-on-one instructor arrangement. She felt both nervous and excited about this new attempt tomorrow.

events.name: Preliminary cleanup of the store and planning to resume business.
events.description: In the afternoon, the weather improved. Song Yajing and Xiaomei returned to the store, put the sandbags back in place, dried the floor, and rearranged the goods, making simple preparations for reopening the next day. She also made a point of hanging up a small blackboard at the door that read “Normal business tomorrow.” In the evening, she did a simple stretching routine.

start_state.mood: With the calm after the storm, she was concerned about the neighbors' situation.

end_state.mood: Reassured by the smooth community mutual aid and the fulfilled donation, and curious about tomorrow’s diving.

state.daily_exercise: Electric scooter round trip to the store and a small amount of household cleaning

date_attribute.weather: Clear and sunny, with a spotless blue sky

2025-08.daily_overview: Sunday morning was spent tidying the herb garden; in the afternoon I completed my first-ever dive and was awestruck by the seabed. In the evening I rode a scooter to pick up flower materials for Zhao Li. The dive took a huge toll on my energy, so I was exhausted and went to bed early that night.

events.name: Make mint tea bags and offer them in limited quantities.
events.description: Early in the morning, Song Yajing carefully washed and dried the remaining mint leaves that had been brought back before the typhoon. Then, together with Xiao Mei, she packed the mint leaves into small gauze tea bags at the store. She placed the tea bags in a small rattan basket on the counter, with a sign reading 'House-made mint tea, limited daily, welcome to take some,' as a little thank-you for regular customers.

events.name: Final pruning of the balcony herbs for the season.
events.description: At home in the morning, Song Yajing gave the balcony herbs, which had become a bit messy after the typhoon, one last careful trim, clearing away dead branches and leaves. She took nine photos capturing the whole summer from sowing to flourishing growth to harvest, posted them on Moments with a short reflection, and brought her first herb season to a close. Since she couldn't go to church on Sunday, she said a brief silent prayer.

events.name: First-time scuba diving experience
events.description: In the afternoon, she went alone to the diving club near Wutong Wharf at the appointed time. Under the one-on-one guidance of a professional instructor, she gradually let go of her fear as she put on the equipment, learned to breathe underwater, and slowly descended to the seabed. When the colorful tropical fish and swaying coral groups appeared before her eyes for the first time, she was completely awed and felt this was the bravest thing she had done this year.

events.name: Sharing the joy of diving with her husband
events.description: After the dive, Song Yajing changed clothes in the club's rest area and couldn't wait to send the underwater photos taken by the instructor to her husband Chen Zhiqiang via WeChat. She excitedly sent a string of voice messages describing the fantastic underwater experience. Her husband praised her again and again and promised to bring their daughter to see the sea next time.

events.name: Rode a scooter to help Zhao Li pick up flower materials.
events.description: On the way back, her friend Zhao Li sent a message asking Song Yajing to go to the flower market two kilometers away to pick up an urgently needed special floral material. Without saying a word, Song Yajing rode her electric scooter to the flower market, picked up the floral material, and delivered it to Zhao Li's studio. After riding just a few kilometers, her back was slightly sweaty, and she unexpectedly found that this light exercise was very stress-relieving.

events.name: Fell asleep extremely early
events.description: After returning home, Song Yajing took a quick shower, had only a bowl of soup for dinner, then collapsed into bed from extreme exhaustion and fell into a deep sleep before 21:30. She did no stretching or meditation.

start_state.mood: Leisurely and carefree, enjoying the tranquility after the typhoon.

end_state.mood: Extremely thrilled and proud of herself for overcoming her fear, but physically exhausted.

state.daily_exercise: Dove for about 40 minutes and rode an electric scooter about 4 kilometers.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, summer heat returns.

2025-08.daily_overview: A new week began. Due to thigh soreness from diving, Song Yajing paused her morning brisk walking and instead started a new habit of making light lunches at home. In the evening, she discussed investing the family security fund with her husband and put 20,000 yuan into low-risk products.

events.name: Thigh soreness was obvious; paused morning brisk walking.
events.description: When she got up early, Song Yajing felt obvious soreness in both thighs and her lower back, and her walking posture was slightly affected. She knew it was the result of being too tense during yesterday's diving. She canceled her morning exercise and applied a hot towel to her legs for half an hour.

events.name: Buy a week's worth of light meal ingredients at the supermarket.
events.description: Before opening the store in the morning, Song Yajing walked slowly to the community supermarket despite the pain. Following the light meal recipes she had saved earlier, she bought a week's worth of ingredients including lettuce, arugula, cherry tomatoes, chicken breast, eggs, and whole wheat bread, planning to prepare refreshing light lunches for herself at noon on workdays.

events.name: Day one of making a homemade light lunch
events.description: At noon, Song Yajing opened the lunch box she had brought in an insulated bag that morning in the store's rest area, and for the first time ate a homemade chicken Caesar salad and whole wheat bread at the shop. Compared with the usual shacha noodles and fast food from outside, she felt the taste was refreshing and she wasn't sleepy in the afternoon. She was satisfied with this change.

events.name: Discussed and decided to take 20,000 yuan from the security fund to purchase wealth management products.
events.description: In the evening, as the soreness eased somewhat, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang sat on the living room sofa and reopened the security fund plan. She suggested that, while keeping a sufficient emergency reserve, they could withdraw 20,000 yuan to buy low-risk wealth management products and transfer 2,000 yuan from monthly savings into a more liquid money market fund, so the money would not sit completely idle. Her husband listened carefully and agreed, and the two made an initial comparison of the features of several products.

events.name: Update the family ledger and mark tomorrow's bank to-do
events.description: After the discussion, Song Yajing recorded in detail this month's savings allocation adjustment plan in the family electronic bookkeeping app and marked in her schedule that she would go to the bank tomorrow morning to handle wealth management and money market fund settings. Before bed, she forced herself to do targeted lower-body stretches despite being tired.

start_state.mood: Sore and uncomfortable, but in a calm state of mind.

end_state.mood: Fulfilled from completing new habit formation and financial advancement, and feeling a strong sense of planning for tomorrow

state.daily_exercise: Commuted by electric scooter (rode slowly because of soreness)

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with thin clouds visible in the afternoon.

2025-08.daily_overview: In the morning, went to the bank to buy the first wealth management product, and the family assets began to "breathe"; in the afternoon, selected a birthday gift for Father on Mobile Taobao and had it delivered home; in the evening, the whole family watched the IMAX movie Inception. My daughter was excited, but we returned home early, so bedtime was somewhat earlier.

events.name: Go to the ICBC Siming Sub-branch to consult about and purchase low-risk wealth management products
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing, despite the lingering soreness in her legs, walked to the ICBC Siming Sub-branch near her home and met with account manager Lin Xiaofeng. Manager Lin introduced in detail a 6-month wealth management product with an annualized return rate of 3.2% and a plan for regular monthly investment in a money market fund. Song Yajing decided on the spot to buy 20,000 yuan of the wealth management product from the family emergency fund account, and set up an automatic monthly transfer of 2,000 yuan into the money market fund to balance returns and liquidity. She completed all the procedures with Manager Lin's assistance.

events.name: At noon, continue with the light meal preparation.
events.description: Returning to the store at noon, Song Yajing took out the ingredients prepared that morning from the refrigerator, and used the store's quick-boil kettle and simple tools to make a light meal mainly of boiled eggs and fresh vegetables, paired with a pot of homemade mint water, and ate it slowly.

events.name: Pick out a birthday polo shirt for Dad in the afternoon.
events.description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing told Xiao Mei to watch the store, while she used the Taobao app on her phone to browse men's clothing. Imagining her father Song Minghui, she carefully selected a dark blue polo shirt made of soft fabric, understated and steady in style, placed the order, and chose express delivery to home, as a heartfelt gift for her father's birthday two days later.

events.name: The whole family watched the rerelease of Inception.
events.description: After closing the store early, Song Yajing went to Siming Wanda Cinema to meet her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan. The family of three picked up their tickets, bought popcorn and drinks, and watched the re-release of Inception in the theater. It was her daughter's first time seeing a sci-fi film on the big screen; she was so excited that she kept whispering questions. Her husband patiently answered them, and Song Yajing immersed herself in the rare family time.

events.name: Daughter stayed up late, excited after watching the movie
events.description: After the movie ended, the family lingered in the mall for a while. The daughter only shopped for a short time before they went home together. On the way home, the daughter kept chattering about the movie. By the time she finished washing up and lay down, it was nearly 11 p.m., but Song Yajing only tidied herself up after her daughter fell asleep, and went to bed at 23:15. She only did a few simple stretches.

start_state.mood: Clear objective for the errand; the leg soreness has eased a bit.

end_state.mood: My legs were sore, but the family time was warm, and I felt deep satisfaction before falling asleep

state.daily_exercise: Walked to the bank and back, and strolled around the mall.

date_attribute.weather: Brief hot thunderstorm in the afternoon

2025-08.daily_overview: On Wednesday, she returned to the store routine, continued eating light meals, started doing initial displays for the fall new arrivals, and mulled over birthday wishes for her father. The soreness in her thighs had basically disappeared, but she remained cautious and did not resume morning running. Because of the light meals and stopping high-intensity exercise, her weight crept up slightly, which made her adjust her salad dressing amount to cut calories.

events.name: Initial display of autumn new arrivals at the shop
events.description: The morning was not too busy. Song Yajing and Xiaomei dressed the mannequins in several new arrivals from Guangzhou, adjusting the window display to the autumn theme. She was able to squat down and pick up items with ease, feeling grateful that her body had recovered quickly enough. She tried combining brown-orange tones with faux autumn leaves to create an early fall atmosphere.

events.name: Third consecutive day of bringing a light lunch from home
events.description: Song Yajing had prepared an avocado egg sandwich and a small box of fruit cucumbers today, and ate them slowly in the back room of the shop. She noticed that after several days of eating lightly, her skin seemed clearer when she looked in the mirror in the afternoon, and she felt more convinced of this new habit.

events.name: Answer the follow-up call from the diving club.
events.description: In the afternoon, the diving club's customer service made a follow-up call to ask about her experience. Song Yajing sincerely praised the instructor's patience and also mentioned wanting to invite her close friends to experience it again; the other party said they could reserve a discounted spot. After hanging up, she couldn't help looking through the underwater photos taken a couple of days ago.

events.name: Test the video call and compose birthday wishes for Dad.
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing conducted a short video test at the store with her mother Lin Xiuying, who was far away in Quanzhou, via WeChat, to make sure the network was smooth and the audio and video were clear. She was mentally drafting the birthday wishes she would say to her father the day after tomorrow at noon, and a smile unconsciously spread across her face. Before bed, she did gentle stretching and tried to return to meditation, but her focus was only so-so.

start_state.mood: Calm and organized

end_state.mood: A gentle sense of anticipation, warmed by the approaching birthday of her father

state.daily_exercise: Electric scooter commute and light stretching; thigh is no longer a problem.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, slightly muggy.

2025-08.daily_overview: Muscle soreness completely disappeared. Song Yajing cautiously resumed light morning brisk walking, shortening the distance to 2 kilometers. She continued with light meals and made dried mint tea bags, preparing for her father's birthday tomorrow, her mind already flying to Quanzhou.

events.name: Resume light morning brisk walking
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Song Yajing felt recovered and tried going out for a brisk walk, but consciously slowed her pace, completing only 2 kilometers at a pace of 10 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer, making sure she felt no discomfort. After returning home, she stretched her legs carefully.

events.name: Continue to reinforce the light-meal habit and develop new combinations
events.description: Today Song Yajing tried adding quinoa and roasted pumpkin cubes to a salad bowl, and the taste was unexpectedly good. She sent a photo of her lunch to the group chat with her two best friends. Li Meiling immediately liked it and asked for the recipe, while Wang Jia teased her about transforming from a dessert master into a light food blogger.

events.name: Confirmed tomorrow's video call time with Mom via WeChat.
events.description: In the morning, her mother Lin Xiuying proactively sent a message on WeChat, saying that she would open WeChat early tomorrow noon to wait, and also mentioned that her father had been looking well recently and often talked about the tea his daughter sent him. Song Yajing set an alarm for tomorrow's reminder to make sure it wouldn't be delayed by shop business.

events.name: Use the spare time to make dried mint tea bags
events.description: Looking at the last bunch of fresh mint, Song Yajing decided not to let it wilt. She carefully dried the leaves in the microwave in the back room of the store, then packed them into several small resealable bags as simple mint tea sachets, planning to send them to her parents tomorrow for her father to steep in water.

events.name: In the evening, she put together a small remote celebration plan for her father's birthday.
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Song Yajing wrapped the polo shirt simply in gift paper, placed it on the desk, and prepared to show it on camera during tomorrow's video call. She also had her daughter Chen Lexuan draw a birthday card for Grandpa, intending to give her father a surprise tomorrow. She meditated before sleep, filled with gratitude.

start_state.mood: Cheerful and looking forward to tomorrow's family video

end_state.mood: Composure and gratitude with everything in place.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk of 2 kilometers, then commuting by electric scooter.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with a gentle breeze in the evening.

2025-08.daily_overview: The emotional thread ran through the entire day. In the morning, she resumed her full morning brisk walk; at noon, she celebrated her father's birthday via video and received his reminder to “keep a calm mind”; in the evening, while breaking a light sweat on the scooter, she discovered the joy of exercise; at night, during meditation, her mind drifted to childhood, and afterward she couldn't help catching up with old classmates in her group chat. After signing up for the gathering, she was too excited to fall asleep and went to bed a bit later than usual.

events.name: Resume the full morning power-walking routine.
events.description: Waking up naturally at 6:20 in the morning, Song Yajing went to the community park full of energy, easily completed a 2.5-kilometer brisk walk, and her pace returned to 9 minutes per kilometer. She felt that her physical fitness had basically recovered.

events.name: Celebrate father's birthday via video at noon
events.description: During the noon break at the shop, Song Yajing opened a WeChat video call on time in the rest area to connect with her parents far away in Quanzhou. She showed the dark blue polo shirt to the camera, and her daughter Chen Lexuan also held up a hand-drawn birthday card and leaned in. Her father Song Minghui repeatedly praised the shirt for fitting well and urged her not to work too hard in Xiamen and to keep a calm mind; her mother Lin Xiuying shared a mousse cake recipe she had recently tried. In the frame, the family of three kept laughing across the screens, warm and cozy.

events.name: Contact the courier to send out the dried mint tea and gifts
events.description: After the video call, Song Yajing handed the homemade dried mint tea bags and a polo shirt to the courier who came to pick up the package, sending it to her hometown in Quanzhou, hoping her father could wear it soon. On the waybill, she wrote, 'Fragile items; handle with care.'

events.name: In the evening, commuting by electric scooter, experiencing the joy of exercise.
events.description: After work today, Song Yajing rode her electric scooter home as usual. The evening breeze was slightly cool, and she suddenly noticed that her back was a bit sweaty. This slight exertion made her redefine the scooter from a 'commute tool' to 'light exercise' for the first time. The corners of her mouth lifted. No longer in a hurry, she rode slowly, enjoying this solitary stretch of road with no one urging her on.

events.name: In the evening, was pulled into the elementary school classmates group, initially feeling surprised and hesitant.
events.description: After dinner, while Song Yajing was resting in the living room, her phone suddenly vibrated. She was added to a WeChat group called "Quanzhou Experimental Primary School, Class 6, Class of 2007." The class monitor sent a notice calling for the first reunion dinner after graduation to be held on August 17. As she scrolled past the familiar-looking names, a complex ripple rose in her heart—excitement at seeing old friends again, but also worry about the store being understaffed and about taking her daughter to and from school.

events.name: After discussing with her husband, she decided to sign up for the class reunion.
events.description: Song Yajing took her phone into the study and told her husband Chen Zhiqiang, who was busy coding overtime, about her hesitation over the classmate group. Her husband paused his work, listened attentively, then patted the back of her hand and said cheerfully, 'I'll take leave on the 17th to pick up Lexuan. Xiaomei can cover the store for the whole day. Don't worry, go see your old friends.' His firm support put Song Yajing's mind at ease. She immediately replied in the group, 'I'll sign up and look forward to meeting everyone.' After putting down her phone, she felt much lighter.

events.name: Evening meditation
events.description: Before going to sleep, Song Yajing meditated as usual, but childhood memories surfaced in her mind and her concentration dropped. She barely managed to complete 10 minutes of meditation, and it was less effective than usual.

events.name: Staying up late due to catching up with old classmates in the group chat.
events.description: After meditation, Song Yajing couldn't help opening the group chat again and talked animatedly about childhood memories with Liu Fang, Wu Xiaoli, and others she hadn't seen in years, until she forced herself to put down her phone at nearly 23:45. Her heart was filled with a warm connection.

start_state.mood: Made a special note to be on time for the video call, feeling eager.

end_state.mood: Wrapped in warm nostalgia

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk of 2.5 kilometers, then a light-sweat commute on an electric scooter.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny and hot, isolated thunderstorms in the afternoon, 34°C

2025-08.daily_overview: On Saturday, Song Yajing's schedule had originally focused on the shop and preparations for the next day's gathering, but at noon she suddenly learned that her good friend Zhao Li's mother had suffered a stroke. She quickly deployed staff, mobilized the community, and covered shifts herself while juggling multiple responsibilities. Returning home in the evening to check the next day's logistics, she was physically and mentally tired but felt reassured for being able to help a friend.

events.name: Arranged Sunday store handover and gathering preparations.
events.description: After arriving at the store in the morning, Song Yajing talked with clerk Xiaomei and told her that on the afternoon of the 17th she would go out to attend a dinner with elementary school classmates, asking Xiaomei to take sole charge of the store on Sunday. She then neatly prepared the new arrivals that were planned to go on sale on the 17th, labeling each item with a price and styling tips so Xiaomei could handle things easily.

events.name: Emergency response after Zhao Li's mother suddenly had a stroke
events.description: At noon, her good friend Zhao Li urgently asked in the group for help: her mother had suddenly suffered a stroke and was in critical condition, needing manpower and resources urgently. Song Yajing immediately called Zhao Li to calm her down and asked in detail what exactly she needed.

events.name: Redeploy resources: lend out the store clerk and cover the shift myself.
events.description: To let Zhao Li focus on handling her mother's hospitalization, Song Yajing immediately decided to lend Xiaomei, a clerk familiar with floral design, to Zhao Li for half a day to handle the studio's urgent orders. She stayed in the clothing store to cover the shift while coordinating matters on both sides by phone.

events.name: Mobilize the community to help maintain Zhao Li's studio cash flow
events.description: Song Yajing quickly forwarded Zhao Li's flower bouquet pre-sale information to the shop's customer group and Moments, calling on everyone to lend a hand. Group members responded immediately, not only spreading the word, but several regular customers also helped contact an ambulance and provided leads for temporary care. Song Yajing coordinated in the middle and played a key connecting role.

events.name: Return home in the evening to verify logistics and clear the way for tomorrow's gathering
events.description: After closing the shop and returning home in the evening, Song Yajing checked the refrigerator and supplies to make sure there were enough ingredients for her husband and daughter's dinner. She also messaged her daughter's kindergarten teacher to say that her husband might pick up their daughter on Monday. Then she briefly synced with her husband about the Zhao Li family matter, and her husband said he understood.

events.name: Hurriedly preparing party desserts late at night
events.description: Only before going to bed did she remember she had promised to bring homemade pastries the next day, so she hurriedly baked a tray of cranberry cookies. It was late into the night when she finished packing, and she sighed at how she easily forgets when busy.

start_state.mood: Calm, with a relaxed weekend feel.

end_state.mood: Tired but at peace because she helped a close friend.

state.daily_exercise: None (busy all day)

date_attribute.weather: Sunny and hot, 34°C

2025-08.daily_overview: On Sunday, Song Yajing temporarily left the shop to attend an elementary school reunion that spanned many years. She dressed up carefully and brought homemade desserts. During the meal, she unexpectedly reunited with Lin Wei, her deskmate whom she had lost touch with for years. The two talked about everything from career changes to their love of creative work, and renewed their friendship on the spot. After the gathering, she stopped by the shop to check on it, and in the evening brought the surprise home to share.

events.name: Dressing up carefully, preparing gifts, and heading to the gathering.
events.description: At home in the morning, Song Yajing changed into a newly arrived floral print dress, put on light makeup, and packed the cranberry cookies she had made last night as gifts. Before leaving, she specifically confirmed with her husband the arrangements for their daughter in the afternoon.

events.name: Head to the restaurant for a dinner gathering with elementary school classmates.
events.description: Around 11 o'clock, Song Yajing drove to a Minnan-style private restaurant on Hubin North Road in Siming District to meet nearly twenty elementary school classmates. During the meal, everyone raised glasses and laughed about childhood embarrassing moments, and the atmosphere was lively and warm.

events.name: Surprise reunion with former deskmate Lin Wei, discovering how much they had both changed
events.description: During the free conversation, Song Yajing recognized the quiet smiling figure in the corner as Lin Wei, her third-grade deskmate. The two happily reunited. Lin Wei shared her journey of switching from accounting to becoming an independent illustrator, and Song Yajing shared her baking photos. They found that both had shifted from a routine-driven life to a passion-driven one and hit it off immediately.

events.name: Added each other on WeChat and agreed to quarterly creative sharing
events.description: Before the meal ended, Song Yajing took the initiative to suggest adding each other on WeChat, and they agreed to share their works online every quarter — watercolors and desserts — so that their childhood friendship could continue through creative resonance. Lin Wei readily agreed.

events.name: After the gathering, I stopped by the store to check on it; in the evening, family sharing.
events.description: After the banquet ended at 2:30 pm, Song Yajing drove to the shop on Zhongshan Road. Seeing Xiao Mei independently and skillfully attending to customers and everything in good order, she praised her with relief. After returning home, she enthusiastically told her husband and daughter the story of the reunion.

start_state.mood: A little thrill of looking forward to meeting an old friend.

end_state.mood: Content and relaxed, delighted to have reconnected with childhood friendship.

state.daily_exercise: Short walk

date_attribute.weather: Partly cloudy with afternoon showers, 32°C

2025-08.daily_overview: On Monday, Song Yajing returned to the store to run the daily operations and dealt with the backlog of consultations from the weekend. Starting from that day, she began a fixed evening routine of supporting Zhao Li's floral design studio, riding an electric scooter there for the first time—inexperienced but determined.

events.name: Handle routine store affairs and online customer service.
events.description: After arriving at the store in the morning, Song Yajing and Xiaomei organized the weekend sales records together, replied one by one to community customers' inquiries about the new autumn arrivals, and reserved popular styles for several regular customers.

events.name: Stuck to her light meal habit at noon.
events.description: At noon, she enjoyed a homemade chicken breast salad with fruit tea at the shop and took photos to document it. It was the second week of her light meal plan, and she had grown used to this fresh, simple lunch.

events.name: First evening support at Zhao Li Florist Studio.
events.description: After closing in the evening, Song Yajing rode the electric scooter she had been using recently to Zhao Li's floral studio in Huli District. Zhao Li's mother was hospitalized, so she stayed at the hospital during the day and only rushed back in the evening to handle orders. Song Yajing helped trim flower stems, make bouquets, and reply to online messages until ten o'clock at night.

start_state.mood: Calm, but faintly worried about Zhao Li

end_state.mood: Tired, but duty-bound

2025-08.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Song Yajing booked her annual physical exam in the morning, then shot a large amount of material at the shop for online pre-promotion, and shared her light meal records in the baking group, receiving enthusiastic feedback from fellow enthusiasts. In the evening, while helping Zhao Li, she was already able to wrap simple bouquets independently, and she felt the small joy of growing in an unfamiliar field.

events.name: Book annual physical exam.
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing remembered the reminder from the health center, took time to contact her family doctor Wang Mingyuan via WeChat, and booked her annual physical exam for the morning of August 25. Dr. Wang quickly confirmed and told her to come on an empty stomach. The worry of having gone nearly three years without a check-up finally made it onto the schedule.

events.name: Shooting outfit content for the new autumn collection
events.description: In the morning, when there were few customers, Song Yajing used her phone with a tripod to shoot outfit videos and photos of several new autumn styles in the shop, while Xiaomei helped organize the clothes and set up lighting, striving to create a warm and fashionable autumn atmosphere.

events.name: Share light meal tips in the baking group.
events.description: During the lunch break, she posted photos and thoughts about the past week's light meals to the baking hobby group. Mrs. Liu instantly liked the post and shared her own fat-loss recipe, suggesting trying quinoa salad; Song Yajing noted it carefully, and the two launched into a lively discussion about healthy eating.

events.name: Handling a picky customer's exchange request
events.description: In the afternoon, a customer came to the store to exchange an item ordered online that didn't fit, and was impatient. Song Yajing patiently took measurements and selected an alternative style; in the end the customer left satisfied and even bought an extra accessory.

events.name: More proficient with evening support.
events.description: In the evening, she rode the electric scooter to the floral studio again. Song Yajing could now independently finish bouquet wrapping and instant consultation replies. When Zhao Li hurried over from the hospital and saw that everything was in order, her eyes grew warm. After they finished their work, the two had a simple dinner together and chatted about light topics.

start_state.mood: Positive and driven.

end_state.mood: With a small sense of accomplishment from progress in flower arranging

2025-08.daily_overview: Wednesday was extremely packed: in the morning, Song Yajing raised a nighttime lighting initiative in the community group and called the property management office. At noon, she successfully launched a fall new-product preorder in the store's customer group and secured 12 orders that very evening. By the time she was helping Zhao Li at night, she had grown used to fighting on two fronts.

events.name: Proposed enhancing nighttime lighting in the homeowners' group.
events.description: In the morning, because her close friend Li Meiling was feeling unwell from pregnancy nausea, Song Yajing on her own proposed systematic improvement suggestions in the community WeChat group, pointing out several lighting blind spots and attaching photos she had taken at night, advocating the installation of sensor streetlights. Her clear plan immediately received responses from several neighbors.

events.name: Proactively call the property management to discuss the specific plan.
events.description: To leave no loose ends, she immediately called the neighborhood property management office and described the hazardous spots and the required lighting specifications in detail to the manager. The property management replied that they would send someone to inspect the site as soon as possible. Song Yajing then shared the progress in the group.

events.name: Launched limited-time presale for new autumn products and got off to a successful start.
events.description: At noon, Song Yajing posted the edited outfit videos and photos to the shop's VIP community, announcing a three-day 10% off pre-sale. The content was both stylish and wearable, and that evening she received 12 orders. Regular customer Vivian ordered 3 pieces in one go.

events.name: Support Zhao Li in the evening while taking care of family matters
events.description: Even though she needed to organize orders, Song Yajing still kept her appointment at the flower arrangement studio. She got home at 10 p.m.; her husband had already put their daughter to sleep and left some hot soup for her. After a quick shower, she replied to a few customers' late-night inquiries on her phone before going to bed.

start_state.mood: Stay focused and get ready to nail both the community and pre-order tasks in one go.

end_state.mood: Satisfied with the pre-order results, but feeling a bit tired

2025-08.daily_overview: On Thursday, Song Yajing and the shop assistant focused on packing the first batch of pre-order packages. The moist air of the rainy day actually made the busy work feel brisk. In the afternoon she systematically recorded the pre-order data in the ledger and contacted suppliers for replenishment accordingly. In the evening she went home early to take care of her daughter who had a low-grade fever, but, worried about her daughter, she still kept her rain-soaked appointment to support the flower studio, with mixed feelings.

events.name: Pack and ship pre-sale orders.
events.description: Early in the morning, Song Yajing tallied the orders and worked with Xiaomei to prepare, iron, and box the goods, handwriting thank-you cards to slip into regular customers' parcels. Because of the passing rain, she specially called a courier to pick up the packages.

events.name: Record business data.
events.description: Having free time in the afternoon, Song Yajing copied the pre-order data and customer feedback from the past few days into a dedicated notebook and marked the restocking needs. She decided to keep a systematic business log starting this month.

events.name: Analyzed pre-order data and adjusted the restocking plan
events.description: Based on the recorded data, Song Yajing found that autumn trench coats and knit sweaters were the most popular, so she immediately contacted supplier Susan via WeChat to request additional orders for restocking.

events.name: Daughter had a mild fever; hurried home to handle it.
events.description: In the evening, she got a call from her husband saying their daughter had a slight fever. Song Yajing closed the store early and hurried home. She measured her temperature at 38°C, gave her fever reducer and applied physical cooling. Looking at her daughter's flushed little face, her heart ached, but she still had to keep her appointment with Zhao Li. Only after her daughter fell asleep soundly did she brave the rain and head to the flower studio.

events.name: Rode a scooter in the rain to the appointment to offer support
events.description: In the evening, she rode her electric scooter while holding an umbrella to the floral studio. As the rain gradually let up, the air was especially fresh. She helped Zhao Li process several corporate group-buy orders, which eased Zhao Li's anxiety a little, though she still worried about her mother from time to time.

start_state.mood: A bit lazy because of the rainy day, but still as action-oriented as ever.

end_state.mood: Anxious about her daughter.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Friday morning, Song Yajing prepared the macaron ingredients and finalized the community lighting plan. In the afternoon, she closed the shop early to welcome her elder sister Song Yawen, who was returning to Xiamen from Shenzhen. The sisters had a deeply symbolic conversation and haircut — her sister remarked that her eyes held more softness, while she cut off her long hair, gently bidding farewell to her tense past. The sisters had dinner together until late at night, and the warmth of family love outweighed everything.

events.name: Purchase macaron-specific ingredients
events.description: For the weekend macaron challenge, Song Yajing went in the morning to a familiar baking ingredients store in Siming District, bought almond flour, powdered sugar, aged egg whites, and a silicone mat, ready to take on this French dessert challenge over the weekend.

events.name: The community lighting plan has been officially implemented.
events.description: The property management company reported in the owners' group that the survey had been completed and, after discussion with the owner representative Song Yajing, confirmed that four LED motion-sensor streetlights would be installed at the corner of Building 3, the corner of Building 5, and the children's play area, with construction starting next week. The neighbors all gave thumbs-ups, and Aunt Zhang even said she would make mung bean soup to reward her.

events.name: Closed the shop early to pick up her sister, and hugged when they met.
events.description: At 3 p.m., Song Yajing left the store in Xiaomei's care and drove to Xiamen North Station to pick up her older sister Song Yawen. When the sisters met, they hugged tightly. Yawen had become thinner, but her gaze was more determined.

events.name: Elder sister's heartfelt assessment and the sisters' haircut
events.description: On the way to the hair salon, her sister looked at her seriously and said that there wasn't as much fire in her eyes anymore, but more water, which was good. Song Yajing's eyes immediately grew warm and moist, and she felt deeply seen. At the salon, she decisively cut the long hair she had kept for years to shoulder length, laughing that it would save time blow-drying her hair. The neat look in the mirror made her feel as if she had shed a great deal of heaviness.

events.name: Deep talk over sisters' dinner; letting go and growing.
events.description: After getting haircuts, the two had dinner at a long-established seafood restaurant on Zhongshan Road, reminiscing about childhood and talking about the emotional journey of the past six months. Song Yajing described decisions such as refusing expansion and helping Zhao Li. Her sister approved, and Yajing also felt more clearly her inner growth. That night, her sister stayed at her house and played happily with her niece.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to my elder sister's arrival, slightly excited

end_state.location: At home (shared a bed with my sister for a long talk).
end_state.mood: The emotion of being seen, relief, and warm healing.

2025-08.daily_overview: Saturday was destined to be memorable: after seeing off her sister in the morning, Song Yajing took on the difficult challenge of making macarons at home. From the oven temperature deviation to successfully producing the signature feet, she reached a baking milestone of the year. In the afternoon, she rearranged the shop display, and in the evening she still went to support Zhao Li, bringing homemade sweets to comfort her.

events.name: Saw my older sister off on her return to Shenzhen.
events.description: Early in the morning, Song Yajing and her husband saw her older sister off at Xiamen Station to take the high-speed rail. Before parting, her sister slipped her a box of chocolates and said, "Remember to take better care of yourself."

events.name: First attempt at macarons ends in frustration
events.description: While her husband took their daughter out, Song Yajing made macarons using Master Chen's recipe. The first batch cracked on top and had no feet because her oven's actual temperature was higher than expected. Though frustrated, she calmly searched online for solutions and decided to lower the temperature and try again.

events.name: After adjustment, it was a perfect success and won great praise
events.description: After lowering the oven temperature by 10°C and placing a double-layer baking tray underneath, the second batch showed the signature delicate pink, evenly ruffled edges. Excited, she took photos and posted them to the baking group, and also privately messaged Master Chen and Mrs. Liu, earning praise for having "reached a professional level" and enthusiastic encouragement.

events.name: Sharing sweet results with family
events.description: In the afternoon, her husband and daughter came home. Chen Lexuan ate two in a row and cheered, "Mom is a superhero!" The family sat around and tasted them, as Song Yajing shared the twists and turns of making them, and the room filled with laughter.

events.name: Clean up, organize, and update the store display
events.description: In the afternoon, she cleaned the baking tools and tidied the kitchen, then rode her scooter to the shop. Together with Xiaomei, she changed the window mannequins and hung the new products that had received excellent pre-sale feedback in prominent positions, attracting many evening strollers.

events.name: Evening support and bringing homemade desserts
events.description: In the evening, went to the floral design studio; Song Yajing brought a box of homemade macarons for Zhao Li. After one bite, Zhao Li's eyes turned slightly red and she said it had been a long time since she'd tasted such sweetness. There were many orders that day, so Song Yajing helped pack goods until nearly 10 p.m.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the challenge yet slightly nervous

end_state.mood: Filled with the pride and satisfaction of overcoming a tough challenge.

state.daily_exercise: Electric scooter commute

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, 35℃

2025-08.daily_overview: On Sunday, Song Yajing took her daughter to Sunday Mass in the morning and received spiritual comfort from talking with Auntie Lin Xiuying. After a short rest in the afternoon, she went to help at a floral design studio in the evening. After finishing the chores, Zhao Li suddenly broke down and poured out her marital crisis. Song Yajing quietly listened and stayed with her until late at night, emptying herself until she, too, became a vessel. It was a heavy night, but one that truly forged a bond between lives.

events.name: Take daughter to Sunday Mass
events.description: In the early morning, Song Yajing dressed her daughter in a white dress, wore an elegant knee-length skirt herself, brought a Bible and her wallet, and drove to Siming Catholic Church. The two arrived early at their usual seats and participated fully in the Mass led by Father Wang Mingde. Her daughter followed quietly, and when receiving Communion, Song Yajing felt a deep inner peace.

events.name: Had a heart-to-heart talk with fellow church member Aunt Lin Xiuying in the courtyard
events.description: After Mass, she met Aunt Lin Xiuying, who was tidying up the flowers in the church courtyard, and the two sat on a stone bench and talked. Song Yajing confided her exhaustion and guilt from recently balancing the store, supporting Zhao Li, and family life. Aunt Lin kindly reassured her: This is practicing charity; the Lord will look after you. When you are tired, pray more and don't carry it alone. She felt comforted after hearing this.

events.name: In the evening, she stayed with Zhao Li until late, confronting the marital difficulties head-on.
events.description: At 7 p.m., she went to the flower studio again. After finishing the scattered orders, Zhao Li suddenly broke down in tears, saying she could barely hold on—her husband not only refused to help but also scolded her, and she wanted a divorce. Song Yajing sat beside her, handed her tissues, and listened for over two hours without judging. Only at the end did she gently share her own ways of coping with stress, and promised to always be there for her. Near midnight, she drove Zhao Li back to her place before returning home.

start_state.mood: Reverent and peaceful.

end_state.mood: Heavy, but she felt even more heartache for Zhao Li and a firm resolve to support her.

state.daily_exercise: None

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, 33°C

2025-08.daily_overview: On Monday, Song Yajing completed the annual physical examination that had been postponed for three years as scheduled. All indicators were normal, lifting a huge weight off her mind. She seized the moment to create a new exercise and diet plan, feeling she had regained the initiative over her health. During the evening support session, Zhao Li's mood clearly improved, and the two began talking about the future.

events.name: Went to the community health center on an empty stomach for a physical exam.
events.description: In the morning, on an empty stomach and carrying her ID, Song Yajing rode an electric scooter and arrived early at the Huli District Community Health Service Center to complete registration.

events.name: Completed various checkups including blood draw and ultrasound
events.description: Guided by the nurse, she completed a complete blood count, urinalysis, electrocardiogram, and abdominal ultrasound, and also had her blood pressure and blood sugar measured. During the waiting breaks, she handled a few store matters on her phone.

events.name: Heard the report: everything is normal
events.description: After reviewing the report, Dr. Wang Mingyuan told her that all indicators were normal and there was no anemia. He only noted that sitting for long periods might affect the lumbar spine and recommended regular walking and stretching. Song Yajing felt relieved.

events.name: Go home, record it, and make a light exercise plan.
events.description: After getting home, she wrote in her new planner: physical exam OK, weight 48.3, plan to walk 30 minutes daily, do yoga stretching 3 times a week, continue light meals. Her sense of control over life returned.

events.name: Evening support, Zhao Li's performance picking up
events.description: In the evening, she went to the floral design studio. Zhao Li told her that her mother had been moved to a regular ward and could eat. Some of her smile returned. The two trimmed the newly arrived roses while talking about the studio's recovery plan after her mother's discharge.

start_state.mood: A little nervous before the check-up

end_state.mood: Relieved and motivated to plan proactively

state.daily_exercise: Electric scooter commute + 20-minute evening walk

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, light rain at night, 32°C

2025-08.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Song Yajing took time out of her regular business operations to order a smart doorbell for a family safety upgrade. She regards the steady support as part of life, and in the evening she tried to let Xiaomei become more involved in community operations, building backup strength for the shop.

events.name: Manage store inventory and spring clothing promotion
events.description: In the morning, she restocked with Xiaomei, counted the inventory after preorders, and set up a discount section for a few slow-moving spring clothes.

events.name: Buying a smart doorbell online
events.description: During the lunch break, recalling the community lighting incident, she decided to upgrade the security at her own doorstep as well. After comparing options on e-commerce platforms, she ordered a video doorbell, chose next-day delivery, and told her husband.

events.name: Husband is on a business trip; she is alone taking care of her daughter.
events.description: The husband was away on a sudden one-night business trip. After work, Song Yajing picked up her daughter and went home, cooked a simple dinner, played with building blocks, and then put her to bed. Since she was caring for the child alone, evening support was postponed until after her daughter fell asleep.

events.name: Evening support and mentoring of Xiaomei.
events.description: After settling her daughter in, she rode her scooter to the floral studio. Zhao Li's mother's condition continued to improve, and the two chatted about parenting anecdotes while wrapping flowers. Before leaving, she encouraged Xiaomei to interact more proactively with customers in the community and practice sales skills.

start_state.mood: Steady and orderly

end_state.mood: She felt a little tired from the temporary challenge of taking care of her child alone, but was comforted by her daughter's maturity.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Xiaomei took half a day off, and Song Yajing, alone in the shop, took the opportunity to get closer to customers. The smart video doorbell had arrived but was not yet unpacked; she planned to wait until her husband was free to install it together. During the evening support session, she came up with a Teacher's Day activity idea for Zhao Li's flower shop, applying her business insights across industries.

events.name: Watching the store alone while also managing online operations.
events.description: Xiaomei took leave to handle her rental contract renewal, so Song Yajing received customers alone. She took advantage of the lull to post a few new try-on photos of herself in the clothes on Moments, and the response was good.

events.name: Smart doorbell arrived.
events.description: In the afternoon, the courier delivered the doorbell to the home. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang received it on her behalf and took a photo to let her know. They agreed to study the installation together in the evening.

events.name: Felt slightly dizzy in the afternoon, so closed the store early and rested.
events.description: Possibly due to days of fatigue and low atmospheric pressure, Song Yajing felt dizzy in the afternoon. She held on until Xiaomei came back, then went home early and lay down for half an hour. She felt better after eating some nuts and drinking water.

events.name: Evening support and planning for Teacher's Day bouquets.
events.description: At the flower studio, Zhao Li mentioned that her mother might be discharged from the hospital next week, and they needed to consider reactivating the studio. Song Yajing, drawing on her own shop experience, helped her plan a pre-sale scheme for small bouquets for Teacher's Day. Zhao Li's eyes lit up.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and composed

end_state.mood: Joyful because I can help across fields, but my body reminds me to pay attention.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Thursday evening, Song Yajing and her husband worked together to install a smart doorbell, successfully sharing the surveillance feed with her parents in Quanzhou, creating a cross-regional home safety net. During the day, Zhao Li's mother had improved further, and she felt increasingly relieved.

events.name: Husband and wife installed a smart doorbell together
events.description: After dinner, the couple opened the package. Chen Zhiqiang handled drilling the holes, fixing the doorbell, and connecting it to WiFi, while Song Yajing handed him tools and downloaded the corresponding app. The doorbell came online smoothly, and the image at the entrance was displayed clearly.

events.name: Share the access permission with parents.
events.description: After debugging, Chen Zhiqiang shared the remote viewing access with Song Minghui and Lin Xiuying via a QR code. Song Yajing then video-called her mother, who was amazed at the real-time footage and joked that she was helping keep watch over the house too.

events.name: Learned during the day that Zhao Li's mother had improved.
events.description: In the morning at the store, she received a WeChat message from Zhao Li saying that her mother could now sit up with support and was trying to get out of bed, and would be discharged soon. The heavy weight in her heart was lifted, and she was even humming while shipping orders in the afternoon.

events.name: Took a short nap in the shop in the afternoon to restore her energy.
events.description: After seeing off a wave of customers, Song Yajing felt drowsy and took a 20-minute nap on the couch in the store. When she woke up, she was noticeably refreshed.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and pleasant

end_state.mood: Reassured by the substantial improvement in the family's sense of security.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Friday, Song Yajing started buying stationery and a schoolbag for her daughter's elementary school enrollment. In the evening, taking the opportunity as the support assignment was wrapping up, she made the first handover with Zhao Li. Seeing that Zhao Li's mother had been discharged from the hospital and that her support assignment was also nearing its end, she felt a complex blend of relief and reluctance.

events.name: Buy school supplies and a schoolbag for her daughter
events.description: In the afternoon, taking advantage of the quiet shop, Song Yajing went to a stationery store near her home and, following the teacher's list, bought pencils, erasers, watercolor pens, and a drawing pad. She also specially picked out a pink two-layer pencil case.

events.name: Preliminarily setting up the daughter's study corner.
events.description: After returning home in the evening, she cleaned the small table in a corner of the living room, laid a new cartoon table mat, and placed the new stationery on it, planning to do a deeper tidy-up on the weekend. Her daughter clapped her hands excitedly when she saw it.

events.name: Brief evening support and a warm handover
events.description: In the evening she went to the flower studio and packed the last batch of pre-wrapped bouquets with Zhao Li. Zhao Li's mother had been discharged from the hospital and was recuperating at home, and Zhao Li would move in with her to care for her; the studio's business would gradually resume. The two agreed to talk on the phone again on Sunday, their words full of reluctance and gratitude.

events.name: Weight loss draws concern; add an evening snack
events.description: Before bed, she weighed herself and found it had dropped to 48.1 kg. Worried about lacking energy, she warmed a glass of milk with whole-wheat bread and reminded herself to strengthen her nutrition in the coming days.

start_state.mood: A slightly busy anticipation for back-to-school preparations

end_state.mood: With the relief of wrapping up a major matter and a faint reluctance to say goodbye.

state.daily_exercise: Shopping walk.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, light breeze, 33°C.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Saturday, Song Yajing devoted all her time to recharging and saying goodbye: in the morning, the whole family went to Bailuzhou Park for a picnic and to practice driving, laughter spilling across the grass; in the evening, she completed her final support for Zhao Li's floral design studio, and the two witnessed their friendship elevated into a life connection in an embrace.

events.name: Preparing picnic food and cycling gear
events.description: Early in the morning, Song Yajing and her husband made a fruit salad and ham sandwiches together in the kitchen, and packed drinks and a picnic mat. Her husband checked the training wheels and helmet on their daughter's bicycle. At 9 o'clock, the whole family set off.

events.name: Teaching daughter to ride a bike at Bailuzhou Park
events.description: On the park path, Chen Zhiqiang patiently supported his 5-year-old daughter as she practiced pedaling, while Song Yajing filmed beside them. When the girl wobbled along independently for a short stretch, the couple clapped and cheered, their pride written all over their faces.

events.name: Picnic on the lawn and warm conversation
events.description: At noon, they spread a mat under the shade of a tree for a picnic. The daughter got salad all over her mouth and ran off to chase butterflies. Song Yajing sat side by side with her husband, talking about the upcoming elementary school life and their feelings about this journey of helping Zhao Li. Her husband expressed full support.

events.name: Ran into neighbor Aunt Zhang and was given mung bean soup
events.description: During the picnic, they happened to meet their neighbor Aunt Zhang Xiuying. Aunt Zhang had heard about how she helped Zhao Li, so she specially brought a thermos of mung bean soup and praised her warm-heartedness. Song Yajing thanked her repeatedly and drank the sweet mung bean soup, thinking that after days of rushing to help others she had grown thinner and really needed to build herself up.

events.name: Packing up and returning home in the afternoon.
events.description: As the afternoon sun grew stronger, the family took away the trash, folded the picnic mat, loaded the bicycles into the car, and drove home for a rest.

events.name: In the evening, provided final support to Zhao Li, completing the life connection.
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing rode her scooter to the floristry studio for her last day of support. The two finished the final orders and cleaned up. Zhao Li suddenly hugged her tightly and said in a choked voice that she really couldn't have held on without her. Song Yajing lightly patted her back and said they were sisters. Zhao Li gave her a potted peace lily, symbolizing smooth sailing. Both knew that the days they had spent together had carved each other into their lives.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to a special family day.

end_state.mood: Surrounded by the twofold happiness of family warmth and a deepened friendship.

state.daily_exercise: Walking in the park and playing with her daughter.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, 32°C

2025-08.daily_overview: On the last day of August, Song Yajing took her daughter to Sunday Mass in the morning to pray for the upcoming primary school life. In the afternoon, she efficiently prepared her daughter's school bag and reviewed the store's sales. In the evening, she had a long phone chat with Zhao Li, catching up on the past two weeks. Finally, at the family meeting, she officially switched the family routine back to school mode.

events.name: Attended Sunday Mass and prayed for her daughter's school enrollment.
events.description: Early in the morning, Song Yajing tied her daughter's hair, took her Bible, and took a ride to Siming Catholic Church. During Mass, she prayed especially for her daughter's upcoming elementary school life and for Zhao Li's family to recover smoothly.

events.name: Prepare the complete set of back-to-school items for her daughter
events.description: In the afternoon, she took out the small pencil case sewn by her mother Lin Xiuying, put the new stationery into the new schoolbag one by one, washed the new school uniform and indoor shoes, and used a label maker to print name tags and stick them on one by one. When her daughter tried on the backpack, she smiled with her eyes curved. Song Yajing looked at her slightly thinner face in the mirror and decided to add a bowl of chicken soup tonight to restore her energy. Her daughter kept saying she wanted to show Grandma.

events.name: Organize autumn new product sales data
events.description: While her daughter napped, Song Yajing compiled sales data since the pre-sale on the 20th on her computer, analyzed bestsellers and customer preferences, and planned the September marketing rhythm. She was pleased to find that online pre-sales contributed 30% of the month's revenue.

events.name: Call Zhao Li to take the friendship further
events.description: In the evening, she called Zhao Li and learned that her mother was already able to get out of bed and move around. The two of them looked back on the little moments over the past two weeks. Zhao Li called her a family member beyond blood ties, and they agreed to meet at least once a month from now on. After hanging up, Song Yajing was moved by how this trial had made their friendship shine even brighter.

events.name: Family meeting establishes the back-to-school routine
events.description: In the evening, the family of three held a short family meeting and finalized a new schedule to start from September 1: their daughter goes to bed at 8:30 p.m. and wakes up at 7:00 a.m., Song Yajing is responsible for the morning drop-off, and her husband is responsible for the afternoon pickup. She also added daily checks of the smart doorbell to the family security checklist. Finally, she sent her parents a photo of their daughter carrying a schoolbag and shared the school preparation over video; laughter came from the Quanzhou end.

events.name: Evening stretching and meditation before bed.
events.description: Before bed, Song Yajing did 15 minutes of stretching in the bedroom, focusing on relaxing her calves, neck, and shoulders. She also meditated and reviewed the past month, feeling grateful for helping others while reminding herself to restore her energy. She resolved to pick up morning brisk walking again in September.

start_state.mood: Solemn and full of hope

end_state.mood: Satisfied, calm, with a clear and steady plan for the future, and she promised herself to reclaim control over her body in the midst of her busy life.

state.daily_exercise: Walk to church

2025-03.daily_overview: On the first day of the floral collaboration event, she and florist Zhao Li redesigned the shop window together, launching a 'Spring Flower Language' themed display and a buy-clothes-get-coffee promotion. However, because of insufficient promotion, the coffee corner was almost completely ignored. In the morning, she nearly arrived late because her alarm clock malfunctioned and she had to rush out. In the evening, she scheduled her annual physical exam. At night, she went home and continued organizing her daughter's school enrollment materials, feeling weighed down by the twin anxieties of business pressure and her daughter's enrollment.

events.name: Rushing out the door in the morning
events.description: The night before, she forgot to charge her phone, so the alarm didn't go off. Song Yajing got up 20 minutes later than usual. After a hurried wash-up, she drank only half a glass of milk and rushed out the door. When she arrived at the store, she realized she had forgotten the store keys, so she had to go back to get them, which delayed opening by fifteen minutes.

events.name: Completed the spring floral window display with Zhao Li.
events.description: After opening up in the morning, partner Zhao Li arrived at the store with dried flower materials. The two of them cleared out the originally heavy winter window display and replaced it with dried lavender, eucalyptus leaves, and light pink bouquets, creating a layered spring flower language theme. Song Yajing steam-ironed the newly arrived spring clothes, while Zhao Li set up an exquisite gift flower display stand in the corner and put out a handwritten blackboard event poster. As they chatted while working, Zhao Li mentioned trying an online floral community collaboration, laying the groundwork for future cooperation.

events.name: Coffee corner trial run met with a cold response, and the first attempt at online promotion.
events.description: After opening the shop in the afternoon, Song Yajing quietly set up a coffee machine next to the fitting room in the corner and launched a promotion offering a free Americano with every clothing purchase. But because the location was out of the way and she didn't actively mention it to customers, by evening she had given out only seven cups of coffee, and the response was lukewarm. During a quiet moment, she took a photo of the coffee corner and a bouquet and posted it on WeChat Moments with the caption, “The first free coffee of spring, come and try it,” but she only got a few likes, and the customer group chat was silent. For the first time, she realized that even good wine can be hidden by a deep alley—relying purely on offline foot traffic was far from enough.

events.name: Schedule the annual full-body health check-up.
events.description: Before closing the store, Song Yajing remembered that she had not had a physical examination last spring because she had been busy, so she called the Huli District Community Health Service Center while organizing the accounts. After a short wait, she was connected to an agent. She gave her ID number and booked the annual full-body checkup package for the morning of March 5. The customer service representative reminded her to fast and drink no water after 10 p.m. the night before. After hanging up, she recorded the appointment time in her mobile phone memo and set a reminder one day in advance.

start_state.location: Bedroom in the home on Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Slightly tired but full of determination, preoccupied with the month-end working capital gap.

end_state.location: Bedroom in the home on Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: Feeling slightly disappointed; the coffee event drew no interest, which was frustrating, but looking at the storefront photos brought a hint of comfort.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Sunday morning, she first went to Siming Catholic Church to attend Mass. After Mass, she helped an elderly grandmother carry heavy items home and felt a simple kind of joy. In the afternoon, she returned to the store and tried to move the flower arrangement co-branding event online. She gathered her courage and did her first livestream on WeChat Channels, but had to end the stream awkwardly because of background music copyright issues and interruptions from customer calls, leaving her quite discouraged. In the evening, after clerk Xiao Mei got off work, she reviewed the situation alone, listed an improvement plan, and decided to start by learning the platform rules.

events.name: Sunday Mass and a small episode of helping others.
events.description: At nine in the morning, Song Yajing put on a clean linen shirt and walked to Xiamen Siming Catholic Church. During Mass, Father Wang Mingde shared a scripture reading about forgiveness and perseverance, which made her think of yesterday's failed coffee promotion and brought her some comfort. After Mass, she saw an elderly woman struggling with two bags of fruit at the church entrance, so she took the initiative to help her carry them to the nearby bus stop. The old woman thanked her repeatedly, and Song Yajing felt a warmth in her heart.

events.name: Online dual-track co-branded promotion
events.description: After lunch, she returned to the store. Song Yajing used the high-definition floral photos provided by Zhao Li, paired them with spring outfits, and posted carefully written copy to Moments and two regular customer groups, tagging @Zhao Li to interact. Zhao Li reposted it in her floral community at the same time, and the two drove traffic to each other. Song Yajing also taught herself to make a promotional poster with the store's QR code using a collage app. Although it was a little rough, she felt a sense of novelty the moment it was done.

events.name: First WeChat Channels livestream ended awkwardly.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Song Yajing set up her phone stand next to the fitting room, chose an upbeat pop song as background music, opened WeChat Channels, and started livestreaming. She was a bit nervous and only briefly introduced the shop's spring clothing and bouquets, but soon a background-music copyright infringement warning popped up on the screen. Flustered, she was about to switch to a royalty-free track when a regular customer called to ask about returns and exchanges. She had no choice but to answer the phone and temporarily step away from the camera. When she hung up and returned, she found only two people still watching in the livestream room, and the warning had still not disappeared. Awkwardly forcing a smile at the camera, she said she would stop here for today and quickly ended the stream. The whole thing lasted only about 15 minutes.

events.name: Reviewing the livestream and formulating an improvement plan.
events.description: After closing the store, Song Yajing gathered the courage to check the live stream replay data and found that apart from a like from her mother Lin Xiuying and her mother-in-law, there were no new followers or interactions. She sat in silence at the cashier counter for a few minutes, then took out her notebook and wrote: 1. Learn the platform's copyright rules and the live stream pitfall-avoidance guide; 2. Prepare scripts and interaction segments in advance next time; 3. Combine online and offline traffic - cannot rely on the live stream room alone for traffic. She closed the notebook, took a deep breath, and temporarily sealed away this frustration.

start_state.location: At home on Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Calm and hopeful, wanting to seek peace at church and also make up for the regret of yesterday's lukewarm event.

end_state.location: Home study on Hubin South Road.
end_state.mood: Frustrated but not hopeless; the rational side tells her this is an inevitable path, just that she doesn't know how long it will take.
