2025-03.daily_overview: On Monday, a business day, the floral co-branded event proceeded normally. Although there was no obvious surge in customers, regular customers came one after another specifically to pick up bouquets. As she attended to them, Song Yajing silently observed customers' reactions to the coffee corner and began posting outfit photos in the WeChat group in a more natural way. In the afternoon, a difficult customer asked for a refund; after much back-and-forth, it was peacefully resolved. After returning home in the evening, she confessed to her husband Chen Zhiqiang about the weekend livestream mishap. From a technical perspective, he gave her practical advice on copyright avoidance and livestream settings, allowing her to sleep soundly.

events.name: Daily operations and execution of floral activities
events.description: After opening at ten in the morning, three middle-aged customers who had seen the event on Moments came in one after another to try on clothes. After making purchases, they happily chose small flower bouquets. Song Yajing took the opportunity to ask their opinions about the coffee corner. One woman said, "If you hadn't mentioned it, I wouldn't have noticed." She gave a bitter smile. In the afternoon, foot traffic increased. She had her sales assistant Xiaomei handle the cashier, while she stood at the shop entrance and proactively invited women passing by to come in and look at the flowers and clothes. The results were fairly good.

events.name: Online community interaction and content optimization.
events.description: Taking advantage of the free time, Song Yajing posted to the customer group a photo of a spring trench coat that a regular customer had agreed to share, with the caption: Today's outfit: light camel trench coat + floral dress, last 3 spots get a bouquet. On Zhao Li's suggestion, she also added emojis, making it look much more lively. Several new customers in the group finally replied that it looked nice and they would go take a look tomorrow. She found that real try-on photos were more likely to generate interaction than floral-art posters.

events.name: Handle difficult returns and exchanges.
events.description: At three in the afternoon, a customer who had bought a dress the previous week stormed into the shop, claiming that the dress had shrunk after washing and demanding a full refund. Song Yajing examined it carefully and found that the washing method had been improper. She explained patiently and offered to shorten it for free. The customer finally left satisfied. Although it delayed her for nearly half an hour, she felt that resolving the conflict with service was more valuable than arguing.

events.name: Pouring out work frustrations to her husband
events.description: After returning home in the evening, her daughter Xuanxuan was already asleep. On the living room sofa, Song Yajing told her husband Chen Zhiqiang about the embarrassing live-streaming situation from yesterday, unconsciously repeating how embarrassing it was. Chen Zhiqiang did not offer much comfort but patiently explained how music copyright works on Channels, and suggested she first use the phone's built-in recording feature to record background audio, then turn off the live room's original sound. He also taught her how to set Do Not Disturb mode to avoid phone calls interrupting. Song Yajing suddenly felt enlightened, gratitude toward her husband welled up in her, and she slept very soundly that night.

start_state.location: At home on Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Anxious, but determined to be more proactive in attracting customers.

end_state.location: Bedroom in the home on Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: Her anxiety was partly relieved. With her husband's technical support, she gained the confidence to try again, and she fell asleep peacefully.

2025-03.daily_overview: Mid-term review day for the flower-arranging co-branding event. In the morning, I had a WeChat video call with Zhao Li to discuss inventory. In the afternoon, I adjusted the display layout: I moved the coffee corner from the corner to a spot within sight from outside the fitting room and added more prominent handwritten price tags. A sudden downpour hit in the afternoon, leaving the store unusually quiet. Song Yajing and Xiaomei took the opportunity to sort through inventory and found some forgotten out-of-season styles. In the evening at home, she attempted a simple French lemon tart as a warm-up for the weekend advanced class, but it was a small failure; still, the process calmed her down considerably.

events.name: Mid-event data inventory and flower material replenishment.
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing analyzed the sales receipts from the previous three days and found that although the flower giveaway with a minimum purchase had not significantly increased the average transaction value, the cross-selling rate had risen. She photographed the remaining flower materials and sent the photos to Zhao Li. After a video discussion, they decided to buy two more bundles of dried sunflowers and baby's breath. Zhao Li also sent a few tutorial photos showing how to make mini bouquets from leftover materials, and they joked that this was a zero-cost sequel.

events.name: Adjustments to in-store displays and promotional copy.
events.description: In the afternoon, taking advantage of a break in the rain, Song Yajing and Xiaomei moved the coffee machine onto the low cabinet outside the fitting room, drew the words Free Coffee in large letters in chalk on the blackboard, and hung a string of dried flowers as decoration. She took a few new photos of the area and wrote in the customer group: The coffee corner has moved—it's right next to the fitting room. Grab a cup after trying on clothes~ The new location made it visible to customers the moment they walked in.

events.name: Inventory sorting brought on by heavy rain
events.description: At 3 p.m., a sudden downpour hit and there were few people on the streets. Song Yajing and Xiaomei carried a few unopened cartons out of the storeroom, checked the tags one by one, and rehung them by color. To their surprise, they found several knit cardigans from last autumn and two pairs of retro bell-bottom pants. She joked that this pile of long-forgotten clothes could make a seasonal clearance sale, and Xiaomei immediately agreed. As they worked, they chatted about funny stories from their school days, so they didn't feel tired.

events.name: Evening baking practice failed.
events.description: After closing the shop and returning home, her daughter was playing with building blocks in the living room. Song Yajing opened the fridge, took out butter and lemons, and wanted to follow a tutorial to try making a French lemon tart. But because the egg yolk batter was overmixed, it collapsed after being poured into the mold, and after baking it came out too hard. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang tasted a piece and said it tasted like lemon-flavored cookies, which made her laugh. Although it failed, the feel of the dough in her hands temporarily made her forget her daytime anxiety over inventory and accounts, and she decided to ask Master Chen for advice at the weekend class.

start_state.location: At home on Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Rational and pragmatic, planning to use data analysis to guide subsequent activities.

end_state.location: Living room at home on Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: Slightly regretful about the baking failure, yet fulfilled inside; the stress was released through her hands.

2025-03.daily_overview: A busy and heavy day. Early in the morning on an empty stomach, she went to the community center for the annual physical, which found signs of neck and shoulder strain, and she received a doctor's warning about stress management. While waiting in line for the ultrasound, she ran into her neighbor Aunt Zhang Xiuying and felt a bit embarrassed. In the morning she returned to the shop to urgently organize loan materials. In the afternoon, she walked into the bank full of hope but was rejected because her self-employed income flow was insufficient. The loan officer hinted that she needed her husband to guarantee or provide collateral, which dealt a blow to her self-esteem. In the evening she was home alone; her husband was still at work overtime. She digested the double setback by herself, decided not to mention the loan failure for now, and to first cut costs on her own to keep going. She stayed awake until midnight.

events.name: Annual full-body checkup and health wake-up call.
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, Song Yajing, fasting, took the bus to the Huli District Community Health Service Center. Under the nurse's guidance, she completed blood routine, biochemistry, electrocardiogram, and gynecological examinations in turn. The ultrasound room required waiting, so she sat on a bench in the corridor looking at the morning light outside the window. A credit card repayment reminder popped up on her phone, and her heart tightened. While waiting, Aunt Zhang Xiuying, a neighbor, also came for a routine checkup. The two chatted briefly about everyday matters, and Song Yajing felt a bit awkward, not wanting an acquaintance to know about her health concerns. At ten o'clock, all the items were finished. Dr. Wang Mingyuan held the preliminary report and told her that all indicators were basically normal, but long-term standing and looking down at her phone had caused obvious strain in her neck and shoulder muscles, and her blood pressure was slightly high. He reminded her to be sure to manage stress and arrange at least two exercise sessions per week. Song Yajing nodded seriously and wrote the doctor's advice in her phone's memo.

events.name: Organizing business loan application materials
events.description: After the physical examination, Song Yajing had a late breakfast at a rice noodle roll shop near the community entrance, then went straight back to the shop. She opened the safe, took out the handwritten sales ledgers, bank receipts, and purchase lists from the past three months, repeatedly checked the total turnover with a calculator, and sorted them into categories using old file folders. She also specially printed out photos of the few clothing items that had sold well during last year's store anniversary, intending to use them as evidence of her business capability. Before leaving, she touched up her makeup and took a deep breath in front of the small mirror.

events.name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China loan application rejected
events.description: At 3 p.m., she arrived at the ICBC Siming Sub-branch. The account manager Lin Xiaofeng, whom she had booked in advance, was already waiting in the wealth management room. Lin Xiaofeng was polite but rigorous. After flipping through the documents, he frowned slightly and said bluntly that the sole proprietorship's monthly turnover was only about 40,000 yuan and the tax payment records were intermittent, so the risk assessment could not pass unless a co-borrower was added (suggesting her husband) or a second mortgage on the property was provided. Song Yajing's face flushed instantly. She barely managed a smile and said she would go home and think it over. As she walked out of the bank, the early spring wind seemed bitingly cold. She felt she had been labeled an unreliable sole proprietor.

events.name: At night, digesting the frustration alone.
events.description: When she got home, her daughter had already been picked up by her mother-in-law, and her husband Chen Zhiqiang sent a WeChat message saying the company had called an impromptu overtime shift that night. Song Yajing took off her jacket, didn't turn on the living room overhead light, leaned into the sofa and slid through the photos of the bank entrance on her phone again and again, feeling a suffocating tightness, as if she wanted to cry but couldn't. Opening her memo app, she typed a line: I won't tell him for now; I'll rely on myself first. Cut next month's purchasing volume by 30%, clear out old-season styles at 40% off, and be sure to get the cash flowing again. Then she took the leftover scraps of yesterday's failed lemon tart out of the fridge and slowly ate them, suddenly feeling that this bit of sourness was no big deal. She tossed and turned and did not fall asleep until after midnight.

start_state.mood: Feigning calm, pinning all hopes on the bank application after the medical examination.

end_state.location: Living room sofa at home on Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: Doubly frustrated, feeling unprecedented loneliness and a collapse of self-esteem, but the stubborn side was stirred.

2025-03.daily_overview: On the second day of the countdown to the floral co-branded event, the store was filled with a faint floral fragrance and the urgency of the last wave of gifts. Song Yajing was enthusiastically telling customers that the event was about to end while using her notebook behind the cash register to make a plan to tighten operations next month and cut some minor expenses. In the evening, her daughter Xuanxuan was fussy about going to sleep, and she patiently coaxed her for a long time. Afterwards, she called her sister Song Yawen in Shenzhen, who provided her with several channels for Taobao surplus fabric, giving her a glimmer of hope.

events.name: Facilitate the conclusion of the flower arrangement activity and prepare for wrap-up.
events.description: After opening, Song Yajing wrote in bold on the small blackboard at the store entrance that the spring bouquet giveaway had only two days left. She also tied the remaining flower materials into small corsages and took the initiative to give them to customers who tried on clothes. She also @'d everyone in the customer group, posted photos of the remaining bouquets, and used 'while supplies last' wording to create a sense of scarcity. By the afternoon, even the last batch of dried baby's breath had been given away.

events.name: Formulate next month's operation tightening and promotion plan.
events.description: Taking advantage of the quiet afternoon with few customers, Song Yajing leaned over the cash register, opened her binder, and wrote down the specific adjustment plan based on last night's ideas: First, notify suppliers to reduce next month's spring clothing order quantity by 20%; second, select slow-moving items and out-of-season coats in the store and set up a spring renewal area with 5 items at 40% off; third, stop purchasing new shopping bags and the background music platform membership, expecting to save about 800 yuan per month. She crossed out a line and added another; her handwriting was a bit messy, but the direction was becoming clearer.

events.name: Daughter was fussy before bedtime.
events.description: At a little past eight in the evening, Xuanxuan was too excited to lie down before bed because she had played so wildly at kindergarten during the day. Song Yajing had no choice but to hold her and pace back and forth in the living room, humming more than a dozen nursery rhymes before slowly calming her down. By the time her daughter finally fell into a deep sleep, her arms were sore from exhaustion, but looking at the child's sweet sleeping face, her heart softened into a puddle.

events.name: Had a long-distance call with her older sister Song Yawen to seek advice
events.description: After putting her daughter to sleep, Song Yajing took the initiative to video-call her sister Song Yawen in Shenzhen. Song Yawen had just gotten off work and, while removing her makeup, listened to her story about the rejected loan. She immediately analyzed calmly: Banks look at stable cash flow. Rather than going to a bank, you should optimize your cost of goods. I know a few fabric suppliers selling export overstock and independent designer studios—unique styles and small-batch orders available. I'll send you their contact info another day. Song Yajing silently noted this, feeling her sister's voice was like a shot of tranquilizer.

start_state.mood: Still heavy, but the emotion has been transformed into the motivation to take action and solve problems

end_state.location: Home study on Hubin South Road.
end_state.mood: With her sister's remote support, she rekindled a glimmer of hope, while feeling slightly excited about finding a new direction for sourcing goods.

2025-03.daily_overview: This was the official wrap-up day for the floral co-branding event. In the morning, she called the doctor to get the official physical examination report, confirming that everything was normal, and together with Zhao Li she removed the window decorations and compiled the final data. In the afternoon, she unexpectedly received a handwritten thank-you card from an old customer praising her styling taste, which made her feel that all the hard work was worthwhile. In the evening, the two had a brief and candid review at a small café near Zhongshan Road. Although sales did not meet expectations, the feasibility of cross-industry traffic generation had been preliminarily verified, and they agreed to try deeper community collaboration in the future.

events.name: Obtain physical examination report to confirm health status
events.description: At ten in the morning, Song Yajing called Dr. Wang Mingyuan. Dr. Wang pulled up the electronic report online and explained it item by item: the complete blood count was normal, the ECG showed no abnormalities, and the gynecological exam was fine as well. The main problem was still neck and shoulder myofascial strain, and he suggested she do neck and shoulder stretches once a week. Song Yajing breathed a sigh of relief, but felt a little guilty when she remembered she still hadn't carried out her exercise plan. After thanking the doctor, she forwarded the electronic copy of the report to her own email for backup.

events.name: Removal of event materials and data statistics
events.description: After the last wave of customers left in the afternoon, Song Yajing and Zhao Li worked together to carefully take down the dried-flower decorations from the window display. The reusable parts were packed into a cardboard box and left for Zhao Li to reuse in her next event. Song Yajing went through the sales records and calculated a seven-day total revenue of about 8,700 yuan, with 32 bouquets given away, and about 20 cups of coffee served along with them, plus 11 new WeChat friends added. Although it fell far short of her initial expectations, compared with the same week last year, foot traffic still improved slightly.

events.name: Unexpected thank-you card from a customer
events.description: While cleaning the cashier counter, Xiaomei discovered a handwritten card tucked into the ledger. It had been left by regular customer Vivian. The card read: Sister Yajing, every time I come to your shop I find just the right outfit. When I'm stressed, wearing new clothes makes me feel better. Thank you! Song Yajing read it twice, her eyes slightly reddening, and carefully placed the card into her journal.

events.name: Debrief with Zhao Li and plan future collaboration
events.description: After closing the shop in the evening, the two walked to a small café on the corner of the block and each ordered a hot latte. Zhao Li frankly said that the traffic generated from the floral course had been limited, but the visual content combining clothing and florals had indeed attracted a wave of attention on WeChat Moments. Song Yajing then mentioned that she wanted to build a formal customer community, and Zhao Li immediately said she could help her pull a few targeted followers who were also interested in styling from the floral class group. This review gave both of them a clearer direction for deeper work. When they shook hands and said goodbye, Song Yajing felt that this partner was more and more like a younger sister she spent every day with.

start_state.location: At home on Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Grounded and organized, trying to close the chapter on this week’s experiences.

end_state.location: Bedroom in the home on Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: She felt relieved. Although the results were unremarkable, she gained a reliable comrade-in-arms and had vague expectations for the direction of the community.

2025-03.daily_overview: A dramatic turning-point day. In the morning, she unexpectedly received a small bunch of carnations from her husband as a Women's Day gift. After settling the joint profit share with Zhao Li, the family of three walked to visit the assigned primary school, but their spirits were dampened by the high number of registrations and the risk of reassignment. The figure of the private school's huge tuition weighed on her chest. On the way home, the couple remained silent. Only after dinner did Chen Zhiqiang proactively suggest that he could take on side jobs to increase their income, and Song Yajing finally admitted that her loan had been rejected. Amid their anxiety, they reached an unprecedented agreement to share finances, and the warmth in their marriage rose again under pressure.

events.name: A small surprise for Women's Day
events.description: Waking up in the morning, Song Yajing found a small bouquet of pink carnations and a card on the bedside. On it was her husband Chen Zhiqiang's somewhat messy handwriting: 'Wife, you've worked hard. Happy holiday.' Her daughter Xuanxuan also pounced over and said in a sweet baby voice, 'Happy holiday, Mom.' She smiled and put the flowers into the glass bottle, feeling warm in her heart all day.

events.name: Floral co-branding profit settlement and friendly feedback
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing invited Zhao Li to the store and transferred the calculated commission in full via WeChat. Zhao Li declined several times before accepting, and agreed to leave the remaining floral materials for her as future shooting props. Song Yajing specially gave her a newly arrived silk scarf as thanks. Zhao Li said she would like to bring some students from her flower arrangement class to the store to try on clothes next time, and the two smiled at each other.

events.name: A family of three visits their designated primary school and runs into a placement adjustment crisis
events.description: At 2 p.m., Song Yajing, her husband Chen Zhiqiang, and their daughter Xuanxuan walked hand in hand to the designated public primary school in Siming District for the school open day. Unexpectedly, the admissions teacher told them that this year's intake for local district students was full, and children whose household registration time was later than 2018 would very likely be reassigned to another primary school 3 kilometers away. Song Yajing immediately crouched down and hugged her daughter, while Chen Zhiqiang silently calculated the 80,000-yuan annual tuition at a private primary school, his face heavy. The family of three lingered by the slide on the playground; Xuanxuan innocently swung on the swing, but the two adults' hearts felt as if stones were pressing down on them.

events.name: In-depth communication between the couple and building financial defenses.
events.description: Back home, the air hung heavy for a moment. Chen Zhiqiang sat on the sofa and spoke first: I can take on some freelance website maintenance work with colleagues from the company, earning an extra three to five thousand yuan a month, and at the very least it can help cover tuition. Song Yajing's nose stung with emotion, and she finally poured out the experience of having her loan rejected that had been weighing on her for days, her voice choking a little. Chen Zhiqiang did not blame her; instead he held her hand firmly and said: We're in the same boat now. This family isn't your battlefield alone. That night, the two spread out the family's master ledger in the study and decided to set aside 2000 yuan from her husband's salary each month as a dedicated education reserve, temporarily freeze non-essential store advances, and require both of them to discuss any expense over 500 yuan. A formal family emergency and education plan was born through tears.

start_state.mood: A touch of ceremonial feeling on Women's Day prompted by merchants' promotions, but overall calm

end_state.location: Home study on Hubin South Road.
end_state.mood: The anxiety did not disappear, but wrapped in trust and empathy, she gained a steady feeling of facing the battle side by side.

2025-03.daily_overview: After Sunday Mass, she enjoyed a long-missed period of focused time. Song Yajing brought her pre-organized baking notes and drove to Master Chen's baking workshop in Huli District to attend the long-awaited advanced French pastry class. She spent the whole afternoon immersed in chocolate tempering and cream puff piping, and her anxiety was dissolved by precise gram measurements. In class, she also met Fang Yi, a young mother who shared the same love of baking, and the two hit it off immediately. In the evening, she brought her creations back to the store and shared them with the community, unexpectedly receiving many compliments and pre-order inquiries from customers, which opened up new ideas for the store's future added value.

events.name: Peace before Sunday Mass and the baking class.
events.description: At nine in the morning, Song Yajing quietly completed Mass at Siming Catholic Church. In his sermon, Father Wang spoke of how every hardship has its meaning, reminding her of her husband's firm promise the night before, and a warmth surged through her heart. After Mass, she rarely lingered, briefly greeted Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow parishioner, and returned home to check her apron, notes, and insulated bag.

events.name: Advanced French Pastry Workshop
events.description: At one in the afternoon, she drove to Master Chen's Baking Workshop on Xinglong Road in Huli District. The studio was filled with the sweet aroma of butter. Under Teacher Chen's one-on-one guidance, Song Yajing folded imported cultured butter by hand for the first time to make puff pastry, and used a chocolate spray gun to coat mousse balls with a velvet-like matte shell. The hardest part was piping the éclair shapes; she was so nervous her hands were shaking. Teacher Chen gently held her hand and said, 'Yajing, relax your wrist, like using a calligraphy brush.' In the end, the baked éclairs were all plump and even. She also asked the teacher about why her lemon tarts had collapsed, and after the expert's guidance, she suddenly understood.

events.name: Met a new friend, Fang Yi
events.description: During the break, the young woman Fang Yi at the next workstation was frustrated by a failed meringue. Song Yajing proactively handed her some lemon juice and shared her own failure experiences. The two chatted about the details of running a store and raising children, discovered they were both mothers balancing career and family, and immediately exchanged WeChat contacts, agreeing to practice and share tips online in the future.

events.name: Sharing dessert creations and building the store’s reputation.
events.description: After returning to the shop in the evening, Xiao Mei gasped in admiration when she saw the chocolate mousse in the takeout box. Song Yajing cut the dessert into small portions and offered them to several regular customers who came into the shop, and posted an artfully arranged photo in the customer group with the caption: Today's fresh output from the baking class; maybe our shop will have a dessert corner in the future. Unexpectedly, within half an hour, seven or eight customers asked whether they could place custom orders. Although she couldn't mass-produce for now, these warm responses greatly eased the business pressure she had been feeling over the past few days.

start_state.location: At home on Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: After Mass she felt calm inside, was full of anticipation for the baking class, and temporarily stepped away from the financial numbers.

end_state.location: Bedroom in the home on Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: A long-lost sense of accomplishment and the joy of being recognized; body and mind were nourished, and she fell asleep early.

At noon, while at the bank to print out her transaction history, she ran into former colleague Sun Li, who was back in Xiamen to visit family, and the two chatted briefly. In the evening, she had a brief video chat with her best friend Li Meiling; they each vented about the chaos of parenting and work, which made her feel she was not alone.

events.name: Contacted suppliers to reduce orders
events.description: In the morning, following her plan, Song Yajing called her two main suppliers, Susan and another Hangzhou leftover-order studio, to reduce the originally planned purchase volume for next month's new styles by 25%. Susan was somewhat surprised on the phone and pressed to ask whether sales had run into trouble. Song Yajing casually said she was testing a new product selection direction, but she felt a little upset inside.

events.name: Start organizing customer information.

She planned to formally launch a closed Yajing Select Styling Group after Zhao Li helped with new customer acquisition.

events.name: Ran into former colleague Sun Li at the bank
events.description: At noon, taking advantage of a lull at the store, she went to ICBC to print her bank statements for the past three months to keep on file. While taking a number and waiting in line, she unexpectedly ran into her former colleague Sun Li. Sun Li now lives in Shenzhen and had returned to Xiamen to visit family and take care of some business. The two chatted happily for more than ten minutes. Sun Li praised her courage in starting a business and shared some operational tips from popular internet-famous shops in Shenzhen, which inspired Song Yajing greatly.

events.name: Had a video chat with her best friend Li Meiling to de-stress.
events.description: At nine in the evening, Song Yajing video-called her best friend Li Meiling, who teaches in Xiamen. They chatted from the kids' homework to their husbands' simple, honest antics. Li Meiling listened to her vent while grading homework, occasionally throwing in a funny classroom story. When they hung up, Li Meiling said, “Remember in junior high when we kept messing up our handwritten newspapers, and later they became the model examples? You’ll be fine.” Song Yajing smiled and rubbed her eyes.

end_state.location: Living room at home on Hubin South Road

Although she still stammered a bit, it was much more fluent than last time, and she unexpectedly received a few likes. In the evening, she got encouragement from Aunt Lin Xiuying through the church Bible reading group sharing. Later, her husband brought home oolong tea, and the two of them took a rare short walk in the rain, chatting about small matters concerning their daughter's future. The atmosphere was warm.

events.name: First attempt at filming a short outfit video to test the waters
events.description: While watching the shop in the morning, Song Yajing referred to a fashion blogger on Xiaohongshu and used her phone's built-in camera, set up by the window, to try to shoot a 15-second video showcasing a spring knit top paired with a tulle skirt. She smiled stiffly at the camera, retook the video seven or eight times before she was satisfied, and in the end still did not post it—she just saved it to drafts and planned to publish it later once she was more familiar.

events.name: Second livestream attempt: slight progress

Song Yajing turned off the background music, used the recorded audio her husband had taught her as the base track, and started another livestream on WeChat Channels. This time she prepared several interactive questions in advance. Although the number of online viewers stayed in single digits throughout, one viewer commented that the host's smile was very sincere, which boosted her confidence, and she kept streaming for 25 minutes before going offline.

events.name: Evening church Bible reading group online sharing
events.description: At eight in the evening, at the invitation of the fellowship group leader, Song Yajing read a passage from Proverbs in the church's Bible reading group WeChat chat and briefly shared her reflections on being in business difficulties. Aunt Lin Xiuying then left a voice message: “Yajing, we've all seen your persistence. The Lord will open a way for the diligent.” Other church members also sent blessing stickers, and she felt a jolt as if struck by an electric current.

events.name: A brief walk for the couple on a rainy night
events.description: When her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work, he brought back a pack of oolong tea from a time-honored brand. While their daughter was asleep, the two of them shared an umbrella and walked down along Hubin South Road. Rain soaked the bottoms of their trousers, but they didn't talk about finances or education; they only talked about which coffee shop had changed its sign and when they might go see a movie together again. This kind of near-luxurious ordinariness made Song Yajing remember the night.

2025-03.daily_overview: The tense mood was briefly relieved by the midday massage. Song Yajing gathered her courage and walked into the massage parlor for a 60-minute shoulder and neck treatment. After the therapist's stern warning, she immediately added monthly therapy to her fixed plan. Even better news came in the evening — her husband Chen Zhiqiang was promoted through his technical grade rating, with an 8% monthly salary increase, and he voluntarily put the raise into the family joint account. The whole family went out for barbecue to celebrate. Song Yajing rarely indulged herself and ate a bit too much. This positive cycle of earning and spending slightly loosened the nerves that had been tense for so long.

events.name: First systematic shoulder and neck massage.
events.description: During her midday shift break, Song Yajing walked into the Jianmin Tuina Clinic near her home as promised. The moment the therapist pressed both hands on her Fengchi acupoints and trapezius muscles, she winced and inhaled sharply. The therapist bluntly said her neck and shoulders were as stiff as an office worker who sits at a desk all day, and advised her to come at least once a week. After 60 minutes of hot compresses and meridian therapy, her muscles were sore but she felt much more relaxed mentally. At checkout, she decisively set a monthly reminder for physiotherapy on the 12th in her phone memo and added the expense to her fixed expenditures.

events.name: Husband's monthly salary increase came as unexpected good news.
events.description: At seven in the evening, Chen Zhiqiang rarely arrived home earlier than usual. As soon as he entered, he loosened his tie and said excitedly: 'Yajing, our company's annual technical rating results are out. I've been promoted one level, and starting this month my monthly salary is raised by 8%. I've already applied to transfer all the extra money into the family joint account.' Song Yajing's eyes widened, and she immediately rushed over and hugged him tightly. All her calculations about loans and tuition found a subtle anchor at that moment. Their daughter also ran over and climbed up her father's leg, filling the small living room with long-missed laughter.

events.name: A little indulgence for the celebration dinner
events.description: To celebrate a salary raise, the family of three went to a newly opened Korean BBQ restaurant nearby. Song Yajing ordered pork belly, grilled beef tongue, and cheese corn, and even made an exception to drink a small glass of plum wine. Xuanxuan wrapped meat in lettuce leaves clumsily, making the two of them laugh. The meal lasted nearly two hours; Song Yajing felt a bit stuffed, but her heart felt the lightest it had all month.

start_state.location: At home on Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Feeling physically exhausted and mildly anxious, planning to force myself to stop by getting a massage

end_state.location: Bedroom in the home on Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: Relaxed muscles and a glimmer of economic hope brought an unprecedented feeling of double relief.

2025-03.daily_overview: Family health planning day. In the morning, Song Yajing went alone to the dental hospital for her annual teeth cleaning. A slight wear was found on an old filling. She noted the doctor's advice and also booked summer dental check-ups for the whole family. In the afternoon, she had a video discussion with her elder sister Song Yawen about choosing a birthday gift for their mother, and settled on a massager. In the evening, she bought family tickets for the next day's science and technology museum online and watched popular science videos with her daughter to build anticipation. By the end of the day, several health-related to-dos had been added to the family medicine kit and memo.

events.name: Annual dental cleaning and family health planning
events.description: At ten in the morning, after having her teeth cleaned at the Municipal Stomatological Hospital, the doctor used a probe to gently trace the edge of the old filling on her lower left sixth molar and reminded her that the resin showed mild wear. Although it didn't need refilling yet, he suggested a follow-up in six months. She readily asked the nurse to make appointments for her husband and daughter during the summer vacation, and forwarded both the doctor's instructions and the appointment confirmation text to Chen Zhiqiang. As she walked out of the hospital, the sunlight was just right, and she suddenly felt that actively managing the whole family's health was also a fulfilling thing.

events.name: Discuss their mother's birthday gift with her older sister
events.description: In the afternoon at the shop, Song Yajing had a video call with her elder sister, Song Yawen, to discuss how to celebrate their mother's birthday next month. Song Yawen suggested that they pool their money to buy a high-end neck and shoulder massager, which would be perfect for relieving their mother's years of back and shoulder soreness. Song Yajing thought the idea was both practical and heartwarming, and immediately transferred her share.

events.name: Buy tickets for the science and technology museum and prepare for the weekend trip.
events.description: Before closing the shop in the evening, she followed the Xiamen Science and Technology Museum's official account on her phone and bought early-bird tickets for tomorrow's session for two adults and one child. After getting home, she held her daughter and watched a popular-science video about a dinosaur skeleton and a mirror maze. Xuanxuan was so excited that she squirmed around, pointed at the screen, and shouted that Dad had to go too; Chen Zhiqiang agreed with a helpless but doting look. Song Yajing also made a point of checking the camera battery, ready to take more family photos tomorrow.

start_state.location: At home on Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Objective and calm, she regarded the dental appointment as routine, with no unnecessary associations.

end_state.location: Bedroom in the home on Hubin South Road

2025-03.daily_overview: A bittersweet day. In the morning, the family enjoyed happy parent-child time at the Xiamen Science and Technology Museum. Seeing her daughter's delighted laughter in the mirror maze, Song Yajing relaxed in a way she hadn't for a long time. In the afternoon, they stopped by Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street on the way to look for accessories for the store. Unexpectedly, her phone was stolen in the dense crowd, and she broke down on the spot. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang rushed over quickly, calmly handled reporting the loss, calling the police, replacing the SIM card, and buying a new phone, and that evening, with his technical skills, recovered most of the cloud data. The accident nearly shattered her sense of security, but it also made her deeply experience her husband's unreserved sense of responsibility; their bond as a couple was tempered by the crisis.

events.name: Parent-child exploration time at the science and technology museum.
events.description: At ten in the morning, the family of three entered the Xiamen Science and Technology Museum using their reservation code. In the Children's Science Park, Xuanxuan broke free from her mother's hand and ran toward the mirror maze, while Song Yajing chased after her, out of breath but laughing. In front of the virtual water flow wall, her daughter used her little palm to change the direction of the sluice gate, and Chen Zhiqiang crouched beside her explaining the logic behind the water level changes. When experiencing the simulated earthquake platform, Xuanxuan was scared at first; Song Yajing held her tightly and explained that it was the earth's waltz. The family ordered kids' meals at the museum's themed restaurant, and while gnawing on chicken wings, Xuanxuan recounted the morning's adventures with a full mouth. Song Yajing took many photos with her husband's phone, thinking that she would post them on Moments when her new phone arrived.

events.name: Sudden crisis: phone stolen on Zhongshan Road.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Song Yajing was alone in the wholesale accessories area of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. As she squatted down to pick out a silk scarf clasp, the phone in the side pocket of her handbag was stolen. When she stood up and reached for her phone to pay, the moment she touched the empty pocket, her blood seemed to freeze. She rushed to a nearby shop for help and called Chen Zhiqiang from a public phone. The instant she heard her husband's voice, all her composure collapsed, and she sobbed so hard she could barely speak.

events.name: Husband's composed handling and data recovery.
events.description: Chen Zhiqiang arrived within twenty minutes. He first called the bank customer service to freeze the debit card and credit card linked to her phone, then accompanied her to Zhongshan Road Police Station to make a statement and get a receipt. Afterward, the two hurried to a China Mobile branch to get a replacement SIM card and bought a new domestically made phone. It was already evening when they got home. Chen Zhiqiang asked Song Yajing to accompany their daughter while he stayed up alone in the study, and using technical methods he successfully recovered most of the customer numbers, chat records, and purchase vouchers from the family iCloud backup and a memory image of the old phone. At 11:30 p.m., he walked out of the study holding a glass of warm milk. Song Yajing looked at the dark circles under her husband's eyes, and tears welled up in her eyes. They hugged in silence, but the warmth of overcoming the difficulty together outweighed a thousand words. Finally, they lay down just before midnight.

start_state.location: At home on Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Excited and looking forward to it. She deliberately chose a thin knit sweater in the same color scheme as her daughter's, wanting to take a family photo at the science and technology museum.

end_state.location: Bedroom in the home on Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: The exhaustion after the scare was intertwined with deep emotion, giving her an almost dependent, comrade-in-arms-like trust in her husband.

state.daily_exercise: Lots of walking inside the Science and Technology Museum and along Zhongshan Road, with about 12,000 steps counted

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, 21°C - 27°C, slightly warm in the afternoon.

2025-03.daily_overview: A Sunday of recovery and regrouping. In the morning, she went to Siming Catholic Church to attend Mass, and shared the experience of her stolen phone with fellow parishioner Aunt Lin Xiuying and Father Wang, receiving warm comfort and blessings. In the afternoon, she went to a phone store to apply a screen protector and buy a case, and on the way picked out two picture books for her daughter to make up for yesterday's scare. In the evening, the family watched an animated movie at home, and Song Yajing made a simple tomato and egg noodle soup. Ordinary happiness felt especially precious after the ordeal. She felt her physical fatigue gradually fade, and her fighting spirit for the new week rekindled. Her weight stabilized at 51.2 kg after several days of fluctuation.

events.name: Sunday Mass and comfort from fellow church members.
events.description: At nine in the morning, Song Yajing entered Siming Catholic Church. After Mass, Father Wang Mingde came up to her and asked how she had been. Song Yajing briefly mentioned that her phone had been stolen. Father Wang patted her on the shoulder and said, 'Lost belongings can be regained; the safety of your family is the greatest blessing.' Aunt Lin Xiuying from the scripture reading group also took her hand, prayed for her, and shared a story about how, after her wallet was stolen when she was young, she became more vigilant. Song Yajing felt surrounded by the love of the community.

events.name: Buying accessories for the new phone and browsing in a bookstore
events.description: In the afternoon, she went to the electronics market alone and bought a shockproof case and tempered glass screen protector for her new phone. Then, passing by Wai Tu Book City, she remembered that her daughter had kept talking about the mirror maze last night, so she went in and picked out two popular science picture books about light and shadow, intending to surprise Xuanxuan when she got home. While flipping through the books, she herself was drawn into the colorful illustrations, briefly forgetting her worries.

events.name: Family movie night and a simple dinner.
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing cooked a simple dinner of tomato and egg noodles and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang finished setting up the projector, and the family of three curled up on the sofa to watch Zootopia. Xuanxuan imitated Judy the rabbit's voice, making both of them double over with laughter. Before bed, Song Yajing stepped on the scale, looked at the number 51.2, and silently noted: starting tomorrow, she would cut back on sweets, but tonight, she just wanted to enjoy the peace of the moment. She massaged her slightly sore shoulders and neck, and turned off the lights at 23:30 on time.

start_state.location: At home on Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Calmed from yesterday's panic, a little tired but grateful.

end_state.location: Bedroom in the home on Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: Calm and determined, all the ups and downs have come to an end, ready to embrace the challenges of the new week.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Sunday, she found spiritual comfort at church. After returning home, she and her husband worked together to complete a cloud backup of customer data, and the panic of losing her phone was finally replaced by a sense of order. In the evening, she made cookies with her daughter and did a serious stretching routine before bed.

events.name: Attend Sunday Mass and talk with fellow parishioners
events.description: Early in the morning, Song Yajing went alone to Siming Catholic Church for Sunday Mass. After Mass, she chatted with Aunt Lin Xiuying from the scripture reading group and other parishioners in the church courtyard for about ten minutes, sharing how her husband had helped her recover data after she lost her phone. Aunt Lin comforted her that fortune and misfortune depend on each other, and prayed for safety for her shop and family. Song Yajing felt much more at ease.

events.name: Husband and wife cooperated to complete cloud backup of customer data
events.description: After the morning Mass, they returned home, where Chen Zhiqiang was already ready in the study. He taught Song Yajing how to upload customer contacts to the cloud using the address book backup feature of WeChat Work. Song Yajing sat beside him and operated carefully while Chen Zhiqiang explained patiently. When they came across accidentally deleted numbers, the two recalled and verified them together. This was the first time the couple had calmly divided and cooperated on handling business data in the study; the atmosphere was focused and harmonious. In less than an hour, all the important customer information was backed up, and Song Yajing finally breathed a sigh of relief.

events.name: Family lunch and an afternoon park walk
events.description: At noon, Song Yajing cooked a simple seafood noodle dish, and the family of three sat together to eat. After the meal, the sun was just right. She and her husband took their daughter Chen Lexuan to Bailuzhou Park near the residential community for a walk. The daughter ran and jumped on the grass while the couple walked side by side, chatting about the next steps for the shop after the backup was completed. The short hour outdoors relieved much of the week's tension.

events.name: Evening parent-child baking and pre-sleep stretching.
events.description: Before putting her daughter to bed at night, Song Yajing and her daughter used cookie cutters to make butter cookies, and her daughter ended up with flour all over her hands. After tucking her daughter into bed, Song Yajing followed a mobile app for a 10-minute gentle neck and shoulder stretch in the bedroom and felt the muscles that had been tense for days loosen up a lot.

start_state.mood: Still uneasy from the shadow of losing her phone, but looking forward to the peace the church brings.

end_state.mood: Feeling reassured, grateful for her husband's reliability, and much more relaxed from the stretching.

2025-03.daily_overview: During the workday, she hurriedly reissued her SIM card and bank card, linked various payment tools, and got the store's business channels working again. Although physically tired, she gradually regained a sense of security. In the afternoon, her mother video-called to check on her, warming her heart.

events.name: Go to the carrier's business hall to get a replacement SIM card
events.description: At 9:30 in the morning, Song Yajing went to the China Mobile service hall on Hubin South Road, Siming District, and used her ID card to apply for a replacement SIM card. Since she had already reported the loss online the day before, the on-site process was quick, and she received the new SIM card in less than half an hour. She inserted it into her new phone immediately, received several missed-message notifications, and after confirming that her communication functions were restored, she immediately sent her husband a message saying 'Done'.

events.name: Go to the bank to report the loss and apply for a replacement card.
events.description: After getting the SIM card, Song Yajing walked to ICBC Siming Sub-branch with her ID card and the police report receipt. Guided by account manager Lin Xiaofeng, she filled out a loss-report and replacement application and also handled the replacement of her debit and credit cards. While waiting for the cards to be produced, Lin Xiaofeng politely asked how the shop was doing. Song Yajing simply replied, "Still adjusting," and did not bring up the rejected loan. About forty minutes later, the new cards were in hand.

events.name: Re-bound the payment account and collection QR code at the store.
events.description: In the afternoon, she returned to the shop. The clerk Xiaomei had just finished serving two customers. Song Yajing opened her phone and computer behind the counter, logged into WeChat Pay, Alipay, and the store's merchant payment code backend one by one, unbinding the old card and binding a new one, testing each small payment successfully. During this, she also reset the passwords of several procurement platforms that required SMS verification. After all was done, she let out a long sigh of relief and said to Xiaomei, 'Finally, we can accept payments again.'

events.name: In the evening, organize the new phone's contacts and important records
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Song Yajing sat on the living room sofa and manually supplemented the notes for several suppliers based on the cloud-restored backup, and pinned the family emergency contacts to the top. Chen Zhiqiang walked over, glanced at the phone, and reminded her to set a lock screen passcode and enable the Find My feature on her new phone. The two spent another ten minutes straightening out the security settings. Song Yajing felt that she had truly learned her lesson this time.

events.name: Mother's concerned video call.
events.description: While sorting out her phone, her mother Lin Xiuying called via video and asked about the SIM card replacement and the shop business. Song Yajing recounted the process of getting the replacement card. Her mother also reminded her to "eat well and sleep well, don't be too thrifty," and mentioned that she had knitted a sweater for her granddaughter over the weekend and had already sent it. The brief conversation gave Song Yajing an extra sense of reassurance amid her fatigue.

start_state.mood: The goal is clear, but worried the card replacement process will be cumbersome.

end_state.mood: Tired but grounded; after the payment function was restored, my sense of security clearly bounced back.

The store's appearance and community foundation were both refreshed that same day. In the afternoon, a regular customer brought a friend to show support, two sales were closed, and the group became active.

events.name: Zhao Li arrived at the store and completed the spring flower arrangement display.
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Zhao Li walked into the store carrying two large bouquets of fresh flowers and a few bags of dried flower materials. Following the plan agreed on earlier, she arranged a spring floral display featuring white violets and eucalyptus leaves by the window display and next to the fitting room, and also put a few daisies in the small vase at the cash register. Song Yajing helped hand things over from the side, and seeing the originally ordinary display area immediately become lively and eye-catching, she couldn't help taking photos and posting a Moments entry.

events.name: Zhao Li helped create the first official customer WeChat group.
events.description: After the flower arrangement was finished, Zhao Li offered to help Song Yajing move her regular customers into a proper WeChat group. Using Song Yajing's new phone, she walked her through setting the group announcement, group chat name, and welcome message, and helped invite familiar customers from her contacts into the group one by one. The first batch had about thirty members. Zhao Li also suggested that she could post outfit photos or small perks in the group later. The group was named Yajing Life Studio · Spring Styles.

events.name: Regular customer brings in a new customer and closes a deal
events.description: A little after 4 p.m., Vivian, a regular customer, came into the shop with a colleague. Attracted by the new flower arrangements, the two tried on several spring outfits and each bought two pieces. Song Yajing took the opportunity to ask them to scan the code to join the group. Vivian readily added her colleague to the group and sent a happy emoji in the group chat. This small early success gave Song Yajing confidence in recruiting new members to the group.

events.name: In the evening, post the first interactive content in the WeChat group
events.description: After closing the shop in the evening, Song Yajing sat on a chair inside the store and posted a photo of the daytime floral display in the newly created group, with the caption: "A floral magician came to the shop today. Does everyone think it looks good?" Soon several regular customers liked and replied. Seeing the group come alive, she felt much lighter.

start_state.mood: Slightly tired, still somewhat confused about online operations.

end_state.mood: A small joy: seeing the first step of the community take shape and bring in a sale.
