2025-03.daily_overview: During a break at work, she found an online course on community operations and discussed the study plan with her husband. As life was getting back on track, there was a little more sense of self-recharging. In the evening, her daughter suddenly developed a fever, disrupting the study rhythm.

events.name: Hold the second interaction in the WeChat group and collect feedback.
events.description: After opening the store in the morning, Song Yajing posted two photos of the new spring/summer dresses in the “Yajing Lifestyle Store” group chat, with the caption “Whoever wears these will look divine,” and tagged a few customers who usually like this style. Soon after, Vivian replied that she wanted to reserve one of them, and another customer suggested taking more try-on photos. Song Yajing immediately asked Xiaomei to try them on and take photos, then posted a few more. The engagement was even better than the first time.

events.name: Search for and sign up for an online community operations course.
events.description: In the afternoon, there were fewer customers. Song Yajing sat behind the cash register and browsed Tencent Classroom on her phone. After comparing several community marketing courses, she chose a well-reviewed series called 'Community Operations in Practice'. She checked the syllabus, which covered acquiring new customers, activating users, conversion, and other topics, felt it matched her current needs, and placed the order. She also jotted down in her notebook: 'Study one lesson every night and organize notes on weekends.'

events.name: In the evening, discussed study plans with her husband.
events.description: After dinner, Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang sat at the dining table and briefly discussed buying the course. Her husband expressed support. However, just as they were about to study, their daughter Chen Lexuan suddenly touched her forehead and said she felt unwell. When they took her temperature, it was 38.2°C. The two quickly gave her warm water and a fever patch, took turns caring for her, and the course had to be postponed.

events.name: Caring for daughter with a fever
events.description: All evening, Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang revolved around their daughter, taking her temperature every hour and wiping her body with warm water. The daughter cried several times in discomfort, and Song Yajing held her and paced gently around the living room to soothe her. Not until late at night, when her temperature dropped a little, did their daughter fall into a dazed sleep.

start_state.mood: Calm, facing the new day with a try-it-and-see attitude.

end_state.mood: Worried about her daughter's condition and feeling a bit tired.

state.daily_exercise: None; her energy went entirely to the shop and caring for her daughter throughout the day.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, with brief sunshine in the afternoon, 17-21°C.

2025-03.daily_overview: After her daughter's fever went down, she sent her back to kindergarten and returned to the shop to focus on studying. She found time during the day to finish the first lesson, and caught up on notes in the evening. Her thinking on community operations gradually became clearer.

events.name: Confirm the course schedule and prepare study supplies
events.description: Before arriving at the store that morning, Song Yajing first took her daughter, who was in good spirits again, to kindergarten. After arriving at the store, during a lull with no customers, she logged in to Tencent Classroom on the computer to confirm the course had been activated, and prepared her notebook, earphones, and so on. Xiaomei casually asked, “Yajing, you don't look well today.” She gave a wry smile and said she hadn't slept well last night.

events.name: Use spare moments during the day to study the first lesson
events.description: Because she had lost study time the previous night, Song Yajing used a few lulls in customer traffic during the morning and afternoon to watch the first lesson, 'Seven Strategies for Acquiring New Community Members', bit by bit on her phone. She jotted down the key points in her memo app and paused to take screenshots at key points. Although she was interrupted many times, she finally caught up with the schedule.

events.name: In the evening, caught up on study notes and shared them with my husband
events.description: In the evening after her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing, in the study, cross-referenced screenshots and video replays to carefully organize concepts such as "seed user screening" and "benefit hook design" into her notebook. Chen Zhiqiang brought her a glass of warm water and sat beside her, listening to her explain the key points of the course for more than ten minutes. The two then discussed which customer acquisition strategy would suit their own store.

start_state.mood: Feeling a little low, but determined to catch up on the study schedule.

end_state.mood: The satisfaction after mental exertion and the feeling of fulfillment from gaining new knowledge.

state.daily_exercise: No dedicated exercise; about 4,000 steps moving around the shop

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with occasional clouds, warm and comfortable, 18-24°C

2025-03.daily_overview: Friday had a bit more customer traffic, and I was busy all day, but I still finished the second customer-retention lesson in the store as planned. In the evening, I talked with my best friend Li Meiling on the phone, caught up on how we were doing, and encouraged each other.

events.name: In the morning, received several waves of customers and applied customer acquisition tactics.
events.description: On Friday morning, while helping a customer match outfits, Song Yajing tried using the 'benefit hook' she had learned the night before to get the customer to scan the code and join the group, saying, 'Joining the group gives you priority reservations for new styles next time.' Two young girls readily scanned the code and joined. Although it was only a small attempt, Song Yajing felt a strong sense of achievement from putting what she had just learned into practice.

events.name: Brief video call with her daughter at noon
events.description: While eating lunch in the small room behind the store, Song Yajing video-called her daughter at the kindergarten for a few minutes. Her daughter's fever had completely gone down, and she was doing crafts with the other children. After reminding the teacher to make sure she stayed warm during naptime, Song Yajing hung up.

events.name: Evening study, Lesson 2: Methods for community activation
events.description: After the store closed, Song Yajing stayed in the shop and opened the second lesson of "Five Engines for Community Activation." The lesson explained how to keep a group from turning into a dead group through daily topics, interactive benefits, check-in activities, and so on. She thought of her newly created group and felt she could start with a daily outfit topic. She jotted down concepts such as "recurring feature design" and "tiered user incentives."

events.name: Had a phone call with best friend Li Meiling
events.description: After returning home, Song Yajing tidied up while having a long phone call with Li Meiling. Li Meiling detected the exhaustion and excitement in her voice and said with a laugh, 'You've finally found the feeling of being a student again.' The two talked about their respective family pressures and shared stress-relief methods with each other. By the time they hung up, Song Yajing felt much lighter in her heart.

start_state.mood: Stable, ready to handle Friday's customer traffic.

end_state.mood: Learning was fulfilling, and a friend's listening helped release the pressure.

state.daily_exercise: Paced back and forth in the store to attend to customers, about 5,500 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, high pollen concentration, light breeze in the afternoon, temperature 19-25°C

2025-03.daily_overview: The sudden rhinitis attack caught me off guard, but I still went to see the eco-friendly fabric exhibition at Fashion Week as planned. The gain was far greater than the discomfort, and on the way back I talked about inspiration the whole way with Xiaomei and Susan. In the evening my rhinitis got worse, so I decided to see a doctor the next day.

events.name: Allergic rhinitis recurred in the early morning.
events.description: Early Saturday morning, just after getting up, Song Yajing sneezed five or six times in a row, and then her nose was completely blocked and her eyes became itchy. She immediately realized it was her spring allergic rhinitis, which had not flared up for years, coming back. When she looked in the mirror, the tip of her nose was already slightly red and her voice sounded muffled. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang helped her find the half box of loratadine left from last year. She hesitated for a moment before deciding to take one tablet.

events.name: Go to the pharmacy to buy anti-allergy medication.
events.description: After taking the medicine, her nasal congestion did not improve immediately, so before opening the shop in the morning, she walked to the pharmacy next to the residential area, described her symptoms to the pharmacist, and bought a box of loratadine and a bottle of saline nasal spray. The pharmacist suggested that if it didn’t improve within a day or two, she should see a doctor. Song Yajing nodded and put the medicine in her bag.

events.name: During a phone call, friend Zhao Li teased her and she decided to visit the fashion week.
events.description: After returning to the store, Song Yajing called Zhao Li with a slightly nasal voice, originally to confirm the flower materials for next week. As soon as Zhao Li heard her, she laughed and asked, "Yajing, why do you sound like you've just been crying?" Song Yajing, not knowing whether to laugh or cry, explained that it was pollen allergy. After the call, she opened WeChat and saw the static exhibition information for Xiamen International Fashion Week sent by supplier Susan, which highlighted emerging designers of eco-friendly fabrics. Although her nose was still uncomfortable, she felt it was a rare opportunity to broaden her horizons, so she decided to squeeze out half an afternoon to go.

events.name: Visited the up-and-coming designers' static exhibition at the convention center.
events.description: At one in the afternoon, Song Yajing left the store to Xiaomei and took a taxi to Xiamen International Conference and Exhibition Center. In the static exhibition area, she focused on the works of three independent designers who specialized in eco-friendly fabrics, including nylon regenerated from waste fishing nets and plant-dyed organic cotton collections. She took the initiative to chat with one young designer for more than ten minutes, learning about the fabric characteristics and supply chain. The designer also gave her a business card.

events.name: After the visit, returned to the store to record inspirations
events.description: At 3:30 p.m., back at the store, Song Yajing sat behind the counter, opened her notebook, jotted down the inspiration from the eco-friendly fabrics she had just seen, and drew a simple mind map, thinking about how to introduce one or two pieces made of eco-friendly materials in autumn. The more she thought about it, the more she felt this path was worth trying. In her diary she wrote, "Stay firmly on the niche quality route."

events.name: Shared visit insights with supplier Susan.
events.description: In the evening, while there were few customers in the shop, Song Yajing talked with Susan via WeChat voice for about ten minutes, going over her impressions of the exhibition and the possibility of cooperation. Susan also knew some agents for some of these fabrics and said she could help ask about the minimum order quantity and quotation. The two initially agreed to discuss details in early April.

events.name: Rhinitis worsened in the evening; decided to see a doctor tomorrow.
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Song Yajing's nasal congestion and sneezing got worse because she had been exposed to more pollen outside during the day, even affecting her sleep. Chen Zhiqiang urged her not to tough it out and to go to the community hospital or see a Chinese medicine practitioner tomorrow. Song Yajing leaned against the headboard and agreed gloomily, feeling a little regretful that she had not worn a mask during the day.

start_state.mood: Slightly irritated that allergy symptoms disrupted my plans.

end_state.mood: Physically unwell but mentally energized, with new confidence in the product selection direction.

state.daily_exercise: Walk to and from the pharmacy, and walk about 1 hour at the Convention and Exhibition Center.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning clear, 18–23°C, pollen concentration still high

2025-03.daily_overview: The morning Mass brought peace, and the first successful used-clothing exchange event in the afternoon truly enlivened the community. Zhao Li's floral decorations were the finishing touch. She was busy until evening but felt a deep sense of accomplishment. After the event, she made an exception and ate an extra piece of cake to celebrate.

events.name: Attend Sunday Mass and have a brief chat with Aunt Lin Xiuying.
events.description: At eight in the morning, Song Yajing went to Siming Catholic Church wearing a mask to attend Mass. She deliberately sat in the back row to avoid disturbing others with the sound of her blowing her nose. After Mass, Aunt Lin Xiuying saw that she was in decent spirits but had a heavy nasal voice, and kindly advised her to try steeping some magnolia buds in water. Song Yajing smiled and thanked her, and asked Aunt Lin to continue praying for today's store event.

events.name: Returned to the shop to prepare for the clothing swap event.
events.description: After Mass ended, at about 9:30, Song Yajing went straight to the store. Zhao Li was already waiting at the door, bringing leftover flowers from previous floral arrangements, along with a few rolls of ribbon and small brooches. Together they pushed the display rack in the center of the store against the wall, clearing an open space where they set up a long table as the exchange area, and sorted clothes into summer wear, spring wear, and accessories. Zhao Li used the remaining lisianthus and eucalyptus leaves to make a few small bouquets to decorate the table.

events.name: Send the official event notice in the community group
events.description: At 10 a.m., Song Yajing sent the official event notice in the "Yajing Life Studio" group, stating that it would start at 2 p.m., each person could bring no more than five pieces of clean old clothing, and could pick the same number of items on site to take home. She also specifically mentioned that "a floral artist will be on site for handmade embellishment." Shortly after the message was sent, more than a dozen mothers confirmed they would attend.

events.name: In the afternoon, host the participants and facilitate the used-clothing exchange.
events.description: At two in the afternoon, the moms from the community group arrived one after another. Song Yajing and Xiaomei greeted them with smiles at the door, guided them to place their clothes in the corresponding areas, and put a name sticker on each of them. The fitting mirror soon became lively. The moms helped one another with advice, and when they found clothes they liked, they stuck their own name labels on them. The whole process was even more orderly and cheerful than expected.

events.name: Zhao Li created flower arrangements on the spot to decorate the clothing
events.description: While everyone was picking out items, Zhao Li sat at a small table in the corner and used the remaining floral materials to sew silk flower brooches or decorative belt buckles onto a few plain-colored garments that were less likely to be chosen. A mother saw this and delightedly selected the reworked white shirt, saying, 'It looks as good as new.' Song Yajing watched from the side and genuinely admired Zhao Li's skillful hands.

events.name: After the event, clean up the venue and provide feedback to the community.
events.description: The event ended at 5 p.m. Song Yajing and Zhao Li packed up the remaining unclaimed clothes and prepared to donate them to the community used-clothing recycling bin. The floor was quickly cleaned up. Song Yajing posted a set of event photos in the group, thanked everyone for participating, and announced that a similar event would be held once a month from now on. The group immediately received many thanks and likes.

events.name: In the evening, she treated herself to a piece of tiramisu.
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Song Yajing felt so accomplished today. She took out the tiramisu she had made in advance over the weekend, cut a small piece, and ate it with fruit tea. Although she knew she was watching her weight, she decided to indulge occasionally. While washing up, she noticed that her nasal congestion seemed to have eased a little.

start_state.mood: The nasal congestion hasn't cleared, but she is both nervous and excited about today's activities.

end_state.mood: A strong sense of achievement; the success of the offline community event boosted my confidence

state.daily_exercise: Stood and walked continuously for about 5 hours during in-store setup and customer reception

date_attribute.weather: Overcast, with occasional light drizzle, 17-21°C

2025-03.daily_overview: Rhinitis still plagued her, but it didn't stop her from testing a small member-recruitment activity in the group chat using the method she learned last night; even though the results were limited, she figured out what needed improvement. The sweater her mother mailed arrived in the morning, and she showed it off in the group chat as well.

events.name: In the morning, research copywriting for the customer acquisition campaign.
events.description: In the morning, customer traffic was light. Song Yajing sat behind the cash register, opened the operations manual, referred to the "benefit hook" template from the class, and repeatedly revised the customer acquisition campaign copy in her phone's memo. She finally settled on: "Invite two close friends to join the group, and you will receive a 15-yuan no-minimum coupon after sending a screenshot." She sent it to Zhao Li for a quick look, and Zhao Li replied, "Pretty attractive, you can give it a try."

events.name: Received a hand-knitted sweater sent by my mother
events.description: In the morning, a courier delivered a package: a pink sweater knitted by her mother Lin Xiuying for her granddaughter, along with some Quanzhou specialties. Song Yajing opened it, took photos, and sent them to the family group. She also casually showed it in the customer group, saying "Mom-made warmth." Several moms in the group liked it, and the atmosphere was warm.

events.name: In the evening, posted a user recruitment activity in the WeChat group.
events.description: At eight in the evening, before putting her daughter to bed at home, Song Yajing officially posted the event information in the group chat, along with the heartwarming photos from yesterday's old-clothes swap event, writing: 'Good clothes should be shared with good sisters. Invite two close friends to join the group, screenshot it and send it to Xiaoya, and you will immediately get a 15 yuan coupon.' Within an hour of the message being sent, three regular customers responded and brought in six or seven new members. Although the number of new additions was not large, Song Yajing carefully recorded it and felt that the approach had worked.

events.name: Reflecting on the details of the activity before bed and planning improvements
events.description: Before going to bed, Song Yajing leaned against the headboard and wrote in her notebook reflections on today's activity: choosing Monday evening for the event may not have been ideal; on weekends people would be more available to share; the coupon amounts could be set as tiered rewards. She decided to adjust and try again next time.

start_state.mood: The nasal congestion hasn't cleared up, but her mood is fairly stable, and she is trying to put what she has learned into practice.

end_state.mood: A small gain; though the effect wasn't explosive, the path was validated.

state.daily_exercise: None; voluntarily reduced outdoor activities due to nasal congestion.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, 18-24°C, moderate humidity

2025-03.daily_overview: During the day she went over the accounts to get a clear picture of the family finances, and in the evening she and her husband formally worked out an education savings plan together for the first time. She also received a call for help from an old classmate who had lost their job. Her emotions were like a roller coaster, but the sense of alliance between the couple grew deeper. Late at night, she tried making a low-sugar muffin and failed.

events.name: In the afternoon, take inventory of the day's income and prepare financial materials.
events.description: After the afternoon customer flow gradually dwindled, Song Yajing printed the day's sales receipts from the cash register and took out the recent household ledger, last month's loan repayment records, and her daughter's kindergarten payment notice from the document folder. She arranged all the documents by date, double-checked the month's total income and expenses with a calculator, and already had a clear picture of the cash situation, waiting only to discuss it in detail with her husband in the evening.

events.name: Chen Zhiqiang prepares the payroll in the living room and thinks about education savings.
events.description: After dinner, Chen Zhiqiang took his just-issued payslip out of his briefcase. After his technical rating promotion, his monthly salary had risen by 8%, and his take-home pay was nearly 1,600 yuan more than before. Sitting on the living room sofa, he quietly calculated that if he set aside 2,000 yuan each month, plus extra income from private projects, he could save nearly 30,000 yuan a year for education funds. This gave him a sense of security.

events.name: The couple formally discussed and formulated an education savings plan
events.description: Around 9:30, after their daughter was sound asleep, Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang sat facing each other at the small desk in the study. She spread out the ledger and explained the family's tight cash flow, especially the increased working capital pressure after the shop loan hit a snag. Chen Zhiqiang then took out his pay slip and offered to deduct 2,000 yuan from his salary every month as their daughter's education fund, and suggested reducing takeout frequency and postponing non-urgent purchases. The two went down one by one the expenses that could be cut. It was the first time in their nearly ten years of marriage that they had formally planned finances side by side.

events.name: Song Yajing made a detailed record of the savings plan in her notes app.
events.description: As soon as the discussion ended, Song Yajing opened her phone memo and carefully wrote: “Transfer 2,000 yuan from Zhiqiang's salary card to the education savings account on the 10th of each month; check the family bills on the 1st of each month; cost cuts: reduce takeout from three times a week to once and pause personal clothing purchases. Pilot starting in April.” She copied it and sent it to her husband via WeChat.

events.name: Received a help request from old classmate Zhang Wei, who had lost his job, and tried to help
events.description: Just as she saved the memo, a message from Zhang Wei, her junior high school classmate, popped up on WeChat. Zhang Wei said he had been laid off in Shenzhen and asked whether there were any suitable jobs in Xiamen, his tone full of exhaustion. Song Yajing immediately searched her phone contacts and reached out to a few people who might have connections, but none could offer real help. In the end, she could only reply with a few hugging and encouraging emojis, and when she put down her phone, she felt a heavy lump in her chest.

events.name: Baked low-sugar muffins late at night but failed
events.description: To calm herself down, Song Yajing tried making a reduced-sugar banana muffin in the kitchen, but because there was less sugar, the cake body was too dry and tasted bad. She gave a wry smile, took a photo of the failed cake, and posted it in the baking group with a self-deprecating remark. Mrs. Liu replied, 'Reduced sugar is the easiest way to fail.' Even though it failed, the process of working with her hands relieved some of her stress.

start_state.mood: Financial pressure is on my mind; I plan to sort it out carefully.

end_state.mood: A complex mix: relief after joint planning, sadness over being powerless to help an old friend, and the small frustration of a baking failure

state.daily_exercise: No additional exercise; did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching before bed.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, warm sunshine, temperature 18-25°C

2025-03.daily_overview: Made up her mind to treat her rhinitis with traditional Chinese medicine. The shop was filled with the aroma of herbal medicine. Although it was a bit embarrassing, she finally had hope of getting better. In the afternoon, a vague response appeared in the classmates group to the message Zhang Wei had forwarded.

events.name: Carry out the spending cut action in the early morning
events.description: After getting up in the morning, Song Yajing remembered last night's agreement. The first thing she did was open her phone and cancel the monthly subscription for a video conferencing app she hadn't used in a long time. Then she made a simple bento for herself and Chen Zhiqiang each for lunch. Chen Zhiqiang saw this, smiled, and opened his game account to suspend this month's recharge plan.

events.name: Forwarded an internal referral inquiry for Zhang Wei in the junior high school class group
events.description: After arriving at the store in the morning, Song Yajing hesitantly posted a message in the junior high school classmates group: “Dear old classmates, Zhang Wei from our class was laid off in Shenzhen. Does anyone have a position in Xiamen to refer him for?” After the message was sent, the group was quiet for a long time, until an old classmate replied, “I’ll ask our company HR if there’s a suitable position.” Song Yajing immediately forwarded the message to Zhang Wei.

events.name: Took advantage of the free time in the morning to visit the veteran Chinese medicine doctor.
events.description: Around ten o'clock, Song Yajing saw that Xiaomei could handle things on her own, so she walked to an old Chinese medicine clinic not far from home. She described her symptoms of sneezing, nasal congestion, and itchy eyes over the past few days in detail. After taking her pulse and examining her tongue, the old Chinese medicine practitioner diagnosed her with “wind-heat attacking the lungs with sinus congestion” and prescribed a week of Chinese herbal medicine. The main ingredients included magnolia flower, cocklebur fruit, and others, and he advised her to avoid spicy food and keep warm.

events.name: Pick up the medicine, go home, and simmer the Chinese herbal medicine.
events.description: After picking up seven doses of Chinese herbal medicine at the clinic, Song Yajing went home first. She double-boiled one dose in a stewing cup for half an hour, and the kitchen filled with a faint herbal aroma. She poured the herbal liquid into a thermos to take to the shop for the afternoon.

events.name: Drank medicine in the shop and was teased by the staff.
events.description: Back at the store, when Song Yajing opened her thermos and took the first dose of Chinese medicine, the distinctive smell of the medicine immediately spread through the air. Xiaomei sniffed and laughed, 'Sister Yajing, our store has turned into a Chinese pharmacy!' A nearby customer also glanced over curiously. Song Yajing explained a little sheepishly that it was 'to regulate allergies,' but in her heart she hoped the medicine would really work.

start_state.mood: Determined to solve allergies with traditional Chinese medicine, and also felt encouraged by making the first move to cut expenses.

end_state.mood: With hope for the effects of the traditional Chinese medicine, my nose is still stuffy, but I feel more at peace.

state.daily_exercise: Walk to the clinic, about 1.5 kilometers round trip

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, with occasional sunshine, temperature 17-22°C.

2025-03.daily_overview: On the second day of taking the Chinese herbal medicine, my symptoms eased slightly. While buying groceries in the evening, I ran into Aunt Zhang, the neighbor, and her unexpected folk remedy and advice added a bit of community warmth to life. Before bed, I carefully recorded my reactions to the herbal medicine.

events.name: Take Chinese herbal medicine on time and record symptom changes.
events.description: After taking her daughter to school in the morning, Song Yajing heated up and drank the second dose of Chinese herbal medicine she had decocted the day before yesterday. She noted in her phone memo: "Day 2 of taking the herbal medicine: morning sneezes reduced from 6 in a row to 3, but the stuffy nose is still severe." She planned to keep recording for a few days to see the effect.

events.name: Went to the vegetable market in the evening and ran into Aunt Zhang
events.description: At five in the afternoon, Song Yajing closed the shop a bit early and went to the Hubin South Road vegetable market to buy some greens and eggs. While she was choosing, her neighbor Aunt Zhang tapped her on the shoulder from behind. Hearing her muffled, nasally voice, Aunt Zhang immediately guessed she had allergies and enthusiastically recommended the honeycomb extract she often drank, saying it was especially good for the nose and throat, and told her not to keep taking Western medicine. The two chatted as they walked, and Aunt Zhang also mentioned that she wanted to make some chive dumplings and bring them over to their family in a few days.

events.name: Returned home and took honeycomb essence to relieve nasal congestion
events.description: After returning home, Song Yajing took out the small jar of honeycomb extract that had been kept at home in the cupboard and, as Auntie Zhang had said, scooped a spoonful and dissolved it in warm water. After drinking it, she felt that her throat and nasal passages were indeed more moisturized, and the nasal quality in her voice seemed lighter. She decided to make honeycomb extract a regular staple this year.

events.name: Updated her health records before bed.
events.description: Just before bed, Song Yajing added a note in her phone memo: today her nasal congestion had eased by about 30-40%, and starting in the afternoon she could smell the flowers in the shop. She sent the old Chinese doctor a message with the update, and he replied, "Keep taking the medicine and mind your diet."

start_state.mood: Cold symptoms were a bit lighter, so she was in the mood to buy fresh ingredients.

end_state.mood: The warmth of neighbors and the small comfort of folk remedies also gave her confidence in traditional Chinese medicine

state.daily_exercise: Walking to the market and back is about 2 km

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, light breeze, temperature 18-24°C

2025-03.daily_overview: In the morning, her live stream unexpectedly gained popularity after she shared her minor allergy troubles, and the fans' warm recommendations made her feel for the first time the power of authentic sharing, so she took the opportunity to buy honeycomb extract. In the afternoon, a friend introduced by an old classmate called to ask about Zhang Wei's condition, which gave her a glimmer of hope.

events.name: Woke up early to prepare for today's morning livestream
events.description: After dropping her daughter off at school, Song Yajing deliberately set aside time to set up a livestream corner in the living room at home: she made a cup of hot coffee, fixed her phone on a stand, and poured the traditional Chinese medicine from her thermos into a beautiful ceramic cup. She planned not to talk about clothes today, but to casually chat about spring life.

events.name: Sharing her allergy experience during the livestream resonated with viewers.
events.description: At the start of the livestream, there were only a dozen or so people. Song Yajing chatted about recent life under the theme "coffee after dropping off the kids." Subconsciously rubbing her nose, she naturally ended up talking about her pollen allergy and taking traditional Chinese medicine, and held up a ceramic cup to show everyone the medicinal broth. Unexpectedly, the comment section immediately became lively. Many mothers said "Me too" and "My nose feels terrible in spring," and some shared their experience with honeycomb extract and nasal irrigators. The atmosphere was unexpectedly good.

events.name: After the livestream, contact the beekeeper to buy honeycomb essence
events.description: After the live stream ended, Song Yajing looked through the comments and private messages. A regular customer sent her the QR code of a local beekeeper in Xiamen. She immediately added him on WeChat, chatted a bit, and ordered a bottle of fresh honeycomb essence, agreeing to have it delivered by same-city express the next day. She felt that this kind of feedback from real sharing was more effective than any deliberate marketing.

events.name: Received and tried honeycomb essence, and decided to have it on hand in spring.
events.description: The package was delivered to the store that afternoon. Song Yajing opened it and immediately brewed a cup. It tasted cleaner and sweeter than the jar at home. After drinking it, she felt a lasting moist and soothing sensation in her nasal passages and throat. She happily wrote in her daily notes that hive essence should be listed as a spring staple, and sent a photo to Auntie Zhang to express her thanks.

events.name: Answer a phone call inquiring about Zhang Wei
events.description: In the evening, a call came from an unfamiliar number. The caller claimed to be an HR person at an IT company in Xiamen and, entrusted by Song Yajing's junior high school classmate, wanted to learn about Zhang Wei's technical background. Song Yajing quickly forwarded Zhang Wei's WeChat contact, feeling that her efforts had not been in vain.

start_state.mood: A bit nervous about preparing for the livestream, but also looking forward to a relaxed chat.

end_state.mood: Happy. I unexpectedly discovered that authentic sharing is the best way to interact, and the old classmate's matter has also taken a turn for the better.

state.daily_exercise: No additional exercise; stood for about 40 minutes during the livestream.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, temperature 19-25°C, with brief sunshine in the afternoon.

2025-03.daily_overview: The rhinitis has clearly improved, and my voice is much clearer. Sharing my experience with honeycomb extract in the group also brought me closer to customers. At noon, I had afternoon tea with Li Meiling. While shopping, she accidentally broke her phone screen, and I quickly solved the communication problem by using the shop's backup phone.

events.name: Third day of taking Chinese herbal medicine; allergy symptoms have improved significantly.
events.description: When she woke up in the morning, Song Yajing was pleasantly surprised to find she had only sneezed once and her nose was clear. She walked to the balcony and took a few deep breaths, confirming her sense of smell had returned to normal. She updated her memo: 'Day 3 of medication, symptoms greatly improved, nasal congestion gone, occasional sneezing.'

events.name: Proactively shared her experience trying the honeycomb extract in the customer WeChat group.
events.description: In the morning at the shop, Song Yajing wrote a heartfelt post in the "Yajing Life House" group, honestly sharing her experience of combining honeycomb extract and traditional Chinese medicine, and reminded everyone that severe allergies still require seeing a doctor. Several customers then shared their own allergy remedies, and interactions in the group were much livelier than usual.

events.name: Afternoon tea and shopping with best friend Li Meiling
events.description: At noon, Li Meiling met Song Yajing at a newly opened milk tea shop on Zhongshan Road. The two ordered low-sugar fruit tea and chatted for nearly two hours, covering everything from children's education to shop management. Afterwards, they strolled along the street and browsed a few accessory shops, and Song Yajing also bought a pair of hair clips for her daughter.

events.name: Li Meiling accidentally smashed her phone, and Song Yajing resourcefully lent her a spare phone.
events.description: While shopping, Li Meiling accidentally dropped her phone while answering a call, cracking a corner of the screen. She was so anxious that she stamped her feet. Song Yajing remembered that there was a spare phone that had just been taken out of service at the store, so she pulled her back to the shop, reset the phone, and lent it to Li Meiling for the time being, solving the pressing problem. Li Meiling thanked her repeatedly, and the two agreed that she would treat Song Yajing to dinner next week.

events.name: In the evening, neighbor Aunt Zhang brought over chive dumplings.
events.description: A little after five in the afternoon, Aunt Zhang knocked on Song Yajing's door with a box of steaming hot chive dumplings and a smile. She said she had made too many and thought that since Song Yajing's family had been busy recently, they could have them for dinner. Song Yajing gratefully took them and gave Aunt Zhang a bag of juicy peaches she had bought that morning. In the evening, the family of three ate Aunt Zhang's dumplings and found them especially delicious.

start_state.mood: The refreshing feeling that comes with getting better; the whole body feels light and nimble

end_state.mood: Satisfied — the double delight of health recovery and stronger community interaction, and a friend's little mishap was also smoothly resolved.

state.daily_exercise: Afternoon shopping walk of about 1.5 hours.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, with brief showers in the afternoon, temperature 18-23°C.

2025-03.daily_overview: After spending some quiet time at church on Sunday, she spent the afternoon baking with her daughter and going for a walk and chat with her husband after the rain. In an ordinary day, their mutual understanding was growing. In the evening, she tried making a weekly planning template for community operations.

events.name: Attended Sunday Mass and shared recovery updates with fellow parishioners.
events.description: At eight in the morning, Song Yajing appeared at the church in good spirits. Aunt Lin Xiuying, hearing her clear and bright voice, said happily, "Thank the Lord, the medicine is working." Song Yajing smiled and nodded, and after Mass she also thanked several church friends who had prayed for her. She deliberately stayed a little longer today and helped tidy the scripture bookshelf.

events.name: Make a simple cake at home with her daughter in the afternoon
events.description: After returning home at noon, her daughter insisted on eating the cake her mother made. Song Yajing took out her baking tools and made a simple honey chiffon cake with her daughter. When her daughter stirred the batter, she spilled some flour on the floor, and the mother and daughter laughed together. When the cake came out of the oven, the room was filled with a sweet aroma. As the family of three shared it, her daughter said proudly, 'I helped make it.'

events.name: After the rain, an evening walk with her husband to discuss the future
events.description: A heavy rain in the afternoon soon stopped, leaving the air fresh. After dinner, Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang took a walk along Hubin South Road. They talked about the ups and downs of the month. Song Yajing said that although the books didn't look good at the end of the month, the direction for the community and product selection was much clearer now. Chen Zhiqiang said he felt they were better able to handle things together than before. The two walked for more than half an hour under the streetlights.

events.name: In the evening, made a weekly plan template for community operations.
events.description: After walking home, Song Yajing used her computer in the study to create a simple Excel template for the weekly community operation plan, with columns for daily topics, interactive activities, and product recommendations. She planned to operate according to the template starting next week and share it with Zhao Li for feedback.

start_state.mood: Calm, going to church with a grateful heart

end_state.mood: Stable, satisfied with the deeper understanding between husband and wife, and more organized in community operations.

state.daily_exercise: Evening walk for about 40 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Overcast, occasional light rain, temperature 17-21°C

2025-03.daily_overview: After closing, facing the dismal March net profit figures alone, she clearly saw the cost of impulsive investment, resolved to cut ineffective costs and focus on community efficiency, and held the most honest review meeting with herself in the quiet little shop. Before bed, she kept up her stretching and set April goals.

events.name: During the day, organize the current month's vouchers and prepare for closing the accounts
events.description: On Monday morning, Song Yajing gathered all the original vouchers for March—sales receipts, purchase orders, equipment procurement orders for the coffee corner, utility bills, employee attendance sheets, and so on—into a document box. She sorted them by category with small labels, setting aside a whole block of time for the evening's settlement. Xiaomei saw how serious she was and didn't dare disturb her much.

events.name: In the evening, alone at the store, compiled the monthly operating data.
events.description: After closing at 7:30 pm, Song Yajing sat alone behind the counter and opened an Excel spreadsheet on the computer to enter data item by item: total revenue for March was about 42,000 yuan, but after deducting purchase costs, store rent, Xiaomei's salary, coffee corner ingredients, equipment depreciation, utilities, and so on, the final net profit was less than 8,000 yuan, more than half lower than she had expected.

events.name: Deep analysis of profit and loss causes and deciding on the direction for adjustment
events.description: Looking at the numbers on the screen, Song Yajing felt a chill in her heart, but she forced herself to analyze calmly. She found that the online traffic investment had hardly brought any actual conversions, and the coffee beans and milk for the beverage corner cost nearly 1,000 yuan a month without noticeably driving clothing sales. In red pen she wrote two key adjustments in her notebook: "Suspend new purchases for the coffee corner and switch to simple tea drinks; focus community activities on repeat purchases from existing customers and do not invest in traffic for now." She also decided to discuss with Zhao Li the next day adjusting the flower arrangement collaboration from storefront decoration to sellable small bouquets to add a revenue stream.

events.name: Briefly share the analysis results with her husband
events.description: Before packing up and closing the shop, Song Yajing sent Chen Zhiqiang a WeChat message: "I've finished the accounts. March net profit is less than 8,000 yuan. I've decided to cut the coffee investment and focus on survival." After a while, her husband replied: "Got it. Let's talk when we get home. The final payment for my side job came in today. I'll transfer 2,000 to the education account tomorrow." Looking at the message, Song Yajing felt both bitter and warm.

events.name: Stretch before bed and write down key improvements for April.
events.description: After returning home and washing up, Song Yajing spread out a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and followed an app for a 10-minute neck and shoulder stretch, feeling much more relaxed in her tense shoulders and back. Then she listed three improvement points for April in her notebook: ① Execute the community's weekly plan; ② Introduce small-batch testing of eco-friendly fabrics; ③ Set aside one hour every Thursday evening to study marketing knowledge. When she closed the notebook, she felt she had a direction again.

start_state.mood: Walked into the shop carrying the account book, knowing that today she had to face the truth.

end_state.mood: Clear-headed and urgent, she gained a more directed courage after adjusting the direction of her plan.

state.daily_exercise: 10-minute neck and shoulder stretch before bed

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning overcast, autumn breeze rising.

2025-11.daily_overview: In the early morning, Song Yajing was still checking the insurance plan in the family's electronic ledger, setting aside the premium from this month's income. In the morning, a phone call from Quanzhou broke the calm — her mother, Lin Xiuying, had suddenly suffered a mild stroke and was hospitalized. She immediately set down everything she was doing and urgently coordinated with her husband, Chen Zhiqiang. Zhiqiang took leave from work and drove, and the family of three rushed back to Quanzhou overnight. Her older sister, Song Yawen, remotely contacted the hospital from Shenzhen to coordinate specialist resources. By the time they arrived at the hospital in the evening, her mother was still in emergency treatment. Song Yajing waited anxiously outside the ward and was only able to enter to accompany her mother late into the night. That day, the priorities of family and career were completely reset.

events.name: Reserve family insurance premiums.
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing, following the insurance special plan set at the beginning of the year in the family electronic ledger, carefully checked this month's premium amount from November's family income and transferred it to a dedicated account via mobile banking, ensuring that the family's health insurance and accident insurance premiums were paid on time and not missed because of the busy start of the month.

events.name: Learned that her mother was hospitalized and rushed back to Quanzhou.
events.description: At around 10 a.m., Song Yajing received a message in the family WeChat group forwarded by her father and supplemented by her elder sister — her mother Lin Xiuying had suddenly suffered a mild cerebral infarction that morning and was already receiving emergency treatment at Quanzhou First Hospital. Her mind went blank for a moment, but she forced herself to calm down and called her husband Chen Zhiqiang with trembling hands. Zhiqiang immediately asked for leave from his company and rushed home from work within 20 minutes. The two quickly packed a few changes of clothes and the essentials for their daughter, settled 5-year-old Chen Lexuan into the safety seat in the back, and Zhiqiang drove the family car north at high speed along the Shenhai Expressway. On the way, she called her sister Song Yawen, who was on a business trip in Shenzhen. The two sisters divided the work clearly: Yawen was responsible for using her connections to coordinate remotely with specialist resources at Quanzhou Hospital, while Song Yajing went directly to handle things on site. The atmosphere in the car was tense; she clutched her phone the whole way, not daring to miss any message.

events.name: Arrived at the hospital and stayed with mother
events.description: In the early evening, the family of three arrived at the hospital in Licheng District, Quanzhou. Her mother Lin Xiuying had just finished emergency treatment and was admitted to the neurology intensive care unit; she had regained consciousness but still needed close observation. Song Yajing asked Zhiqiang to take their daughter to a nearby hotel to settle in and have dinner, while she stayed alone on a bench in the corridor outside the ward. Staring at the closed ward door, she recalled her mother's usual hearty laughter and the two of them shopping together, and finally could not hold back her tears. After visiting hours, she obtained permission by talking with the nurse, put on a sterile gown, and entered the ward. Her mother lay weak in bed and, seeing her come in, raised her hand slightly. Song Yajing gently held her mother's hand and said softly, 'Mom, I'm back,' then quietly sat by the bed, watching the IV drip fall drop by drop.

start_state.location: Home on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen
start_state.mood: Calm and focused.

end_state.mood: Anxious and sad, but forcing herself to stay strong.

state.daily_exercise: None; spent the whole day rushing around.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning to light rain, cold and damp

2025-11.daily_overview: Good news about her mother's condition came in the early morning: the blood vessels had reopened well, and the muscle strength in her hands and feet had visibly recovered. Song Yajing, who had been anxious all night, finally felt a little relieved. In the morning, she fetched warm water in the ward, gently wiped her mother's face and hands, and then used a comb to tidy her hair, which had become tangled from lying in bed. While combing her hair, her mother looked at the drizzle outside the window and recalled how she had taken care of her own mother when she was young. Mother and daughter shared a tender conversation full of tears and smiles by the hospital bed. Zhiqiang brought their daughter to visit, and Xuanxuan obediently sang a nursery rhyme for her grandmother. Laughter was a rare sound in the ward.

events.name: Her mother's condition improved; she gently combed her mother's hair at the bedside.
events.description: After the morning ward round, the doctor informed them that mother Lin Xiuying's cerebral infarction was small and had been treated in time, her blood vessels had recanalized well, and her limb muscle strength had recovered from grade 2 on admission to grade 4. She was expected to be discharged after two more days of observation for rest at home. Song Yajing was overjoyed; the weight in her heart finally settled. After the doctor left, she brought a basin of warm water, wrung out a towel, and carefully wiped her mother's face and hands. Then she took out the wooden comb that had been used for over ten years from her mother's small bag, sat by the hospital bed, and gently combed her mother's gray hair, which had become messy from lying in bed, while chatting with her. Her mother looked at the fine autumn rain outside the window and calmly recalled the past, saying that when her grandmother had a stroke back then, she had combed her hair like this too, and that Yajing, who was only in her teens at the time, always helped her turn her grandmother over after school. Listening, Song Yajing's eyes grew moist, but she smiled and replied that yes, she had inherited her mother's filial piety gene. The two smiled at each other, and the air in the ward no longer only smelled of disinfectant, but also carried the warmth of memories.

events.name: Husband and daughter visited; Xuanxuan sang for her grandmother.
events.description: In the afternoon, Chen Zhiqiang brought his daughter Chen Lexuan from the hotel to the hospital. As soon as Xuanxuan entered the ward, she ran to her grandmother's bedside and said in a tender voice, “Grandma, I missed you so much,” then stood by the bed and earnestly sang “Little Hands Holding Big Hands,” a song she had just learned at kindergarten. Her grandmother beamed with joy and, with her still somewhat unsteady hand, touched her granddaughter's little cheek. Seeing that his wife looked exhausted, Zhiqiang gently put his arm around her shoulder and said in a low voice, “I'll keep watch tonight. You and Xuanxuan go back to the hotel and get a good night's sleep.” But Song Yajing shook her head and insisted on staying the night.

events.name: Confiding in her older sister during a late-night phone call
events.description: At ten in the evening, after her mother fell asleep, Song Yajing walked alone to the garden downstairs in the hospital and called her older sister Song Yawen. The two sisters talked for nearly half an hour, from their mother's condition to their own pressures. Yawen comforted her, telling her not to take all the responsibility on herself, and promised to come back to Fujian to visit the family next week. Listening to her sister's familiar voice, Song Yajing felt her suppressed emotions find an outlet. After hanging up, she sat on a bench in the garden for a while before returning to the ward.

start_state.mood: Tired but with a hint of relief.

end_state.mood: Moved and warm, the mother-daughter bond deepened

state.daily_exercise: None; stayed active in the ward

date_attribute.weather: Light rain turning cloudy

2025-11.daily_overview: Her mother was recovering well and could sit up with assistance and eat liquid food by herself. Song Yajing stayed in the ward all day, helping her mother with bedside limb rehabilitation exercises and feeding her porridge spoonful by spoonful. At noon, Zhiqiang came to the hospital again with a change of clothes and fruit. The two briefly talked in the ward corridor about Xuanxuan's care arrangements and store matters. In the evening, Song Yajing used a WeChat video call to let Xiao Mei show her the store situation. Confirming that everything was going smoothly, she felt reassured for the time being.

events.name: Full-day caregiving, assisting mother's recovery.
events.description: Today is a critical period for her mother's recovery. Song Yajing stayed by her hospital bed almost the entire time, strictly following the nurse's instructions and helping her mother with passive limb flexion and extension exercises every two hours to prevent deep vein thrombosis. In the morning, her mother tried to slowly sit up with support. She was still a little dizzy, but it was significant progress. At lunch, she fed her mother the nutritional porridge provided by the hospital and carefully wiped the corner of her mouth with a tissue. Her mother ate slowly, so she patiently waited, spoonful by spoonful. When you were little and sick, I fed you like this too, her mother suddenly said. Song Yajing felt a pang in her nose and replied gently, So now it's my turn to take care of you. In the afternoon, she washed up briefly in the ward bathroom, patted her face in the mirror, and told herself she had to stay steady.

events.name: Discuss household chore arrangements with her husband and check on the store remotely.
events.description: At noon, Chen Zhiqiang came to the hospital again with a change of clothes and a few bags of fruit. The two sat on a bench in the corridor outside the ward for ten minutes and talked in low voices: Zhiqiang would take Xuanxuan back to Xiamen that afternoon, because it was hard to ask for too much leave from kindergarten and the store also needed him to help receive the packages that were about to arrive. Song Yajing would stay in Quanzhou to accompany her mother until she was discharged. In the evening, she video-called Xiaomei via WeChat, quickly panning the camera across the store display and the checkout counter. Xiaomei reported that customer flow had been normal over the past two days and that the online community activities were being posted as usual, which set her mind at ease for the moment.

start_state.mood: Focused, tired, but determined.

end_state.mood: Somewhat reassured, yet the responsibility feels heavy.

state.daily_exercise: None, mainly staying in the ward to keep the patient company

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning sunny

2025-11.daily_overview: After the doctor's morning rounds confirmed that her mother's vital signs were stable and she could be discharged to recover at home, Song Yajing completed the discharge procedures for her mother, carefully noted all medical instructions and follow-up appointment times, and took her mother back to her home in Licheng District, settling her in properly. After repeatedly reminding her father about daily care precautions, she met up with her husband Chen Zhiqiang, who had come to pick her up, and drove back to Xiamen in the afternoon. On the highway home, leaning against the car window, she kept picturing her mother kneading dough and baking cakes in her youth. A thought of carrying on her mother's craft quietly took shape—she wanted to organize the baking recipes her mother had handwritten 20 years ago and make them into a small booklet.

events.name: Mother discharged from hospital; arrangements made to return to Xiamen.
events.description: In the morning, after the attending physician's rounds, it was officially confirmed that her mother Lin Xiuying's cerebral infarction had entered a stable recovery period and she could be discharged to recuperate at home. The doctor prescribed antiplatelet aggregation and antihypertensive drugs. Song Yajing carefully noted every key point in the medical instructions — a low-salt, low-fat diet, daily blood pressure monitoring, a head CT recheck after one month, and avoiding emotional agitation and overexertion. She completed the discharge procedures for her mother and made another trip to the hospital pharmacy to pick up all the discharge medications. Then, together with her father Song Minghui, she took her mother back to the old house in Licheng District. At the doorstep, her father held her hand and said, “This time we really relied on you; leave the rest to me.” Song Yajing repeatedly reminded her father to make sure her mother took her medications on time and measured her blood pressure every day. She also wrote the hospital's contact information on a sticky note and stuck it on the refrigerator door. After a simple lunch, her husband Chen Zhiqiang drove from Xiamen to Quanzhou to pick her up. At two in the afternoon, she reluctantly said goodbye to her parents and got on the highway back to Xiamen with her husband.

events.name: On the way back, the idea of making a small baking recipe booklet came to me.
events.description: The car drove smoothly on the Shenhai Expressway, and the Minnan countryside outside the window shimmered gold under the autumn sun. Chen Zhiqiang focused on driving, while Song Yajing leaned back in the passenger seat, finally releasing a bit of the exhaustion from the past few days. Half-closing her eyes, she couldn't help picturing her mother busy in the kitchen in her youth—wearing a faded floral apron, humming a Minnan folk song while kneading dough and whipping cream, the aroma of baked cake filling the whole alley. "Zhiqiang," she suddenly said, "do you remember my mother's old red notebook? It's full of her handwritten baking recipes." Zhiqiang nodded. Song Yajing looked out the window, her gaze turning gentle and determined: "I want to find that notebook, scan and copy it into a booklet, and sell it at the shop. Not to make money—I want to donate all the proceeds to an elderly foundation. This is Mom's craft; I can't let it vanish with time." Chen Zhiqiang reached out his right hand and gently patted the back of her hand. "That's a good idea. I support it."

start_state.mood: Relieved but still troubled

end_state.location: Home on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen
end_state.mood: Exhausted, yet new ideas are brewing.

state.daily_exercise: None, long-distance car ride back.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny to cloudy

2025-11.daily_overview: On the first day back in Xiamen, Song Yajing could not wait to dig out the handwritten baking recipe notebook her mother had used twenty years ago. Stroking the yellowed pages, she decided to scan and typeset them into a beautiful booklet to sell, passing on the craft. However, the cost of days of rushing around and anxiety showed itself in the afternoon—her old lower back condition flared up severely, and she had to lean on Zhiqiang for support to go to the community hospital. The doctor warned that she must reduce standing and prolonged sitting, and those words struck her like an alarm bell: it was time to change the way she worked. After returning home, she made an unprecedented decision to cut her weekly working hours from 56 to 40, and posted a part-time shop assistant job listing on a recruitment platform. This was a major turning point in her work philosophy.

events.name: Took out her mother's handwritten recipe book and went to a print shop to scan and typeset it
events.description: After getting up in the morning, Song Yajing took out from the back of her wardrobe the red-covered baking recipe notebook handwritten by her mother Lin Xiuying twenty years ago. The notebook had yellowed, and the corners were slightly curled, but her mother's handwriting was still clear and elegant. Each page recorded in detail the ingredient ratios and steps for cakes, cookies, and traditional Minnan pastries, and some page footers had small notes, such as "Yajing likes to eat this" and "Used double the sugar on New Year's Eve." She sat in the living room sunlight, flipping through page by page, as if smelling the sweet aroma of childhood. Then she walked alone to a print shop near the neighborhood, asked the clerk to carefully scan each page, and spent nearly an hour adjusting the layout on the computer, finally producing a beautiful A5-sized draft booklet with the cover reading "Mom's Recipes, the Sweetness of Time."

events.name: Her old lumbar spine problem flared up; she sought medical treatment and decided to reduce her working hours and hire part-time help.
events.description: In the afternoon, when Song Yajing tried to get up and pour water in the kitchen, a familiar sharp pain suddenly shot through her lower back, and she could no longer stand straight. Days of rushing around, anxiety, and long periods of sitting stiffly while accompanying her father in the hospital had triggered the lumbar disc herniation she had developed two years ago from carrying goods. The pain made it almost impossible for her to stand, and cold sweat broke out on her forehead. Chen Zhiqiang hurried over when he heard her, helped her slowly sit back on the sofa, and then drove her to the community health center. The family doctor, Wang Mingyuan, gave her a careful examination and arranged physical therapy, and sternly admonished her: 'Your lumbar muscle strain with disc bulge is more serious than last time. You must strictly reduce the amount of time you stand and sit for long periods each day, especially that long walking-around inspection in the store. Otherwise, the next time, you may end up on the operating table.' The doctor's warning was like a cold bucket of water thrown over her. On the way home, she was silent for a long while, then suddenly said to her husband: 'Zhiqiang, I've decided. From now on, I'll spend at most 40 hours per week in the store. For the remaining time, I'll hire a part-timer to rotate with me.' That night, enduring the back pain, she leaned against the sofa and used her phone to post a part-time shop assistant recruitment notice on 58.com and a local life services group, specifying about 16 hours per week of rotating hours and the main responsibilities.

start_state.location: Home on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen
start_state.mood: An energetic morning disrupted by an unexpected event.

end_state.location: Master bedroom of the home on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen
end_state.mood: Pain mixed with the determination to burn the boats

2025-11.daily_overview: Following the doctor's orders, Song Yajing began complete bed rest. She propped a lumbar cushion behind her on the bed, and apart from using the bathroom, she barely got out of bed. This forced stillness opened up a different kind of life experience—she picked up a novel she had bought long ago but never had time to read, and read dozens of pages in one sitting. What moved her even more was that her 5-year-old daughter Xuanxuan carefully brought over a glass of water and said, "Mommy, drink some water; it won't hurt after you drink." In the evening, her husband Chen Zhiqiang quietly ordered a massage chair online and had it delivered to the door, saying, "I've been meaning to buy this for you." Song Yajing's eyes grew moist. She opened the newly downloaded diary app and seriously wrote down these three things under the 'Three Little Joys of the Day' section.

events.name: Resting at home in bed, starting to read a novel and keep a gratitude journal
events.description: Starting today, Song Yajing followed the doctor's orders and began bed rest at home. Early in the morning, Chen Zhiqiang quickly converted the living room sofa area into a recovery zone, placing a new lumbar cushion behind her lower back and a low stool by her feet. After her husband went to work and their daughter was taken to kindergarten, the house was unusually quiet. She took out the healing novel "The Camellia Stationery Shop" from the bedside table — a gift from her close friend Li Meiling at the beginning of the year — which she had previously had no time to read because the shop was too busy. As she opened the first page, sunlight happened to fall on the pages, and she slowly sank into the world of Jiuzi, the letter writer; before she knew it, she had read more than forty pages that morning. In the afternoon, her daughter Chen Lexuan came home from kindergarten, ran to the sofa as soon as she entered, and carefully held out a glass of warm water with both hands (Zhiqiang had poured it earlier and left it on the tea table to cool), saying in a sweet, childish voice, "Mommy, drink some water. If you drink more water, your back won't hurt." Song Yajing took the cup and hugged her daughter tightly, kissing her again and again. At six in the evening, the sound of delivery workers moving things came from outside the door — Chen Zhiqiang had a brand-new massage chair delivered when he came home from work. "I had seen him secretly watching reviews online before and thought he was picking one for himself," Song Yajing later wrote in her diary app. That day she downloaded a diary app and created a column called "Three Small Joys a Day" on the home page, writing her first entry: "1. Xuanxuan brought water for my sore back; my little sweetheart has grown up. 2. My husband secretly bought a massage chair; this man of few words always remembered when I said my back was sore. 3. Zhao Li sent photos of the new hydrangeas in her flower shop and said she saved the most beautiful bunch for me." After that, she leaned back in the massage chair and, in the warm kneading, felt an unprecedented sense of security wrapped in gentleness.

start_state.location: Sofa rest area in the living room at home, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen
start_state.mood: Pain and discomfort, but calm at heart.

end_state.location: Master bedroom of the home on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen
end_state.mood: Deeply moved, filled with happiness.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny

2025-11.daily_overview: She continued to rest flat at home. It was the weekend, and her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Xuanxuan were both home. In the morning, Zhiqiang took their daughter to build blocks and read picture books in another corner of the living room, while Song Yajing leaned on the sofa and continued reading “The Camellia Stationery Store.” The afternoon sunlight was just right; Zhiqiang helped her sit on the balcony for half an hour to get some fresh air, and Xuanxuan watered her potted plants on the side. She continued using her diary app to record today's little blessings: the sunshine, the osmanthus fragrance, and the crooked family portrait Xuanxuan had drawn. With life slowing down, she began to truly notice the details she usually overlooked.

events.name: Continued resting and reading, enjoying a slow family weekend.
events.description: Today is Saturday, and her husband and daughter are both home, leaving the whole house wrapped in the lazy atmosphere unique to weekends. Chen Zhiqiang voluntarily took on all the housework and cooking. He played with building blocks with Xuanxuan on the carpet on the other side of the living room and read her the picture book Guess How Much I Love You, deliberately not disturbing his wife's rest. Song Yajing continued reading the novel and had finished most of it. At two in the afternoon, Zhiqiang carefully helped her move to the balcony to enjoy the sun. The autumn sunlight was soft and warm; the osmanthus flowers in the garden of the residential complex downstairs were in full bloom, and waves of sweet fragrance drifted on the wind. She closed her eyes and took a few deep breaths, feeling the tense nerves and lower back discomfort of the past few days slowly ease. Xuanxuan used her mini watering can to water the pothos and spider plants on the balcony, and even picked a leaf and ran over to press it into her mother's hand. The child ran back inside and soon came out with a drawing—three crooked stick figures labeled 'Daddy, Mommy, Me,' clearly just drawn. 'This is a family portrait!' Xuanxuan announced proudly. In the evening, Song Yajing opened the diary app and wrote under 'Three Small Blessings': '1. The fragrance of osmanthus on the autumn balcony, sweet to the heart; 2. The crooked family portrait drawn by my daughter, precious; 3. The tomato and scrambled eggs my husband made today were surprisingly not bad.'

2025-11.daily_overview: On the last day of bed rest, with her back pain relieved, Song Yajing turned her attention to the store. Leaning back in the massage chair, she carefully went through the sales data and inventory records for the past two weeks sent by Xiaomei, and combined with her understanding of female customers in Xiamen, she put together a detailed list of winter women's clothing categories that needed restocking. At ten in the morning, she had a video call with her Guangzhou supplier Susan as scheduled to select styles, carefully choosing 10 coats, knitwear, and scarves through the camera. In the afternoon, she finalized the order details and paid the deposit. In the evening, she finished the last page of the novel and used a diary app to record her reflections from these days of rest, drawing a close to this unexpected period of recuperation.

events.name: Analyze sales data and organize winter restocking needs.
events.description: In the morning, the pain in her lower back had eased noticeably, and she could sit up for short periods. Song Yajing leaned back in the massage chair, opened the inventory management app on her phone, and carefully reviewed the store's sales records and current inventory for November 1 to 7 sent by Xiao Mei. As she looked, she manually summarized in her notebook: Xiamen's November temperatures this year were slightly higher than past years, so lightweight coats and cardigans were the fastest movers, while heavy down jackets were slow-moving; several knitwear styles from the autumn clearance were mostly out of stock in key sizes due to the heavy discounts. Based on recent customer inquiry preferences in the community, she listed categories to restock: mid-length wool-blend coats (mainly caramel and beige), thick turtleneck sweaters (in black, gray, and camel), and cashmere scarves (to be promoted as coordinating add-on items). She also specifically noted the size ratio — local Xiamen women tend to be petite, so sizes S to M should account for 70%, while ordering fewer XL sizes to reduce inventory risk.

events.name: Video call with supplier Susan to select styles.
events.description: At 10 a.m., Song Yajing opened a WeChat video call on time to connect with Su Shan, the Guangzhou supplier. Su Shan was at her stall in the wholesale market, with her phone mounted on a stand, showing the latest winter arrivals one by one. Song Yajing asked her to zoom in to carefully check the fabric texture, lining workmanship, and stitching details of the coats, and kept asking, 'Does this one come in caramel? What material are the cuff buttons?' The two cooperated well. After about an hour of selection, they finalized 10 styles: two well-tailored double-faced wool coats, three turtleneck sweaters with different textures, two cashmere scarves, and three cardigans with designer buttons. She said to Su Shan, 'Several pearl buttons on the last batch of cardigans fell off; this time please help me confirm that the buttons are sewn on securely.' Su Shan readily agreed to check every one.

events.name: Finalized the order and paid the deposit
events.description: After the video selection of styles ended, Song Yajing wrote up the final order details confirmed with Susan and double-checked them over WeChat: style number, color, size ratio, quantity, and unit price. Susan sent the total amount and the estimated delivery date (shipping on November 10, arriving in Xiamen in about two days). After confirming that everything was correct, Song Yajing transferred the 30% deposit via mobile banking and sent a screenshot to Susan as proof. She quickly calculated the turnover cycle and gross profit margin for this batch, estimating that the first wave of winter new arrivals could restock in time after Double 11.

events.name: Finished reading the novel and recorded reflections in a diary app.
events.description: In the early evening, as the sky darkened, Song Yajing opened the final chapters of The Tsubaki Stationery Store. When she read the passage where Poppo finally reconciled with her pen pal, her eyes felt a little hot. After finishing, she closed the book and sat quietly for a while, staring at the gradually darkening sky outside the window. She then opened her diary app, and under today's 'Three Little Blessings' section, she wrote: '1. Today's video selection went smoothly, and Su Shan was as reliable as ever; 2. My waist is clearly much better, and I can finally walk slowly to the bathroom on my own; 3. I've finished this book — the way the letter-writing proxy wrote letters so carefully reminded me of my mother writing out recipes stroke by stroke. After three days of rest, my body has rested, but my heart feels full.' She put the book back on the shelf, and her three full days of bed rest officially came to an end.

2025-11.daily_overview: On the first day after her convalescence, Song Yajing was still careful in her movements, but mentally she had already begun actively planning her life. In the morning, watching a rerun of a Mediterranean diet documentary on TV, and taking into account her mother's stroke health warning and her own back condition, she decided to start a one-week diet experiment for the whole family to lower cardiovascular risk. She brought Zhiqiang into the discussion, and after gaining his support, she made a list of ingredients. At noon she received a tracking number from Susan; the goods were already on the way. In the afternoon, she received a package from Shenzhen and an intra-city express delivery in Xiamen — her close friend Wang Jia sent a full set of professional lumbar support gear, with the note "You're 38 years old, so you have to admit defeat"; Li Meiling sent sour plums she had pickled herself during pregnancy. Looking at these two tokens of affection, Song Yajing laughed out loud, took a photo and posted it on Moments: "Admitting defeat is a philosophy," with the protective gear and sour plums as the image.

events.name: Inspired by a Mediterranean diet program, she decided to start a one-week diet experiment.
events.description: In the morning, while Song Yajing was doing waist stretches in the living room, the TV was replaying a documentary about the Mediterranean diet. In the program, a nutritionist elaborated on the significant benefits of a Mediterranean diet pattern rich in olive oil, fish, whole grains, and fresh fruits and vegetables for reducing the risk of cardiovascular disease. She thought of her mother Lin Xiuying's stroke—the doctor had explicitly said it was related to a daily diet that was too salty and too oily—and she also thought of her own cardiovascular health risks that she had not paid attention to (no physical exam in nearly three years and low exercise levels). A thought gradually became clear. She paused the program, walked into the kitchen, took out a brand-new notebook from a drawer, and carefully wrote down the words Family One-Week Diet Experiment.

events.name: Discussed the diet adjustment plan with her husband and listed the ingredients.
events.description: Chen Zhiqiang was walking through the living room with a coffee cup when Song Yajing stopped him. She seriously explained to her husband the concept of the Mediterranean diet and her proposal for the whole family to join in—not for weight loss, but to build healthier daily eating habits to prevent future risks. Although Zhiqiang was skeptical about “a dinner without rice,” seeing the determination in his wife's eyes, he nodded and said, “Then let's try it, but can you not be too extreme and not completely Westernize everything all at once?” Yajing smiled and agreed. In her notebook, she wrote out the shopping list of needed ingredients: extra-virgin olive oil, fresh salmon, chicken breast, chickpeas, quinoa, whole wheat bread, all kinds of fresh vegetables and fruits, and low-fat Greek yogurt.

events.name: Confirm the logistics status of the goods
events.description: At noon, Song Yajing received a WeChat message from her Guangzhou supplier Susan—a screenshot of a tracking number showing that the goods had been shipped from the Guangzhou clothing wholesale market and were expected to arrive in Xiamen tomorrow or the day after. She opened the courier app, entered the tracking number, and enabled real-time push notifications to track the parcel's logistics. At the same time, she told Xiaomei to watch for large packages over the next two days and to clear space in the storeroom in advance for the new winter styles.

events.name: Received a gift from her best friend and posted a self-deprecating Moment
events.description: At two in the afternoon, the delivery man rang the doorbell. Song Yajing received a box sent from Shenzhen. When she opened it, inside was a full set of professional lumbar protective gear carefully chosen by her best friend Wang Jia — including a medical waist brace with steel bar support, a car cushion, and an electric heating waist belt. A card was attached in the box with Wang Jia's flamboyant handwriting: 'Boss Song, you're 38 — time to admit defeat! Your back isn't made of iron. Wear these when you work. Love, Jia.' Almost at the same time, another small package arrived via Xiamen same-city delivery — two large jars of salted plums made by Li Meiling herself, with a note saying: 'I'm seven months pregnant and can't come see you, so here's something to whet your appetite. Eat one when you miss me. When you're better, we'll go shopping!' Song Yajing placed the protective gear and the salted plums together, took out her phone, snapped a photo, and wrote: 'Admitting defeat is a philosophy. I used to think it meant showing weakness. Only at 38 did I learn that it means letting yourself off the hook. Thank you, my ladies.' She posted it to Moments. Before long, likes and comments poured in. Her father, Song Minghui, commented below: 'Well said. Take care of yourself.'
