events.name: Attend Sunday Mass
events.description: Woke up at 7 a.m. and took her daughter to church to attend Mass led by Father Wang, praying for her family and career. After Mass, she caught up with fellow church member Aunt Lin Xiuying and shared the news that her mother was recovering.

events.name: Supermarket Shopping and Winning a Prize
events.description: After Mass, she took her daughter to the supermarket to buy baking ingredients. At checkout, they had a member points lucky draw; her daughter pressed the button and won the first prize—an electric oven—and was overjoyed.

events.name: Sharing the joy of winning
events.description: She immediately sent the winning news to her besties' group and church friends' group. Friends congratulated her one after another, and Li Meiling teased that she should seriously pursue a career in baking.

events.name: First time baking egg tarts with the new oven
events.description: At noon, she went home, cleaned the new oven, and ran it empty to burn off any residue. Then she baked a tray of golden, crispy egg tarts. The whole family gobbled them up, and her husband joked that the oven had won the jackpot.

events.name: Plan a Thanksgiving event
events.description: After lunch, selected 50 highly engaged members, designed handwritten thank-you cards and homemade nut and oat crisp gift packs, and made a shopping list.

events.name: Successfully made the official low-sugar Minnan cake.
events.description: In the afternoon, she fine-tuned the baking time and sugar substitute ratio. The finished Minnan cake was golden in appearance, fluffy and pleasant to taste, becoming a regular household snack, and she photographed it for reference.

events.name: Purchase materials for the event
events.description: In the evening, go to a baking supplies store and a stationery store to buy cake flour, nuts, dried-flower stickers, blank thank-you cards, and so on.

events.name: Evening stroll
events.description: After the meal, the whole family went for a 30-minute walk. Song Yajing felt almost no discomfort in her waist. She discussed Thanksgiving plans with her husband, and he voluntarily took over the dishwashing duties for a few days.

start_state.mood: Calm and expectant, with a sense of ritual about returning to faith.

end_state.mood: Excited and grateful; good luck dispelled the gloom, and the baking results and event planning made the coming week full of anticipation.

state.daily_exercise: Evening walk for 30 minutes (about 4,500 steps), with extra walking in the supermarket

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, 18-23°C, northeast wind force 2

2025-11.daily_overview: On Monday, in a spare moment amid her busy schedule, Song Yajing posted photos of the finished low-sugar Minnan rice cake and her thoughts to her community, which resonated warmly with everyone. In the evening, she focused on baking 50 portions of nut and oat crunch, preparing the core items for the Thanksgiving gift packages.

events.name: Filming and sharing insights on low-sugar cake
events.description: In the morning, took styled photos of low-sugar Minnan cakes and wrote a post, honestly sharing the journey from a Western-style diet to incorporating hometown flavors.

events.name: Community interaction
events.description: In the afternoon, she posted text and images in the community, encouraging everyone to find a health approach that suits them. Group members resonated with it and shared their own low-sugar attempts.

events.name: Baking a large batch of nut and oat crunch
events.description: After their daughter fell asleep at night, she and her husband used the new oven to bake batches of low-sugar nut oat crisps, mixing oats, almonds, walnuts, and a little honey and olive oil. They worked until 11 o'clock and finished 50 individually wrapped portions.

events.name: Keep up the walking
events.description: Despite the heavy baking workload, the whole family still went for a 30-minute walk after dinner. Song Yajing felt that her waist had recovered well and also stretched her shoulders and neck.

start_state.mood: Orderly and proactive, looking forward to sharing in the community group to get closer to customers.

end_state.mood: Tired but fulfilled. The core materials for the Thanksgiving event are ready, and I feel at ease.

state.daily_exercise: Evening walk for 30 minutes, about 4100 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast, 16-20°C, feels slightly cool.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Song Yajing continued to work out the details of the Thanksgiving appreciation campaign, fine-tuned the healthy recipes, purchased items for the gift bags, and began handwriting thank-you cards, conveying a sense of gratitude through community interactions.

events.name: Improved dinner seasoning.
events.description: In the evening, she added honey and lemon zest to the cold chickpea salad and pan-fried the salmon with only a thin layer of oil. The flavor was fresher and lighter, and her family was very satisfied.

events.name: Purchase gift bag supplies
events.description: In the morning, she went to the wholesale market to buy kraft paper bags, coupons, and so on, and borrowed eucalyptus leaves and dried flowers from florist Zhao Li for decoration.

events.name: Handwritten thank-you card
events.description: In the afternoon, at home, she started writing personalized thank-you notes for 50 members, recalling each regular customer's preferences. When her wrist felt sore, she rubbed it and continued writing.

events.name: Community healthy eating discussion.
events.description: In the community group, she browsed members' photos of their baking attempts, replied to each with encouragement, and a warm, mutually supportive atmosphere formed in the group.

events.name: Walk and gratitude journal
events.description: After the meal, she took a 30-minute walk. After returning home, she recorded the three things she was grateful for today in her journal app: Zhao Li's generosity, the customers' trust, and her husband's quiet support.

start_state.mood: Focused and grateful, immersed in the warmth of preparing surprises for customers

end_state.mood: Her heart was soft and content; the warmth of handwriting reignited her original passion for the business.

state.daily_exercise: Evening walk for 30 minutes, about 4,000 steps, and 10 minutes of meditation.

date_attribute.weather: Light rain turning cloudy, 15-19°C

2025-11.daily_overview: One day before Thanksgiving, Song Yajing invited shop assistant Xiaomei and fellow church member Zhao Li to the shop to pack gift bags. The three worked together to complete all preparations. During her evening walk, she felt calm anticipation for the next day's event.

events.name: Completed handwritten thank-you cards
events.description: In the morning, at home, she finished writing the last 15 cards, writing a personal message for each customer. One customer who had once given her masks made her eyes moist.

events.name: Collectively wrapping gift bags
events.description: In the afternoon, in the back storage room of the store, Zhao Li decorated cards, Xiaomei packed them into bags, and Song Yajing tied twine and pinned flowers. They chatted while working, and the atmosphere was warm. The three completed 50 gift packs.

events.name: Community interaction
events.description: In the evening, she checked the community group. Several members posted their low-sugar baking attempts, and she commented on and encouraged each one. The group felt as relaxed as a circle of friends.

events.name: Evening stroll
events.description: After the rain, the air was fresh. The family took a 30-minute walk. My daughter stepped in puddles. My husband was worried that tomorrow's activities might be too tiring for her, so he offered to put her to bed himself.

start_state.mood: Filled with warmth and motivation, ready to complete the emotional connection with the last handmade work.

end_state.mood: Deeply grateful, warmed by the help from the team and friends, and calmly looking forward to tomorrow.

state.daily_exercise: Evening walk for 30 minutes, about 3800 steps

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning clear, 17-22°C, light breeze

2025-11.daily_overview: On Thanksgiving Day, Song Yajing personally handed the carefully prepared thank-you gift bags to members. Many customers spontaneously shared photos of their purchases online, which spread the word, and store foot traffic increased by 30%. In the bustle, she felt the two-way warmth of emotional connection. After the evening event, although tired, her heart was full of gratitude.

events.name: Publishing the gratitude list
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, posted the thank-you message and the list of 50 members in the community group, notifying them to pick up handwritten cards and bakery gift bags at the store.

events.name: Hand-delivering gift bags
events.description: Customers began arriving at the store in the morning. Song Yajing and Xiaomei handed out gift bags in person, and many customers were moved. Retired teacher Aunt Chen’s eyes reddened as she looked at the card.

events.name: Mail gift packages to remote customers.
events.description: Took her daughter to the courier point in the afternoon to mail gift packs to 17 customers who could not come to the store; her daughter helped affix the labels.

events.name: Organic sharing and customer traffic generation
events.description: From the evening on, customers kept posting order photos on Moments, positive reviews spread, and new customers came following the address. Song Yajing received them warmly and signed them up as members.

events.name: Data statistics and organization
events.description: After closing, she counted the customer traffic and found it had increased by about 30%, with many new customers recommended by friends. She saved screenshots of the healthy-eating discussion takeaways into her electronic notes.

events.name: Gratitude night walk
events.description: Although standing all day made her lower back sore again, the whole family still took a 20-minute walk after dinner. Her daughter asked about the meaning of Thanksgiving. She briefly explained gratitude and silently gave thanks for everything in her heart.

start_state.mood: Expectant and excited, as if about to hand in a carefully prepared answer sheet

end_state.mood: Deeply moved and fulfilled, feeling the power of emotional connection; fatigue was diluted by joy.

state.daily_exercise: Busy at the shop, steps exceeded 9,000; took a 20-minute evening walk (gentle).

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, 18–25°C, clear and crisp autumn weather

2025-11.daily_overview: On Friday, her daughter Chen Lexuan brought the good news of a painting competition. Song Yajing quickly adjusted the store schedule to ensure she could accompany her throughout. In the evening, she began planning the year-end VIP appreciation dinner, filtering the guest list, calculating the budget, and discussing return gift ideas with the designer.

events.name: Found out about the competition notice while picking up her daughter
events.description: When picking up her daughter in the afternoon, the art teacher told her that her daughter had been selected to participate in the citywide painting competition on December 6. Her daughter proudly handed over the notice, and Song Yajing hugged her tightly in excitement.

events.name: Coordinate store scheduling.
events.description: She immediately discussed the scheduling for the day of the competition with Xiaomei. Xiaomei readily agreed, and Song Yajing promised to give her a day off in lieu later.

events.name: Communicate with husband about the competition schedule.
events.description: After dinner, they discussed in detail, confirmed that she would accompany throughout, her husband would come to help after work, and they planned how to celebrate.

events.name: Planning a VIP dinner.
events.description: After her daughter fell asleep, she selected the 20 members with the highest spending as dinner guests, calculated the budget in Excel (restaurant, dishes, gifts, etc.), and decided to allocate it from this month's profits.

events.name: Contact designer Zheng Kai.
events.description: Called Zheng Kai, thanked him for the success of the co-branded collection, and proposed the idea of making custom small silk scarves as favors for the VIP dinner. Zheng Kai was interested and agreed to produce sketches.

events.name: Evening walk and rehabilitation exercises
events.description: The whole family walked for 30 minutes. After returning home, did 10 minutes of lumbar rehabilitation exercises (glute bridge, cat-cow pose). Lumbar flexibility continues to improve.

start_state.mood: Daily rhythm, the lingering warmth of Thanksgiving, and an unexpected surprise from her daughter.

end_state.mood: Joy coexists with planning; the daughter's competition gives the family a shared anticipation, and the dinner party preparations add a new business goal.

state.daily_exercise: Evening walk for 30 minutes (about 4,000 steps), lumbar rehabilitation training for 10 minutes.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, 19-24°C, light breeze.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Saturday, Song Yajing handled routine work at the store in the morning, and in the afternoon went to a Minnan cuisine restaurant to finalize the venue and menu for the VIP dinner. During an evening walk, she shared her ideas with her husband and felt that family was her biggest support system.

events.name: Morning store work
events.description: In the morning, she went to the store to handle after-sales follow-up for the co-branded collection and pay for replenishment. Xiaomei reported the growth of new members. She reflected that the thick records were filled with trust.

events.name: Reserve the dinner venue
events.description: In the afternoon, she went to a well-regarded Hokkien private kitchen restaurant, discussed the buyout arrangement, fusion menu, and nostalgic décor with the manager, and paid a deposit.

events.name: Ran into Zhao Li while she was selecting floral materials
events.description: On the way, I ran into Zhao Li, the owner of a flower shop, and we looked for inspiration for the dinner party table flowers together. Zhao Li suggested using dried flowers and ribbons to coordinate.

events.name: Call with older sister
events.description: In the evening, she spoke with her older sister Song Yawen in Shenzhen and invited her to return to Xiamen for Christmas and also attend a dinner party.

events.name: Evening walk and sharing
events.description: After dinner, took a 30-minute walk and described the dinner party concept to her husband in detail. Her husband suggested making a store growth video. Their daughter pointed at the moon and said she wanted to invite the moon to the dinner party. The whole family laughed.

start_state.mood: Efficient and pragmatic, with the clear goal of finalizing the dinner

end_state.mood: Expectant and relaxed, with the New Year atmosphere growing stronger and both career and family plans moving forward.

state.daily_exercise: Evening walk for 30 minutes, about 4200 steps

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, 16-21°C, northeast wind level 2

2025-11.daily_overview: The last day of November was a Sunday. Song Yajing took her daughter to a long-missed church Mass, shared with fellow believers the good news of her mother's recovery and her Thanksgiving reflections, and her spiritual life returned to normal. In the afternoon, she handled the store's daily transactions and community messages. In the evening, after the family went for a walk, she reviewed the ups and downs of the past month with a heart full of gratitude, and recharged her body through rehabilitation exercises and meditation.

events.name: Going to church for Mass
events.description: Got up at 7 a.m., after washing up, drove with her daughter to Siming Catholic Church to attend Mass presided over by Father Wang Mingde. During the sermon, she felt gratitude and silently prayed for her mother, husband, daughter, and the benefactors of the shop.

events.name: Communicated with fellow believers.
events.description: After Mass, in the courtyard she shared the good news of her mother's recovery and her Thanksgiving experience with Aunt Lin Xiuying and other church members. Aunt Lin invited her to join the December Bible reading group sharing session.

events.name: Reviewed the Mass with her daughter
events.description: On the way back in the car, I discussed the Mass with my daughter. She said she had learned to say thank you out loud, and Song Yajing felt gratified.

events.name: Checked the transaction records and community group messages.
events.description: In the afternoon, she checked the shop's monthly transaction records at home and found that profits had reached a new high. She replied to messages in the community group, and her Xiaohongshu follower growth was good. She smiled and turned off the screen.

events.name: Family walk and monthly reflections
events.description: After dinner, they took a 30-minute walk. Song Yajing took the initiative to share her feelings about this month: from her mother's illness to her own back pain, then the success of the co-branded product and the warmth of Thanksgiving, she felt as if she had lived her life all over again. Her husband held her hand tightly, and her daughter pointed at the moon, saying the moon had accompanied them for a whole month.

events.name: Rehabilitation training and meditation
events.description: After returning home from the walk, did 15 minutes of lumbar rehabilitation exercises (cat-cow pose, glute bridges, etc.), then did 10 minutes of bedtime meditation and a gratitude journal, recording the three biggest things to be grateful for this month.

events.name: Said goodnight to her husband before bed
events.description: Before bed, she and her husband said goodnight to each other, full of anticipation for the upcoming December, turned off the lights, and went to sleep.

start_state.mood: Calm and expectant, welcoming the end of the month with a sense of ritual from returning to faith

end_state.mood: Gratitude and satisfaction mixed with anticipation for December, feeling the resilience and gifts of life

state.daily_exercise: Evening walk for 30 minutes (about 3,500 steps), lumbar rehabilitation training for 15 minutes, and stretching and meditation for 10 minutes before bed.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning clear, temperature 9-15°C, light breeze.

2025-02.daily_overview: The last day of the Spring Festival holiday, enjoying a rare slow-paced reunion at my parents' home in Quanzhou. In the morning, I video-chatted with my sister, who was about to return to work, and caught up on family news. In the afternoon, I accompanied my father for a walk at the nearby Zhongshan Park and helped my mother try making an old-fashioned cake. Late at night, I packed my luggage for the return trip the next day, feeling a little nostalgic for the leisure of the holiday and also a hint of nervousness about the store's post-holiday transformation plan.

events.name: Video call with older sister Song Yawen
events.description: After breakfast, Song Yajing had a video chat on WeChat with her elder sister Song Yawen in Shenzhen for nearly half an hour. Her sister shared amusing stories from her short trip to Guangzhou during the Spring Festival, asked about the shop's plan for new arrivals after the new year, and suggested trying some warm-up promotion in community groups. Song Yajing mentioned that she was considering adding drink service to the shop. Her sister reminded her to calculate the costs and discuss it with her husband, and not to be too impulsive.

events.name: Accompanied her father on a walk and made old-fashioned cake with her mother.
events.description: After waking from her nap, Song Yajing accompanied her father Song Minghui for a walk at Zhongshan Park in Quanzhou. Her father mentioned that he had been having trouble hearing people lately, but she didn't pay much attention, thinking it was just a normal sign of aging. After the walk, her mother Lin Xiuying pulled her into the kitchen to try making old-fashioned Hokkien cake in the old oven. As they baked, they talked about the stress of running the shop, and her mother advised her to go to church more often and rely on faith in everything.

events.name: Packing luggage for the return trip and tidying up daughter's toys
events.description: After dinner, Song Yajing began sorting and packing the clothes brought back from the Spring Festival and the specialties her parents had given in return, such as dried seafood and meat zongzi. Her daughter Chen Lexuan helped tidy up her own paintbrushes, drawing books, and small plush toys, pouting several times because she didn't want to leave her grandparents. Song Yajing patiently comforted her and promised to bring her back when the store was less busy.

start_state.location: Bedroom at parents' home in Licheng District, Quanzhou.
start_state.mood: Relaxed and warm, with a faint wistfulness that the holiday was drawing to a close

end_state.location: In the bedroom at her parents' home in Quanzhou, her daughter was already asleep
end_state.mood: Reluctant to leave, and secretly feels a little nervous about the store transformation after the New Year.

state.daily_exercise: Walked with her father in the park for about 40 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, brief light rain in the afternoon, temperature 11-17°C

2025-02.daily_overview: Day of the return trip after the holiday. Early in the morning, she said an emotional goodbye to her parents and set off on the journey home, laden with hometown flavors and words of advice. Because of the long traffic congestion on the expressway during the Spring Festival return peak, the drive that usually took just one and a half hours stretched to nearly three hours. She was exhausted when she arrived home in Xiamen in the evening, but she still mustered the strength to settle the luggage, check the shop keys, and make simple preparations for resuming work the next day.

events.name: Said goodbye to her parents in the morning and loaded the luggage.
events.description: Early in the morning, her mother, Lin Xiuying, stuffed a few Quanzhou meat zongzi and rice cakes into the suitcase and told her and Zhiqiang to take care of themselves. Song Yajing hugged her father, her husband Chen Zhiqiang loaded the luggage into the trunk, and their daughter Xuanxuan clung to her grandmother's leg and cried for a while before letting go. At 8:50, the car slowly drove out of the residential community. Looking in the rearview mirror, Song Yajing saw her parents still standing at the entrance to the alley waving, and her nose tingled slightly.

events.name: Severe congestion on the return trip on the Shenhai Expressway.
events.description: Around 10 a.m., they got on the expressway from the Quanzhou toll station and soon became stuck in stop-and-go traffic. Along the way they saw several minor rear-end collisions. Chen Zhiqiang gripped the steering wheel tightly, while Song Yajing fed their daughter crackers and played children's songs to distract her. After 1 p.m., they were too tired, so they stopped at the Puli service area to rest. The family had instant noodles and marinated eggs and waited in a long line for the restroom. It took nearly an hour and a half longer than planned.

events.name: Arrived home in the evening, rested, and prepared to resume work the next day.
events.description: Around 5 p.m., they finally drove into the community on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen. The two took turns carrying the heavy luggage up to the third floor. Song Yajing immediately sorted and put things away: daily necessities in their place, food into the fridge, and clean spring clothes hung up in advance to take to the store tomorrow. Chen Zhiqiang went downstairs to check the car's tire pressure, while their daughter fell asleep on the sofa from exhaustion. For dinner, they simply cooked Xiamen instant noodles. After the meal, Song Yajing found the remote control for the store's rolling shutter door from the drawer and charged it.

start_state.mood: Reluctant and nostalgic, but determined to go home.

end_state.location: Home bedroom on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen.
end_state.mood: Tired but grounded, with a slight thrill about returning to work tomorrow.

state.daily_exercise: Carried luggage up and down the stairs several times.

date_attribute.weather: Partly cloudy, temperature 10-16°C, northeast wind force 2-3

2025-02.daily_overview: Preparation day for officially resuming work after the holiday. Alone in her quiet store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, she listened to English songs while doing a thorough cleaning and unpacking and ironing new spring clothing, enjoying rare solitude and focus. In the evening, while testing the home coffee machine she had bought before the New Year, she had the idea of fully upgrading the drink corner, but she also developed a dull ache in her lower back from bending over for a long time.

events.name: Went to the store alone to do the New Year deep cleaning.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Song Yajing left her daughter with her husband and rode her electric scooter to Shop No. 36 on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. After opening the rolling shutter door, she played her favorite English songs on a Bluetooth speaker, rolled up her sleeves, and began a thorough cleaning: mopping the floor, wiping every shelf, polishing the display windows with newspaper and glass cleaner until they shone, and even scrubbing mildew spots in the corners of the fitting room with a small brush. When she straightened up after bending over for a long time, her lower back was sore and numb. She pounded it with her hand and kept working.

events.name: Unpacking and displaying the early spring new arrivals purchased before the New Year
events.description: For lunch, she ordered takeout of satay noodles nearby and ate simply. At 1 p.m., she started processing several boxes of spring clothing that had arrived before the holiday. She opened the shirts, dresses, and light knitwear one by one to check for defects, used a garment steamer to smooth out wrinkles, then rearranged the window mannequin and the main in-store display according to the gradient color scheme of [light pink – white – misty blue – grass green], replacing some dark-toned winter pieces. She also handwrote several [New Spring Arrivals] price tags.

events.name: Tested the home coffee machine and quietly resolved to upgrade.
events.description: At 5 p.m., she brought out an ordinary home capsule coffee machine she had bought online before the New Year, connected water and power for a test, and found that the coffee came out slowly with thin foam, and it could only make the simplest Americano. While wiping the machine, she thought about the professional semi-automatic espresso machines she had browsed before. After hesitating for a moment, she wrote in her phone memo: If you're really going to do a drink corner, you have to invest in professional equipment and a bar counter. The thought lodged in her heart like a small thorn.

start_state.location: At home on Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Energetic and full of drive for the store's operations in the new year

end_state.location: At home on Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: Physically exhausted but mentally excited. The idea of upgrading the drink corner lingered, and the soreness in her waist was obvious.

state.daily_exercise: Store deep cleaning and moving cargo boxes, about 9,200 steps, slight waist strain

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning to light rain, temperature 12-18°C, humid air

2025-02.daily_overview: Unable to suppress the idea, she contacted the equipment supplier early in the morning and transferred nearly 20,000 yuan from the store bank card to buy a brand-new Italian espresso machine and a simple bar counter. The machine and counter were installed and debugged that afternoon. When her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work and heard the news, he flew into a rage. The couple had their fiercest quarrel since getting married, completely dispelling the sweet festive atmosphere. In the middle of the night, her lower back pain grew worse, and she tossed and turned, unable to sleep.

events.name: Impulse purchase of a professional coffee machine and bar counter
events.description: After arriving at the store at 9:30 a.m., Song Yajing couldn't resist and directly called the local coffee equipment supplier in Xiamen she had consulted before the Chinese New Year. She negotiated a price of 19,800 yuan for a commercial semi-automatic Italian espresso machine plus a small solid-wood bar counter. She gritted her teeth and transferred the money from the store's business account working capital, and arranged for delivery and installation at 3 p.m. that afternoon. The moment the transfer went through, her heart raced, but she quickly convinced herself that this was a necessary investment for transformation.

events.name: Install, test, and officially open the new beverage corner.
events.description: The equipment arrived on time in the afternoon, and the workers placed the bar counter to the right of the cash register and connected the coffee machine to water and electricity. Song Yajing read the manual while learning to grind coffee beans, pull espresso, and froth milk. After several failures, she finally made a decent latte. Taking advantage of her excitement, she cleaned up the packaging debris. Around 4:30, the first customer after the Spring Festival arrived — regular customer Vivian pushed open the door, surprised and delighted to take the free hot latte she offered, and repeatedly praised the store for becoming more upscale.

events.name: Chen Zhiqiang questioned the accounts, triggering a heated argument.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Chen Zhiqiang came home from work and casually asked how business was at the shop that day. Song Yajing hemmed and hawed and mentioned that she had bought a machine. Chen Zhiqiang immediately logged into the shop account on his phone to check the balance. Seeing that working capital had suddenly decreased by nearly 20,000 yuan, his face instantly turned ashen. He growled in a low voice, ‘You made the decision on your own again!’ accusing her of being arbitrary and disregarding the family’s financial security. The quarrel spread from the living room to the kitchen. Song Yajing tearfully argued that this was a necessary transformation for the shop. Chen Zhiqiang slammed the door and went into the study, and they slept in separate rooms that night. Their frightened daughter hid by the crack of the door, clutching her stuffed toy. Later, Song Yajing’s lower back hurt so much she could not straighten up, but no one paid her any attention.

start_state.location: At home on Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: With the excitement of going all in and a bit of unease; lower back still uncomfortable

end_state.location: Home bedroom, husband in the study
end_state.mood: Feeling wronged, angry, and also panicked, with twinges in the lower back, tossing and turning all night unable to sleep.

state.daily_exercise: Adjusted equipment while walking back and forth in the store, about 4,800 steps

date_attribute.weather: Light rain turning cloudy, 11-15°C

2025-02.daily_overview: On the first day after the quarrel, the couple fell into a cold war. She forced herself to keep the shop open, but her heart was heavy. She even lost focus while recommending clothes to a regular customer. In the afternoon, her best friend Li Meiling called to check on her. She couldn't help crying and pouring out her feelings. Her friend advised her to sit down with her husband and talk things through. The atmosphere at home dropped to freezing point. After work, her husband went straight into the study to avoid her, and their daughter became timid.

events.name: Daily store operations amid an ongoing cold war
events.description: Song Yajing arrived at the store at 9 as usual and made cappuccinos with the new coffee machine for two regular customers, earning their praise, but that did not lift the heaviness in her heart. At noon she sat alone behind the cash register, scrolling through last year's photos of her and Chen Zhiqiang on her phone, lost in thought, and didn't even react when the shop assistant Xiaomei called her to lunch. In the afternoon, she also miscounted the inventory several times.

events.name: Best friend Li Meiling called to comfort her and give advice.
events.description: Around 3 p.m., her best friend Li Meiling called. She had originally wanted to ask Song Yajing to go shopping over the weekend, but she heard something off in her voice and kept asking. Once she learned that the couple had quarreled, she advised: 'You two are both stubborn, but life has to go on. Take the initiative to make him a cup of coffee and admit you were wrong; it's not a big deal.' Song Yajing said tearfully that it wasn't about admitting fault, but about feeling misunderstood. Li Meiling suggested that she clearly explain her future plans for the store to him and stop keeping everything to herself. This phone call cheered Song Yajing up a bit.

events.name: Cold and silent family dinner and evening
events.description: In the evening, she closed the shop early and went home, cooking the satay noodles that Chen Zhiqiang loved. But her husband only said, 'Just put it there,' and carried it into the study without even looking at her. Their daughter tried to pull her father out for dinner, but Chen Zhiqiang brushed her off with 'I have to work overtime.' Song Yajing and her daughter ate in silence, and as she washed the dishes, tears fell into the sink again. In the evening, her daughter drew a picture of the whole family holding hands and showed it to her; she could only force a smile.

start_state.location: At home on Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Cold and bitter, not knowing how to break the deadlock.

end_state.mood: Lonely, self-blaming, yet still stubbornly believing she was not wrong

state.daily_exercise: From home to the shop, about 4,200 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy with overcast spells, temperature 10-14°C.

2025-02.daily_overview: Her husband was the first to break the silence, proposing to establish an electronic ledger for the shop and strictly control expenses. Although Song Yajing outwardly compromised and agreed, deep down she still felt that her husband didn't understand her career determination. After arriving at the shop in the morning, her lower back still felt stiff; she tried a few stretching movements to ease it slightly. In the afternoon, a customer was picky and said the coffee was weak; after patiently explaining, she felt low. In the evening, she took the initiative to show the ledger to her husband, and the relationship temporarily moved toward surface calm.

events.name: Chen Zhiqiang proactively communicated and established financial rules.
events.description: In the morning, Chen Zhiqiang, for the first time, didn't leave early for work; instead, he waited at the dining table. After Song Yajing got up, he said in a tired but calm voice: 'Since we've bought the coffee machine, we might as well use it. But from today on, every income and expense in the store must be clearly recorded, and any large expenditure must be discussed by both of us.' Song Yajing was silent for a while, then nodded and agreed, apologizing that she had been too hasty this time. The two of them rarely had such a quiet breakfast together.

events.name: While the store was open, she privately weighed her husband's request.
events.description: After arriving at the store, Song Yajing kept replaying her husband's words from that morning while tidying the clothing racks. She opened the memo app on her phone and noted down "set up an electronic ledger," but then, in a fit of pique, added, "He has no idea how hard it is to run a physical store these days." In the afternoon, while making a pour-over coffee for a customer, a picky customer said it tasted too weak and wasn't as good as Starbucks. She swallowed her hurt feelings and made another cup, her eyes slightly reddening as she turned away. Xiaomei noticed and took the initiative to attend to the other customers.

events.name: Took the initiative in the evening to reach out and show vulnerability.
events.description: After dinner, Song Yajing put the paper ledger she had just started using that day on the coffee table and said to her husband, 'I've started keeping accounts, take a look.' While Chen Zhiqiang was flipping through it, she quietly said her waist hurt a little. Her husband froze for a moment, silently got up, took a medicated patch from the medicine box, handed it to her, and said, 'Put it on, don't push yourself too hard.' This small gesture almost made Song Yajing cry. Although they didn't say much, the atmosphere softened a bit.

start_state.mood: Alert and tired, expecting another argument.

end_state.mood: Outwardly she accepted the compromise, but inwardly she still felt unwilling and wronged; yet the medicated patch on her lower back gave off a faint warmth.

state.daily_exercise: No intentional exercise; just did simple lower back stretches in the shop for 5 minutes.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, temperature 12-18°C, warm sunshine.

2025-02.daily_overview: To keep her promise, she began sorting through income and expense receipts. When her husband came home from work, he offered to help her build a spreadsheet, and their sharp confrontations turned into calm, numbers-based conversations as they finally laid the store's financial plight out on the table. When she saw that their working capital might only last a month, she finally realized how much pressure her impulse had caused and sincerely committed to controlling costs. The couple's relationship began to mend, with difficulty, through practical cooperation. In the evening, she suddenly felt dizzy, perhaps because of days of stress and lack of sleep.

events.name: During the day at the store, sorted out the income and expense vouchers for the past two months.
events.description: In the morning customer traffic was light, so Song Yajing sorted the crumpled purchase orders, receipts, and transfer screenshots from the drawer by date and spread them on the cash register counter. She also exported the monthly payment records from WeChat and Alipay. Using a calculator, she added up each item and found that several small expenses were completely unfamiliar to her; just the batch of decorative silk scarves she had impulsively stocked up on before the holiday alone tied up nearly 3,000 yuan. She wrote 'Must think for three days before buying' on a sticky note and stuck it on the calculator.

events.name: In the evening, the couple worked together to enter data into the electronic ledger.
events.description: At 8 p.m., after his daughter fell asleep, Chen Zhiqiang opened his laptop and sat down at the dining table. Song Yajing brought over a stack of receipts and records. The two entered January revenue, rent, merchandise costs, consumables, and that glaring coffee machine expense item by item into the spreadsheet. Chen Zhiqiang typed quickly, looking focused, occasionally asking about the purpose of a particular expense in a calm tone. When the spreadsheet automatically calculated that after fixed costs were deducted for February, only about 6,000 yuan of working capital remained, Song Yajing turned pale and nervously clasped her hands together.

events.name: Set the February budget and agree on a joint review
events.description: Facing the deficit warning, the two jointly set February budget red lines: employee salaries and rent/logistics were to be prioritized, personal living expenses drawn from the store were cut by one-third, and consumables such as coffee beans were rationed weekly. Song Yajing voluntarily promised not to buy any personal clothing in February and agreed to show the account book to her husband every Sunday evening. Chen Zhiqiang’s expression softened. He held her hand and said in a low voice, ‘It’s not about controlling you; I want to carry the burden with you.’ Song Yajing’s eyes reddened slightly and she nodded gently.

events.name: Late at night, contacted Master Chen to schedule a lesson.
events.description: Once the accounts were tallied, it was nearly 11 p.m., and Song Yajing still wasn't sleepy. She sent a WeChat message to her baking teacher, Master Chen, asking if he was free on Saturday to teach her pour-over coffee and tiramisu, saying she wanted to truly improve her skills and make the drinks corner more competitive. Master Chen replied quickly, and they agreed to meet at the studio at 2 p.m. on February 8. She then rummaged through the drawer and found her previously purchased baking notebook, and made a list of things to bring, such as an apron and a digital scale. When she stood up, she felt dizzy, so she held onto the chair back and closed her eyes for a moment.

start_state.mood: With a determination to make amends, she decided to take the bookkeeping seriously.

end_state.mood: Felt heavy after seeing the crisis clearly, but relieved by the partner's support, yet also gained worry about health.

state.daily_exercise: No, I felt dizzy in the afternoon and rested my head on the counter for a while.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, 13-20°C, warm and comfortable.

2025-02.daily_overview: It was a make-up workday. Her husband went to work in the morning, and she went to the store alone, strictly following her new habit of recording expenses. In the afternoon, she took her notebook to Master Chen's studio to focus on learning pour-over coffee and classic tiramisu, temporarily putting her financial worries aside and immersing herself in the orderly rhythm of baking. In the evening, on her way home, she stopped by the pharmacy to buy medicated oil, planning to apply a warm compress to her lower back before bed.

events.name: The store started implementing daily expense bookkeeping.
events.description: The first thing she did when she arrived at the shop in the morning was open the notes app on her phone, create a new note titled ‘February 8 Expenses’, and carefully enter the 28 yuan spent on a box of coffee filter papers and two bottles of milk. She also put a dedicated small notebook in the cash register drawer, asking herself and Xiao Mei to jot down every cash expense as they went. In the morning she received five customers and closed two sales. At noon she checked the accounts again, feeling a small sense of control.

events.name: Go to Master Chen's studio to learn coffee and dessert making.
events.description: At 2 p.m., she arrived on time at Master Chen's studio in Siming District. Master Chen first taught her the water flow control, cup warming, and blooming techniques for the pour-over kettle, and had her practice repeatedly until the water stream was thin and steady. Then he demonstrated the classic tiramisu, including how to whip the mascarpone mixture and how long to dip the ladyfingers in the coffee. Song Yajing took notes as she got hands-on, especially on the key point that the coffee should not be absorbed too much, otherwise the cake would collapse and turn mushy; she drew a star with emphasis. During a break, she mentioned her waist discomfort to Master Chen, and he taught her a few stretching moves. When she left, Master Chen encouraged her: 'Go make it for your family first. You'll get the hang of it after a few failures.'

events.name: Evening self-care and reflection
events.description: After returning home, her husband was helping their daughter with a drawing. Song Yajing took out the medicated oil she had bought at the pharmacy from her bag. Seeing this, her husband offered to give her a hot compress. With the patch on, she leaned back on the sofa and thought: maybe she really should slow down a little—her body is her own. Her husband handed her a glass of warm water, and the two exchanged a few occasional words. The atmosphere was rarely so peaceful.

start_state.mood: Forced herself to cheer up and shift her attention to studying.

end_state.mood: She felt fulfilled from the new skill, temporarily forgot real-world stress, and her body was somewhat soothed by the care.

state.daily_exercise: Round-trip walking plus standing work in the studio came to about 6,800 steps. In the evening, she did Master Chen’s 10-minute lower back stretching routine.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, 11–17°C, fog in the morning.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Sunday, she went alone to church to attend Mass. The sermon about 'do not worry about tomorrow' brought temporary comfort to her anxious heart, and a brief conversation with Aunt Lin, a fellow church member, after Mass made her feel understood. At the church entrance she met a new friend, Zhao Li, a freelancer in floral design, and they hit it off. In the afternoon, she took that peace home and practiced the tiramisu recipe she had just learned, treating failures as a necessary part of the journey.

events.name: Attend Sunday Mass at Siming Catholic Church
events.description: At 8:30 in the morning, Song Yajing put on a neat dark blue dress and walked to Siming Catholic Church. During the sermon, Father Wang Mingde interpreted the passage from the Gospel of Matthew about not worrying. The line 'Look at the birds of the sky...' made her nose tingle. She closed her eyes and prayed for family harmony and for the financial pressure on the shop, and her heart no longer felt as tight as it had in the past few days.

events.name: Talking with fellow parishioner Aunt Lin in the courtyard and meeting Zhao Li.
events.description: After Mass, in the church courtyard planted with bougainvillea, Aunt Lin Xiuying, an old parishioner, came over and took her hand, saying, 'You don't look well. Take life slowly. God has his own plans.' Song Yajing sighed softly and briefly mentioned that she had been upset with her husband over store expenses. Aunt Lin patted the back of her hand and said, 'Go home and brew him a cup of the coffee you just learned to make. Husband and wife never hold an overnight grudge.' At that moment, a young woman holding a bouquet walked past. Aunt Lin introduced her as Zhao Li, a newcomer to the parish who did floral design. Zhao Li smiled warmly and curiously asked about Song Yajing's store. When she heard it was on Zhongshan Road, she immediately said excitedly that she could come help arrange the window display. The three stood together and chatted for more than ten minutes. Before parting, Zhao Li said, 'When I have time, I'll definitely come visit your store.' Song Yajing smiled and nodded in agreement, and the two said goodbye.

events.name: Try making tiramisu at home
events.description: In the afternoon, her husband took their daughter to the supermarket, and Song Yajing stayed home alone to make tiramisu according to her notes. She strictly followed the steps to mix the egg yolk batter and whip the cream, carefully dipping each ladyfinger only halfway into the coffee liquid. Although the finished cake looked somewhat flat and the cocoa powder was sprinkled unevenly, its taste earned a thumbs-up from her daughter. She sent a photo of the cross-section to Master Chen for feedback and got the reply, "You've improved, keep practicing."

start_state.mood: Yearning to find inner peace.

end_state.mood: Calm and gentle, regaining some patience for life, with new expectations from meeting new friends.

state.daily_exercise: Walk to the church and back, about 4,500 steps

date_attribute.weather: Overcast with occasional light drizzle, 12-16℃

2025-02.daily_overview: Her mood fell from yesterday's warm peak. She plucked up her courage to tackle the difficult Opera cake, but because she was frequently interrupted by customer inquiries on her phone, she failed and wasted the entire tray of ingredients, causing her to break down in tears. Soon after, the old injury in her lower back flared up with piercing pain. She forced herself to return to the store, and Xiaomei, seeing how bad she looked, urged her to rest. That night, her daughter quietly mended her heart with a childlike drawing. Holding her daughter in her arms, she thought: at least I still have my family.

events.name: First attempt at making Opéra cake was a failure.
events.description: At 2 p.m., while there were no customers in the shop, she asked her employee Xiaomei to watch the store and rode her electric bike home to try making an Opéra cake. This French dessert, which needs eight stacked layers, is extremely elaborate: simmering ganache, brushing coffee syrup, spreading cream, and repeatedly chilling. But her phone kept ringing—sometimes a customer asked about sizes, sometimes Susan sent photos of new styles—and after frantically answering the phone several times, she would return to the cutting board only to find the butter over-melted or the syrup caramelized and burned. In the end, the baked cake layers severely collapsed, and the cream layer was mixed with coffee grounds, tasting bitter. Staring at the wasted whole block of President butter and Valrhona chocolate, she squatted helplessly on the kitchen floor tiles, covering her face and crying. When she stood up, she felt a sudden sharp pain in her lower back and had to lean against the wall for quite a while.

events.name: Xiaomei noticed something was wrong and comforted her.
events.description: At 4:30 in the afternoon, she returned to the store, pale-faced. Xiaomei could tell at a glance that something was wrong. Xiaomei poured a cup of hot water and handed it to her, saying, "Sister Jing, you should go home early today. I'll watch the store." Song Yajing shook her head. Xiaomei insisted, "You can't even straighten your back. I'll take care of the store. Just think of it as giving me a chance to practice." Song Yajing gratefully held Xiaomei's hand and finally closed the store early at 6 o'clock.

events.name: Her daughter Xuanxuan conveyed silent comfort through her painting.
events.description: At 9 p.m., Song Yajing, whose mood had sunk to rock bottom, bathed her daughter and returned to the bedroom to find a crayon drawing taped to the headboard: in the picture, a smiling person stood in front of a house hung with dresses, with "Mom, keep going" and a red heart scrawled beside it. Her daughter slipped in barefoot, hugged her leg, and said, "Mom, the cake is pretty, don't cry." Song Yajing hugged her tight, buried her face in her soft hair, and cried and laughed at the same time.

start_state.mood: Decided to challenge myself, with a bit of all-or-nothing excitement.

end_state.mood: The exhaustion after crying hard was interwoven with the candlelight-like warmth from her daughter, while the lower back pain still faintly lingered.

state.daily_exercise: Rode an electric bike back and forth between the store and home, with no extra exercise; lower back pain restricted her activity.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning clear, 14-20°C, south wind force 2

2025-02.daily_overview: A day of lifting herself out of a slump and being incredibly productive. She reviewed the reasons for the cake failure right after waking up, contacted Master Chen in the morning for advice, then entered an intense mode of purchasing and negotiations: a video call with Susan in Guangzhou to finalize the new spring styles, and a confirmation with Zheng Kai in Hangzhou about the trial sales cooperation for handcrafted tops. In the evening, she unexpectedly received a WeChat message from Zhao Li, who warmly asked if she needed help arranging the storefront. She gladly invited her to come on Saturday. Before closing the shop, she also gave Xiaomei the full picture and arranged next week's delivery schedule methodically. Though her lower back discomfort had not gone away, her spirits had returned.

events.name: Morning review failed and contacted Master Chen
events.description: During breakfast, she sent the photos and step-by-step notes of her failed opera cake to Master Chen and asked for advice by voice message. At 8:30, Master Chen replied and hit the nail on the head, pointing out that the ganache temperature was too high and the chilling time was insufficient, and suggested she use a timer and operate in stages. Based on the advice, Song Yajing made a 'Weekend Opera Cake Retry Checklist' and put it on the refrigerator door.

events.name: In the morning, organized sales data and prepared product selection materials.
events.description: After arriving at the store at 9 o'clock, she pulled up the sales software statistics for the past three months, highlighted the styles with the highest sell-through rate and the styles customers frequently asked about with a fluorescent marker, and organized them into her notebook. She found that macaron-colored shirts and waist-cinching dresses had the best data, so she decided to ask Susan specifically about these styles. Meanwhile, her lower back was still a bit stiff, so she stood up and walked around from time to time.

events.name: Had a video call with Susan, the supplier from Guangzhou, to select products and place an order
events.description: At 11 a.m., she connected with Susan via WeChat video. At her stall, Susan showed spring silk blouses and floral chiffon dresses one by one. Based on her notes, Song Yajing precisely selected 8 styles, specifically asking for stock in sizes S and M, and patiently cut out some larger sizes that might become dead stock. The two finally settled on a first order of 30 pieces at a supply price of 75 percent of retail, with delivery via SF Express within 48 hours. After ending the call, she immediately made an entry in the purchase ledger.

events.name: Contact Zheng Kai, a designer in Hangzhou, to finalize the trial-sale style.
events.description: At 3 p.m., she proactively contacted Zheng Kai on WeChat to ask in detail about the fabric composition, care instructions, and minimum order quantity of his batch of hand-embroidered silk tops. After confirming that it matched the store's target customers, she decisively ordered two pieces of each of two styles for trial sales, transferred a 450 yuan deposit via WeChat, and noted down 'arrival expected around February 15; can be displayed with flower arrangements.'

events.name: Discussed follow-up arrangements with Xiaomei and received an invitation from Zhao Li.
events.description: Before closing the shop at 5 p.m., Song Yajing showed Xiao Mei the confirmed delivery list and expected dates, and the two agreed to rearrange the display stand on Saturday morning. Just as they were talking, a WeChat message popped up from her florist friend Zhao Li, whom she had met at the church last time. Zhao Li wrote: 'Sister Jing, are you free this weekend? I want to visit your shop and design flower arrangements for the entrance. It would definitely look great for outfit photos!' Song Yajing replied in surprise: 'That's wonderful! I was just worrying about not having a backdrop for Saturday's shoot. You're a godsend!' The two immediately discussed the style and the needed flowers over a voice call.

start_state.mood: Determined to dispel the sense of frustration through action

end_state.location: In bed, her husband was already asleep
end_state.mood: Fulfilled by advancing multiple matters, a sense of control has returned, and looking forward to Saturday's photo shoot

state.daily_exercise: Kept walking around the store to organize stock, about 7,200 steps, with intermittent waist stretches.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, 15-22°C, bright moon

2025-02.daily_overview: On the Lantern Festival, she deliberately closed the store early and returned to her family role. The couple and their daughter made tangyuan in the kitchen and made rabbit lanterns out of old red envelopes. Although there was still a subtle distance because of past grievances, working together let a warm family feeling slowly flow. She turned the heartwarming moments into a short video and posted it to the community, unexpectedly receiving a lot of likes. With the caption "make life round," she quietly let out a sigh of relief.

events.name: Closed the shop early and walked home to prepare for the Lantern Festival.
events.description: At 4 p.m., Song Yajing put up a handwritten sign saying “the shop will close early at 17:00 for the Lantern Festival,” tidied up the storefront, and walked to the food market to buy freshly ground glutinous rice flour, sesame filling, and crushed peanuts. She also picked a few pink daisies at the flower shop at the entrance of the residential community. When she got home, her husband was tying a swing for their daughter on the balcony, and she put on an apron and started boiling water and preparing the ingredients.

events.name: The whole family works together to make sesame tangyuan.
events.description: The daughter brought over a small stool and stood on it at the kitchen counter. Song Yajing kneaded the dough into a smooth ball, while Chen Zhiqiang was in charge of rolling the sesame filling into small balls. The three divided the work: Song Yajing pinched off dough pieces, wrapped the filling, and sealed the edges, while her husband and daughter rolled the wrapped tangyuan in dry flour. The daughter made a strangely shaped bunny tangyuan, which made the couple burst out laughing at the same time — it was their first natural, relaxed laughter together after the quarrel.

events.name: Making simple rabbit-shaped lanterns from red envelopes
events.description: After eating the tangyuan she had made herself, Song Yajing brought out the red envelopes, transparent tape, and bamboo sticks saved up during the Spring Festival. Following a short video tutorial, she and her daughter folded, stapled, and strung them into a chubby red rabbit lantern. Chen Zhiqiang sat to the side, helping hand scissors and fix the lantern frame, occasionally unobtrusively brushing his wife's wrist. Their daughter ran around the living room carrying the lantern, light and shadows swaying throughout the room.

events.name: Shoot and post a Lantern Festival family vlog.
events.description: While her husband and daughter weren't paying attention, Song Yajing used her phone to capture a few impromptu clips of kneading dough, carrying lanterns, and eating tangyuan. During a break from washing dishes, she used editing software to stitch them into a 30-second short video, added a Hokkien nursery rhyme as background music, and posted it in the store community and her personal video channel with the caption, "No matter how busy business gets, keep life full and round #HappyLanternFestival." Soon, likes and comments such as "The boss is so warm-hearted" poured in from long-time customers. She leaned back on the sofa scrolling through them, with a slight smile curving at the corners of her eyes.

start_state.mood: Hopes to use the holiday to restore family harmony

end_state.mood: The warm afterglow remained, and the invisible ice between the couple had thinned a bit

state.daily_exercise: Walking to buy groceries and doing housework, about 5,600 steps

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, 13-19°C

2025-02.daily_overview: She calmed herself down and reviewed the week’s tasting data at the beverage corner. After brainstorming with Xiaomei, she decided to switch the free coffee to limited supply to control costs, and for the first time posted a preview in the customer group: “Complimentary pour-over coffee when you visit the store” to test the market response. In the afternoon, a regular customer brought a new friend, and she unexpectedly closed a high-priced item. Her business approach began to shift from emotional input to rational fine-tuning. Her waist still ached, but she felt she had a direction.

events.name: Organize and evaluate the data from the free tastings at the beverage corner
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing opened the daily expense records on her phone and calculated that over the past week, the free coffee had consumed about 210 yuan worth of coffee beans and milk products, bringing 12 new customers into the store, but only 4 of them actually placed orders. Regular customers generally liked the service, but it had limited effect on encouraging them to buy spring clothing. She summarized these scattered pieces of feedback in her notebook, frowning slightly.

events.name: Discuss and adjust beverage service strategy with Xiaomei
events.description: Taking advantage of the lunchtime lull with no customers, she pulled Xiaomei aside to sit down and discuss. Xiaomei thought the coffee was a highlight that attracted people to the store, but having it completely free was indeed costly. The two quickly agreed: keep the pour-over coffee experience, but limit free coffee to the first 10 customers each day; after that, anyone who wanted more would pay a cost price of 15 yuan. Song Yajing felt it was not yet the time to charge, so it would first serve as a traffic-driving hook.

events.name: Post a preview of limited free coffee in the customer WeChat group.
events.description: At 3 p.m., Song Yajing wrote a warm message and sent it to the store's WeChat group 'Yajing's Good Clothes Old Friends Group': 'To make your afternoon tea more enjoyable, from today on, the first 10 sisters to arrive at the store each day will be given a freshly brewed hand-drip coffee~' She then attached a close-up photo of the coffee machine and a smiling selfie. As soon as the message was sent, the group immediately became lively. Several regular customers replied 'We'll be there tomorrow!' and someone asked whether it could be paired with cookies. She laughingly replied to each one.

events.name: A regular customer brought a new customer, and a big order was closed.
events.description: Less than an hour after the announcement, regular customer Vivian came with a colleague. They took a liking to three early spring new arrivals at once, and the colleague also bought a suit and skirt, totaling over 2,000 yuan. Song Yajing, pleasantly surprised, gave them two extra cups of pour-over coffee. This unexpected income made her more confident in her limited-edition strategy.

start_state.mood: Put aside emotions and force herself to let the numbers speak.

end_state.mood: Feeling reassured about the direction after the strategy adjustment, with a small sense of accomplishment.

state.daily_exercise: No deliberate exercise; did a bit more walking around the store, about 5,000 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny during the day, light fog at night, temperature 15-23°C

2025-02.daily_overview: This Valentine's Day was full of conflict and concern. In the morning she unexpectedly received a call from her mother and learned that her father had formally sought medical treatment in Quanzhou and started wearing a hearing aid. After hanging up, she felt both relieved and saddened by her parents' aging. In the evening, her husband carefully arranged a candlelit dinner to try to completely warm up their relationship, but the resentment triggered by the pressure of the shop rent made her lose control and retort publicly, shattering the romance completely. Late at night, as she looked through their wedding album alone, she finally saw through tears how much fragile strength she had been forcing herself to muster, and vowed never to let her emotions hurt her family again.

events.name: Received a call from her mother and learned that her father had been diagnosed with a hearing condition
events.description: At 10 a.m., her mother Lin Xiuying called, her tone one of relief: her father Song Minghui had a hearing test today at Quanzhou First People's Hospital and was diagnosed with moderate-to-severe age-related hearing loss. He had been successfully fitted with hearing aids. At first they felt a little strange, but he could hear much more clearly. Song Yajing's heart, which had been tight for a long time, loosened halfway. Over the phone, she told her father to take his time adjusting and not to be too sparing with batteries. After hanging up, she stared blankly at the mannequin in the window dressed in new clothes, thinking that her parents were truly getting old.

events.name: In the evening, went to a candlelit dinner at a Western restaurant as planned.
events.description: At 6 p.m., she left the store in Xiao Mei's care, hurried home to change into a wine-red knit dress, and drove with Chen Zhiqiang to a booked Western restaurant in Siming District. They didn't talk much along the way; she kept turning her head to watch the flickering festive lights outside the window. The roses and candlelight inside the restaurant were elegantly arranged. Chen Zhiqiang took her hand and said, 'You've worked hard during this period. I just want you to be well—don't push yourself too hard.'

events.name: Stress explosion led to losing control at dinner, breaking up, and going home
events.description: When she heard 'Don't push yourself too hard,' what appeared in Song Yajing's mind was the balance alert in her mobile banking app and next month's shop rent payment notice. She abruptly pulled her hand back and retorted in a low, unrestrained voice: 'You don't understand. The rent is due soon. If I don't fight, who will bear it for me?' After she said that, she saw the light in her husband's eyes dim. Chen Zhiqiang paid the bill in silence, and they drove home without a word the whole way. The silence in the car was more suffocating than any argument.

events.name: Late at night, I sat alone, flipped through the wedding album, and cried in self-reflection.
events.description: It was nearly 10 p.m. when they got home. The two washed up separately, and Chen Zhiqiang lay down with his back to her. Song Yajing was not sleepy at all. She quietly went to the living room and dug out the 2015 wedding album from the back of a drawer. Seeing herself in the simple wedding dress, held by her husband and smiling without a trace of gloom, and comparing it with the future of shop rent and loans and the rift between husband and wife, tears fell one by one onto the plastic cover. She prayed softly, "Lord, help me." She sat there until almost 2 a.m., then returned to bed with a heart full of guilt and a determination to change. She gently hugged her husband from behind. He stiffened slightly, said nothing, but did not move away.

start_state.mood: Hoping the dinner would repair the relationship, she also felt a lingering worry about her father's hearing problem.

end_state.location: In bed, close against her husband's back
end_state.mood: Guilt, self-pity, and confusion intermingled, but a single thought of repentance brought a glimmer of light.

state.daily_exercise: None

date_attribute.weather: Sunny to partly cloudy, temperature 14-21°C, plenty of sunlight

2025-02.daily_overview: Drowsy from lack of sleep, she summoned her energy and invited her florist friend Zhao Li to help. They set up a fresh dried-flower photo area in a corner of the store, and she served as her own model to shoot several short videos of early-spring workwear outfits. Her back pain worsened after changing clothes repeatedly, but she gritted her teeth and carried on. That evening, after editing and publishing, she unexpectedly got a wave of online bookings. Tiredly replying to messages, she felt a long-missed sense of real sales. Before bed, her husband silently handed her a glass of warm milk, and their eyes briefly met, as if testing a new beginning.

events.name: Contacted friend Zhao Li and set up the floral photography background.
events.description: At 10:30 a.m., Song Yajing applied an ice pack to her puffy eyelids and sent a voice message on WeChat to Zhao Li, a friend she knew from church. Zhao Li soon arrived at the shop with a large bunch of eucalyptus leaves, dried roses, and kraft paper. The two of them moved aside the racks outside the fitting room, built a rustic pastoral backdrop with hemp rope and a wooden ladder, and decorated it with several rattan baskets Song Yajing had brought from home. The photos came out fresh and natural. Zhao Li also thoughtfully applied a heat patch to her waist.

events.name: Try on spring clothing and film a short video of early-spring work outfits.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Song Yajing put on light makeup and changed into the six spring outfits she had prepared: a mint-green blazer with white wide-leg pants, a floral-print shirt with a khaki skirt, and so on. With the help of Zhao Li and Xiaomei, she kept adjusting the lighting and hem details, introducing fabrics and styling ideas to the phone camera. Several collars kept curling up, and Zhao Li cleverly fixed them with pins from behind. Bending down repeatedly to change shoes and straighten skirts worsened her lower back pain, and a thin sweat broke out on her forehead, but she still persisted in shooting all the planned looks.

events.name: In the evening, edit and publish videos and process online orders.
events.description: After closing the shop and going home, she put her daughter to sleep, then sat at the dining table with earphones on to edit the footage. She added subtitles and light music and cut it into a short video called “One-Week Commute Outfits in Early Spring.” At 10 p.m., she posted it to the customer WeChat group and her WeChat Channels account as planned. The caption emphasized that spring clothing was available for limited-time pre-order at 5% off. More than a dozen WeChat messages popped up right away: “Save the whole third outfit for me!” “Do you have the misty blue shirt in size L?” Song Yajing was wide awake. Holding the milk her husband had just warmed, she replied to each message one by one and noted the sizes and advance payments in her ordering notebook.

events.name: Her husband handed her milk as a silent gesture of goodwill.
events.description: At midnight, she was busy at the dining table, with her back and waist stiff from work. Chen Zhiqiang quietly came out of the bedroom, placed a cup of hot milk beside her, and said softly, "Go to bed early." He turned and went back without waiting for a reply. Song Yajing held the cup and felt the warmth of the milk spread to her heart. She decided to have a good talk with her husband tomorrow.

start_state.mood: Physically exhausted but forced herself to work to escape her emotions.

end_state.location: At the dining table, tidying up charging cables before heading back to the bedroom.
end_state.mood: Skin tired but heart faintly lit, as online orders gave her a bit more confidence, and the relationship with her husband seemed to be showing signs of thawing.

2025-02.daily_overview: With a faint hope that the marital relationship would ease, Song Yajing went to church. An unexpected encounter with her new friend Zhao Li lifted her spirits. In the afternoon, Zhao Li's proactive offer of a floral arrangement collaboration gave her a long-missed sense of support, and the family atmosphere also loosened a little when she shared the good news.

events.name: Going to church alone to attend Mass
events.description: On Sunday morning, Song Yajing got up quietly, prepared a simple breakfast for her husband and daughter, then took the bus alone to Xiamen Siming Catholic Church to attend Mass. Because she had been in a cold war with her husband over the coffee machine investment recently, and the shop's working capital was tight, she felt busy and anxious inside, and urgently needed to seek inner peace through faith and a quiet environment. During Mass she prayed calmly, and her mood eased a little.

events.name: Ran into Zhao Li in the church courtyard and instantly hit it off.
events.description: After Mass ended, she met Zhao Li in the courtyard. Zhao Li was playing by the flowerbed with her daughter. The two chatted like old friends. Zhao Li expressed concern about her relationship with her husband and the business at her shop. Song Yajing gave a wry smile and briefly mentioned the recent pressure. Zhao Li comforted her, saying that when she first started floristry she had also encountered many difficulties, and that everything would get better. Song Yajing felt a warm surge in her heart.

events.name: Return home at noon to have lunch with family and briefly share.
events.description: Song Yajing returned home on Hubin South Road at noon; her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Xuanxuan were already waiting at home. She quickly made three dishes and a soup. During the meal, she cautiously mentioned that she had met a florist from the same hometown at the church. Though her husband's attitude remained somewhat cold, he did respond, "It's nice to have another friend." Their daughter Xuanxuan excitedly showed off her drawing, and the family atmosphere loosened slightly amid the silence.

events.name: In the afternoon, took a relaxing walk with my daughter around the neighborhood.
events.description: In the afternoon, sunlight broke through the clouds. Song Yajing took Xuanxuan for a walk in the community garden, watching her daughter chase butterflies and greet Auntie Zhang, a neighbor. Auntie Zhang asked with concern about the store's business, and she could only smile wryly and say, 'I'm slowly adjusting.' The half-hour walk briefly pulled her away from her anxiety. Seeing her daughter so carefree, she silently cheered herself on.

events.name: In the evening, Zhao Li took the initiative to suggest a window display makeover
events.description: After dinner, Song Yajing received several floral arrangement sketches from Zhao Li, along with a message: “Sister Jing, I saw that the spring clothing in your store has a fresh style. I’ve designed a few dried flower decorations. Would you like to try them? I’ll only charge the cost price, hoping to make your window display more attractive and maybe bring in some new customers.” Song Yajing looked at the detailed design drawings, was deeply moved, and immediately replied: “That’s great! You’re really a godsend! How about coming to the store tomorrow morning?” The two excitedly finalized their plan to meet the next day.

start_state.mood: Slightly hopeful but still anxious and uneasy

2025-02.daily_overview: The new week began with the fragrance of flowers. In the morning, Zhao Li arrived at the shop with floral materials as promised. While chatting, the two completed the window display makeover, and the ordinary window suddenly gave off a fresh and refined atmosphere. Song Yajing felt a long-lost sense of creativity and support during the collaboration. Afterwards, she actively contacted important customers to prepare for the next afternoon's tea party, and the shop's pace of business showed new hope amid the busyness.

events.name: Went to the store early in the morning to prepare for opening and welcome Zhao Li
events.description: Song Yajing arrived at Shop No. 36 on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street at 8:30 a.m. She first checked the leftover finishing work from yesterday, then cleaned the storefront and adjusted the placement of new products. After the shop assistant Xiaomei arrived on time, the two briefly discussed the day's precautions. Around 9:30, Zhao Li arrived carrying two large bags of dried flowers and green plants; Song Yajing hurried over to take the flowers and thanked her repeatedly.

events.name: Completed the window floral display makeover in collaboration with Zhao Li.
events.description: Zhao Li selected eucalyptus leaves, cotton, dried lavender, and faux green plants based on the store's overall light-toned style, and worked together with Song Yajing. Song Yajing moved the mannequins and cleaned the glass, while Zhao Li skillfully built a tiered display, arranging the floral materials gracefully among the clothing. The two cooperated well, and the whole makeover took about an hour and a half. When finished, the window display looked fresh and natural, attracting many passersby to stop and look.

events.name: Took a group photo as a memento and formally established the flower arrangement collaboration.
events.description: After the window display renovation was completed, Song Yajing used her phone to take a few group photos of the two of them with the window display. Zhao Li also took close-up shots for her studio's promotion. During their conversation, Zhao Li agreed to provide free floral arrangement support for the store's future online new-product shoots, and Song Yajing promised to recommend Zhao Li's flower studio in her Moments and community groups. The two established a long-term mutually beneficial partnership through a verbal agreement.

events.name: Contacting regular customers one by one to send out afternoon tea party invitations
events.description: After seeing Zhao Li off, Song Yajing took advantage of the still-light morning customer traffic and opened WeChat to contact one by one the four regular customers with the highest spending over the past year, as well as the regular customer Vivian. She told them in detail that a small afternoon tea party would be held at the shop the next afternoon, where she would personally make tiramisu and fruit tea to treat them, and asked about their taste preferences and attendance times. All five customers happily agreed.

events.name: Open normally in the afternoon and manage the drinks corner at scheduled times.
events.description: Light drizzle in the afternoon; foot traffic on the pedestrian street decreased slightly. Song Yajing and Xiaomei took turns serving customers while, as previously decided, offering limited free pour-over coffee. She posted a message in the community group: "Try on clothes in the store and get a free pour-over coffee." Two regular customers saw it and came specially. During free moments, she began thinking about tomorrow's tiramisu decoration style.

events.name: After closing the store, recorded the accounts and had a brief exchange with her husband.
events.description: The shop closed at 8 p.m. Song Yajing sorted out the cash flow and entered it into the electronic ledger, and found that today's turnover was mediocre because it was not a rest day. After getting home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang was helping their daughter learn to read. While changing shoes, she briefly mentioned the cooperation with the florist. Her husband reminded her, “Business is business, but costs need to be calculated clearly.” His tone still felt a little distant, but there was no longer any rancor.

start_state.location: Home at No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District.
start_state.mood: Anticipation mixed with slight nervousness, holding hope for the new collaboration
