2025-02.daily_overview: Today was the day Song Yajing independently planned a VIP customer retention event for the first time. She bought ingredients early in the morning and baked by hand. In the afternoon, with carefully prepared refreshments, she gained valuable suggestions and goodwill from customers. The joy of the event's success was soon replaced by vulnerable confessions during an evening video call with her mother. Her mother's warm comfort and the recipe for savory rice dumplings became an outlet for her emotions, and her mood clearly improved when she wrote down the recipe late at night.

events.name: Went to the fresh supermarket in the morning to buy baking ingredients
events.description: After taking her daughter to kindergarten in the morning, Song Yajing went directly to a large nearby fresh food supermarket. Following a pre-made list, she carefully selected mascarpone cheese, ladyfingers, concentrated espresso, and cocoa powder for making tiramisu, as well as fresh strawberries, lemons, passion fruit, and honey for preparing fruit tea. She also bought a small bunch of flowers to decorate the table.

events.name: Carefully making tiramisu and fruit tea in the store's back kitchen
events.description: After finishing the shopping, Song Yajing returned to the store, put on an apron, and started making it on the small counter in the back kitchen. Following a classic recipe she had saved online, she first whipped the cheese batter, then layered biscuits and cheese mixture alternately, and finally sprinkled cocoa powder on top and put it in the refrigerator to set. At the same time, she brewed a pot of mixed fruit tea, sweetened it with honey, and let it cool. Several times during the process, customers came into the store, and Xiaomei handled them at the front, allowing her to focus on baking.

events.name: Held a small afternoon tea party for five VIP regular customers.
events.description: At 2:30 in the afternoon, five well-dressed regular customers (including the frequent customer Vivian) arrived as promised. Song Yajing put two glass tables together, spread a light-colored tablecloth, and set out tiramisu just out of the fridge and fruit tea in crystal glasses. Everyone chatted while eating, and the atmosphere was relaxed. She took the opportunity to ask about their expectations for the spring new arrivals. Vivian suggested that the store could add some delicate earrings and scarves as accessories. Song Yajing carefully noted it down in her phone memo.

events.name: Send a 20%-off experience voucher and post the event on WeChat Moments.
events.description: As the tea party drew to a close, Song Yajing handed each guest a handwritten 20% off experience voucher for the spring new products, thanking them for their long-term support. After the guests left the store, she edited the close-up photos of the tea refreshments, the group photos with the guests, and the window flower arrangement pictures she had taken earlier, with the caption “Thank you to my dearest VIPs, your suggestions are the best nourishment for the shop,” and posted it on WeChat Moments. Within less than an hour, it received dozens of likes and positive comments.

events.name: After closing the store and going home at night, she proactively made a video call to her mother.
events.description: After closing the shop at 9 PM and going home, she saw her husband working overtime in the study and their daughter already asleep, put to bed by him. Song Yajing poured herself a glass of warm water, sat on the living room sofa, hesitated for a moment, then made a video call to her mother, Lin Xiuying.

events.name: Video call with mother to vent stress and receive comfort.
events.description: As soon as the video call connected, her mother immediately noticed the tiredness in her eyes. Song Yajing could no longer hold it in and poured out her argument with her husband after impulsively investing in a coffee machine, the ruined Valentine's Day dinner, and her panic over the shop's cash flow. Her mother comforted her softly in Hokkien: “When husband and wife are of one mind, they can cut through metal. You and Zhiqiang both want what is best for this family; if you talk it through slowly, you will work it out.” Then she deliberately changed the subject and taught her the recipe for Hokkien meat zongzi by heart, from choosing glutinous rice and stir-frying the filling to tying the dumplings, explaining every step in detail, and urged her, “Cooking can calm the mind.” The call lasted nearly an hour.

events.name: Wrote down the recipe for savory rice dumplings and decided to try making them tomorrow.
events.description: After hanging up, Song Yajing's eyes were slightly red but there was a smile on her lips. She immediately organized her mother's meat zongzi recipe from beginning to end in her phone's memo. She decided to buy the ingredients early the next morning and try making zongzi by hand using the method from her hometown, using focused work to release the pressure. After sorting out her thoughts, she quietly returned to the bedroom, her mood clearly much better.

start_state.location: Home at No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District.
start_state.mood: Excited and nervous about the afternoon tea party.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District
end_state.mood: Warmed by motherly love, she suddenly felt uplifted and gained the strength to keep going.

2025-02.daily_overview: Song Yajing turned the accessory suggestions she got at the tea party into action. In the morning, she went to the wholesale market to select samples and enjoyed the fun of picking products. In the afternoon, she returned to the shop and continued working on the floral collaboration idea with Zhao Li. In the evening, she tried making Minnan meat zongzi for the first time using her mother's recipe. Although her technique was unfamiliar, the rich aroma of the zongzi made her feel as if she were back in the kitchen of her hometown in Quanzhou, and the process was unexpectedly healing. At night, her daughter suddenly had an upset stomach, and she took care of her all night, barely sleeping.

events.name: Go to the small commodities wholesale market to look for accessory samples.
events.description: At ten in the morning, Song Yajing went alone to the small commodities wholesale market in Siming District. Following the suggestions of Vivian and others, she made a point of visiting several accessory wholesale shops. She carefully picked out a few silk square scarves, a couple of pairs of vintage-style earrings, and a wide-brimmed straw hat that suited the store's style, talked with the shop owners about wholesale prices for small batches, and used her phone to photograph sample images and price quotes, planning to make the final selection after returning to the store.

events.name: After returning to the shop, communicated with Zhao Li via WeChat about combining flower arrangements with accessories.
events.description: In the afternoon at the store, Song Yajing paired some of the selected accessories with the dried flowers in the display window to test the effect and sent the photos to Zhao Li for feedback. Zhao Li quickly replied that both the straw hat and the silk scarf could be used as props for flower arrangement photography, and suggested trying the theme of 'Flowers and Accessories' for the next new-product shoot. Song Yajing thought the idea was great, and the two agreed to adopt this style for the shoot next week.

events.name: In the evening, tried making Minnan-style meat zongzi for the first time in the shop's back kitchen
events.description: Inspired by yesterday's video call with her mother, Song Yajing took advantage of the evening lull in customer traffic, and while Xiao Mei helped watch the store, she tried making Minnan meat zongzi using a rice cooker in the shop's back kitchen, following a recipe from her phone memo. She clumsily washed the bamboo leaves, soaked the glutinous rice, and stir-fried the pork belly and shiitake mushrooms. The zongzi she wrapped came out lopsided, but after nearly two hours of steaming, the aroma of zongzi filled the air. She couldn't help tasting one first. The flavor still fell short of her mother's, but it felt thoroughly familiar.

events.name: Bring the zongzi home to share with her husband and daughter.
events.description: At 7:30 p.m., Song Yajing closed the store early and packed some freshly cooked zongzi in an insulated container to bring home. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Xuanxuan were pleasantly surprised to see the zongzi. Chen Zhiqiang took a bite, smiled a rare smile and said, 'It tastes like home.' Xuanxuan also held up half a zongzi and said it was delicious. The little zongzi seemed to bring a bit more warmth to the couple, and after dinner Chen Zhiqiang voluntarily cleaned up the dishes.

events.name: Daughter vomited in the middle of the night; provided emergency care and called the family doctor
events.description: Around 2 a.m., Xuanxuan suddenly woke up crying and vomited in bed. Song Yajing got up in a panic and cleaned up with Chen Zhiqiang, and found that their daughter also had a low fever. She immediately called the family doctor, Wang Mingyuan. Following his guidance, she gave Xuanxuan electrolyte water and monitored her temperature. The couple took turns holding and comforting their daughter, and her condition did not stabilize until dawn.

start_state.location: Home at No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District.
start_state.mood: With her mother's support yesterday, she is full of motivation today.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District
end_state.mood: Anxious and exhausted due to her daughter's sudden discomfort, but the success of the zongzi brought some comfort.

2025-02.daily_overview: The store business began to find its rhythm. Song Yajing was busy packing and shipping orders and reviewing marketing results early in the morning, and communication with her supplier Susan also settled the spring clothing restock. But the efficiency of the day did not extend into the night: while she was telling her daughter a bedtime story, she received a call from Liu Fang, a primary school classmate, and the differences of living in different cities brought a slight sense of estrangement. She tried to find a moment to herself in a novel, but because she had been short on sleep for days, she fell asleep on the sofa.

events.name: Went to the shop in the morning to handle order packing and short-video review.
events.description: Song Yajing arrived at the store at 8:40. She first opened her phone to check the engagement data of last night's spring clothing short videos in the community, and found that views had increased compared with last time, with a dozen customers asking about prices and sizes in the comments. She checked, ironed, and packed the pre-ordered new spring styles one by one, and contacted the regular delivery courier to pick up the packages. At the same time, she noticed that only two pieces of a popular dress style remained in stock, so she immediately messaged her supplier Susan on WeChat to place a rush order. Susan replied that the same fabric was in short supply and suggested replacing it with a new style made of a similar fabric. Yajing decided to take a few pieces of each to test sales.

events.name: In the afternoon, she ran the shop and talked with regular customer Vivian.
events.description: In the afternoon, the shop received several waves of passersby. Xiaomei handled the reception, while Song Yajing sorted through the customer preference notes collected over the past two days behind the cash register. Vivian, a regular customer, stopped by the shop after work, tried on several newly arrived accessories, bought a silk scarf on the spot, and praised Song Yajing for her strong execution. Song Yajing happily went on to share the idea of a possible collaboration with floral styling, and Vivian kept saying she looked forward to it.

events.name: While telling her daughter a bedtime story in the evening, she received a call from Liu Fang.
events.description: Around eight in the evening, Song Yajing was in her daughter Xuanxuan's bedroom, leaning against the headboard and reading a picture book to her, when her phone suddenly rang. It was Liu Fang, her primary school classmate from Shenzhen. She let Xuanxuan look at the book by herself and answered the call. Liu Fang said excitedly that she had just found their primary school graduation photo and suddenly missed her a lot. The two chatted about childhood anecdotes, laughing continuously. But when Liu Fang talked about how busy and lonely she felt working at a big tech company, Song Yajing tried to bring up the pressure of starting her own business and the friction with her husband. Liu Fang's reply, however, seemed superficial; she merely said, "It's so free to be your own boss," and Song Yajing immediately felt a sense of being misunderstood and disappointed. The call ended after about half an hour.

events.name: Tried to read a book to find peace but fell asleep from exhaustion.
events.description: After hanging up, Song Yajing felt empty inside. She tiptoed to the study, took from the bookshelf the Yi Shu novel she had bought six months earlier and never unwrapped. She had only flipped through two pages when drowsiness washed over her like a tide. Several days of insufficient sleep and the previous night's ordeal made her fall asleep on the sofa without realizing it. It wasn't until her husband got up in the middle of the night and found her that he woke her and led her back to bed.

Then she and store clerk Xiaomei ironed and displayed several sample garments that had arrived the night before, and adjusted the display order.

events.name: Agreed with Zhao Li on preliminary ideas for next week's flower arrangement photography.
events.description: In her spare time, Song Yajing further refined the "Flowers and Accessories" theme she had discussed with Zhao Li the day before, and finalized a preliminary plan with Zhao Li via WeChat voice messages: once the new accessories arrive next Wednesday, they would use the backdrop at Zhao Li's studio, with Zhao Li providing the floral materials, and shoot a set of styled photos pairing silk scarves with dried flowers and straw hats with wildflowers for community promotion. Zhao Li readily agreed and suggested that they also talk about the possibility of a long-term collaboration then.

events.name: Initiate contact with best friend Li Meiling to arrange weekend afternoon tea
events.description: In the afternoon, while the shop was quiet, Song Yajing sent a WeChat message to her best friend Li Meiling: "Meiling, lately I've been overwhelmed by the shop and Xuanxuan's schooling. Do you have time on Saturday afternoon? Let's have tea at the usual place and vent." Li Meiling quickly replied with two hugging emojis and agreed to meet at 2 p.m. on Saturday at "Yiyu Coffee," their usual place near Zhongshan Road. Song Yajing felt relieved.

events.name: In the evening, after returning home, she briefly discussed school choice with her husband and searched for school district information
events.description: When I got home in the evening, Chen Zhiqiang, for once, didn't work overtime, and the family of three had dinner together. After dinner, Song Yajing brought up that Li Meiling had said the pre-registration for the transition from kindergarten to primary school might start in early March, and she felt very uncertain. Chen Zhiqiang put down his phone and said seriously, "This weekend, let's first look up information on Siming District Experimental Primary School and the Foreign Language School Affiliated Primary School online, and then ask people who have gone through it." Her husband's clear stance made her feel a little more grounded, and the two of them browsed the school district divisions and past policies together at the computer.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Saturday morning, Song Yajing was busy at the shop as usual. In the afternoon, she met her close friend Li Meiling at a café as planned. The two-hour heart-to-heart talk released her pent-up stress. More importantly, Li Meiling, as a primary school teacher, reminded her of the urgency of registering for the transition from kindergarten to primary school. After returning home, she struck while the iron was hot, proactively talked with her husband, and looked up policies online. The family's attention began to officially shift toward choosing a school for their daughter. In the evening, she relaxed by browsing photos on her phone and went to bed a little later than usual.

events.name: Go to the store in the morning to handle the weekend business and brief Xiaomei
events.description: Even though it was Saturday, Song Yajing habitually arrived at the store at nine, opened up, organized the goods, and attached handwritten price tags to the newly arrived accessories. She told Xiaomei that she had to go out this afternoon and asked her to take messages if any regular customers came looking for her. Around ten, a few young shoppers came in, and she recommended a newly arrived silk scarf to one of them, who happily bought it.

events.name: Went to a café in the afternoon to meet Li Meiling and pour out her heart
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Song Yajing arrived at Yiyu Café on time. Li Meiling had already ordered a hot latte for her. The two sat by the window, and Song Yajing poured out all her pent-up worries: the fierce argument with her husband after investing in the coffee machine, the hurtful words spoken at the Valentine's Day dinner, the difficulty of trying to transform the shop, and her worry about whether her daughter would successfully get into the elementary school of her choice. After listening, Li Meiling patted the back of her hand and seriously reminded her, "Online pre-registration for primary school admission in Siming District usually starts in early March. You need to prepare the documents now, such as the property ownership certificate and the household registration booklet. Don't just worry; take action first." She also comforted her, "You've already been very strong to have lasted four years on Zhongshan Road. Even though Zhiqiang argues with you, look, isn't he helping you now? Having the whole family together is a blessing."

events.name: Bid farewell to Li Meiling and savor the conversation.
events.description: At 4:30 they said goodbye at the entrance of the café. Li Meiling still had to rush to school to prepare for next week's open class. Song Yajing slowly walked home along Zhongshan Road, repeatedly mulling over Li Meiling's reminder about the pre-registration time. She felt a deep sense of urgency, but at the same time, she felt much lighter because she had gotten everything off her chest.

events.name: After returning home, I communicated gently with my husband and looked up the registration policy.
events.description: After dinner, Song Yajing proactively sat down next to her husband Chen Zhiqiang and told him what Li Meiling had said. The two rarely discussed things so calmly. Chen Zhiqiang suggested she first look it up online, so Song Yajing opened the computer and found the previous enrollment notices from Siming District Education Bureau. She checked the requirements one by one, such as the "two consistencies" (household registration and property ownership consistent), and began listing the materials they needed to prepare. Seeing how serious she was, her husband said, "Tomorrow morning I'll first take you and Xuanxuan to the park to relax, and when we come back we'll sort it out together." Song Yajing felt warm at heart when she heard this.

events.name: Before bed, scrolled through phone photos and recalled the journey of opening the shop.
events.description: In the still of the night, Song Yajing leaned against the headboard and scrolled through the photos on her phone, from the decoration photos of the store's early days to group photos with customers during last year's busy season. She swiped through them one by one, reflecting on the hardships and rewards of running her own business. This brief moment of nostalgia strengthened her resolve to make it through the difficult times, and before she knew it, it was almost midnight.

2025-02.daily_overview: This was the warmest family day in days. Song Yajing's carefully planned park outing let the family of three rediscover laughter on the sunny lawn, and the rift between the couple was further healed through cooperation in flying kites and feeding pigeons. However, after returning home in the afternoon, in-depth research into enrollment policies brought new anxiety—the household registration residency requirements of some popular primary schools made their daughter's admission prospects look grim. The couple then decided to immediately start preparing documents and consulting schools. In the evening, after talking it over, they watched an episode of a light-hearted short drama together, which eased their anxiety somewhat. Song Yajing also tried simple bedtime stretching for the first time to relieve the back soreness that had built up over the past few days.

events.name: Getting up early to prepare outdoor gear and wake the family.
events.description: At seven thirty in the morning, Song Yajing quietly got up, took her daughter's small kite out of the storage room, and prepared a small bag of pigeon feed, a few bottles of mineral water, and a box of cut fruit, putting them in her backpack. Then she walked to the bedroom, gently shook her husband awake, and went to the children's room to pick up Xuanxuan, who was still lying in bed, announcing that they would go to Zhongshan Park to fly kites and feed pigeons. Xuanxuan immediately lost all sign of sleepiness and clapped happily.

events.name: The family went to the lawn at Zhongshan Park to fly kites.
events.description: The family of three walked and took a short bus ride to Zhongshan Park and headed straight to the large lawn. Chen Zhiqiang first untangled the string of Xuanxuan's butterfly kite, then patiently taught her how to run against the wind and let out and reel in the line. Xuanxuan ran across the grass pulling the kite, shrieking with joy. Once the kite took off and wobbled in the air, Song Yajing took out her phone and took a burst of photos to capture the bright smiles of father and daughter.

events.name: At Pigeon Square, feeding the pigeons was a joy
events.description: After flying the kite, the three of them moved to Pigeon Square. Xuanxuan put pigeon feed in her palm, squatted down, and carefully called the pigeons. A flock of white pigeons cooed and gathered around to peck at the food, and she giggled without stopping. Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang stood side by side not far away, watching their daughter, both wearing rare relaxed smiles.

events.name: The couple chatted casually on a bench, strengthening their bond.
events.description: While Xuanxuan chased the flock of pigeons, the couple found a bench under the shade of a tree and sat down side by side. Song Yajing talked about how their daughter had looked while learning to fly a kite just then, and Chen Zhiqiang mentioned that the projects at his company had been less busy lately. The conversation naturally turned to the upcoming elementary school enrollment. Though the topic was serious, their tone was warm and understanding, and the relaxed park setting once again dissolved the stiffness left from the previous cold war.

events.name: Return home to rest after the event and look up admissions policies
events.description: At noon, the family returned home, and Xuanxuan was so tired that she fell asleep as soon as her head hit the pillow. Song Yajing, however, didn't take a rest. She sat down at the computer and carefully reviewed the 2025 primary school enrollment policy issued by the Siming District Education Bureau. She found that among the two schools she favored, Siming Experimental Primary School explicitly required that school-age children's household registration be in place for at least one full year. Xuanxuan's registration had not yet been in place for a year, which made her heart sink and her stress soar.

events.name: In the evening, had a serious discussion with her husband and finalized the preparation plan.
events.description: At dinner, Song Yajing looked a little somber. Chen Zhiqiang noticed and asked what was wrong. She told him about the household registration residency requirement she had found out about, and they both fell silent. After thinking for a moment, Chen Zhiqiang said, 'There's no use rushing. Let's first prepare the documents one by one according to the checklist. In the next few days, I'll take another half day off, and we'll go directly to the Experimental Primary School admissions office to ask if there is any leeway.' Song Yajing nodded in agreement and decided to start sorting out the certificates tomorrow. It was nearly ten o'clock after their discussion, and both felt tense. To lighten the mood, Song Yajing suggested watching an episode of a lighthearted short drama. They leaned against the sofa, not saying much, but sitting side by side eased their anxiety quite a bit.

events.name: Do simple stretches before bed to relieve lower back soreness.
events.description: After days of rushing around and standing for long periods, her lower back ached noticeably. Before going to bed, Song Yajing laid a yoga mat on the bedroom floor, searched Baidu for several stretching exercises to relieve back pain, and tried them for about 10 minutes. She felt her muscles relax a lot and decided to keep doing this as much as possible in the future.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District
end_state.mood: The warming of family relationships brought comfort; the daughter's school enrollment issue remained a source of stress, but watching a drama together in the evening eased the anxiety somewhat.

2025-02.daily_overview: Song Yajing focused on organizing her daughter's school enrollment materials from early morning, carefully checking every document and silently reviewing every detail. At the same time, store operations and the cooperation with Zhao Li were also advancing steadily: she used the lunch break to call the target primary school for information and got preliminary details. Although there were no major ups and downs today, the orderly progress made her feel her sense of control gradually returning. At night, she had trouble falling asleep due to school-choice anxiety and tossed and turned until late.

events.name: In the morning, organize the documents and materials required for school enrollment at home.
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing did not rush to the shop. Instead, she took out all the important documents from home: the property ownership certificate, the family household register, the marriage certificate, her daughter's birth medical certificate, vaccination certificate, and so on, checking each one to make sure the information was complete. She noticed that the handwriting on the page listing her native place in the household register was somewhat blurry. Worried that it might affect the review, she took a photo with her phone and planned to consult the school.

events.name: Called the admissions office of Siming District Experimental Primary School for an initial consultation.
events.description: At around ten o'clock, Song Yajing dialed the admissions office of Siming District Experimental Primary School, and a female teacher answered. She politely asked about the specific implementation criteria in the 2025 enrollment policy regarding the time of household registration transfer, and mentioned her own situation. The teacher replied that this year's policy had not yet been finalized, but according to previous years, the household registration indeed needed to have been transferred for at least one year. She suggested that Song Yajing pay attention to the school's official website and submit the materials during pre-registration; the school would review them uniformly. After hanging up, she felt the issue was thornier than she had imagined, but at least there was a definite answer.

events.name: After arriving at the shop, she arranged the week's key work with Xiaomei.
events.description: At noon, Song Yajing arrived at the shop. Xiaomei had already opened up and been working alone for half the day. Song Yajing first checked the sales revenue, then talked with Xiaomei about this week's focus: rearrange the displays after the new accessories arrive on Wednesday, and start the pre-event decoration for the 'Spring Flower Language' promotion over the weekend. Xiaomei enthusiastically said she could handle daily reception on her own, giving Song Yajing time to take care of school matters.

events.name: In the afternoon, confirmed the progress of the flower-arranging co-branded material preparation with Zhao Li via WeChat.
events.description: Song Yajing used her free time in the afternoon to have a twenty-minute voice call with Zhao Li. Zhao Li told her that she had designed several small bouquet styles for the upcoming event and sent over hand-drawn sketches. Song Yajing liked them very much after seeing them, and the two agreed that Zhao Li would bring samples to the store for a face-to-face discussion on February 27.

events.name: At night, anxiety made it hard to fall asleep, so she got up to sort out her thoughts.
events.description: After dinner, her husband worked overtime. After their daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing lay in bed with the contents of the phone consultation replaying in her mind, too anxious to sleep. At 1 a.m. she finally got up and wrote a to-do list of things that must be completed soon in the living room. Only after making the pressure tangible did she feel somewhat calm, and it was nearly 2 a.m. when she lay down again.

start_state.location: Home at No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District.
start_state.mood: Resolved to devote herself to school selection preparations and keep anxiety in check.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District
end_state.mood: Still uneasy about the unknown school admission result, but the feeling of moving forward according to plan brings a sense of control.

2025-02.daily_overview: After finishing the daily store tasks, Song Yajing took advantage of the afternoon lull in customer traffic to once again challenge the difficult French dessert that had previously failed—opéra cake. This time she concentrated fully, strictly followed the steps, and ultimately achieved great success. The recognition of a professional-grade result not only restored her confidence but also unexpectedly sparked a new idea for collaborating with Zhao Li on a dessert bouquet gift box. The sense of accomplishment that day greatly dispelled the gloom of recent days. That evening, she excitedly shared it with her husband and stayed up late perfecting the collaboration concept.

events.name: In the morning, review the online course videos at home and prepare the cake ingredients.
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing played Master Chen the baking teacher's Opéra cake tutorial video at home. As she reviewed, she wrote down key points in her notebook: the heat for the almond sponge cake, the smoothness of the coffee buttercream, and the pouring temperature for the ganache. Then she portioned out the almond flour, caster sugar, eggs, butter, dark chocolate, and other ingredients she had bought in advance according to the amounts needed, packed them into insulated bags, and got ready to bring them to the store.

events.name: Successfully made an opera cake in the shop's back kitchen in the afternoon.
events.description: At 1 p.m., with few customers in the shop, Song Yajing greeted Xiao Mei and then threw herself into the task. She first baked thin, even layers of almond sponge cake, let them cool, and brushed them evenly with concentrated espresso syrup. Next she whipped coffee buttercream and spread it layer by layer over the cake layers, putting each layer in the refrigerator to chill briefly for setting. Finally she poured warm chocolate ganache over the top and smoothed it quickly with an offset spatula. While waiting for the final chilling to set, she was so nervous that her palms were sweating. Two hours later, she unmolded and cut the cake. The cross-section showed clear layers, and it tasted slightly bitter at first with a sweet aftertaste — quite close to the flavor she had at Chef Chen's shop.

events.name: Shared photos of the finished product with Master Chen and Zhao Li and received their approval
events.description: Song Yajing excitedly sent photos of the finished cross-section and a short video to Master Chen and Zhao Li. Master Chen quickly replied, praising the distinct layers and the balance of sweet and bitter, and encouraged her to keep improving. Zhao Li was amazed by the beautiful cross-section and said directly, “If this were placed in a bouquet gift box, it would definitely sell well,” and suggested that they could cooperate to make small dessert gift boxes to pair with her small bouquets, as a special store gift or as individual products.

events.name: Seriously consider the proposal for dessert bouquet gift boxes and record the concept.
events.description: After receiving Zhao Li's proposal, Song Yajing was very excited. She felt it was an excellent way to combine baking with store operations. She immediately recorded the rough idea of a dessert bouquet gift box in her phone's notes: mini pound cakes or canelés paired with Zhao Li's small dried flower bouquets, wrapped in kraft paper and twine, which could serve as a gift with purchase or a Mother's Day special. She decided to discuss the details with Zhao Li when they met on the weekend. Then she spent half an hour cleaning the kitchen tools and countertops.

events.name: In the evening, shared the success with her husband and discussed dessert gift boxes.
events.description: When she got home in the evening, Song Yajing showed Chen Zhiqiang the photos of the finished opera cake, and her husband gave her a rare compliment that it looked very professional. She then brought up Zhao Li's idea of a dessert bouquet. Chen Zhiqiang reminded her to pay attention to cost and preservation issues, but he supported trying it. The two talked late into the night. After going back to her room, Song Yajing continued searching alone on her phone for food-grade packaging materials and did not go to sleep until the early morning.

start_state.location: Home at No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District.
start_state.mood: With the unwillingness to accept last time's failure, I was determined to try again.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District
end_state.mood: Regaining strong confidence from successful baking, filled with the joy of creation

2025-02.daily_overview: The success of the Opera cake gave Song Yajing the motivation to build on her momentum. Today she officially signed up for Master Chen's online advanced course, turning her baking hobby into systematic study. After receiving the course schedule, she immediately began planning the next four weeks, trying to find a new balance among the course, the shop, and family. In the afternoon, she discussed a co-branded floral collaboration with Zhao Li, and the two quickly finalized the trial plan for the 'Spring Sweetheart' bouquet gift box, aiming to launch it before Women's Day. The rational planning and anticipation of the new collaboration filled her with energy for the future. In the afternoon, because the damp, cold weather worsened her back and waist pain, she did a short stretch in the back room of the shop.

events.name: Contacted Master Chen to ask about the advanced course and formally enrolled in it.
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing contacted Master Chen via WeChat, saying she wanted to systematically learn French desserts. Master Chen gave a detailed introduction to a four-week online advanced course, including two live classes per week teaching mousses, tarts, cream puffs, and other categories, with after-class group Q&A and work critiques. The cost was within her budget. After hearing this, Song Yajing immediately completed the payment via WeChat transfer.

events.name: Receive the electronic class schedule and print it out to post at the cashier counter.
events.description: After payment, Master Chen sent a beautifully designed electronic course schedule listing the live course dates, times, and the materials and tools needed for each lesson. After arriving at the shop, Song Yajing printed it out with the shop's small printer and placed it prominently on the board behind the cash register, so she could see it every day and remind herself to prepare in advance.

events.name: Planned the time allocation for study and business operations over the next four weeks.
events.description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing made detailed plans in her notebook based on the course schedule and the store's daily customer flow patterns. She found that most live courses were scheduled from 2:00 to 3:30 PM, exactly the time when the store had the fewest customers in the day, so Xiaomei could mind the store while she followed along in the back kitchen wearing earphones. She also marked the weekly advance-purchase day and decided to go to the supermarket every Wednesday morning to buy the ingredients needed for the courses and practice in the afternoon.

events.name: In the afternoon, confirmed the progress of the flower-arranging co-branded material preparation with Zhao Li via WeChat.
events.description: After finishing her afternoon planning, Song Yajing remembered Zhao Li's praise for the Opéra cake and the bouquet proposal from yesterday, and immediately sent a voice message asking about the preparation of materials and the feasibility of the co-branded collaboration.

events.name: In-depth discussion with Zhao Li on dessert bouquet gift boxes and finalizing the trial production plan
events.description: After taking inventory, Song Yajing remembered Zhao Li's praise of the Opera cake yesterday and her suggestion about bouquets, so she immediately sent her a voice message. The two chatted back and forth and hit it off, quickly settling on a preliminary plan: Song Yajing would first bake a batch of Madeleines and cannelés that are easy to package within the week, while Zhao Li would be in charge of designing matching small bouquets and gift box packaging. The goal is to launch the first "Spring Sweetheart" bouquet gift box before Women's Day on March 8, either as a new gift-with-purchase item for the store or sold separately, to test market response. Song Yajing felt full of motivation.

events.name: In the afternoon, I did simple stretches in the back room of the store because of lower back soreness.
events.description: In the afternoon at the shop, the recent damp and cold weather made Song Yajing's back and waist unbearably sore. When there was a lull with no customers, she slipped into the back room and followed a video on her phone to do several cat-cow and side-bend stretches, which eased the discomfort a little.

events.name: Before leaving work, she told her husband about the enrollment and got his support.
events.description: When she got home that evening, Song Yajing told Chen Zhiqiang at the dinner table about signing up for the advanced course. After hearing it, her husband asked a couple of questions about the course fee and study duration. When he learned that she had planned it seriously, he was silent for a few seconds and said, "If you like it, study it well, but don't push yourself when the store is busy." Although he was not enthusiastically supportive, the supportive tone put Song Yajing at ease. That night she even showed Xuanxuan a few pictures of exquisite desserts, and Xuanxuan pointed at the chocolate tower and said, "Mommy, make this for me."

start_state.mood: Inspired by yesterday's success, resolved to invest in her own skills

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District
end_state.mood: With a clear learning path and collaboration plan, I feel fulfilled and determined about the future.

2025-02.daily_overview: Today was an intensive preparation day. Song Yajing first took care of a health concern by scheduling her first full-body physical examination in three years. In the afternoon, Zhao Li brought samples to the shop, and the two smoothly finalized the complete plan for the [Spring Flower Language] collaboration event, officially launching the flower-and-clothing partnership. In the evening, she enthusiastically wrote promotional copy and pre-ordered the first batch of floral materials, fully laying the groundwork for the first marketing campaign in March. After finishing work late at night, she did her first formal 15-minute yoga stretching session and felt her body and mind gradually getting back on track.

events.name: Calling the family doctor to make an appointment for a full physical examination
events.description: In the morning at home, Song Yajing remembered that she hadn't had a physical examination in nearly three years, and under the recent high-pressure life, she had occasionally experienced heart palpitations and insomnia. She found the business card of her family doctor, Wang Mingyuan, and called his Community Health Service Center. After Dr. Wang answered, she booked a full-body checkup package for the morning of March 5, including a complete blood count, electrocardiogram, and gynecological examination, and noted the instruction to fast for 8 hours before the checkup.

events.name: In the afternoon, Zhao Li came to the store to finalize the floral art co-branding plan in detail.
events.description: At 2:30, Zhao Li arrived at the store with several small bouquet samples and dried flower materials. The two sat in the rest area and discussed in detail: they confirmed the '[Spring Flower Whispers] theme week' would be held from March 1 to 7, and the window display would be completely changed to dried flower decorations designed by Zhao Li; customers who spent 388 yuan or more would receive one of Zhao Li's handmade small bouquets as a gift; Song Yajing would post a set of 'Flowers and Clothing' outfit pictures with text in her community groups and Moments every day; the bouquet costs would be borne by Song Yajing, who would pay Zhao Li the cost price for each bouquet given away, and if customers bought bouquets separately, the profits would be split 50/50. Zhao Li also took out a simple cooperation memorandum, and the two signed it with a smile.

events.name: That evening, wrote the promotional copy for [Spring Floral Whispers] at home.
events.description: After dinner, Song Yajing opened her laptop and, referring to the bouquet sample photos taken in the afternoon and her ideas for collaboration, carefully wrote a set of WeChat Moments teaser copy and community announcements. She designed lively, upbeat text highlighting the selling points of “free flowers with purchases” and “spring outfits meet floral art,” and even used a photo-editing app to cut out several matching preview images. It was nearly 10 p.m. before the copy was polished to her satisfaction.

events.name: Contacted the flower supplier to order the first batch of event flowers.
events.description: After finishing the copy, Song Yajing did not pause and immediately contacted the flower supplier recommended by Zhao Li via WeChat, sending a list of the first batch of needed dried flower bundles, chamomile, eucalyptus leaves, and so on. The other party quickly quoted a price and confirmed, promising to deliver the flowers directly to the shop on the morning of March 1. Song Yajing paid a small deposit and reminded Xiaomei in the shop's work group to watch for the delivery. After everything was settled, she breathed a long sigh of relief.

events.name: Do a full yoga stretching routine late at night to build a new habit
events.description: When all the work was done, it was almost 11:30. After washing up, Song Yajing didn't go straight to bed. Instead, she found a gentle bedtime yoga sequence in her phone bookmarks, rolled out her yoga mat, and followed along seriously for 15 minutes, focusing on stretching her neck, shoulders, and lower back. After finishing, her tense body felt as if a weight had been lifted, and she decided to include it in her daily bedtime routine.

start_state.mood: Multiple tasks on the list, a fulfilling sense of being methodically organized

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District
end_state.mood: Excited that the co-branded event came together smoothly, and looking forward to March.

2025-02.daily_overview: The last day of February was filled with multiple important tasks. In the morning, Song Yajing and her husband went to the target primary school for an on-site consultation and obtained crucial admissions information. Back at the shop, she first received the flowers from her collaboration with Zhao Li and did a preliminary arrangement, then faced the numbers and calculated that the monthly accounts barely broke even. Under pressure, she called the bank manager to explore the possibility of a loan. In the evening, her communication with her husband and the activity setup after closing let her see a glimmer of light to move forward side by side amid the financial gloom. Before bed, she practiced yoga as usual; her weight rose slightly because of dinner, but her mood was calm.

events.name: In the morning, went with her husband to Siming District Experimental Primary School for an on-site consultation.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Chen Zhiqiang took half a day off as arranged. The couple brought copies of their daughter's relevant documents and went together to Siming District Experimental Primary School. After stating their purpose at the gatehouse, a teacher in charge from the admissions office received them. The teacher explained in detail the expected class sizes for 2025, the requirements for the "two consistencies" policy and the duration of household registration, and frankly said that if the household registration fell short by one to two months, there had been a few supplementary admission cases in previous years, but there was no guarantee. They left with the latest enrollment brochure, and Song Yajing felt a mix of joy and worry.

events.name: Go to the shop in the morning to receive the flower materials from Zhao Li for the collaboration and do the first round of sorting.
events.description: After returning from the school consultation, Song Yajing first made a stop at the shop on the way. She happened to meet the flower supplier that Zhao Li had arranged to make the delivery. Together with Xiaomei, she opened the boxes and checked the quality and quantity of materials including eucalyptus leaves, chamomile, and dried flower bundles, and signed for them after confirming they were correct. The two moved the flowers into the air-conditioned room in the shop for fresh storage, and according to the schematic Zhao Li had sent earlier, roughly sorted and pre-organized them, fully preparing for Zhao Li to come the next day to set up the window display. Seeing the room filled with fragrance, Song Yajing felt a bit more anticipation for the next day's event.

events.name: After returning to the store, reconciled the complete February accounts and analyzed the financial situation.
events.description: After leaving the school, Chen Zhiqiang went straight to the company for work, while Song Yajing returned to the store. She opened the electronic ledger on her computer and, together with bank statements and purchase receipts, calculated item by item the February revenue, spring clothing costs, coffee machine amortization, miscellaneous expenses, and so on. She found that due to the post-Spring Festival off-season and the large coffee machine expense, the month's net profit barely broke even; after deducting the upcoming quarterly rent, the book cash flow was less than 5,000 yuan.

events.name: Called the bank's account manager to inquire about a micro and small business loan
events.description: After checking the accounts, Song Yajing realized that the pressure of next month's rent and other payments for goods was not to be underestimated. After much deliberation, she called Lin Xiaofeng, the account manager at ICBC. She cautiously asked whether it was possible to get a small and micro business loan without collateral. Manager Lin said she would need to provide the past six months' corporate account statements, purchase receipts, and business certificates, and suggested that she organize them as soon as possible and come to the bank for an interview and assessment on Monday morning. Song Yajing agreed.

events.name: In the evening, returned home and informed her husband about the loan consultation and discussed countermeasures together.
events.description: When she got home in the evening, Chen Zhiqiang had already prepared a simple dinner. After the meal, Song Yajing told him in detail about the consultations she had had during the day. Chen Zhiqiang looked serious, but he did not blame her. He only stressed again that loans must be handled with the utmost caution, and said he would take another half day off on Monday morning to accompany her to the bank. Song Yajing gratefully squeezed her husband's hand and decided to give it a try no matter what. The two then spread out the account books, re-planned the family income and expenses, and cut some non-essential spending.

events.name: Before closing, she set up the coffee machine and the event sign with shop assistant Xiaomei.
events.description: Before dinner, Song Yajing rushed back to the store. Together with Xiaomei, she reorganized the simple drink corner set up earlier, wiped clean the coffee machine, arranged paper cups, sugar packets, and ingredients for free American coffee, and set up a small chalkboard at the store entrance reading "Spring Floral Whispers: Enter the store and enjoy hand-drip coffee." They also adjusted the floral samples in the window to the best angle ahead of time. Once everything was ready, Song Yajing took a photo of the storefront at night and posted it in the community group, announcing the start of the next day's event.

events.name: Pre-bedtime yoga practice and mindset adjustment
events.description: A busy day came to an end. Song Yajing persisted in a 15-minute bedtime yoga stretching routine, focusing on breathing and relaxation. After practicing, she felt that although her body was tired, her heart was more grounded than in the past few days. Even though financial pressure still lay ahead, she believed that as long as the couple worked together, they could gradually solve it.

events.name: Month-beginning financial processing and insurance reservation.

According to the family electronic ledger, she set aside December's insurance premium and the budget for new health insurance, transferred the money through mobile banking, and sent a screenshot to her husband for confirmation. Considering the upcoming weight-gain diet plan, she raised this month's dining budget by 200 yuan.

events.name: Create and send e-invitations for the thank-you dinner

She then sent private messages to 20 regular customers one by one and recorded their replies. Those who did not reply immediately were left for telephone follow-up the next day.

events.name: Close friend Wang Jia suddenly returned to Xiamen, impromptu bestie gathering.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Tuesday, because she had gone to bed late the night before, she got up a little later in the morning. In the morning, she contacted baking teacher Master Chen to confirm the next day's class. Following Wang Jia's suggestion, she tried starting a fashion topic chain in the community group. In the afternoon, as a light rain fell, she adjusted the winter clothing display and put up the plus-size section sign. After dinner, the whole family insisted on walking in the rain. They put on raincoats and briskly walked along Hubin South Road for 20 minutes before turning back, shortening the time but not breaking the habit.

events.name: Contact Master Chen to confirm the baking class time

Looking at the two trays of failed products, Song Yajing didn't know whether to laugh or cry. Master Chen encouraged her, saying 'Failure is part of learning.'

Soon, Li Meiling showed a burnt chiffon cake, Wang Jia posted collapsed egg tarts, and Mrs. Liu also sent cracked macarons. A "fail contest" broke out in the group, and everyone teased each other, laughing together. Song Yajing laughed until tears came. She wrote in the group: "So we're all the same—failing is the daily norm in baking!"

In the afternoon, I sorted customer pre-orders at the store. During an evening walk, I discussed family insurance options with my husband. Before bed, I kept up stretching and a gratitude journal, recording this month's growth: moving from recovery to strengthening, my weight returning, and my mind feeling stronger. I firmly believe the coming year holds promise.

events.name: Spring clothing shipping notice and pre-sale preparation
events.description: In the morning, she received a WeChat message from Susan saying the spring clothes had been shipped from Guangzhou and were expected to arrive tomorrow or the day after. Song Yajing immediately posted a preview in the customer group, 'Spring clothes arriving soon,' and opened 5 pre-order slots, which were quickly taken.

events.name: Weight is back up to 47.8 kg, assessing progress.
events.description: In the morning she weighed 47.8 kg, up 0.8 kg from the beginning of the month (starting at 49.2 kg, but after a rapid adjustment at the beginning of the month, it has risen steadily). The body fat scale showed a slight rise in muscle percentage. She took photos to record this and updated her health journal: increase the weight in core training, and keep an upright posture while walking. She plans to keep it up and reach 48.5 kg by the end of the year.

events.name: Discussing family health insurance.
events.description: After dinner, she took out yesterday's insurance materials and studied and compared them with her husband. The two decided to meet account manager Lin Xiaofeng within the week to consult on details and include it in next year's family financial plan.

events.name: Gratitude and outlook before bed
events.description: After stretching before bed, wrote in her diary: 'In the first half of December, family warmth overflowed, career was stable with small joys, and she actively strengthened her body. The most precious gifts: Grandma Zhang's handshake, her husband's hand-holding, and her daughter's hug. The coming year is worth looking forward to.'

start_state.mood: Full of energy, feeling light and refreshed

end_state.mood: Calm and settled, with abundant gains and full confidence in the future.

2025-12.daily_overview: On a Tuesday workday, in addition to taking care of the shop, she completed the third core rehabilitation training in the morning, consulted online about family insurance during her free time in the afternoon, and in the evening the whole family went for a walk and discussed the protection plan. Her life rhythm gradually found a new balance among rehabilitation, career, and family.

events.name: Morning: third core rehabilitation training session
events.description: At 9 a.m., Song Yajing arrived at the community gym as promised for her third core training session under a personal trainer. She tried extending her plank from 30 seconds to 45 seconds. During the process, she clearly felt the deep abdominal muscles trembling, but the coach encouraged her to maintain proper form. After completing bridge, bird-dog, and modified plank exercises, she slowly stood up with her hand on her lower back, thinking that her core support really was stronger than last week, and her steps were also more stable when walking.

events.name: After opening the store, checked restocks for the co-branded items and community messages
events.description: After training, she showered and changed clothes, arriving at the store on Zhongshan Road around 10. She first did a quick inventory of yesterday's sales with Xiaomei, then opened the WeChat community to reply to a regular customer's inquiry about sizes for the co-branded hoodie, and again confirmed the shipping progress of the third batch of co-branded items with supplier Susan in Guangzhou to ensure they could be put on shelves before the weekend.

events.name: Using break time to schedule an afternoon insurance consultation
events.description: At 2 p.m., store traffic had eased slightly. Song Yajing sat behind the cash register and contacted bank relationship manager Lin Xiaofeng via WeChat, briefly explaining that she wanted to arrange health coverage for the whole family. Since Manager Lin happened to be free that afternoon, the two scheduled an online meeting at 3 p.m. After hanging up, she casually sent a screenshot of the appointment reminder to her husband Chen Zhiqiang.

events.name: Online insurance consultation with Manager Lin
events.description: At 3 p.m., Song Yajing connected with Lin Xiaofeng via WeChat video in the small warehouse at the back of the shop. Based on her old lumbar spine condition, her mother Lin Xiuying's recovery from a cerebral infarction, and the fact that her daughter was still young, Manager Lin explained in detail a combined plan of critical illness insurance with accidental injury insurance. While listening, Song Yajing noted down key points about premiums, coverage amounts, and the claims process, and specifically asked whether lumbar-related diseases were covered. Manager Lin patiently explained the details of the terms.

events.name: Forwarded the insurance plan to her husband and had an initial discussion
events.description: The consultation ended around 4 p.m. Song Yajing immediately forwarded the electronic proposal sent by Manager Lin to her husband Chen Zhiqiang via WeChat, with the note: 'Let's discuss it in detail during our evening walk. See whether we can afford the premium.' Chen Zhiqiang replied that he would review it carefully after receiving it. Song Yajing looked at the family portrait on her phone's screensaver and calculated in her mind whether this additional monthly expense would affect her daughter's interest class fees.

events.name: After dinner, the whole family went for a walk around Yundang Lake.
events.description: At about 8 p.m. after dinner, Song Yajing and her family of three walked to the Yundang Lake trail. The lake breeze was slightly cool on the winter night; she helped her daughter Chen Lexuan adjust her scarf, and her husband naturally took her hand. The three walked along the lake for about 30 minutes. Under the streetlights along the way, Xuanxuan spotted several blooming bougainvillea flowers. Song Yajing felt that her waist was no longer as stiff as in the past few days, and her posture was naturally straighter.

events.name: The couple had an in-depth discussion about insurance plans and made a decision.
events.description: After walking home and settling their daughter into bed, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang sat on the living room sofa and went through the printed insurance proposal item by item. The two used a calculator to estimate the family's monthly expenses and finally concluded that the premium was within an affordable range. Since her husband's birthday had just passed not long ago, they agreed to use the New Year holiday to sign in person with Manager Lin and officially complete the insurance application, building a more solid protective wall for their family.

start_state.mood: I'm a little looking forward to today's consultation and also thinking about the training results.

end_state.mood: Feeling at ease now that the insurance plan is taking shape, and sensing her husband's shared effort.

2025-12.daily_overview: Midweek was a regular operating day for the shop. Song Yajing focused mainly on organizing winter inventory and handing over daily tasks to staff member Xiaomei. In the evening, the family took their usual walk, and the ordinary days quietly built up the peace of the year's end.

events.name: Organize winter inventory and adjust displays
events.description: After arriving at the store at 10 a.m., Song Yajing noticed that several coats had fewer try-ons due to the recent warming, so she and Xiaomei changed the window mannequins into the newly arrived co-branded light jackets. She folded some heavy wool coats and stored them in the warehouse, and marked in the inventory book the styles that needed price adjustments after the New Year. Xiaomei chatted about the drama she had been watching last night while ironing new clothes. The store atmosphere was relaxed.

events.name: Video call with mother Lin Xiuying at noon.
events.description: At noon, she ordered satay noodles for delivery. Song Yajing took advantage of the meal break to video-call her mother Lin Xiuying on WeChat. Her mother said it had turned cold in Quanzhou too and that she was wearing the thermal clothes Yajing had sent last time, and reminded her not to forget the church's Christmas event. Song Yajing asked her mother to walk a few steps in the living room so she could see her; seeing that her mother was steady on her feet and recovering steadily, she felt relieved. The mother and daughter then talked about how Xuanxuan had recently taken a liking to painting, and her mother smiled and said she was just like Yajing when she was little.

events.name: Received the Shenzhen specialties my sister sent
events.description: In the afternoon, a delivery arrived at the door. Song Yawen had sent two large packages of cured sausages and Chaoshan gongfu tea from Shenzhen, with a note saying, "Winter Solstice is coming soon. One portion for Mom and Dad, and one for you." Song Yajing opened and divided them, keeping half for her parents in Quanzhou and bringing the other half home. She shared some with Xiaomei and the neighboring store owner, and everyone praised how delicious they were.

events.name: After dinner, the whole family went for a walk around Yundang Lake.
events.description: At 8 p.m., the family went to the Yundang Lake trail as usual. Their daughter Chen Lexuan was especially excited today, hopping on the stone path while holding her parents' hands. After walking for a while, Song Yajing felt much more relaxed in her lower back, so she quickened her pace a little. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang reminded her not to overdo it. The three shared a new nursery rhyme their daughter had learned in kindergarten, and the streetlights stretched their shadows long.

start_state.mood: Calm, habitually preparing to start the day.

end_state.mood: Enjoying the warmth in ordinary life, feeling better and better physically

2025-12.daily_overview: In the morning I did the fourth core workout, and the rain didn't interrupt the plan. In the afternoon I handled a customer complaint about the co-branded style in the shop and studied the key points of the bird dog exercise. During the family walk, I could already feel my lower back support building up.

events.name: Fourth core rehabilitation training session
events.description: Although a light drizzle was falling outside, Song Yajing arrived at the gym on time at 9 a.m. The training session focused on strengthening balance in the bird-dog exercise. The coach required her to keep her torso absolutely stable while lifting opposite arm and leg. The first two times, as soon as her right knee left the ground, her pelvis tilted; on the third attempt, she concentrated and controlled her movement, finally holding the position for 10 seconds. The coach nodded and said her core activation had clearly improved. Song Yajing took photos of the coach demonstrating the standard posture, planning to practice in front of the mirror at home.

events.name: Handle co-branded product exchanges and contact the supplier
events.description: After returning to the store at noon, Xiaomei told her that a customer had brought back a co-branded hoodie, saying it had shrunk slightly after washing. Song Yajing patiently called the customer to apologize and promised to send a replacement of the new style. She then reported the situation to the supplier Susan, and the two discussed improvements to the fabric preshrinking process on WeChat. Susan agreed that the next batch would receive extra spot checks on washing standards. Song Yajing saved the records in the supplier tracking folder, feeling somewhat annoyed but ultimately having found a solution.

events.name: Watching the baking community's fail contest interactions
events.description: In her free time in the afternoon, she opened the group chat of the fail contest she had started after her puff pastry attempt failed. Group members were posting burnt cakes and collapsed macarons one after another, and the laughter never stopped. Song Yajing replied to each failed creation with a smile, inwardly feeling lucky that showing vulnerability back then had instead made the community more warm and personal.

events.name: Learn the key points of the bird-dog exercise and keep a rehabilitation log
events.description: After training, she used the coach's demonstration video to draw the step-by-step breakdown of the bird dog pose in her rehabilitation journal, writing "Keep your pelvis level and imagine a cup of water on your back that doesn't spill." She also circled the mistakes she tends to make in red pen, planning to ask the coach to correct her again before the next session.

events.name: After dinner, the whole family went for a walk around Yundang Lake.
events.description: After the rain stopped in the evening, the ground was slightly wet. After dinner, the family of three still went to Yundang Lake; the air was cool and carried the faint scent of soil. Song Yajing gently rotated her lower back as she walked, feeling it more flexible than yesterday. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang proactively brought up the year-end project wrap-up at his software company, while she shared amusing stories from the community's 'fail' contest. Xuanxuan squatted down to watch a snail, and the couple also stopped and waited patiently.

start_state.mood: I feel motivated to keep training, and I don't want to interrupt it even in the rain.

end_state.mood: A sense of control brought by improved body control, and a positive mindset.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Friday, she gave herself a little break, entrusted the store entirely to shop assistant Xiao Mei, and met up with her best friend Li Meiling at Shapowei to enjoy a long-missed shopping and afternoon tea time, getting an early dose of Christmas warmth. In the evening, she alone reviewed the results of two weeks of recovery and realized that rest and friendship are equally important parts of managing life.

events.name: Gave instructions on store matters before going out.
events.description: At 10 a.m., after having breakfast at home, Song Yajing made a point of calling Xiaomei and carefully went over the afternoon's tasks: signing for incoming deliveries, notifying a few regular customers about their reserved items, and handling normal reception and cashier duties. Xiaomei agreed readily and joked that the boss had finally agreed to take a rest.

events.name: Go to Shapowei Art West Zone to meet up with her best friend.
events.description: At 1:30 PM, Song Yajing changed into her favorite beige sweater and wide-leg pants, walked from near the shop to the bus stop, and took the bus two stops to Shapowei. Li Meiling was already waiting at the west entrance. As soon as they met, they remarked that the last time they had gone shopping alone like this was two months ago. Sunlight streamed through the roof of the old factory building, and the temperature was comfortable.

events.name: Shopping at designer boutiques with a close friend and trying on winter clothes
events.description: The two strolled through the alleys of Art West Zone into several independent designer shops. Song Yajing liked an asymmetrically cut navy coat and held it up in front of the mirror. Li Meiling offered styling advice, saying it made her look elegant. In the end she tried it on but didn't buy it, laughing that today's goal was to recharge, not to spend. Li Meiling, on the other hand, bought a hand-dyed scarf, saying she needed materials for her handicraft club.

events.name: Afternoon tea and heart-to-heart talk at a sea-view café
events.description: At 3 p.m., they walked into the café overlooking Xiamen Port and ordered hot fruit tea and a slice of chestnut cake. Li Meiling shared funny moments from the children's rehearsal of their New Year's Day program, and Song Yajing talked about how she had recently ruined a French dessert and held a flop contest in the group chat. Their laughter drew glances from neighboring tables. When the conversation turned to family, she told her best friend that after her waist recovered, she had come to appreciate her body more.

events.name: Received a Christmas gift of a hand-knitted scarf from her best friend.
events.description: When they parted, around 5 o'clock, Li Meiling took out a soft hand-knitted cream-colored scarf from her bag and handed it over, saying it was an early Christmas gift that she had knitted on and off for a month. Song Yajing wrapped it around her neck right away, her eyes slightly reddening, and hugged her friend tightly, repeating how warm it was and thanking her. The two said goodbye at the intersection and agreed to meet again in Quanzhou during the Spring Festival.

events.name: After returning home, she had a minor quarrel with her husband over a scarf and quickly reconciled.
events.description: Returning home in the evening, Song Yajing excitedly showed the scarf to her husband. Chen Zhiqiang joked that she received more socks than flowers every year, and this scarf had gotten ahead of his down jacket plan. Song Yajing pretended to be angry, and the two bickered a bit, but Chen Zhiqiang immediately hugged her and said, "Just kidding. Your happiness is what matters most." He also revealed that he had used part of his year-end bonus to order a goose down jacket, arriving by end of year. Song Yajing turned from annoyance to laughter.

events.name: Two-week rehabilitation training self-assessment.
events.description: After dinner in the study, Song Yajing pulled up the training photos from two weeks ago on her phone and compared them with the selfies she took after today's training. She noticed that when standing, her shoulders no longer leaned forward, and her pelvis was much more stable when walking. She reported her progress to her coach in the rehabilitation group. The coach replied that her core endurance had almost returned to normal and she could appropriately increase the load. She noted the key assessment points in her health journal, feeling full of motivation to keep going.

events.name: After dinner, the whole family went for a walk around Yundang Lake.
events.description: Despite quite a bit of walking during the day, the family of three still went for a walk at 8 p.m. Song Yajing wore the new scarf, showed off her best friend's gift to her husband, and took his hand voluntarily. Xuanxuan looked up and asked her mother why the scarf was so long. The atmosphere was warm as spring.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to a rare girls' day out, feeling excited.

end_state.mood: Nourished by friendship, physically and mentally fulfilled, and full of confidence in future recovery.

2025-12.daily_overview: Saturday kicked off Christmas-season family time. In the morning, the whole family worked together to decorate the Christmas tree and display their daughter's paintings. In the afternoon, Song Yajing made her monthly summary of dietary structure. In the evening, they took their usual walk. At night, she enjoyed her first monthly movie theater ritual alone, luxuriously having private laughter.

events.name: The whole family worked together to decorate for Christmas.
events.description: After breakfast, a little past 9, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang carried the stored Christmas tree components, string lights, and ornament boxes out of the storage room. Their daughter Chen Lexuan excitedly served as a little helper, passing small snowflakes and colorful balls. Chen Zhiqiang was in charge of assembling the trunk and carefully wrapping the string lights around it, while Song Yajing helped him hold the tree steady, adjusting the loose branches bit by bit. When the lights were plugged in and twinkling, Xuanxuan clapped her hands happily.

events.name: Frame her daughter's award-winning painting and hang it next to the Christmas tree
events.description: Just as the decorations were nearly done, Song Yajing took out a frame she had prepared earlier and carefully placed Xuanxuan's commemorative award-winning painting from the December 6 painting contest, "Cactus on the Windowsill," into it. Then she hung it on the wall beside the Christmas tree. She said, "This is the most meaningful Christmas decoration in our home." Xuanxuan pointed proudly at the painting and said, "I painted this when Mommy and I went to the botanical garden together." Chen Zhiqiang captured the moment with his phone.

events.name: Organize and summarize the past month's diet records.
events.description: After lunch, while her daughter was napping, Song Yajing opened her tablet in the dining room and reviewed the dietary records since December 8. She saw that the whole family had a high acceptance of baked salmon and cold chickpea salad, but her daughter occasionally complained that the tofu pieces were too big. In the summary column, she wrote: keep these two dishes as fixed weekly dishes, and officially designate reducing oil and replacing it with olive oil as a family cooking rule. Then she sent the summary to the family group, and her parents liked it.

events.name: The whole family took a photo with the Christmas tree and shared it.
events.description: A little after 4 p.m., everything was ready. Chen Zhiqiang called the mother and daughter to stand in front of the Christmas tree and took several family photos with a tripod. Song Yajing picked the best one and sent it to the family group and her close friends' group, with the caption "The simplest decorations, the warmest home." Relatives and friends all liked it.

events.name: After dinner, the whole family went for a walk around Yundang Lake.
events.description: After dark, the three of them still went out for a walk. Tonight Song Yajing walked with a particularly light step, telling her husband about her afternoon dietary summary. Chen Zhiqiang expressed full support for replacing regular oil with olive oil. Xuanxuan noticed the lake reflecting the colored lights of the distant buildings and happily pointed them out to her parents.

events.name: Buy a movie ticket to watch a movie alone
events.description: After her walk, she got home at around 7:40. Song Yajing opened the movie ticketing app on the sofa and saw that the 8:30 showing of the Chinese comedy "Her Story" at MIXC Cinema still had back-row corner seats, so she immediately bought a ticket. She decided to give herself a night out. After getting Xuanxuan to bed, she changed into a light jacket and went out.

events.name: Watching a movie alone and enjoying a sense of personal ritual.
events.description: At 8:30 p.m., Song Yajing sat in a corner of the back row at MixC Cinema, holding a large popcorn and a cola, completely immersed in the film's humorous plot. When the protagonist delivered the classic line, she laughed so hard she doubled over. For that moment, she completely forgot about store data and household chores and felt completely relaxed.

events.name: Ran into former colleague Sun Li at the mall after the movie.
events.description: The movie ended around 10 p.m., and Song Yajing wandered around MixC. A discounted purple cashmere cardigan in a window display caught her eye. While she was hesitating, someone tapped her shoulder—it was her former colleague Sun Li, who had returned from Shenzhen to visit family in Xiamen. The two sat down at the coffee corner in pleasant surprise and caught up. Sun Li, now a regional operations manager, encouraged Yajing to keep running her community. Yajing hung the cardigan back, and the two agreed to meet in Shenzhen next year.

events.name: Posted on Moments and returned home.
events.description: On the taxi ride home, Song Yajing chose a photo of a movie ticket stub and the night view of the mall to post on Moments, writing: 'Give myself at least one movie theater moment every month—this is a ritual that belongs only to me.' Soon after posting, she received likes from Li Meiling and Wang Jia. She got home at nearly 11:30, washed up quietly, kissed the forehead of the sleeping Xuanxuan, and fell asleep peacefully.

start_state.mood: Feeling thrilled about the family Christmas decorations

end_state.mood: Filled with both family warmth and personal healing time, feeling inner peace.
