2025-12.daily_overview: The winter solstice fell on a Sunday. In the morning, we went to church for the Sunday Mass; in the afternoon, we shopped for ingredients; in the evening, the whole family made gingerbread men together. Not only did we prepare gifts to share on Christmas Eve, but we also conveyed the family philosophy that imperfection is love through the dough and laughter.

events.name: Attend Sunday Mass.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Song Yajing took Xuanxuan to Siming Catholic Church to attend Sunday Mass. Her husband, Chen Zhiqiang, arrived later because he had to handle work. During the sermon, Father Wang mentioned the meaning of Advent, reminding the congregation to prepare their hearts while waiting. In silent prayer, Song Yajing thought of her mother Lin Xiuying's recovery and her daughter's growth. After Mass, she had a brief conversation with Aunt Lin, and they wished each other a Merry Christmas.

events.name: Buy ingredients for making gingerbread men
events.description: At 3 p.m., Song Yajing went alone to the large supermarket near her home. Following the list she had prepared the night before, she picked up cake flour, butter, brown sugar, ginger powder, honey, and eggs. While waiting in line at checkout, she scrolled and saw caramel cookies that her baking enthusiast friend Mrs. Liu had posted on Moments. They exchanged a few words, and Mrs. Liu recommended adding a little cinnamon powder to the dough for extra fragrance, so she grabbed a small bottle of cinnamon powder.

events.name: When her husband had to work overtime midway, Song Yajing made gingerbread men with her daughter on her own
events.description: At about 7:30 after dinner, Chen Zhiqiang suddenly received an urgent call from the company and had to handle a system failure remotely. Song Yajing then put on an apron by herself and squeezed into the kitchen with her daughter. She read out the recipe while Xuanxuan helped crack eggs (a bit of shell fell into the bowl). When they kneaded the dough, it was too sticky, so they sprinkled more flour. While the dough was chilling in the refrigerator, her daughter couldn't wait, and she patiently taught her to recognize the different aromas of ginger powder and cinnamon.

events.name: The whole family finally worked together to finish the gingerbread man
events.description: Half an hour later, Chen Zhiqiang finished his work and joined in. The three of them rolled out the dough and pressed out cookie shapes. Xuanxuan used too much force, leaving several Christmas tree cookies lopsided and the tip of her nose dusted with flour. Song Yajing carefully placed the baking tray into the oven preheated to 180°C. After 12 minutes, the gingerbread men came out golden but slightly burnt on the edges and crooked in shape. Chen Zhiqiang laughed and commented, 'They have a unique artistic feel.'

events.name: Document the gingerbread man and share the imperfection manifesto
events.description: After baking, Song Yajing picked out a few of the most misshapen cookies with her phone and took photos, posting them to the family group and Moments with the caption, "Perfect or imperfect, they are all shapes of love." Her best friend Wang Jia immediately replied, "So cute," and her mother Lin Xiuying sent a voice message saying, "They look delicious." Song Yajing portioned the cookies into sealed bags, planning to bring them to the homeless care center on Christmas Eve, the 24th.

events.name: After dinner, the whole family went for a walk around Yundang Lake.
events.description: Because of the evening activity, the walk was moved up to 6:30 after dinner. On the evening of the winter solstice, it was already completely dark, and in the distance there was the smoky smell of burning joss paper. Xuanxuan asked why today was special. Song Yajing told her that on the winter solstice you eat tangyuan, but unfortunately they were so excited making gingerbread men today that they forgot to cook them, and would make up for it tomorrow. The three of them walked a full circle around the lake, and she felt her waist was strong and her steps were light.

start_state.mood: The peace brought by the Lord's Day, looking forward to baking together as a family

end_state.mood: Enjoying the intimacy of working together with her husband and daughter, feeling content and grateful

2025-12.daily_overview: On the Winter Solstice itself, a warm make-up tangyuan-rolling ritual was woven into the ordinary workday rhythm; three generations shared the tradition over video. During the evening walk, she felt no issue with daily lower-back movements, and her recovery entered a stable phase.

events.name: Daily store operations and spring stocking communication
events.description: Arrived at the store at 10 a.m. Song Yajing and Xiaomei took stock of weekend sales; four co-branded light jackets were sold. She then contacted Susan in Guangzhou via WeChat to follow up on the sampling progress of the plus-size spring styles. Susan sent several fabric swatch cards, and the two briefly discussed the feasibility of switching the basic T-shirt to high-count cotton. Because the details required repeated confirmation, the communication took longer than expected; she rubbed her brow and finished a glass of warm water.

events.name: Go home early in the afternoon to prepare Winter Solstice food
events.description: Considering the Winter Solstice, she handed the shop over to Xiao Mei at 4 p.m., went to the market to buy ready-made glutinous rice flour and sesame filling, and began kneading the glutinous rice dough once she got home. Xuanxuan ran over excitedly after kindergarten. Song Yajing taught her to divide the dough into small pieces and roll them into balls. Her daughter rolled out an oval and called it a 'dinosaur egg.' Once they were cooked, she sprinkled brown sugar and crushed peanuts over them, and they were piping hot.

events.name: Video call with parents in Quanzhou to share tangyuan on the winter solstice.
events.description: At 6 p.m., Song Yajing opened WeChat video and pointed it at the tangyuan on the table. Her father, Song Minghui, also brought out the large yuanxiao balls he had cooked at home in Quanzhou. Xuanxuan held up the misshapen tangyuan she had made and said to the camera, “Grandpa, Grandma, look at mine!” Her mother, Lin Xiuying, praised her repeatedly. Her father reminded her that the weather was cold and she should avoid getting her waist chilled. She thumped her chest and said her waist was much better now. The Winter Solstice reunion across space made Song Yajing's eyes moist.

events.name: After dinner, the whole family went for a walk around Yundang Lake.
events.description: After eating the tangyuan and resting for a while, the family of three went out at 8 o'clock. The temperature had suddenly dropped; Song Yajing bundled herself up, and Xuanxuan wore a knitted cap with little ears. Her husband mentioned how their daughter had acted in the video, saying she was becoming more and more confident. Song Yajing took her husband's arm and said that although they couldn't return to Quanzhou often, video calls like this were nice, too. After walking one full lap in about 35 minutes, on the way back she stretched her lower back a few times by the lake and felt no discomfort.

start_state.mood: Thinking of the Winter Solstice tradition, wanting to give her daughter a holiday memory.

end_state.mood: Warm, wrapped in family affection, at ease that recovery is no longer a concern.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Tuesday, she continued core training, and her body stability entered a new phase. Meanwhile, she handmade display labels for the Christmas Imperfect Works Exhibition. In the evening, the whole family went for a walk, incorporating the sense of fulfillment from rehabilitation and exhibition preparation into daily life.

events.name: Fifth core rehabilitation training session.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Song Yajing arrived at the gym on time. After two weeks of buildup, the trainer added an advanced version of the plank — lightly touching the opposite shoulder with one hand. She wobbled at first but quickly engaged her transversus abdominis to steady herself. After the workout, she felt her core was firmer and could easily stand up from the floor without using her hands to support her lower back. The trainer told her that her core can now protect her lumbar spine well and that she could try adding farmer's carries with light weight.

events.name: Return to the store to handle routine tasks and fine-tune the display
events.description: After training, she arrived at the store around 10:30. Song Yajing put the newly arrived Christmas-red sweaters in a prominent spot and placed a small Santa Claus figurine beside the cash register. She asked Xiaomei to move the batch of T-shirts that had been taken off the shelves because of a slightly high return rate into the storeroom, to be dealt with together after the New Year. Xiaomei mentioned that customers had been asking about Christmas activities recently. Song Yajing smiled and revealed that there would be an "imperfect works" exhibition tomorrow.

events.name: While selecting and organizing exhibition items at home, she accidentally cut her finger.
events.description: After leaving the store at 4 p.m., Song Yajing went home, opened the storage cabinet, and dug out photos of a burnt cake from an earlier baking failure, a warped ceramic cup, scraps of paper from her daughter's calligraphy practice, and a dress that had been returned by her former company and then altered. She made labels from light-colored card stock. While cutting the paper, the utility knife accidentally cut her index finger. After a quick disinfection and a band-aid, she continued, laughing at herself: “Imperfection is also one of the exhibits.” She wrote her thoughts about each item on the labels, such as “This cup cracked because the temperature was too high, but the crack looks like a smile.”

events.name: After dinner, the whole family went for a walk around Yundang Lake.
events.description: At 8 p.m., the family of three went for a walk. Xuanxuan held Song Yajing's hand and asked, "Mom, what is an exhibition tomorrow?" Song Yajing explained that it means letting everyone see some imperfect but very interesting things. When her husband Chen Zhiqiang heard this, he praised the idea as very special and said that software also has imperfect but useful functions. The family walked slowly under the starry sky, without any burden on their waists.

start_state.mood: Full of drive, wanting to make the exhibition feel authentic

end_state.mood: Eager for being fully prepared, with confidence in improved physical steadiness.

state.daily_exercise: Core training for 50 minutes, walking for 30 minutes.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, 10-16°C, light breeze.

2025-12.daily_overview: Christmas Eve was spent amid the sweet aroma of baking cream, the sacred carols of the church, and the kindness of handing out gingerbread men on the streets. Faith and family love blended completely in the act of sharing, and late at night she fell asleep deeply moved.

events.name: Purchase gingerbread man baking ingredients in the morning
events.description: At 9 a.m., Song Yajing made another supplementary shopping trip before the supermarket got crowded, buying butter, flour, ginger powder, brown sugar, and colored frosting. Back home, she counted the first batch of gingerbread men baked last night, found there weren't enough to pack into 30 portions, and decided to bake another batch.

events.name: Making gingerbread men with the whole family again
events.description: At 3 p.m., Song Yajing, her husband Chen Zhiqiang, and their daughter Xuanxuan put on aprons again. Thanks to their previous experience, the dough was more even this time, and Xuanxuan pressed the molds with more strength. The oven gave off the warm aroma of ginger and brown sugar. The cookies that came out were still lopsided but evenly colored. The three of them used icing to draw simple smiley faces and stars, and Xuanxuan looked adorable carefully piping the icing.

events.name: Attended the Christmas Eve Midnight Mass and took photos with fellow believers.
events.description: At 9 p.m., the family of three dressed neatly and went to Siming Catholic Church. Father Wang, wearing a white alb, preached on 'Grace is made perfect in weakness.' Song Yajing quietly tightened her grip on her husband's hand, tears at the corners of her eyes. After Mass, the congregation wished each other a Merry Christmas. Song Yajing specifically took a group photo at the church entrance with Aunt Lin, Father Wang, and several members of the visiting team. Aunt Lin reminded her to keep warm in the cold weather.

events.name: Distribute gingerbread men and blessings to the homeless.
events.description: Around 11 a.m. after Mass, Song Yajing's family carried more than 30 small bags of gingerbread men to the church-partnered homeless care center. Xuanxuan initially hid behind her mother, but with encouragement she personally handed a small bag to an old man and whispered, 'Merry Christmas.' The old man took the cookies with his rough hands and kept saying thank you. Song Yajing looked at her daughter's face and felt this was more precious than any gift.

events.name: Returned home late at night and completed the walk
events.description: After the distribution ended, it was nearly midnight. The three of them slowly walked home along the quiet streets, like a special Christmas Eve walk. Half asleep, Xuanxuan lay on her father's back, while Song Yajing gently held her husband's arm. The moonlight on Christmas Eve was clear and bright, and she felt a quiet happiness overflowing in her heart. After arriving home and washing up, she kissed her daughter's forehead and softly said a word of gratitude.

start_state.mood: Full of anticipation, the sacredness of Christmas Eve, and a longing to share it with family.

end_state.mood: Deep emotion and gratitude, and the satisfaction of faith and action in unity.

state.daily_exercise: Walked about 25 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, 10-17°C, gentle breeze.

2025-12.daily_overview: Christmas kicked off with an unexpectedly heartfelt exhibition of imperfect works. Song Yajing turned individual vulnerability into public resonance. In the afternoon, she donated the proceeds from the charity sale to stray animals, and continued her training, completing a powerful self-affirmation of both body and mind.

events.name: Morning: stuck with the sixth core workout
events.description: Even on a holiday, Song Yajing went to the gym at 8 a.m. to complete her core workout. The coach led her through a set of farmer's walks; she carried a pair of 6kg dumbbells steadily for three laps. After training, she checked in on the calendar: No break for Christmas, sixth time. After going home and showering, she felt energized.

events.name: Arranged an Imperfect Works exhibition at the shop
events.description: At 9:30 in the morning, Song Yajing and Xiaomei set up a display table in the window area of the shop. They laid out linen cloth and placed the warped clay cups, photos of burnt cakes, their daughter's calligraphy practice paper, and the failed dress transformation at intervals. Song Yajing stood up the handwritten labels from yesterday one by one, put sticky note pads and colored pens beside them, and posted a handwritten theme on the wall: 'You are perfectly imperfect.'

events.name: The exhibition opened and struck a chord with customers.
events.description: At 10 a.m., the exhibition officially opened, and many pedestrians strolling along Zhongshan Road were drawn into the shop. A young girl wrote on the message board, “I keep failing at my internship and I’m so afraid others will discover that I don’t know anything.” When Song Yajing saw it, her nose tingled and she quietly took a photo of the note. A middle-aged auntie wrote, “So no one is perfect after all.” There were over 40 messages in total, and the memo board quickly filled up. At one point, a girl teared up in front of a piece; Song Yajing sat quietly beside her and gently stroked her back. The two added each other on WeChat and later became active members of the community.

events.name: Tallied the charity sale proceeds and donated them to stray animals.
events.description: At 4 p.m., the charity sale of exhibits began. An old customer bought the remade dress and said that this kind of imperfection was very real. With some customers voluntarily scanning codes to donate, a total of 500 yuan was received. After closing, Song Yajing and Xiaomei checked the amount, then Song Yajing went alone to a nearby pet supply store to buy cat food, delivered it to a stray animal rescue station in Siming District, and photographed the donation certificate to send to the store's community group.

events.name: Evening family walk by Yundang Lake
events.description: After finishing the busy evening work, Song Yajing went home to have a simple Christmas dinner with her husband and daughter, and afterwards the whole family still went for a walk. Xuanxuan said that the children had exchanged gifts at kindergarten today, and she received a hair clip. Holding her daughter, Song Yajing said that Mama had also received a gift today—the heartfelt words of many strangers.

start_state.mood: Driven by the spirit of Christmas giving, feeling an urge to share.

end_state.mood: Seeing her vulnerable side accepted, she felt an enormous sense of release and strength.

state.daily_exercise: Core training for 50 minutes, walking for 30 minutes.

2025-12.daily_overview: On the first workday after the holiday, she delivered the remaining gingerbread men to another gathering spot for homeless people, letting the warmth of sharing continue; she handled the shop's daily chores, and her sense of physical and mental order grew increasingly steady in the ordinary routine.

events.name: Organize the store and restock displays
events.description: After opening the shop in the morning, Song Yajing took down some Christmas decorations, ironed the newly arrived spring clothing samples, and hung them on the display racks. Xiaomei reported that foot traffic on Christmas Eve and Christmas Day was good, and the two updated inventory records together. Song Yajing noticed that several sweater styles had missing sizes, so she immediately contacted the supplier to ask about restocking.

events.name: Go to another gathering spot for the homeless to distribute gingerbread men
events.description: At 2 p.m., Song Yajing took the last 20 sealed bags of gingerbread men and walked to a common gathering corner for homeless people in the old town of Xiamen. She squatted down and handed the cookies with both hands to an elderly person leaning against luggage. The elderly person took them and softly said, "God bless you." Nearby shopkeepers saw this, offered her a pot of hot water, and praised her kindness. Several more homeless people gathered around. Song Yajing handed them out one by one, wishing them a healthy New Year. She quietly noted the location, planning to come again before Spring Festival.

events.name: Her husband took their daughter to an interest class, and Song Yajing enjoyed a walk alone.
events.description: In the evening, Chen Zhiqiang took Xuanxuan to the painting class, so Song Yajing went alone for a walk around Yundang Lake. It was the first time in two weeks she had walked alone. She put on her earphones and listened to English songs, letting her thoughts drift. She thought about the store transformation, family insurance, and the New Year's Day visa interview, slowed her steps, and enjoyed the rare time alone.

events.name: After dinner, the whole family went for a walk around Yundang Lake.
events.description: At 8 p.m., the family of three was still out. Xuanxuan excitedly shared that she had learned to draw a little deer in art class. Song Yajing told her husband about the scene of handing out cookies at noon and remarked, "When faith becomes real, it is precisely the moment of reaching out like this." Chen Zhiqiang put his arm around her shoulder. As she walked, Song Yajing did a few chest-opening stretches and felt light and relaxed.

start_state.mood: Peaceful, with the lingering warmth and goodwill of Christmas.

end_state.mood: Found calm in giving; no obvious physical discomfort remains.

state.daily_exercise: Walked for 60 minutes in total

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, temperature 9-15°C, northeast wind force 2.

2025-12.daily_overview: Saturday marked a career milestone: Song Yajing officially invited Xiaomei to become a partner, and the store's operation entered a new stage. During the evening family walk, she felt both unease about handing over some authority and responsibility and a firm resolve to move forward together.

events.name: Morning in-store inventory and preparation for the conversation.
events.description: Saturday morning customer traffic was lighter. While Xiaomei was organizing the storage room, Song Yajing copied the key points of the partnership agreement she had drafted into her notebook. She reviewed Xiaomei's performance over the past year—from awkward reception work to independently handling customer complaints now—and felt the time was ripe. Then she asked the clerk to watch the store for a while and invited Xiaomei to the small rest area at the back of the store.

events.name: Formally inviting Xiaomei to become a partner
events.description: In the small rest area, Song Yajing candidly explained that because of her back pain and her family members needing more companionship, she hoped Xiao Mei would invest in the store and become a partner, holding a 12% stake and mainly responsible for daily operations, while she herself would shift to product selection and the community. After a moment of surprise, Xiao Mei's eyes turned red and she said she had always regarded the store as her home and was willing to work hard together. The two signed the memorandum of agreement and took a group photo. Song Yajing said, "From today on, you are also the boss."

events.name: Having a celebratory dessert with Xiaomei
events.description: After signing, the two walked to a nearby dessert shop and ordered tiramisu and fruit tea. Xiaomei asked a little nervously about their division of responsibilities after becoming partners, and Song Yajing explained each one, promising to take her to the spring Guangzhou ordering fair. Xiaomei smiled and said, "Going from shop assistant to boss feels like a dream." They clinked glasses, and the atmosphere was relaxed.

events.name: She told her husband the news and shared her joy.
events.description: On the way home in the afternoon, Song Yajing called Chen Zhiqiang and excitedly told him that Xiao Mei had agreed to the partnership. Her husband was happy for her and said that this way she could also take better care of herself and their daughter. Song Yajing hung up, stood at the street corner, took a deep breath, and felt as if a huge burden had been lifted from her shoulders.

events.name: After dinner, the whole family went for a walk around Yundang Lake.
events.description: The evening walk was unusually relaxing. Song Yajing took the initiative to hold her husband's arm and talked about wanting to take their daughter out for more outdoor activities on weekends. Xuanxuan ran and jumped ahead, and she no longer felt as anxious as usual about not replying to shop messages. The surface of Yundang Lake was as calm as a mirror, reflecting the sparse stars.

start_state.mood: Slightly nervous, but determined to complete the partnership plan.

end_state.mood: Relieved, relaxed, and full of anticipation for how tasks will be divided in the future.

state.daily_exercise: Take a 30-minute walk

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, light breeze, temperature 8-14°C

2025-12.daily_overview: Sunday was fulfilling: in the morning I attended the church's annual visit sharing meeting, in the afternoon I completed the year-end inventory and made a healthy menu for January, and in the evening I rewarded myself with a Coach bag using the profits from the co-branded items, marking the formal establishment of my self-worth recognition.

events.name: Attend Sunday Mass.
events.description: At 9 in the morning, Song Yajing went alone to church for Sunday Mass (her husband stayed home to look after their daughter). Today she prayed especially for her mother Lin Xiuying and her close friend Zhao Li. After Mass, she stayed for the annual sharing session of the Charity Visiting Group.

events.name: Reviewing service insights at the annual visit sharing session
events.description: The sharing session started at 10:30 in the morning. Song Yajing sat next to Aunt Lin. When it was her turn to speak, she stood up and candidly said that at first she hadn't known what to say when visiting patients, but later she realized that all she needed to do was hold the other person's hand and listen. When she mentioned visiting Grandma Zhang and cutting her nails, her voice choked up a little. She said she had gained peace and strength through serving and would continue to take part in the new year. The fellow believers present applauded.

events.name: Plan the healthy menu for next January and purchase the ingredients
events.description: After lunch, Song Yajing sat in the study and finalized the January menu based on the previous diet summary, adding more chickpea salad variations and lemon-herb salmon. She then used her phone to place an order on a fresh grocery app for olive oil, salmon fillets, canned chickpeas, and so on. Half an hour later, the delivery person knocked on the door and delivered the order. She neatly put the ingredients into the refrigerator, thinking that a health plan should be as systematic as her store.

events.name: Completed the shop's year-end bookkeeping and profit verification (initially miscalculated).
events.description: At 3 p.m., Song Yajing went to the store and closed the door. At the computer, she carefully checked the total revenue, costs, and net profit for 2025. In the middle, because she mistakenly entered an extra zero in the purchase price of a batch from Guangzhou, the net profit appeared falsely low. She broke out in a sweat from anxiety, and only after rechecking every item did she restore the correct numbers. The final accounting showed revenue up 18% year-on-year. Although it did not reach the 20% target set at the beginning of the year, because the co-branded products had a high gross margin, net profit increased instead. The co-branded products contributed 22% of sales. Looking at these numbers, she revealed a satisfied smile.

events.name: Took her daughter to pick out a Coach tote bag as a self-reward.
events.description: After checking the accounts, Song Yajing decided to treat herself with part of the profit from the co-branded collection. She picked up her daughter Xuanxuan and took the bus to SM Shopping Center. At the Coach counter, she asked Xuanxuan to help pick a color, and her daughter pointed at the oak brown and said, "This one is like Mom." After trying it on, Song Yajing resolutely bought it. While the sales associate wrapped it, she softly said to herself in the mirror, "You deserve it." Xuanxuan mimicked her nearby, which amused her.

events.name: Return home to show off the new bag and share the joy
events.description: When she got home in the evening, Song Yajing showed her new bag to her husband Chen Zhiqiang, explaining the results of the inventory check and the meaning behind buying it. Her husband smiled and said she should have bought it earlier, then revealed that he had used part of his year-end bonus to order a down jacket for her as a New Year gift. Song Yajing, pleasantly surprised, patted him on the shoulder, and the couple hugged. Xuanxuan was fiddling with the bag and asked to put her drawing inside.

events.name: After dinner, the whole family went for a walk around Yundang Lake.
events.description: Even though the day was busy, the evening walk was not skipped. Song Yajing kept her back straight and even jogged a few steps during the walk to see how her waist reacted. She seriously described her future work plans after the partnership to her husband, and said they should watch the first movie of the new year together. Xuanxuan pulled the two of them over to the swing, and laughter echoed.

start_state.mood: Full of the desire to summarize and sort things out, looking forward to a moment of reward.

end_state.mood: Felt pride and consolation in her efforts over the past year, and her sense of self-worth was enhanced.

state.daily_exercise: Take a 30-minute walk

date_attribute.weather: Sunny to cloudy, 10-16°C, light breeze.

2025-12.daily_overview: On a Monday workday, the arrival of her husband's year-end bonus added warmth to the family. After the couple discussed how to allocate it, Song Yajing put more energy into gathering materials for the year-end review, and during their evening walk they exchanged little aspirations for the new year.

events.name: Handled spring clothing pre-sale at the shop on workdays.
events.description: After opening the shop in the morning, Song Yajing found several inquiries about spring clothing on the WeChat Official Account, so she worked with Xiaomei to edit an image-and-text post and start the pre-sale. She put the plus-size styles on the cover and specifically noted that they could be reserved. Within an hour of posting, they received 5 pre-orders. She took a screenshot and sent it to Xiaomei, and the two high-fived.

events.name: Her husband informed her that the year-end bonus had arrived and they discussed how to use it.
events.description: At noon, Chen Zhiqiang sent a message saying that his year-end bonus of about 20,000 yuan had arrived. After a brief discussion, the couple decided that 5,000 yuan of it would be used to increase the budget for the upcoming health insurance, and that they would also buy warm winter clothing and gifts for both sets of parents, with the rest going into the family emergency fund. Song Yajing felt that their financial partnership was becoming more and more well-coordinated.

events.name: Received regional specialties mailed by college classmate Zhao Min from Hangzhou
events.description: In the afternoon, a courier came to the door. Zhao Min had sent West Lake lotus root powder and Longjing tea. The card read, 'I heard your back is recovering well. These are good for the stomach. See you at the New Year.' Song Yajing immediately thanked her in the class group and made an appointment to meet up in Xiamen during the Spring Festival. She put the lotus root powder away in the kitchen, planning to prepare it for Xuanxuan to drink tomorrow morning.

events.name: In the afternoon, organized monthly data for the year-end review.
events.description: Taking advantage of the store's quiet afternoon, Song Yajing exported the December sales report, community interaction data, and expense details, and filed them into the annual review folder. She also pulled up the rehabilitation training check-in chart and the weight change curve screenshot, to be used on the 31st. Seeing how busy she was, Xiaomei voluntarily took on more of the reception work.

events.name: After dinner, the whole family went for a walk around Yundang Lake.
events.description: During the 8 p.m. evening walk, Song Yajing discussed with her husband what to buy for both sets of parents. She wanted to buy her mother-in-law a cashmere vest. Her husband said his father-in-law liked tea, so they could buy a set of purple clay teapots. Xuanxuan sang a newly learned nursery rhyme to herself, and the family savored the quiet, steady sense of security in the calm night air at the end of the year.

start_state.mood: Surrounded by a sense of year-end achievement, she worked methodically.

end_state.mood: Mulling over New Year plans, with the reassuring feeling of steady family finances.

state.daily_exercise: Take a 30-minute walk

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, temperature 11-17°C, light breeze

2025-12.daily_overview: On Tuesday, complete the last core training session of the year. In the afternoon and evening, do a year-end inventory check and sales data analysis with Xiaomei, closing out 2025 with numbers and optimizing next year's purchasing strategy—logic and sweat go hand in hand.

events.name: Seventh core training session, preparing for the next phase
events.description: At 8 a.m., Song Yajing completed the last core training session of this phase at the gym. The coach assessed that her core endurance had improved from 4 to 7 out of 10, and suggested adding kettlebell swings and jogging in the next phase. Wiping sweat, she thought that maybe she could resume morning running in the new year, feeling excited. She drew a little trophy in her training log and posted on Moments: “Last training session of 2025, keep moving forward in 2026!” earning likes from her coach and close friends.

events.name: Organize the materials needed for inventory.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Song Yajing and Xiaomei prepared for stocktaking in the store: checking the barcode scanner battery, printing the latest inventory list, and preparing red sale tags. She separately marked the items that had been slow-moving for over 6 months and the one-off items area, planning to focus on them during data review.

events.name: Full inventory scan and verification after closing the store
events.description: After closing at 8 p.m., the two scanned items one by one and compared the actual inventory with the system data. They found that several styles of autumn/winter layering tops had one fewer physical item than the system showed; suspecting it was lost in the fitting room, Xiaomei marked it. They moved all slow-moving items, one-off pieces, and damaged goods into the clearance area, put eye-catching red labels on them, and prepared for a pre-New Year's Day sale.

events.name: Exported full-year sales data and identified key issues
events.description: After inventory was completed around 10 o’clock, Song Yajing opened her computer and exported the annual sales details from the WeChat mall and Kuaituantuan. When she expanded the pivot table, she was surprised to see that demand for plus-size women’s clothing exceeded 15%, but procurement accounted for only 5%, while basic T-shirts had a return rate as high as 12% due to fabric issues. The two looked at each other and instantly understood the main direction to focus on.

events.name: Finalize the New Year procurement adjustment plan.
events.description: Based on the data, Song Yajing immediately wrote an adjustment plan in her phone memo: increase the procurement share of plus-size women's clothing to 20% for spring 2026, and strictly screen suppliers for fabric and fit of basic T-shirts, with a goal of reducing the return rate to below 5%. She shared the plan with Xiaomei and supplier Susan for reference, setting the tone for the new year's cooperation.

events.name: Organize and file the inventory results
events.description: Before midnight, Song Yajing organized the inventory list and procurement adjustment plan into an electronic document, saved it in a folder named "2026 Restart Plan", and marked a to-do item to contact three new fabric suppliers after the Spring Festival. She patted Xiaomei on the shoulder and said, "You've worked hard. We'll do better next year." Then she returned home and finished the final filing work in the bedroom.

start_state.mood: A sense of ceremony on the final day of training, curious and focused on reviewing the data.

end_state.mood: A clear decisiveness brought by data, with a strong sense of direction for next year

state.daily_exercise: Core training for 50 minutes; no walking (inventory count instead).

2025-12.daily_overview: She spent the last day of the year in a deep annual review, from checking insurance coverage, reviewing store data, recording physical changes, to writing down interpersonal commitments. She drew a tree of life in her diary and ended 2025 with the New Year's wish of 'take root, go downward, and live.' She also prepared to share her warm reflections as the first post in the New Year community group.

events.name: Family financial review and insurance coverage check.
events.description: At 10 a.m., Song Yajing sat at the dining table with her husband Chen Zhiqiang and opened the family ledger. She confirmed that this year's family security fund had saved 90,000 yuan, and the education fund and travel fund were also proceeding as planned. The two put the New Year's Day interview materials (ID card, copy of medical records) into a document folder. She let out a long sigh of relief, feeling that her sense of security had grown even thicker.

events.name: Watching and encouraging daughter's New Year's Day party performance
events.description: At 11 a.m., the whole family went to the kindergarten to watch Xuanxuan's New Year's Day party. Xuanxuan was one of the lead dancers in the dance 'Little Star'. She forgot a few moves but had a bright smile. Song Yajing recorded the whole time, clapped enthusiastically at the end, and said to her daughter, "You are already mommy's little dancer." After returning home, Xuanxuan excitedly hung up her performance costume and said she wanted to go on stage again.

events.name: Prepare New Year's Eve dinner and chat about family matters.
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing and her husband cooked a simple New Year's Eve dinner together, making Minnan braised noodles, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and a ready-made roast chicken. During the meal, they talked about how their daughter had become more confident in kindergarten, and her husband also mentioned the year-end summary at his software company. Song Yajing revealed that she wanted to pick up French dessert classes again next year, but she would not insist on perfection. The couple agreed to watch the movie 'Starry Night' together on New Year's Day.

events.name: Annual key outcomes review for the store
events.description: At 8 p.m., Song Yajing sat in front of the computer in her study, systematically reviewing the store: revenue increased 18% year over year. Although it did not reach 20%, net profit increased; co-branded items contributed 22% of sales; Xiaomei officially became a partner with a 12% stake. She solemnly recorded this as the first year of the partnership system. Looking at the screen, she felt a freedom no longer bound by numbers.

events.name: Personal physical and mental changes and relationship reflection.
events.description: At 8:45, she turned to personal data: her weight had risen from 47 kg to 48.5 kg, and she decided to include gaining weight to 48-50 kg in her New Year's plan. The breast hyperplasia found in her checkup had not continued to develop, which relieved her somewhat. Her relationship with her husband had warmed up again, and the dedicated time every Friday made her feel gratified. Then she remembered that her best friend Zhao Li had decided to have a negotiated divorce after the Spring Festival. She once again confirmed in her heart her promise to accompany her throughout, and wrote 'Walk with her' in her diary.

events.name: Drawing the annual Tree of Life
events.description: At 9:30, Song Yajing took out a new diary and colored pencils. On the New Year page, she drew a sturdy tree, with every leaf and fruit labeled with important people, events, and things. She specially added a fruit labeled Children's Painting for her daughter's painting competition on December 6. On the trunk, she wrote the names Zhiqiang, Xuanxuan, Mom and Dad, parents-in-law, older sister, Zhao Li, Xiao Mei, Meiling, Jiajia, and Minmin, and at the roots she wrote in bold: take root, grow downward, live.

events.name: Wrote insights from church visits as the community's New Year sharing
events.description: After finishing the tree painting, it was about 10 o'clock. She looked back on the patient visit on December 14, and a warm current surged in her heart. So she opened her notes and wrote 'Stop Demanding Love, and Learn to Give,' telling of the wonder of giving in a gentle tone. She scheduled the article to be sent to the regular customer group at 8 a.m. on January 1, with the message, 'May we illuminate each other in our imperfection in the new year.' This became her first New Year's gift to set the tone for the community.

events.name: New Year's Eve pillow talk with my husband
events.description: Close to eleven, her husband Chen Zhiqiang walked to the study door, handed her a cup of warm water, and asked, "Where do you want to travel next year?" Song Yajing capped her pen, turned around and replied with a smile, "Don't rush. First we stay alive, then we live well." The two stood side by side on the balcony. In the distance outside the window, sporadic fireworks rose into the sky. They interlocked their fingers, keeping each other's silence amid the noise, until the night breeze turned cool.

events.name: Wrapping up the annual review and preparing to rest
events.description: At 11:30 at night, Song Yajing locked her diary in the drawer, tiptoed into her daughter's room to tuck in the blanket, and then returned to the bedroom. Lying in bed, she replayed the branches of the tree of life in her mind and felt a sense of solidity she had never experienced before. She silently prayed for her family's safety in the new year, nestled against her husband, and welcomed the new year with a peaceful heart.

start_state.mood: Nostalgia and anticipation interwoven, solemn yet warm.

end_state.mood: Boundless gratitude and the power of taking root; the new year begins with calm.

state.daily_exercise: No dedicated exercise; walked about 3,000 steps to the performance

date_attribute.weather: Clear and sunny, with a gentle breeze in the afternoon, autumn is gradually showing.

2025-10.daily_overview: National Day was also the tenth wedding anniversary. After persisting with a short morning run at dawn, she handled insurance and reviewed the livestream in the morning, and was busy at the store until late in the afternoon, which made them nearly an hour late for the anniversary dinner with her husband, triggering a candid but painful conversation between the couple. While walking by the lake, they agreed to set aside exclusive time for just the two of them on the 1st of every month, injecting healing strength into their marriage.

events.name: Brief morning run at dawn.
events.description: Despite the National Day holiday, Song Yajing still changed into her sportswear at 6:40 as usual and went to Zhongshan Park for a jog. Because her schedule was full today, she only ran for 15 minutes (about 1.5 kilometers) before hurrying home, buying soy milk and fried dough sticks for breakfast on the way. She knew the holiday might disrupt her routine, but decided to at least get out the door.

events.name: Early morning: set aside family insurance premium
events.description: After waking up in the early morning, Song Yajing followed the insurance-specific plan in the family's electronic ledger, using mobile banking to transfer the month's insurance premium to the deduction account, ensuring that the mid-month payment date wouldn't be forgotten due to the holiday. This is a financial habit developed from years of reminders by her mother, Lin Xiuying.

events.name: Reviewed the first month's live-streaming program and thanked loyal fans offline
events.description: In the morning at her desk at home, Song Yajing organized the data and feedback from the past month's Tuesday and Thursday morning livestream segment. The loyal fan Lao Lin attended almost every session. She contacted Lao Lin via WeChat to meet at a fast food restaurant on Zhongshan Road at noon, thanked him in person, and gave him a set of autumn women's clothing (saying it was for his younger sister). Lao Lin was moved and said the livestream had added a warm human voice to his days of caring for his child alone.

events.name: Contact designer Lin Yue to express intention for a collaboration.
events.description: After lunch, behind the store's checkout counter, Song Yajing sent an email to independent designer Lin Yue, whom she had met on a fashion forum three weeks earlier, elaborating on her boutique's positioning with women in the community as the core customer base, and her co-branding concept of incorporating Lin Yue's clean-line designs into everyday commuter wear. This was an important step in her search for differentiated competitiveness for the store.

events.name: Came home late because she was taking measurements and choosing styles for a regular customer and her friends.
events.description: In the afternoon, an old customer brought her soon-to-be-married best friend to the store to choose bridesmaid dresses. Song Yajing received them warmly, took measurements herself, and recommended three styles in different looks based on the wedding venue, having the guests try them on and adjust one by one. The customers were very satisfied and ordered two dresses. By the time she saw them off, it was past seven in the evening and the sky had darkened.

events.name: Hurried to the wedding anniversary dinner.
events.description: Song Yajing hastily locked the shop's rolling shutter door and, without even changing out of her work apron, stood by the roadside and ordered a car on her phone. With Zhongshan Road congested during the holiday, she watched the slowly moving vehicle icon on her phone and her palms began to sweat slightly. She sent her husband Chen Zhiqiang two WeChat messages in a row, but only received a cold OK emoji.

events.name: Lateness triggers a silent standoff between the couple.
events.description: Song Yajing almost ran into the reserved Western restaurant. Chen Zhiqiang was sitting alone by the window, and the glass of red wine in front of him was already half empty. When he looked up at her, his eyes were calm, and he said in a low voice, "You're here." Song Yajing apologized repeatedly. After a moment of silence, Chen Zhiqiang said in a nearly detached tone, "Today is our tenth anniversary, and I still cleared my schedule. But every time, it seems like I'm the one waiting. In your ranking, I always seem to come last." The words pierced Song Yajing's heart like a thin needle. The two then finished their appetizers and main courses in silence.

events.name: A proposal to mend the relationship on the way home.
events.description: After dinner, the two walked along Yundang Lake toward the parking lot. The autumn night breeze over the lake was cool. Song Yajing took a deep breath, took the initiative to hold her husband's arm, and said softly, "Zhiqiang, what happened today was my fault. I've thought of a way — from now on, on the evening of the first day of every month, no matter how busy we are, that time will belong only to the two of us. The shop can close early, and we can ask Mom or Aunt Zhang to look after our daughter for a while. Would you be willing to try?" Chen Zhiqiang stopped, turned to look at her, his eyes slightly red. After a moment of silence, he nodded firmly and held her hand tightly. This agreement became an important healing ritual in their marriage.

events.name: Organizing a list of autumn style preferences
events.description: After returning home and washing up, Song Yajing used the quiet moment before bed when her daughter had already fallen asleep to open the memo app on her phone and go through, one by one, the records of fitting discussions with regular customers Vivian, Lao Lin, and other customers, as well as the fitting feedback from the past two weeks compiled by shop assistant Xiaomei. She compiled a list of preferences and a size distribution table for the Xiamen market this autumn for trench coats, knitwear, and skirts, to use in the next day’s video call with supplier Susan. When she finished, it was already almost midnight. She glanced at her husband sleeping soundly beside her and gently turned off the light.

start_state.mood: Slightly tired but full of expectation; today is both National Day and the tenth wedding anniversary

end_state.mood: Some insomnia, with the sting of the relationship and the warmth after repair intertwined.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run for 15 minutes (about 1.5 km)

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, muggy in the afternoon

2025-10.daily_overview: On the second day of the National Day holiday, Song Yajing did not rest completely. In the morning, she handled peak-season stocking work at home, such as selecting products from videos and confirming orders, and squeezed in time to bake a batch of cookies to take on tomorrow's trip. In the afternoon, she prepared together with her husband for the family trip to Volcanic Island. The atmosphere between the couple had clearly warmed up because of last night's agreement.

events.name: Schedule a video product-selection time with supplier Susan.
events.description: While seeing her husband off to buy breakfast early in the morning, Song Yajing contacted supplier Susan in Guangzhou via WeChat to schedule a video call at 10 a.m. to discuss the autumn new collection order and fabrics for the co-branded series. Susan quickly replied OK and attached a digital catalog of the autumn new collection.

events.name: Browse the catalog and shortlist fall styles.
events.description: After breakfast, Song Yajing sat on the living-room sofa, drinking fruit tea while browsing the autumn new-arrival catalog Susan had sent on her phone. Combining the customer preference list she had sorted out the day before, she selected 15 trench coats, knit tops, and skirts that suited Xiamen's autumn climate and local aesthetic, and beside three of the knit tops she noted possible modifications for a collaboration. Her daughter Chen Lexuan came over, pointed at a maroon trench coat, and said, "Mom looks good in this." She smiled and patted her daughter's head.

events.name: Video call to confirm order and fabric details
events.description: At 10 a.m., Susan made the video call right on time. The two first caught up on how each other's children were doing, then got down to business. Song Yajing confirmed the order quantity, size ratio, and delivery time for each of the 15 styles, especially emphasizing that the goods must arrive in the first week after the holiday. They then focused on the poplin and jacquard fabrics that might be used for the co-branded collection, and Susan promised to send swatch samples next week. The call lasted about forty minutes.

events.name: Input into the system and notify Xiaomei of the new product plan.
events.description: After the video call ended, Song Yajing opened the store management backend and entered the confirmed order information into the system. Then she sent a WeChat voice message to store assistant Xiaomei, telling her the arrival time of the new items and asking her to come to the store early to help unpack and hang the samples. Xiaomei quickly replied, 'Got it, sis, don't worry.'

events.name: Baking cookies for her daughter
events.description: At noon, her daughter clamored for cookies, so Song Yajing tied on an apron and baked a tray of butter cookies using ingredients from the kitchen. She deliberately made extra, leaving some for her daughter and wrapping up the rest to take as snacks on the road tomorrow. Her daughter pressed out star shapes with cookie cutters beside her, and when the oven began to smell fragrant, she sneaked two pieces of raw dough while her mother wasn't looking.

events.name: Prepare for tomorrow's trip to Volcano Island.
events.description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang packed their luggage together. Chen Zhiqiang was responsible for checking the car and downloading offline maps; Song Yajing packed clothes for the three of them, sunscreen, and their daughter's sand toys, and put the cookies baked in the morning into the snack bag. Chen Zhiqiang confirmed that the scenic area tickets had been booked and sent a screenshot of the QR code to the family group chat. After packing, the two smiled at each other; the stuffy feeling from the restaurant the previous night had mostly dissipated.

start_state.mood: Although she was somewhat sleep-deprived, the sense of reassurance from last night's agreement made her feel calm when she woke up in the morning.

end_state.mood: Anticipation of the trip dominated the mood, the couple interacted naturally and affectionately, and they looked forward to tomorrow with hope.

state.daily_exercise: None (preparing to travel during the holiday).

date_attribute.weather: Clear skies, strong UV rays by the sea.

2025-10.daily_overview: On the third day of the National Day holiday, the whole family drove to Zhangzhou Volcano Island, starting a short three-day, two-night trip. The geological museum and the cliff-side sea view thrilled their daughter. The couple rarely put down their phones and work at the same time, focusing wholeheartedly on accompanying their child to explore nature. In the evening, at the homestay, Yajing received an email from designer Lin Yue expressing interest in a collaboration, a positive signal for her career.

events.name: Visited the Volcano Island Geological Museum.
events.description: After checking in in the morning, the whole family walked to the geological museum in the scenic area. The museum displayed basalt columnar jointing specimens and a dynamic model of volcanic eruptions. Daughter Chen Lexuan was deeply fascinated and held Song Yajing's hand while asking repeatedly, "Why do rocks erupt from underground?" "Are there dinosaurs?" Song Yajing squatted down and patiently explained. Chen Zhiqiang quietly captured a side view of mother and daughter looking at the exhibit board with their heads together. The family stayed in the small museum for nearly an hour and a half.

events.name: Afternoon walk in the scenic area and rest at the homestay.
events.description: After leaving the museum, the family drank iced coconut juice at a coconut stall to cool off, then strolled along the cliff path, looking out at the black sand beach and the sea-eroded landforms. When the sun was strongest in the afternoon, they returned to the guesthouse. Their daughter flipped through a mineral booklet bought at the museum on the tatami, Song Yajing leaned by the bed and took a 20-minute nap, while Chen Zhiqiang tested his drone on the terrace. In the evening, once it had cooled down, the three went out again and walked barefoot on the black sand beach, watching the sunset dye the sea orange.

events.name: Received an email from designer Lin Yue.
events.description: In the evening at the guesthouse, while checking her mobile email, Song Yajing saw that independent designer Lin Yue had replied to the co-branding intention email she had sent on October 1. Lin Yue expressed great interest in the letter and asked about details such as the initial order quantity and target price range. Song Yajing excitedly showed it to her husband. After a brief discussion, they decided to follow up in detail after the holiday.

start_state.mood: Feeling light and excited about the imminent departure; she checked the small backpack prepared for her child three times.

end_state.location: Homestay at Zhangzhou Volcano Island Scenic Area.
end_state.mood: Fulfilled and content. The novelty of the seaside brought more smiles to the whole family. Before bed, her daughter's words 'Today is the happiest day of my life' made her feel that all the trouble was worth it.

state.daily_exercise: Walked approximately 12,000 steps (sightseeing on foot in the scenic area).

date_attribute.weather: Partly sunny with clouds, comfortable sea breeze

2025-10.daily_overview: Saturday was also the fourth day of the National Day holiday. In the morning, the whole family rode bikes on the beach; in the afternoon they played on the sand and ran into regular customer Vivian and her boyfriend, who joined them. After returning to the guesthouse, Song Yajing took an hour to attend the third session of her online English speaking course, finding a brief balance between accompanying her family and self-improvement.

events.name: Cycling at the beach and a new discovery with her daughter.
events.description: In the morning, the whole family rented a four-person bicycle and rode along the coastline. The sea breeze blew in their faces. Their daughter sat in the back seat and excitedly pointed at the old fishing boats docked by the roadside and a stretch of gleaming white salt fields. It was the first time she had seen sea salt crystals with her own eyes. Chen Zhiqiang stopped the bike and took his daughter closer to the salt field. He dipped a finger into the salt grains and let her taste. The way she frowned made the whole family laugh. Song Yajing took out her phone and photographed the scene from afar.

events.name: Afternoon shell picking on the beach and a seafood dinner.
events.description: In the afternoon after low tide, the family gathered shells and small volcanic stones on the beach. My daughter's little plastic bucket quickly filled with shell fragments of all colors. During this time, we happened to run into regular customer Vivian and her boyfriend, who were also playing nearby. The four of us exchanged brief pleasantries and took a group photo. In the evening, following the recommendation of the B&B owner, we found a small fisherman-run restaurant and ordered a table of local seafood: steamed grouper, boiled shrimp, and assorted small fish in soy sauce. My daughter got her hands all oily from eating the shrimp.

events.name: Attended the third online English speaking class.
events.description: After dinner, back at the guesthouse, while her husband took their daughter to watch the stars in the courtyard, Song Yajing opened her tablet and attended the third session of the online intensive English speaking workshop. Today's topic was "asking for directions and emergency help." She practiced a simulated dialogue with a participant from Anhui. Though she stumbled a bit, she no longer dared not to speak like in the first class. After class, she also practiced pronunciation in front of the mirror for ten minutes.

start_state.location: Homestay at Zhangzhou Volcano Island Scenic Area.
start_state.mood: Woken by the sea breeze and birdsong, feeling refreshed, and unconsciously humming a tune

end_state.location: Homestay at Zhangzhou Volcano Island Scenic Area.
end_state.mood: The small progress in English class made her feel satisfied with herself; her daughter's cheers and the sea breeze mixed into an unforgettable memory.

state.daily_exercise: Cycled for about an hour and walked about 8,000 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, with scattered light rain in the evening

2025-10.daily_overview: Last day of the trip. In the morning, we took a precious drone family photo on the pitch-black basalt platform, and in the afternoon drove back to Xiamen. After returning home, Song Yajing and her daughter edited the travel video together, preparing for the Mid-Autumn reunion dinner the next day. In the evening, her husband Chen Zhiqiang brought up whether they wanted a second child, sparking a nighttime conversation blended with relaxation and deep thought.

events.name: Made initial contact with the Hangzhou designer introduced by former colleague Zheng Kai.
events.description: Early in the morning before checkout, former colleague Zheng Kai sent a WeChat message introducing Chen Siyuan, an independent designer from Hangzhou. Song Yajing had a brief text exchange with Chen Siyuan, and they initially discussed the intention to collaborate on a joint new Chinese-style womenswear project. Chen Siyuan was interested in the community-based operation model in the Xiamen market, and they agreed to meet in Xiamen on October 12 for an in-person meeting. This introduction from an old colleague put Song Yajing into work mode early at the end of her trip.

events.name: Drone family photo on the basalt tableland.
events.description: In the morning, they went to the scenic area's iconic black basalt platform. Chen Zhiqiang unfolded the foldable drone. The family stood in front of the columnar jointed basalt pillars, with the sea behind them, as the drone slowly rose. Song Yajing held her daughter's hand, and the daughter waved the long seashell she had picked up yesterday. Seeing the image on his phone screen, Chen Zhiqiang shouted to them, "Smile naturally, don't look at the drone," and only stopped after taking more than a dozen shots to his satisfaction. This photo was later enlarged, printed, framed, and hung on the store's family photo wall.

events.name: Return drive to Xiamen and a break en route.
events.description: Around 1 pm, they left the scenic area and headed back to Xiamen along the Shenhai Expressway. Traffic was heavy during the National Day holiday return. Chen Zhiqiang drove the whole way, while Song Yajing sat in the front passenger seat sorting travel photos on her phone; their daughter slept in the car seat in the back. The car made a brief stop at the Zhangzhou service area, where the family each bought a hot drink before getting back on the road. They arrived home on Hubin South Road in Xiamen just before 6 pm, with a light drizzle falling in the sky.

events.name: Mother and daughter collaborate on editing a travel short film
events.description: After dinner, Song Yajing sat on the living room sofa with her daughter Chen Lexuan snuggled beside her. The mother and daughter used a mobile video editing app to cut the three days of video footage into a short film of about two minutes. The daughter was in charge of picking the clips, and Song Yajing was in charge of adding subtitles and music. Her daughter insisted on putting 'Chen Lexuan's Trip' at the beginning of the video — even though it was already autumn now. When the finished video was previewed on the TV, Chen Zhiqiang came out of the kitchen with fruit and watched it, completely absorbed. The short film would be shown to her maternal grandparents, who were coming from Quanzhou, during tomorrow evening's Mid-Autumn Festival reunion dinner.

events.name: Evening topic: having a second child.
events.description: Just before bed, Chen Zhiqiang suddenly asked softly, 'Have you ever thought about giving Xuanxuan a little brother or sister?' Song Yajing was taken aback. The two exchanged views on practical matters such as store management, allocation of energy, and living space, but reached no clear conclusion. Yet Chen Zhiqiang's eyes showed expectation, while Song Yajing felt a mix of happiness and pressure. In the end, they held each other and fell asleep in silence.

events.name: University classmate Zhou Ting is going through the resignation process in Shenzhen.
events.description: Meanwhile, Zhou Ting, a college classmate far away in Shenzhen, was going through her final resignation procedures at the company, organizing documents and handing over access. She sent a message in the three-person group chat saying she would take the high-speed rail back to Xiamen tomorrow, but Song Yajing was helping her daughter take a bath at the moment and had not seen it yet.

start_state.location: Homestay at Zhangzhou Volcano Island Scenic Area.
start_state.mood: With the reluctance of leaving and the anticipation of taking a family portrait this morning

end_state.mood: Physically exhausted, but her spirit was lifted at the same time by Zheng Kai's news and the success of the short film. The long-missed family time made her step back into her roles as wife and mother with more ease than before she left; the topic of a second child stirred ripples in her heart.

state.daily_exercise: In the morning, walked on the terrace for about an hour; about 10,000 steps in total for the day.

date_attribute.weather: The autumn sky is clear and crisp, and the full moon is bright at night.

2025-10.daily_overview: Mid-Autumn Festival. During the day, Song Yajing was busy with community group buys and store preparations. In the afternoon, her parents arrived from Quanzhou for a reunion. She tried baking mooncakes but ended up failing, yet the whole family happily ate them anyway. At 4:30 p.m., she began preparing the reunion dinner; at 5:30 p.m., the family ate together and played a travel short film. In the evening, the whole family enjoyed the moon and pomelos on the balcony. Her daughter's innocent gesture and the late-night message from Zhou Ting brought unexpected warmth to the Mid-Autumn night.

events.name: Launched a Mid-Autumn Festival group buying event in the community
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing initiated a group-buying event for Mid-Autumn mooncake gift boxes in the customer WeChat group. She confirmed with neighbors and a few regular customers the number of boxes and pickup method for the co-branded mooncake gift box with Zhao Li Floral Art. She suggested that everyone handwrite greeting cards to each other, and she would distribute them at the store. The group members responded enthusiastically, and soon twenty orders were gathered.

events.name: Daughter drew a 'Most Handsome Dad' award certificate.
events.description: In the morning, Chen Zhiqiang sat on the living room sofa working on his laptop, while his daughter Chen Lexuan spread out crayons and colored paper on the coffee table beside him and drew quietly for a long time. When she finished, she held her artwork up with both hands and announced, “I’m giving Dad a certificate of merit.” On the paper was a simple drawing of a person wearing glasses, with the words “Handsomest Dad” written beside it in crooked letters, and it was covered with lopsided stars. Chen Zhiqiang took it solemnly, taped it with clear tape to the most prominent spot on the refrigerator door, turned to his daughter and said, “This is the greatest award Daddy has ever received in his life.”

events.name: Attempted to bake mooncakes but failed.
events.description: At noon, Song Yajing ambitiously tried to make snow skin mooncakes at home, but added too much water when kneading the dough, and the filling poked out. Chen Zhiqiang and their daughter stood at the kitchen doorway, amused by her flustered attempts. The final products were lopsided, but after taking a bite, their daughter loudly said "Delicious!" and the family of three laughed and polished off the failed batch as a lunchtime dessert.

events.name: Mid-Autumn Festival reunion dinner and travel short video sharing
events.description: Starting at 4:30 p.m., Song Yajing helped her mother Lin Xiuying in the kitchen prepare the Mid-Autumn reunion dinner, while her father Song Minghui cooked several Minnan dishes. The meal officially began at 5:30. During the meal, Song Yajing cast the short travel video of Volcano Island that she and her daughter had edited the day before onto the TV. Her parents watched and praised it repeatedly. Her daughter proudly explained her wonderful moments in the video, and the atmosphere was lively and warm.

events.name: Shared travel journal of Volcano Island trip in the community.
events.description: After cleaning up after the meal, Song Yajing shared a travelogue of her trip to Volcano Island in a WeChat parenting group—a guide of about 500 words, with photos of the guesthouse environment and the beach, along with a booking link. Several group members immediately asked for the specific family-friendly itinerary, and she replied to each one. Someone said on the spot that they would take their family to try it next week.

events.name: Mid-Autumn Festival balcony moon viewing and warm family conversation
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing's parents Song Minghui and Lin Xiuying, together with the family of three, all five members of three generations, set up rattan chairs and a small side table on the balcony, and cut into snow skin mooncakes and a pomelo. The balcony faced Yundang Lake, with the full moon hanging high in an unobstructed sky. Lin Xiuying smiled and mentioned that she hoped to hold a second grandchild next year; Song Yajing exchanged a glance with her husband and gave a vague answer. Her daughter seriously took another bite of the failed mooncake her mother had baked, puffed out her cheeks, and said, 'No, it's not — this is the best mooncake I've ever eaten!' That sentence made Song Yajing freeze, and her eyes warmed. She realized that home is not a place for pursuing perfection, but a place for accepting each other's flaws.

events.name: Zhou Ting announced that she would return to Xiamen and arranged a get-together.
events.description: Around ten o'clock on Mid-Autumn Festival night, college classmate Zhou Ting sent a message in the three-person group chat, telling everyone that she had finished her resignation procedures and taken the high-speed rail back to her home in Xiamen. Seeing the message, Song Yajing immediately replied "Welcome back" and promptly suggested getting a meal together while the holiday was still winding down. Within a few minutes, she called and reserved a table for the evening of October 11 at a Minnan private restaurant near Zhongshan Road, and shared the location screenshot in the small group.

events.name: Record Mid-Autumn Festival reflections and share on Moments.
events.description: Before falling asleep, Song Yajing leaned against the headboard and wrote down today's reflections in her phone memo: "Xuanxuan said the mooncake with a chipped corner tastes best, and Chen Zhiqiang stuck the childish certificate on the refrigerator—I have been desperately pursuing a beautiful and decent life all these years, yet I almost missed the most authentic life because of perfectionism." She took screenshots and posted a Moments entry with the certificate on the refrigerator and the chipped mooncake as images; within just ten minutes she received dozens of likes.

start_state.mood: The relaxed feeling of the Mid-Autumn Festival morning; knowing that today is a day of reunion, the pace can slow down.

end_state.mood: Healed by her daughter's innocence, touched by her mother's hint about a second child, and moved by Zhou Ting's message. It was as if the Mid-Autumn moon had truly shone into a corner of her heart that should have been illuminated long ago.

state.daily_exercise: None (Mid-Autumn family reunion day, no exercise planned)

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with a gentle afternoon breeze

2025-10.daily_overview: The last day of the National Day holiday was a compensatory rest day. In the morning, Song Yajing took her daughter to the community park to play and ran into her neighbor Aunt Zhang, exchanging parenting tips. In the afternoon, she shifted her focus back to work: she organized the first batch of materials for the collaboration collection, picked up the developed family portrait from the photo studio, set up a photo wall in the shop, and bought the first set of gear for the new morning-run plan starting tomorrow.

events.name: Take her daughter to the community park to chat with neighbor Aunt Zhang.
events.description: The morning sun was warm. Song Yajing took her daughter to the small community park to play on the slide. Neighbor Aunt Zhang was there with her grandson, and the two sat on a bench chatting about holiday life and parenting topics. Aunt Zhang praised Song Yajing's cookie recipe and recommended a local pediatric tuina practitioner. Her daughter and Chen Zhiqiang joined later, and after a short walk, they went home.

events.name: Organize design materials for the co-branded new Chinese-style women's clothing.
events.description: In the morning at home, Song Yajing opened the chat history of her earlier brief communication with Hangzhou-based designer Chen Siyuan and organized the key points from their preliminary discussion. Drawing on the inspiration she had gained from the trip the night before, she put together about a page of design sketch notes and style copy for a co-branded New Chinese-style women's clothing line, with three keywords: earth tones, Minnan patterned tile elements, and a loose silhouette. This material would be released as the first teaser in the community group tomorrow.

events.name: Go to the photo studio to pick up the developed family photo.
events.description: After the sun had risen higher at noon, Song Yajing walked to an old-fashioned photo studio near her home to pick up the family portrait developed a few days earlier. The 12-inch family photo, shot on a basalt mesa and printed on matte paper, was ready. She studied it for a long time, feeling that the people in the photo looked particularly relaxed.

events.name: Set up a family photo wall in the shop
events.description: After picking up the photos, Song Yajing stopped by her store on Zhongshan Road on the way. Taking advantage of the light holiday foot traffic, she placed the newly picked-up family photo in a prominent spot on the family photo wall inside the store. This wall had recorded many moments since the store opened in 2020: the opening day, her daughter's first visit to the store, a photo with customers last Christmas, and this latest family photo from Volcano Island. She stepped back two paces to examine the overall effect and nodded with satisfaction.

events.name: Selecting running shoes and sportswear to prepare for morning runs.
events.description: In the afternoon, prompted by her lack of stamina during the trip and remembering that a doctor had verbally advised her to add more aerobic exercise the year before, Song Yajing made up her mind to start a regular morning running routine. She went to a sports goods store near Zhongshan Road and, on the clerk's recommendation, bought a pair of entry-level running shoes with good cushioning and two sets of breathable, quick-drying workout clothes. While trying on the shoes, she walked around the store a few times and found them more comfortable than she had expected. Walking out of the store with shopping bags, she felt a prelude to a new stage of life.

start_state.mood: The lazy feeling of the last morning of the holiday; woke up half an hour earlier than usual and ate the Quanzhou meat zongzi her father brought yesterday as breakfast.

end_state.mood: Excited about the initial concept for the co-branded collection, and also nervous and expectant about the morning run plan starting tomorrow; the two emotions were intertwined.

state.daily_exercise: Walked about 8000 steps (round trips to the park, photo studio, store, and sporting goods store).

date_attribute.weather: Clear and cool, with a morning feels-like temperature of about 18 degrees

2025-10.daily_overview: The first day back at work after the holiday was also the day Song Yajing started her new morning running plan. The morning jog along the Yundang Lake trail reminded her of a physical challenge she hadn't felt in a while, but left her refreshed. In the morning, she posted a teaser for the co-branded collection in the community group, and the outfit vlog she edited from her trip to Volcano Island sparked a group-buying boom, getting the autumn sales off to a good start.

events.name: First-day morning run (new plan started)
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, the alarm went off twice. After hesitating for a moment, Song Yajing changed into the sports clothes and running shoes she had bought yesterday and walked along Hubin South Road to the Yundang Lake trail. A thin mist hung over the lake. She ran about 2.5 kilometers at an extremely slow pace, stopping to walk twice along the way. She was out of breath the whole time but gritted her teeth and persisted. After finishing, she stood by the lake stretching, her heartbeat gradually calming. She felt more clear-headed than ever. She set herself a goal of at least three morning runs per week and not running too far at once.

events.name: Posted the intention for a co-branded new Chinese-style womenswear collection in the community
events.description: After arriving at the store in the morning, Song Yajing posted pre-launch information about the co-branded new Chinese-style women's clothing in the core customer WeChat group “Yajing Lifestyle Store.” She shared the design direction sketches compiled the day before, style keywords, and a passage about “wanting to design clothes with warmth for women in the community.” After the message was sent, more than a dozen regular customers expressed interest in the group, and four paid a 100 yuan deposit on the spot according to the instructions. Song Yajing marked this money separately in the electronic ledger.

events.name: Edited and posted an outfit vlog to drive group buying.
events.description: During a lull in customer traffic in the afternoon, Song Yajing sat behind the cash register and used her phone to edit the footage from her Volcano Island trip into a one-and-a-half-minute short video titled "Save the Plane Ticket, Travel with a Sense of Ritual." In the video, she wore two sets of autumn casual women's clothing from her own store and showcased the outfits on location by the sea, on a basalt platform, and in a homestay courtyard, explaining layering techniques and fabric features in voiceover. After the video was simultaneously posted to the community group and Moments, it generated group-buying orders for autumn outing outfits within a few hours. In just half a day, 18 orders were completed, achieving the first small sales peak after the National Day holiday. Xiaomei was busy packing shipments in the store, smiling all over.

start_state.mood: When the alarm woke me, I was still sleepy but gritted my teeth and got up; before going out, I drank a large glass of warm water.

end_state.mood: The refreshing feeling after the morning run mixed with the joy of the group-buying results. Her rhythm successfully switched from vacation to work, and she was already getting an initial sense of the energy boost that morning running brought.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of about 2.5 km (first day of morning running, alternating walking and running), walked about 7,000 steps

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning to cloudy, with afternoon showers.

2025-10.daily_overview: Resumed daily work. Because her thighs were sore from yesterday's morning run, Song Yajing chose to commute on foot as an alternative exercise. In the morning she handled store affairs, and during the lunch break she bought ingredients for basil cookies. In the afternoon, after seeing the church visitation notice in the community group, she went through an inner struggle. In the end, empathizing with her own parents, she plucked up the courage to accept the task of visiting elderly church members living alone. To make time, she left the store early and went home to bake a batch of basil cookies as gifts.

events.name: Walking to work relieved muscle soreness
events.description: There was no morning run today, because yesterday's first 3 kilometers left the fronts of her thighs and her buttocks noticeably sore. Song Yajing applied a hot towel for a while, then left half an hour early and chose to walk the whole way to the store. The forty-minute walk actually stretched her muscles considerably. She also bought coffee and a rice ball at the convenience store for breakfast.

events.name: Bible study group notice and inner struggle.
events.description: In the morning, before any customers came in, Song Yajing saw a message pop up in the WeChat group for the church's Bible study group: the group leader posted a notice arranging volunteers to visit Uncle Chen, an elderly fellow believer living alone who had just been discharged from the hospital.
