Song Yajing's first reaction was to back out — the shop had just resumed business, and she still had preliminary work for the co-branded collection in hand; there wasn't enough time. She stared at the screen for a long time, ready to type that she really couldn't squeeze it in this time, but her finger hovered over the send button without pressing it.

events.name: Summoned up the courage to accept the visit because of her parents' situation.
events.description: Hesitating, Song Yajing remembered her mother Lin Xiuying's serious illness earlier this year and her father Song Minghui's declining hearing. She thought that her parents were just as elderly—if one day they also lived alone, wouldn't they long for someone to knock on the door to keep them company and chat? With a change of heart, she bit her lip, deleted the original refusal message, and replied in the WeChat group: 'I can go. I'll bring some cookies I baked as a small gift.' After sending this, she felt an unfamiliar impulse—she had rarely volunteered for such tasks before; it was like a small step of faith from Sunday Mass into daily practice.

events.name: Purchase ingredients for basil cookies
events.description: During the lunch break (around 13:00-13:30), while Xiaomei watched the store, Song Yajing walked to the nearby supermarket and bought cake flour, butter, fresh basil leaves, sea salt, and a small pack of cheese powder according to the recipe saved on her phone. When selecting the basil, she deliberately smelled it to make sure the leaves were fresh and fragrant, thinking that elderly people might not have strong teeth, so the cookies had to be made crispier.

events.name: Bake basil cookies and package them
events.description: At 4 p.m., she left the store early and went home. Song Yajing tied on an apron and started making savory basil cookies in the kitchen. While kneading the dough, her mind wandered, and she remembered her mother teaching her to make pineapple cakes when she was young. When the cookies came out of the oven, the whole house was filled with the aroma of butter and basil. When her daughter came home from school, she smelled the scent and ran into the kitchen, reaching for a cookie. Song Yajing laughed and gently slapped her hand away, saying, “These cookies are for Uncle Chen. I've left a few for you on the dining table.” After the cookies had completely cooled, she divided them into small portions with transparent baking bags, tied them with twine, and attached a handwritten card: “Peace in the Lord, respectfully prepared by Song Yajing.”

events.name: Confirm the visit time and the people accompanying
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing contacted the person in charge of the Bible reading group via WeChat group to confirm the next day's visit arrangement: meet at the church entrance at 10 a.m., and the group leader would accompany them to Uncle Chen's home, located in an alley in the old part of Siming District. The person in charge sent a voice message saying that Uncle Chen was hard of hearing and that they might need to be patient during communication. Song Yajing copied the address into her phone map and saved it, and before going to bed checked again that the bag of cookies was tied tightly.

start_state.mood: The day after the morning run, my legs were a bit sore, but there was none of the unease I feel on days without a morning run. I plan to walk to the store today as a substitute exercise.

end_state.mood: Baking calmed her mood, and the courage to accept the visit gave her a new understanding of herself—that caring for others through action is not as frightening as she had imagined.

state.daily_exercise: Walked about 9,000 steps (didn't do the morning run; chose to walk to and from the store to increase activity).

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy to clear, muggy in the morning then turning cool

2025-10.daily_overview: In the morning, from the store, she remotely advanced the contract details of the co-branded collaboration. After lunch, she set out for her first church visit. The silent time spent accompanying Uncle Chen at his home became a quiet awakening in her spiritual life. In the evening, she confirmed the classmate gathering and helped shop assistant Xiao Mei process orders.

events.name: Morning run and handling the store's electronic contract signing matters
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, she continued her morning run. Today she ran the full 2.5 kilometers without stopping to walk. Although her pace was still slow, she felt noticeably lighter than the day before yesterday. After the run, she went home, showered, and changed. She used a WeChat video call to discuss the signing details of the co-branded contract with Hangzhou-based designer Zheng Kai (Zheng Kai's line focuses on everyday commuter wear, unlike Chen Siyuan's new Chinese-style womenswear line), including the initial order quantity, delivery time, and payment milestones. The two went through the contract terms item by item over the video call. After Song Yajing confirmed each item was correct, she completed the contract signing through the e-signature platform and arranged payment of the first deposit.

events.name: Preparing items for the visit before departure.
events.description: Returning home at noon, Song Yajing re-checked the packaging of the basil cookies she had baked last night, and cut a few sprigs of homegrown mint from the balcony, wrapping them in kraft paper as a simple bouquet. Before going out, she straightened her collar in front of the mirror, making sure she was dressed appropriately but not too formally. Chen Zhiqiang sent a WeChat message reminding her to take it slow on the way and bring a sun umbrella.

events.name: First visit to Uncle Chen, an elderly man living alone.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Song Yajing met the Bible study group leader at the church entrance, and they walked through several old alleys to Uncle Chen's home. The old man was indeed hard of hearing, and because he had just been discharged from the hospital, he was in low spirits and spoke indistinctly. Song Yajing tried to make small talk but found herself in awkward situations several times because he could not hear her. At the group leader's signal, she stopped trying to force conversation and instead took an old-song CD from the old man's bookshelf and put it in the player. When Teresa Teng's old songs began to play in the room, the old man's expression relaxed, and he gently tapped the armrest of the wooden chair with his fingers. Song Yajing simply sat beside him and listened to the entire CD with him, without any extra words.

events.name: Sitting quietly in church and writing down insights
events.description: After the visit, Song Yajing returned alone to the church and sat quietly on the last row of pews for fifteen minutes. She opened her pocket diary and wrote: "When Uncle Chen kept time with his fingers, I suddenly stopped feeling awkward. We probably said fewer than twenty words to each other, but the music expressed things for him; I only needed to sit beside him and listen. It turns out that companionship itself is already a language." Afterwards, she briefly reported on the visit in the Bible reading group's WeChat group and shared Uncle Chen's mental state.

events.name: Confirm the details of the gathering to welcome Zhou Ting.
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing confirmed the time and restaurant address for tomorrow's gathering with Zhou Ting via WeChat, and also contacted Liu Lei, a college classmate coming from Quanzhou, to ask whether he needed help booking accommodation after arriving in Xiamen. After everything was arranged, she sent the detailed time and place information in the three-person group chat.

start_state.mood: The energy from my morning run, plus the reassurance of the contract being finalized.

end_state.mood: A never-before-experienced sense of inner peace spread through her mind and body. The visiting experience made her rethink what genuine care really meant. She was a little tired but very fulfilled.

state.daily_exercise: Morning jog about 2.5 km; walked about 10,000 steps throughout the day.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with a slightly hot noon at about 28 degrees

2025-10.daily_overview: In the morning, attended the fourth session of the English speaking class, and after class returned to the shop for business. In the evening, closed early to go to Zhou Ting's welcome party. During the gathering, they chatted freely about workplace and family topics. After the party, in the parking lot, Zhou Ting pointed out the problem of idle cash in the shop's accounts, laying the groundwork for her later financial system upgrade.

events.name: Attended the fourth online English speaking class
events.description: On Saturday morning at home, Song Yajing turned on her tablet on time to attend the fourth lesson of the online English speaking workshop. Today's topic was 'Shopping and Returns.' She was paired with a student from Guangdong to simulate the scene of exchanging an item in a clothing store, and the conversation was much more fluent. After class, she was pleasantly surprised to find that her pronunciation evaluation score had improved by 5 points compared to last week.

events.name: Closed early to go to a classmate reunion
events.description: After finishing the weekend routine restocking at the store in the afternoon, Song Yajing closed an hour early and went home to change into a simple casual outfit—a white shirt and cropped pants. She took a taxi to the booked Minnan home-style restaurant, and on the way bought a small bouquet of daisies at a flower shop to give to Zhou Ting.

events.name: Welcome party for Zhou Ting and Liu Lei
events.description: At 6:30 p.m., Song Yajing arrived at the private restaurant on time to meet Zhou Ting and male classmate Liu Lei, who had come from Quanzhou. Zhou Ting looked a little thinner than three years ago, but her smile was still bright. The three ate Hokkien home-style dishes and drank Tieguanyin tea, and the conversation shifted from careers to parenting to embarrassing moments from their vocational college days. Zhao Min, far away in Hangzhou, joined the chat via video call, and the four clinked glasses on the phone screen.

events.name: Zhou Ting points out financial issues in the parking lot.
events.description: After dinner, everyone went their separate ways, but Zhou Ting and Song Yajing were still full of energy, so the two chatted for another half hour standing by their cars in the restaurant parking lot. When the conversation turned to store operations, Zhou Ting asked Song Yajing to show her the simple accounts in her phone. Zhou Ting stared at the screen for a while and quickly pointed out several problems with delayed cash recovery — there was an obvious time mismatch between the inflow of several payments and the daily cash flow. She suggested Song Yajing adopt an electronic inventory management system and separate ledger management to improve capital turnover efficiency. Song Yajing listened carefully, jotted down the key points in her phone's memo app on the spot, and sincerely thanked her.

events.name: Return home and discuss financial advice with her husband
events.description: It was already 10 PM when she drove back to the home on Hubin South Road. As soon as she entered, Song Yajing sat down in the living room and shared Zhou Ting's advice with her husband Chen Zhiqiang, who was telling their daughter a bedtime story. After their daughter fell asleep, the two moved to the living room for a long talk, discussing in detail the issue of idle cash, the pros and cons of electronic bookkeeping, and the feasibility of separate account management. Chen Zhiqiang, from a technical perspective, raised some data security precautions. They eventually agreed to move toward digitalization, trying it for one month first. Before bed, she set her alarm for the next morning, decided to resume her morning jog, and conserve energy for the important afternoon meeting.

events.name: Decided to apply for the merchant version of the cash register system
events.description: After discussing with her husband, Song Yajing used her phone that evening to look up the merchant cashier system introductions of several banks and decided to contact account manager Lin Xiaofeng next week to inquire about activation. She wrote the first item on next week's to-do list in her memo: "Meet with Manager Lin in person."

start_state.mood: On Saturday she didn't have to rush to open the shop early. Before English class she had a cup of fruit tea she made herself, and felt quite energized.

end_state.mood: Zhou Ting's return made her feel warm at reuniting with an old friend. The half-hour financial guidance in the parking lot touched her far more than the value of a meal, and she was full of energy for the changes in the coming days.

state.daily_exercise: None (no morning run today; chose a rest day).

date_attribute.weather: Clear and sunny, with gorgeous sunset clouds in the evening.

2025-10.daily_overview: Sunday was an important cross-city business meeting day. Chen Siyuan, an independent designer from Hangzhou, arrived in Xiamen as scheduled. They started at the shop, then went to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to get a feel for the community before discussing cooperation. The two reached an agreement that day, but on the way her daughter suddenly developed a slight fever, so Song Yajing left early to take care of her. That evening, after her daughter's fever subsided, she had a video call with her husband to briefly update him on the cooperation progress.

events.name: Hangzhou designer Chen Siyuan arrived in Xiamen for talks.
events.description: As agreed on October 5, Chen Siyuan arrived in Xiamen as scheduled on the morning high-speed train. Song Yajing received her at the Zhongshan Road shop. Chen Siyuan was dressed simply and neatly, spoke softly, but was very clear about her views on design. The two first shook hands and exchanged pleasantries inside the store. Song Yajing then walked her out of the store and along Zhongshan Road, which, just after National Day, had slightly fewer people but still overflowed with the bustling energy of everyday life. She introduced the neighborhood atmosphere around the shop and the life scenes of her female customers. On the way back to the shop, Chen Siyuan said seriously, "This street has made me understand the community character you mentioned."

events.name: Her daughter's sudden illness interrupted the business meeting.
events.description: Just as the two were having an in-depth discussion in the office behind the store, Song Yajing received a call from her husband Chen Zhiqiang saying that their daughter had suddenly developed a fever of 38 degrees. Her face changed, and she apologized to Chen Siyuan and explained the situation. Chen Siyuan expressed understanding and suggested discussing it in detail another day. Song Yajing hastily entrusted the store to Xiaomei and took a taxi home.

events.name: Caring for her daughter and calming emotions
events.description: After returning home, Song Yajing and her husband took their daughter's temperature and applied a fever patch. The daughter cried and said she felt terrible. Song Yajing hugged her and coaxed her gently, then fed her the fever reducer the doctor had prescribed. Half an hour later, her temperature gradually dropped, and the daughter fell into a deep sleep. Only then did Chen Zhiqiang and Song Yajing breathe a sigh of relief.

events.name: Late in the evening, continued communicating with Chen Siyuan and initialed the letter of intent.
events.description: In the evening, after her daughter's fever broke, Song Yajing continued to communicate with Chen Siyuan, who had stayed behind to rest at a hotel in Xiamen, via WeChat video. The two efficiently finalized the cooperation framework for the co-branded New Chinese style collection, including the design direction (earth tones, Minnan patterned tile elements), the first batch quantity, and the retail price range. Chen Siyuan agreed with the positioning of making it an affordable line that women in the community could afford, and electronically initialed a letter of intent, laying the foundation for the official signing on the 15th.

events.name: In the evening, had a video call with her husband to discuss cooperation progress
events.description: After closing for the night, Song Yajing settled her daughter in and sat on the sofa to have a preliminary WeChat video discussion with her husband, who was working overtime at the company, about the results of the talks with Chen Siyuan and the prospects for the co-branded project. She read out the key terms of the letter of intent to her husband. After hearing them, Chen Zhiqiang said, "Sounds like a good direction, but it may require tapping into part of our fixed deposits." Song Yajing said she had thought of that too and suggested they go over the numbers together in detail tomorrow evening after he came home. Chen Zhiqiang agreed.

start_state.mood: On Sunday morning, after going to church for Mass and returning home, she felt both nervous and composed about the important meeting in the afternoon.

end_state.mood: A cross-city collaboration that had been brewing for weeks still came together after a small incident with her daughter, but having to dip into family savings made her slightly uneasy, while her daughter's recovery put her at ease.

state.daily_exercise: Ran about 2.5 km in the morning.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast with occasional drizzle and a slight drop in temperature.

2025-10.daily_overview: Monday was the start of family finance day and the store's digital upgrade. Because her daughter had a fever last night, Song Yajing took half a day off in the morning to take care of her, and because of rainy weather, she did 20 minutes of home strength training instead of her morning run. In the evening, after calculating carefully with her husband, they decided to use part of their fixed deposit to launch the co-branded project; the shop assistant Xiao Mei proactively offered to invest 10,000 yuan to share the risk; Zhou Ting guided Song Yajing online through installing the inventory management App, officially bringing the store's financial management into the digital stage.

events.name: Home strength training instead of morning jogging
events.description: A light rain fell in the early morning, and since her daughter's low fever had just broken and it was not suitable to go out, Song Yajing decided not to go for an outdoor morning run. She opened the fitness app on her phone, laid out a yoga mat in the living room, and followed a 20-minute core and glute-leg strength class. Her movements were not very smooth, but she kept the exercise continuous. After finishing, she was lightly sweaty and felt that the stiffness in her neck and shoulders had eased a bit.

events.name: Take half a day off to take care of daughter
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing asked for half a day off from the store, cooked millet porridge for her daughter at home, and watched cartoons with her. Her daughter gradually recovered, and by noon her fever had broken and she was clamoring for rice. After confirming that everything was fine, Song Yajing hurried to the store in the afternoon.

events.name: Calculated startup funds in detail with her husband.
events.description: In the evening, after Chen Zhiqiang came home from work and had dinner, the two went into the study and closed the door. They opened the computer and the family ledger and went through the family savings, monthly income and expenses, and store operating data item by item. Chen Zhiqiang used Excel to list the funds needed to launch the co-branded project (including design fees, the initial fabric deposit, and packaging material costs), which amounted to about 15% of the family safety fund. He calmly said the ratio was acceptable and the risk was manageable. They agreed the project had good prospects and decided to allocate the startup funds from their fixed deposit.

events.name: Shop assistant Xiaomei voluntarily asked to become a shareholder.
events.description: At noon in the store, shop assistant Xiao Mei approached Song Yajing and, looking a little embarrassed, said that she had saved 10,000 yuan and wanted to invest in the co-branded project to share the risk and give herself a more formal place in the store. Song Yajing was momentarily stunned, then sincerely took Xiao Mei's hand and sat down with her in the rest area to discuss in detail the investment amount, profit-sharing ratio, and division of responsibilities. Xiao Mei said she trusted the boss's vision and believed the co-branded series would sell well. Touched by this trust, Song Yajing decided to accept Xiao Mei as a small shareholder in the project.

events.name: Zhou Ting remotely recommended and guided the installation of the inventory management app.
events.description: In the afternoon, Zhou Ting took the initiative to contact Song Yajing via WeChat, saying that she had looked at several inventory management software options for her over the past two days and finally narrowed them down to two suitable for a small boutique, and sent a comparison with pictures and descriptions. Song Yajing chose the one with simpler operation. Zhou Ting guided her remotely through a video call to download and install it, then demonstrated step by step how to set up product categories, import existing inventory data, and create a basic income-and-expense accounting template. Song Yajing studied it carefully and spent about forty minutes completing the initial setup. When they hung up, she said to Zhou Ting, "From now on I'll treat you to afternoon tea every month as tuition." Zhou Ting laughed and said, "Just keeping the books is enough."

events.name: Tested the inventory management app and entered the day's transactions
events.description: While doing the evening accounts, Song Yajing followed the operation method she had learned that afternoon and entered the day's several sales and one purchase into the newly installed inventory management app. She was not yet very skilled, but the instant feedback of automatically updated inventory numbers and cash balances made her immediately see the benefits of digital management. She decided to start a trial run tomorrow, running it in parallel with the original manual reconciliation for a week before switching over.

start_state.mood: Felt the busy pace of a workday, but was a bit worried because her daughter was sick. Before going out, she used a forehead thermometer to take her daughter's temperature and only felt reassured after confirming it was normal.

end_state.mood: Within a single day, she completed a family financial decision, accepted Xiao Mei's investment as a partner, and took the first step in digitizing the purchase-sales-inventory system. So much happened, but every bit was a positive push, and excitement outweighed fatigue.

state.daily_exercise: Home strength training for 20 minutes (core, glutes, and legs), walking about 6,000 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning clear, crisp autumn air

2025-10.daily_overview: A packed Tuesday. In the morning, I worked on a draft of the co-branded cooperation agreement. In the afternoon, I met my best friend Li Meiling at a newly opened milk tea shop to relax, and she proactively introduced a potential supplier. Also, moved by the health issues of the elderly I had visited a few days earlier, I booked physical exams for the whole family. In the evening, I reviewed the first week of morning runs and felt my body was improving.

events.name: Complete the disbursement of the family security fund and prepare the agreement draft.
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing, following the plan agreed with her husband the night before, used mobile banking to complete the partial withdrawal procedures for the family's time deposit and transferred the startup capital into the shop account. At the same time, Xiaomei transferred her 10,000 yuan investment into the shop account via mobile transfer, and Song Yajing made an allocation note in the electronic ledger. After the withdrawal was completed, based on the earlier consensus with designers Chen Siyuan and Zheng Kai, she organized and printed a draft co-branded cooperation agreement in the office at the back of the shop, including terms such as design categories, initial batch quantity, sales commission ratio, cooperation period, and the rights and obligations of both parties, ready to sign tomorrow.

events.name: Afternoon tea date with best friend Li Meiling
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing arranged a time with her best friend Li Meiling via WeChat to meet at a newly opened trendy milk tea shop on Zhongshan Road at 2 p.m. She sent Li Meiling an electronic album of her Volcano Island travel photos in advance. In the afternoon, each ordered a cup of fruit tea. Song Yajing flipped through the album while sharing travel anecdotes, and Li Meiling complained about the recent increase in administrative inspections at her school. Li Meiling also mentioned that she knew an independent accessory designer in Guangzhou whose style suited Song Yajing's store very well, and she was willing to help make the connection. Song Yajing noted down the contact information on the spot, feeling that this best-friend date came at just the right time.

events.name: Scheduled a comprehensive physical examination after being moved by the visit
events.description: On the way back to the shop after parting with Li Meiling, Song Yajing recalled how frail Uncle Chen had looked when she visited him, and how her own mother had been hospitalized earlier this year, and suddenly realized that she hadn't had a systematic physical exam in nearly three years. She immediately called the physical examination center at Xiamen First Hospital on her phone and booked a comprehensive checkup package for the morning of October 22. After the customer service representative confirmed, she received an SMS reminder, which she screenshotted and sent to her husband with the message, “This time I really can't delay it any longer.”

events.name: After reviewing the first week's morning running records, she decided to keep the same frequency.
events.description: Before bed, Song Yajing browsed the morning run records in the health app on her phone: from the first run on October 8 to today, she had run four times in total (on the 8th, 10th, 12th, and 14th), about 11 kilometers in all. She stood on the scale; the number hadn't changed significantly yet, but she felt that her daytime energy was indeed a bit better than before. She simply wrote in her diary: “I can run well and sleep well; it seems I can keep going.” She decided to maintain a frequency of at least three times a week.

start_state.mood: Morning runs gradually stopped being a reluctant struggle; I started to look forward to that cold air by the lake in the early morning.

end_state.mood: Her best friend's company relieved the stress of the past few days, and scheduling the health check-up made her feel she had taken charge of her health. Overall, her state stayed balanced amid the busy routine.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of about 3 kilometers and walking about 9,000 steps

date_attribute.weather: Sunny and warm, with a gentle afternoon breeze.

2025-10.daily_overview: A milestone day. Song Yajing, Hangzhou designer Chen Siyuan, and shop assistant Xiaomei formally signed a cooperation agreement for a co-branded new Chinese-style women's wear project. The store officially upgraded from a pure buyer model to a brand co-branding model. At the same time, she also completed the signing with Zheng Kai and the community sharing of illustrations by primary school classmate Lin Wei, with multiple co-branding directions sprouting at once. When she got home in the evening, she marked the date in her diary and called her mother to share the good news, receiving unexpected tears.

events.name: Officially signed the co-branded new Chinese-style women's clothing project agreement.
events.description: In the morning, Chen Siyuan, an independent designer from Hangzhou, came to the store again. Song Yajing took out the formal co-branding cooperation agreement she had organized the day before. In the small office behind the store, she and Chen Siyuan checked the final terms clause by clause and signed their names. The shop assistant Xiaomei also signed an equity participation agreement, and her 10,000 yuan was officially counted into the project's share capital. The three stood together holding pens for a group photo, with an irrepressible smile on Song Yajing's face. This photo was later set as her phone's home screen. In her diary, she drew a star with a red pen and wrote beside it 'the opening day of the second store'.

events.name: All project start-up funds are in place.
events.description: After the contract was signed, Song Yajing reviewed the family time deposit that had been drawn earlier, the investment capital transferred in by Xiaomei, and the portion allocated from the store's own working capital. The start-up funds for the entire joint new-Chinese-style project were all in place as planned. She made complete records in the store's financial accounts and set up a separate project sub-account using the newly adopted inventory management app.

events.name: Publish the co-branded project preview on multiple platforms
events.description: As soon as the signing ceremony ended, Song Yajing and Xiaomei took action: they simultaneously released the preview information for the co-branded new Chinese-style women's wear project on the store's official account, Moments, and customer WeChat groups. The accompanying images were a group photo of the three from the morning's signing and close-ups of two design sketches. The preview announced that an offline tasting event would be held in November. Within an hour of posting, several regular customers left comments expressing anticipation, and 5 new deposit reservations were added.

events.name: Reached a preliminary agreement for an illustration collaboration with primary school classmate Lin Wei.
events.description: During some free time in the afternoon, Song Yajing remembered that her primary school classmate Liu Fang (pen name Lin Wei) had shared floral watercolor illustrations on her Moments. She contacted Lin Wei via WeChat, expressed her idea of sharing her paintings in the customer community, and asked whether a joint co-branded design might be possible in the future. Lin Wei readily agreed and sent over several high-resolution original images, also specially picking a few in tones she said would suit autumn.

events.name: Shared Lin Wei's illustrations in the community group, sparking inspiration for cultural and creative products.
events.description: Before closing in the evening, Song Yajing carefully selected three floral watercolor illustrations provided by Lin Wei in the shop’s rest area, and wrote copy telling the story of their friendship from elementary school to now and the flower language behind the paintings. She posted it to the core customer WeChat group and her Moments. The group members responded enthusiastically; several customers asked for the original high-resolution wallpaper images, and some even left comments asking whether these floral patterns could be printed on T-shirts or canvas bags. Song Yajing quickly noted down the idea and wrote the title: “Collaborating with Lin Wei to launch a co-branded floral cultural merchandise series — feasible.”

events.name: Completed the joint electronic contract signing with designer Zheng Kai
events.description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing also did a final contract check over WeChat with Zheng Kai, a former colleague and independent designer in Hangzhou, and then officially signed the co-branded new Chinese-style women's clothing collaboration contract through an electronic signature platform. As agreed in the contract, she paid the initial deposit from the store account. This was the other of the two designer co-branded lines with Zheng Kai and Chen Siyuan.

events.name: Called mother to share the good news.
events.description: Back home in the evening, Song Yajing could not contain her excitement and called her mother Lin Xiuying to tell her the news of the successful signing and the store's upcoming transformation. On the other end of the line, Lin Xiuying was silent for a few seconds, then said in a choked voice, “You have loved beautiful clothes since you were little, and now you've really built a career out of it. Mom is so happy.” Listening to her mother's sobs in the living room, Song Yajing shed tears herself.

start_state.mood: Knowing that she had an important contract signing today, she got into gear faster than usual after waking up, and her steps were much lighter during her morning run.

end_state.mood: A sense of fulfillment she had never felt since starting her business enveloped her. From a nervous new shop owner when she opened, to the owner of a micro brand with a co-branded collection and a tiny partner, this road had taken five years. Lying in the dark with her eyes open, she replayed the scenes of the day in her mind, feeling calm and clear-headed.

state.daily_exercise: Morning jog of about 3 kilometers.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning clear, northeast wind level 3, temperature 22-28°C

2025-10.daily_overview: On Thursday, instead of going out for her morning run as planned, Song Yajing chose to stretch at home to relieve shoulder and neck discomfort. In the morning, she focused on wrapping up the social-media warm-up work after the co-branding contract signing and formally shared the good news with regular customers who had paid booking deposits. At noon, after closing the store, she went to the Siming Sub-branch of ICBC, finalized the details of opening a dedicated overseas travel savings account with account manager Lin Xiaofeng, and completed the opening of an installment savings account with automatic transfer settings. In the evening, after returning home, she shared the plan to set up a dedicated travel fund with her husband Chen Zhiqiang, and the two confirmed a three-year goal together, adding another sign of their financial harmony as a couple.

events.name: Morning home stretching and neck-shoulder relaxation
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Song Yajing woke up feeling some tightness in her shoulders and neck, so she spread out a yoga mat and followed a phone video for 15 minutes of full-body stretching and shoulder-and-neck relaxation. She paid special attention to slow neck circles. After finishing, she felt much more comfortable and decided to make this small habit a fixed part of every non-running morning.

events.name: Organized prepaid prospective customers and posted the good news of the co-branded signing.
events.description: After arriving at the store, Song Yajing pulled out the list of regular customers who had sent private messages expressing interest in the co-branded collection since October 8, and checked the records one by one. She then officially announced the good news in the customer community about signing with a Hangzhou designer, detailing the follow-up sample development schedule and the first-batch pre-sale price reservation rules, and attached a close-up of the signed handwriting taken that day. The group was filled with cheers.

events.name: Go to ICBC to open a dedicated overseas travel account.
events.description: Song Yajing took advantage of the noon break when the store was closed and walked to the Siming Sub-branch of ICBC, where the account manager Lin Xiaofeng was already waiting. The two sat down in the wealth management room. Lin Xiaofeng patiently explained the difference between an installment savings deposit and an ordinary fixed deposit, and suggested that an automatic monthly deduction of 2,000 yuan would accumulate a sufficient travel fund after three years. After carefully asking about the interest rate and the rules for early withdrawal, Song Yajing decided to open the account. Then at the counter, she filled out the account opening application form with her ID card, officially opened an installment savings account as a dedicated fund for the family's overseas trip, and immediately set up an automatic transfer of 2,000 yuan from her main debit card to the new account on the 10th of each month via mobile banking, so that the savings plan would not be forgotten or squeezed out by daily spending. The whole process took about half an hour.

events.name: Evening: update husband on the travel fund plan
events.description: After dinner, Song Yajing carefully told her husband Chen Zhiqiang about the plan to open a dedicated travel account and set aside a fixed 2,000 yuan in savings each month. Chen Zhiqiang praised her foresight. The two sat on the sofa and briefly estimated the total after three years, agreeing that this pace would allow the family to comfortably complete an overseas trip in 2028. Chen Zhiqiang also offered to keep an eye out for travel guides in the future. The couple confirmed the goal together, and their family financial planning became further aligned.

events.name: Enter family financial records and remind of payment due dates.
events.description: Before going to sleep, Song Yajing opened the family’s shared digital notebook, created a new page titled “Overseas Travel Fund,” recorded the account information, monthly savings amount, and three-year cumulative goal, and set a monthly deduction reminder on the 10th in her phone calendar. She softly reminded her husband to keep an eye on the monthly deduction, and Chen Zhiqiang nodded and made a note.

start_state.mood: Alert but slightly hurried, preoccupied with the day's many tasks

end_state.mood: Grounded and satisfied, the family travel goal now has independent financial support.

2025-10.daily_overview: Friday, the intricate rhythm of a regular workday. Early in the morning, Song Yajing completed her second morning run of the week as planned and felt her body gradually adapting. In the morning, she focused mainly on store sales and new product displays, and found time to check the color swatches for the first batch of fabric for the co-branded collection. In the afternoon, shop assistant Xiao Mei independently served several regular customers, which allowed Yajing to concentrate in the back room on organizing her online course notes. Before closing in the evening, her best friend Li Meiling sent a message to finalize weekend afternoon tea, and she happily agreed. At night, she also handled a customer's exchange request, patiently and thoughtfully.

events.name: Morning jog around Yundang Lake at dawn
events.description: At 6:30 a.m., Song Yajing jogged 3 kilometers along the Yundang Lake trail, waking up her body for the new day. She had been running this route for over half a month. Familiar runners along the way nodded to her, which gradually helped her move past the initial feeling of being forced to run and start enjoying the freshness of the morning breeze. After running, while stretching by the lake, she noticed an auntie she often met give her a thumbs-up, which gave her more motivation.

events.name: Daily store operations and confirmation of co-branded fabric
events.description: Morning customer flow was steady. While sorting the newly arrived autumn coats, Song Yajing communicated with a Hangzhou designer via WeChat about the color samples of the first batch of fabric for the co-branded collection. Xiaomei helped hang a New Chinese-style inspiration board in a prominent spot in the store, which caught the attention of several young customers who stopped to ask. Song Yajing took the opportunity to make a few appointment registrations.

events.name: Summarized notes from the online English course
events.description: During the idle afternoon hours, Song Yajing opened her phone notes in the small office area behind the counter and reorganized the key phrases and scenario dialogues from the first three online Travel English conversation classes into a dedicated notebook. She especially reviewed restaurant ordering and hotel check-in expressions as preparation for tomorrow's final class, thinking to herself that she would show off to her family when the time came.

events.name: Discussed getting started with the inventory management app with shop assistant Xiaomei.
events.description: During a lull while Xiaomei was serving customers, Song Yajing briefly demonstrated the basic operations of the inventory management app recommended by Zhou Ting and taught her how to enter the day's sales and returns. Xiaomei caught on quickly and offered to take charge of the daily inventory reconciliation before closing. Song Yajing nodded repeatedly and immediately granted her access to the electronic ledger, freeing up her own time.

events.name: Finalized the weekend bestie afternoon tea plan.
events.description: In the evening, Li Meiling suggested in the three-person besties group chat that they meet up at the newly opened light-fare cafe on Zhongshan Road on Saturday afternoon. Wang Jia couldn't attend because she was in Shenzhen, but she sent a voice message to tease. Song Yajing checked her calendar, confirmed she was free after tomorrow's English class, immediately agreed, and took the initiative to book a table.

events.name: Handling customer exchange requests in the evening
events.description: After dinner, a customer contacted her on WeChat saying the coat she bought last week had some loose stitching. Song Yajing immediately apologized and agreed to an exchange, and also proactively offered a store discount coupon as compensation. She forwarded the information to Xiaomei and arranged for it to be handled at the shop tomorrow.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and organized, easing into Friday step by step.

end_state.mood: Looking forward to weekend relaxation and time with my best friend.

2025-10.daily_overview: Saturday's theme was personal breakthrough and community planning running in parallel. In the morning, Song Yajing attended the online sharing session for graduates of the travel spoken English workshop in her home study, sharing her learning experience in English and earning praise from the foreign teacher, and she once again showed her English progress in front of her family. In the afternoon, she and Li Meiling finalized the details of Vivian's bachelorette party at a café and officially launched the activity sign-up chain in the community. In the evening, she made a detour to a newly opened accessory store on Zhongshan Road to buy extra supplies for the party favors, and after returning home, she carefully selected the background music playlist for the party night.

events.name: Participated in the online travel oral English workshop graduate sharing session
events.description: At ten in the morning, Song Yajing entered the online meeting room on time to attend the first online sharing session held by the oral English workshop for graduating students. The foreign teacher invited several outstanding students to share their learning experiences in English. Song Yajing gave a two-minute self-introduction and sharing of her learning insights in slightly nervous but complete and coherent English, and received praise from the foreign teacher. She sent a screenshot of her sharing to the family group chat, and her husband Chen Zhiqiang replied with three thumbs-up. After the session, she also exchanged ideas with several classmates about their follow-up self-study plans and decided to continue practicing daily conversations.

events.name: Show her English learning progress in front of the family.
events.description: After the sharing session ended, her daughter Chen Lexuan curiously came over. Song Yajing then pulled her husband and daughter to sit on the sofa and performed on the spot the English self-introduction and a short daily conversation she had just given at the sharing session. Her daughter clapped and said, 'Mommy is amazing,' and Chen Zhiqiang smiled and said, 'Now I won't have to worry about losing you when we go abroad.' Her family's approval encouraged Song Yajing greatly and strengthened her resolve to continue self-study.

events.name: Have afternoon tea with Li Meiling and finalize the bachelorette party plan.
events.description: At 3 p.m., Song Yajing and Li Meiling met at a newly opened tea room on Zhongshan Road. The two went through their phone memos item by item: the party theme was set as "Vivian's Next Stop to Happiness," the time was set for the evening of Monday the 20th after the store closed, the venue would be the community shared space behind the store, the fee would be pay-what-you-feel, and the donation recipient was chosen by community vote as the Siming District Disabled Children's Center. They also confirmed the game segments and the division of work for collecting materials for the memory video.

events.name: Post a party notice in the community group and collect blessing videos.
events.description: After parting with Li Meiling, Song Yajing immediately posted the official party notice in the customer community, set up a sign-up chain, and privately messaged several group members familiar with Vivian, asking them to record 15-second blessing videos. She then added Li Meiling to a small party preparation group, forming a three-person planning team with shop assistant Xiaomei.

events.name: Pick party favors, restock supplies, and prepare music.
events.description: On the way back to the store, Song Yajing stopped by a newly opened boutique accessory store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street and picked out cute scented candles as additional party favors for each guest, which happened to pair well with the custom engraved necklaces. After returning home in the evening, she spent half an hour choosing a warm and cheerful background music playlist on a music app and shared it to the planning group for opinions.

start_state.mood: Slightly nervous but full of anticipation, not wanting to leave regrets in the last lesson

end_state.mood: Full of a sense of achievement — both the English course completion and party preparations have made substantial progress.

2025-10.daily_overview: Sunday was Song Yajing's deliberately slow-paced day arranged for herself and her family. In the morning, she systematically organized her English notes and baking materials at home, made a follow-up practice plan, and painted with her daughter. After lunch, she left her daughter with her husband and went alone to Xinhua Bookstore to enjoy reading time, picking out a novel and baking books. On the way home in the evening, she stopped by to pick up the custom engraved necklace made for Vivian. The evening was warm family time; she photographed the necklace and sent it to the party group for final confirmation.

events.name: Organize English class notes and make a follow-up practice plan
events.description: After breakfast, Song Yajing made a cup of fruit tea, sat at the dining table, merged the new notes from yesterday's lesson with her previous summaries, and used a highlighter to mark the 30 sentences most frequently used in daily life. On the last page of her notebook, she wrote down her follow-up plan: use the App to read along for 10 minutes every night before bed, and try role-playing games in English with her daughter on the weekend.

events.name: Organizing baking workshop materials and reviewing French pastry basics.
events.description: After organizing her English notes, Song Yajing pulled out the handouts from Master Chen's basic dessert course she attended earlier this year, and reviewed the whipped cream consistency and the differences in gelatin amounts. She compared her notes with the syllabus for the mango mousse class coming up on the 26th, marked a few questions she wanted to confirm in advance, and planned to ask Master Chen on WeChat.

events.name: Accompanying daughter while she draws.
events.description: Before noon, daughter Chen Lexuan took out her watercolor markers and wanted to draw. Song Yajing sat down beside her and patiently drew a sun and small flowers with her. The daughter hung the picture of her mother on the refrigerator and proudly showed it to her father.

events.name: Handed over the care of her daughter to her husband and went out alone.
events.description: At 1:30 p.m., Song Yajing briefly told Chen Zhiqiang about the arrangements after their daughter's nap, then changed into a light knit top and wide-leg pants, slung a canvas bag over her shoulder, and went out alone. Chen Zhiqiang, who was building LEGO, replied without looking up, "Go ahead, I'll cook dinner tonight," giving her a warm feeling of being supported.

events.name: Immersive reading and book buying at Xinhua Bookstore
events.description: She lingered for a long time between the literature and lifestyle sections on the second floor of Xinhua Bookstore on Zhongshan Road, and finally picked out a healing novel and a detailed cake recipe book by a Korean baker. After paying, she sat by the window in the bookstore's café area with a hot latte. She first read the first two chapters of the novel, then slowly browsed the mango dessert chapter in the baking book, and before she knew it, two hours had passed. The peace of being alone, immersed in words, left her fully recharged.

events.name: Pick up Vivian's custom necklace on the way.
events.description: After leaving the bookstore, Song Yajing walked to the custom jewelry store at the other end of the pedestrian street and picked up a silver clavicle necklace engraved with the letters "Y.J". The shop owner had specially wrapped it in a velvet gift box. She opened it, checked that the engraving was correct, and put it away with satisfaction, planning to give it to Vivian in person as a special gift at tomorrow evening's party.

events.name: Purchase party decorations, desserts, and drinks.
events.description: After picking up the necklace, Song Yajing stopped by a general store on the way to buy party decorations such as balloons, letter garlands, and tablecloths, and then went to the bakery she frequents to pre-order tiramisu and fruit tarts to be ready tomorrow afternoon. She carried everything back to the store in two trips. Xiaomei had already helped tidy up the tables and chairs in the shared space.

start_state.mood: Relax and enjoy a morning unhurried by an alarm clock.

end_state.mood: Feeling fulfilled; the time spent reading alone healed many days of busyness.

2025-10.daily_overview: On Monday morning, Song Yajing completed her morning run as planned and felt her pace had improved slightly. In the morning, she left the store to Xiaomei and, at a friend's request, rode an electric scooter to the flower market to pick up party flower materials, putting on earphones to listen to a podcast she had been wanting to catch up on. In the afternoon, college classmate Zhou Ting came to the store to catch up during her trip back to Xiamen to visit family. The two tried out an inventory management app and carefully optimized the stock-entry process. In the evening after closing, community members gradually gathered in the shared space. A warm and touching bachelorette party moved Vivian to tears, and the engraved necklace Song Yajing gave her, along with the words “Yajing's place will always be your home,” became the most heartfelt footnote of the night.

events.name: Morning run gradually hitting its stride
events.description: At 6:40 in the morning, Song Yajing completed a 3-kilometer morning run along Yundang Lake. Today she felt her breathing rhythm was smoother, and she did not slow down noticeably in the second half. Her pace was about 7 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer. After the run, she stretched quickly, happily feeling the growing stability of her condition.

events.name: Rode an electric scooter to the flower market to pick up the ordered floral materials.
events.description: At ten in the morning, a florist friend in the community had an urgent matter and asked Song Yajing to help pick up three bunches of lisianthus and eucalyptus leaves for a party at the flower market on Xi'an Road. Song Yajing put on her helmet and rode the shop's spare electric scooter along Hubin South Road to the flower market. On the way, she listened to an industry podcast she had saved last month but not yet listened to using Bluetooth earphones. The coolness before the light breeze and drizzle made her especially comfortable. The 2-kilometer round trip took less than half an hour, helping a friend while also stealing a moment alone.

events.name: Zhou Ting visited the shop and provided on-site guidance on optimizing the inventory management app.
events.description: At 3 p.m., Zhou Ting arrived at the shop as arranged. The two sat at the small round table next to the fitting room drinking fruit tea. Song Yajing opened the inventory management app and showed the category confusion she encountered while entering data. Zhou Ting took the phone, quickly adjusted a few custom categories, and demonstrated how to use the scanning function to enter items instantly. She encouraged Song Yajing: 'Once you get used to this little tool, you can save a whole vacation's worth of time in a year.' She also promised to compile the key operation points into an illustrated guide and send it to her before returning to Shenzhen.

events.name: Bachelorette party planning and execution
events.description: At five in the evening, Song Yajing and Xiaomei closed the store early to set up the shared space. They hung up balloons and a letter banner reading "Vivian's Next Stop, Happiness," and laid out tiramisu and fruit tea. Starting at six, community members arrived one after another, and laughter rang out during the games. When the memory video was played, Vivian was already secretly wiping away tears. In the final segment, Song Yajing took out an engraved necklace, put it on her, hugged her, and said, "Here at Yajing's will always be your family home." Amid applause from the whole room, Vivian was choked with tears. For this first tentative emotional event, each person was charged 30 yuan, and about 400 yuan was collected in total. Song Yajing announced on the spot that the entire amount would be donated to the community center for children with disabilities.

start_state.mood: In good spirits, looking forward to today's reunion with classmates and the party tonight.

end_state.mood: Moved and fulfilled. The emotional connection of the community goes beyond business.

date_attribute.weather: Light rain turning cloudy, temperature 19-23°C.

2025-10.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Song Yajing had a buffer day before her physical exam. In the morning, she swapped her cardio run for indoor stretching and light yoga, then went to the shop to handle the day's new products and customer inquiries. She took the time to give her florist friend feedback on the flowers used at the party and thanked her for her support. In the afternoon, she transferred the modest earnings from last night's party via mobile banking to the corporate account of the community center for disabled children, and posted the donation certificate in the community group, earning a wave of likes. In the evening, she began preparing for tomorrow's fasting checkup, ate an early light dinner, and packed her ID and documents. That night, she excitedly browsed baking websites, studied mango mousse decoration techniques, and went to bed a little late.

events.name: Indoor light yoga as a replacement for the morning run.
events.description: Because of the physical exam the next day and today's light rain, Song Yajing did not go to Yundang Lake. Instead, she laid out the yoga mat in the living room and followed a video on her phone for 30 minutes of stretching and basic yoga, focusing on relieving the shoulder and neck fatigue from the past few days. After her daughter got up, she curiously imitated her, and the two finished the last few moves while giggling. After several days of busy work, her body felt a bit tired, and she did the yoga moves especially slowly, so she decided to give herself a buffer day today.

events.name: Give feedback to a florist friend on the flowers used for the party
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing sent a few photos of the flower arrangements from yesterday's party to her friend, a community florist, via WeChat, thanking her for the flower support and telling her that the lisianthus and eucalyptus leaves looked great. The florist replied that she was very happy to take part in such a warm event and offered to provide discounted sponsorship for the next community activity.

events.name: Complete the party donation and announce it to the community.
events.description: After arriving at the store, Song Yajing opened her mobile banking app and transferred a total of 500 yuan — the 400 yuan emotional fee collected from yesterday's party plus 100 yuan she added from her own pocket — to the corporate account of the Siming District Disabled Children Service Center. After screenshotting the successful transfer page, she posted the payment receipt and a thank-you message in the community, writing, "Every kind thought has become a warm place to go." Vivian sent several moved-to-tears emojis in a row, and group members gave likes one after another. The community felt increasingly like a place of belonging.

events.name: Making physical preparations for tomorrow's health check-up.
events.description: At dinner, Song Yajing deliberately made light tomato and egg noodles and blanched greens to avoid greasy food. She checked the notes on the physical exam appointment form, put her ID card, social security card, and the appointment form into her small bag, and set an alarm on her phone for the next morning. Before bed, she specifically checked to confirm that she had fasted for 7 hours. She had a little water and then ate nothing more.

events.name: Evening practice of baking techniques
events.description: After preparing for the physical exam, Song Yajing was suddenly in the mood to watch a baking expert video she had saved long ago, learning mirror-glaze techniques for mango mousse and fruit-cutting skills for decoration. She was drawn in by all kinds of creative ideas and didn't put her phone away until nearly 11 p.m. She went to sleep a little late but with her heart full of sweet plans.

start_state.mood: Calm, with a solemn feeling of preparing for the physical exam

end_state.mood: At ease and excited about learning, and all pre-physical-examination preparations have been completed.

2025-10.daily_overview: Wednesday's focus was the annual physical exam. Song Yajing got up early, fasting, and went alone to the physical examination center at Xiamen First Hospital, completing all the tests one by one. After receiving the preliminary report, the doctor reminded her that her blood lipid levels were elevated and advised her to increase aerobic exercise. Although she was a little worried, she was also glad that she had already started morning runs, which strengthened her resolve to make morning running a long-term habit and mentally raised her goal from at least three times a week to four. In the afternoon, after returning to the store to handle work, she received a call from her elder sister Song Yawen, and the two sisters talked about recent news and health management. In the evening, she discussed the results with her husband and they agreed to keep each other accountable.

events.name: Go to the hospital on an empty stomach to complete a comprehensive physical exam.
events.description: At 8 a.m., Song Yajing arrived at the physical examination center of the First Hospital on an empty stomach. Guided by the reception nurse, she completed all the scheduled items in turn: blood draw, electrocardiogram, and abdominal ultrasound. The entire process took about an hour and a half. While waiting in the waiting area, she flipped through the hospital's health brochures and learned about women's blood lipid management systematically for the first time.

events.name: Heeded the doctor's initial advice and resolved to strengthen her morning jogging habit
events.description: About two hours after completing the physical exam, Song Yajing listened to the preliminary results in the doctor's office. The doctor told her that apart from total cholesterol and LDL being slightly above the ideal range, all other indicators were normal. He advised her to increase regular aerobic exercise and adjust her diet to reduce fried foods and desserts. Song Yajing took careful notes and silently thanked herself for starting morning runs on the 8th. Now she was even more determined to make morning running a long-term habit, and mentally raised her goal from at least three times a week to four times a week. On the spot, she mentally upgraded morning running from something requiring persistence to a non-negotiable commitment.

events.name: Had a phone call with her elder sister Song Yawen.
events.description: Shortly after returning to the store in the afternoon, Song Yajing received a call from her elder sister Song Yawen in Shenzhen. Her sister asked how she was doing, and upon hearing that she had just finished a health checkup, shared her own habit of getting regular checkups every year and suggested she eat fewer late-night snacks. The sisters also talked about their father's health and their Double 11 shopping list, and agreed to reunite in Quanzhou on New Year's Day.

events.name: Communicate the physical exam results with her husband and make a joint health agreement
events.description: After dinner, Song Yajing relayed the doctor's advice in full to Chen Zhiqiang. Her husband admitted that he had been sedentary and lacked exercise, and had recently been getting short of breath climbing stairs. The two then wrote the joint commitment “exercise at least three times a week” on a fridge magnet. Chen Zhiqiang decided to start jogging in the evening again, while Song Yajing promised not to skip her morning runs. The little family health pact turned the checkup warning into positive motivation.

events.name: Sharing physical exam insights in the community group.
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing shared in the customer community that she had finished her health checkup, reminding everyone—especially women who have been busy for a long time—not to forget to look after their own health. When some group members asked about how to book, she replied to a few of them privately.

start_state.mood: Slightly weak from an empty stomach, while also feeling a mix of anticipation and a trace of unease about the result

end_state.mood: Grounded. After the health data became transparent, I felt more at ease, and my goals were clearer.

state.daily_exercise: None (morning run suspended on physical exam day)

2025-10.daily_overview: Thursday returned to normal. Song Yajing resumed her morning run. By Yundang Lake, she felt her body adapting to the routine, and she resolved to adjust the frequency of her morning runs to four times a week starting today, in response to the medical check-up advice. The whole day was mainly spent on shop operations and continuing to get familiar with the inventory management app. Xiaomei could already handle most of the data entry independently, while Song Yajing took the opportunity to sort out the backlog of special customer request forms from the previous days. In the evening, she discussed the initial sales forecast for the co-branded product with her husband and made final confirmation of the materials for the upcoming dessert class.

events.name: Resuming morning runs and establishing a rhythm
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Song Yajing put on her running shoes and ran 3 kilometers along Yundang Lake. For her first run after the physical exam, she deliberately slowed down and focused on coordinating her breathing. After the run, she stretched on a bench at the end of the trail, watching the mist over the lake slowly disperse, and felt certain this would become a habit she would keep for many years. She also wrote in her phone notes: "This week's goal: complete four morning runs."

events.name: Daily shop operations and inventory reconciliation
events.description: After arriving at the store, Xiaomei had already completed yesterday's sales entry in the app. Song Yajing spent ten minutes checking system inventory against actual inventory and found that a knit top showed only one left, but the displayed item had actually sold out. She immediately went through it and found that Xiaomei had missed entering a sale from dinner time, so she entered it on the spot and made a note. Though the error was small, it showed her the need for a two-person review, so she set up a process where Xiaomei enters the sales and she reviews them daily.

events.name: Handling personalized customer needs.
events.description: Song Yajing replied to several regular customers who had privately messaged over the past few days about the co-branded collection. For two of them, she took measurements and pre-ordered non-standard sizes, noting them in the order sheet. She also contacted Susan via WeChat to restock an autumn trench coat, because after the community sharing on the health check-up day, three group members had placed orders for the same style.

events.name: Discuss the sales forecast for the co-branded item with her husband
events.description: After dinner, Song Yajing took out a spreadsheet and estimated the cost and expected profit of the first batch of the co-branded product with Chen Zhiqiang. The two discussed pricing strategy over the calculator on their phones. Her husband suggested setting an early-bird price to quickly recoup funds, which Song Yajing thought made a lot of sense and planned to apply in future community activities.

events.name: Confirm materials and details for the French dessert class.
events.description: Before bed, Song Yajing looked over the mango mousse recipe Master Chen had sent last night, replied to confirm that she had already prepared an apron and notebook, and asked whether she should process the mangoes in advance. Master Chen replied by voice that she only needed to bring patience, and revealed that the class would also teach a little trick for mirror glaze. She saved a screenshot of the ingredient list and set an alarm for Sunday morning.

start_state.mood: Full of energy; resuming the morning run makes my body feel great.

end_state.mood: Full and orderly, everything progressed as planned.

2025-10.daily_overview: On Friday, Song Yajing completed her third morning run of the week with a steady pace. In the morning, she spent half the day warming up the community's weekend topic and confirmed with Master Chen the exact time and transportation route for the day-after-tomorrow class. In the afternoon, she proactively video-called her mother, Lin Xiuying, sharing her recent baking progress and the good news about the co-branded product, which made her mother feel very involved from afar. Near the end of the month, she also spent half an hour reviewing the store's income and expenses for the month. In the evening, her husband suggested watching a comedy to relax, and the two of them spent a happy two hours curled up on the sofa. They went to bed a little later but in a good mood.

events.name: Morning run of 3 kilometers with a steady pace.
events.description: At 6:40 in the morning, Song Yajing finished her morning run by Yundang Lake. Today she deliberately measured her pace, about 7 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer, a clear improvement from the beginning of the month. As she ran, she thought about how to combine the community's weekend topics with the store's new arrivals, and inspiration surged.

events.name: Community weekend topic warm-up and interaction
events.description: In the morning, in the customer group, Song Yajing started a sign-up thread asking "Which autumn foliage spot in Xiamen do you most want to visit this weekend?" and paired it with a morning run selfie of herself wearing the store's autumn outerwear by Yundang Lake, creating a lifestyle outfit topic. Group members actively shared, and she took the opportunity to recommend several looks suitable for outdoor photos, planting seeds for possible weekend shopping foot traffic.

events.name: Confirmed the course schedule with Master Chen a second time
events.description: At noon, Song Yajing confirmed with Master Chen via WeChat the specific time of the course on the 26th (9:30 a.m.) and the detailed address of the workshop in Huli District and nearby parking lots. Master Chen thoughtfully sent a pre-class preparation note so the students could learn in advance the difference between gelatin sheets and gelatin powder. Song Yajing saved the address in a map app and estimated the travel time from home.

events.name: Video call with her mother Lin Xiuying to share recent updates
events.description: In the afternoon, when there were few customers in the store, Song Yajing called her mother on WeChat video. She propped her phone against the fitting room, and while sorting the new arrivals, showed her mother the English ordering dialogue she had recently learned. She also described in detail the excitement of signing the co-branded collection. On the other side of the screen, her mother listened while doing needlework, occasionally commenting, "If your father knew, he would be so proud," and reminded her that October is dry and she should drink more white fungus soup.

events.name: Manual account backup and comparison at month end.
events.description: Before closing the shop in the evening, Song Yajing took out the paper ledger and compared the handwritten entries from October 1 to 24 day by day with the electronic data in the inventory management app. She marked three discrepancies and found that all were caused by entry delays. She photographed the corrected paper ledger for archival purposes, ready to bid farewell to this stack of ledgers for good when the official switch took place on the 31st.

events.name: Watching a movie with her husband in the evening to relax
events.description: After dinner, Chen Zhiqiang suggested watching a newly released comedy film, and Song Yajing readily agreed. They snuggled together on the sofa, laughing out loud at the plot, which dispelled the busy feeling of the past few days. The film didn't end until almost 11 p.m. After a quick wash-up, they fell into a peaceful sleep.

start_state.mood: Relaxed, with the pleasant feeling of Friday lingering in my heart.

end_state.mood: Warmth. The phone call with her mother and the couple's movie night melted away most of the week's fatigue.

2025-10.daily_overview: On Saturday, Song Yajing devoted her day to practicing both faith and charity. In the morning, she followed the church charity visitation group on her first formal visit to the family of a sick friend and experienced the power of silent companionship. After the visit, she immediately submitted an application to Father Wang Mingde to join the group, promising to participate in at least one visit every month. In the afternoon, she used her free time to do final preparation for the next day's dessert class and called her father to catch up. In the evening, she shared the day's reflections in the church group chat and received warm responses from many fellow believers.

events.name: First formal patient visit with the Aide visiting group.
events.description: At nine in the morning, Song Yajing gathered at the church and, together with Aunt Lin Xiuying and three other fellow church members, went to the home of a sick friend who lived alone in the old town of Siming and had just been discharged from the hospital. She took the initiative to bring freshly baked basil cookies and fruit. During the visit, she did not say much, mostly helping to tidy the coffee table and listening with her friend to half an episode of a Hokkien radio program. When they left, the friend held her hand and said, 'When you come, the house doesn't feel so empty.' That remark stayed with her for a long time.

events.name: Submitted an application to join the group to Father Wang Mingde.
events.description: After the visit, she returned to the church. Song Yajing found Father Wang Mingde, solemnly filled out the official membership application form for the Aide Visiting Group, and wrote in the remarks column: "May I accompany the lonely with the Lord's love at least once a month." The priest patted her on the shoulder and said, "God will bless your perseverance," and added her to the group's official contact group.

events.name: Preview the mango mousse recipe to warm up for tomorrow's class
events.description: After lunch, Song Yajing sat in a rattan chair on the balcony. Referring to the preview notes Master Chen had sent, she broke down the mango mousse recipe in her notebook, using different colors to mark the optimal temperature for mixing the gelatin liquid and fruit puree. She also took out a kitchen thermometer to practice measuring water temperature, ensuring she would feel confident during tomorrow's actual operation.

events.name: Call father Song Minghui.
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing called her father, and the two chatted for about twenty minutes. She told her father about joining the visiting group and signing the co-branded collection deal. Song Minghui said "good" several times, then reminded her not to burn herself out and to remember to stew the half free-range chicken he had left for her in the fridge. Her father's steady voice was always her most reassuring support.

events.name: Share visit reflections in the church group.
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing shared in the parish fellowship group how moved she was by her first visit, along with a photo of herself and a fellow patient (with their consent). Many parishioners liked and commented. Aunt Lin Xiuying replied, "Welcome, Yajing, to officially join the group. Let's walk this warm path together in the future," which made her feel a strong sense of belonging.

start_state.mood: Respectful and solemn, looking forward to today's visit experience.

end_state.mood: A peaceful feeling of being spiritually nourished, and deep fulfillment from serving others.

2025-10.daily_overview: On Sunday, Song Yajing went alone to Master Chen's Bakery Workshop in Huli District to attend an advanced French dessert course. Under the teacher's guidance, she completed the entire process of making a mango mousse cake, focusing on mastering the use of gelatin and the mixing level of the mousse batter. In the evening, she brought the finished cake home. Her husband and daughter gathered around the table to taste it, and their unanimous praise boosted her confidence. After class, she also exchanged insights with fellow student Mrs. Liu on WeChat and agreed to share their baking works with each other.

events.name: Go to Master Chen's Baking Workshop.
events.description: Early in the morning, Song Yajing said goodbye to her husband and daughter, put on her backpack containing an apron and a notebook, and took the bus to Master Chen's Bakery Workshop in Huli District. The trip took about half an hour, and she used the time to go over her preview notes again and imagine what the hands-on operation would look like.

events.name: Learned mango mousse theory and observed a demonstration.
events.description: The class began. Master Chen first explained the recipe principles of mango mousse on the whiteboard, emphasizing that the gelatin dissolving temperature must be controlled at 50-60°C; if too high it will fail, if too low the setting will be uneven. He then fully demonstrated the entire process from blending the fruit puree, melting the gelatin, whipping the cream, to mixing and pouring into the mold, and also showed the technique of wrapping the outside of the mold with a hot towel when unmolding. Song Yajing quickly took notes in her notebook, afraid of missing any detail.

events.name: Independently made a mango mousse cake.
events.description: When it was the trainees' turn for hands-on practice, Song Yajing tightened her apron. Following the steps, she melted the gelatin sheets, mixed the mango purée with sugar, then carefully folded in cream beaten to soft peaks in small batches. Master Chen stood beside her, guiding the mixing consistency and reminding her to "stop as soon as the lines disappear." After pouring the mousse mixture into the mold, she gently tapped it to release air bubbles and put it in the refrigerator to set. While waiting, she cleaned the workbench and washed the tools, and also observed the decoration ideas of the other trainees.

events.name: Practice demolding and decorating, pack finished products
events.description: After the mousse had chilled for about an hour, Song Yajing, under Master Chen’s guidance, wrapped the mold with a hot towel for a few seconds and successfully unmolded it. She arranged sliced mango in a fan shape as a topping, sifted a layer of moisture-proof powdered sugar over it, and put it into a dedicated cake box. The finished cake looked quite good. Pleased with herself, she took photos and sent them to her mother and the close friends’ group chat.

events.name: Bring the cake home to share with the family.
events.description: At a little past four in the afternoon, Song Yajing returned home carrying a cake box. Her daughter Chen Lexuan was already waiting at the door and cheered as soon as she saw the cake. After dinner, the family of three sat around and tasted it. The mousse was smooth and the mango sweet. Chen Zhiqiang scooped up two large portions and praised her, saying she 'could open a dessert shop.' Watching the satisfied expressions of her husband and daughter, Song Yajing began to mull over a small plan to make a new dessert for the family every month.

events.name: Exchanged messages online with Mrs. Liu, a fellow baking enthusiast.
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing received a WeChat message from Mrs. Liu. Having seen the mousse photos on Moments, Mrs. Liu praised them highly and shared the matcha mille crepe cake she had recently made. Mrs. Liu was a fellow baking enthusiast whom she had met at the last baking exhibition. The two chatted for more than half an hour about baking tools and techniques. Mrs. Liu invited her to go to a baking exhibition in Hangzhou together next time, and Song Yajing happily made a note of it.

start_state.mood: Eager and full of anticipation for the mango mousse

end_state.mood: She felt proud and happy; the desserts she had made by hand made family time especially sweet.
