2025-10.daily_overview: On Monday, Song Yajing completed her first morning run of the week in the early morning. In the morning, she updated the store window display, combining autumn new arrivals with a collaboration inspiration board to attract office workers shopping during brunch time. In the afternoon, she processed new design sketches sent by Susan and finalized orders for a batch of winter pre-sale items. In the evening, she took her daughter to a nearby dental clinic for routine fluoride treatment, and later accompanied her daughter in drawing and reading picture books. Before bed, she received an urgent message from a Hangzhou designer about fabric samples. She spent over half an hour communicating and confirming, delaying her bedtime.

events.name: Morning run of 3 kilometers, felt easy.
events.description: At 6:30 a.m., Song Yajing went for a morning run along Yundang Lake. Today she tried to increase her stride cadence, with an overall pace of about 7 minutes 45 seconds per kilometer; after finishing, she was only slightly sweaty. She felt her body had fully adapted to the 3-kilometer intensity and planned to occasionally extend it to 4 kilometers starting next week.

events.name: Changing the store window display to showcase the co-branding concept
events.description: After arriving at the store, Song Yajing felt the old display window had become monotonous, so she and Xiaomei set about changing it together. She used a plain background cloth as the base, paired with a photo of a new-Chinese-style sample garment that was about to be produced and printed floral illustrations, creating a simple yet elegant Oriental feel. The new display indeed attracted several young female customers into the store to take photos, and one of them immediately asked how to reserve the co-branded item. Later, she shared photos of yesterday's mango mousse cake in the community group. The group members responded enthusiastically, and several people asked for the recipe. She promised to compile it into a text-and-image post and publish it within the week.

events.name: Confirm the winter pre-sale order with supplier Susan
events.description: In the afternoon, Susan sent a batch of new photos of thick winter coats and sweaters via WeChat. Song Yajing carefully compared fabric compositions and cuts, and considering that Xiamen's winters have been short, damp, and cold, she removed some overly thick long styles and selected eight styles for the store's first winter pre-sale. She sent the order to Susan and paid a partial deposit, agreeing that the goods would arrive within two weeks.

events.name: Taking daughter Chen Lexuan for dental fluoride treatment.
events.description: After closing the store, Song Yajing hurried to the kindergarten to pick up her daughter, and then went directly to the dental clinic near the community for the semiannual routine fluoride application. Her daughter was a little nervous about the dentist; Song Yajing held her hand and reassured her softly, and the whole process was completed quickly. The dentist told her that her daughter's teeth were developing normally and that she just needed to keep it up. Relieved, she took her daughter to the nearby bakery and bought whole wheat toast as a reward.

events.name: Evening parent-child time and urgent work communication
events.description: After dinner, Song Yajing put down her phone and drew today's trip to the hospital with her daughter using crayons on the carpet. Her daughter colored the dentist's chair in rainbow colors. After bath time, she read two picture books to her daughter until her daughter's eyelids began to droop. Just as she was about to rest, a Hangzhou designer suddenly sent a WeChat message saying that the silk fabric sample used in the co-branded collection had a color discrepancy and an alternative fabric needed to be confirmed urgently. Song Yajing pulled herself together, compared color swatches one by one with the designer over a video call, finally settled on an alternative fabric, and agreed to send it out for verification tomorrow. By the time she closed her laptop, it was already 11:20 p.m.

start_state.mood: Start the workday smoothly and energetically.

end_state.mood: Although I slept late due to work, the soft satisfaction from parent-child time; handling the emergency quickly also brought a sense of achievement.

2025-10.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Song Yajing experienced an interesting shift as her husband moved from behind the scenes to the customer community. She did not go for a morning run today; instead, she slept in and stretched at home. In the morning, she handled a customer's return and exchange, coordinating patiently. At noon, Chen Zhiqiang volunteered to join her customer group, and Song Yajing happily agreed. In the afternoon, Chen Zhiqiang made his debut in the group with a practical computer tip, and was affectionately called "brother-in-law" by the group members, creating a lively atmosphere. In the evening, after closing the shop and returning home, Chen Zhiqiang's words, "So your world is really this interesting," made the couple resonate deeply on a career level for the first time, and they talked late into the night.

events.name: She stretched at home and did daily chores.
events.description: This Tuesday was a rest day from exercise. Because she had been working late into the night, she still felt a little tired when she got up this morning, so she decided to rest as planned instead of going for a morning run, and used gentle stretching to wake up her body. After getting up, Song Yajing did a simple 10-minute stretch, then calmly prepared breakfast and took her daughter to school. With a little more time than usual, she organized the home and did some seasonal storage of summer and autumn clothes.

events.name: Handle customer returns and exchanges, maintain relationships.
events.description: In the morning, a customer came to the store with a dress she had bought last week, saying the collar was slightly unraveled. Song Yajing apologized immediately and proactively offered a full refund or a replacement of the same style, and also gave her a small-denomination voucher. The customer was very satisfied; she tried on the newly arrived autumn clothing on the spot and bought a coat as well.

events.name: Husband Chen Zhiqiang expressed his willingness to join the community
events.description: During the lunch break, Chen Zhiqiang sent a WeChat message saying he had been following the group for a while, felt the atmosphere was warm, and wanted to occasionally join in to help everyone with computer questions. Song Yajing felt a hint of sweetness in her heart and replied, 'Welcome, family member, I'll add you.' She briefly explained that the group had mostly women and that topics were mainly about dressing and daily life, and reminded him to lurk and get familiar with the group first.

events.name: Chen Zhiqiang made his first appearance in the community and shared tips.
events.description: Around 3 p.m., Chen Zhiqiang sent the first message in the group chat. After introducing himself briefly, he shared a browser trick that makes shopping links open instantly without lag. The group members immediately became lively, @-ing him with all kinds of software questions and addressing him uniformly as “brother-in-law.” Chen Zhiqiang patiently replied to five or six messages until Song Yajing sent him a private message saying, “That’s enough, you’re off work,” and only then did he stop. The group atmosphere became unprecedentedly lively, and several regular customers even joked, “We’ll only feel reassured if brother-in-law stays around for good.”

events.name: Evening in-depth conversation between the couple about their respective careers.
events.description: After getting their daughter to sleep that evening, Chen Zhiqiang brought it up on his own: “So your group isn’t just for posting clothes—it’s like a sister support squad.” Song Yajing then opened her phone and showed him photos of community activities and thank-you messages from customers over the past six months. Chen Zhiqiang looked through them carefully and, for the first time, intuitively felt that what his wife ran was not just a shop but an emotional community. He held her hand and said, “In the future, share some of the difficult things in your career with me too.” At that moment, Song Yajing’s eyes became warm. The two talked late into the night, sharing their visions for the future. The rift from their wedding anniversary was already nowhere to be seen.

start_state.mood: An ordinary Tuesday, but her husband's small request made her feel curious.

end_state.mood: Moved and deeply understood; for the first time, their relationship as a couple truly blended on the career level.

2025-10.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Xiamen was drizzling with autumn rain. Song Yajing switched her outdoor morning run to indoor strength training to keep her exercise routine unbroken. In the morning, she followed up on the progress of the co-branded sample development and confirmed with the Hangzhou designer the shipping time for the first sample garment. In the afternoon, taking advantage of the slow customer flow on the rainy day, she organized her notes on morning runs and baking that she had kept this month in the store, and drafted an initial outline of her personal plan for November. During a quiet moment in the store, she also exchanged ideas with her college classmate Zhou Ting via WeChat about the financial analysis features of the inventory management app. In the evening, she discussed with her husband the arrangement to visit her parents in Quanzhou before New Year's Day, moving the family reunion earlier on the schedule.

events.name: Indoor core, glute, and leg strength training
events.description: In the early morning, as the rain grew heavier, Song Yajing decisively switched to living-room workout mode and followed the app to complete a 20-minute core, glute, and leg strength training session. She smoothly performed planks, squats, and glute bridges. Though sweating profusely, she could clearly feel that her lower-body strength had improved compared with the beginning of the month, and her form was also more standard. She decided that whenever the weather is bad in the future, she would use this routine as a backup.

events.name: Follow up on the sampling progress for the co-branded product.
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing communicated with the Hangzhou design team via WeChat and confirmed that the first sample of the new Chinese-style women's clothing had entered the cutting stage, expected to be shipped to Xiamen around November 3. She carefully verified the fabric color difference and size chart confirmed yesterday, and scheduled November 5 to invite core community members for offline fitting feedback. The progress of the co-branded project gave her a real sense of being a brand owner.

events.name: Organize October morning running and baking notes, and draft a preliminary personal plan for November.
events.description: In the drizzly afternoon, with few customers in the shop, Song Yajing made a cup of hot tea, opened her morning running log app and baking notes, and tallied her total running distance for October at about 35 kilometers. She had also completed a mango mousse in baking. On a sheet of A4 paper, she sketched a simple calendar for November and noted a few small goals, including increasing her morning runs to four times a week, learning to make a matcha opera cake, and scheduling a second in-person tasting event. She planned to stick it on the refrigerator to keep herself motivated.

events.name: Exchanged financial insights with Zhou Ting online
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing remembered that Zhou Ting was a financial expert, so she asked her via WeChat about the calculation logic for gross profit and turnover rate in the inventory management app. Zhou Ting patiently answered and sent over several report templates she had compiled, suggesting she use the data at the end of the month to analyze which styles were truly profitable. Song Yajing thanked her repeatedly, saying that this month’s data finally had a professional analytical perspective.

events.name: Discussed with her husband the plan to return to Quanzhou for New Year's Day.
events.description: During dinner, Song Yajing brought up the New Year's Day plans, suggesting that they take three days off while the shop's marketing pace was slightly slower and go back to Quanzhou to visit her parents. Chen Zhiqiang enthusiastically agreed and volunteered to drive, saying that their daughter could also get closer to her grandparents. The two of them immediately circled December 31 to January 2 on the calendar, and Song Yajing planned to set aside some of the newly arrived warm clothing from the shop to take back for her parents.

start_state.mood: Calm, embracing the slower pace brought by the rainy day

end_state.mood: Looking forward to it, and making preliminary plans for the family reunions next month and on New Year's Day

2025-10.daily_overview: On Thursday, Song Yajing went for a jog in the rain at Yundang Lake in the early morning, completing her fourth morning run of the month and formally drafting a regular morning running plan for November. There were many trivial store matters during the day; she patiently handled several returns and exchanges and questions about the co-branded collection, and also received a call from her mother and chatted about family. In the evening, she exported and backed up this month's data in the inventory management app, running a final test for the official switchover the next day. On her way home at night, she noticed her daughter had a slight cough. She took good care of her, had her drink honey water, put her to bed early, and also went to rest early herself. She also made a verbal preview in the community group for the upcoming November new product tasting event, and the group members' anticipation was maxed out.

events.name: Morning run in the rain and planned the November morning running schedule.
events.description: The light rain had not stopped in the early morning, but Song Yajing put on her waterproof windbreaker and went out as usual, running 3 kilometers along Yundang Lake. She found that jogging in the rain had its own tranquility. After the run, she went home and wrote her November morning running plan in her phone's memo: run in the morning on Tuesdays, Thursdays, Saturdays, and Sundays, at least 3 kilometers each time, with a monthly goal of 50 kilometers. She sent a screenshot of the plan to Chen Zhiqiang with the teasing note “Please supervise”, and he replied with an OK gesture.

events.name: Processing returns and exchanges and maintaining customer relationships
events.description: A customer asked for a return after comparing prices online for the same item. Song Yajing patiently explained the store's after-sales service policy and proactively offered a free alteration service as an alternative, and the customer was ultimately satisfied. She also took the opportunity to follow up with three customers who had purchased co-branded reservations, confirming their sizes were correct—a thoughtful and thorough job of maintaining relationships.

events.name: Brief phone call with her mother
events.description: While sorting goods in the afternoon, her mother Lin Xiuying called to ask if she had put on extra clothes on the rainy day. Song Yajing smiled and reassured her mother, mentioning that her daughter had won a small certificate in a drawing contest yesterday. Her mother happily told her over the phone to cook something nice for her granddaughter on the weekend.

events.name: End-of-month data export and backup for the inventory management App
events.description: After closing, Song Yajing used the inventory management app to generate the sales and inventory reports from October 1 to 30, and exported them to Excel for archiving on her computer and cloud drive. She found by comparison that the profit analysis function of the electronic accounts was far more intuitive than the handwritten ledger, so she decided to completely stop using the paper ledger starting from the beginning of next month, and put the old ledger into an archive box as a keepsake.

events.name: Published the teaser for the November offline new product tasting event
events.description: At noon, she posted a beautifully designed teaser poster in her customer community group, announcing that on the evening of November 8 she would hold a small tasting event at the shop called “Late Autumn, Early Winter · First Preview of New Chinese Style.” At the event, customers could be measured and order the first version of the co-branded sample garment, with a limit of 15 people. Within five minutes of the poster’s release, the sign-up list was already full, which surprised and delighted her, and she immediately began working intensively on the tea break and return-gift plans for the day.

events.name: Caring for her daughter with a slight cough.
events.description: Returning home in the evening, Song Yajing noticed her daughter Chen Lexuan coughing occasionally, so she carefully made honey lemon water for her and applied a warm towel to her back. She watched a quiet cartoon episode with her daughter and got her to sleep early. Seeing her daughter's steady breathing, she finally relaxed, washed up briefly, and went to bed early herself.

start_state.mood: The self-discipline of persisting in morning running even on rainy days brings a sense of accomplishment in the morning.

end_state.mood: An efficient Thursday: morning run and store work both accomplished; the worry over her daughter's discomfort was eased by attentive care.

2025-10.daily_overview: On Friday, the last day of the month, Song Yajing wrapped up her healthy month with a perfect morning run and completely completed the digital upgrade of her shop. In the early morning, she completed another morning run during the consolidation phase, with a steady pace of 7 minutes per kilometer; the doctor's advice had been fully transformed into action. During the day, she and Xiaomei divided the work, formally abandoned the heavy paper ledgers, and fully adopted the inventory management app to record daily sales, deduct inventory, and tally income and expenses. In the evening, she used the app's automatic inventory check function for a comprehensive month-end reconciliation. The inventory discrepancy rate dropped significantly compared with previous manual bookkeeping. She excitedly shared the good news with her financial mentor Zhou Ting, and with a light heart accompanied her daughter to sleep, briefly reviewing the day's store earnings on her phone before going to bed. October ended perfectly with a leap in health and business upgrade.

events.name: Morning run consolidated; pace steady at 7 min/km.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Song Yajing completed a 3-kilometer morning run around Yundang Lake. Today she felt especially light, and her pace stabilized at 7 minutes per kilometer for the first time. Looking at the App records, from 8 min/km at the beginning of the month to 7 min/km now, a month of persistence was paying off. Facing the rising sun, she smiled and told herself: This is the life I want.

events.name: Officially abandon manual ledger and fully launch electronic bookkeeping
events.description: Arriving at the store early in the morning, Song Yajing solemnly closed the manual ledger she had used for nearly a year, wrote "As of 2025.10.31" on the cover with a marker, and put it into the file cabinet. She opened the inventory app and announced to Xiao Mei that from then on, all sales, returns, and stock changes would be recorded only in it. That day Xiao Mei entered seven sales transactions. When Song Yajing reviewed them, she corrected one amount, but the overall smoothness was far beyond the manual era.

events.name: The app's automatic month-end inventory produced gratifyingly accurate data.
events.description: After closing the store, Song Yajing tapped the "Month-End Inventory" button in the inventory management app, and the system automatically compared theoretical stock with actual counted quantities to generate this month's discrepancy report. The results showed that the discrepancy rate had dropped from around 3% when done manually to 0.5%. Only one hat showed a discrepancy because a child had tried it on and put it back in the wrong place, and it was quickly found. Unable to contain her joy, she immediately screenshotted the discrepancy report and sent it to Zhou Ting: "Ting, look! 0.5%! I've completely said goodbye to muddled accounts." Zhou Ting replied instantly: "Now that's my good student."

events.name: Accompany daughter in the evening and check the day's transactions.
events.description: After returning home, Song Yajing and her husband bathed their daughter and told her bedtime stories. After their daughter fell asleep, she sat back against the headboard, opened the inventory management app to check the day's sales summary and transaction charts, and confirmed that business revenue matched the payments received by the payment platform. Looking at the clearly changing numbers on the screen, she realized that this October had brought not only a co-branding breakthrough in her career and closer family relationships, but also financial management keeping pace. A sense of solid accomplishment made her smile unconsciously. She gently put down her phone, sent a goodnight message in the family group chat, and fell asleep with satisfaction.

start_state.mood: Full of determination, ready to round off October in a modern way.

end_state.mood: Feeling light and content, with all physical metrics trending upward; she has both digitized bookkeeping and family warmth.

2025-04.daily_overview: On the first day of April, under the pressure of running the shop, Song Yajing displayed the initiative and practical mindset characteristic of the ESFJ personality. Early in the morning, she arrived at the shop and, based on her review notes from the night before, made a series of operational adjustments. She resolved to cut the ineffective online traffic-generation budget and reallocate the funds to restocking best-selling items. In the morning, she held a formal store meeting with her staff member Xiao Mei, communicated the new strategy, and adjusted the sales incentive plan. Xiao Mei's positive response brought her some comfort. However, with spring pollen levels rising, she suddenly started sneezing and had a runny nose while organizing merchandise in the shop in the afternoon—the familiar symptoms of allergic rhinitis struck again. She endured the discomfort, dug out the Chinese herbal medicine and honeycomb extract the doctor had prescribed last month from the medicine box, and took them, realizing that she would spend yet another spring fighting allergies. In the evening, after closing the shop and going home, she felt a little tired but still insisted on telling her daughter Xuanxuan a bedtime story. Before bed, she did her usual 10-minute neck and shoulder stretch and brewed a cup of warm Chinese herbal medicine to ease her stuffy nose.

events.name: Arrive at the store in the early morning to formulate the April business adjustment plan
events.description: Song Yajing arrived at the boutique clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street half an hour earlier than usual. She turned on her computer and last month's business ledger and, based on the review and analysis she had done at home the previous night, systematically worked out operational adjustment measures for April. She decided to cut the online customer-acquisition advertising budget by about 2,000 yuan, put the coffee corner materials purchase plan she had been considering on hold, and use the saved funds to restock several spring dresses and knit cardigans that had sold best in the past three months. At the same time, she listed concrete plans in her notebook for strengthening WeChat community maintenance, intending to post outfit-sharing content in the customer group at least three times a week to increase repeat purchase rates among regular customers.

events.name: Communicate the new business strategy to store clerk Xiaomei and adjust the incentive plan.
events.description: At nine in the morning, after Xiaomei arrived at the store, Song Yajing spread out a notebook on the small table next to the fitting area and formally conveyed to Xiaomei the details of the April operation adjustments. She explained that because the coffee corner had been put on hold, they would need to focus more on guiding customers to try on clothes and providing one-on-one customer maintenance, and she changed Xiaomei's sales commission rate from the original 3% to a tiered incentive—monthly sales exceeding 20,000 yuan would be commissioned at 5%. Xiaomei said she understood and proactively offered to reply to more old customers' inquiries on WeChat. Song Yajing felt gratified. The two of them together moved the best-selling styles to more prominent display positions.

events.name: Spring allergic rhinitis recurred, requiring urgent medication.
events.description: Around two in the afternoon, the wind began to pick up in Siming District, Xiamen, and the pollen concentration in the air suddenly rose. While organizing shelves in the shop, Song Yajing suddenly had a continuous fit of sneezing, a runny nose, and unbearable itching in her nasal passages. She immediately realized that her seasonal allergic rhinitis had flared up again — this was the third consecutive spring she had been affected. She asked Xiao Mei, who was nearby, to watch the store, then took out the traditional Chinese medicine granules and honeycomb extract capsules prescribed by Dr. Wang Mingyuan at Xiamen Community Health Center last month from the medicine box under the cash register, and took them according to the stated dosage. Half an hour later, her symptoms had eased, but she still sounded congested, so she decided to carry anti-allergy medication with her for the next few days.

events.name: Bedtime neck and shoulder stretches and brewing traditional Chinese medicine
events.description: At 10:30 p.m., Song Yajing unrolled her yoga mat on the bedroom floor, opened the app on her phone, and followed the guidance for a 10-minute neck, shoulder, and back stretch, focusing on relaxing the trapezius and scapular areas. After stretching, she brewed a cup of traditional Chinese medicine granules with hot water and sipped it slowly to help her sleep and relieve nasal congestion. This was a new habit she had formed since March, trying to maintain a sense of order in her body amid the busyness.

start_state.mood: Clear-headed with a slight sense of pressure, and with clear ideas about operational adjustments for the new month.

end_state.location: Home bedroom, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen.
end_state.mood: Feeling unwell but a solid sense that the plan has been carried out; a bit helpless about the spring allergy recurrence.

2025-04.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Xiamen welcomed dusty weather under the warm spring sun. Song Yajing's allergic rhinitis symptoms were slightly better than yesterday, but she still needed to be careful. Before opening the shop in the morning, she took extra time to organize her medications, packing loratadine tablets into a small pillbox and putting it in her bag. This gesture revealed the meticulous planning that her ESFJ personality brings to family and personal health. Today the shop's new spring clothing arrived. She and Xiaomei unpacked, ironed, and displayed the items together. After the new floral dresses were shown in the window, several young female passersby came in to try them on. In the afternoon, she confirmed the shipping time for the next batch of goods with supplier Susan via WeChat, and posted a set of spring outfit inspiration photos in the customer group. Several regular customers liked and interacted with the posts, which gave her more confidence in the direction of her new community operations. In the evening, after playing with puzzles with her daughter, she felt some stiffness in her neck and shoulders, so she extended her pre-sleep stretching to 15 minutes.

events.name: In the early morning, organized her portable anti-allergy medication.
events.description: To ensure she could promptly deal with possible sudden allergy symptoms when going out, Song Yajing spent ten minutes organizing her portable medications before leaving. She took a box of loratadine tablets from the family medicine cabinet, divided them into a portable pill case at a dosage of one tablet per day, and attached a sticky note on the pill case with the time to take them. She also checked the remaining amounts of the traditional Chinese medicine granules and the honeycomb extract capsules she had taken yesterday, and put the honeycomb extract in the side pocket of her handbag. Before going out, she cleaned her nasal cavity with saline spray in front of the hall mirror — a preventive measure that Doctor Wang Mingyuan taught her during last year's allergy season, and she decided to stick with it this year.

events.name: Go to the store to sort newly arrived goods and communicate with suppliers online
events.description: Song Yajing and Xiaomei spent most of the morning processing the three newly arrived boxes of spring clothing. After opening the boxes, they checked the fabric and workmanship piece by piece, ironed the key styles such as floral chiffon dresses and thin knit cardigans, and displayed them on the mannequin and main display racks at the store entrance. Xiaomei entered each item into the cashier system, while Song Yajing took photos of the new items for online promotion. At 2 pm, she confirmed the final payment for this batch of goods and the estimated shipping time (around April 10) for the next batch of jeans with the supplier Susan via WeChat voice message. Susan praised her eye for selecting styles during the last restock, and Song Yajing felt in a good mood.

events.name: Posted spring outfit ideas in the customer WeChat group.
events.description: At 4:30 p.m., when foot traffic in the store had eased, Song Yajing posted a set of spring outfit inspiration photos in the boutique's customer WeChat group—three looks featuring mostly new in-store items, including a floral dress with a denim jacket, a knit cardigan with white straight-leg pants, etc. In each look description, she noted size recommendations and suitable skin tones. This was the first attempt in the April community maintenance plan. After posting, several regular customers asked in the group about prices and size details, and some asked to reserve the dresses; Song Yajing replied to each one. The interaction boosted her confidence in strengthening the WeChat community maintenance strategy.

events.name: Evening with daughter and bedtime stretching
events.description: After dinner, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang accompanied their daughter Xuanxuan doing puzzles in the living room. Xuanxuan insisted that her mother put together three small animals in a row. After putting their daughter to bed, Song Yajing felt her shoulders and neck tense from carrying goods during the day. She unrolled her yoga mat, extended her pre-sleep stretching to 15 minutes, and added several sets of shoulder circles and cat-cow poses, which brought noticeable relief. Afterward, she brewed her Chinese herbal medicine, took it, and got into bed right on time at 22:45.

start_state.mood: Mild nasal congestion after waking; a reassuring sense of being prepared for allergy management.

end_state.location: Home bedroom, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen.
end_state.mood: A gratifying feeling from the positive feedback in community interactions, and anticipation for tomorrow's trip back to Quanzhou.

2025-04.daily_overview: The day before Qingming Festival, Song Yajing returned to her hometown in Quanzhou with her daughter as planned to pay respects to her ancestors. After getting up in the early morning, she packed quickly and efficiently, loading into the car her daughter's and her own clothes, allergy medication, and gifts for her parents. Since her husband Chen Zhiqiang had suddenly received an urgent business trip notice from his company and could not go with them, she drove the white family SUV alone with her daughter, heading north along the Shenhai Expressway. Xuanxuan hummed a song she had learned in kindergarten from her safety seat in the back. It was already noon when they arrived at her parents' home in Quanzhou. Her mother, Lin Xiuying, opened the door and beamed with joy at the sight of her daughter and granddaughter, but the attentive mother soon noticed that Song Yajing had lost weight compared with the Spring Festival. She quietly pulled her daughter into the kitchen and pressed 2,000 yuan in cash into her hand, telling her to eat well. The afternoon sunshine in Quanzhou was warm. Her father, Song Minghui, went to the market specially to buy bamboo shoots and pork ribs. In the evening, the family sat together eating bamboo shoot and rib stew and mugwort cake. Song Yajing felt a rare sense of relaxation in her parents' care. While sorting her luggage at her parents' home, she placed the air purifier she had bought in the afternoon in the corner of the shop, and studied and marked walking routes near the house. Before going to bed, she did some simple stretching in the guest room, but because she was tired from the trip, the stretching was mediocre.

events.name: Packed luggage at home in Xiamen in the early morning for the trip back to Quanzhou to honor ancestors.
events.description: Song Yajing got up at 6:30 and began packing for the trip back to Quanzhou while her daughter Xuanxuan was still sleeping. She took out two sets of clothes for herself and her daughter from the wardrobe (including a plain-colored jacket suitable for grave-visiting occasions), put a small medicine pouch containing loratadine, traditional Chinese medicine granules, and honeycomb extract into the side pocket of her carry-on luggage, then took out two boxes of Xiamen specialty pies and a light spring jacket she had bought for her father as gifts. Before loading the luggage into the car, she called her mother in Quanzhou to tell her the estimated arrival time. Her mother said on the phone that she had already prepared the meat zongzi her daughter loved.

events.name: Drove alone with her daughter along the Shenhai Expressway to Quanzhou.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Song Yajing settled her daughter into the car seat in the back, started up her white SUV, and drove out from Hubin South Road, through the Xiangan Tunnel, and onto the Shenhai Expressway. In the back seat, Xuanxuan hugged her plush toy cat and kept pointing out the window asking her mother why the trees were running backward. Along the way, Song Yajing played light music and chatted with her daughter from time to time; the drive took about an hour and a half. During a brief stop at a highway service area, she helped her daughter use the restroom and bought a bottle of water, and also checked the store WeChat group on her phone to see the message Xiaomei had sent about opening the shop. After confirming everything was fine, she continued on the road.

events.name: Arrive at parents' home in Quanzhou and reunite with them.
events.description: At about 10:30 a.m., Song Yajing's car stopped downstairs at the old residential complex where her parents lived in Licheng District, Quanzhou. Her mother, Lin Xiuying, was already waiting on the ground floor of the building. When she saw her granddaughter, she immediately went over, picked her up, and kissed her again and again. Her father, Song Minghui, took their luggage and led them upstairs. Once inside, her mother brought out the meat zongzi and mugwort cakes she had prepared in advance and urged the mother and daughter to eat them while hot. Observant Lin Xiuying noticed that her daughter looked tired and much thinner than when they had met at the Spring Festival. After the meal, while her father took Xuanxuan to the balcony to look at the goldfish, she pulled Song Yajing into the kitchen and quietly slipped her 2,000 yuan in cash, telling her to eat a little better in Xiamen and not be too frugal. Song Yajing's eyes reddened slightly as she accepted her mother's care.

events.name: Went to a home appliance store in Siming District, Xiamen, to buy an air purifier for the shop.
events.description: Before departing from Quanzhou (around 8:30 AM), Song Yajing made a stop en route at a home appliance chain store in Siming District, where she selected an air purifier with a HEPA filter suitable for a small shop. After asking the salesperson about the applicable area and pollen filtration function, she chose a mid-priced, low-noise model. After paying, she asked the store to deliver it to Stall 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street that afternoon, and called Xiaomei to let her know to watch for the delivery. She hoped this purifier would reduce the pollen concentration in the shop during spring and ease the allergy discomfort of both herself and her customers.

events.name: Place the air purifier and set its operating mode
events.description: In the afternoon, after the shopping mall delivered the air purifier to the shop, Xiaomei signed for it and sent a photo via WeChat to Song Yajing, who was already in Quanzhou, for confirmation. Song Yajing guided Xiaomei over the phone to place the purifier in the left corner of the shop (near the fitting area), plug it in, and set the operation mode to auto to ensure air circulation and filtration in the shop. Xiaomei reported that the machine ran very quietly and did not disturb customers. Relieved, Song Yajing crossed this item off her to-do list.

events.name: Research walking routes near home and mark allergen-prone road sections
events.description: In the evening at her parents' home in Quanzhou, while her daughter Xuanxuan was watching cartoons with her maternal grandfather in the living room, Song Yajing opened the map app on her phone to study walking routes around her home on Hubin South Road in Xiamen. Based on her experience when her allergies flared up last year, she marked several stretches near the residential area with dense flowering trees (including sections lined with orchid trees and white magnolias), and designed a new morning walking route that avoided these plants, ran along Hubin South Road toward Bailuzhou and then turned back, about two kilometers in total. She recorded the route and estimated time in detail in her phone memo, planning to try it once after returning to Xiamen.

events.name: Simple stretching and relaxation before bed
events.description: In the guest room at her parents' home, Song Yajing laid out her own travel yoga mat and followed an app on her phone for an 8-minute neck and shoulder stretch. But because of the day's driving fatigue, her movements were somewhat perfunctory, and she skipped her usual back relaxation. She reassured herself that today's activity was already enough, and lay down early.

2025-04.daily_overview: On the day of the Qingming Festival, a light rain fell in Quanzhou in the morning, and the air was damp. Song Yajing helped her mother prepare fresh flowers, incense and candles, and offerings for the tomb-sweeping. Her father took out a folding trowel and a cloth from the cabinet. In the morning, the family drove to the family cemetery on a hillside on the outskirts of Quanzhou. Her daughter Xuanxuan, taking part in a formal Qingming tomb-sweeping for the first time, asked all kinds of curious questions. In front of the tombstone, Song Yajing and her parents cleared the weeds, wiped the inscription, placed flowers, burned incense, and bowed. She whispered to her ancestors about the shop's business and the family's recent life. Just as they were about to leave, she unexpectedly saw a familiar figure by the stone steps of the cemetery — Zhang Wei, her middle school classmate, whom she had not seen for nearly ten years. Zhang Wei looked more haggard than in his WeChat Moments photos. The two sat on the stone steps and chatted for half an hour. Zhang Wei frankly said that the pressure of his mortgage was enormous and that his income from ride-hailing was just a drop in the bucket, his tone full of powerlessness. Song Yajing wanted to say something encouraging, but found herself also overwhelmed by the anxiety of running the shop. In the end, she silently shook his hand and said goodbye. After returning to her parents' home, she sat alone in the room she had lived in as a child and, for the first time, sincerely knelt down to pray for her friend. A sense of responsibility and spiritual stirring that she had never felt before welled up in her heart. In the evening, the rain stopped. She helped her mother make spring rolls for dinner. Her father's braised pork ribs with bamboo shoots appeared on the table again, and the family sat together through a peaceful, warm Qingming evening. Because of her emotional turmoil and physical exhaustion, she did not stretch before going to bed and went straight to sleep.

events.name: Went with her parents and daughter to a cemetery in Quanzhou to pay respects to their ancestors.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, the sky was faintly light. Song Yajing helped her mother pack the pre-prepared yellow and white chrysanthemum bouquets, sandalwood, candles, and fruit offerings into bags. Her father took out an old towel and a small shovel for wiping the tombstone from the storage room. At 7:30, the family drove to the cemetery park on the outskirts of Quanzhou. A fine rain pattered against the car windows, and there were already many families in the cemetery paying respects. In front of the family tombstone, Song Yajing and her father pulled up the surrounding weeds together; her mother carefully wiped the inscribed characters on the tombstone with a wet towel, and Xuanxuan helped pass the flowers. The family burned incense and kowtowed in turn. Song Yajing silently prayed before the tombstone, reporting to her ancestors about the fifth year of the store's opening, Xuanxuan starting primary school this autumn, and her husband's absence due to a business trip, and prayed for the ancestors to bless the whole family with safety.

events.name: Ran into middle school classmate Zhang Wei at the cemetery and had a deep talk
events.description: After the tomb-sweeping was over, as Song Yajing was packing up the offering bags, she looked up and saw a familiar yet unfamiliar figure not far away—Zhang Wei, her junior high school classmate, was crouching alone in front of a grave burning paper offerings. She asked her parents to take Xuanxuan to the parking lot first and went over to greet him. Zhang Wei looked up, stunned for a moment before recognizing her; the last time they had seen each other was at a class reunion ten years ago. They sat down on the stone steps of the cemetery and chatted for about half an hour. Zhang Wei said he worked as a software engineer in Shenzhen. After the company laid off staff last year, he started driving for ride-hailing services, but his monthly income had dropped sharply. The monthly mortgage of 12,000 yuan was crushing him. This time, when he returned alone to Quanzhou to sweep the tomb, he couldn't even bear to buy a first-class seat on the high-speed rail. Song Yajing wanted to comfort him and shared that her own store was also facing financial pressure and supplier disputes, but found that no words could reach the depth of his suffering. The two shook hands silently at the cemetery entrance and went their separate ways. As Song Yajing turned around, she saw a few raindrops on his shoulders.

events.name: After returning home, she prayed sincerely alone for Zhang Wei.
events.description: Around three in the afternoon, she returned to her parents' home. Her father went next door to play chess with a neighbor, and her mother took Xuanxuan to read picture books in the living room. Song Yajing walked into the bedroom she had shared with her sister as a child (which her mother had now set up as a guest room but kept the old desk and the cross ornament), closed the door, and sat alone on the edge of the bed. In her mind, the image of Zhang Wei sitting forlornly on the stone steps kept recurring, along with her frustration at being unable to help. She knelt in front of the bed, palms pressed together, and for the first time prayed so sincerely to God for another person's difficulties—from Zhang Wei's mortgage pressure and unemployment to his mental health, and then to the fragile interconnectedness between people that she had never felt so clearly. When the prayer ended, her eyes were moist, and an indescribable sense of responsibility rose in her heart. She also had an experience of faith that was different from her usual routine of going to Mass every Sunday.

events.name: Skipped the pre-bedtime stretch due to mood swings.
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing felt physically and mentally exhausted. Although she knew she should do some stretching to relax, she simply washed up and lay down on the bed. Today's experiences caused her emotions to fluctuate greatly, and her muscle tension seemed temporarily overshadowed by the heaviness in her mind. She decided to "be lazy" tonight.

start_state.mood: A reverent and solemn Qingming mood, along with a sense of responsibility for taking her daughter to formally visit the family grave for the first time.

end_state.mood: After praying for a friend, she felt calm and a deep sense of responsibility, and a new stirring in her faith.

2025-04.daily_overview: Although today is Saturday, strictly speaking it is not a public holiday (the Qingming holiday ended yesterday). Song Yajing was nevertheless enjoying family time at her parents' home in Quanzhou. In the morning, she took Xuanxuan to stroll through the old streets of Licheng District, which she had known since childhood. She bought Xuanxuan some traditional Quanzhou sugar paintings and dough figurines, and also bought some popiah wrappers to bring back to Xiamen. In the afternoon, while driving back to Xiamen, they made a brief stop at a service area. After arriving home in the evening, Song Yajing found Xuanxuan's masterpiece on the living room wall—a rainbow and cats drawn in crayon covering a sizable portion of the wall. She was startled at first, but instead of getting angry, she was moved by her daughter's uninhibited creativity and thought of her own childhood regret of never having had the chance to learn painting because she had to help with housework. In the evening, after discussing with her husband, she searched for community art centers in WeChat on her phone and found a notification saying there happened to be a parent-child watercolor class the next day, so she immediately signed up online. That day, as planned, she had also walked alone in the early morning along the planned pollen-avoiding route and confirmed it was feasible. At the same time, she received the parent-child watercolor class notification pushed by the community art center, completed registration and payment, and integrated it into a coherent event. Since she was back at her own home, she resumed her bedtime stretching, and while stretching, she thought about preparing for the watercolor class.

events.name: Took a morning walk along the newly planned route to verify its feasibility
events.description: At seven in the morning, Song Yajing got up at her parents' home in Quanzhou and decided to go out for a walk to get some fresh air (also to test whether the morning route idea she had planned for Xiamen the day before could be transferred). She walked along the alleys of Licheng District, where her parents lived, to the nearby Confucius Temple Square, deliberately bypassing several kapok trees in full bloom along the way. After walking for about twenty minutes, she felt her nasal congestion ease, confirming that the strategy of avoiding pollen-dense stretches was effective. When she returned to her parents' home, her mother had already prepared soy milk and fried dough sticks for breakfast, and she shared the idea of avoiding pollen-heavy routes with her father, who also had mild allergies.

events.name: Daughter's graffiti on the living room wall triggers Song Yajing's childhood memories
events.description: At six in the evening, Song Yajing returned to her home in Xiamen; her husband Chen Zhiqiang was still working overtime at the company. While she was putting away the popiah wrappers she had brought back in the kitchen, she suddenly noticed that her daughter Xuanxuan was unusually quiet. When she walked into the living room, Xuanxuan was kneeling beside the sofa, drawing a big rainbow, three cats of different shapes, and a sunflower on the snow-white wall with crayons. As Song Yajing approached, Xuanxuan turned around and said proudly, “Mom, look, I drew our home.” Song Yajing did not scold her. Instead, she crouched down and carefully studied these imaginative doodles, and the regret she had felt at eight years old—when she had longed to join the school art club but was told by her mother to stay home and help look after her younger sister—suddenly surfaced in her mind. She stood still in front of the wall for a moment, filled with a tender feeling.

events.name: After discussing with her husband, she decided to sign up for the parent-child watercolor class.
events.description: At 8 p.m., after her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home, Song Yajing pointed at the crayon doodle on the living room wall (she had taken a photo with her phone to print and keep) and talked with her husband in the bedroom. She shared her regret over her artistic interest being ignored in her childhood, and suggested that she and her daughter sign up for a parent-child painting class that the community activity center might offer soon. Chen Zhiqiang said that Xuanxuan really did like doodling, so they might as well give her a chance to try. He not only expressed support, but also volunteered to take care of the store or do housework on Saturday mornings. Encouraged, Song Yajing immediately opened WeChat, searched for the Siming District Community Art Center official account, and happened to see a recruitment post for a parent-child watercolor class starting on April 12.

events.name: Completed registration for the parent-child watercolor class through the community art center's official account.
events.description: At around ten in the evening, Song Yajing filled out the online registration form for the parent-child watercolor class on the bed in the bedroom via the community art center's WeChat official account, registering for herself and her daughter Chen Lexuan. The course information showed that the class would be held every Saturday from 9:00 to 10:30 a.m., six sessions in total, and the fee included basic painting tools. She paid the registration fee via WeChat Pay and soon received a confirmation text message reminding her to bring her own and her child's identification to the first class to pick up materials. She sent a screenshot of the class schedule to her husband on WeChat, and he replied with a thumbs-up emoji.

events.name: Resumed pre-bed stretching and thought about preparations for the watercolor class
events.description: After signing up, Song Yajing spread out her yoga mat and did 12 minutes of neck, shoulder, and back stretches. While stretching, she was already making a mental list of the items she needed to prepare for the watercolor class, and decided to take her daughter to buy art materials the next day. When the stretching was over, she let out a comfortable long sigh and felt her body recovering a little from the fatigue of the Qingming tomb-sweeping visit.

2025-04.daily_overview: On Sunday, the sunlight in Xiamen was gentle. As usual, Song Yajing first went to church to attend Mass, her weekly moment of spiritual quiet as a Catholic. After Mass, she chatted briefly with Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow parishioner, at the church entrance about recent news. Aunt Lin said with concern that she looked less healthy than usual, and she admitted that she had been troubled by spring allergies and the pressure of running the shop. When she got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang took the initiative to take their daughter to the park to give her some alone time. Song Yajing used this gap to share her personal experience with managing spring allergic rhinitis in the customer WeChat group—a community engagement approach that had suddenly occurred to her before bed last night. She wanted to try bringing herself closer to customers with life-oriented content, and it indeed resonated with many women. In the afternoon, she took the course list she had signed up for the night before and brought her daughter to an art supply store near Zhongshan Road. The mother and daughter picked out pink and blue waterproof aprons, a set of children's safe watercolor paints, and brushes of different sizes. Xuanxuan ran around excitedly in the store. Song Yajing decided to take the opportunity to replace the shop's community sharing content, and that post received quite a few likes that evening. When she returned home in the evening, she checked all the art supplies against the course list, folded the aprons, and packed them with the paints into a spare cloth bag, preparing for the first class next Saturday. Before bed she insisted on stretching, but her right shoulder was especially sore and swollen today, so she specifically rolled a massage ball over her shoulder blade.

events.name: Go to Siming Catholic Church to attend Sunday Mass and fellowship with fellow parishioners
events.description: At 8:30 in the morning, Song Yajing changed into a solid-color dress and left, walking alone to Siming Catholic Church about a kilometer from home. Mass was celebrated by Father Wang Mingde. The Gospel reading today was the passage from the Gospel of John about the Good Shepherd. As she listened, Song Yajing could not help thinking of her helpless feeling when she met Zhang Wei at the cemetery yesterday, and she silently continued to hold her concern for her junior high school classmate in her prayers. After Mass, in the small square in front of the church, Auntie Lin Xiuying, a fellow parishioner, stopped her and asked with concern why she looked a bit tired. Song Yajing admitted that she had been troubled by spring allergies and the pressure of running the store. Auntie Lin comforted her warmly in the tone of someone who had been through it, and said she should come to her home for a cup of pomelo tea and a chat when she had time.

events.name: Shared spring allergy care insights in the customer WeChat group and resonated with everyone.
events.description: At 10 a.m., she returned home. After her husband took their daughter to the park, Song Yajing made a cup of warm water and sat on the sofa. She opened the customer WeChat group of her boutique clothing store and composed a long message—starting from her own experience, she described how she dealt with a relapse of allergic rhinitis last week: taking the traditional Chinese medicine granules and honeycomb extract prescribed by her doctor, carrying loratadine as backup when going out, rinsing her nose with saline solution, and buying an air purifier for the store. She said sincerely that for women over thirty, health is the most important asset, and urged her sisters to be careful in spring. The message quickly triggered replies and discussions from more than ten customers in the group. Some asked where to buy honeycomb extract, and others shared their experience using nasal irrigators. The atmosphere in the group was warm and lively. This was Song Yajing's first proactive attempt to shift her community operations from simply selling goods to sharing lifestyle content. Watching the interaction, she felt the satisfaction that comes from serving others.

events.name: Took her daughter to an art supply store to buy watercolor supplies
events.description: At three in the afternoon, Song Yajing rode an electric scooter with her daughter Xuanxuan to an art supplies store near Zhongshan Road. Following the course list received last night, she purchased watercolor paper (thick weight 200g), a box of 12-color child-safe watercolor paints, three brushes of different thicknesses, and a plastic palette. She also picked out a pink waterproof apron for her daughter and chose a light gray-blue one for herself. After paying, Song Yajing took a photo of the art supplies in the shopping bag with her phone at the store entrance and casually posted it on Moments with the caption: our first mother-daughter set, class starts next Saturday. Soon her best friend Li Meiling commented that she looked forward to seeing the works.

2025-04.daily_overview: On Monday, she returned to the store and resumed the normal business rhythm. When she got up this morning, Song Yajing noticed her runny nose was getting worse. The combined effect of haze and pollen in the air caused a clear reaction in her nasal mucosa, so she decided to start the daily medication plan from today instead of waiting for symptoms to flare up. In the morning, she spent time organizing the medicine box under the cashier counter at the store—packing the traditional Chinese medicine granules into small sealed bags according to morning, noon, and evening doses, placing the honeycomb essence capsules within easy reach, and setting up three daily medication reminders on her phone. Xiaomei saw this and teased her for being more particular than an old person. She said allergies can't be put off and are maddening. The store's air purifier kept running with a green light, which reassured her a lot. During a quieter period in the afternoon, she proactively removed the filter from the air purifier at home, washed it, and let it dry. She found the filter was covered with fine grayish-white pollen particles, proving that spring pollen was indeed not to be underestimated. Overall, customer traffic was low today, but after sharing outfit looks on WeChat Moments, she attracted a new customer to the store for a fitting. That evening, after getting home, she had planned to do stretching, but she received a call from Xiaomei saying that the store's cash register system had malfunctioned. She spent nearly an hour providing remote guidance to fix it, which delayed her stretching until close to midnight, and she did it in a hurry.

events.name: After arriving at the store, organized the daily medication schedule and set reminders.
events.description: After arriving at the store at 9 a.m., Song Yajing took out the entire medicine box from under the cash register, repacked the small packets of Chinese medicine granules into three labeled sealed bags according to three daily doses (after breakfast, after lunch, and before bed), and placed the bottle of honeycomb extract capsules in the cash register drawer within easy reach. She opened the alarm app on her phone and set three daily medication reminders (9 a.m., 1 p.m., and 9 p.m.), labeling the alarm Nasal Allergy Medicine. Xiaomei, who was tidying the display nearby, saw what she was doing and joked, Yajing, you take your medicine even more regularly than an elderly person. Song Yajing smiled wryly and told Xiaomei about how last year she had to stay home for three days after allergies triggered sinusitis.

events.name: Clean the air purifier filters at the store and at home.
events.description: At three in the afternoon, following the air purifier manual's recommendation (first cleaning needed after one week of use), Song Yajing unplugged the purifier in the corner of the store and carefully removed the pre-filter and the HEPA main filter. A layer of grayish-white fine particles was visible on the filter surface. She gently wiped the pre-filter with a damp cloth and used the vacuum cleaner's lowest setting to remove pollen and dust from the HEPA filter. After cleaning, she reinstalled them and turned it on; the air quality index on the purifier dropped from orange to green. After returning home in the evening, she used the same steps to clean the small air purifier filter in her daughter's room and recorded the next cleaning date on her phone.

events.name: Provided remote assistance to Xiaomei to resolve a cash register system failure, which delayed stretching.
events.description: At 10 p.m., Song Yajing was spreading out her yoga mat for a pre-bedtime stretch when her phone suddenly rang. Xiaomei said anxiously that the store’s cash register system was showing a database error and could not process payments. Song Yajing immediately connected remotely using her laptop and, under the voice guidance of her husband Chen Zhiqiang (who has an IT background), troubleshooted step by step. Eventually they found that after the system auto-updated, a port conflict had occurred. By the time the problem was resolved, it was almost 11 p.m. Song Yajing was exhausted, but she still forced herself to do 5 minutes of neck circles and shoulder stretches, then fell asleep as soon as her head hit the pillow.

2025-04.daily_overview: Tuesday is a day with relatively heavy customer traffic for the shop, but Song Yajing deliberately scheduled a full inventory count before opening—a task she had planned a month earlier but kept putting off. In the morning, she and Xiaomei arrived at the store early, took out all the clothes from the shelves and the storeroom, and counted and recorded each item by category, size, and color. They found that several sweaters and heavy coats from last winter were still taking up shelf space, while the XS and S sizes of the spring light knit cardigans were nearly sold out. The inventory data gave her a clear picture of the store's actual stock situation and also provided a basis for the next order. In the afternoon, during breaks in the inventory work, she used her phone to contact her main supplier, Susan, on WeChat, had an initial discussion about replenishment needs for the next season, and got confirmation of delivery in mid-April. She also found time to rearrange the window display, featuring the newly arrived spring floral dresses as this week's main promoted items. Standing for long stretches made her lower back, neck, and shoulders sore, but mentally she felt more grounded because the inventory data was now clear. In the evening, her neighbor Aunt Zhang brought over some egg tarts she had baked herself. Song Yajing ate two in one go, and her mood improved a bit. Before bed, she did some serious stretching and decided that she would definitely take care of the education savings the next day.

events.name: Conduct a full inventory count of the store before opening
events.description: Before opening at 8:30 a.m., Song Yajing and Xiaomei arrived early to conduct a full inventory count. They took out all clothing from the warehouse and shelves by category (dresses, knit tops, shirts, pants, outerwear). Song Yajing read out the style number, size, and color of each item, and Xiaomei recorded them in the inventory book. They found that several styles of heavy winter coats and sweaters were still taking up valuable shelf space (about 15 pieces). Song Yajing immediately decided to pack them up and put them in the warehouse corner to be restocked in autumn/winter. Meanwhile, the XS and S sizes of the spring lightweight knit cardigans were sold out and needed immediate replenishment. The entire count took nearly three hours, and when the store officially opened at 11:30, a small amount of unorganized goods was still piled up near the fitting area.

events.name: Make a restocking plan based on the inventory results and contact supplier Susan.
events.description: At 1 p.m., taking advantage of a lull in customer traffic, Song Yajing organized the inventory data on the computer at the cash register. Based on spring fashion trends (she had recently noticed from browsing fashion news that floral prints, thin knitwear, and wide-leg pants were still the season's themes), she made a restocking list for the next season—focusing on restocking small-size thin knit cardigans, adding two colors of wide-leg jeans, and one French square-neck dress. She sent the list to supplier Susan via WeChat and confirmed by voice message that these styles were in stock and could be shipped to Xiamen before April 13. Susan replied that the in-stock items could meet the needs and suggested adding light blue shades to the wide-leg pants to suit Xiamen's spring-to-summer transition. The smooth communication gave Song Yajing confidence in the upcoming restock.

events.name: Rearranged the window display and launched this week's featured products.
events.description: After the inventory check was completely finished at three in the afternoon, Song Yajing and Xiaomei rearranged the store's street-facing window display together. She swapped out the winter coat on the mannequin and, using the display techniques she had learned from recent fashion news, put together a spring look with a floral chiffon dress, a beige knit cardigan, and off-white canvas shoes. Xiaomei found a picture of daisies online, and the two placed the store's existing bunch of dried flower props at the mannequin's feet to create a rustic feel. After the new window display was done, Song Yajing took a photo, posted it to the customer WeChat group, and noted that this week's featured items were 10% off storewide. A regular customer soon left a message saying she would drop by to try them on.

events.name: Neighbor Aunt Zhang brought egg tarts and had a brief chat.
events.description: In the evening, after closing the shop and going home, Song Yajing met Auntie Zhang Xiuying, a next-door neighbor, in the hallway. Auntie Zhang was holding a plate of freshly baked egg tarts, saying she had tried a new recipe from her baking group and specially saved six for their family. Song Yajing thanked her and took them, and the two chatted at the door for about ten minutes. Auntie Zhang asked with concern how the store was doing; Song Yajing perfunctorily said it was okay, but felt a warmth in her heart. After going home, she and her daughter each ate two egg tarts, and the sweets somewhat eased the fatigue.

events.name: Pre-bedtime stretching and plan for tomorrow

She decided not to go to the store tomorrow morning and to handle this matter specifically. After stretching, she sent her husband a WeChat message reminding him to meet up tomorrow afternoon after taking compensatory leave.

2025-04.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Song Yajing let Xiaomei run the shop on her own and focused on family financial planning. Her daughter Xuanxuan would start elementary school this autumn. The couple had always talked about opening an education savings account for her but had kept putting it off. Last night, Chen Zhiqiang brought it up again before bed, and they decided to get it done today. In the morning, Song Yajing took out the couple's ID cards, household registration booklet, and salary cards, put the materials in a file folder, and also went online to get a rough understanding of ICBC's education savings products. In the afternoon, her husband specially took a half day off. The two went to the Siming Sub-branch, met account manager Lin Xiaofeng, successfully opened an education savings account in their daughter's name, deposited the first month's 2,000 yuan, and also set up the monthly automatic transfer service. When they came out after finishing the banking business, a fine rain began to fall. The couple walked under one umbrella to a nearby time-honored satay noodle shop for dinner as a small celebration. Chen Zhiqiang said that now they had the first brick for Xuanxuan's college tuition. After returning home, Song Yajing neatly recorded the new account information in the family financial ledger. Looking at the clear categories in the ledger, she felt the groundedness that comes from building a family. Because she was in a relaxed mood today and had walked a lot during the day, she tried new hip stretches during her pre-bedtime stretching, and planned to go hiking with a close friend on the weekend.

events.name: At home, she and her husband agreed on the details of the education savings account and prepared the account opening materials.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Song Yajing did not go to the store (Xiao Mei was in full charge of the store today). Instead, she sat down face-to-face with her husband Chen Zhiqiang at the kitchen table at home to discuss the specific plan for their daughter's education savings. The two agreed to set aside 2,000 yuan from the family's total monthly income into a dedicated account, without touching the store's working capital. The account would be managed by Song Yajing, but both of them could check it. She then took out their ID cards, the household registration book (needed to prove the parent-child relationship with their daughter), their respective salary cards, and a copy of the store's business license, and neatly placed them all into a document folder. Chen Zhiqiang went to his company first in the morning to handle work, and they agreed to meet at 2 p.m. at the ICBC Siming Sub-branch.

events.name: Went to ICBC with her husband to open an education savings account
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang met at the entrance of the ICBC Siming Sub-branch. Account manager Lin Xiaofeng was already waiting in the wealth management room (Song Yajing had booked the time in advance through WeChat yesterday). Lin Xiaofeng introduced the interest rates, withdrawal conditions, and tax benefits of the education savings product. Song Yajing carefully asked about the fees for early termination so that she would be fully informed. After confirming the terms, the couple opened a dedicated education savings account with their daughter Chen Lexuan as the beneficiary, and Song Yajing transferred the first 2,000 yuan from her salary card. Lin Xiaofeng also helped set up an automatic transfer agreement from the joint family account on the 15th of each month, and handed them a brochure for a conservative wealth management product to review at home.

events.name: Entered savings account information into the family financial ledger and confirmed long-term plans with her husband
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Song Yajing took down the household finance ledger with a pink cover from the bookshelf (a habit she had kept since marriage) and solemnly wrote in the savings section the account opening date, bank, account tail number, monthly agreed transfer amount, and account purpose. Beside it, she also noted the automatic transfer reminder on the 15th of every month and the estimated total savings target for the primary school years. Her husband was playing a jigsaw puzzle with their daughter in the living room. She showed him the ledger, and they verbally confirmed the details for the automatic transfer starting on the 15th of next month. Chen Zhiqiang patted her on the shoulder and said it was great—now they had a house, a car, and education savings.

events.name: After the rain, the couple went for a walk sharing an umbrella and enjoyed a dinner of shacha noodles.
events.description: After taking care of their business, a passing shower started. The two shared one umbrella and walked about a kilometer along Siming South Road, then found a time-honored satay noodle shop. They ordered two bowls of signature satay noodles with fried five-spice rolls, and chatted about their dating days while eating. This rare time alone together let Song Yajing temporarily forget the pressure of her shop.

She felt that her hips were indeed tight after sitting for a long time, and this pose was very comfortable. During a break in stretching, she sent Li Meiling a WeChat message to confirm the weekend hiking plan, and Meiling instantly replied OK.

2025-04.daily_overview: That Thursday, her rhythm switched flexibly between work and social life. In the morning, as soon as Song Yajing arrived at the store, she finalized the final details of the spring clothing restock order with her supplier Susan via WeChat, requiring all goods to be shipped before the 13th; both parties confirmed the process for sending back the tracking numbers. After taking care of this, the slight anxiety of waiting for the goods eased. The afternoon was a rare chance for best-friend time—she had arranged with Li Meiling three days earlier to visit a newly opened cat café in Siming District. On the walk there from the store, she bought a small bunch of lisianthus for Meiling. The two sat by the window at the cat café, drinking fruit tea, playing with the cats, and catching up: Li Meiling complained that two particularly naughty boys in her class had left her voice hoarse for a week, while Song Yajing poured out her worries about store inventory pressure and spring allergies. After listening, Meiling suggested going hiking on the weekend to clear their minds, saying the Dongping Mountain Trail was suitable for beginners and also allergy-friendly. Song Yajing happily agreed, and as they said goodbye at the cat café entrance, they agreed to finalize the exact weekend time on WeChat. This relaxed get-together made her feel the healing power of friendship. On the way back to the store, she posted two photos of the cats taken at the cat café in her customer group with the caption 'Today's little happiness.' However, after getting home in the evening, she received a voice message from Susan saying the factory had hinted that one batch of dyed fabric in this order might have a color difference problem, but it had already been shipped, which made her heart lurch. This news left her anxious and unable to sleep; she tossed and turned in bed until the early hours before finally falling asleep.

events.name: Confirmed the final shipment of the spring clothing restock order with supplier Su Shan.
events.description: After arriving at the store in the morning, Song Yajing opened WeChat and had a voice call with Susan. She confirmed the replenishment list discussed the day before item by item—20 pieces each of XS and S lightweight knit cardigans, 15 pairs of new light blue wide-leg jeans in total across all sizes, and 5 pieces of each size of French square-neck floral dresses. The two also settled on the total payment, the final payment settlement method, and the process for sending back logistics tracking numbers. Susan vowed that the goods would be shipped from the Guangzhou warehouse before April 13, and said the quality was good—she had kept one for herself. Song Yajing recorded the agreed details and expected arrival date in her phone memo.

events.name: In the morning, made plans with best friend Li Meiling to meet at a cat café in the afternoon.
events.description: After confirming the restocking, Song Yajing sent a WeChat message to her close friend Li Meiling asking if she had time in the afternoon. Meiling instantly replied that today's students had midterm exams, so she had no classes in the afternoon and was just worrying about having nothing to do. The two were of the same mind. Meiling suggested going to the newly opened cat café in Siming District, which her colleague had been to and said the environment was nice. Song Yajing said she could arrive within half an hour if she left the store at two in the afternoon. Meiling said she happened to be at a nearby school and would go over early to get a good spot.

events.name: Go to a cat café to meet and chat with best friend Li Meiling.
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Song Yajing took off her work apron, told Xiaomei to watch the store, and walked to the newly opened cat café in Siming District. On the way, she stopped at a flower shop and bought a small bunch of pink lisianthus for Meiling. When she arrived, Meiling had already taken the sofa seat by the window, with an orange tabby cat curled in her lap. The two ordered fruit tea and tiramisu cake, and chatted for over an hour to the café's soothing background music. Meiling poured out her grievances, saying that two naughty boys in her class kept passing notes and throwing paper airplanes during class, and she had yelled herself hoarse. Song Yajing shared her own spring allergy troubles and the store's recent wrong turns. After listening carefully, Meiling suggested, 'Hey, let's go hiking this weekend! The Dongping Mountain trail isn't hard, and there aren't many flowers there, so it's allergy-friendly for you.' Song Yajing found the suggestion more refreshing than caffeine, and the two agreed to finalize the weekend time later via WeChat.

events.name: After the gathering, returned to the store in a good mood and shared life updates.
events.description: At 4:30 p.m., she said goodbye to Meiling at the entrance of the cat café. On the way back to the store, Song Yajing felt much lighter. Her best friend's listening and the outdoor suggestion felt like a massage to her tense nerves. In the customer WeChat group, she posted two close-up cat photos she had just taken, with the caption: 'Today's little blessing: checked in at the newly opened cat café. The cats are so healing.' This casual share sparked interactions from several pet-owning customers, and a regular customer even replied with a photo of her Ragdoll cat. The group atmosphere was warm.

events.name: Received Su Shan's warning about possible color difference, leading to insomnia.
events.description: At 9 p.m., Song Yajing received a voice message from Susan. In an apologetic tone, Susan said the factory had informed her that afternoon that one batch of these chiffon blouses might be dyed darker, but the goods had already been shipped, so she should check carefully. Song Yajing's heart suddenly clenched. She immediately called back to ask for details, but Susan only vaguely said it might be the dusty pink one and asked her not to put it on the shelves after receiving it. After hanging up, Song Yajing tossed and turned in bed, unable to fall asleep, imagining all sorts of worst-case scenarios, and only barely fell asleep after 1 a.m. She completely forgot to do her pre-sleep stretching.
