2025-04.daily_overview: Saturday was a day full of new experiences. At six in the morning, Zhao Li arrived as promised to pick her up downstairs at Song Yajing's home. The two drove toward the seaside on Huandao Road, facing the morning sun, to attend an outdoor yoga class. Song Yajing wore a set of sportswear she had bought last year but worn only a few times. On the beach, she clumsily completed every pose following the teacher's guidance. Her body was stiff, nowhere near as flexible as Zhao Li's, but after persisting for 45 minutes amid the sound of waves and morning light, she felt a surprising sense of physical openness and lightheartedness. After class, the two had a steaming bowl of satay noodles with soy milk at a seaside breakfast shop. Zhao Li said she would invite her again, and she didn't refuse. After hurrying home to shower and change, at nine in the morning she took her daughter Xuanxuan by the hand and walked into the community art center for the first class of the parent-child watercolor class. The child did not hesitate to wield the paintbrush and covered the paper with bright color blocks, while she stared at the blank watercolor paper, not knowing where to start. Infected by the teacher's and her daughter's giggles, she finally let go of her inferiority about her painting skills and began to enjoy the process. When she got home at noon, her husband had already prepared lunch. As she ate, she excitedly shared the unexpected joy of beach yoga and the free-spirited way her daughter created. The afternoon and evening were mostly for rest, accompanying her daughter to do crafts, and before bed she checked tomorrow's hiking gear again. However, in the evening she received a logistics message from Susan confirming that the goods had arrived in Xiamen and would be delivered to the shop early the next morning. Her heart was half relieved and half still hanging. During pre-sleep stretching, her shoulders and neck felt relaxed thanks to yoga and the day's activities, but she was still thinking about how to handle possible color differences.

events.name: Early in the morning, at Zhao Li's invitation, she went to the seaside on Huandao Road to attend an outdoor yoga class.
events.description: At six in the morning, just as dawn was breaking, Zhao Li drove up in her red compact car to the downstairs of Song Yajing’s building. Song Yajing, wearing black yoga pants bought online last year and a light gray sports tank top with a thin jacket over it, came down carrying a bag with a yoga mat. The two drove fifteen minutes to the flat beach at the seaside along Huandao Road, where about ten trainees had already laid out their mats. The instructor was a woman in her early thirties who guided the Sun Salutation sequence in a gentle voice. Song Yajing’s movements were stiffer than anyone else’s – she couldn’t straighten her legs in Downward Dog, wobbled and nearly fell several times in Tree Pose, and even collapsed within half a minute during plank. But with the rhythmic sound of waves as background, she persisted through the entire class. Finally, lying on her mat in Corpse Pose looking at the blue sky and white clouds, she felt her spine stretch as never before.

events.name: After yoga class, shared feelings candidly with Zhao Li at a seaside breakfast shop
events.description: After the eight o'clock yoga class ended, Zhao Li suggested going to a nearby eatery for breakfast. At a simple breakfast shop on Huandao Road, they each ordered a bowl of satay noodles with soy milk. Song Yajing admitted that she had initially been resistant to getting up early and trying an unfamiliar exercise, but now her body indeed felt much more relaxed, especially her chronically sore neck and shoulders. Zhao Li said she admired Song Yajing's openness to trying new things, unlike some friends who never agreed no matter how often they were asked. They chatted over breakfast until 8:30, when Song Yajing glanced at her watch and remembered she needed to rush home to change clothes and take her daughter to watercolor class. She quickly said goodbye to Zhao Li and took a taxi home.

events.name: Took her daughter to the first class of the parent-child watercolor class at the community art center (including the walk before class).
events.description: At exactly nine o'clock, Song Yajing and Xuanxuan arrived on time at the art studio on the second floor of the community art center (about a 15-minute walk from home). Inside, there were several low tables, each already set with watercolor paper, brushes, and palettes. The teacher was a gentle middle-aged woman, and the theme of the first class was "My Home". After getting her materials, Xuanxuan did not hesitate at all. She brushed out a crooked yet lively blue sky and then painted green grass underneath. Song Yajing, however, faced the blank paper with sweaty palms and muttered quietly, "Mom's drawing is ugly." Xuanxuan heard her, turned around, and said, "Mom, drawing doesn't have to be pretty—just happy is enough." Those words made Song Yajing freeze for a second; then she picked up a brush, dipped it in purple paint, and drew a crooked sun on the paper. For the next half hour she gradually became absorbed and even forgot the time. After class, her daughter proudly showed her work to the teacher, who praised her bold use of color. Afterward, the mother and daughter walked home together, with Xuanxuan skipping all the way.

events.name: After returning home, shared with her husband the joy of the morning's two new experiences.
events.description: At 12:30 in the afternoon, mother and daughter returned home carrying the painting, and Chen Zhiqiang had already cooked a pot of seafood porridge and was waiting. During the meal, Song Yajing animatedly described her morning yoga experience to her husband—"I never thought I could do a downward dog on the beach. My legs weren't fully straight, but I held it to the end." Then she showed him the photos on her phone of Xuanxuan painting and her daughter's words: "Mom's painting doesn't need to look good." Her husband smiled and said that the child had unintentionally become her teacher. Song Yajing nodded and said that next class she would not bring her sense of inferiority. After the meal, she used a refrigerator magnet to stick her daughter's first formal watercolor painting on the fridge door, took two steps back to admire it, and felt a sense of fulfillment completely different from business success.

events.name: Received the delivery notice with mixed feelings.
events.description: At six in the evening, Song Yajing received a logistics screenshot from Susan showing that three boxes of goods had arrived at the Xiamen distribution center and were expected to be delivered to the store before nine the next morning. She stared at her phone screen, hoping the goods would be fine, yet with a vague feeling that something might go wrong. After a brief discussion with her husband, she decided that the next morning he would take their daughter to the park while she went to the store early to inspect the goods.

events.name: Pre-sleep stretching and mental preparation
events.description: Tonight's stretching was especially earnest for Song Yajing. She extended the session to 18 minutes, focusing on relaxing her back muscles that were sore from yoga. While stretching, she prayed that tomorrow's shipment would not have color differences. This way of channeling anxiety into exercise calmed her mind a little before bed.

2025-04.daily_overview: Sunday was a day full of frustration for Song Yajing. In the morning she went to Siming Catholic Church for Mass as usual, but Father Wang Mingde's sermon didn't sink in, because her mind was full of the spring clothes from her supplier Susan that were due to arrive that day. After Mass, she hurried back to the shop and, sure enough, saw three delivery boxes piled by the entrance. She was in a good mood at first while unpacking, but her smile froze when she tore open the chiffon blouse package — the actual colors of this batch were visibly and seriously different from the sample photos Susan had sent earlier. What should have been a soft lotus-pink came out as a dull brick red. To make matters worse, in the afternoon Vivian, a regular customer, came to the shop as promised to try on the chiffon blouse and said immediately that she couldn't accept it. After trying on four different styles in a row, she complained harshly about the quality, and outside the fitting room, in front of another customer, she said, 'How can your store sell something like this?' Song Yajing held back her tears, saw Vivian off, and immediately placed a voice call to Susan. On the other end, Susan first brushed her off, saying her screen had a color discrepancy, then made excuses that it might be a factory batch issue, and would only refund 50% of the payment while refusing to pay the return shipping costs. After hanging up, Yajing squatted in the stockroom for a long time, her head buzzing, and for the first time seriously thought about how much longer she could keep going. This conflict made her completely decide to stop relying on Susan as her main supplier. She changed Susan's WeChat note to 'Use with caution - 4.13 color discrepancy dispute,' and was determined not to work with her again unless Susan provided a solid guarantee. As for the originally planned Sunday family walk in the park, she really had no heart to join; her husband took their daughter to Zhongshan Park alone. She stayed in the shop by herself until dusk, then dragged herself home with heavy steps.

events.name: Go to Siming Catholic Church to attend Sunday Mass.
events.description: At 8:30 in the morning, Song Yajing went to church as usual, but today she was restless—she knew that the replenishment order from supplier Susan should arrive at the shop today. During Father Wang Mingde's sermon, though she sat in the pew, her mind kept drifting to the store inventory and the quality of the new goods. After Mass, she didn't chat with Aunt Lin Xiuying as she usually did; she just greeted her hurriedly and left quickly.

events.name: Arrived at the store to receive the supplier's spring clothing; unpacked and inspected it and found serious color difference.
events.description: When Song Yajing arrived at the store at 10 a.m., three delivery cartons were neatly stacked at the door. Xiaomei had already opened up and was tidying the messy clothing racks left from yesterday's customers. Song Yajing sliced open the first box with a utility knife and took out the chiffon top—then her movements suddenly froze. The top in her hand was a dull brick red, while the sample photo Susan had sent to her phone showed a soft, translucent lotus pink. She opened all three boxes and compared them piece by piece. At least sixteen of the roughly twenty chiffon tops in this batch had color discrepancies to varying degrees: some were dark red, some gray, and some belts clashed completely with the main fabric. Xiaomei was stunned too and whispered, 'Who would buy something that looks like this?'

events.name: Vivian, a regular customer, returned the item on the spot after trying it on in the store because of a color difference issue and complained harshly.
events.description: At two in the afternoon, regular customer Vivian arrived at the store as promised. After handing her the reserved white knit top, Song Yajing also recommended a new lotus-pink (actually brick-red) chiffon blouse. When Vivian came out of the fitting room and looked in the mirror, her expression clearly darkened. She said the color of the garment was too different from the photos she had seen before and made her skin look very yellow. After trying on four different styles from this batch, she said, with displeasure, that the quality of this batch was a whole level below the standard of the store's previous items, and while paying for the white knit top, added in front of another customer, "Next time I'll think twice about coming." Vivian's harsh complaint made Song Yajing blush bright red, and the other customer near the fitting area silently left the store, sensing the awkward atmosphere.

events.name: Contacted supplier Susan to discuss the color difference issue but was fobbed off, and decided to end the partnership
events.description: After seeing Vivian off, Song Yajing closed the shop door (Xiaomei was tidying up in the outer room) and made a WeChat voice call to Susan from the warehouse. She tried to stay calm and stated the problem. Susan at first said her phone screen had a color difference and she could not see any difference, then made excuses that the factory's last batch had switched dye lots and it had nothing to do with her. Song Yajing demanded a full return and refund and that Susan cover the shipping costs. Susan's attitude turned tough, saying she could at most refund 50% of the payment, and that Song Yajing would have to pay the return shipping costs herself. The call lasted about twenty minutes and ended with an argument and an unpleasant parting. After hanging up, Song Yajing sat on a cardboard box in the warehouse for a long time, her mind buzzing and tears welling up in her eyes. This batch of goods had cost about 3,000 yuan. Now she had not only lost her capital but also the trust of old customers she had built over five years. She took out her phone and changed Susan's WeChat remark to 'Use with caution - 4.13 color difference dispute', and silently decided: unless Susan could provide concrete quality guarantees and a compensation plan, she would never cooperate with her again. This decision gave her a hint of resolve, but what remained was mostly confusion.

events.name: Her husband took their daughter to the park alone to complete the weekend family activity.
events.description: At 3 p.m., Song Yajing called her husband, saying in a tired voice that she couldn't go to the park today because something had come up at the store. Chen Zhiqiang didn't ask any more and just said, "I'll take Xuanxuan. Come home early when you're done." He took his daughter to Zhongshan Park. Xuanxuan chased bubbles on the grass, and Chen Zhiqiang took a few photos and sent them to Song Yajing on WeChat, but she was not in the mood to open them. She stayed alone in the storeroom for another half hour before locking up and going home.

end_state.location: Home bedroom, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen.
end_state.mood: The supplier incident drained my confidence overnight. Intense frustration and grievance were intertwined, and for the first time I had the thought of giving up. But I have made the decision to no longer rely on Susan.

2025-04.daily_overview: It was drizzling in Xiamen on Monday, echoing Song Yajing's gloom. She had barely slept all night, and today she went to the shop with dark circles but had no heart for business. All morning she only tidied the racks mechanically, staring blankly at the box of off-color chiffon blouses in the corner. At noon she sat alone in the back storeroom facing the defective goods for a long time. For the first time, she seriously considered a frightening question—not in a fit of anger but in silence: should she close the shop? The thought made her both afraid and tempted by a hint of relief. When she got home that evening, her husband noticed that she seemed off. After he kept asking, she finally confessed her wavering to Chen Zhiqiang. Chen Zhiqiang was silent for a moment, then held her hand and said that whether she continued or closed the shop, he supported her, as long as she was healthy. That unconditional support broke down her defenses instead. She burst into tears in his arms, pouring out months of accumulated stress, grievances, and fear through her tears. After the crying fit, she sat alone in the living room late at night and cleaned the air purifier's filter (it was pollen season again, so the filter had gotten dirty quickly), mechanically going through the routine of sticking to her medication. Taking care of her body became the only sense of order she could hold on to after her emotional collapse. Afterward, she forced herself to do 20 minutes of stretching despite her low mood, but her movements were heavy and the quality was poor.

events.name: First seriously considered closing the shop and struggled alone in the warehouse
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Song Yajing let Xiaomei, who was looking after the shop, go to lunch by herself. She walked alone into the back storage room and sat beside the cardboard box filled with color-difference chiffon blouses. From the shop outside came the occasional murmur of customers, hard to hear clearly through the thin wall. She opened the calculator on her phone and ran the numbers over and over—the direct loss on this batch was about 3,000 yuan, the declining revenue from reduced foot traffic, and if she returned the goods she would have to pay shipping out of her own pocket, while online customer acquisition had been ineffective. She looked through last month's barely break-even figures and, for the first time, seriously thought in a clear-headed rather than impulsive way: if she closed the shop, she could find a job at a clothing company as a sales assistant again, with a stable monthly salary and without bearing all the risks. The thought made her feel both fear and temptation. She sat in the warehouse for over an hour until Xiaomei called to ask whether she was coming back.

events.name: That evening, she confessed to her husband Chen Zhiqiang her idea of closing the store and broke down in tears.
events.description: After their daughter fell asleep at nine in the evening, Song Yajing sat in the bedroom going through the warehouse product photos on her phone again and again, her face ashen. Chen Zhiqiang hugged her gently from behind and asked what was wrong, since she had seemed off since coming back yesterday. She turned to face him and, in a trembling voice, told him the whole thing — the color discrepancy in the goods, customer complaints, the supplier's buck-passing, and the sixteen unsold chiffon blouses in the warehouse — then said with red-rimmed eyes that for the first time, she was seriously thinking about closing the store. Chen Zhiqiang didn't answer right away. After a few seconds of silence, he held her hand tightly and said it didn't matter; he would support whatever decision she made. Those words made her tears burst instead. She leaned on his shoulder and cried out loud for nearly half an hour, releasing all the toughness she had forced herself to maintain over the past few months. Chen Zhiqiang kept patting her back gently without saying more, but the warmth of his body conveyed solid support.

events.name: After calming down, cleaned the home air purifier filter and kept taking medication
events.description: It was already 11 p.m. after her crying fit. Chen Zhiqiang went to the kitchen and poured her a glass of warm water. Song Yajing rose from the sofa with swollen eyes, grasping at something she could still control. She walked to her daughter's bedroom door, took down the small air purifier, removed the filter, and carefully cleaned it in the bathroom with a brush and a wet cloth — during pollen season the filter becomes filthy within a week, but the act of cleaning itself gave her a sense of order. After cleaning and reinstalling the filter, she poured water and took tonight's dose of honeycomb extract capsules, and prepared tomorrow's pill organizer. Maintaining the daily routine of body care amid the chaos was the only care she gave herself today.

events.name: Forced herself to complete 20 minutes of stretching, but the quality was poor.
events.description: Even after an emotional breakdown, Song Yajing still rolled out the mat; she knew her neck and shoulders were tense from stress. She followed the app and did 20 minutes of stretching, but every move felt heavy, her breathing was short, and she couldn't concentrate. Midway through, she stopped and stared blankly for a while, then mechanically continued. When she finished, she felt her muscles hadn't truly relaxed, but at least she had maintained the integrity of the habit.

end_state.location: Home bedroom, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen.
end_state.mood: Exhaustion and emptiness after crying hard, but her husband's unconditional support was like a rope in the darkness.

2025-04.daily_overview: When Song Yajing woke up early on Tuesday morning, her eyes were still a little swollen, but last night's bitter crying seemed to have drained some of the despair from her body. Looking in the mirror, she told herself that she had cried enough and had to get things done today. In the morning, she arrived at the store an hour earlier than Xiaomei. She calmly took out all sixteen color-difference chiffon blouses from the warehouse one by one, counted them, and calculated the loss. Using the ledger, she confirmed that the direct loss was about 3,200 yuan. She decided not to let this batch pile up in the warehouse but to run a candid clearance sale. She thought of her best friend Zhao Li, who has a florist's aesthetic, and thought she could help her restyle the clothes and find a way out for the defective pieces. Zhao Li did not hesitate on the phone and arrived at the store in the afternoon. Using her professional eye for color matching, she paired the brick-red chiffon blouses with dark blue jeans and cream-white short jackets to create an unexpectedly retro style, and set up a small display area right in the store. Zhao Li also personally took multiple sets of photos of Song Yajing trying on the outfits for online promotion. At the same time, Song Yajing urgently contacted her former colleague in Hangzhou, Zheng Kai, who is now an independent clothing buyer. After she explained the inventory crisis, Zheng Kai agreed without hesitation to send a batch of unlisted sample goods the same day via SF Express, to be sold first and settled later. In the evening, she posted the outfit photos to the customer group with an honest caption saying that the store owner had tried on the items herself and that this batch was being cleared at a special price due to a supplier batch problem. A few regular customers said that the colors actually looked nice once matched well, and people began asking about them. She did not make any money today and even expected a loss, but action overcame her sense of helplessness. Because she had been busy during the day and her stress had eased a bit, the quality of her stretching improved that night, and she ate a small piece of tiramisu before bed as comfort. Her weight, affected by the diet fluctuations and emotions of the past few days, rose back to 50.8 kg.

events.name: In the early morning, I arrived at the store ahead of time to count the color-difference chiffon tops and calculate the loss.
events.description: At eight in the morning, Song Yajing opened the store door alone and walked into the back warehouse. She brought out all the chiffon tops with color discrepancies that had piled up yesterday and spread them on the sofa in the fitting area. She inspected each one and recorded the degree of the problem — four of them had such serious color deviation that they could not be sold and had to be written off, while the other twelve had slight color differences but the fabric and tailoring were fine. In her account book, she calculated the cost price, shipping, and the estimated total loss of about 3,200 yuan if the batch were put on clearance. She closed the account book, took a deep breath, and decided to cut her losses proactively, taking action instead of staying stuck in yesterday's breakdown.

events.name: Contact good friend Zhao Li and supplier Zheng Kai to seek emergency support
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., after Xiaomei arrived at the store, Song Yajing asked her to get the store ready while she made two key phone calls. The first was to Zhao Li. In a steady but slightly hoarse voice, she briefly stated the situation and asked Zhao Li to come to the store that afternoon if she was free, using her florist's aesthetic eye to help re-match and restyle the clothes to see if styling could rescue them. Zhao Li said, "I have no classes this afternoon, so I'll come over after lunch." The second call was a WeChat voice call to Zheng Kai in Hangzhou. She honestly told Zheng Kai that she was facing a color-difference dispute and urgently needed to add high-quality new styles to offset the reputation risk, and asked him to allocate a batch of unshelved sample goods, ship them to Xiamen first, and settle later. Zheng Kai paused briefly on the phone, then said, "No problem. There are seven or eight good samples in the warehouse. I'll send them to you via SF Express this afternoon, and they should arrive tomorrow. No rush on payment—settle with me after you sell them." After hanging up, Song Yajing felt a warmth—after Susan had passed the buck, Zheng Kai's prompt support was like a cup of water in a drought.

events.name: Zhao Li arrived at the store and used floral art aesthetics to restyle the defective goods.
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Zhao Li arrived at the store carrying a small flower bag (with a few dried flowers and ribbons inside). She asked Song Yajing to put on the first brick-red chiffon blouse, then picked out a dark blue pair of wide-leg jeans and a light beige blazer from the existing inventory to go with it, instantly turning the brick red from old-fashioned to retro Hong Kong style. She also used a few dried lavender sprigs to make a simple brooch and pinned it at the collar of the chiffon blouse, adding a delicate handmade touch. Zhao Li put together four outfits in total and photographed Song Yajing trying them on with her phone—although Song Yajing's eyes were still slightly swollen, she tried hard to show a confident smile in front of the camera. While taking photos, Zhao Li said that these outfits might go viral if posted on Xiaohongshu.

events.name: Launched a candid special-offer promotion in the customer group and received initial positive feedback.
events.description: At 5:30 PM, Song Yajing finished organizing the photos taken by Zhao Li and posted an unprecedentedly candid promotional message in the customer WeChat group. She wrote: “Let me tell you the truth, ladies. The factory made a mistake with the dye batch for this batch of chiffon blouses. The actual items look brick red and are quite different from the sample photos. Vivian tried one yesterday and was very disappointed. I’m upset too. Today I asked a florist friend to help me restyle them. Actually, the vintage look is quite appealing. All items are on clearance at 60% of the original price. The shop owner personally tried them on and took photos, and I guarantee the fabric is fine.” After this message was sent, several regular customers responded in the group saying that once the colors were styled well, they really did look good, and the 60% price was a great deal. Someone asked if there were any plus sizes left. Another female customer who usually stayed quiet sent a private message saying she appreciated her honesty and reserved one set.

events.name: Rewarded myself with a piece of tiramisu; weight went back up to 50.8 kilograms
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Song Yajing felt the exhaustion of having survived an ordeal, but there was a glimmer of light in her heart. She took out the leftover tiramisu cake from the weekend from the fridge, cut a large piece, and sat on the sofa eating it slowly. The comfort brought by sweets briefly made her forget her worries. When she stepped on the scale, she found her weight had rebounded to 50.8 kg, and she knew it was due to stress eating and fluctuations in exercise recently, but she decided to temporarily accept the number and deal with the immediate crisis first.

events.name: Stretching quality is back on track; ready to start a new phase of crisis management.
events.description: During her pre-sleep stretching, Song Yajing did the usual 15-minute routine, but this time she was able to focus on her breathing and felt less tension in her neck than yesterday. While stretching, she listed tomorrow's plan in her phone memo: contact Zheng Kai to follow up on logistics, organize community feedback, and recalculate working capital with her husband. Having an action plan gave her something to hold on to, and after stretching she fell asleep more peacefully than in the previous few days.

She was conducting an honest promotional sale in the WeChat group while coordinating the listing of Zheng Kai’s sample products. In the end, her sincerity and cost-effectiveness won positive feedback from customers. She sold about 60% of the inventory that day and temporarily stabilized the situation.

The store's reputation was not hurt by the flaw incident; instead, its honesty won praise from regular customers.

2025-04.daily_overview: The days of extremely intense work finally took a toll on her body. In the evening, Song Yajing suddenly felt dizzy and collapsed while sorting goods in the warehouse, hitting her forehead on a shelf and frightening the shop assistant Xiaomei. She was then taken to see a doctor, accompanied by her husband, and was diagnosed with severe sub-health. After returning home, her husband flew into a rage out of extreme worry, and the two had a fierce quarrel. Their daughter used her childish drawings to express her worry about her mother. This day became the most fundamental turning point of the entire April and even beyond.

events.name: Suddenly fainted while organizing goods in the warehouse.
events.description: In the evening, while Song Yajing was organizing the newly arrived sample goods from Zheng Kai in the back storage room of the store, she suddenly blacked out, felt dizzy, and collapsed due to days of fatigue, irregular eating, and severe lack of sleep. Her forehead hit the edge of a metal shelf with a dull thud.

events.name: Shop assistant Xiaomei discovered the situation and immediately contacted the family
events.description: Xiao Mei at the front heard a noise from the storeroom and ran in to look. She found Song Yajing lying on the floor, pale, with a red swollen forehead, and cried out in fright. She managed to calm herself down, pressed a tissue against the wound on Song Yajing's forehead, and then called Chen Zhiqiang to tell him what had happened.

events.name: Chen Zhiqiang took his wife to see a doctor, and she was diagnosed with severe sub-health.
events.description: After receiving the phone call, Chen Zhiqiang immediately took leave and returned, helped Song Yajing into the car, and went straight to the community health center to see the family doctor, Wang Mingyuan. After a detailed examination, Dr. Wang diagnosed her with hypoglycemia, autonomic nervous system dysfunction, and a severe sub-health condition, seriously instructed her to maintain a regular routine and reduce stress, and treated the superficial wound on her forehead.

events.name: After returning home, the couple had a fierce quarrel
events.description: After settling down at home, Chen Zhiqiang's excessive worry turned into anger, and he furiously berated Song Yajing: “Do you want money or your life? Do you want a divorce?” Knowing she was in the wrong and physically weak, Song Yajing silently cried. The two had the most intense quarrel since their marriage.

events.name: Her daughter drew a picture of her mother on the hospital bed to show her care
events.description: In the living room, her daughter Chen Lexuan witnessed her mother getting sick and her parents arguing, and then hid in her room in fear. After a while, she drew a simple but touching picture — her mother lying in a hospital bed, with "Mom, get well soon" written crookedly beside it — and secretly slipped it into Song Yajing's hand. Song Yajing broke down in tears when she saw it.

events.name: Communicated with Zheng Kai by phone about the settlement of sample goods and reviewed the cooperation
events.description: Before the medical appointment, during a brief moment of lucidity, Song Yajing called Zheng Kai to confirm that the sample goods would be sold first and payment settled later as agreed. During the conversation, she also reflected on how Zhao Li and Zheng Kai had worked together to resolve the crisis, deepening her gratitude for these two business partners.

start_state.location: At home, she struggled to pull herself together to head to the store
start_state.mood: Body felt heavy, but still tried to hold on through willpower

end_state.location: At home in the bedroom, feeling dazed after fainting and an argument.
end_state.mood: Physical pain, guilt, and being moved intertwined inside her, and she sank into deep reflection.

state.daily_exercise: Apart from routine walking around the shop, she did no conscious exercise; about 1,500 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning to cloudy with light mist in the morning, then a light breeze in the afternoon, temperature 18-24℃

2025-04.daily_overview: The first day of strict bed rest as advised by the doctor. Song Yajing was unable to go to the shop. Her mother and husband took turns caring for her, and Xiaomei came by in the afternoon to report on how the shop was running. Though weak, she handled calls from bed to coordinate with suppliers and communicate about the store layout adjustment, and she began to seriously consider changing her lifestyle. Her husband took their daughter to her painting class, bringing back a touch of normal rhythm for the family.

events.name: Stay in bed and rest, with family members taking turns to care
events.description: Following Dr. Wang's instructions, Song Yajing stayed strictly on bed rest all day, with a cold towel on her forehead. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang took leave from work to care for her at home, and her mother Lin Xiuying came over from Quanzhou early in the morning to help, cooking her daughter a light porridge. Song Yajing alternated between drowsiness and brief wakefulness, and her strength recovered slightly.

events.name: At noon, video-called her mother to report that she was safe. Her mother urged her to rest and recover.
events.description: In the afternoon, when Lin Xiuying briefly went out to buy groceries, the mother and daughter had a WeChat video call. Her mother again stressed that health is the most important thing and said she had discussed it with her father and would stay in Xiamen for the next few days to help cook and look after the child. Song Yajing, not wanting her mother to worry, forced herself to sound energetic and said she was already much better.

events.name: Xiaomei came to the house to report on the store's operations.
events.description: In the afternoon, shop assistant Xiaomei came by with fruit and reported to Song Yajing that the shop had opened and operated normally that day. The newly arrived sample goods attracted a few customers, and sales were steady. Song Yajing felt somewhat relieved and told Xiaomei to contact her anytime if anything came up.

events.name: Contact supplier Susan in the morning to coordinate the follow-up out-of-stock issue.
events.description: In the morning, feeling somewhat better, she urgently contacted Susan, her supplier in Guangzhou, by phone to discuss the follow-up reorder and refund progress for the previous problematic goods. She stated her position in a restrained but firm tone. Susan said she would handle the return of the remaining payment as soon as possible.

events.name: Discussed the overall direction of the store layout adjustment with her husband.
events.description: After her condition improved further in the afternoon, Song Yajing leaned against the headboard and discussed store space optimization with Chen Zhiqiang. They initially decided to discontinue the coffee corner business, sell off the equipment, and turn the freed-up area into a community sharing zone and floral display zone that better matched the store's positioning. Her husband expressed support for this lighter approach.

events.name: Purchase lavender essential oil and an aromatherapy diffuser online.
events.description: Following the advice of her friend, a physiotherapist at a Chinese medicine clinic, Song Yajing ordered an ultrasonic aromatherapy diffuser and a bottle of lavender essential oil from an online mall on her phone, hoping the sleep-promoting fragrance would improve her long-standing difficulty falling asleep.

events.name: Husband took daughter to a painting class at the community art center
events.description: In the afternoon, Chen Zhiqiang took his daughter Chen Lexuan to the community art center for her watercolor class at the time they had signed up for, so that Song Yajing could rest quietly. Xuanxuan enjoyed drawing very much and showed her mother the little rainbow she painted in class after returning home.

start_state.mood: Body felt weak and powerless, but she was warmed by her family's care.

end_state.location: In the bedroom at home, face already washed and lying down.
end_state.mood: Anxiety has decreased, and I am starting to accept the fact that I need rest.

state.daily_exercise: Only stood briefly in the bathroom and on the balcony with family members' help, walking about 200 steps

date_attribute.weather: Partly cloudy, mild sunshine, temperature 18-25°C.

2025-04.daily_overview: On the second day of bed rest, her body continued to improve, but her mind went through a violent upheaval. In the morning, Song Yajing opened the Bible in the silence, and a passage confronted her with questions about death and the meaning of life. After crying uncontrollably, she made three major decisions: apologize to her husband and delegate store management, schedule a full-body checkup, and sell the coffee machine. In the evening, her husband and daughter prepared a warm Minnan home-style dinner for her, and the idea of a family cooking day added a certain warmth to the future. From that day on, her daily routine truly turned toward 'living is what matters most.'

events.name: Reading scripture while lying in bed triggered thoughts about death
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing leaned against the headboard and thought seriously about death for the first time. She casually opened the Bible and read in the Gospel of Matthew: 'What good is it for someone to gain the whole world, yet lose their own life?' Deeply stirred, she immediately burst into tears. Her past way of living—trading her life for money—completely collapsed in the light of her faith.

events.name: Sincerely Apologizes to Husband and Announces Decision to Delegate Authority
events.description: After reading the scripture, she proactively apologized to Chen Zhiqiang and admitted that overexerting herself before had been wrong. Then she solemnly announced a major decision: she would hand over the daily management of the store to Xiaomei, and in the future she would only be responsible for product selection, community operations, and key client maintenance. Chen Zhiqiang held her hand tightly and expressed his support.

events.name: Called to book a full-body health checkup in early May.
events.description: Song Yajing contacted the partner physical examination center by phone and booked the full-body health checkup package for May 6, determined to finally pay real attention to her body. After hanging up, she felt a great sense of relief; her mindset had officially shifted from 'workaholic' to 'what matters most is being alive.'

events.name: Absent from Sunday Mass for health reasons, she stayed connected through prayer at home
events.description: The doctor advised her to continue lying in bed, so she was unable to attend Sunday Mass at Siming Catholic Church, but she spent a longer time in personal prayer at her bedside in the morning, praying for peace for her store, her family, and those who had helped her.

events.name: Negotiate the coffee machine transfer with regular customer Vivian.
events.description: Contacted regular customer Vivian via WeChat, told her that due to store adjustments I planned to transfer the almost brand-new Italian espresso machine, negotiated the transfer price and handover time, and finally reached an agreement. This both freed up space and recovered a small amount of cash.

events.name: Husband and daughter prepare a heartwarming dinner
events.description: In the afternoon, her husband Chen Zhiqiang left work early and took their daughter Chen Lexuan to the nearby food market to buy fresh shrimp, pork, mustard greens, and other ingredients. After returning home, he put on an apron and cooked satay noodles, stir-fried mustard greens, and braised pork. Their daughter helped set the table, and the kitchen was filled with laughter.

events.name: The whole family sat together for dinner, and she proposed setting up a weekly Sunday family cooking day.
events.description: During dinner, the family of three sat around the table, eating delicious home-style Minnan dishes and chatting about Xuanxuan's amusing stories at kindergarten. Chen Zhiqiang proposed that the whole family cook a meal together every Sunday evening as a family tradition. Song Yajing readily agreed, thinking it was the best investment in the family.

events.name: Setting up an aromatherapy diffuser and establishing new bedtime rules
events.description: After dinner, Song Yajing placed the newly arrived aromatherapy diffuser on the bedside table in the bedroom, added lavender essential oil and water, and set the timer function. She and her husband agreed to remind each other every night at 10 o'clock to get ready for bed, stay away from phones and computers for one hour before sleep, and use aromatherapy and white noise to help them fall asleep.

events.name: Before bed, catch up on her daughter's painting homework from last week.
events.description: To make up for the parent-child watercolor class homework that she had missed the previous week due to being busy, Song Yajing, during a break in the day, followed a teaching video and imitated her daughter's brushstrokes to paint a small sunflower, planning to bring it to the teacher next week. This gave her a rare sense of calm and childlike joy.

start_state.mood: My body is recovering, my thoughts are churning, and I am facing a reorganization of my values.

end_state.location: In the bedroom at home, the aromatherapy diffuser is giving off a faint lavender scent.
end_state.mood: Felt a long-lost inner peace and gained a clearer sense of priorities for the future.

state.daily_exercise: In the evening, accompanied by family, walked slowly in the neighborhood garden for about 15 minutes, about 800 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with a few clouds, moderate UV, temperature 19-27°C

2025-04.daily_overview: After her strength recovered somewhat, Song Yajing began to put the decision to delegate authority and the store renovation plan into practice. In the morning, she went to the store and cleaned the coffee corner equipment with Xiaomei and handed it over to Vivian, then went to purchase decoration materials. In the afternoon, during a lull at the store, she cleaned the air purifier filter, and on the way home bought anti-allergy medication to prepare for the season change. Though she moved slowly, every step was steady. In the evening, her husband brought back her favorite Minnan satay noodles, but she only ate a small half bowl, restrained and clear-headed.

events.name: Cleaned the coffee corner and handed over the coffee machine.
events.description: In the morning, with the help of staff member Xiaomei, Song Yajing cleaned up and packed the espresso machine, bar tools, and extra clutter from the former coffee corner. Vivian came to the store as agreed to pick up the coffee machine. Song Yajing told her that this dream was being returned to life for now, and the two exchanged a smile.

events.name: Purchasing display racks and floral decoration materials
events.description: Went with Xiaomei to a nearby stationery store and home goods shop, and bought two simple display racks, several rattan storage baskets, a large transparent vase, and a few cushions as initial materials for the community sharing area and the floral display area, keeping the cost within budget.

events.name: Clean the air purifier filters at the shop and at home
events.description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing first used a damp cloth to clean the air purifier filter of the store's air conditioner to reduce dust. After returning home, she also removed the filter from the bedroom purifier, rinsed it, and hung it out to dry, maintaining the equipment ahead of the spring allergy season.

events.name: Refill anti-allergy medication at the pharmacy
events.description: On the way home from the shop, she stopped by the community pharmacy and bought loratadine tablets and a bottle of saline nasal spray to replenish the family medicine cabinet for allergy season. She also consulted the pharmacist about precautions for spring catkins.

events.name: Control high-calorie food intake at dinner
events.description: In the evening, her husband Chen Zhiqiang specially brought home Song Yajing's favorite Minnan satay noodles as takeout, wanting to give her a different taste. Song Yajing was tempted by the smell, but remembering the doctor's advice, she only ladled a small bowl, added extra vegetables, and chewed slowly. After the meal, she also weighed herself on her own and recorded 49.4 kg, feeling a small sense of accomplishment for being able to control her eating.

start_state.location: At home, preparing to go out
start_state.mood: Feeling a bit stronger physically, with a "new phase" mindset for work.

end_state.location: Home bedroom, using an aroma diffuser.
end_state.mood: Satisfied with today's light and pragmatic routine; self-control over diet boosted my confidence.

state.daily_exercise: About 4,500 steps walking around the shop and for purchasing

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, turning overcast in the afternoon, temperature 20-26°C

2025-04.daily_overview: The shop space renovation was beginning to take shape. In the morning, she and Xiaomei arranged the newly purchased display racks and cushions into a community sharing area and set up a floral display shelf. The afternoon was dedicated to physical health: she went to the community traditional Chinese medicine clinic for shoulder and neck physiotherapy and learned daily stretching moves, then stopped by the bank to ask about health insurance, turning "being responsible for herself and her family" into concrete action. In the evening, she used an aromatherapy diffuser to aid sleep, and her sleep quality noticeably improved.

events.name: Set up the community sharing area and floral display area
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing and Xiaomei, according to the plan, arranged the display racks purchased two days earlier against the wall, laid out soft cushions, and placed vases, initially dividing the space into a community sharing area where customers could sit and exchange fitting experiences, and a small display stand by the window for seasonal floral arrangements. The spatial functions suddenly became clear.

events.name: Booked an appointment and went to the community TCM clinic for shoulder and neck physiotherapy
events.description: Song Yajing called in the morning to reserve a neck-and-shoulder massage at the community traditional Chinese medicine clinic. In the afternoon she walked there on time, and an experienced therapist gave her about 40 minutes of deep tissue massage to relieve the neck-and-shoulder strain accumulated from long periods of standing and stocking shelves. The therapist suggested coming at least once a month.

events.name: Learning office stretching exercises and recording them
events.description: After physical therapy, the therapist taught three simple shoulder, neck and waist stretches and told her she could do them whenever the store was quiet. Song Yajing learned carefully and noted the key points in her phone memo, planning to teach Xiao Mei and practice together.

events.name: Stop by on the way for a simple health check
events.description: While picking up the medicine, she took the chance to ask the traditional Chinese medicine practitioner to take her pulse and measure her blood pressure. The practitioner said her qi and blood were still weak but recovering, and advised her to continue keeping a regular schedule and doing gentle exercise. Song Yajing took the advice to heart.

events.name: Go to the bank to consult about personal health insurance
events.description: After leaving the traditional Chinese medicine clinic, she walked along the way to the ICBC Siming Sub-branch and met the account manager, Lin Xiaofeng. She explained that she had fainted from overwork and was worried about health risks, and consulted about critical illness insurance and hospitalization medical insurance suitable for self-employed business owners. Manager Lin recommended two products, and they agreed to discuss the insurance details in early May.

start_state.mood: Her spirits have clearly improved, and she feels a little excited about planning the space.

end_state.location: Home bedroom, aromatherapy to help sleep.
end_state.mood: After physical therapy, my body felt much more relaxed, and I gained more confidence in the health insurance.

state.daily_exercise: Walked to and from the Chinese medicine clinic and the bank, about 6,000 steps; learned stretching exercises

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, with occasional light drizzle, temperature 19-24°C

2025-04.daily_overview: The shop's atmosphere was upgraded again. Her good friend Zhao Li sent a batch of dried flower decorations. Song Yajing personally used them to adorn the community sharing area and floral display stand, and the previously cold corners immediately grew warm. Afterward, she and Xiaomei fine-tuned the displays to ensure the clothing area harmonized with the new functional zone. In the afternoon, Xiaomei enthusiastically suggested baking together, but Song Yajing politely declined, saying she still needed to recuperate, though she promised to hold a baking sharing event once she fully recovered.

events.name: Zhao Li brought over dried flower decorations and they caught up on each other's news.
events.description: In the morning, Zhao Li came to the store with a bouquet of dried flowers she had made herself and a few small dried flower wreaths, saying it was to celebrate the store's 'new look.' Song Yajing took the flowers, and the two chatted briefly in the new sharing area of the store. Zhao Li also looked at the store layout and gave some tips on color matching.

events.name: Arranged dried flower decorations to enhance the store's atmosphere.
events.description: Song Yajing placed the dried flowers Zhao Li gave her on the tea table in the community sharing area and hung a small flower wreath beside the fitting room door, instantly softening the formerly cool-toned space. She also brought a ceramic incense burner from home that she had bought before, lit a sandalwood incense coil, and let the shop fill with a subtle woody fragrance.

events.name: Fine-tune the overall display layout and try the seating experience
events.description: With Xiaomei's help, Song Yajing made final adjustments to the overall clothing display to ensure that the new product display racks would not block the view of the sharing area. After adjusting, she personally sat down on the rattan chair in the sharing area to feel the customer's perspective and comfort, and confirmed the phone charging ports and Wi-Fi signal coverage.

events.name: Politely declined Xiaomei's baking invitation, but left hope for a future occasion.
events.description: During the afternoon break, Xiaomei excitedly suggested trying to make tiramisu together in the small kitchen behind the store in the evening. Though tempted, Song Yajing declined with a smile, considering that she had just recovered: "Wait until I've rested for two more weeks, and we'll hold a baking-themed customer sharing session." Xiaomei happily noted down the idea.

start_state.location: At home, slowly enjoyed a bowl of cereal for breakfast
start_state.mood: Feeling relaxed and happy, like decorating my second home.

end_state.mood: Felt satisfied with the renovated store, looked forward to testing community sharing in the future, and learned to refuse gently.

state.daily_exercise: Walking around and light carrying in the store, about 3,500 steps

date_attribute.weather: Light rain turning cloudy, wet roads, 18-23°C.

2025-04.daily_overview: Facing the upcoming community, Song Yajing began to carefully sort out her operational ideas. She used the slack time at the shop to draft preliminary thoughts, then made a WeChat appointment with Zhao Li to meet at a café. On a drizzly afternoon, the two settled on the community's core positioning of 'share life, not just sell clothes' in the warm café and came up with several daily content columns. On the way home, she ran into her neighbor Aunt Zhang, who reminded her to drink a dampness-dispelling soup, and the warmth of neighborhood affection touched her heart.

events.name: During the shop break, organize preliminary ideas for community operations.
events.description: Because it was raining, there were few customers. Song Yajing sat in the newly arranged community sharing area, opened her notebook, and wrote down her original intentions for the online community: downplay sales, build emotional connections, and turn customers into friends. She made an initial list of possible content directions: daily greetings, outfit diary, Zhao Li's breakfast sharing, and her own baking routine.

events.name: I arranged with Zhao Li to discuss at a café in the afternoon.
events.description: Contacted Zhao Li via WeChat and said she wanted to have a dedicated chat about community operations. Zhao Li readily agreed and recommended a quiet little café near Zhongshan Road. Song Yajing arranged for Xiaomei to mind the store, then walked to the meeting spot.

events.name: Finalized the community operation plan with Zhao Li at the café.
events.description: In a corner filled with the aroma of coffee, Zhao Li shared her experience running a flower-arrangement customer group in the past, and sincerely suggested that it must focus on sharing everyday life, definitely not become an advertising group. After discussion, the two officially set the community's daily columns: morning greetings, Zhao Li's energizing breakfasts, outfit notes, Song Yajing's baking daily life, and weekend family life, etc. They also agreed that the group would be called “Yajing Life Studio.”

events.name: Ran into neighbor Zhang Xiuying in the rain and received a reminder about dispelling dampness.
events.description: Walking home from the café, the light rain had just stopped. Song Yajing ran into Auntie Zhang Xiuying, a neighbor, at the entrance of the residential community. Seeing that her complexion was still a bit pale, Auntie Zhang asked with concern. After learning that she had fainted a while ago, she repeatedly urged, "The spring chill hasn't fully gone; drink some barley and pork rib soup to dispel dampness. Tomorrow Auntie will bring you a bowl." Song Yajing felt warm at heart and thanked her repeatedly.

start_state.mood: A bit nervous about launching the community, but full of creativity.

end_state.location: In the bedroom at home, she organized several full pages of notes.
end_state.mood: After having a clear plan, she felt much more steady, and the rapport with Zhao Li and the care from her neighbors made her feel warm.

state.daily_exercise: Walked to and from the café in the rain, about 4,500 steps

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning clear, fresh air, temperature 19-26°C

2025-04.daily_overview: Her body was still in a weak phase, but the urgency of her career transition drove her to start the customer migration work. Throughout the day, while recuperating at home, Song Yajing sorted through her existing customer list one by one and manually entered the information of the first batch of about twenty or thirty most loyal regular customers into WeChat Work, laying the digital foundation for building a dedicated community later. In the morning, she received a video call from her elder sister, Song Yawen. The two sisters chatted for a long time, and her sister suggested the community could run a "one-week outfit challenge," which gave her new inspiration.

events.name: Organize the list of regular customers and contact information.
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing sat at her desk at home and compiled the names, phone numbers, and shopping preferences of regular customers she had recorded in notebooks and her phone contacts since opening the store into a spreadsheet. She selected core customers with continuous purchase records over the past six months as the first batch of migration targets.

events.name: Received a video call from my elder sister Song Yawen and got inspiration for the community
events.description: Around 10 am, her elder sister Song Yawen called via video from Shenzhen to ask about her recovery. The sisters chatted for more than half an hour. Song Yawen shared some online operation methods used by fashion stores in Shenzhen and suggested launching a 'one-week outfit challenge' in the community to encourage customers to show off their matching outfits. Song Yajing thought the idea was great and immediately wrote it down in her notebook.

events.name: Import the first batch of core customer data into WeChat Work
events.description: In the afternoon, she followed the spreadsheet and added customers one by one to the external contacts on WeChat Work, grouping them by labels such as "regular customer", "potential customer", and "occasional spender". Afraid of making mistakes, she double-checked after every few additions; the whole process was time-consuming but ensured accuracy.

start_state.mood: Body still easily fatigued, but mindset is calm; accepting that slow work yields fine craftsmanship.

end_state.mood: As she saw familiar names one by one in the WeChat Work contacts, she felt the community had begun to take tangible shape, and her sister's care added even more motivation.

state.daily_exercise: Only light activity at home, about 1,200 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny and bright, with temperatures of 20-28°C.

2025-04.daily_overview: In the morning, she continued to focus on finishing the customer data migration and testing various features of WeChat Work. In the afternoon, her husband took their daughter to the second painting lesson, while Song Yajing stayed home and quietly caught up on last week's painting assignment. She painted for half an hour and felt the flow that comes from concentration. She overheard her daughter in the living room describing to her father the fear she felt on the day her mother fainted. Her heart ached, and it strengthened her resolve to put health first.

events.name: Complete the remaining customer data import and functional testing.
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing entered the remaining twenty-plus customer records from yesterday into WeChat Work and tested functions such as the bulk messaging assistant, customer tags, and group invitations, confirming that everything operated smoothly. She also used a secondary account to simulate the process of joining a group to make sure the follow-up experience would be problem-free.

events.name: Her husband took their daughter to an art class, and Song Yajing stayed home to catch up on her painting homework.
events.description: In the afternoon, Chen Zhiqiang took Xuanxuan to the community art center for their second watercolor class. Song Yajing was home alone. She spread out watercolor paper and, following the tutorial the teacher had sent earlier, made up last week's homework—a potted succulent. She painted very slowly, yet felt a rare sense of inner calm.

events.name: Overhearing her daughter open up, she felt both deep guilt and resolve.
events.description: After her daughter came home, Song Yajing was cutting fruit in the kitchen when she vaguely heard her daughter in the living room hugging her father and saying, Daddy, I was so scared that day when Mommy fell to the ground. I was afraid Mommy would die. Chen Zhiqiang comforted her softly. Hearing this from behind the door, Song Yajing's tears burst out, and she felt both guilty and empowered, vowing never to let her daughter be so frightened again.

start_state.mood: As it happened to be Saturday, she enjoyed a pace of half work, half leisure at home.

end_state.mood: She was pleasantly surprised by the small sense of accomplishment from painting, and her daughter's innocent words left her with a pang of sadness but also greater clarity.

state.daily_exercise: In the evening, walked around the residential complex for about 20 minutes, taking 3,000 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning sunny, with occasional sunshine, temperature 19-27°C.

2025-04.daily_overview: A Sunday of rebuilding inner order. In the morning, she attended Mass at church and connected with fellow believers, drawing strength from it. In the afternoon, she formally began daily Bible reading and recording her reflections, and then in one go completed the official upgrade of the community, transforming the ordinary group chat created in March into a lifestyle community with a brand feel and locking in the main theme of sharing life. Before bed at night, she said a brief family prayer with her husband, entrusting the store and family completely to God. Her routine continued to improve, and her difficulty falling asleep had greatly improved.

events.name: Prepare for the afternoon daily scripture reading.
events.description: Before attending Mass in the morning, Song Yajing took out her black-covered Bible and a brand-new notebook at home, placed them in a fixed spot on the study desk, and set a glass of warm water beside them, creating a small spiritual corner for herself. She planned to start reading from the Gospel of Matthew day by day.

events.name: Attend Sunday Mass and talk with fellow parishioners
events.description: At nine in the morning, she went alone to Siming Catholic Church to attend Sunday morning Mass. After it ended, she exchanged a few words with fellow parishioner Aunt Lin Xiuying and others at the church entrance. Seeing that her complexion was still a little pale, Aunt Lin gently patted her shoulder and said, The Lord will give you strength.

events.name: First daily Bible reading and journaling in the afternoon.
events.description: After lunch, she sat in the corner of the study and opened the Bible to read the first chapter of the Gospel of Matthew. She skimmed over the genealogy and focused on meditating on the account of Jesus' birth. Then she wrote her first reflection in her notebook: "In an ordinary genealogy, God accomplished an extraordinary plan. My little shop also has His arrangement." The whole process lasted about 20 minutes.

events.name: Officially upgraded and launched the “Yajing Life House” community.
events.description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing systematically restructured the customer group that had been migrated from personal WeChat to Enterprise WeChat: she updated the group name to 'Yajing Life Hall,' released official group rules (the first rule: share life, not just sell clothes), and set up a clear column plan, including morning greetings, outfit notes, Zhao Li's energetic breakfast, and more. This move upgraded the ordinary customer group created on March 18 into a lifestyle community with a sense of brand, marking an evolution from a test launch to standardized operation.

events.name: Bedtime family prayer
events.description: Before going to sleep, Song Yajing took the initiative to invite her husband Chen Zhiqiang to kneel together by the bedroom bed and briefly pray for the store's transformation, family peace, and good health. Chen Zhiqiang did not pray often, but he held his wife's hand tightly. The family ended the day in this way, feeling extremely secure.

start_state.location: At home, getting ready to go to church.
start_state.mood: Inner peace and a sense of weekend fulfillment.

end_state.mood: Feeling at ease with the dual progress on the new faith habit and the community upgrade; family prayer let love flow

state.daily_exercise: Walked round trip between the church and home, about 5,000 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with a few clouds, a gentle breeze, temperature 20-29°C

2025-04.daily_overview: The community officially launched operations. In the morning, Song Yajing carefully sent invitations to customers to join the group and posted carefully designed group rules. In the afternoon, there was a precious spiritual exchange: she chatted with Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow church member, at a tea restaurant, and they prayed together for the store and the family. After returning home, an old customer shared an eco-friendly bag made from old clothes in the group, which inspired her idea to launch an “Old Clothes, New Life” activity in May.

events.name: Officially launched the Yajing Lifestyle Center community and released the group rules
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing sent group invitation links one by one to her added customers via WeChat Work. As members gradually joined, she officially posted the group announcement and group rules. The first rule reiterated: “Share life, not just sell clothes,” and everyone was welcome to share breakfast, outfits, parenting tips, and daily fun moments. Several regular customers in the group immediately responded with emoji stickers.

events.name: Had an afternoon tea appointment with Aunt Lin Xiuying.
events.description: At noon, she confirmed the meeting with Aunt Lin Xiuying via WeChat and booked a window booth at Manxianglou Tea Restaurant near Sacred Heart Church. At three in the afternoon, she tidied up a bit and walked there.

events.name: In-depth spiritual conversation and prayer with Aunt Lin.
events.description: Under the soft lights of the tea restaurant, Aunt Lin Xiuying shared how she had relied on her faith to get through family difficulties in her youth, encouraging Song Yajing to entrust the burdens of the shop and her health worries completely to God. Then the two held hands and prayed quietly together for the shop's transformation, family peace, and physical health. This conversation brought Song Yajing immense comfort and strength.

events.name: Customers' creative sharing in the community inspires ideas for new activities
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Song Yajing browsed community messages and saw an old customer sharing an eco-friendly shopping bag she had made from old jeans, with the caption 'Find an eco-friendly sister for new clothes.' Song Yajing's eyes lit up. She immediately wrote down the idea of 'May: New Life for Old Clothes' in her notebook and planned to team up with Zhao Li to hold an offline upcycling salon.

start_state.mood: The excitement and anticipation of opening a new store

end_state.mood: Deeply encouraged by Auntie Lin's faith testimony, and customer interactions brought new business ideas, feeling very fulfilled.

state.daily_exercise: Walked to and from the tea restaurant, about 5,500 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, turning overcast in the afternoon, comfortable feels-like temperature, 21-27°C

2025-04.daily_overview: The day after the community launch, things began to take off. Customer Zhao Li was the first to respond to the group rules, posting a photo of her homemade breakfast and becoming the key moment that broke the ice in the group. Song Yajing saw the message at the store and happily interacted and liked it, and she noticed that the community was beginning to operate on its own around sharing everyday life. After returning home in the afternoon, she had a sudden urge to try making a low-sugar banana oat cake. It didn't look great, but her husband and daughter were very supportive, and the small success made her mood even brighter.

events.name: The first group member shared life content, breaking the ice in the community atmosphere
events.description: In the morning, in the 'Yajing Lifestyle Club' group, a customer named Zhao Li with the nickname 'Lili' posted a photo of a beautifully plated avocado toast and pour-over coffee, with the caption: 'Today's good morning, sharing with my sisters.' This happened to match the group rules. Song Yajing saw it and immediately replied in the group with a like, and encouraged everyone to keep sharing.

events.name: Community interactions are warming up; Song Yajing records content inspiration.
events.description: Following Zhao Li's lead, two or three more customers posted photos of their houseplants and cats. Song Yajing sat in the store's sharing area, replying to group messages while jotting down ideas in her notebook: she could regularly start small topics like "breakfast check-in" and "outfit OOTD," and planned to kick off the first one by sharing four ways to style a light spring jacket.

events.name: Daily customer reception and light stocking at the store.
events.description: While at the shop, Song Yajing and Xiaomei attended to several waves of customers, two of whom were new customers who had come to the store specifically to try on clothes after seeing the community group message. In the afternoon, based on sales, she fine-tuned the display positions of a few main styles, but strictly following the doctor's advice, she did not do any heavy lifting.

events.name: First attempt at low-sugar baking, received praise from the family.
events.description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing came home early and suddenly wanted to try healthy baking. She used bananas, oats, and a little sugar substitute to bake a tray of banana oat cakes. Although the tops were a bit burnt, the aroma filled the room. Her daughter Xuanxuan came home from school and ate two pieces in a row. Her husband also praised, 'Healthier than store-bought.' Song Yajing took a photo and posted it on her Moments, and soon received a like and recipe discussion from her baking friend Mrs. Liu.

start_state.location: At home, before going out, she deliberately reviewed the group messages
start_state.mood: A bit nervous about whether the community can operate autonomously.

end_state.mood: The group icebreaker went smoothly, a small baking experiment brought family joy, and life is getting back on a warm track.

state.daily_exercise: Standing and slow walking during daily store work, about 4,000 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, light breeze in the evening, temperature 20-28°C

2025-04.daily_overview: On the last day of April, Song Yajing switched her pace back to actuary mode. During the day she finished sorting the shop accounts for April, read and recorded scriptures at noon as usual, and in the evening had a serious and productive family financial review with her husband, jointly finalizing the May budget with health and education as spending priorities. Before nightfall, she completed in one go the community operations review, end-of-allergy-season cleaning, and formal confirmation of the new daily routine, and prepared materials for the May Day promotion together with Xiaomei. The storm of April had passed; the direction for May was clear and steady.

events.name: Organize the store's April sales accounts and bank statements
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing spread out the account books at the store and compiled April's daily sales records, special promotion income and expenses, supplier refunds, and the coffee machine transfer payment one by one. She then logged into the corporate bank to export the store's business account statement for April, preparing clear data for the evening family finance meeting.

events.name: Read the scriptures at noon and record reflections.
events.description: After lunch, as usual, she read Chapter 2 of the Gospel of Matthew in her study, meditating on the story of the Magi paying homage, and wrote in her notebook: "God guided the Magi to Jesus; I also ask Him to guide me to find the balance between career and health." Several consecutive days of Bible reading had made her heart calmer and calmer.

events.name: Evening family financial review and May budget planning
events.description: After their daughter fell asleep that night, Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang spread the account books and mobile banking app on the coffee table in the living room and reviewed the family's total income and expenses for April together. They discussed in detail the reasons for the decline in the store's net profit, the actual effects of the promotional sale, and the education savings transfers, and together set the May budget: cut back on non-essential shopping, deposit 2,000 yuan into education savings, and reserve 1,500 yuan as a special fund for physical exams and physical therapy. The overseas travel plan was tacitly adjusted to "within five years."

events.name: Community operations review and follow-up content plan development
events.description: In the afternoon, she reviewed the interaction data and level of enthusiasm since the community launched a few days earlier and compiled the first list of 'seed users' who had actively shared. She then made a content plan for early May, including the theme for the first outfit-sharing post, inviting Zhao Li to give an online breakfast tutorial, and so on. She also told Xiaomei to help forward the morning greetings every day.

events.name: Final cleaning of the air purifier filter and allergy management summary
events.description: Taking advantage of the good daylight, she gave the purifier filters at the store and at home their final deep cleaning and drying of the season, then packed up and discarded the old filters that had been replaced. She wrote a brief summary in her phone memo: "Allergy symptoms decreased significantly in April; loratadine was only taken twice, and I kept up well with the honeycomb extract." She sorted and archived the remaining medication.

events.name: Formally confirmed the new routine as a long-term habit
events.description: Before bed, she wrote in her sleep diary: “Having gone to sleep around 22:30 for 11 consecutive days, waking up early is no longer difficult. This afternoon, when clearing the accounts, my mind was clearer than ever. This routine is officially confirmed and will not waver.” At this point, going to bed early had become a discipline she wanted to maintain for life.

events.name: May Day promotional materials setup and preparation for tomorrow's sales.
events.description: After the shop closed in the evening, Song Yajing and Xiaomei worked together to put up the May Day promotional posters, rearrange the display in the best-seller section, prepare packaging bags and complimentary silk scarves, and confirm the member discount plan. Once everything was ready, she turned off the lights and gently pulled down the rolling shutter door, feeling a calm anticipation for the coming May.

start_state.location: At home, went out after eating the egg noodles her husband made.
start_state.mood: Facing the month-end review with composure; has built up the courage to confront financial reality

end_state.location: In the bedroom at home, the scent of lavender filled the air.
end_state.mood: Seeing transparent finances, a growing community, improving health, and a harmonious family, she felt an unprecedented sense of peace and gratitude.

state.daily_exercise: Daytime store work plus a little walking, about 5,000 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny to partly cloudy, with brief thundershowers in the afternoon.

2025-04.daily_overview: On the first day of July, Song Yajing continued the peaceful pace from the end of June, but her mind had already begun planning for the new month. In the morning, she settled last month's accounts at the store, set aside insurance premiums, and invested in the health of herself and her family. In the afternoon, while Xiaomei watched the store, she booked an adult pottery wheel-throwing course for late July online, continuing her monthly time for self-care. During her evening walk, she found her weight had dropped compared with last month, which strengthened her healthy habits. At night, she received a video call from her mother and confirmed the plan to pick up her parents, with warmth and a touch of anticipation.

events.name: Book a private pottery experience class
events.description: During the afternoon customer lull, Song Yajing compared several pottery studios in Siming District on a local life platform, chose one with a good reputation, booked an adult pottery wheel-throwing course for late July, and paid online. She looked forward to relaxing both body and mind through creation, continuing her monthly self-care time.

events.name: Set aside for family insurance expenses
events.description: At the beginning of the month, following the special insurance plan in her electronic ledger, she set aside the premium from her July income and deposited it into a dedicated account to ensure the month's insurance was deducted on time. This has become a regular ritual that gives her a sense of security.

events.name: Video call with Mother in the evening
events.description: After dinner, her mother Lin Xiuying video-called to ask about the exact time to pick them up and what items were needed. Song Yajing laughed and told her mother not to bring too much, but her mother insisted on bringing homemade Poria powder and small sewing items. Her father, beside her mother, reminded her to drive safely. The call lasted half an hour; after hanging up, she felt warm inside.

events.name: Write a health diary after the walk.
events.description: After brisk walking for half an hour in the community garden in the evening, she opened her health diary and recorded today's weight and how the walk felt. Comparing with the data from the beginning of the month, she found that her body felt much lighter, the breast tenderness had basically disappeared, and she secretly gave herself a thumbs-up.

start_state.mood: Peaceful, with a faint anticipation of the new month

end_state.mood: Pleasant and content; the orderliness of her finances and the progress of her family plans made her feel secure.

state.daily_exercise: Evening walk for 30 minutes (about 2 km).

date_attribute.weather: Sunny to partly cloudy, with brief thundershowers in the afternoon.

2025-07.daily_overview: Tomorrow she would pick up her parents, and Song Yajing spent the whole day in excited busyness. In the morning, after finishing the new-arrival display in the store, she closed early and went home for a thorough cleaning. In the evening, she went to the supermarket to buy her father's favorite shacha noodles and Tieguanyin, and also checked the car with her husband. Before going to bed, she dug out a CD of old Hokkien songs and imagined her parents sitting in the car, almost unable to fall asleep.

events.name: Preparing in advance for her parents' arrival
events.description: After her lunch break, she cleaned the guest bedroom, put on fresh sheets and a thin quilt, and placed mosquito repellent and a small night light on the bedside table. Then she went to the supermarket and, from memory, bought ingredients for Minnan satay noodles, seasonal fruit, and the Tieguanyin tea her father loved. On the way home, a sudden thunderstorm broke out. While taking shelter in the arcade, she sent a message reminding her mother to bring an umbrella tomorrow morning.
