events.name: Check the vehicle and create a homecoming atmosphere.
events.description: After dinner, she and her husband Chen Zhiqiang went to the garage to check the car. They confirmed that the tire pressure, brakes, and air conditioning were normal, and filled up the tank. Back in the car, she took out her phone, pulled up the playlist her father used to like when he was young, burned it to a CD, and put it in the glove compartment, planning to play it as soon as they hit the road the next day. Her husband teased her for being thoroughly prepared, and she said it was a ritual for the family reunion.

start_state.mood: Excited and a little busy, her mind already drifting to her hometown in Quanzhou.

end_state.mood: She lay awake for a long time, her anticipation mixed with excitement at the prospect of seeing her parents soon.

state.daily_exercise: No deliberate exercise, but walking during housework and shopping exceeded 8,000 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning sunny, 28-33 degrees, suitable for going out.

2025-07.daily_overview: In the early morning, she drove alone back to Quanzhou, accompanied all the way by old Hokkien songs. When she saw her parents at her hometown, her father's clear responses reassured her. In the afternoon, she returned to Xiamen. Three generations squeezed into the small kitchen to prepare dinner, stewing her father's favorite Tong'an braised pork. After the meal, her mother took out the Poria powder she had brought, and beside the flowerpots on the balcony there were two new pots of freshly transplanted mint.

events.name: Return to Quanzhou to pick up my parents
events.description: In the morning, she drove alone along the Shenhai Expressway back to Quanzhou, listening to the CD she had burned the night before. After arriving at her parents' home, she helped them carry their luggage. Her mother had specially brought a jar of homemade Poria powder and some sewing supplies, and her father adjusted his hearing aid and showed it to her. On the way back, her father sat in the back seat, pointing out the window and chatting nonstop. The heavy stone in her heart had finally been lifted.

events.name: Getting the whole family together and cooking dinner
events.description: I got home shortly after four in the afternoon. My daughter Xuanxuan threw herself into her grandparents' arms. In the kitchen, I cooked: braised assorted fish in soy sauce, Tong'an braised pork, stir-fried rice noodles, and popiah. My mother was picking vegetables beside me, while my father was pulled by Xuanxuan to look at her drawings. At dinner, my father, with his hearing aid on, responded to everything with ease. I felt all the running around had turned into a sense of peace.

events.name: Mother transplanting mint on the balcony.
events.description: After dinner and cleaning up, her mother took out the mint seedlings she had brought from Quanzhou and planted them with Song Yajing in flower pots on the balcony. Her mother said Xiamen's weather suited these herbs and they could make tea with them later. Watching her mother's back as she squatted by the flower pots, Song Yajing felt as if she had returned to her childhood.

start_state.mood: Anticipation and slight nervousness before the tiring journey.

end_state.mood: Happy and peaceful, a feeling of satisfaction from being surrounded by family filling my heart

state.daily_exercise: After the long drive, took a slow 10-minute walk around the residential area to relax the legs.

date_attribute.weather: Clear, with a brief thundershower in the afternoon.

2025-07.daily_overview: On the first day her parents officially moved in, Song Yajing deliberately slowed down her work pace. She went to the store for a little over two hours in the morning and then returned home. After the rain stopped in the afternoon, she took her mother and Xuanxuan to the community park and introduced the nearby facilities. Her mother and the neighbor, Aunt Zhang, hit it off immediately, while her father pointed out things to pay attention to when repotting her plants on the balcony. In the evening, fellow church member Lin Xiuying called and warmly invited her parents to go to church together on the weekend.

events.name: Accompany parents to get familiar with the neighborhood.
events.description: At 4 p.m., she walked slowly around the neighborhood with her daughter by the hand and her mother on her arm, introducing her mother to the Cainiao Station, the pharmacy, and the park. Her mother sighed at how green Xiamen was, saying that from now on she could bring Xuanxuan to play on the slide every day. Xuanxuan ran ahead excitedly, while she and her mother followed behind, exchanging smiles from time to time.

events.name: Parents' first interaction with neighbors
events.description: In the evening, their neighbor Auntie Zhang Xiuying met them downstairs. She greeted them warmly and pressed a few pieces of homemade cold rice cake into Xuanxuan's hands. Her mother chatted endlessly with Auntie Zhang about family and cooking, while her father stood quietly nearby, smiling. Song Yajing felt that her parents were gradually blending into her life circle in Xiamen.

events.name: Call invitation from fellow church member Lin Xiuying
events.description: After dinner, Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow church member, called to ask about how her parents were settling in and invited them to attend Mass at church together on Sunday. Her mother took the phone and chatted for a long time. Though her father was not a believer, he said he was willing to go and experience it. Song Yajing put down the phone, feeling warm inside.

start_state.mood: Lazy and warm, enjoying slow time with parents nearby

end_state.mood: Peace of mind, a relaxed feeling of being cared for gradually growing back

state.daily_exercise: Take a walk with family in the neighborhood for about 40 minutes (about 6,000 steps)

date_attribute.weather: Partly sunny, with a cool sea breeze in the evening.

2025-07.daily_overview: On Saturday evening, Song Yajing took the whole family for a walk along the seaside on Huandao Road. Her father's remark “You've lost weight” made her eyes redden; the pressure she had been carrying alone for years was suddenly seen. After returning home, she talked with her parents late into the night, pouring out the stress of running the shop and the anxiety of parenting. Her father comforted her with his own youthful experiences, saying “Take it slow.” Before going to sleep, she solemnly wrote in her notebook: “Return to Quanzhou once a month” and “Try to arrange a short family trip by the end of the year.”

events.name: Family walk along the seaside on Huandao Road
events.description: At six in the evening, she came home from the shop and drove the whole family to Huandao Road. The sea breeze blew away the summer heat; Xuanxuan chased the waves on the beach while her parents supported each other. When they were tired of walking, they sat on a bench. Her father turned his head and looked at her for a long time, then said softly, 'You've lost weight. Don't push yourself too hard.' Her nose tingled, she tightly held her father's arm, buried her face in his shoulder, and amid the sound of the waves, the hardship she had endured alone seemed finally to have been seen.

events.name: Had a long late-night talk with her parents and adjusted the focus of her life.
events.description: After walking home, her husband took their daughter to bathe, while she sat down with her parents in the living room, poured Tieguanyin tea, and slowly talked about the ups and downs and pressures since opening the shop. Her mother held her hand and patted it gently. Her father shared his experience of learning everything from scratch at the factory when he was young, and advised her that life is built day by day. She wrote in her notebook, 'Return to Quanzhou once a month' and 'Family short trip at the end of the year,' and felt much relieved.

start_state.mood: Tired after work, but looking forward to family time

end_state.mood: The softness that was healed and the ease after long-missed vulnerability was accepted.

state.daily_exercise: Seaside walk for about 50 minutes (about 3 km).

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with convective cloud clusters in the afternoon but no rain.

2025-07.daily_overview: On Sunday morning, Song Yajing took her parents to Mass for the first time. Her mother prayed devoutly, her father watched quietly, and the fellow parishioners warmly welcomed them. In the afternoon, with the help of her parents and Xiaomei, she turned the blank wall at the store entrance into a 'Family Photo Wall,' putting up photos of family smiles and group photos with customers, which immediately attracted customers to stop and look. In the evening, when they got home, her mother made tea with freshly picked mint from the balcony. The whole family sat on the balcony and chatted for a while. Her father said that adding two more pots of flowers on the balcony would make it even nicer.

events.name: Take parents to Sunday Mass.
events.description: At eight in the morning, she and her parents arrived at Siming Catholic Church. Father Wang's sermon mentioned that "family is a safe haven," and her mother gently held her hand. After Mass, fellow parishioner Aunt Lin Xiuying came over especially to chat and invited her parents to come to church often. Her father said he would be willing to accompany her mother occasionally.

events.name: Decorate the family photo wall in the shop
events.description: At two in the afternoon, she brought photos and colored washi tape from home and, with the help of her parents and Xiaomei, set up a photo wall, putting up the family portrait, Xuanxuan's playful photos, a profile shot of her mother making Poria cake, and photos with regular customers. As soon as the wall was finished, a customer stopped to take photos. She smiled and handed over sticky notes, inviting them to leave their stories.

events.name: Mint tea time on the balcony
events.description: In the evening, Mother brewed a few cups of tea with the mint leaves transplanted earlier. Father sat in the rattan chair looking at the sunset glow and said it would be even better if the balcony had one more pot of bougainvillea. Song Yajing made a mental note and decided to look for one at the flower market next week.

start_state.mood: The peace of the Sabbath.

end_state.mood: Satisfaction after the inspiration came to life, and greater confidence in the shop's human connections.

state.daily_exercise: Evening walk for 20 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Sunny and hot, maximum temperature 34 degrees

2025-07.daily_overview: After being awakened by her father's words "Don't push yourself too hard," Song Yajing decided to step up her self-care. In the afternoon, she squeezed in a trip to a sporting goods store and bought professional walking shoes and a set of sportswear, planning to start morning exercise. That evening, she sat on the balcony's rattan chairs with her husband to discuss it. Her husband was very supportive and agreed to look after their daughter in the morning. Before bed, she placed her new shoes neatly outside the bedroom door, like a solemn ritual.

events.name: Buy sports equipment to prepare for morning brisk walking.
events.description: At two in the afternoon, she went to a sporting goods store on the pedestrian street. After trying on several pairs of cushioned shoes, she chose light gray walking shoes and paired them with a quick-dry T-shirt and capri pants. At checkout, she thought: Father was right — you have to take care of yourself first before you can take care of your family and the store.

events.name: Discussing the morning plan with her husband.
events.description: After dinner, she sat with her husband on the newly arranged rattan chairs on the balcony and told him she wanted to start morning brisk walking. Her husband was very supportive and offered to wake up Xuanxuan and prepare breakfast in the morning. They also chatted about how the shop was doing, and as a gentle breeze blew, the scent of jasmine drifted through the air.

start_state.mood: Lightness after making a decision

end_state.mood: Eager to try the new habit that is about to begin

state.daily_exercise: Evening walk for 20 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with a few clouds; cool in the morning.

2025-07.daily_overview: At 6:30 in the morning, Song Yajing completed her first morning brisk walk with her father accompanying her. Her father silently followed behind or sat on a bench, which gave her great encouragement. Later she discovered that her father had been waiting in the living room all along, just to accompany her. In the morning, she cleared out the clutter from the balcony and bought lounge chairs and a coffee table for her parents. After an evening walk, she felt soreness in her calves and did a more careful stretch before bed.

events.name: First morning brisk walk accompanied by Father
events.description: At 6:30 she pushed open the door and found her father already drinking tea in the living room. Her father said, "I'll walk with you." The two walked into the community park; she walked briskly while her father exercised alongside. Half an hour later she was slightly sweaty. Her father handed her a towel and said she looked well. He quietly told her that he had actually woken up at five and waited in the living room because he was afraid she would be lonely. She was silently moved.

events.name: Clean up clutter on the balcony
events.description: In the morning, after her parents took Xuanxuan to the park, she cleaned up the old flower pots and cardboard boxes stacked on the balcony, wiped the empty space clean, and imagined what it would look like with a lounge chair.

events.name: Purchase balcony leisure furniture for parents
events.description: After cleaning up, she ordered two rattan lounge chairs and a folding coffee table on an e-commerce platform, chose the beige cushion version, and left a note asking the seller to reinforce the packaging, hoping her parents could enjoy them more during their stay in Xiamen.

events.name: Extra stretching in the evening to ease muscle soreness.
events.description: Before going to sleep, she felt slight soreness in her calves, so she extended her stretching time and rolled her calves with a foam roller, and in her meditation she thanked her father for his company.

start_state.mood: I struggled a bit getting up, but was encouraged by my father's company.

end_state.mood: My body is a bit sore but I feel refreshed, and I'm glad I did something concrete to show filial piety.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk for 30 minutes (about 2.8 km).

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning overcast, with light rain in the afternoon.

2025-07.daily_overview: After a brisk morning walk, she felt refreshed. She spent the entire morning at the store sorting through sales data from the past three months and identified the direction for autumn collection selection. In the afternoon, rainy weather dampened customer traffic. She chatted with her close friends Li Meiling and Zhao Min in a group about the pain points of managing kids during summer vacation, and a flash of inspiration led them to turn free weekend time into a “Parent-Child Afternoon Tea”. In the evening, she posted a recruitment poster, and Li Meiling was the first to sign up. Because of planning the event, she stayed up late until nearly 11:30.

events.name: Organize sales data and customer preference analysis.
events.description: In the morning, she spread out the sales receipts and tables from April to June and tallied sales volumes and return reasons by category. She found that French vintage-style dresses and draped suit shorts sold well, while avant-garde styles were slow-moving, which gave her a clear idea for the autumn orders.

events.name: Discussed with her close friend launching a parent-child afternoon tea.
events.description: On a rainy afternoon, she discussed how to deal with overly energetic children with Li Meiling and Zhao Min in their three-person WeChat group. Li Meiling complained that there was nowhere for the kids to play, and Zhao Min shared a parent-child afternoon tea model from Hangzhou. A spark flashed through her mind, and she decided to test the waters. The three divided the work: Zhao Min would oversee the process, Li Meiling would build buzz, and she would come up with a mini flower arrangement + cupcake combo.

events.name: Create and publish the recruitment post for the first parent-child afternoon tea.
events.description: In the evening, she posted an invitation for 'Parent-Child Afternoon Tea · Mom's Breathing Moment' in the store's community group and on Moments. It was scheduled for Sunday afternoon and included mini flower arranging and low-sugar desserts, limited to 6 groups at cost price. After posting, she kept refreshing until Li Meiling was the first to sign up, and then she breathed a sigh of relief.

events.name: Went to bed late due to event planning.
events.description: Because she kept revising the event copy and posters, she did not go to bed until after 23:30, an hour later than usual.

start_state.mood: Energetic, with the refreshed feeling after morning exercise.

end_state.mood: Excited about her new idea, but also slightly tired from staying up late.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk for 30 minutes (about 3 km); no extra exercise in the afternoon because of drowsiness.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, temperature 28-34 degrees, hot at noon

2025-07.daily_overview: Feeling a bit sleepy during the morning brisk walk because she had stayed up late the night before. An extremely fulfilling day. After the morning brisk walk, she had a video call with supplier Zheng Kai to finalize 6 core styles for autumn, paid a deposit, and locked in the launch of new items for mid-August. During her lunch break, she slept an extra 20 minutes to make up for lost sleep, then ran to the vegetable market to buy rice flour and poria powder. Back home, under her mother's hands-on guidance, she made the poria cake from her childhood memory completely for the first time. The mother and daughter laughed and chatted in the kitchen, revisiting the embarrassing incident of sneaking sugar. In the afternoon, she brought the warm poria cake to the shop to share with Xiao Mei. In the evening, her mother took out an old photo album, and the family sat together reminiscing. Her father pointed at a photo of her at age three and said with a smile, "You were chubby then."

events.name: Finalized autumn orders with supplier Zheng Kai
events.description: Before opening the store in the morning, she connected by video with Zheng Kai, a supplier in Guangzhou. Based on yesterday's analysis, she quickly selected 6 French vintage and simple commuter styles, ordering 20 pieces of each and paying a 30% deposit in advance. Zheng Kai praised her increasingly accurate style selection, and they agreed the goods would arrive in mid-August.

events.name: Extended lunch break to make up for lack of sleep
events.description: Because she had been planning activities late into the night the previous night (July 9), she felt slightly drowsy during this morning's brisk walk. At lunch break, she deliberately slept 20 minutes longer (about 40 minutes in total). In the afternoon, her energy recovered and she continued working.

events.name: Purchasing ingredients for making Poria cake
events.description: After her afternoon nap, she rode her electric bike to the dried goods stall at the vegetable market and bought rice flour, glutinous rice flour, poria powder, and more. The owner gave her a handful of dried osmanthus flowers, saying that sprinkling some in while cooking would make it more fragrant.

events.name: Made Minnan poria cakes by hand with my mother
events.description: At one in the afternoon, the mother and daughter put on aprons. The mother demonstrated how to sift the rice flour and mix the ingredients, and she followed along step by step. When the steam rose and the fragrance of rice filled the air, her mother suddenly laughed at how she used to lie by the stove as a child, waiting to lick the cake molds covered with white sugar. Her eyes grew slightly warm, and she felt that the cake was steaming with her childhood and her mother's love.

events.name: Tasting Poria cake and revisiting mother-daughter memories
events.description: The steamed poria cake was sprinkled with crushed hawthorn and osmanthus—delicately sweet, soft, and chewy. The mother and daughter sat at the table and ate slowly. Her mother said it tasted exactly like the one her own mother used to make, so she quickly noted the recipe in her phone memo.

events.name: Shared the Poria cake with the store clerk Xiaomei
events.description: When she went to the shop in the afternoon, she packed some poria cake to give to Xiaomei. Xiaomei was pleasantly surprised and said it was like her grandmother’s steamed sponge cake but chewier. As the two shared the cake, the shop seemed filled with the sweet taste of home.

events.name: The whole family looks through old photo albums in the evening
events.description: After dinner, her mother dug out an old photo album from the suitcase, and her father pointed at a chubby photo of her at age 3, smiling as he recalled funny stories from her childhood. Xuanxuan compared photos of her mother with her own, and three generations of the family enjoyed a warm, happy time together.

start_state.mood: Rising early, she was full of energy and planned the whole day methodically.

end_state.mood: Physically tired but emotionally fulfilled, filled with the double satisfaction of mother-daughter collaboration and family memories.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk for 30 minutes (about 3 km).

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, with sunset glow in the evening.

2025-07.daily_overview: The rattan chairs and coffee table she ordered online arrived. Song Yajing and her husband assembled and arranged them while her parents were taking a nap, and the balcony was completely transformed. When her mother woke up, she was pleasantly surprised; her father immediately boiled water to make tea. From then on, the balcony became her parents' daily morning tea corner. In the afternoon, she contacted Zheng Kai to confirm the autumn order logistics and anchored the new-product launch plan for mid-August. In the evening, she taught her mother to use cloud backup for the phone photo album and synced the balcony photos she took today to her older sister.

events.name: Assembling balcony furniture with my husband
events.description: At 2 pm, the courier delivered two large boxes of furniture. She and her husband spent more than an hour using hex wrenches to tighten screws, assembling rattan chairs and a coffee table, and laying a cotton-linen tablecloth. The balcony finally stopped being a storage room.

events.name: Placed plants and completed the balcony mini-renovation.
events.description: She moved her mother's favorite jasmine plant next to the coffee table, hung a small pot of pothos, and adjusted the angle of the table and chairs to ensure morning sun without harsh exposure. A breeze blew by, and the scent of jasmine drifted; she took a photo and sent it to the family group chat, and her sister liked it instantly.

events.name: Parents discovered the surprise and formed a habit of balcony tea breaks
events.description: Waking from her nap, the mother was pleasantly surprised to find that the balcony had been completely transformed, and she immediately pulled the father over to sit and experience it. The father brewed Tieguanyin tea, and the two sat on the new chairs admiring the green trees in the community until Xuanxuan came to pull Grandpa over to play with blocks. From then on, every morning shortly after six, the father would quietly brew tea and sit on the balcony with the mother for half an hour, and this became their most cherished ritual in Xiamen.

events.name: Follow up on autumn order logistics and adjust the new-arrival plan
events.description: Before closing in the evening, she confirmed with Zheng Kai that the order had been scheduled for production, with delivery expected on August 12. She recorded it in the purchase ledger, noted the new-arrival display on August 15 in her phone calendar, and also started brainstorming a French vintage-themed styling event.

events.name: Teach mother how to use cloud backup on her phone
events.description: In the evening, her mother said she wanted to send balcony photos to relatives in Quanzhou. She patiently taught her mother to use the cloud backup feature of the phone's photo album and synced today's photos to her sister. Mother and daughter leaned their heads together, laughing as they operated the phone, and talked about the days when letters were written in the past.

start_state.mood: Feeling excited at waking up, thinking about the furniture arriving today.

end_state.mood: Content and at ease, having created a comfortable space for her family and laid the groundwork for the autumn work.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk for 30 minutes (about 3 km), plus light physical labor of assembling furniture

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with a light breeze now and then, a typical summer weekend.

2025-07.daily_overview: On Saturday, Song Yajing planned light tasks for herself. In the morning she went to the farmers' market with her parents and bought bitter melon and pork ribs to make soup. In the afternoon, while her daughter was napping, she sorted out the flowers and materials for tomorrow's parent-child afternoon tea and ran through the process in her mind. Her father teased her while wiping the flower shears, saying she was more serious than when she took the college entrance exam. After dinner, her parents went to bed early and her daughter was already asleep. She and her husband Chen Zhiqiang watched an old Hokkien movie, The Story of Time, with the projector. As they watched, they chatted about funny memories from when they first met, enjoying a rare moment alone together. In the evening, Li Meiling called to confirm the details, and the two also talked about parenting tips, staying on the phone until very late.

events.name: Accompanied parents to the farmers' market to buy ingredients for a cooling summer soup
events.description: After finishing her brisk morning walk, she walked with her parents to the morning market on Hubin South Road. While choosing bitter melon, her mother taught her how to pick ones with large surface bumps and a lighter color, while her father bought pork ribs and soybeans. At home, they stewed a big pot of bitter melon, soybean, and pork rib soup together. At lunch, each person had a bowl, and the summer heat completely disappeared.

events.name: Made material preparations and mentally rehearsed for the parent-child afternoon tea.
events.description: At three in the afternoon, after Xuanxuan fell asleep, she divided daisies, eucalyptus leaves, and floral foam into six portions, and laid out the low-sugar cake cups and piping bags. When her father teased her while wiping the flower shears with alcohol, she rehearsed the entire flow—from greeting, to flower arranging, to sharing dessert—in the living room, and her mother watched with great amusement. Everything was ready, and she felt calm anticipation for her first event.

events.name: In the evening, watched an old movie with my husband.
events.description: After dinner, her parents went to bed early, and her daughter had already fallen asleep. Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang sat in the living room and watched an old Hokkien-language movie, In Our Time, on the projector. They chatted about funny stories from when they first met as they watched, enjoying a rare moment alone together.

events.name: Discussing event details with Li Meiling over the phone
events.description: At nine in the evening, Li Meiling called and proactively asked whether Song Yajing still needed help. The two chatted for nearly another hour, moving from tomorrow's event to funny stories about their children. Song Yajing remarked that even after becoming a mother, a late-night call from her best friend was still the best stress reliever.

start_state.mood: The relaxing feeling of the weekend, gently surrounded by everyday household chores.

end_state.mood: Fell asleep peacefully looking forward to the first event, slightly nervous but confident

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk for 35 minutes (about 3.2 km), plus extra walking around the market.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny in the morning, cloudy in the afternoon; suitable for indoor activities

2025-07.daily_overview: A Sunday intertwined with faith and community activities. In the morning she took her parents and daughter to Mass, and silently prayed for the afternoon activity and her parents' health. In the afternoon, although only three families came to the first parent-child afternoon tea, the mothers and children were fully engaged. The flower arrangements were naive and adorable, and the cake was eaten up. After the event, the mothers spontaneously posted photos and recommendations on their Moments. Looking at those words, she knew she had done the right thing. She strictly followed her four o'clock work-end principle, went home to have dinner with her daughter, and enjoyed her time as a mother. In the evening, she received a long private message from one of the mothers and was moved almost to tears.

events.name: Attending Sunday Mass and offering prayers.
events.description: At nine in the morning, she walked into the church holding Xuanxuan's hand, accompanying her parents. Father Wang's sermon happened to touch on 'small acts of ministry,' and her heart was stirred. When receiving Communion, she silently prayed for a smooth afternoon and gave thanks that her parents could come.

events.name: Host the first parent-child afternoon tea event
events.description: At 2:30 in the afternoon, soft jazz was playing in the store. She taught the children the names of flowers and guided the parent-child activity of making handheld flower boxes. The children got glue all over their hands, and the mothers laughed while making repairs. Then came the cupcake decorating session; Xuanxuan ate while playing, and the whole shop was filled with laughter. At the end of the activity, the mothers actively joined the group chat and posted recommendations on Moments, praising the place as a hidden gem.

events.name: Stuck to the principle of family time after 4 p.m.
events.description: It ended right on time at four. She left the rest of the tidying to Xiaomei and cycled home by herself. With her phone on silent, she played with LEGO and Xuanxuan, then helped her mother pick vegetables. At dinner, she told her family about the amusing moments. Her father praised her gift, and her husband sent her screenshots of the moms' Moments posts. She wrote in her diary, "For the first time, I feel that there can be no rift between work and home."

events.name: Received a thank-you private message from the participating mom.
events.description: In the evening, a mother sent a long private message thanking her for providing such a wonderful parent-child activity and saying that her child kept talking about the little flower box all the way home. She read it with tears in her eyes and immediately took a screenshot and saved it in 'Achievements Folder'.

start_state.mood: In the stillness of the Sabbath, there was a hint of slight nervousness.

end_state.mood: A deep and perfect sense of relief; the gateway to self-worth has been redefined.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk for 30 minutes (about 3 km).

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, high of 33°C, muggy.

2025-07.daily_overview: Monday began with mutual help and a busy pace. In the morning, she confirmed the next day’s family dental checkup, organized feedback from yesterday’s event, and fielded a steady stream of community consultations. In the afternoon, her best friend Li Meiling, who was suffering from pregnancy sickness, asked her to help pick up her son. Without a second thought, she agreed and arrived on time at the elementary school gate to pick up Haohao. The two chatted in the car for a long time. Li Meiling said tearfully, “You’re more reliable than my husband,” and then took the opportunity to suggest that she take over the regular drop-off and pick-up every Tuesday and Thursday. She agreed readily. In the evening, she and her husband finalized the plan for their daughter’s birthday party on the balcony, settling on the theme “Little Designer” with clear division of tasks. Before bed, her sister Song Yawen called via video, concerned about how their parents were adjusting, and the sisters chatted for half an hour.

events.name: Confirm the family dental check-up time.
events.description: Before opening the shop in the morning, she confirmed the family appointment at 9 a.m. the next day with the dental hospital, and sent a reminder in the family group.

events.name: Processed feedback from the parent-child afternoon tea and organized the community group.
events.description: In the morning at the store, she received long positive reviews from three mothers, and new parents asked about the next event. She replied to each one, added the new people to the community group, and created a participant family information table to accumulate data for the next event.

events.name: First time helping best friend Li Meiling pick up her child
events.description: At 3:30 in the afternoon, Li Meiling, suffering from severe morning sickness, asked for help. She immediately agreed and arrived on time at 3:50 to pick up Li Haoyu. At the car, Li Meiling got out, heavily pregnant, and the two chatted for more than forty minutes. Li Meiling wiped her tears and said, 'You're more reliable than my husband.' She held her best friend's hand tightly to comfort her.

events.name: Agreed to regular weekly pickups and drop-offs, deepening the friendship.
events.description: After dropping off Haohao, Li Meiling sent a WeChat message proposing a regular Tuesday and Thursday pickup and drop-off arrangement. She immediately replied 'No problem' and set a recurring reminder in her calendar. She wrote in her diary: 'Friendship isn't only found in cafés; sometimes it's most real in a car at the elementary school gate.'

events.name: Discussing and finalizing the plan for our daughter's birthday party with my husband
events.description: After dinner, she and her husband sat on the balcony, opened their memo by the streetlight, and discussed item by item. They settled on the "Little Designer" theme, inviting 8 children. She was in charge of catering and the handicraft session, and her husband handled balloon decoration and photography. He also suggested using leftover fabric scraps from the store for a paper doll clothing contest, and she clapped her hands in approval.

events.name: Video call with older sister Song Yawen
events.description: Before bed, her older sister Song Yawen video-called and asked about their parents' health and whether she had adjusted to life in Xiamen. They talked for half an hour. She also shared the success of the afternoon event, and her sister praised her for becoming more and more capable, saying she might come to Xiamen on a business trip next month and they could meet up.

start_state.mood: A sense of everyday busyness, but supported by the positive feedback from community activities, she feels positive.

end_state.mood: Fulfilled by being able to help her best friend, looking forward to the family celebration, and the call with her sister added to her happiness.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk for 30 minutes (about 3 km).

date_attribute.weather: Sunny; cool in the morning, hot at midday

2025-07.daily_overview: As planned, the whole family went to the dental hospital for their annual checkup in the morning. All three generations had no major dental problems, and Song Yajing carefully entered the results into the family health record. After returning home, she picked the basil and rosemary that were overflowing from the balcony pots, and in the evening made basil pesto pasta for the family. The aroma was enticing, and her father praised her, saying she could open a private home-style restaurant. In the afternoon, as usual, she picked up Haohao, then without stopping went shopping for supplies for her daughter's party. In the evening, because some mint leaves had wilted from the midday sun, she quickly moved them to a semi-shaded spot and watered them thoroughly. Before bed, she weighed herself and found that her weight had dropped to 49.3 kg. Remembering that her father had said she looked thinner, she decided to add a “muscle gain” goal to her health journal.

events.name: The whole family completed their annual dental checkup.
events.description: At nine in the morning, the family of five arrived on time. Xuanxuan and her husband had healthy teeth, her old filling was intact, and her parents only needed routine cleaning. The doctor recommended dental sealants for Xuanxuan as prevention. She carefully copied the results and follow-up time into the family health record book.

events.name: Harvest balcony herbs
events.description: When she got home, she found the basil and rosemary were bursting out of their pots. She picked a large handful of tender basil leaves and rosemary sprigs, brought them close to smell the fragrance, and thought about the evening's menu. While watering the jasmine, she noticed new flower buds had appeared, so she took a photo and sent it to the family group.

events.name: Made basil pesto pasta using produce harvested from the balcony
events.description: In the evening, she blended the picked basil leaves with pine nuts, garlic cloves, olive oil, etc. into a bright green pesto. After cooking the spaghetti, she gently tossed it in the sauce and garnished it with fresh basil leaves. Her husband took a taste and praised it endlessly, saying it was more authentic than at Western restaurants. Xuanxuan held up her fork and shouted for more. During the meal, her parents talked about the old days of growing basil in Quanzhou. One meal connected the balcony, childhood, and the present moment.

events.name: Tend to the balcony plants and adjust the shading.
events.description: After the scorching sun in the afternoon, she noticed that the mint leaves she had moved out of the harsh sunlight in the morning were looking a bit wilted. She quickly moved the plant back to a semi-shaded spot, watered it thoroughly, and trimmed the scorched edges with scissors. She was glad she found it in time; plants, like family, need careful care.

events.name: Pick up best friend's child from school again
events.description: At 4:30 pm, she finished restocking and arrived at the primary school gate on time to pick up Haohao and take him back. Li Meiling looked a bit better today. The two stood and chatted about pregnancy nutrition, and she promised to bring low-sugar cupcakes next time.

events.name: Buy supplies for my daughter's birthday party.
events.description: After picking up Haohao, she went to the supermarket to buy colorful balloons, juice, and tablecloths, then went to the bakery shop to buy cake flour, whipping cream, and a castle-shaped cake mold. In front of the shelves, she used her phone to search for a strawberry yogurt mousse recipe. The shopping cart was filled with love and anticipation.

events.name: Write a health summary and set new goals in the evening.
events.description: Before going to sleep, she weighed herself and found her weight had dropped to 49.3 kg. Reviewing the two weeks of morning brisk walking and dietary changes, she wrote in her health diary, "My weight has dropped slightly; my father said I look thinner, so maybe I should consider building muscle." She decided to consult Dr. Wang next week about healthy ways to gain weight, and to continue maintaining her exercise habits.

start_state.mood: A sense of responsibility about health check-ups and a composed start to the day.

end_state.mood: Deeply satisfied, nourished by her family's healthy smiles and the dinner cooked with their own hands.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk for 30 minutes (about 3 km).

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with occasional clouds, hot and humid in the afternoon.

2025-07.daily_overview: After a brisk walk with her father in the early morning, Song Yajing harvested rosemary on the balcony to prepare ingredients for dinner. In the morning, after giving instructions to Xiaomei at the store, she took her notebook to the cultural and creative park for an industry livestream salon, where she met a hanfu shop owner and gained ideas for transformation. In the evening, she returned home and roasted potatoes with her homegrown rosemary. Her daughter ate happily, which made her feel deeply gratified. At night, she contacted relatives and friends one by one to confirm the weekend birthday party, and the busy yet orderly day ended on a warm note.

events.name: Morning brisk walk and picking rosemary on the balcony.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Song Yajing and her father brisk-walked about 3 kilometers in the community park along Hubin South Road at a pace of 8 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. Afterward, while the sun was not yet strong, she carefully cut a small bunch of rosemary sprigs from the herb corner on the balcony, saving them to add flavor to roasted potatoes in the evening.

events.name: Arrived at the shop in the morning and gave instructions to the shop assistant Xiaomei
events.description: At 9 AM, Song Yajing arrived at the Zhongshan Road shop on time. After arranging the new display, she personally explained the afternoon shop-sitting instructions to Xiaomei, including checking VIP customer Vivian's pre-paid order and updating the day's special-price labels.

events.name: Organize salon items and set off
events.description: After quickly finishing a simple meal in the back storage room of the shop at noon, Song Yajing put her notebook, spare pens, business cards, and power bank into her canvas bag, and called a ride-hailing car to go from Zhongshan Road to the Cultural and Creative Park in Siming District.

events.name: Attending a clothing industry livestream salon
events.description: From 2 pm to 4:30 pm, in the shared exhibition hall of the Cultural and Creative Park, Song Yajing listened to three local shop owners share their livestream-selling experience and noted down key points such as 'warm up with store materials before going live' and 'show fabric details.'

events.name: Proactively got to know a Hanfu store owner and exchanged WeChat contacts
events.description: As the salon wrapped up, Song Yajing proactively talked with the hanfu shop owner, praising her idea of "treating livestreaming as a shop window that never closes." The two added each other on WeChat and agreed to visit each other's shops in August.

events.name: Returned to the store and summarized the meeting takeaways
events.description: Returning to the shop at 5 p.m., Song Yajing organized her notes while the customer flow ebbed. With a red pen, she circled applicable ideas such as 'live streaming time can be after daughter falls asleep' and 'start by sharing internally with the regular customer group.'

events.name: Use balcony rosemary to roast potatoes as a dinner side dish
events.description: Got home at 6:30 pm. Song Yajing cut small potatoes into pieces, mixed them with rosemary, garlic cloves, and olive oil, and roasted them. The whole house was filled with aroma. Her daughter Chen Lexuan ate two big pieces, and she felt warm at heart watching her child's satisfied look.

events.name: In the evening, invite relatives and friends for the daughter's birthday party one by one and count the number of attendees.
events.description: After dinner, Song Yajing contacted the parents of her daughter's close friends from kindergarten, her own parents, best friends, church friends, and neighbors via WeChat and phone to confirm attendance at Sunday's party. She used tally marks in her phone memo to count the number of people so she could prepare enough food.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, Hubin South Road, Siming District
start_state.mood: Full of energy and looking forward to the new salon.

end_state.mood: Filled with a sense of fulfillment and comfort, she fell asleep looking forward to her daughter's party.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk of 3 km.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, with occasional light breeze.

2025-07.daily_overview: An ordinary Thursday became special because of the regular pick-up of Li Haoyu. In the morning, Song Yajing helped Xiaomei organize the goods in the store and replied to online customer inquiries. In the afternoon, she picked up the child from school on time on behalf of Li Meiling, who was feeling unwell. The two naturally chatted about baking and the store's recent news downstairs. The relaxed, easy conversation made the ordinary day feel warm. In the evening, her father noticed a slight decrease in her weight, which strengthened her resolve to maintain healthy habits.

events.name: After a morning brisk walk, tend to the balcony plants.
events.description: Continuing the morning workout, Song Yajing brisk-walked 3 kilometers with her father, then watered the balcony mint, basil, and jasmine and pinched back their growing tips. The mint had overgrown its pot, and she planned to take some to the shop to brew tea. Her mother praised her, saying, “You've managed the balcony better and better.”

events.name: Daily store operations and online customer replies
events.description: Arrived at the shop at 10 a.m. Song Yajing handled a regular customer's request for stock transfer, ironed summer clothes with Xiaomei, and posted recap photos of the parent-child afternoon tea in the community group, attracting new inquiries.

events.name: Pick up Li Meiling's son Li Haoyu from school in the afternoon.
events.description: At 4:30 p.m., Song Yajing drove to the kindergarten to pick up Li Haoyu. The two children exchanged cards, and she smiled as she led them to the car.

events.name: Downstairs, chatting with Li Meiling about baking tips and the store's new products
events.description: After sending Li Haoyu to the downstairs of his home, Li Meiling, her morning sickness having eased, pulled Song Yajing aside to chat about low-sugar chiffon cake recipes and the new puff-sleeve blouses that had arrived at the shop. The twenty-minute chat strengthened their friendship.

start_state.mood: Feeling refreshed after morning exercise, planning to handle shop affairs in perfect order.

end_state.mood: Relaxed and happy; the warmth brought by friendship lingered for a long time.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk of 3 km.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, turning to thundershowers in the afternoon.

2025-07.daily_overview: Today Song Yajing used mint she had grown herself to brew tea for regular customers at the store, and her attentive service drew praise from Vivian. In the afternoon, she enjoyed her monthly pottery me-time. The lopsided cup she threw and shaped on the wheel turned out to have an unexpectedly beautiful glaze. When her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home, his comment "It's more interesting than anything you could buy" made her feel that the truth of imperfection has its own power. In the evening, her husband brought out his bonus and once again suggested buying an electric scooter. She finally moved from resistance to acceptance, and the couple chose a model together online, agreeing to place the order the next day.

events.name: Morning brisk walk and harvesting fresh leaves on the balcony
events.description: In the morning, after brisk walking 3 kilometers with her father, Song Yajing picked mint leaves and chamomile covered in dew, washed them, and planned to take them to the shop.

events.name: At the shop, using newly arrived mint leaves to brew tea for customers.
events.description: After opening the store in the morning, Song Yajing made mint tea from mint leaves and served it to her regular customer Vivian. Vivian praised it as natural and refreshing, took photos and posted them on her Moments, which helped draw customers to the store.

events.name: Completed the pottery experience reservation in the morning and walked to the venue.
events.description: At 11 a.m., Song Yajing confirmed her pottery class on WeChat, turned off phone notifications, put on earphones to listen to an English podcast, and walked about 1 kilometer to the studio with an umbrella.

events.name: Pottery studio wheel-throwing experience; molded a lopsided tea cup.
events.description: At 1 p.m., after the teacher's demonstration, Song Yajing wheel-threw a clay tea cup. Her technique was rusty and it turned out lopsided, but she enjoyed the feel of the clay and kept its natural, unpolished look.

events.name: Waiting for the firing and taking some time to relax
events.description: Because the course involved rapid firing, Song Yajing rested for about 1.5 hours, flipping through home magazines and drinking chamomile tea to clear her mind.

events.name: Discovered a pleasant surprise in the glaze and brought home a slightly crooked cup
events.description: When the finished piece came out of the kiln, an unexpected kiln-transmutation glaze flowed over the warped body in irregular blue-green halos. She happily paid, wrapped it in recycled paper, and walked home.

events.name: Went home, arranged the flowers, and her husband gave heartfelt praise.
events.description: After arriving home, she put chamomile in a cup and placed it on the coffee table. When her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work and saw it, he praised it seriously, saying, "It's more interesting than store-bought." Her heart warmed.

events.name: In the evening, her husband suggested buying an electric scooter; after some discussion, they chose a model together.
events.description: After dinner, her husband showed the transfer record of his project bonus and again suggested using the bonus to buy an electric scooter for short-distance commuting. Song Yajing was initially worried about safety, but her husband calculated the costs carefully and mentioned the doctor's advice to increase physical activity, and in the end she was convinced and agreed. The couple compared several models online together, chose a white foldable anti-slip model, and agreed that her husband would place the order and pay the next day.

start_state.mood: Full of energy in the morning, looking forward to the relaxing pottery at the end of the month

end_state.mood: Wrapped in the happiness of being understood and cherished, she feels both excited and nervous about the new scooter.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk of 3 km.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny and hot, with brief local showers in the afternoon.

2025-07.daily_overview: Saturday was filled with an all-day online English speaking workshop. Song Yajing gradually loosened up from her morning stiffness; her loud read-aloud made her daughter laugh, and learning together as mother and daughter turned into an unexpected bonus. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang finished paying for the scooter online while she was in class, and the family spent another fulfilling day in a relaxed learning atmosphere.

events.name: Woke up early to preview the course and prepare the online course environment.
events.description: Before 8:00 in the morning, Song Yajing quickly ate the porridge her mother had prepared, sat down at her desk to review the notes from the first class, tested the computer camera and microphone, and encouraged her daughter to move a small chair over and sit beside her to “attend class with Mommy.”

events.name: In the morning, attended an online English workshop; her daughter sat in and was amusing.
events.description: From 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM, she attended the second class of the speaking workshop, practicing self-introductions and ordering conversations. After three weeks of reading-along practice, she gradually caught up with the speaking speed. When she read aloud, her daughter mimicked her, and the two burst into laughter.

events.name: Chen Zhiqiang completed the online payment for the scooter in the morning.
events.description: While Song Yajing was in her English class, her husband used a tablet in the room to look up scooter reviews, then directly completed the online payment for the white lightweight scooter they had selected yesterday, and sent a screenshot of the order to the family group.

events.name: Role-played an English conversation with my daughter during lunch.
events.description: At noon, the mother and daughter ate bitter melon and pork rib soup noodles and played a “restaurant ordering” game using the sentences learned in the morning. The daughter held up a toy menu and said “I want cake,” and Song Yajing gently corrected and encouraged her.

events.name: Continued learning shopping and asking-for-directions scenarios in the afternoon, with growing confidence.
events.description: From 1 PM to 5 PM, the workshop moved into the shopping and asking-directions modules. Song Yajing was no longer so nervous; she occasionally made slips of the tongue but could read the dialogue passages completely, gesturing directions in front of the camera, and lost track of time when she was engaged.

events.name: After class, organized the notes and taught them to her husband.
events.description: After the class ended, Song Yajing spent 30 minutes copying the key sentence patterns into a categorized notebook. Then she pulled over her husband, who was assembling a toy, and taught him the asking-directions sentence patterns on the spot. His halting repetition made their daughter laugh.

start_state.mood: A bit nervous, but much more relaxed thanks to her daughter's company

end_state.mood: Proud of her breakthrough in speaking English, and looking forward to the arrival of the new scooter.

state.daily_exercise: No dedicated exercise, but standing and reading along consumed quite a lot of energy.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with occasional clouds in the afternoon and high temperatures.

2025-07.daily_overview: Daughter Chen Lexuan's sixth birthday party was held successfully. Song Yajing, her husband, and her parents busily decorated from early morning, and the low-sugar strawberry cream cake she baked herself in the afternoon won everyone's praise. The children had a great time playing the "Little Designers" game, and family and friends gathered joyfully, with Chen Zhiqiang capturing each warm and lively moment. Amid the busyness, Song Yajing felt the family's cohesion and gained confidence in her event planning abilities.

events.name: Morning shopping for party food and decorations
events.description: At 8:30 AM, Song Yajing and her mother went to the supermarket and the baking supply store to buy cake flour, strawberries, cream, balloons, letter banners, and ribbons. Her mother reminded her to buy an extra pack of candles.

events.name: At noon, the whole family worked together to set up the party venue.
events.description: At 11 a.m., her father moved tables and chairs, her husband climbed a ladder to put up balloons and ribbons, and Song Yajing and her mother arranged flowers and hung a banner. The living room gradually turned into a pink fairy-tale world.

events.name: Carefully baked a low-sugar strawberry cream cake in the afternoon
events.description: At 1:30 p.m., Song Yajing tied her hair back and entered the kitchen. Following Chef Chen's recipe, she carefully whipped the egg whites and folded in the flour, baked a soft chiffon cake, let it cool, spread cream on it, layered strawberries, piped shell patterns on the surface, and placed a number 6 candle.

events.name: The sixth birthday party officially started, with family, friends, and playmates arriving
events.description: From 3 p.m. to 7 p.m., Li Meiling brought her son, Zhao Li brought her daughter, and kindergarten classmates arrived one after another. The shop assistant Xiaomei brought over Barbie dolls. The children played the 'Little Designer' game on the floor mat, gluing clothes onto paper dolls with fabric scraps. Then they sang the birthday song and cut the cake. Xuanxuan blew out the candles and smiled until her eyes curved. Chen Zhiqiang held up his camera to record the moments, while Song Minghui and Lin Xiuying helped refill drinks and pass out wet wipes.

events.name: After the party, cleaned up and tidied up with the family, and shared the leftover cake with neighbors.
events.description: At 7:30 in the evening, after the guests had gone, Song Yajing and her family put away the tableware, returned the tables and chairs to their places, and cleaned up scraps of cloth and balloons. She boxed up an intact piece of strawberry cream cake and took it next door to Aunt Zhang, who gave Xuanxuan a peace knot as a gift in return.

events.name: In the evening, reviewed party photos with her husband and shared thoughts on the event.
events.description: After their daughter fell asleep at night, Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang leaned together and looked through party photos. Pointing at a close-up of the children focused on gluing fabric, she said, "Incorporating this kind of handicraft session into the shop's parent-child afternoon tea might be nice too." Her husband agreed, and the two went on to discuss the prototype of the August event upgrade.

start_state.mood: Excited and well-organized, looking forward to everything about the party

end_state.location: On the bed in the master bedroom.
end_state.mood: Tired but fulfilled, filled with family warmth and creativity

state.daily_exercise: Moving around and standing before and after the party was sufficient activity

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with a light breeze in the evening

2025-07.daily_overview: Monday foot traffic in the store was relatively light, so Song Yajing used the free time to turn the "Little Designer" game inspiration from the birthday party into a plan, preparing to introduce it into the August parent-child afternoon tea. After closing in the evening, with her staff member Xiaomei accompanying her, she tried practicing on an electric scooter for the first time. Though she fell clumsily and scraped her knee, after persisting for 40 minutes she could already wobble along for a short stretch. What was buried in the failure was determination.

events.name: Morning brisk walk and compiling party inspiration notes
events.description: While power-walking 3 km in the morning, her father asked about the party yesterday. Song Yajing described it between breaths, and a sudden inspiration struck. When she got home, she immediately wrote down the plan “fabric handicrafts + children's T-shirt doodling” in her study notes.

events.name: Daily shop communication and online promotion
events.description: In the morning at the store, Song Yajing sent photos of the children doing crafts at the party to the VIP group and the parents' group, with the caption 'The little designers from last week's party are even more stylish than their moms.' The posts drew likes and inquiries, and she replied to each one and drafted the copy for the August parent-child craft workshop.

events.name: In the evening, she practiced riding the electric scooter for the first time, accompanied by a staff member.
events.description: After closing at 7 pm, Song Yajing, accompanied by Xiaomei, pushed the newly arrived scooters to a less crowded section of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. She put on her helmet and protective gear, and carefully stepped onto the scooter following the video her husband had recorded, her palms sweating with nervousness. At first she only slid two or three meters before losing balance and falling sideways, scraping the skin on her right knee. Xiaomei quickly helped her up. Gritting her teeth, she got up and continued. After repeated attempts, she gradually found the feeling of shifting her center of gravity. Forty minutes later, she could wobbly glide about 50 meters. Rubbing her knee, she muttered to herself, 'I'll continue tomorrow.'

start_state.mood: In good spirits, eager to turn new ideas into reality.

end_state.mood: Her knee was faintly aching, but she refused to give in and was proud of herself for taking the first step in practice.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk of 3 km, evening scooter practice for 40 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Partly sunny, with brief thunderstorms in the afternoon.

2025-07.daily_overview: Today was an important day for her daughter's health management. In the morning, Song Yajing took Xuanxuan to the community health center to get two booster vaccines. She used a picture book to comfort her crying daughter and kept her promise with tiramisu. In the evening, she still completed the last pick-up and drop-off for Li Haoyu as agreed, and the fruit tea Li Meiling gave her made their mutual-aid friendship even more precious. At night, she continued practicing the scooter and could already glide smoothly in a straight line.

events.name: In the morning, checked the vaccination materials and comforted her daughter.
events.description: Before breakfast, Song Yajing took out her daughter's vaccination record book and medical insurance card, and specially found the picture book I'm Not Afraid of Shots to read to her. Xuanxuan pouted; she patiently explained and promised tiramisu after the shot.

events.name: Taking her daughter to the community health service center for a booster vaccination
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., Chen Zhiqiang drove the mother and daughter to the community health center. After checking, family doctor Wang Mingyuan administered the diphtheria-tetanus combined vaccine and the second dose of the MMR vaccine to Xuanxuan. Xuanxuan cried loudly during the shots. Song Yajing held her tightly and flipped through a picture book to distract her, while Dr. Wang finished the injections quickly.

events.name: After vaccination, comfort her with a dessert and return home.
events.description: After observing for half an hour with no issues, Song Yajing took her daughter to a nearby dessert shop and ordered a piece of tiramisu cake and warm milk. Xuanxuan's tears turned into smiles. After eating, mother and daughter walked home hand in hand. Once home, the daughter had regained her liveliness and went to play with building blocks with her grandfather.

events.name: In the afternoon, picked up Li Haoyu as usual and said a warm goodbye to Li Meiling.
events.description: At 4:30 p.m., Song Yajing picked up Li Haoyu on time and took him home. Li Meiling's pregnancy symptoms had improved, and she handed over a pot of homemade fruit tea to thank her for this period of mutual help. Song Yajing joked, 'That's what friends are for,' and the two agreed to have afternoon tea together at the end of the month. This marked a temporary end to this special period of weekly pick-ups and drop-offs.

events.name: In the evening, continued practicing on the scooter; made clear progress in gliding in a straight line.
events.description: After closing, Song Yajing continued practicing with Xiaomei accompanying her, focusing on getting on and off the scooter and gliding in a straight line. Through her attempts the previous day, she could already slowly move forward about 100 meters without falling, but she still braked in a fluster when turning. Xiaomei kept encouraging her, and she herself felt that her body seemed to have developed muscle memory.

start_state.mood: Slightly worried about her daughter's vaccination, but well prepared

end_state.mood: Felt at ease due to the successful vaccination and the warmth of friends, and the progress on the scooter added a small sense of achievement

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk of 3 km, evening scooter practice for 40 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning partly cloudy, muggy at midday.

2025-07.daily_overview: Song Yajing focused on two things today: she made another attempt at French macarons and failed again, but unexpectedly sparked a wave of flop relay in the baking group. At the same time, she carefully sorted out her daughter's vaccination records and household registration materials for elementary school registration at the end of August. In the evening, she added turning practice to her scooter training, making slow but steady progress.

events.name: Consult a baking instructor online after the morning brisk walk.
events.description: After walking briskly for 3 km in the morning, Song Yajing took a shower and sat on the balcony to ask Master Chen via WeChat about macaron difficulties. Master Chen gave voice guidance that the drying time depends on Xiamen's humidity and suggested working in an air-conditioned room. She noted everything down in her memo.

events.name: Attempting to make macarons again in the morning
events.description: At 10 a.m., Song Yajing prepared the ingredients and, following Master Chen's guidance, worked again in the air-conditioned room. She meticulously sifted, whipped, piped the batter, and let the shells rest. Recalling that the macarons had failed last time even when resting in the air-conditioned room, she felt a bit anxious. After putting them in the oven, she kept watching, but when they came out, most macarons still hadn't developed feet, with only a few having a faint lace edge. Overall, it failed again.

events.name: Took photos of the failed creations and shared them in the baking community, triggering a chain of baking fails.
events.description: Feeling a little frustrated, Song Yajing photographed the collapsed macarons and posted them to the Mom's Baking Study Group, joking that "participation is what counts, the lace edge is just a tiny bit." After the message was sent, the moms in the group showed off their sunken cake bottoms, cracked toast, and other baking fails, making the atmosphere lively. Looking at the screen full of failed works and funny comments, she suddenly felt relieved and added with a laugh: "So we're all baking fail artists."

events.name: In the afternoon, organized my daughter's vaccination records and household registration materials for school enrollment.
events.description: After lunch break, Song Yajing took out her daughter's vaccination record book, household register, birth certificate, etc. She photographed each page with her phone and saved them to her memos, then printed two copies. She put all the originals and copies into transparent document bags and labeled them "Xuanxuan Elementary School Registration Materials". She also entered the latest vaccination records into the parenting app and sent screenshots to her parents in Quanzhou.

events.name: In the evening, made new progress practicing on the scooter, trying turning and avoiding obstacles.
events.description: After closing in the evening, Song Yajing practiced for an hour with Xiaomei keeping her company. She tried making small turns around markers in an open space. At first she turned the handlebars too sharply and nearly hit a flower bed, but gradually she found the technique by leaning with her body weight. By the end, she could smoothly circle around a water bottle. Xiaomei recorded a video and sent it to her husband; Chen Zhiqiang replied with three thumbs-up emojis.

start_state.mood: Hoping to make a breakthrough in today’s baking

end_state.mood: She had already let go of the macaron failure, and the resonance from the community strengthened her original resolve to learn baking.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk of 3 km; evening scooter practice for 1 hour.

date_attribute.weather: Clear sky for miles, with a cool breeze in the evening.

2025-07.daily_overview: Today marked the end of the regular task of picking up and dropping off Li Haoyu. Song Yajing made an appointment with Li Meiling for an afternoon tea at the end of the month. At the shop, she freed up time to continue planning the August parent-child craft workshop. In the evening, her scooter practice entered the simulated road stage, practicing stopping and starting at traffic lights on the pedestrian street, getting closer and closer to riding home alone.

events.name: After a morning brisk walk, tidied up the balcony herbs.
events.description: Song Yajing walked briskly for 3 kilometers in the early morning. After returning home, she pulled weeds from the herb pots, divided the overgrown mint into new pots, and planned to move them to the shop next week.

events.name: Last regular pickup of Li Haoyu, and arranged afternoon tea with Li Meiling.
events.description: At 4:30 p.m., Song Yajing completed the last regular pick-up/drop-off. Li Meiling handed her a box of homemade mung bean cakes and told her that her husband could resume the regular pick-ups starting next week. Song Yajing's eyes welled up slightly. The two agreed in the car to go to the newly opened tea house together for afternoon tea at the end of the month.

events.name: In the afternoon, I polished the planning proposal for the August handicraft workshop at the store.
events.description: After dropping off her child, Song Yajing returned to the store, opened her laptop at the cash register, and drafted the event time, material list, and pricing for the Little Designers · Summer Fabric Craft Workshop, then sent it via WeChat to Zhao Li and Li Meiling for feedback. The two quickly replied with practical ideas.

events.name: In the evening, I practiced long-distance gliding and simulated stopping and starting at traffic lights.
events.description: After closing, Song Yajing continued practicing with Xiaomei by her side, focusing on long-distance gliding and traffic light simulation: when seeing a hand signal, she stopped smoothly, and when the light turned green, she slowly accelerated. Although she wobbled a bit when starting, she did not fall the entire time and could glide nearly 200 meters continuously, which greatly boosted her confidence.

start_state.mood: Slightly reluctant about the farewell task, but emotionally stable.

end_state.mood: Excited about the scooter progress and confident about the August event plan.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk of 3 km; evening scooter practice for 50 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning clear, light breeze at night

2025-07.daily_overview: During the day, Song Yajing took inventory at the shop and contacted Zheng Kai to reorder popular autumn styles. In the evening, she had a deep video chat with her college best friend Zhao Min. The two middle-aged women candidly shared their feelings of helplessness and perseverance across the screen, cheering each other on late into the night. Song Yajing was deeply comforted by this understanding that transcended distance and wrote down her thoughts in her diary.

events.name: Thought about autumn merchandise combinations during a morning brisk walk
events.description: During her 3.5 km brisk walk, Song Yajing saw a young woman wearing a French tea dress and thought about the direction for autumn stocking, so she decided to contact Zheng Kai today to order additional sizes. Along the way, her father shared memories of looking at fabrics at the supply and marketing cooperative when he was young, and the two of them unconsciously extended their route.

events.name: Contacted supplier Zheng Kai during the day to place an additional order
events.description: After arriving at the store in the morning, Song Yajing reviewed the recent try-on rate data, contacted Guangzhou supplier Zheng Kai via WeChat video, and placed an additional order for 7 pieces each of French vintage-style dresses in plus size and mini size, prepaying part of the payment. Zheng Kai mentioned that there would be a small ordering fair in Hangzhou this month, and she planned to go check it out next month.

events.name: In the evening, had an in-depth video talk with college friend Zhao Min about midlife uncertainties
events.description: At 9 p.m., Song Yajing made a cup of chamomile tea, sat down, and started a video call with her close college friend Zhao Min, who was in Hangzhou. Zhao Min complained that the advertising agency was extremely cutthroat, with so much overtime that she questioned her life and wanted to quit outright. Song Yajing listened quietly, then shared her own experience from last year's off-season when she went several days without a single customer and considered closing the shop. The two found that their feelings of helplessness were strikingly similar. The half-hour call lasted an hour and a half. Before hanging up, Zhao Min said, 'Tonight I feel understood.' Song Yajing nodded again and again.

events.name: Late at night, wrote in her diary, recording the warmth of friendship.
events.description: After hanging up the video call, it was almost 11 o'clock. Song Yajing opened her diary and wrote: “Friendship does not require meeting often, but it is still warm when we are on the same wavelength. Minmin's struggle let me see my former self, and also made me cherish the little shop and the lights beside me even more.” She set down her pen and looked out the window, feeling quiet and full inside.

start_state.mood: Focused, with strong planning sense.

end_state.mood: The relaxed feeling after being deeply understood, with a soft heart

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk, 3.5 kilometers

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, cool breeze in the evening.

2025-07.daily_overview: The weekend store business was a bit busy, but Song Yajing was thinking about the evening challenge all day. After closing, she took a deep breath, put on her helmet, and finally rode the electric scooter alone along the planned route for 3 kilometers smoothly back home, without a single fall along the way. The moment she arrived, her eyes glistened. She joked in the family and friends group, 'Learned a new skill at the age of 38!', and received a screen full of congratulations. Her husband even quietly put reflective strips on the scooter.

events.name: Morning store reception and parent-child afternoon tea review.
events.description: After the store opened in the morning, several regular customers came to pick summer clothes, and Song Yajing styled them personally. During a break, she sent private messages to participants of last week's parent-child afternoon tea to ask for feedback, and compiled improvement points such as adding children's safety straps and simplifying the flower arrangement steps.

events.name: In the afternoon, plan the solo evening cycling route.
events.description: In the afternoon, while her daughter was napping, Song Yajing repeatedly checked the route on her phone map from the latter part of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to her home on Hubin South Road. She deliberately chose the Wenyuan Road-Hubin Erli section, which has less traffic and a continuous non-motorized lane, took a screenshot and sent it to her husband to keep him informed, and put a power bank and keys into her waist pack.

events.name: Riding the electric scooter home alone for the first time after closing in the evening
events.description: At 7 p.m., Xiaomei helped her push the scooter to a flat area. Song Yajing put on her helmet and protective gear, took a deep breath, mounted the scooter, and twisted the throttle to start off smoothly. She rode slowly along the planned route, releasing the throttle and coasting before red lights, and at intersections she watched vehicles on both sides before starting again. The three-kilometer ride took about twenty minutes. When the neighborhood gate came into view, she was so excited she almost honked the horn. She stopped at the building entrance, took off her helmet, and grinned even though her bangs were soaked with sweat.

events.name: After arriving home, shared the joy of learning a new skill in the family and friends group chat.
events.description: After going upstairs, Song Yajing sat in the entryway, took a selfie wearing the helmet, and posted it to the family and friends group with the caption "Learned a new skill at 38 years old! Thanks to my husband for the technical guidance and my family for waiting patiently~" The group instantly became lively. Li Meiling sent a string of firecracker emojis. Her father called and said "My daughter's really got guts!" and her sister, far away in Shenzhen, left a message: "Next time I go back, you can take me for a ride."

events.name: The husband secretly added reflective strips to the scooter for extra safety.
events.description: In the evening, her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work, grinning and holding a roll of yellow reflective stickers. He crouched in front of the scooter, gesturing, and said, 'All the logistics drivers' vehicles have these on them; they're really eye-catching.' Song Yajing watched her husband's earnest back, her eyes growing warm. She took a photo and sent it to the family group chat with the caption 'My personal safety advisor.'

start_state.mood: Elation mixed with the nervousness of facing a challenge.

end_state.mood: An immense sense of accomplishment interwoven with happiness, feeling as if she could do anything.

state.daily_exercise: In the evening, rode a kick scooter about 3 kilometers.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning clear, with afternoon sunlight streaming through the stained glass windows of the church.

2025-07.daily_overview: On Sunday morning, Song Yajing went with her husband, daughter, and parents to Siming Catholic Church for Sunday Mass, quietly receiving the Eucharist amid hymns. After Mass, she happened to meet Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow parishioner, and the warm greetings made her deeply feel the unity of the faith community. After returning home, while her parents were preparing Minnan home-style dishes in the kitchen, she sorted through photos from last week's activities, setting a warm backdrop for the half-day family time ahead.

events.name: In the morning, walked with family to church to attend Sunday Mass
events.description: At 8:30 in the morning, Song Yajing's family of five, neatly dressed, walked to Siming Catholic Church. Holding Xuanxuan's hand under the shade of trees, with her mother wearing a veil and linking arms with her father, the family made a warm picture in the eyes of the neighbors.

events.name: Participating in Mass and receiving the Eucharist, gaining insight into faith in daily life
events.description: From 9:00 to 10:15 a.m., Father Wang Mingde presided over Mass, and the homily centered on “finding the presence of the Holy Spirit in the busyness of daily life.” Song Yajing knelt before the pew with her eyes closed in prayer, giving thanks one by one for her parents' health, her husband's work, her daughter's schooling, and the shop's operation. She felt especially peaceful when receiving Communion.

events.name: After Mass, caught up with fellow parishioner Aunt Lin Xiuying about recent news.
events.description: After Mass ended, Song Yajing met Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow church member, at the church entrance. Aunt Lin kindly asked how her parents were adjusting, shared advice on keeping the elderly cool in summer and eating a light diet, and reminded her to cook mung bean and barley soup often. Song Yajing smiled and took note, touched by the sincere care of the faith community.

events.name: Passed by the fresh market on the way home and bought seafood
events.description: On the way home on foot, her mother suggested turning into the Hubin vegetable market along the way.
