Song Yajing accompanied her father in picking out lively sea shrimp and small yellow croaker, planning to make her father's signature soy-sauce-braised mixed fish for lunch. The market was bustling with voices, and the family chatted and laughed, extending the weekend ritual into everyday life.

events.name: Afternoon family meal and organizing photos
events.description: At noon, her mother was the head cook and served home-style Minnan dishes. The whole family sat together, and Song Yajing took the opportunity to show her parents the scooter selfie from the previous day. Her father gave a thumbs-up while picking up food with his chopsticks. After the meal, she leaned back on the sofa, using her phone to organize this week's activity photos, and picked out a few to post on Moments the next morning to recap Xuanxuan's birthday and the scooter breakthrough, with a draft caption turning over in her mind.

start_state.mood: With Sunday's characteristic calm, prepare to bathe in the sacred atmosphere.

end_state.mood: Feeling spiritually fulfilled, the warmth from family interactions lingered.

state.daily_exercise: Walked to the church and the vegetable market and back, about 6000 steps

date_attribute.weather: Sunny and hot, with summer cicadas chirping

2025-07.daily_overview: On a summer Monday, Song Yajing went out early to buy fresh mint to ensure the store's drink supply. Later, she received a sincere thank-you message from Li Meiling and replied humorously, deepening their friendship. In the evening, she shopped online for a phone mount and a basket for her scooter, adding convenience to her commute. When her husband came home from work, he brought a reflective bike bell he had installed himself. Small things, full of family support.

events.name: In the morning, went to the farmers market to buy fresh mint leaves and fruit.
events.description: After a brisk 3-kilometer walk in the morning, Song Yajing rode her bike alone to the farmers' market. She picked two bunches of fresh local mint leaves and a few lemons to keep the store's mint tea in supply. She also bought a small basket of longan and mangosteen as a treat for her parents.

events.name: In the morning, received a formal thank-you from Li Meiling on WeChat, taking their friendship to a new level.
events.description: In the morning, while arranging mint in the store, her phone vibrated with a long message from Li Meiling, sincerely thanking Song Yajing for helping with rides over several consecutive weeks, saying it was the warmest support during the most fragile period of her pregnancy. Song Yajing's eyes grew slightly moist, and she typed in reply: 'Friends are meant to be troubled. When I first opened my shop, you also helped me hand out flyers until midnight, so we're even~' Their friendship grew stronger through mutual support.

events.name: In the afternoon, the shop assistant shared customer praise, and the store atmosphere was light and cheerful.
events.description: In the afternoon, Xiaomei excitedly held up her phone to show Song Yajing a five-star review on Dianping, praising the store's clothes for their texture and the mint tea for being light and sweet. Song Yajing took the opportunity to suggest turning the "free mint tea" into the shop's signature service, and decided to change the herbal tea variety every week.

events.name: In the evening, shopping for a phone mount and a basket for the scooter.
events.description: In the evening, after her daughter was asleep, Song Yajing opened an e-commerce platform and compared several phone mounts and front baskets made for electric scooters. She chose a waterproof, shockproof mount and a detachable canvas basket, making it convenient for future commutes to check navigation or carry light goods. After ordering, she took a screenshot and sent it to her husband to check the dimensions.

start_state.mood: Full of energy, planning to build a smooth Monday from small tasks.

end_state.mood: Be grateful, and give a thumbs-up to long-lasting friendship and family.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk of 3 km.

date_attribute.weather: There were fiery sunset clouds in the evening, and a gentle summer breeze blew

2025-07.daily_overview: Song Yajing has become more and more skilled at riding her electric scooter. In the evening, she deliberately rode to the nearby park greenway, gliding freely in the twilight, turning it from a commuting tool into a summer night treat. She began using a bunch of chamomile to adorn the shop window, keeping the overall pace relaxed yet orderly.

events.name: In the morning, used chamomile to decorate the store's display window
events.description: After arriving at the shop in the morning, Song Yajing cut a few chamomile flowers that were in full bloom from the balcony of her home, tied them into a small bundle with thin twine, and hung them on the wrist of the mannequin in the shop window. This fresh, natural little detail made passing women stop to take photos. Satisfied, she took a photo and uploaded it to the shop's community group.

events.name: In the afternoon, finalized the itinerary details for the Hangzhou ordering fair with Zheng Kai.
events.description: In the afternoon, she confirmed the specific schedule and exhibitor list for the mid-August Hangzhou ordering fair with supplier Zheng Kai via WeChat, and the two initially planned to stay at the same hotel for convenient communication. Song Yajing marked it on her calendar and thought that if time allowed, she could make a side trip to Shaoxing to visit her college roommate Zhou Ting.

events.name: In the evening, rode an electric scooter to a nearby park to enjoy the summer night.
events.description: After dinner, as the sun set, Song Yajing put on her helmet and rode her scooter slowly along Hubin South Road to the greenway in Bailuzhou Park. The cool evening breeze brushed her face as she glided easily along the lakeside path, occasionally getting off to walk and watch the square-dancing crowd and playing children, enjoying her own lighthearted freedom. After an hour of riding, she returned home with slightly tousled hair, and her husband laughed that she looked like a school kid who had just gotten out of class.

start_state.mood: Calm and orderly; planning to integrate the scooter into daily life

end_state.mood: Enjoy the joy of exercising alone, and love this city's summer nights even more

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk of 3 km, evening leisure scooter ride of 1 hour

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, sultry in the afternoon, with showers brewing for the evening.

2025-07.daily_overview: Month-end settlement day. After closing, Song Yajing carefully calculated July revenue. Thanks to the parent-child activities, revenue had grown by about 15%. She transferred part of the profit into the family emergency reserve fund and set aside her daughter's autumn tuition. Her husband also transferred his project bonus at the same time, and the couple shared their financial progress in the family group chat. The sense of security they built together shone brightly behind the numbers. Her mother began packing her luggage for the return to Quanzhou, and reluctance filled the air.

events.name: Discussed savings plans with Father during a morning brisk walk.
events.description: During the 3-kilometer brisk walk in the morning, her father brought up how they saved money when they were young and encouraged Song Yajing to keep up her sound financial habits. She linked her arm through his and confided that she wanted to divide the monthly surplus into three parts: shop reinvestment, family savings, and support for her parents. Her father nodded with satisfaction.

events.name: Daytime wrap-up communication for the last few parent-child afternoon tea sessions at the shop.
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing processed the confirmation of spots for the last parent-child afternoon tea of July at the shop, and posted to the community group a preview that the "Little Designer" activity would be launched in August. Several mothers immediately sent private messages to reserve seats. As she noted them down, she felt the attempt at the summer vacation slot was truly on the right track.

events.name: In the evening, she tallied up July's entire revenue by herself and allocated the funds.
events.description: After the store closed, Song Yajing sat behind the cash register and used the computer to check the sales transactions, online payments, and return/exchange records one by one, confirming that July revenue increased by about 15% compared with June. She transferred 20% of the net profit (about 3,200 yuan) into the family emergency fund, reserved about 6,000 yuan for next quarter's merchandise costs, and set aside a pending transfer specifically labeled Xuanxuan's Autumn Tuition. After sorting out all the numbers in the account book, she let out a long sigh of relief.

events.name: Synced finances with her husband and added his bonus to the joint account
events.description: Song Yajing sent the revenue and distribution screenshots to the three-person family group. After seeing them, Chen Zhiqiang immediately transferred the remaining 8,000 yuan of this month's project bonus to the couple's joint account via mobile banking and sent a voice message: "Your business is getting more and more stable, so our little coffer is getting fuller too." After receiving the bank notification and checking the balance, she replied with a hug emoji.

events.name: Before going to sleep, my mother mentioned that she would leave the handwritten recipe book to her daughter.
events.description: At night while tidying the tea table, her mother, Lin Xiuying, took out a yellowed notebook page on which she had copied out several Minnan summer dishes for dispelling dampness, including Poria cake, Four Spirits lean pork soup, and bitter melon, soybean, and pork rib soup. She placed the paper in Song Yajing's hand and urged her to keep making soup in autumn too. Song Yajing looked down at her mother's flowing handwriting, felt a lump in her throat, and gently hugged her mother's shoulders.

start_state.mood: Stay rational and calm, and prepare to draw the curtain on July’s operations.

end_state.mood: A sense of security from financial stability, mixed with a faint reluctance to see her parents soon return to Quanzhou.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk of 3 km.

date_attribute.weather: Turning overcast, with intermittent moderate rain from the afternoon onward

2025-07.daily_overview: On the last full day of summer vacation, Song Yajing helped her parents pack. Her mother carefully placed a handwritten recipe book into her kitchen drawer and took back the local specialties given by her close friends. In the afternoon, she took her daughter to see her parents off at the station, waving goodbye to her father in the drizzle. On the way back, she rode a scooter slowly through the wet lanes while holding an umbrella, already planning her August trip to visit her family.

events.name: Early morning solo brisk walk, the last morning workout before her parents left.
events.description: At 6:25 in the morning, Song Yajing woke up naturally and saw that her father was already up, so she invited him to join her for the final 3-kilometer brisk walk around the Hubin South Road community park. The father and daughter slowed their pace and talked along the way about the courtyard at their old home in Quanzhou and childhood memories. When they got home, sweat was beaded on her forehead. Her father gently patted her shoulder and said, “From now on, keep up the walking by yourself in Xiamen too.”

events.name: In the morning, helped her mother pack her luggage for returning to their hometown
events.description: After breakfast, Song Yajing and her mother opened a suitcase in the guest room and packed spare clothes, her father's usual blood pressure medication, and a few boxes of Xiamen specialty pastries. She secretly slipped two red envelopes and a card into her mother's handbag, on which she had written: "Mom and Dad, you've worked hard. In the autumn we'll come back to Quanzhou and stay for a few days."

events.name: Mother officially placed the handwritten recipe book into the kitchen drawer
events.description: Before leaving, mother Lin Xiuying pulled Song Yajing into the kitchen, pointed to the recipe pages she had flattened with a paperweight in the drawer, and urged her, "When making Poria cake, remember to strain the rice milk three times to make it smooth." Song Yajing nodded vigorously, reached out to hug her mother, and buried her face in her graying temples for a few seconds.

events.name: At noon, the whole family had a farewell lunch together
events.description: At noon, Song Yajing cooked personally, using the recipe her mother had just taught her to make bitter melon pork rib soup, and also stir-fried her father's favorite oyster omelet. At the dinner table, the family agreed that Song Yajing would take Xuanxuan back to her hometown in Quanzhou for a week during the National Day holiday. Her father took a sip of the soup and said with a smile, “Much better than your mother's first attempt.” Her mother feigned anger and lightly patted his arm, and the whole table burst into laughter.

events.name: In the afternoon, saw parents off at the station, waving goodbye in the rain.
events.description: At 2 p.m., a fine rain began to fall. Chen Zhiqiang drove his parents-in-law to Xiamen Railway Station. At the station entrance, Xuanxuan hugged her grandmother's leg, her eyes reddened. Song Minghui patted his granddaughter's head and promised to take her to see Laojun Rock at Qingyuan Mountain next time. Song Yajing watched her parents swipe their ID cards and pass through the gate, and waved in the rain for a while, until her father's figure disappeared.

events.name: After returning, quietly tidied the house and drafted a to-do list for August.
events.description: After returning home, the rain got heavier. Song Yajing asked her husband to accompany their daughter for a nap, while she changed and washed the sheets in her parents' room, which kept a faint scent of floral water. Then she sat in the study and listed the August priorities: the first parent-child craft workshop on August 5, confirming the itinerary for the Hangzhou order fair, accompanying her husband to have his teeth rechecked, and scheduling her own health checkup. After writing, she looked at the rain outside the window, feeling calm and focused.

events.name: In the evening, rode a scooter to the shop to pick up a forgotten folder, then returned early and slept peacefully.
events.description: In the evening after the rain stopped, Song Yajing rode her scooter carefully along the wet road to the shop, retrieved the forgotten August event materials checklist, and took a photo at the shop entrance of the scooter with the neon lights and sent it to her husband—commemorating the little wheels still turning on the last day of July. After returning home, she felt a little tired, was grateful for the precious company of her parents, and was full of anticipation for the new month. She finished washing up at 22:40 and fell asleep peacefully to the sound of rain.

start_state.mood: The sadness of parting is faint, like the fragrance of tea, yet I calmly accept the separation.

end_state.mood: Grateful for the precious company of my parents, and full of plans and expectations for the new month

2025-05.daily_overview: The Labor Day promotion was an important real-world test of Song Yajing's delegated management. After getting up in the morning, she completed the monthly education savings transfer and reserved funds for physical exams and physical therapy through mobile banking. Then, following her doctor's advice, she only went to the store in the morning to oversee the promotion, handing the core independent operation responsibilities to Xiaomei. In the morning, she forced herself to stay focused and provide on-site guidance. After confirming the promotional display and contingency plans, she went home to rest before noon. In the afternoon, Xiaomei took the lead independently for the first time. Because of nervousness, she called three times for help. Song Yajing guided her remotely from home, and the final sales reached 80 percent of a normal day, proving the feasibility of delegation. In the evening, she returned to the store to check the accounts and began preparing for activities during her recovery period. She took out the long-unused cross-stitch and a Bible from the storage room. That day marked a turning point for her: from being forced to let go during the health crisis in April to actively validating her team's capabilities.

events.name: In the early morning, completed the monthly savings transfer and set aside the health reserve fund
events.description: After waking up early in the morning, Song Yajing used mobile banking in the bedroom to set up an automatic monthly education savings transfer of 2,000 yuan for May, and separately set aside 1,500 yuan from the month's shop revenue into a dedicated account for her scheduled physical exam on May 12 and follow-up physiotherapy costs. She briefly recorded the two payments in her ledger, let out a small sigh of relief, and felt that her financial arrangements were gradually returning to a manageable rhythm.

events.name: Went to the store in the morning to check the Labor Day promotion and gave Xiaomei on-site guidance.
events.description: In the early morning, she walked to the Zhongshan Road shop. Although it was Labor Day, she only went to the shop in the morning on the doctor's advice. She carefully checked whether the promotional displays were neat and whether the discount labels were correctly pasted. She noticed that the discount sign on the promotional cart at the door had been blown askew by the wind, and immediately asked Xiao Mei to fix it. Then she gathered Xiao Mei for a brief on-site training, demonstrating how to introduce the styling tips for the new French floral dresses to customers, and told her to call her immediately if any unexpected situations occurred, such as inventory queries or system cash register failures, and not to tough it out alone. At around 11 o'clock, after confirming everything was normal, she left the shop with peace of mind and walked home to rest.

events.name: In the afternoon, remotely guided Xiaomei from home on independent store operations.
events.description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing followed the doctor's advice and took a nap in the bedroom at home, setting her phone ringtone to maximum volume and placing it by the bedside. Xiaomei ran the promotional event independently at the store. She was a bit flustered, but she called for help three times because customers were bargaining too hard, because she had to check the remaining stock of a certain sun-protection jacket in the backend, and because the checkout system froze briefly in the evening. On the phone, Song Yajing reassured her one by one and gave clear instructions: after asking how much the customer wanted to cut off, she suggested Xiaomei offer appropriate matching gifts instead of a direct discount; check inventory quickly through a screenshot of the inventory management page; and guide Xiaomei to exit and restart the checkout system program. With remote support, Xiaomei solved the problems smoothly, and the day's total sales reached 80% of a regular day.

events.name: Returned to the store in the evening to check the promotional accounts and confirm the feasibility of delegating authority
events.description: Around 7:30 p.m., Song Yajing put on a light jacket and walked alone back to the shop on Zhongshan Road. Together with Xiaomei, she compared the cash register system records with the cash flow, checking one by one the discounts, actual amounts received, and membership points registration for each promotional transaction, confirming that the day's transaction volume reached 80% of a typical day and the loss rate of promotional goods was lower than expected. She looked up at Xiaomei's forehead dampened with fine sweat and said, “You did better than I expected.” For the first time, she truly realized the feasibility of delegating authority, which strengthened her confidence in future team building.

events.name: Find the cross-stitch and Bible from the storage room to prepare for the recuperation period
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Song Yajing took out a dusty canvas bag from the storage space on top of the bedroom wardrobe. Inside were her cross-stitch tool kit, several rolls of unused embroidery thread, and a half-finished pattern draft, all set aside during her pregnancy. She gently patted off the dust, then went to the living room bookshelf and took out the Bible that had been left unused for a long time. She placed both items neatly on the small table by the bedside cabinet in the bedroom, arranging low-effort but soothing handicraft and devotional activities for her recovery period.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Feeling slightly tense, but determined to delegate and observe today.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: Reassured, having confirmed for the first time the feasible scope for Xiaomei to undertake independent operations.

2025-05.daily_overview: On the second day after the Labor Day promotion ended, Song Yajing settled into a formal routine of home recovery. In the morning she had a brief wrap-up meeting with Xiaomei, praising her performance while candidly discussing existing problems, gaining experience for similar independent operations in the future. In the afternoon she began organizing her cross-stitch tools and patterns, and tried to calm herself down for her first home spiritual devotion. In the evening, her husband Chen Zhiqiang purposely came home early, bringing a bouquet of elegant carnations to comfort her, and the family of three quietly enjoyed dinner together. That day marked the initial transition from crisis-response mode to a regular life of recovery.

events.name: Had a promotion summary and improvement meeting with Xiaomei.
events.description: Around 9:30 the morning after the promotional event ended, Song Yajing held a brief review meeting via WeChat video call from home with Xiaomei, who was tidying up the shop. She first praised Xiaomei's ability to independently handle bargaining and cash register malfunctions, then frankly pointed out issues such as the slow adjustment of the promotional displays in the morning and the careless counting of the cash float during the evening handover. After discussion, the two decided that for similar independent operation days in the future, they would do a trial run of the cash register system one day in advance and prepare a small card with answers to common questions to keep at the cash register.

events.name: Organize cross-stitch tools and draw a simple pattern draft
events.description: The afternoon sunlight slanted in through the living room window. Song Yajing took out the cross-stitch kit from the canvas bag she had unpacked the night before and spread the fabric and threads on the coffee table in front of the sofa. She found a simple floral pattern draft she had drawn a few years ago and thought she could add a Bible verse to it. She lightly revised the draft with a pencil, deciding to embroider a piece with an olive branch and the word 'Faith' — arranging a handicraft task for her recovery period that required patience but was not urgent.

events.name: First solo scripture reading at home after the lunch break.
events.description: When she woke up from her nap at around 1:30 p.m., Song Yajing made a cup of warm honey water, sat down at the small table by the head of the bedroom bed, and opened the Bible that had been set aside for a long time. She turned to the passage in Romans about endurance and hope and slowly read a few pages in silence. Although her thoughts kept drifting back to the store from time to time, she forced herself to take a few deep breaths and managed to read for about half an hour. After finishing, she closed the book and wrote a brief reflection in her phone memo: 'Learn to rest first, and then you will have the strength to continue.'

events.name: In the evening, her husband brought home flowers and shared a simple dinner with the family.
events.description: At 5:30 p.m., her husband Chen Zhiqiang left work early and deliberately stopped by a flower shop to buy a bouquet of light pink carnations for Song Yajing, softly saying “You’ve worked hard lately.” Their daughter Chen Lexuan sat at the dining table holding a paper-folding craft she had just learned in kindergarten to show them. For the first time in a long while, the family of three sat together and ate quietly on a weekday evening, without the pressure of holiday promotions or the ringing of the shop’s cash register. Watching her daughter act coquettishly, Song Yajing felt that today’s rest felt more real than yesterday’s.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: A bit tired but stable, looking forward to resting at home

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: Calm, beginning to adapt to the slower pace of family life.

2025-05.daily_overview: Saturday was the day her daughter Chen Lexuan didn't have to go to kindergarten. While recuperating, Song Yajing tried to find relaxation in personal pleasures she had long put aside. In the morning, she took out a Yi Shu novel and flipped through a few pages, but put it back on the shelf because she felt uneasy; in the afternoon, she played and drew with her daughter in the living room, focusing on her child's laughter to fight anxiety. In the evening, Chen Zhiqiang took their daughter to run around in the community garden, and Song Yajing stayed home alone and began the first stitch of her cross-stitch. She also found time to video-call her mother in Quanzhou, chatting about family matters and the recent situation of the shop. Hearing her mother's hearty laughter, her mood relaxed a little. She gradually acknowledged that she was temporarily unable to calm herself down enough for deep reading.

events.name: Tried to read a novel by Yi Shu, but put it back because her mood was unsettled.
events.description: In the morning, while her daughter was reading picture books in the living room, Song Yajing took a Yi Shu novel from the bookshelf that had been set aside for a long time. She curled up on the sofa and opened it, but after reading three or four pages, she found it hard to calm her mind—thoughts of the small mistakes from the previous day's promotion and next week's purchasing decisions kept surfacing. She gently closed the book, did not force herself to keep reading, and decided to put it back on the shelf, telling herself to settle her emotions before attempting to read.

events.name: Doing crafts and doodling in the living room with her daughter.
events.description: In the afternoon, her daughter Chen Lexuan tugged Song Yajing's hand and wanted to draw together. She simply sat with her daughter on the living room floor mat and took out colored pencils and paper. Her daughter drew the family of three and an imaginary puppy, while Song Yajing casually doodled a few simple flowers. Xuanxuan asked her, “Mommy, why don't your flowers have smiling faces?” She suddenly realized that she had forgotten to give the flowers expressions, and amid her daughter's laughter, she added a curved smile to them.

events.name: Video call with her mother in Quanzhou to share daily life
events.description: After waking from her nap, Song Yajing missed her parents and initiated a WeChat video call. Her mother Lin Xiuying was watering flowers on the balcony. Hearing her daughter's voice, she quickly put down the watering can and asked about everything with a smile. Song Yajing briefly told her about the May Day promotion situation at Xiaomeiding, and her mother reassured her, 'Take it slow, health comes first.' The short call made her feel more at ease.

events.name: In the evening, made the first stitch of cross-stitch
events.description: In the early evening, her husband took their daughter to the community garden downstairs to run around and burn off energy. Song Yajing sat alone on the sofa and took out the cross-stitch tools she had already organized. Under the lamp, she followed the revised pattern draft and placed the first stitch of the olive branch outline on the upper left of the embroidery fabric. Her movements were clumsy and slow, but in her concentration her anxiety was unexpectedly diverted. She stitched for about twenty minutes straight before looking up to rest.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Felt slightly restless; made a conscious effort to adjust but did not fully relax.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: Slightly regretful (unable to immerse in reading), but accepting the present moment, and somewhat comforted by the phone call with her mother.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Song Yajing's 35th birthday, life laid out a series of warm emotional rituals for her. In the morning, she went alone to Siming Catholic Church to attend Sunday Mass, praying amid the solemn hymns and giving thanks for the protection through the hardships of the past year. After Mass, she briefly shared the joy of her birthday with Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow parishioner. When she came home in the afternoon, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had secretly joined forces with Zhao Min, Xiaomei, and Li Meiling to decorate the house with balloons and a cake. The moment her daughter Chen Lexuan held up a hand-drawn card and shouted "Happy birthday, Mom!" moved her to tears. In the evening, she video-called her parents in Quanzhou and received a necklace gift box sent by her older sister Song Yawen from Shenzhen. It was the first time in years that her birthday had been celebrated with such care, and the help of her good friends and the deep love of her family became the most precious emotional memory of May.

events.name: In the morning, she went to Siming Catholic Church to attend Sunday Mass.
events.description: Sunday, May 4, was also her 35th birthday. Song Yajing put on a light blue dress and walked alone to Siming Catholic Church to attend the morning Sunday Mass. As the choir sang hymns, she knelt before her seat, giving thanks for the health crisis and store challenges she had experienced over the past year, and prayed for a calm heart and wise management in the new year of her life. After Mass, she briefly chatted with Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow parishioner, outside the church. The aunt smiled, patted her hand, wished her a happy birthday, and urged her to rest well.

events.name: Husband Chen Zhiqiang secretly contacted relatives and friends to arrange a birthday surprise.
events.description: While Song Yajing was out at church, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already secretly hidden balloons and ribbons at home the night before, and privately contacted her best friend Zhao Min, shop assistant Xiaomei, and childhood friend Li Meiling via WeChat. The four of them agreed to arrive at Song Yajing's home one after another in the morning, decorating the living room with pink balloons and ribbons. A tiramisu cake was hidden by the refrigerator, and their daughter Xuanxuan wrote 'Happy Birthday, Mom' on a hand-drawn greeting card.

events.name: Returning home, pushing open the door, she found a birthday surprise and was moved to tears.
events.description: After attending Mass, Song Yajing returned home to rest as planned. The moment she opened the door, she saw balloons floating everywhere and a cake on the table, and her husband, daughter, and friends shouted "Happy Birthday" in unison. Her daughter Chen Lexuan rushed forward holding up a hand-drawn card with a crooked drawing of a mother and daughter holding hands, shouting "Happy Birthday, Mom!" Song Yajing squatted down and hugged her daughter, unable to hold back tears. She noticed that on one of the balloons, her husband had written in black marker "You're not carrying this alone." She realized that this birthday surprise had been secretly planned with great effort by her family and friends.

events.name: Video-called her parents in Quanzhou to share the birthday surprise
events.description: At around 8 pm, Song Yajing connected with her parents Song Minghui and Lin Xiuying, who live in Quanzhou, via a WeChat video call. She turned the phone camera to the balloons still floating in the living room and the cake box on the table, and described the afternoon surprise scene in detail to her parents. Her father smiled with great relief, while her mother's eyes were slightly red, and she urged her to take good care of her health in the year ahead.

events.name: Opened the necklace her elder sister sent from Shenzhen and thanked her.
events.description: Before ending the video call in the evening, Song Yajing tore open a parcel from Shenzhen. Inside was an exquisite necklace gift box sent by her older sister Song Yawen. A small olive leaf pendant hung from the delicate silver chain. She put it on right away and sent a voice message of thanks to her sister via WeChat: “Sis, I really like the necklace. Take good care of yourself too.”

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
start_state.mood: Calm, with a faint expectation for her birthday.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: Deeply moved, the warmth of being surrounded by family and friends filled my heart.

2025-05.daily_overview: On the Monday after the holiday, Song Yajing began preparing for a detailed discussion with bank account manager Lin Xiaofeng in early May about a critical illness insurance application. At home, she organized the materials needed for insurance, including personal identification, proof of income, and health disclosure, checking each page to ensure they were complete. In the afternoon, she spent time analyzing the store's April sales data and recent foot traffic changes, preparing for subsequent operational adjustments with Xiaomei. While sorting through the materials, she happened to come across travel photos with her husband from a few years ago, stirring a longing for overseas travel, but she was quickly pulled back by a sense of real-world responsibility. It rained in the evening, so she canceled her planned short walk and continued doing cross-stitch at home. This day was a stabilizing day during her recovery period, with necessary tasks mixed in.

events.name: Organize the materials needed for applying for insurance to prepare for a detailed discussion about critical illness insurance.
events.description: According to the advice of ICBC relationship manager Lin Xiaofeng, Song Yajing used her recuperation time at home to prepare the materials needed for the insurance application. She took her ID card copy, shop business license copy, bank statements for the shop and personal accounts over the past six months, and proof of income out of the document folder in her bedroom and placed them in a clear document folder. She also looked through her phone for the preliminary physical examination indicator screenshots she had recently taken, as preparatory material for health disclosure. After everything was organized, she confirmed the May 6 meeting time with Lin Xiaofeng on WeChat, and noticed that she had received a brief comparison of several critical illness insurance terms sent by Manager Lin.

events.name: In the afternoon, she reviewed a brief overview of the shop's April sales and customer flow.
events.description: In the afternoon, while her daughter was still at kindergarten, Song Yajing opened her laptop on the living room coffee table, logged into the store's management backend, and exported April sales data into a spreadsheet. As she checked the changes in the average daily number of transactions and average order value during the April promotion period, she also jotted down a few issues in her notebook: the point when customer traffic drops after the May Day promotion, and the gap period before new summer styles are put on the shelves. She planned to bring these observations to Xiao Mei for a debrief on her next visit to the store.

events.name: Looking through old photos brought back memories of family trips.
events.description: While sorting through files, Song Yajing found a yellowed photo album in a drawer, containing photos of the family of three on a trip to Gulangyu in 2018. Looking at her daughter's innocent smiling face and her own relaxed expression at the time, she could not help thinking of the 'family overseas trip' plan that had been written on her vision board for three years. She sighed softly, then silently put the album away and told herself to first take care of the health and work matters in front of her.

events.name: The evening shower canceled the walk, so I stayed home and did cross-stitch instead.
events.description: In the evening, she had originally planned to go for a walk along Hubin South Road, but after the sky turned gloomy, a light rain began to fall, leaving the road too wet for a walk. Song Yajing did not force herself to go out. Instead, she sat in the living room under the light and continued her cross-stitch of an olive branch pattern. Today she finished the second leaf, and her originally restless finger movements gradually became calm.

start_state.mood: Steady, sober alertness with a slight sense of responsibility

2025-05.daily_overview: Today, Song Yajing focused on the insurance application. In the morning, she went to the ICBC Siming Sub-branch again for a face-to-face discussion with the client manager Lin Xiaofeng. Manager Lin patiently explained the terms, coverage, and annual premiums of several critical illness insurance plans suitable for her. After careful comparison, Song Yajing leaned toward choosing a combined product that covered breast hyperplasia-related protection. After carefully confirming the disclosure terms and the waiting period, she finally signed the insurance intent form at the sub-branch. At the bank, she ran into her neighbor, Aunt Zhang Xiuying, who was there on business. They exchanged a few pleasantries, and Aunt Zhang said she looked better than last week. After returning home that day, she sat on the living room sofa and let out a long sigh, feeling that she had added a solid layer of protection to her family's risks.

events.name: Went to the bank to discuss the critical illness insurance terms with Lin Xiaofeng in detail.
events.description: At the agreed time of 10 a.m., Song Yajing brought the organized document folder and went again to the ICBC Siming Sub-branch. In the wealth management room, Lin Xiaofeng opened his computer and showed her a comparison of three critical illness insurance products suitable for self-employed individuals, one of which specifically covered mild illness protection related to breast hyperplasia. Song Yajing asked questions one by one about premiums, waiting periods, renewal conditions, and restrictions related to breast hyperplasia. Manager Lin took out the printed terms, circled key clauses with a pen, and explained them one by one. Song Yajing listened while taking notes in her notebook.

events.name: Ran into neighbor Aunt Zhang Xiuying at the bank
events.description: While waiting for her transaction, Song Yajing saw her neighbor Aunt Zhang Xiuying in the bank lobby. Aunt Zhang was holding a passbook at the counter. When she turned and recognized Song Yajing, she immediately came over, took her hand, looked her over carefully, and said, "You're looking much better than before; you should rest more." The two chatted about family matters for a few minutes, and Aunt Zhang warmly invited her to come by and try some freshly made mung bean cakes.

events.name: Sign the insurance intent form and confirm the submission process for health checkup materials.
events.description: After careful discussion for about forty minutes, Song Yajing decided to choose the critical illness insurance plan that covers mild breast hyperplasia. Following Manager Lin's guidance, she signed a few insurance application forms and confirmed that the identity and income documents she submitted met the requirements. Manager Lin urged her to submit the complete physical examination report from May 12 as soon as possible to assist underwriting. When Song Yajing left the bank, she felt she had added an important layer of financial protection to her family.

start_state.mood: Serious and prudent, treating insurance as the most important matter of the day.

2025-05.daily_overview: Today she had no outside errands, and Song Yajing spent her recuperation with a gentle household routine. She slept a little later in the morning, then carefully made breakfast for herself and her daughter: warm honey water with oatmeal and eggs. In the morning she listened to about half an hour of relaxing English pop music and casually tidied her daughter's toy corner. In the afternoon, she did cross-stitch in the sun and, on a whim, tried making low-sugar oatmeal cookies following an online tutorial; although they looked ordinary, they tasted fresh and light. In the evening, taking advantage of the fine weather, she tried walking slowly in the community garden downstairs for fifteen minutes for the first time as light activity. Today was a typical easy recuperation day, with a soft and unhurried rhythm.

events.name: After breakfast, listen to English music and tidy up daughter's toy corner
events.description: After breakfast in the morning, Song Yajing played her collection of English pop music on her phone and, to the melody, tidied up the puzzles, plush toys, and crayons that her daughter Chen Lexuan had scattered in the corner of the living room. She put the small toys into a storage basket, threw away a few deformed crayon stubs, and used a damp cloth to wipe the dusty plastic shelves in the toy corner.

events.name: In the afternoon, continued cross-stitching the olive branch pattern
events.description: After waking from her nap, Song Yajing sat on the chair by the window and continued doing cross-stitch in the natural afternoon light. Today she completed the third leaf of the olive branch, and the lines were noticeably smoother than the previous two times. She found that this unhurried repetitive motion reduced her anxiety and decided to try to set aside a little time for it every day from now on.

events.name: Tried making low-sugar oat cookies.
events.description: After her eyes grew a little tired from embroidering, Song Yajing suddenly remembered a healthy dessert recipe she had seen the night before. She went into the kitchen, took out oatmeal, eggs, and a little xylitol, and followed the tutorial on her phone to mix and shape them step by step. The baked cookies were a bit hard, but they were full of wheat aroma. She put a few on a small plate, took a photo, and posted it to the Yajing Life Studio community with the caption: a new attempt during the recovery period, a small guilt-free snack. Soon customers replied asking for the recipe, which gave her a small sense of achievement.

events.name: In the evening, try light activity by walking slowly in the community garden.
events.description: At around 6 p.m., Song Yajing changed into flat cloth shoes and for the first time tried walking slowly alone in the community garden downstairs. She circled the flower beds and fountain three or four times, about 15 minutes in total, at a very slow pace. She didn't push herself to walk too long, and went home at ease after feeling no tightness in her chest. This light activity planted a small seed for her subsequent daily walking plan.

start_state.mood: Relaxed, enjoying a slow pace with no schedule.

2025-05.daily_overview: Although her home recovery was not yet over, Song Yajing had to handle the core business of purchasing the new summer collection today. In the morning, she used her phone at home to look at the sample photos, fabric information, and quotation sheets sent by Guangzhou supplier Susan for French floral dresses and lightweight sun-protection jackets. After repeated price negotiations over WeChat, she successfully finalized the order. In the afternoon, she transferred the deposit via mobile banking and called Xiaomei to sync the new product list and planned launch schedule to the store for preparation. During their conversation, Susan also happened to mention this year's trending colors, and the two chatted for another fifteen minutes. Song Yajing felt that industry information was still flowing vividly. Today confirmed that a remote model for making core purchasing decisions is feasible, further strengthening her confidence in delegating authority.

events.name: Reviewing the summer sample materials sent by Susan, the supplier from Guangzhou
events.description: At about 9 a.m., Song Yajing sat down on the sofa at home, placing her phone flat on a cushion so she could zoom in more easily—it was the sample photos of French floral dresses and lightweight sun-protection tops, close-ups of fabric labels, and a detailed quotation sent by her Guangzhou supplier Susan via WeChat. She zoomed in to examine the patterns on the two floral dresses carefully and noticed that one had a darker base color; worried it would look dull under Xiamen's strong summer light, she jotted down this point in her phone memo for follow-up.

events.name: Negotiated the price with Susan via WeChat and confirmed the order details.
events.description: Song Yajing opened WeChat's voice call feature to have a detailed conversation with Su Shan. They discussed and negotiated item by item: the base color of the French floral dresses, the size distribution, the order ratio for the two colors of lightweight sun-protective tops, and the shipping method. After two rounds of coordination, the two parties finalized an order totaling 30 pieces of the new summer styles—18 floral dresses and 12 sun-protective tops—for a total of 6,000 yuan, with Su Shan agreeing to bear the shipping costs. Su Shan also shared the popular trend of French country style in the Guangzhou market this year and suggested that she could do some warm-up promotion in the community. Song Yajing took careful notes.

events.name: Paid the deposit through mobile banking and confirmed the shipment date.
events.description: After confirming the order, Song Yajing transferred 30% of the total amount (1800 yuan) as a deposit via mobile banking to the company account provided by Susan. Then she took a screenshot of the successful payment page and sent it to Susan via WeChat. Susan replied that she had received it and promised to ship before May 12. Song Yajing also marked the expected arrival date in her phone calendar so she could arrange for it to go on the shelves.

events.name: Synced the purchase details to Xiaomei and reminded her of the shelving plan
events.description: At about 3:30 in the afternoon, Song Yajing sent the complete order details of this remote purchase to Xiaomei via WeChat, and also left a voice message saying that the new stock was expected to arrive at the store in about a week, suggesting that she post a few new-product previews on Moments in advance. She asked Xiaomei to check the fabric and color difference before putting the items on the shelves, and to take photos and report immediately if there were any problems.

2025-05.daily_overview: Today was an extremely important emotional milestone in Song Yajing's life. In the morning, after a brief handover with Xiaomei at the store, she hurried to her daughter's warm kindergarten to attend the special Mother's Day event for the senior class. In the activity arranged by the teachers, Xuanxuan strung a bead bracelet for her, drew a holding-hands card, and, in front of the whole class, made the childlike confession, 'My mommy is most beautiful when she tells me stories.' With reddened eyes, Song Yajing put the bracelet on her wrist on the spot and never took it off for the rest of May. The bracelet became her tactile ritual for emotional regulation—whenever she felt anxious, she would stroke the bracelet and remember her daughter's love and pure judgment. After picking her daughter up and returning home that afternoon, she re-examined her life priorities during a quiet moment.

events.name: In the morning, first go to the shop for handover, then rush to the kindergarten Mother's Day event
events.description: At about 8 a.m., Song Yajing first went to the store to discuss the simple morning business arrangements with Xiaomei. After confirming that Xiaomei could manage the store on her own, she told her to leave a WeChat message if there were any large orders or emergencies. Then she walked alone to the nearby Wenxin Kindergarten to attend the special Mother's Day event for the senior class.

events.name: Participated in the Mother's Day event and received a bracelet and a card from her daughter.
events.description: In the senior kindergarten classroom, Song Yajing squatted beside her daughter Xuanxuan to string bead bracelets together. Xuanxuan used small red and pink beads to make a slightly asymmetrical but brightly colored bracelet and put it on her mother's wrist. When the teacher organized the 'Mom, I want to tell you' segment, Xuanxuan stood up and said in front of all the children: 'My mom runs a beautiful clothes shop, but she is most beautiful when she tells me stories.' Song Yajing's eyes reddened as she tightened the bracelet and carefully put away the card her daughter had drawn of the two of them holding hands.

events.name: Picked up daughter and took her home, and wore the bracelet as an emotional anchor.
events.description: After the event ended, Song Yajing took her daughter's hand and slowly walked home. She decided to wear this beaded bracelet for a long time from today and not to take it off lightly. After returning home, she pressed the kindergarten hand-holding card under the transparent glass mat on the table, then sat on the sofa gently turning the beads on her wrist, feeling a moist but clear sense of calm spreading in her chest.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to spending the Mother’s Day event with my daughter.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road
end_state.mood: Moved and at peace, re-evaluating her self-worth because of her daughter's confession of love.

In the morning, she sorted through the cross-stitch pieces she had completed during her recovery and wrote in her diary about her spiritual reflections and inner changes over the past ten days. In the afternoon, she went to the mall early to pick out a set of summer clothes for her mother and one for her mother-in-law, wrapped them properly, and prepared to send them. She also bought a simple photo frame for herself at the mall to display a family photo at home. Before 3 p.m., she arrived at Maan Coffee in Xiamen SM City Plaza to meet Li Meiling. They caught up with each other, and her friend gave her a succulent plant to encourage her to relax, and they agreed to go to the seaside next month to unwind. After returning home in the evening, she placed the succulent by the TV cabinet and felt the steady support of friendship.

events.name: Organize the cross-stitch pieces made during the recuperation period and write a devotional diary

The olive branch pattern had taken shape, and beside it she had embroidered a short segment of the first character of the phrase 'Faith.' She selected a few scattered thoughts from several scripture readings in her phone memos and wrote in her diary: 'Accepting your imperfect self takes more courage than pursuing perfection.'

events.name: Go to the mall in advance to pick out summer clothes for my mother and my mother-in-law, and buy a photo frame.

As she was leaving, she spotted a simple wooden photo frame with clean lines in the home section and bought it on impulse, thinking she could display a favorite family photo in it.

events.name: Afternoon tea with close friend Li Meiling at SM City Plaza
events.description: At 3 p.m., Song Yajing left home and met Li Meiling at Maan Coffee in SM City Plaza. The two ordered fruit tea and desserts. Li Meiling shared funny stories from her class at the end of the semester and a little Teachers' Day moment from the children in her class. Song Yajing softly confided her unease after delegating authority at the shop and her nervousness about the physical exam the following week. Li Meiling listened carefully, then handed her a plump potted succulent and said with a smile, “Keep it in the shop or at home and look at it; it can help relieve stress.”

events.name: Arranged to go to the seaside together next month to relax and bring succulents home
events.description: Before saying goodbye, Li Meiling encouraged Song Yajing to rest more and not push herself too hard, and suggested driving together to the seaside on Island Ring Road one weekend next month to get some fresh air. Song Yajing marked it in her phone calendar. After the two parted happily at the coffee shop entrance, Song Yajing carried the succulent plant home and placed it in a prominent spot next to the TV cabinet in the living room. Every time she passed by, she thought of her best friend's care and support.

After Mass, they joined the parish's parent-child activity; her daughter gave her a drawing that read, "My mom is the most beautiful, even though she gets tired sometimes," which made her tear up again. Auntie Lin Xiuying, a fellow parishioner, shared her experience of caring for her sick elderly husband and quoted "Love is patient," which deeply moved Song Yajing. In the afternoon, she went to a courier station near Zhongshan Road to send off the summer clothes she had chosen the day before for the two mothers. Afterwards, she bought a new vase at a nearby shop and, when she got home, arranged the carnations her husband had given her in it. In the evening, during a video call with her parents in Quanzhou, she learned that her mother's knee was slightly aching, and she silently made a note to buy joint health supplements. On the same day, she called the physical examination center to book a full-body checkup for the next day and asked her husband Chen Zhiqiang to accompany her. That night, she filled the new vase with water, put the carnations in it, and placed it at the center of the dining table, adding a touch of tenderness to the home.

events.name: In the morning, attended Mother's Day Mass and took her daughter to parent-child activities
events.description: On Mother's Day morning, Song Yajing put on an elegant dark blue dress and took her daughter Chen Lexuan to Siming Catholic Church. events.name: Exchanged reflections with Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow churchgoer.

Song Yajing nodded earnestly and took the words to heart, planning to copy them into her Bible reading notebook.

events.name: In the afternoon, buy a vase and go home to arrange carnations to decorate the dining table

2025-05.daily_overview: For Song Yajing, this was an extremely information-dense and turning-point day. In the morning, accompanied by her husband Chen Zhiqiang, she completed a full physical examination at the health checkup center of a Grade 3A hospital. After receiving the report in the afternoon, the doctor told her that in addition to the known hypoglycemia, mild breast hyperplasia had also been found, clearly linking it to long-term emotional suppression and advising her to seriously work on regulating her mood. This diagnosis was a wake-up call for her and the biggest driver pushing her toward systematic health management. After leaving the hospital, she proactively called her older sister Song Yawen and choked up as she poured out her feelings. The call lasted nearly ninety minutes, and her sister gently said, "If you're tired, come back to Quanzhou and stay a few days—I'll pay for it." The sisters' relationship moved toward a deeper emotional connection. That evening, Song Yajing wrote a first draft of the daily operations SOP in her study and discussed with her husband the decision to return to her parents' home in Quanzhou for a period of rest. After her diagnosis, she bought sports shoes, went to the community health center to consult a family doctor, and made a detailed low-sugar diet plan. Health management thus escalated from casual attention to a systematic daily priority.

events.name: Completed a full physical examination in the morning, accompanied by her husband.
events.description: On the morning of May 12, accompanied by her husband Chen Zhiqiang, Song Yajing went to the physical examination center of a Class A tertiary hospital in Xiamen and completed a full set of examinations, including routine blood tests, ultrasound, and breast color Doppler ultrasound. The process took about two and a half hours. Chen Zhiqiang waited for her in the waiting area, scrolling through his phone throughout, and held her hand during the blood draw and ultrasound.

events.name: Received a diagnosis of mild breast hyperplasia and listened to the doctor's advice.
events.description: After the afternoon physical exam results came out, the doctor told Song Yajing and her husband in the consultation room that besides the already known hypoglycemia, she was newly found to have mild breast hyperplasia. He clearly told them that it was closely related to long-term emotional suppression and high-pressure work, and that she needed to earnestly adjust her mood and avoid anxiety, recommending a check-up every six months. Song Yajing pressed her lips together in the consultation room and silently folded the diagnosis report and put it into her bag.

events.name: After the physical exam, went to a sporting goods store to buy comfortable athletic shoes.
events.description: Influenced by the physical exam, Song Yajing decided to start a daily walking routine after leaving the hospital. On her way home, she passed a sporting goods store in Siming District. She went in, tried on, and bought a pair of light gray lightweight athletic shoes, preparing to exercise in her residential area and nearby parks.

events.name: Go to the community health center to consult Dr. Wang Mingyuan.
events.description: After leaving the sports store, she asked her husband to drive home ahead of her, and she walked to the community health center to see family doctor Wang Mingyuan for further dietary advice about her hypoglycemia and breast hyperplasia. Dr. Wang patiently listed high-sugar foods to avoid and recommended dietary fiber foods, and suggested she post the diet plan on the fridge so the whole family could monitor it together.

events.name: Went home to make a low-sugar diet plan and bought ingredients at the supermarket
events.description: After returning home, Song Yajing immediately sat at the dining table and wrote out a low-sugar healthy eating list that included whole grains, vegetables, eggs, milk, and fish. She went to a nearby supermarket and bought all the ingredients she needed for a week in one trip. Once home, she stuck the plan on the refrigerator and asked her husband Chen Zhiqiang to help supervise her daily.

events.name: She proactively called her sister and, choking up, confided the results of her physical examination.
events.description: After finishing the purchases and resting briefly, Song Yajing sat on the edge of the bed in the bedroom and proactively called her older sister Song Yawen. In a slightly trembling voice, she told her about the breast hyperplasia found in the physical examination and the doctor's advice about managing her emotions. Her sister gently comforted her over the phone, saying, 'If you're tired, come back to Quanzhou and stay for a few days, I'll pay.' The sisters sobbed on the phone for a long time, and then her sister sent her a supply chain resource document she had compiled to her WeChat.

events.name: In the evening, I discussed with my husband and decided to return to Quanzhou to recuperate.
events.description: That evening, Song Yajing told her husband Chen Zhiqiang about her sister's suggestion to return to Quanzhou. After discussing it together in the living room, they agreed it was a reasonable and necessary arrangement for recuperation. Chen Zhiqiang proactively offered to adjust the school runs for their daughter and the household chores over the next two weeks, supporting Song Yajing to set off as soon as possible. He marked the days he could take leave in the coming days on his phone calendar as a family buffer.

events.name: Handwritten SOP for daily store operations to prepare for delegated management

While recalling several problem points from Xiaomei's independent operation on May 1, she used a red pen to add emergency handling examples, preparing for the decentralized management that would soon be officially implemented.

At the same time, she started three new daily habits: a half-hour walk along Hubin South Road every evening, strict adherence to a low-sugar diet, and recording an emotional score every night before bed. After handing the store fully over to Xiaomei in the afternoon, she went home for a nap and stayed in remote contact. In the evening, she put on her new sports shoes and took a walk alone along Hubin South Road, feeling a long-lost sense of physical ease. Her mother Lin Xiuying had already prepared her favorite Minnan-style satay noodles in the kitchen for lunch.
