At the same time, she did not cut off contact with Xiaomei: she guided her in optimizing the WeChat marketing copy and praised the data from the previous article. In the evening her father suggested taking a walk in the community park. As they walked slowly, father and daughter chatted about funny stories from her childhood, and Song Yajing felt a long-missing sense of peace. From today on, she shifted her focus to the warmth of family bonds in her family of origin and health recovery.

events.name: Returned to Quanzhou by bullet train in the morning and reunited with father.
events.description: On the morning of May 14, after Chen Zhiqiang took her to Xiamen North Station, Song Yajing took the bullet train back to Quanzhou alone for about 40 minutes. At the exit of Quanzhou Station, she saw her father Song Minghui waiting for her; she smiled, waved, and hurried over. Her father took her small travel bag and put it in the trunk of his old silver sedan, asking along the way about her energy and eating habits.

events.name: Shared lunch with my mother and discussed the physical exam and recuperation arrangements in detail
events.description: After arriving home, her mother Lin Xiuying had already made steaming hot Minnan satay noodles and a bowl of boiled greens. Song Yajing sat in the familiar wooden dining chair and, while eating, told her mother in detail about the diagnosis from the May 12 physical exam and the doctor's instructions about emotional regulation. Her mother gently patted her hand and comforted her, saying, "Come home and stay for a few more days. That works better than any medicine."

events.name: In the afternoon, stuck to a low-sugar diet and controlled cravings for sweets.
events.description: Back in the afternoon to the bedroom she slept in as a child, she took a short rest. She deliberately did not eat the pineapple cake her mother had left on the table, only drinking a glass of warm water. She noted in her phone's Notes app the slight afternoon hunger and the change in energy after eating sugar-free yogurt, keeping her daytime low-sugar eating habit unbroken even while at home.

events.name: Downloaded a mindfulness meditation app and read the beginner's guide.
events.description: After resting, Song Yajing sat on the edge of the bed and downloaded a highly rated mindfulness meditation app from the app store on her phone. She opened the beginner's guide module and read about basic sitting posture, breathing methods, and common questions for beginners. She set a reminder for about 10 minutes of practice before bed each night, planning to formally try her first guided meditation the next day.

events.name: Guide Xiaomei to optimize the WeChat marketing copy.
events.description: During the afternoon tea break, Song Yajing received a screenshot from Xiaomei of the likes on the previous day's WeChat Moments post. After replying with affirmation, she carefully analyzed, via voice message, how well the image composition matched the text description, and gave three revision suggestions: add more outfit-scene descriptions, reduce the pile-up of adjectives, and add an interactive question to guide the comment section.

events.name: Evening walk with father in the community park
events.description: After dinner, her father Song Minghui suggested taking a walk in the nearby community park to aid digestion. The father and daughter walked slowly along the flagstone path. Her father pointed at an old banyan tree and recalled an embarrassing story about Song Yajing falling from a tree when she was little, and they both laughed. After walking for about twenty minutes, Song Yajing held her father's arm and felt that such time together was precious and healing.

start_state.location: Waiting hall at Xiamen North Railway Station.
start_state.mood: Looking forward to being back in the arms of her family, a little tired from the trip

end_state.location: Song Yajing's old bedroom at her parents' home in Licheng District, Quanzhou
end_state.mood: Peace of mind; the relaxed feeling of being wrapped in family affection gradually spreads

state.daily_exercise: Walked about 2,000 steps inside the train station and around the community in my hometown.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with brief local showers in the afternoon, temperature 26-32°C

2025-05.daily_overview: On the second day in Quanzhou, Song Yajing did a rational review of the family finances. Because of the May medical examination costs and the recent drop in store income, she carefully recorded the month’s expenses in the family ledger that afternoon, then wrote the note “Live well first, travel later” beside them, and formally decided to postpone the plan to start a family travel fund. When her husband Chen Zhiqiang found out in Xiamen, he quietly transferred an extra project bonus into the family’s joint account. On the same day, she continued to guide Xiaomei in optimizing the Moments promotion plan and confirmed that the first operation after the handover of product selection authority went smoothly. On the diet front, she started adding whole-grain staples, and the low-sugar diet continued steadily. In the afternoon, she also tried making a low-sugar red bean cake following a recipe shared in the baking group, photographed it, and posted it to the “Yajing Life Studio” community, drawing a wave of likes. In the evening, she completed her first formal guided meditation session with the meditation app and did 10 minutes of stretching before bed. In the small bedroom in Quanzhou, she was slowly reconnecting with her body and mind.

events.name: Recorded family expenses and decided to postpone the launch of the travel fund.
events.description: Because May store income decreased due to promotions and the recuperation period, plus several extra expenses such as physical checkups and health supplements, Song Yajing recorded the details one by one in the family ledger. Her fingertip stopped at the overseas travel plan column written on the vision page three years ago. Beside the total column, she wrote in black pen, "Live well first, then travel far." After closing the ledger, she opened WeChat and sent her husband a message about her decision to postpone the travel fund launch and a screenshot of her diary entry.

events.name: Husband Chen Zhiqiang transferred the project bonus to honor the family consensus
events.description: About forty-odd minutes after the message was sent, Song Yajing was checking the expense tracking app when she noticed a transfer record for her husband's extra project bonus into the shared family account. On WeChat, she received only one line from her husband: "If you see it, put it into savings first." Her eyes grew slightly moist, and in the reply box she typed a thank-you and a folded-hands emoji.

events.name: She continued following up on Xiaomei's WeChat Moments post and guided optimization.
events.description: In the morning, Song Yajing looked at the screenshot of the new styling post that Xiaomei sent the day before. The like count reached 18, up from before, and the writing had improved a lot. She used WeChat voice messages to specifically praise that the scenario-based descriptions were indeed effective, and suggested trying to shoot a short video or add screenshots of customers' fitting reviews next time.

events.name: Stick to a low-sugar diet and increase whole-grain staples, vegetables, and fruit.
events.description: For breakfast, as planned, she had a little whole wheat bread with eggs and milk. For lunch, she asked her mother to prepare whole wheat pasta stir-fried with shrimp and asparagus. For dinner, she had shredded chicken and cucumber salad with millet porridge. After the meal, she wrote in her phone notes: "My energy was noticeably better in the afternoon than the previous two days; for the first time in a while, I didn't feel sleepy." When her husband saw the note, he sent a thumbs-up emoji on WeChat.

events.name: Try making low-sugar red bean cakes and share them in the community group.
events.description: In the afternoon, with nothing else to do, Song Yajing remembered a low-sugar red bean cake recipe shared by Mrs. Liu in the baking group. She asked her mother to help find red beans and xylitol, and in the family kitchen followed the steps to boil, strain, and shape. The finished cake was not as delicate as store-bought ones, but it had a rich bean fragrance and restrained sweetness. She cut it into small pieces, placed them on a porcelain plate, took a photo, and posted it to the "Yajing Life Studio" community with the caption: "A little experiment back at my parents' home, healthy red bean cake, 70 points for myself." Soon, regular customers in the group asked about the recipe, and Mrs. Liu also left an encouraging comment.

events.name: In the evening, tried the first formal guided meditation practice.
events.description: Before sunset in the evening, Song Yajing laid a thin blanket on the floor of her old bedroom at her home in Quanzhou, opened the downloaded meditation app, and did her first basic breathing meditation for about 10 minutes. She tried to slow her breathing following the guided instructions. Stray thoughts still kept emerging, but by the end her hands and feet were noticeably more relaxed than before, and she gained initial confidence in this new practice.

events.name: Evening stretching before bed and recording mood score
events.description: Before going to bed, Song Yajing did her usual 10-minute neck and shoulder stretches, incorporating the moves taught by her physical therapist. After stretching, she followed her new habit of recording today's mood score in her phone's memo app: 8 out of 10, with the note 'Feeling at ease in my hometown; the successful baking brought a little joy.' Then she turned off her phone, applied lavender essential oil, and fell asleep on time.

start_state.location: The old bedroom at her parents' home in Licheng District, Quanzhou
start_state.mood: Calm, beginning to seriously face financial reality.

end_state.location: The old bedroom at her parents' home in Licheng District, Quanzhou
end_state.mood: Rationally accepted it. Although the trip was temporarily shelved, there was a grounded feeling of mutual consensus, and meditation and baking brought positive experiences.

state.daily_exercise: About 1,500 steps of light walking and household chores in the hometown community, plus 10 minutes of stretching before bed.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning clear, with a light early-summer breeze

2025-05.daily_overview: Today was the launch day for the family's financial restructuring and the store's soft-decoration renovation. Song Yajing returned from Quanzhou to Xiamen in the morning, and her husband Chen Zhiqiang picked her up at the station. In the afternoon, she went to the store to select new styles and contact suppliers, while also starting to renovate the store environment. In the evening, the couple reached an agreement under financial pressure to postpone their travel plans. Song Yajing also mailed health supplements to her mother-in-law and called to check in on her, while continuing to keep up her healthy low-sugar diet routine. Before bed, she kept up her meditation and stretching.

events.name: Returned from Quanzhou to Xiamen in the morning.
events.description: After breakfast, Song Yajing said goodbye to her parents, and her father, Song Minghui, drove her to Quanzhou Station. She took the bullet train back to Xiamen and, on the way, used WeChat to confirm with Xiao Mei how the store was operating that morning. Her husband, Chen Zhiqiang, picked her up at Xiamen Station and drove her home. After a short rest and briefly tidying the luggage she had brought back from Quanzhou, she walked to the store.

events.name: Seasonal new arrivals purchasing and supplier communication
events.description: After arriving at the store in the afternoon, Song Yajing, based on recent sales data and fashion information she had browsed online yesterday, selected several light and breathable new women's styles to cope with the early summer warming. She then contacted her Guangzhou supplier Susan via WeChat, discussed in detail the style details, fabric colors, and delivery time of this spring/summer collection, and placed a medium-sized order to replenish store inventory.
events.state_impact: Complete the purchase of the season's new products to keep the store's merchandise updated and refreshed.

events.name: Begin planning the store's cozy soft-furnishing makeover.
events.description: Inspired by the style she had seen at Shiguang Café a few days earlier, Song Yajing decided to give her boutique a cozy makeover. In the afternoon, when there were few customers in the shop, she took out a tape measure, measured the fitting room and a few empty walls, and drew an initial soft-furnishing layout in her notebook. Then she made a detailed list, planning to buy warm-toned LED bulbs, light-colored wooden shelves, and a few potted pothos plants that could hang down, aiming to create a shopping environment where customers felt relaxed and welcomed.
events.state_impact: The store environment upgrade plan was officially launched, preparing for the subsequent renovation.

events.name: Shared financial responsibility between spouses and travel plan adjustment
events.description: In the evening, while sorting out the family accounts in his study, Chen Zhiqiang found a note written by Song Yajing a few weeks ago that said, "Live well first, travel later," and deeply felt the financial pressure the family was currently facing. Without saying much, he silently transferred the full amount of a recent 8,000 yuan extra project bonus to the family joint account via mobile banking. After dinner, the couple had a brief discussion in the living room. Chen Zhiqiang took the initiative to propose officially postponing the original family travel fund launch plan to autumn. Song Yajing nodded in agreement and let out a long sigh of relief. The two reached an unspoken understanding in silence, reflecting the couple's shared responsibility and support during the financial buffer period.
events.state_impact: The family travel goal was officially shelved for the year, financial pressure was temporarily relieved, and the tacit understanding between the couple deepened.

events.name: Send health supplements to her mother-in-law and call to greet her.
events.description: Before going home from the shop in the afternoon, Song Yajing stopped by the courier station on the way, packed the remaining two bottles of glucosamine chondroitin at home, and sent them to her mother-in-law's house by courier. She then called her mother-in-law and told her to take them on time and take good care of her knees.
events.state_impact: Fulfilled care for her mother-in-law, strengthening the bond between mother-in-law and daughter-in-law.

events.name: Following a low-sugar diet and managing energy levels.
events.description: All day she strictly followed a low-sugar diet plan: breakfast at her parents' home in Quanzhou was eggs and milk; lunch was a homemade bento of pre-prepared grilled salmon with steamed pumpkin and stir-fried spinach; dinner was cooked by her husband Chen Zhiqiang, featuring lean pork stir-fried with mushrooms and mixed-grain rice. After lunch, Song Yajing used her free time at the shop to eat a small handful of nuts she had brought as a snack, to avoid dizziness or low energy in the afternoon. In the evening she recorded in her health diary: Today's sugar-free diet was followed well, energy was stable all day, and no hypoglycemia symptoms occurred.
events.state_impact: Maintained a low-sugar diet, with stable blood sugar and good energy levels.

events.name: Keep up bedtime meditation and stretching.
events.description: Although today was packed with tasks, Song Yajing still squeezed in time before bed to complete 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches and 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation. She used a mobile app for guidance, took deep breaths to relax, and let the thoughts from a busy day slowly settle.
events.state_impact: The newly established emotion management habit was maintained, helping to relieve the stress of the day.

start_state.location: Parents' home in Licheng District, Quanzhou.
start_state.mood: Although reluctant, she is ready to return to the rhythm of work.

end_state.location: Home at No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District.
end_state.mood: Grounded, feeling her husband's support and the family's cohesion.

state.daily_exercise: Morning bullet train trip with about 3,000 steps of walking; brisk walk for 15 minutes in the evening; 10 minutes of stretching and 10 minutes of meditation before bed.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with a few clouds in the afternoon.

2025-05.daily_overview: This was the first Saturday after recovery focused on mother-daughter bonding and art healing. In the morning, Song Yajing took her daughter Xuanxuan to a watercolor class, enjoying a long-missed parent-child creative time. In the afternoon, she and fellow church member Aunt Lin Xiuying immersed themselves in the Monet Impressionist Light and Shadow Exhibition, releasing business pressure amid flowing colors and music, and bought a painting to decorate the home. In the evening, she shared the artistic experience with her family and stuck to a low-sugar diet and bedtime meditation.

events.name: Mother-daughter Saturday watercolor class: spring garden sketching
events.description: After recovering, Song Yajing took her daughter Chen Lexuan to the community art center for the first time to attend the Saturday morning watercolor class. This was both an emotional outlet she had been seeking for her daughter and a comfort for her own soul. Today's class theme was "Spring Garden Sketching." Mother and daughter collaborated: Xuanxuan painted the blooming flowers, and Song Yajing filled in the background, completing a vibrant painting together. The teacher praised Xuanxuan's recent clear improvement in color use and water control, making Song Yajing feel gratified and proud.
events.state_impact: The parent-child relationship was nourished, the daughter's drawing skills improved, and Song Yajing's mood became more relaxed.

events.name: Meet up with fellow parishioners at the Monet Light and Shadow Exhibition.
events.description: Before lunch, Song Yajing bought two tickets on her mobile ticketing platform for the afternoon "Monet Light and Shadow Immersive Exhibition", and confirmed via WeChat with Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow church member, to meet at the entrance of Xiamen Powerlong Art Center at 2 p.m. In the afternoon, she closed the store for half a day, met Aunt Lin on time, and the two took a taxi to the art center in Powerlong One City, chatting about everyday matters on the way.
events.state_impact: Start the weekend art journey.

events.name: Immersive Monet Light and Shadow Exhibition and Stress Relief
events.description: At the PowerLong Art Center in Xiamen, Song Yajing watched the Monet Light and Shadow Immersive Exhibition together with Auntie Lin Xiuying. Inside the exhibition hall, in the enormous screens and mirrored spaces, Monet's masterpieces such as 'Water Lilies' and 'The Japanese Bridge' turned into flowing light and shadow accompanied by surrounding classical music. Song Yajing was immersed in it; the gloom caused by nearly half a month of business pressure and physical discomfort was temporarily washed away by the colors and notes, and she felt a long-lost inner peace and pure aesthetic pleasure.
events.state_impact: Art therapy worked, and her mental state was deeply relaxed.

events.name: Selecting paintings for home decoration
events.description: After the visit, the two lingered in the art center's souvenir shop. Song Yajing admired a finely printed reproduction of Monet's "Water Lilies." Imagining hanging this tranquil painting in the bedroom, she bought it without hesitation, planning to use it to decorate the home and bring home the sense of calm from the exhibition.
events.state_impact: New artistic decorative elements will be added to the home.

events.name: Returning home and sharing the art experience
events.description: After saying a reluctant goodbye to Aunt Lin Xiuying at the entrance of the art center, Song Yajing took a taxi back to her home on Hubin South Road, Siming District, carrying the framed water lily reproduction. In the evening, her husband and daughter returned home. Song Yajing excitedly showed them the painting and shared the awe-inspiring exhibition experience and the photos on her phone. She told her husband earnestly that she wanted to take their daughter to experience art and feel beauty more often in the future, and her husband Chen Zhiqiang expressed strong support.
events.state_impact: Add discussions of aesthetics and art to family topics.

events.name: Planning future parent-child art activities
events.description: In the evening, after her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing leaned on the sofa and used her phone to look up recent exhibitions and art experience activities in Xiamen suitable for children, such as a National Geographic photography exhibition and an original-art exhibition by a picture-book author. She saved these activities one by one and resolved to make 'taking her child to experience beauty' a part of family education, starting to arrange them from next month.
events.state_impact: Add new high-quality companionship activities to parent-child life

events.name: Weekend low-sugar diet and family walk
events.description: The weekend diet remained disciplined. Breakfast was milk oatmeal porridge and boiled eggs; lunch was tomato beef brisket with quinoa rice made by her husband; dinner was simple stir-fried vegetables and steamed shrimp. The family ate light and healthy. In the afternoon, to satisfy her cravings, Song Yajing tried making a sugar-free fruit tea at home with sugar substitutes; it tasted refreshing. In the evening, she recorded the day's meals and mood, then took a 20-minute walk around the neighborhood with her husband and daughter, and meditated before bed.
events.state_impact: Maintain a healthy diet, try innovative low-sugar drinks, add fun through couple interactions, and make walks family time.

start_state.location: Home at No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District.
start_state.mood: Relaxed, looking forward to the weekend time with her daughter.

end_state.location: Home at No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District.
end_state.mood: Content and calm, her heart filled with the beauty of art, looking forward to future parent-child activities.

state.daily_exercise: Neighborhood walk for 20 minutes, pre-bed stretching for 10 minutes, and meditation for 10 minutes.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, cool in the morning.

2025-05.daily_overview: A routine yet fulfilling Sunday. In the morning, Song Yajing devoutly attended church Mass and strengthened her connection with fellow parishioners. Afterwards, she returned to spend time with her family and recharge her professional knowledge by paying to register for an online industry lecture. In the afternoon, she went to the building materials market to purchase physical materials for the soft furnishing renovation of her shop, putting the plan from a few days ago into practice. In the evening, the whole family cooked, took a walk, and meditated together.

events.name: Sunday church Mass and fellowship with fellow believers.
events.description: On Sunday morning, Song Yajing set out from home and took the bus to the Catholic church in Siming District to attend the morning Mass. She devoutly listened to Father Wang Mingde's sermon, received Holy Communion, and felt a sense of peace. After Mass, she exchanged greetings with Aunt Lin Xiuying and several other familiar parishioners at the church entrance. They asked about her recent health and shared the news that the church would soon organize a community visitation activity. Song Yajing expressed interest in participating.
events.state_impact: Regularize faith life and maintain and deepen community relationships.

events.name: Paid registration for an online industry lecture.
events.description: After returning home at noon, while her daughter napped, Song Yajing came across a message pushed by the Hangzhou Garment Industry Association. She was very interested in the online lecture Analysis of 2025 Autumn/Winter Women's Wear Fashion Trends. To keep up with industry developments, she immediately completed the paid registration process on the official account and successfully obtained the lecture link and exclusive password, ready to watch on time.
events.state_impact: Got prepared for next week's professional study and stayed professionally sharp.

events.name: Weekend family low-sugar diet and evening sacred duty.
events.description: On Sunday, the meals struck a balance between health and the family's tastes. Breakfast was eggs, milk, and a small handful of nuts, providing lasting satiety. For lunch, Song Yajing made the white-cut chicken the family loves, served with whole-wheat steamed buns and dressed black fungus. Dinner was a simple seaweed and egg drop soup with steamed sweet potatoes. As a fixed Sunday ritual, after dinner the whole family cleaned up together in the kitchen, then took a 30-minute walk around the neighborhood. Before bed, Song Yajing did meditation.
events.state_impact: Successfully completed the second week of the low-sugar diet cycle, and family group activities strengthened emotional bonds.

events.name: Purchase building materials for the store renovation.
events.description: At 4:30 in the afternoon, taking advantage of her husband being home with their daughter, Song Yajing went alone to a large home improvement and building materials market in Huli District, Xiamen. Following the shopping list she had made a few days earlier, she went straight to the lighting and wood sections. She carefully selected warm-toned LED bulbs with a color temperature of 3000K, two light-colored wooden shelves with natural grain, several metal fittings to replace the old shelf parts, and, in the greenery area, three thriving pothos plants. After shopping, she called a van to transport everything back to the store and neatly stacked the supplies in the storage room, ready to start replacing things next Monday.
events.state_impact: The soft furnishing renovation plan has reached the stage where materials are in place, preparing for the actual construction work ahead.

start_state.location: Home at No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District.
start_state.mood: Peaceful, preparing to welcome the Lord's Day

end_state.location: Inside the store at No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District.
end_state.mood: Fulfilled, and looking forward to the work and renovation for the upcoming week.

2025-05.daily_overview: Monday was usually Song Yajing's day for handling miscellaneous chores, and today was no exception. Besides arranging the routine store work, her most important task was to book an appointment with the family doctor for a dedicated follow-up consultation about the breast hyperplasia found during a recent checkup, putting health management first. She continued her low-sugar diet all day, and during an evening walk she discussed the health plan with her husband, who highly praised her persistence in the first week.

events.name: Book an in-person consultation with the family doctor
events.description: After handling the basic shop matters in the morning, Song Yajing used the official online platform of the community health service center to make an appointment for herself with Dr. Wang Mingyuan the next morning. She wanted to specifically consult in detail about the "breast hyperplasia" issue in her physical examination report, to understand its nature, management methods, and daily precautions, and she still felt somewhat worried about it.
events.state_impact: Proactively initiating the medical health consultation process is a key step in taking full control of your personal health.

events.name: Starting a new week of low-sugar eating and receiving encouragement
events.description: Monday's meals were still strictly carried out according to the plan. Breakfast was the usual eggs and milk; lunch was braised fish fillets made from leftover ingredients from last night, served with brown rice and stir-fried greens with garlic; dinner was refreshing cold seaweed salad and pan-seared chicken breast. By then, she had successfully completed her first full week of a low-sugar diet. After dinner, she took a 25-minute walk around the neighborhood with her husband. During the walk, her husband Chen Zhiqiang helped her review the week's food diary and drew a thumbs-up in her health journal, giving her the most genuine affirmation and encouragement. Her confidence grew, and she planned to start the doctor's recommended light exercise next week.
events.state_impact: Received family support, which strengthened the sustained execution of the healthy eating plan, and planned to add exercise.

start_state.mood: Slightly concerned about health issues, but overall in good spirits.

end_state.location: Home at No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District.
end_state.mood: Inspired and full of confidence in health management

2025-05.daily_overview: Today was a busy day with multiple tasks running in parallel. The most important agenda in the morning was meeting the family doctor face to face, which fully clarified the breast hyperplasia issue and produced a scientific health management plan. In the afternoon, she did the store's mid-month financial accounting. In the evening, it was time for self-improvement; she watched an industry trends lecture with full attention and took careful notes, preparing for next season's product selection for the store. After closing, she and her staff member started the first step of the store's lighting renovation together. Because the lecture ran late, she only did a 5-minute meditation before bed.

events.name: Met with the family doctor to discuss breast hyperplasia.
events.description: At 9:30 in the morning, Song Yajing came to the Huli District Community Health Service Center and had a 20-minute interview with her scheduled family doctor Wang Mingyuan. She consulted in detail about the issue of breast hyperplasia. Dr. Wang patiently explained its benign nature, emphasizing that it is directly related to emotional stress and dietary structure, and that regular follow-up checkups are all that is needed. The doctor gave clear advice: have a breast ultrasound every six months, and recommended that she practice meditation and take regular walks to relax her body and mind. This conversation completely put Song Yajing's mind at ease.
events.state_impact: It eliminated the fear of unknown health issues and provided a specific health management guidance plan.

events.name: Develop a daily health and relaxation plan and integrate it into everyday life.
events.description: After leaving the community health center, Song Yajing went straight home and sat quietly on the living room sofa for ten minutes, carefully digesting the doctor's advice. She took out her planner and entered 'evening walks three times a week, 30 minutes each' and '10 minutes of meditation before bed every night' as mandatory tasks in her upcoming daily routine, and set phone reminders.
events.state_impact: The doctor's general advice was converted into a concrete action plan that could be executed and was added to the schedule.

events.name: Half-month financial accounting for the store.
events.description: Back at the shop in the morning, Song Yajing began the financial accounting for the first half of May. She carefully reviewed the account book and checked the revenue, merchandise costs, utility and miscellaneous expenses, as well as the profit from a small mid-month promotion. After confirming that the e-commerce receipts and cash records were correct, she remotely discussed an expense issue on the corporate account with Lin Xiaofeng, the bank's account manager, via WeChat, ensuring that the books remained clear and transparent.
events.state_impact: Maintain a clear grasp of the shop's business performance and develop the habit of regular financial reviews.

events.name: Watched an online lecture on autumn/winter fashion trends
events.description: In the afternoon at the store, Song Yajing checked her phone battery and storage space in advance to ensure a smooth livestream. At 8 p.m. sharp, she set up her phone in the store's rest area, opened the paid livestream link, and watched the lecture 'Analysis of 2025 Fall/Winter Women's Fashion Trends' organized by the Hangzhou Garment Association with full concentration. A well-known buyer explained key trends in depth, such as low-saturation color schemes, functional fabrics, and retro silhouettes. She recorded the entire lecture using the phone's screen recording feature.
events.state_impact: Even with reduced time in the store, she can maintain industry insight and an eye for product selection through continued professional learning.

events.name: Organize lecture notes and key points.
events.description: While watching the lecture, Song Yajing took out a pre-prepared notebook and pen, and as she listened, she quickly jotted down keywords such as "low-saturation color palette," "functional fabrics," and "structured blazers," along with several key brands and product selection suggestions mentioned by the speaker. Though the notes were messy, she planned to systematically organize them the next day together with the screen recording playback.
events.state_impact: Initially digest fragmented knowledge points individually, preparing for subsequent integration.

events.name: Fine-tune the low-sugar diet for the next phase
events.description: After listening to the lecture in the evening, Song Yajing planned a low-sugar meal plan for the second week in her notebook based on the physical feedback from the first week. She found that increasing the proportion of vegetables made her feel fuller for longer, so the focus of this week's shopping list was leafy greens such as spinach, broccoli, and asparagus, as well as higher-quality protein. She wrote out the shopping list in advance, ready to go grocery shopping tomorrow morning.
events.state_impact: Healthier eating management shifts from passive execution to proactive, data-feedback-based refined adjustments.

events.name: Lighting renovation of the store's fitting room
events.description: After the store closed, Song Yajing and the shop assistant Xiaomei were in no hurry to leave. Together they replaced the old harsh white light bulbs in the fitting room with the warm yellow bulbs they had bought a few days earlier. The moment the lights came on, the whole atmosphere of the fitting room softened. Standing inside and looking in the mirror, Xiaomei exclaimed that she felt she no longer needed a filter for selfies. This small change left Song Yajing very satisfied and full of anticipation for the next renovations.
events.state_impact: The first step in upgrading the store's soft decoration has been taken, and the fitting experience for customers will be improved without a sound.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District
end_state.mood: After a busy day, she felt tired but extremely at ease; both health and work tasks made substantial progress.

events.name: Complete the final phase of the low-sugar diet and summarize.
events.description: In the evening, her daughter and husband watched the Dragon Boat Festival gala in the living room, while Song Yajing completed the low-sugar diet record for the last day of May at the desk in the bedroom. Her diet today was: whole-wheat sandwich for breakfast, vegetable and tofu soup for lunch, and a small amount of beef tenderloin with broccoli for dinner, plus some homemade low-sugar zongzi and a few home-style dishes. She reviewed her diet diary and physical sensation records from the past three weeks, wrote a phased summary, and confirmed that the low-sugar diet had an unquestionably positive effect on improving energy, stabilizing mood, and relieving breast discomfort. She decided to carry most of its principles into her long-term lifestyle habits rather than treat it as a short-term task.
events.state_impact: Completed the cognitive shift from short-term diet management to long-term lifestyle habits, laying a solid foundation for a healthy life.

start_state.location: Home at No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District.
start_state.mood: Calm, preparing to welcome the festival and the calligraphy and painting class.

end_state.location: Home at No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District.
end_state.mood: Gratitude and contentment — she feels glad about the response to the charity event and the healthy growth of the shop, and proud of her own health transformation.

2025-09.daily_overview: Today is the first day of the new semester and Xuanxuan's first day of formal elementary school. The morning rain made the school run a bit more hurried, but Song Yajing used the ritual of the picture book 'The Kissing Hand' to help her daughter overcome separation anxiety and take her first independent step. In the morning, she used the time window after the school run to busily prepare for the newly launched morning livestream segment, debugging equipment and planning content. In the evening, after picking up her daughter, a warm conversation between mother and daughter released the tension of the first day. The evening's financial planning and English course enrollment brought this busy Monday to a fulfilling close.

events.name: Completed the transfer for the family insurance dedicated savings.
events.description: According to the special insurance plan set in the family electronic ledger, Song Yajing transferred the month's premium from the household income account to the dedicated insurance account via mobile banking on payday, and took a screenshot to record it in the electronic ledger, ensuring timely payment and continuous coverage. This is her fixed financial routine at the beginning of each month, reflecting her emphasis on family protection.

events.name: Take daughter Xuanxuan to school and manage separation anxiety
events.description: At 7:30 on the morning of September 1, Song Yajing braved the drizzle to take her daughter Chen Lexuan to the gate of Experimental Primary School. Facing the unfamiliar environment and crowd, Xuanxuan suddenly burst into tears and clung tightly to her mother's leg, refusing to let go. Song Yajing squatted down, took out the picture book The Kissing Hand prepared in advance from her bag, and by the flower bed beside the school gate told her daughter the story of a raccoon mother kissing her baby raccoon's palm. After finishing, she gently kissed her daughter's palm and agreed that whenever she missed her mother, she could press it to her cheek and feel her mother's love. Xuanxuan sobbed and closed her little hands, hesitated for a moment, then turned and walked into the campus. Song Yajing watched from outside the school gate, her eyes slightly moist.

events.name: Trying to resume morning brisk walking.
events.description: After dropping off her daughter, Song Yajing remembered the morning brisk-walking habit she had paused in late August, so she took a detour to the community park and did 10 minutes of extremely slow brisk walking, covering only about 1.2 kilometers in total. Although she still felt physically weak, completing this light recovery workout on a busy school-opening day gave her a sense of control. This was the first step of her body waking up after ending the “crisis support mode.”

events.name: Had an emotional debrief with my daughter about her first day of school.
events.description: After school ended at 4 PM, Song Yajing picked up Xuanxuan at the school gate on time and walked home with her. On the way, she asked how her first day had felt. Xuanxuan excitedly said that she had missed her mother three times today, and each time she pressed her palm against her cheek, feeling warm as if her mother were right there. Song Yajing crouched down and hugged her daughter, praising her for being brave and independent. On the way home, the mother and daughter revisited the story of "The Kissing Hand" and agreed to keep using that magic tomorrow. After arriving home, Xuanxuan was clearly more relaxed and took the initiative to show off her new textbooks and exercise books.

events.name: Preparing the morning live-stream program
events.description: After sending her daughter to school and returning to the shop, Song Yajing took advantage of the low customer traffic in the morning to set up a simple live-streaming area in the corner next to the fitting room. She adjusted the phone stand, ring light, and background board (using the shop's minimalist shelves as the background), and wrote the outline for the first live-stream session in her phone notes: sharing recent autumn outfits, thoughts on accompanying her daughter to school, and a brief sharing of a Bible verse. She planned to name the segment "A Cup of Coffee After Dropping Off the Kid" and hold it on Tuesday and Thursday mornings, focusing on relaxed, companion-style content.

events.name: Signed up for an online English speaking course.
events.description: After putting her daughter to bed in the evening, Song Yajing searched online and compared three English speaking workshops, and finally chose a four-week intensive travel English course. The course was for complete beginners, covering scenarios such as airports, hotels, and restaurants, with classes every Saturday morning. After paying via Alipay, she downloaded the course-specific app and e-textbooks, and added the first class time (Saturday, September 6) to her phone calendar. This was her first step toward achieving the family goal of traveling overseas within three years.

events.name: Stretching and meditation before bed
events.description: In the dead of night, Song Yajing spread a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and did a 10-minute full-body stretch, paying special attention to her calves, neck, and shoulders. Then she sat cross-legged to meditate, reviewing her daughter's performance on her first day of school, praying and giving thanks for the family's smooth transition.

start_state.mood: Slightly nervous and expectant, she felt a bit worried about her daughter's first day at school.

end_state.mood: Relieved and satisfied: her daughter made it through the first day of school smoothly, and the new column and English course were also properly arranged. She felt slightly tired physically but mentally fulfilled.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk for 10 minutes (recovery), walking to take her daughter to and pick her up from school, about 9,000 steps, and stretch before bed.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy with a gentle breeze, 27-31°C, warm afternoon sunshine.

2025-09.daily_overview: Today was the second day of school and also the day Song Yajing launched her morning livestream segment for the first time. At drop-off, her daughter's separation anxiety was noticeably lighter, allowing her to focus on the morning's work with more peace of mind. Although the first livestream was a bit unpolished, sharing her daughter's school-enrollment story unexpectedly struck a chord with viewers. After handling the shop's daily affairs in the afternoon, she picked up Xuanxuan in the evening and found that she had already begun adjusting to school life. In the evening, she and her husband spent warm family time with their daughter. The overall pace was smooth and orderly.

events.name: On the way to school, reinforced my daughter's adjustment progress.
events.description: At 7:30 a.m. on September 2, Song Yajing held Xuanxuan's hand and walked her to the school gate. Xuanxuan still hesitated and felt uneasy at the gate for a moment, but she didn't cry loudly like yesterday. Song Yajing crouched down, took out The Kissing Hand, smiled and reminded her daughter of the successful experience of pressing her palm to her cheek yesterday, and kissed her palm again. After hesitating for a moment, Xuanxuan took the initiative to reach out and accept the kiss magic, said Goodbye, Mom, and walked into the school gate on her own. Though her steps were still a little hesitant, her mood was clearly better. Song Yajing watched her daughter walk into the teaching building before turning away, feeling much relieved.

events.name: First morning live-streaming program launches.
events.description: After dropping off her daughter, Song Yajing returned to the store and started the first episode of the segment “A Cup of Coffee After Dropping Off the Kid” on time at 9:30. Holding a cup of latte, she shared an early autumn commute outfit in a relaxed tone, interspersing the story of her daughter starting kindergarten the day before and the warm plot of the picture book The Kissing Hand. Although she was a bit nervous and spoke a little fast, several mothers in the bullet comments shared their own children's kindergarten entry experiences, and the atmosphere was warm. The livestream lasted about 30 minutes, with a peak of 15 concurrent viewers. Although it fell short of expectations, it made her more confident in the direction of the segment.

events.name: Handled daily store operations.
events.description: After the livestream ended, Song Yajing organized the shelves and counted inventory, moving summer leftover stock to the discount area to make display space for the upcoming autumn new arrivals. She also pushed the livestream replay link and several discounted item recommendations to the customer WeChat group; two regular customers privately messaged to place orders. In the afternoon, after staff member Xiaomei arrived, the two together counted last week's sales receipts and entered them into a simple inventory management spreadsheet.

events.name: Picked up her daughter from school and observed how she was adjusting.
events.description: When she picked up her daughter at 4 p.m., Song Yajing noticed that Xuanxuan was in a noticeably relaxed mood and voluntarily talked about the fun things that happened at kindergarten that morning, including her deskmate Xiaoming sharing a piece of candy with her and the teacher praising her for drawing carefully. Song Yajing praised Xuanxuan for today's progress and told her that she had adapted to most of it, and that if she kept it up for one more day, she would be fully adjusted to the primary school routine. On the way home, the mother and daughter bought ice cream at the convenience store as a small reward.

events.name: Evening family time
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang did puzzle games and read picture books with Xuanxuan, and helped Xuanxuan organize the school supplies she would need for the next day. Xuanxuan took the initiative to ask for the story 'The Kissing Hand' one more time. The family enjoyed a peaceful evening.

events.name: Before bed: stretch and review livestream improvements.
events.description: Before bed, Song Yajing did 10 minutes of stretching. During the meditation session, she reviewed the shortcomings of her first livestream and noted in her phone memo: she needs to add more interactive segments, control her speaking pace, and prepare more outfit topics.

start_state.mood: Calm but slightly nervous about her first livestream.

end_state.mood: Relaxed and satisfied, the first livestream experience went smoothly, and my daughter's adaptation is progressing gratifyingly.

state.daily_exercise: Walked to school drop-off + evening walk, about 9,000 steps, stretched before bed.

date_attribute.weather: Partly sunny with a light breeze, temperature 26-30°C, pleasant weather.

2025-09.daily_overview: Today was the third day of school. Xuanxuan completely overcame her separation anxiety and, after voluntarily performing her "magic ritual," confidently walked into campus, filling Song Yajing with relief. In the morning, she used the free time to organize the autumn product selection list to prepare for ordering. In the evening, after picking up her daughter, she wrote up the three-day school experience and shared it in the moms' group, unexpectedly sparking a lively discussion. At night, she confirmed the next day's video conference with supplier Susan, officially starting the store's autumn stocking.

events.name: Witnessing her daughter's full adjustment to school
events.description: At 7:30 a.m. on September 3, Xuanxuan voluntarily stopped at the school gate, held out her little hand and said, “Mom, kiss the magic in my palm.” Song Yajing bent down and kissed her daughter’s palm. Xuanxuan pressed her little hand against her cheek, smiled brightly as she said goodbye, and walked into the campus with big steps. The whole process had no crying or hesitation, a completely different person from two days ago. Song Yajing stood at the school gate watching her daughter’s back, confirming that Xuanxuan had successfully gotten through the school adjustment period, and felt an indescribable pride and relief welling up in her heart.

events.name: Sharing school adjustment experience in the moms' group
events.description: After putting her daughter to sleep at night, Song Yajing shared in detail in the 'Hot Moms Group' WeChat group her experience of accompanying her daughter through the first three days of adapting to school. From choosing the picture book 'The Kissing Hand', to persisting with the ritual of kissing her palm, to the three-day gradual change of her daughter from crying loudly to reaching out on her own, she posted photos of the picture book and a cute moment of her daughter pressing her hand to her cheek (with the face blurred). A dozen or so moms in the group responded one after another; some recalled their own children's separation anxiety when starting school, and others said they would go buy the book too. They all exchanged advice and supported each other, and the community atmosphere was warm and lively. Song Yajing was thus selected as the group's 'Parenting Sharing Star'.

events.name: Organize the requirements list for autumn product selection.
events.description: In the afternoon, when customer traffic in the shop was low, Song Yajing spread out the sales records and customer feedback notes from the past two months on the work desk beside the cash register. Combining the recent fashion trends in the local scene (new Chinese style and light retro style), she systematically organized the autumn women's wear selection requirements. She listed about 30 candidate styles, highlighting three directions: new Chinese-style outerwear, refined knit tops, and versatile wide-leg pants, fully preparing for the video conference with Susan, the Guangzhou supplier.

events.name: Schedule a video conference with the supplier
events.description: At 6 p.m., Song Yajing contacted supplier Susan in Guangzhou via WeChat, sent the organized product selection requirements list as an image, and scheduled a video conference for tomorrow (September 4) at 10 a.m. Susan replied to confirm and said she had prepared the new season's design drafts and sample garments for physical display. The two agreed to do the online product selection via a WeChat video call.

events.name: Extra back relaxation after stretching before bed
events.description: Due to long hours of desk work, she felt some tightness in her neck and shoulders. During pre-sleep stretching, she deliberately added an extra 5 minutes of shoulder and neck relaxation exercises and meditated for 10 minutes, to store up energy for the upcoming busy product-selection season.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to my daughter's performance today and feeling full of drive for the store planning.

end_state.mood: Content and satisfied; daughter adjusted smoothly, and the product selection plan is progressing in an orderly manner

2025-09.daily_overview: Today was the second broadcast of the morning live-streaming program. After sharing autumn fashion trends, Song Yajing held an efficient video ordering meeting with suppliers from Guangzhou and selected 20 styles of autumn women's wear to prepare for the peak season. In the afternoon, she handled down payment payments and communicated with store staff. In the evening, an impulsive decision ignited her passion for exercise—she bought running shoes and workout clothes, and will start morning running from tomorrow. At night, she scheduled a weekend video call with her parents and flipped through travel magazines to gather inspiration for the family's overseas trip, drawing a warm end to a busy day.

events.name: Second morning livestream focuses on autumn outfits
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., Song Yajing started the second episode of "A Cup of Coffee After Dropping Off the Kids" on schedule. She kept the relaxed chat style and shared three early-autumn layering outfits. She also mentioned in passing that she would soon be meeting suppliers to select new styles, giving customers a sense of "being behind the scenes." The live stream peaked at 22 concurrent viewers, up from Monday, and the bullet comments were livelier, with several viewers asking when the new Chinese-style pieces would be available.

events.name: Video ordering meeting with Susan, the Guangzhou supplier.
events.description: At 10 a.m., Song Yajing connected with Susan via WeChat video in the back of the store. Susan set up a phone camera in the showroom and displayed the new season's design drafts and sample garments one by one, including several new Chinese-style improved qipao dresses and light retro knitwear. Song Yajing checked them item by item against the list, finally selected 20 pieces of women's clothing for stocking, focusing on new Chinese style and improved knitwear categories, and confirmed the shipping schedule with Susan (to be sent before September 7) and special discounts (3.5% additional discount for bulk orders). The whole process lasted about 50 minutes, and the two worked together efficiently.

events.name: Complete the order deposit payment and organize the list.
events.description: After the video conference, Song Yajing organized the confirmed order list of 20 women's clothing styles into an Excel spreadsheet, noting style numbers, colors, size ratios, and cost prices, and calculated the 30% deposit amount. She transferred the deposit to Susan's company account via mobile banking, and sent the transfer screenshot and the order spreadsheet together via WeChat for confirmation. Susan replied that she had received it and promised to ship according to the agreed time.

events.name: Decided to start morning running and buy sports gear.
events.description: After closing the shop in the evening, Song Yajing went to a nearby sporting goods store. In her health self-assessment a few months earlier, she had mentioned that her "frequency of daily exercise was not high," and at this moment she made up her mind to try regular exercise. After trying them on, she bought a pair of light running shoes and two sets of breathable sportswear, and set an alarm on her phone for jogging in Zhongshan Park on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday mornings after dropping her daughter at school. While purchasing, she also asked the salesperson for advice on precautions for beginners. The salesperson recommended starting with alternating brisk walking and jogging, about 20 minutes each time.

events.name: Discussing autumn stock arrival preparations with store clerk Xiaomei
events.description: During the store shift handover, Song Yajing told Xiaomei about the morning's ordering situation and said the new autumn products were expected to arrive next week. She guided Xiaomei to organize the warehouse space in advance, clean the autumn display props, and made an initial plan for the window display theme after arrival.

events.name: Schedule a weekend video call with her parents in Quanzhou.
events.description: After Xuanxuan fell asleep that night, Song Yajing asked her parents on WeChat if they were free for a video call on Saturday evening. Her father, Song Minghui, replied that it was fine, and her mother, Lin Xiuying, said with a laugh that she wanted to see how Xuanxuan had changed since starting school. The three agreed to have a family video call at 8 p.m. Saturday.

events.name: Browsing travel magazines for inspiration for a family overseas trip
events.description: Before bed, Song Yajing leaned against the headboard, flipping through a travel magazine and browsing family trip guides to the Maldives and Hokkaido, Japan. She used her phone to take photos of several hotels and attractions that caught her interest, planning to discuss them later with her husband Lin Dong.

events.name: Pre-bedtime stretching and trying on new running shoes.
events.description: Before bed, she excitedly placed her new running shoes beside the bed, traced out the next morning's running route, and did thorough stretches for her legs and neck-shoulders. She fell asleep looking forward to her new exercise habit.

start_state.mood: Energetic and looking forward to the new day's work.

end_state.mood: Content and slightly excited; the autumn clothing stocking is settled, and the exercise plan is also on the agenda.

state.daily_exercise: Walking child to school + visiting a sporting goods store in the evening, about 8,500 steps, stretching before bed

2025-09.daily_overview: Today, Song Yajing carried out the decision she made last night and officially started her first morning run. Although her stamina was still in the adaptation phase, feeling refreshed after the run made her confident about persisting. In the morning, at the shop, she planned the autumn new arrivals display and promotion in detail with the shop assistant Xiaomei. At noon, during her lunch break, she contacted supplier Susan to discuss the customization needs for the fifth-anniversary commemorative silk scarves, and the celebration preparations quietly began. In the evening, when picking up her daughter, Xuanxuan proudly showed off the homework she had completed independently, and the mother and daughter enjoyed a rare leisurely time on the way home.

events.name: First morning run starts a new exercise habit
events.description: At 6:50 in the morning, Song Yajing got up with the alarm she had set the night before, put on her newly bought sportswear and running shoes, and after sending Xuanxuan off, went alone to Zhongshan Park. Following the sports store clerk's advice, she did her first morning run by alternating 5 minutes of brisk walking to warm up, 3 minutes of jogging, and 2 minutes of brisk walking, for a total of about 20 minutes. Although she was out of breath halfway and her cardiopulmonary function clearly couldn't keep up, the morning breeze and the atmosphere of the morning exercisers in the park made her feel great. After finishing, she stretched for a while on a park bench and found that the stiffness in her neck and shoulders seemed to have eased. She posted a photo of the park at dawn on WeChat Moments with the caption, 'First day of morning run, check-in.'

events.name: Plan the autumn new-product promotion with shop assistant Xiaomei.
events.description: After her morning run, Song Yajing returned to the shop and had a brief store meeting with Xiaomei. She shared the list of 20 new fall items she had ordered the day before, and took out the store floor plan to plan the display layout for when the goods arrived together with Xiaomei: the new Chinese-style series would move to the most eye-catching display rack on the right side of the entrance, and knit tops and wide-leg pants would be displayed in coordinated outfits. The two also discussed a community promotion plan, planning to "sneak preview" one new item per day in the WeChat group starting next week, with pre-orders accepted on a first-come, first-served basis.

events.name: Contact supplier Susan to discuss custom fifth-anniversary commemorative silk scarves
events.description: During her lunch break, Song Yajing contacted Susan via a WeChat call to discuss the custom order for the store's fifth anniversary commemorative silk scarves. She described her initial idea: 60 cm square silk, with Morandi blue as the main color, the store logo and the Chinese characters "Yajing Life House" incorporated into the pattern, plus fifth anniversary elements. Susan said her factory could take on the custom order, and the two had a preliminary discussion about the quantity (100 scarves), unit cost, and delivery time (about 10 days).

events.name: Pick up my daughter from school and enjoy some parent-child time.
events.description: When picking up Xuanxuan from school in the evening, her daughter held up a Chinese homework sheet the moment she saw her. On it were neatly written pinyin letters "a o e i u ü", and beside them she had drawn little figures of herself and her mom. Xuanxuan proudly said the teacher had given her a red five-pointed star. Song Yajing squatted down and kissed her daughter on the forehead, telling her this was the first reward since starting elementary school and was worth remembering. Mother and daughter walked hand in hand, paused briefly at the small community park, and sat on a bench to share the small bread roll from Xuanxuan's backpack.

start_state.mood: Before the first morning run, I was a little nervous, afraid I wouldn't be able to keep it up.

end_state.mood: Full of a sense of accomplishment; morning runs and autumn planning are both progressing.

2025-09.daily_overview: For Song Yajing, today was a Saturday full of new attempts and family warmth. In the morning, she overcame her nerves and attended her first online English class, stumbling through travel-scenario dialogues but gaining a lot. In the afternoon, after helping her daughter finish homework, the family of three carefully prepared for the evening family video call. During the call, Xuanxuan performed pinyin for her grandparents, and Song Yajing shared the progress of her store preparations. The tiramisu recipe her mother sent ignited her baking enthusiasm. Before bed, a late-night conversation with her husband helped the couple rediscover their rapport amid their busy daily life.

events.name: First online English speaking course
events.description: At exactly 9 a.m., Song Yajing put on her headphones in the study and attended her first online travel English conversation course, themed around airport and hotel scenarios. The course used a small-class format with 6 students in total. The foreign teacher, Anna, guided everyone to practice basic dialogues in pairs, including greetings, check-in, and asking for directions. Song Yajing was very nervous at first and her mind went blank when she opened her mouth, but with the teacher's patient encouragement, she gradually managed to say simple sentences like “Excuse me, where is the restroom?” When the class ended, although she felt her tongue was tied in knots, it was a novel experience, and she earnestly wrote down in her notes: “Listen more and repeat more.” After class, she completed the voice assignment in the app and downloaded the daily read-aloud materials.

events.name: Accompany her daughter to finish her weekend homework.
events.description: The class ended at nearly 11 o'clock. Song Yajing accompanied Xuanxuan to finish her weekend Chinese and math homework. When Xuanxuan was copying pinyin, she had difficulty writing ü. The mother and daughter practiced repeatedly on paper, and Song Yajing invented a mnemonic of adding dots to the small round dot to help her daughter remember. After finishing the homework, Xuanxuan took the initiative to practice the pinyin recitation she would perform for her grandparents in the evening.

events.name: The whole family is preparing for an evening video call.
events.description: At 7:30 in the evening, Song Yajing began preparing for a video call with her parents in Quanzhou. She checked that the iPad battery was sufficient and tested the stability of the home Wi-Fi signal. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang brightened the lighting around the sofa area in the living room and cleared clutter from the coffee table to create a neat background for the video call. Xuanxuan put on the new floral dress that Grandma Lin Xiuying had sent last week, and practiced her expressions and tone repeatedly in front of the mirror while holding a practice sheet covered in pinyin.

events.name: Warm video call with her parents in Quanzhou
events.description: At exactly 8 p.m., Song Yajing and her family of three connected by video with her parents in Quanzhou. Xuanxuan was the first to lean toward the camera and read aloud 'a, o, e, i, u, ü,' and even spelled out 'yé ye nǎi nai' (grandpa and grandma) in pinyin, making the two elders laugh heartily. Song Yajing then shared the progress of preparations for the shop's fifth anniversary and the good news that her daughter had smoothly adjusted to elementary school. Her father Song Minghui appeared in front of the camera wearing an apron and urged her to take care of herself and not overwork. Her mother Lin Xiuying excitedly shared the tiramisu recipe she had recently learned, and held up her phone to show the finished product she had baked. The call lasted nearly an hour, with a warm and harmonious atmosphere as the two generations shared the details of daily life across the screen.

events.name: Received a baking recipe sent by Mom
events.description: Right after the call ended, Lin Xiuying sent Song Yajing the newly learned low-sugar tiramisu recipe via WeChat in the form of text and pictures. The recipe used mascarpone cheese to replace part of the cream and black coffee to soak the ladyfingers. In the note she wrote, 'This version is not too sweet, suitable for you young people.' Song Yajing replied, 'Got it, Mom. I'll try it in a couple of days,' and saved it for reference during the next baking session.

events.name: Late-night conversation with husband about family matters
events.description: After putting Xuanxuan to bed, Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang chatted on the living room sofa. They talked about how concerned their parents had been during tonight's video call and remarked that the elderly parents were getting older but were still in good spirits and good health. Song Yajing mentioned planning to visit Quanzhou around National Day, and Chen Zhiqiang said he could arrange compensatory leave to go along. They also discussed whether they should prepare health supplements or clothes for the parents before National Day, and initially reached a consensus to ask about the needs before making any purchases.

events.name: Pre-sleep stretching; outdoor plans canceled due to thundershowers.
events.description: The planned evening brisk walk was canceled due to afternoon thundershowers, so she switched to indoor stretching and meditation, focusing on relaxing the lower back stiffness caused by sitting for long periods.

start_state.mood: A rare lazy Saturday morning, feeling both nervous and excited about the English class.

end_state.mood: Fulfilling and warm, with the sense of achievement from English learning, the warmth of family interaction, and the couple's tacit understanding interwoven.

state.daily_exercise: Household cleaning, about 5,000 steps, stretching before bed.
