2025-09.daily_overview: Today was a rare sunny Sunday. Early in the morning, Song Yajing took her daughter to Sunday Mass. At the church, she had a warm conversation with fellow parishioner Aunt Lin and Father Wang Mingde, and found spiritual peace. In the afternoon, she fulfilled the baking craving from the day before and tried the tiramisu recipe her mother had sent, together with Xuanxuan. Though the finished product looked imperfect, it tasted amazing. In the evening, the whole family strolled in the community garden. Aunt Zhang Xiuying from next door brought over some homemade mung bean cakes, which inadvertently provided inspiration for the gifts for the upcoming fifth-anniversary celebration. At night, after helping her daughter pack her schoolbag, Song Yajing watched a short documentary about baking with her husband, then reviewed her English class notes and made plans for the next week.

events.name: Take daughter to Sunday Mass
events.description: At 8:30 in the morning, Song Yajing put on a plain elegant dress and took her daughter Xuanxuan to the parish to attend Sunday Mass. Today's Mass was celebrated by Father Wang Mingde, and the homily was about discovering grace in the trivialities of daily life. After Mass, Song Yajing chatted at the church entrance with Auntie Lin Xiuying, a fellow parishioner from the scripture reading group. Auntie Lin asked how the shop was doing and mentioned that her little granddaughter was also in the upper grades at Xuanxuan's elementary school. Father Wang Mingde passed by and exchanged pleasantries with them, and Song Yajing invited him to offer a blessing for the fifth anniversary celebration on September 15.

events.name: Trying her hand at baking tiramisu at home with her daughter
events.description: At 2 p.m., Song Yajing followed the recipe sent by her mother and tried making a low-sugar tiramisu in the kitchen with Xuanxuan. Xuanxuan was responsible for dipping ladyfingers into the coffee liquid, while Song Yajing whipped the cream and mascarpone cheese. Wearing aprons, the mother and daughter worked in perfect coordination. Although Xuanxuan splashed a few drops of coffee on the countertop while dipping, the two were happily immersed in the sweet aroma. The finished product was put into a glass square container and refrigerated for 3 hours to set, then taken out and dusted with a layer of cocoa powder. Although it didn't look as refined as the ones from the store, Song Yajing took a taste and was pleasantly surprised to find it tasted very authentic. Xuanxuan even had two more bites.

events.name: Interacted with neighbor Zhang Xiuying in the evening.
events.description: At 5 p.m., Song Yajing's family ran into their next-door neighbor, Aunt Zhang Xiuying, while taking a walk in the community garden. Aunt Zhang had just come back from the vegetable market, carrying a bag of freshly made mung bean cakes, and warmly gave a few pieces to Xuanxuan. Song Yajing thanked her and mentioned the store's fifth anniversary celebration planned for next Monday (September 15). Aunt Zhang tried a bite of the tiramisu Song Yajing had brought down, sincerely praised its smooth texture, and mentioned that her mung bean cake recipe could also use less sugar. The suggestion struck a chord with Song Yajing, and a thought flashed through her mind: giving handmade low-sugar mung bean cakes to customers as gifts on the anniversary day.

events.name: In the evening, helped daughter pack her schoolbag and review lessons.
events.description: After dinner, Song Yajing helped Xuanxuan pack her schoolbag for the next day, checking the schedule to confirm Monday's textbooks and stationery were all ready. Xuanxuan took out her Chinese textbook to review the pinyin she had just learned, and Song Yajing used her phone to record her daughter's reading as a growth memento. Before bed, Xuanxuan told her she had a great weekend and looked forward to sharing the weekend fun with classmates at school the next day.

events.name: Watched a short documentary about baking with my husband
events.description: After putting their daughter to sleep, Song Yajing and her husband watched a short documentary in the living room about making traditional Italian desserts, about 20 minutes long. The film showed the authentic method and evolution of tiramisu. As they watched, they discussed their afternoon baking experience, and her husband praised that her creation was no worse than the one in the documentary. This relaxed time enhanced the emotional connection between the couple.

events.name: Review English class notes and plan next week
events.description: After watching the documentary, Song Yajing opened her English notebook at her desk and reviewed the common airport phrases she had noted in Saturday's class. She opened the course app to complete a read-aloud assignment and practiced "Could you please tell me where the check-in counter is?" five times before submitting. She then opened her phone calendar and looked at next week's schedule: morning runs on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday; livestreams on Tuesday and Thursday; the second English class on Saturday; and the fifth anniversary celebration next Monday. Looking at the busy but well-ordered schedule, she felt her life was getting back on track.

start_state.mood: A quiet and peaceful Sunday morning, looking forward to the spiritual nourishment of the Sunday Mass.

end_state.mood: Contentment and calm, interwoven with the joy of successful baking, the warmth of time with her husband, and anticipation for the next week.

state.daily_exercise: Walked around the neighborhood, about 6,000 steps, stretched before bed

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning clear, light breeze, temperature 27-32°C, fine weather

2025-09.daily_overview: Today marked the start of a new week. Song Yajing went for her third morning run, and her stamina had clearly improved, making it much easier than Friday. In the morning, she purchased materials for making handmade soap for Teachers' Day at the store, preparing for the holiday the day after tomorrow. In the afternoon, she began planning the community warm-up event for the store's fifth anniversary celebration. Building on the regular Tuesday livestream, she decided to launch a customer story collection in the community in advance to strengthen emotional connections with regular customers and build momentum for next Monday's celebration.

events.name: The third morning run showed a clear improvement in stamina.
events.description: At 6:50 a.m., Song Yajing put on her running shoes and headed to Zhongshan Park for her third morning run. Unlike Friday, when she was out of breath, today she tried to run two full five-minute segments without stopping her jogging, with only a two-minute brisk walk in between to recover. Although her calves still felt slightly sore along the way, she could feel her heart and lungs adapting, and her breathing rhythm was more stable than the first two times. While stretching after the run, she logged her pace on a running app and found it was nearly 30 seconds faster than last time. This small improvement gave her a huge boost of confidence, and she shared a screenshot of her check-in in the morning running group (where she had just added a few neighbors who also exercised in the park).

events.name: Purchase materials for making handmade soap for Teachers' Day
events.description: After her morning run, Song Yajing stopped by a handmade craft supply store on the way. Following a tutorial checklist she had seen online, she bought milky white soap base, lavender essential oil, dried rose petals, heart-shaped molds, and gift wrapping paper. She planned to make handmade soap with her daughter the day after tomorrow (September 10, Teachers' Day) to give to the kindergarten teachers. While choosing, she deliberately bought an extra set of molds, thinking that if it succeeded, she could make more to give to the store's regular customers.

events.name: During the livestream, preview the fifth anniversary event and launch a story collection.
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., during her regular Tuesday livestream (which was moved up to Monday this week due to preparations), Song Yajing announced to viewers for the first time that the store would soon celebrate its fifth anniversary on September 15. She emotionally recalled the scene of the store's opening five years ago and thanked the customers who had supported her all along. In the latter half of the livestream, she also launched a story-collection activity in the "Yajing Life Store" community group, inviting people to share their "First Piece of Clothing from Yajing" stories, and promised that the 5 selected story contributors would each receive a 100-yuan store coupon. Within 15 minutes of the announcement, nearly 10 people responded in the group. Regular customers sent long reminiscences one after another, and the group's interaction rate soared instantly.

events.name: Purchase ingredients for low-sugar mung bean cakes.
events.description: In the afternoon, while Xiaomei minded the store, Song Yajing went to the supermarket to shop: peeled mung beans, xylitol as a substitute for fine sugar, unsalted butter, mooncake molds, and individual food packaging bags. Recalling the taste of Aunt Zhang's mung bean cake from yesterday and combining it with the sugar-reducing techniques that Master Chen, her baking teacher, had shared, she conceived a low-sugar mung bean cake recipe with less oil and less sugar, suitable for giving as gifts, and planned to start testing it on Wednesday.

start_state.mood: Energetic, enthusiastic about the new week's running goals and celebration preparations.

end_state.mood: Excited and satisfied, the community story collection received enthusiastic responses, and the celebration warm-up exceeded expectations.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run, 22 minutes (mostly jogging), about 10,500 steps, pre-bed stretching.

date_attribute.weather: Partly sunny, with brief showers in the evening, temperature 26-31°C.

2025-09.daily_overview: Today, Song Yajing continued to build up excitement for the fifth-anniversary celebration during her regular livestream, and the community story collection kept gaining momentum. In the afternoon, during a slow period at the store, she tried making low-sugar mung bean cakes in her home kitchen for the first time as a test batch for the celebration gift. Although the taste was acceptable, the appearance was not refined enough, so she decided to adjust the molds and technique tomorrow. In the evening, after picking up Xuanxuan, mother and daughter previewed the handmade soap-making process for the Teacher's Day gift, and Xuanxuan was too excited to fall asleep.

events.name: Tuesday livestream to consolidate the 5th anniversary warm-up momentum
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., Song Yajing started her regular live-stream show on time, sharing autumn outfits in the New Chinese style and mentioning the fifth anniversary celebration again. She selected three touching customer stories from the community comments and read them aloud, mentioning, "One comment said she bought from her sophomore year to her wedding, which almost made me cry." Many viewers in the bullet comments expressed anticipation for the celebration. Peak online viewers reached 33, a new high since the show began.

events.name: First attempt at making low-sugar mung bean cakes
events.description: From 2 p.m. to 4 p.m., when foot traffic at the store was light, Song Yajing left the shop assistant Xiaomei to mind the store alone and went back to the kitchen at home. Following a recipe, she tried making low-sugar mung bean cakes for the first time. She soaked the skinned mung beans, steamed them, ground them into a paste, then stir-fried the paste with xylitol and unsalted butter until it became smooth and dense. Finally, she pressed the mixture into triangular molds to shape the cakes. She made about 20 pieces. They were soft, chewy, and lightly sweet, but when unmolding, the edges were not quite neat, and a few cakes had cracks on the surface. After tasting one, she noted an adjustment plan: add a little milk tomorrow to increase the moisture of the bean paste, and brush a thin layer of oil on the inside of the mold to prevent sticking.

events.name: Prepare making a Teacher's Day gift with my daughter
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing opened the handmade soap kit she had bought yesterday and watched a handmade soap tutorial video with Xuanxuan. The mother and daughter learned the steps for tomorrow: melt the soap base, mix in essential oils and dried flowers, and pour into molds to cool and set. Xuanxuan also used colored pens to design in advance the pattern for a thank-you card for her teacher, drawing her favorite hearts and a sun.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the interaction and customer stories during the live stream.

end_state.mood: Feeling a slight sense of accomplishment — although the mung bean cake trial had its flaws, the direction was correct.

state.daily_exercise: Morning jog for 23 minutes (slow jogging), about 9,800 steps, stretching before bed.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, with light rain showers in the afternoon, temperature 25-29°C, cool.

2025-09.daily_overview: Today is Teachers' Day. In the morning, Song Yajing made lavender essential oil soap by hand at home with Xuanxuan as a Teacher's Day gift. Her daughter innocently asked about 'Mommy's teacher,' which triggered memories of her homeroom teacher Li Fang from vocational college. In the afternoon, she contacted her friend Zhao Li to rush the design of the fifth-anniversary commemorative silk scarves and the celebration gift mung bean cakes (most had been made a few days earlier; today Zhao Li helped finish the remaining 30). In the evening, with gratitude, she sent a greeting message to her homeroom teacher, whom she had not contacted for years, and received a warm reply. The bond between teacher and student was rekindled during the holiday.

events.name: Making Teacher's Day handmade soap together with her daughter.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Song Yajing and Xuanxuan spread a silicone mat on the kitchen island and followed the tutorial step by step. Xuanxuan carefully placed the soap base chunks into a measuring cup, and with her mother's help melted them in the microwave, then added lavender essential oil and dried rose petals. The mother and daughter each dropped in food coloring to create light purple and pink, gently stirred, and poured the mixture into heart-shaped and star-shaped molds. While waiting for the soap to cool and set, Xuanxuan, guided by her mother, neatly wrote on colored card stock, “Thank you, teacher, for your hard work,” and drew hearts and a sun. Four handmade soaps with a faint lavender fragrance were complemented by a thank-you card full of childlike charm.

events.name: Daughter triggers memories of her mentor
events.description: While waiting for the handmade soap to set, Xuanxuan suddenly asked, 'Mom, what was your former teacher like?' Song Yajing was taken aback, and in her mind appeared the figure of Teacher Li Fang, her junior college homeroom teacher—who had encouraged her when she was confused as a newcomer to the workplace and had written 'Take every step steadily' in her graduation yearbook. She squatted down and told Xuanxuan, 'Mom's Teacher Li is a very, very good person.' This simple conversation planted a seed in her heart.

events.name: Collaborating with friend Zhao Li to rush-produce the fifth-anniversary souvenirs
events.description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing's friend Zhao Li (owner of a floral design studio) came to her home. The two of them used a laptop in Song Yajing's study to design the fifth-anniversary commemorative silk scarf pattern. Zhao Li combined the shop's logo with fifth-anniversary elements to create a simple and elegant Morandi blue key visual. After confirming the initial draft, they moved to the kitchen together and, using the recipe Song Yajing had improved the day before, made low-sugar mung bean cakes in batches. Over the previous few days, Song Yajing had already independently completed most of the mung bean cakes; today Zhao Li helped finish the rest. With a clear division of labor—Zhao Li responsible for pressing and packaging, and Song Yajing responsible for stir-frying the bean paste and controlling the heat—their efficiency improved significantly, and they completed about 30 pieces (the remaining portion) in two hours.

events.name: Sent a greeting text to the homeroom teacher she hadn't been in touch with for years.
events.description: After putting Xuanxuan to sleep in the evening, Song Yajing sat in the bedroom and pulled up the few remaining old photos from her school days in her phone's album. The photos showed a young, innocent version of herself and Teacher Li Fang posing together at the school gate. The busyness of work and family had caused her to lose contact with her beloved teacher. On this special Teachers' Day night, she composed a long WeChat message with gratitude: "Teacher Li, hello, I am your student Song Yajing... Today is Teachers' Day, and I suddenly really want to thank you for encouraging me back then. Happy Teachers' Day, and I wish you good health." After sending the message, she felt a little uneasy, wondering whether her teacher still remembered her.

events.name: Received a warm reply from the homeroom teacher.
events.description: About half an hour later, her phone vibrated slightly. Teacher Li Fang replied: "Yajing, of course I remember you! I'm so glad to hear from you. I heard you've opened a shop in Xiamen and become a mother. Your teacher is really proud of you. Come back to Quanzhou for a visit when you have time." The words between the lines were full of love and concern. After reading the message, Song Yajing's eyes grew slightly moist, and she replied with a hugging emoji and "I will definitely go back to Quanzhou to visit you." The teacher-student bond spanning fifteen years was warmly connected at that moment.

events.name: Make handmade soap to give to the store clerk Xiaomei
events.description: When she went to the shop for the handover in the afternoon, Song Yajing wrapped up the few extra handmade soaps she had made and gave them to Xiaomei as a Teacher's Day gift (Xiaomei had once dropped out of a teachers college). Xiaomei was pleasantly surprised and moved, saying it was the first Teacher's Day gift she had received in her life. This small episode made Song Yajing even more convinced that handmade gifts can convey emotions.

start_state.mood: Begin Teachers' Day in the early morning with a grateful heart

end_state.mood: Touched and warmed: my mentor's reply and my collaboration with Zhao Li filled the day with warmth and friendship.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run for 25 minutes (improved continuous running ability), about 8500 steps, stretching before bed

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, hot in the afternoon, temperature 28-34°C, strong ultraviolet radiation.

2025-09.daily_overview: Today Song Yajing continued to push forward with the preparations for the fifth anniversary celebration. In the morning live stream, she shared warm reflections from yesterday's Teachers' Day. In the afternoon, she and Zhao Li continued rushing to make mung bean cakes; through focused collaboration on the third day, the two completed the main production of more than a hundred portions. In the evening, former colleague Zheng Kai sent her an invitation to the opening forum of Xiamen International Fashion Week. The theme, “New Chinese Style and Local Culture,” made her both curious and uneasy. After a night of hesitation, she decided to give herself half a day off to go learn something, drawing new inspiration for running the store.

events.name: Thursday livestream: sharing reflections for Teachers' Day.
events.description: At 9:30 am, Song Yajing shared in her livestream her experience of making handmade soap with her daughter the day before, and how touched she was when her mentor replied warmly to the greeting message she had sent. She extended the topic to “gratitude and heritage”, and at the end read a Bible verse. The livestream atmosphere was warm, and some viewers shared their own unforgettable stories with their teachers in the bullet comments. The highest number of concurrent viewers was 28.

events.name: Invited to a fashion forum, but hesitant inside
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing and Zhao Li packed the last batch of mung bean cakes together in the back of the shop (over 100 pieces in total had been completed). Zhao Li left early because she had something to do. At 7 o'clock, on her way home after finishing work, Song Yajing received a WeChat message from former colleague Zheng Kai: an electronic invitation to the opening forum of the Xiamen International Fashion Week, themed “New Chinese Style and Local Culture,” scheduled for the week after next. Zheng Kai left a voice message: “Yajing, didn't your shop also start carrying New Chinese Style recently? This forum is good and has real substance. I suggest you check it out. If you need to connect with designer resources, I can help introduce you.” Song Yajing looked at the invitation, drawn to the concept of “Local Culture” yet worried whether it would be appropriate for her, an independent shop owner, to attend such a professional event. She replied to Zheng Kai, “Got it, let me think about it,” then opened her computer to check the forum's detailed agenda.

events.name: Checked in and shared on a diet app.
events.description: At lunch and dinner, Song Yajing insisted on using the diet app to record her meals (oatmeal and fruit for breakfast, salad and chicken breast for lunch, and a light dinner), and sent the check-in screenshots to her mother Lin Xiuying. Her mother replied with a like emoji and a photo of the red bean and barley water she had made. The two had formed a quiet little routine of mutual supervision over healthy eating.

events.name: Stayed up late to rush out the celebration schedule
events.description: In the evening, Song Yajing stayed up late in the study to put together the detailed schedule for the celebration day. She broke down the hourly activities for September 15 and confirmed the division of tasks with Xiaomei and Zhao Li in the group chat. Though tired, she felt reassured when she saw the complete execution plan. Her bedtime was therefore pushed back to late at night.

start_state.mood: Full of energy and satisfied with the efficient collaboration with Zhao Li

end_state.mood: Churning inside but slightly excited; both uneasy and eager to try the new thing

state.daily_exercise: Morning run for 25 minutes (ran 2 km continuously without stopping), about 9,500 steps, stretched before bed.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, light breeze, temperature 27-33°C, feels hot in the afternoon.

2025-09.daily_overview: Today was a day interweaving busyness and self-care. Her mother, Lin Xiuying, came from Quanzhou to lend support, resolving any worries about the weekend hot spring trip. Song Yajing completed her morning run and then finished making and sorting the last batch of mung bean cakes into packages. Her continued light diet and app check-ins were praised by her mother. In the evening, to reward herself for the many days of preparation, she did something rare and went alone to the cinema to watch a light comedy, releasing stress in laughter. In her Moments, she wrote 'Smile, and keep going tomorrow,' finding a long-lost sense of relaxation.

events.name: Entrusting her daughter to her mother
events.description: In the morning, her mother Lin Xiuying arrived in Xiamen by high-speed rail from Quanzhou, and Song Yajing went to the station to pick her up. After getting home, she confirmed with her mother the checklist for Xuanxuan's kindergarten drop-off and pick-up, meals, and daily routine, and gave a detailed rundown of her daughter's weekend activities (she had a piano introductory lesson the next day). Xuanxuan was thrilled to see her grandmother, and the three generations enjoyed stir-fried Minnan rice noodles cooked by Song Yajing for lunch.

events.name: Packing luggage for the hot spring vacation with her husband
events.description: During the afternoon, Xiaomei was in charge of the shop. Song Yajing took leave to go home and pack for the short trip with Chen Zhiqiang. They put a change of clothes, swimsuits, sunscreen, phone chargers, and common medicines into a small suitcase and a backpack. Song Yajing also brought along the final execution plan booklet for the shop's celebration next week, wanting to go over it one last time in a quiet moment.

events.name: Finished making and sorting the last batch of low-sugar mung bean cakes.
events.description: At 3 p.m., Song Yajing, building on the concentrated production of the previous two days, boxed the more than one hundred mung bean cakes that had finished setting in the refrigerator one by one, affixed ‘Yajing Life Gallery Fifth Anniversary’ stickers, and stored them by date. At this point, all the fifth-anniversary gift low-sugar mung bean cakes (about 120 in total) were fully made and packaged, marking that preparation of the main celebration supplies was nearly complete.

events.name: Stick to a healthy diet and check in using the app.
events.description: Song Yajing strictly followed her meal plan (oatmeal, fruit, vegetable salad, chicken breast, and a small amount of staple food), and carefully logged each meal through the app. When she sent the records to the private chat with her mother, Lin Xiuying replied, “Mom feels reassured when you eat like this,” and said that after seeing her daughter’s morning run check-in yesterday, she also decided to go out more often. The mutual supervision pattern between mother and daughter began to show positive two-way motivational effects.

events.name: Watching a movie alone to relax.
events.description: On the evening of September 12, after leaving Xuanxuan in her mother's care, Song Yajing said to her husband, “Tonight I want to go out by myself.” She went alone to Wanda Cinema in Siming District, bought a small bucket of popcorn and a cola, and picked a light comedy. Immersed in the laughter filling the theater, she temporarily set aside store preparations and family matters. By the time the movie ended, it was late at night. Walking out of the cinema, she looked up and saw a clear moon, and posted a moment on WeChat Moments: “Smile, and keep going tomorrow,” along with a photo of the ticket stub. This time alone felt like a recharging break, and it was the first time this month she had consciously treated herself.

start_state.mood: Busy but looking forward to a short weekend break.

end_state.mood: Relaxed and content; after the healing solitude, my heart is filled with joy.

state.daily_exercise: Morning jog for 20 minutes (maintained at an easy pace), about 8,000 steps, stretching before bed.

date_attribute.weather: Partly cloudy to clear, with a gentle breeze in the evening, temperature 26–31°C, extremely pleasant.

2025-09.daily_overview: Today was a rare day for just Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang, and it was also a Saturday with several tasks running in parallel. In the morning, she attended her second online English class, and the obvious improvement in her oral fluency was praised by the teacher. The couple then drove to the Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort in Haicang, chatting easily along the way. From afternoon into the night, they relived the days of their first love and of starting a business together in the hot spring pool, enjoyed an exquisite dinner for two, and then strolled in the garden, giving their emotional bank account the highest-quality top-up in more than two years. At the same time, she also remotely received the custom commemorative silk scarf and asked Zhao Li, who was helping, to wrap it.

events.name: Received praise for speaking in the second English class.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Song Yajing attended her second Saturday online English class in her study, with the theme of restaurant ordering and shopping scenarios. With the foundation from the first week and a week of fragmented shadow-reading practice, she was noticeably more relaxed in class and actively raised her hand to join a simulated dialogue about asking for sizes in a mall. Although her grammar occasionally made mistakes, she spoke boldly and her intonation was much more natural. The foreign teacher, Anna, praised her in front of the whole class for her "obvious progress." After class, she completed the reading assignment for the shopping scenario on the app, and her confidence was much higher than last week.

events.name: Drive to the hot spring resort.
events.description: After the class ended, Song Yajing and her husband handed Xuanxuan over to her mother, then drove their own car from Siming District to Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort in Haicang District. The drive took about 30 minutes, and the two chatted happily in the car: Chen Zhiqiang shared amusing stories about the company project that had just wrapped up, while Song Yajing talked about the preparations for the store's fifth anniversary and their daughter's adjustment to school. The long-missed time alone together made them both feel a bit of luxurious happiness.

events.name: Arrived at the resort and enjoyed lunch.
events.description: After arriving at Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort, the couple checked in easily at the hotel lobby. They stayed in a suite with a private soaking pool. After putting away their luggage, they went to the resort restaurant for a lunch for two, ordering local specialties such as satay noodles and seafood snacks. During the meal, Chen Zhiqiang sighed that since Xuanxuan was born, the couple had hardly had any opportunity to travel alone for more than half a day.

events.name: Sharing old times in the hot spring
events.description: From afternoon to evening, Song Yajing and her husband changed into swimsuits and entered the resort's Japanese-style hot spring area. They tried several hot spring pools with different benefits one after another: the lavender spring, the red wine spring, and the herbal bath pool. Surrounded by the warm spring water, they chatted easily. Song Yajing recalled that ten years ago, when they had just started dating, they often strolled along the beach at Gulangyu. Chen Zhiqiang laughed and said that even a steak dinner back then was a "big treat." They also talked about how brave Song Yajing was to quit her job and start a business in 2020, and the memory of her husband quietly saving start-up funds from his salary to support her at the time. Away from daily trivialities, the deep conversation in the hot spring quickly strengthened the intimacy between the couple.

events.name: Evening candlelit dinner for two and a walk
events.description: After finishing their evening hot spring soak, the couple changed into formal attire and went to the resort's western restaurant for a dinner for two. The restaurant had soft lighting, and outside the window was the resort's night view. They ordered lamb chops and pasta with a glass of red wine. After dinner, they strolled along the garden paths in the resort grounds. The early autumn evening breeze brushed their faces, and the surroundings were quiet. Song Yajing leaned on her husband's shoulder, enjoying a long-awaited moment of quiet time together. She told him, "Thank you for arranging this trip." Chen Zhiqiang held her hand tightly and said, "From now on, we should have one of these every year."

events.name: Received the silk scarves and handed them to Zhao Li for wrapping.
events.description: At 4 p.m., during her vacation, Song Yajing received a logistics update from the factory: the 100 custom commemorative silk scarves had arrived at a pickup point near the store. She contacted Zhao Li via WeChat and asked her to pick up the package and use the afternoon to do the final sorting and packaging. Her friend Zhao Li readily agreed and sent photos in the evening: the beautiful scarves were neatly folded and placed in individual gift bags, everything ready. Song Yajing replied with thanks and remarked, "It's only with your help that I can enjoy my vacation worry-free."

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the English class and the hot spring trip; feeling elated.

end_state.location: Hotel room at Riyuegu Hot Spring Resort
end_state.mood: Overflowing with happiness, their relationship was deeply nurtured, and the celebration supplies were delivered smoothly.

state.daily_exercise: After soaking in the hot spring, she went for a brisk walk of about 7,000 steps and stretched before bed

2025-09.daily_overview: Today carried on the relaxed mood from yesterday. After enjoying the buffet breakfast, the couple sat leisurely over tea, and at noon checked out and drove home. In the afternoon, Song Yajing picked up her daughter, who had been looked after by her mother, and took her to Sunday Mass, giving her a spiritual close to the week. Afterwards, she immediately threw herself into the final preparations for the celebration: checking the silk scarves and mung bean cakes that Zhao Li had wrapped, setting up the message wall, testing the sound system, and personally notifying via WeChat the long-time members who had spent at least 5,000 yuan within the past two years to come to the store the next day to collect commemorative silk scarves. In the evening, she discovered that two supplier payments were due before Monday morning to avoid late fees, so she decided to leave early the next morning to handle them. Everything was ready, and she looked forward to the next day's celebration with calm anticipation. In the evening, she had a warm family dinner with her husband and mother.

events.name: Leisurely breakfast and return trip
events.description: The couple slept in and went to the restaurant for a hearty buffet breakfast. Song Yajing got a bowl of oatmeal fruit porridge and a freshly made egg pancake. After breakfast, they drank tea and chatted in the resort's lounge area, each briefly dealing with work WeChat messages. Song Yajing noted in her memo that the silk scarf had been confirmed. At noon, they checked out at 12:00 and drove home to Hubin South Road, Siming District. On the way, they reviewed the trip and agreed that they should schedule regular time for just the two of them at least two to three times a year.

events.name: Picked up her daughter and thanked her mother.
events.description: After arriving home, it was already 1 p.m. Mother Lin Xiuying had prepared a table of dishes and was waiting for them. Xuanxuan rushed over to her mother and recounted the fun stories of the past two days: Grandma had taken her to the museum and bought her a new hair clip. Song Yajing hugged her mother, sincerely thanked her for helping take care of Xuanxuan, and told her that she and Chen Zhiqiang had had a very pleasant trip. In the afternoon, Lin Xiuying took the high-speed train back to Quanzhou. Before leaving, she reminded Song Yajing to take care of her health at tomorrow's celebration and not get too tired.

events.name: Take daughter to Sunday Mass
events.description: At 3 p.m., Song Yajing took Xuanxuan to an extra evening Mass at the parish (they had not been able to attend in the morning because they were away). In the church, Xuanxuan listened quietly to the sermon and, during the offering, voluntarily dropped a coin into the offering box. Song Yajing prayed for the next day's celebration and for her family, feeling full of peace inside.

events.name: Final supplies check before the celebration
events.description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing came to the shop and did a final check on the commemorative silk scarves wrapped by Zhao Li and the mung bean cakes refrigerated in the fridge. She checked the number of scarves one by one and confirmed that the stickers on every individually packed mung bean cake had no curled edges. Then she took out the prepared message-wall display board (a white background board with branch-shaped hooks), sticky notes, and pens from the fitting room, and arranged dried flowers and green plants around the board. She listened to the curated background music playlist on a Bluetooth speaker, and both the volume and song selection were perfect. In the evening, Song Yajing found that two supplier payments needed to be made before Monday morning to avoid late fees, so she decided to leave earlier the next morning to handle them.

events.name: Set up the message wall area and notify regular members
events.description: Song Yajing set up a striking testimonial wall area on the right side of the shop entrance, cutting out the title 'Fifth Anniversary · Hear Your Story' from pink paper. Using WeChat business tools, she screened out about 25 regular members who had spent at least 5,000 yuan cumulatively in the past two years, and sent each of them a WeChat message: 'Thank you for five years of companionship. Come to the store tomorrow to pick up an exclusive commemorative silk scarf, and there will be green bean cakes too! From 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.'

start_state.location: Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort
start_state.mood: Relaxed in body and mind, with a touch of post-vacation languor yet still full of drive.

2025-09.daily_overview: Today is a memorable day — the store's fifth anniversary celebration. Song Yajing got up at 6:30 in the morning, first did a light morning jog to wake up her body, then arrived at the store at 7:00, opening an hour earlier than usual. In the morning, she focused on receiving regular members as they came in and personally handed out commemorative silk scarves. Light music played throughout the day, and all customers who shopped received handmade low-sugar mung bean cakes. At the message wall, customers carefully wrote heartwarming messages. One regular customer wrote, 'From a young girl to a mother,' which moved Song Yajing several times. Her college classmate Zhao Min came all the way to help. After closing, Song Yajing cleaned the store with Xiaomei and Zhao Min, organized the message notes, and reviewed the event results. The celebration ended perfectly. Although her voice was hoarse from speaking, her heart was full of gratitude and a sense of accomplishment.

events.name: Morning run kicks off the celebration day
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Song Yajing went for a relaxing 15-minute morning jog around the neighborhood as a ceremonial start to the celebration day. After the run, she felt refreshed, went home quickly to shower and change, and prepared for a busy day.

events.name: Morning banking errands and final checks before the celebration
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, Song Yajing rode her electric scooter to the ICBC branch near the shop, used the ATM to handle two urgent transfers for the shop's corporate account, and listened to a podcast about brand building for small micro shops on the way. When she returned to the shop at 7:50, she made the final check before the celebration: making sure the battery was fully charged and the voice-message wall was all as arranged the night before.

events.name: Opened early for the anniversary celebration to welcome regular members.
events.description: On the day of the celebration, she opened the store an hour earlier than usual (8:00). Song Yajing stood at the entrance and welcomed one by one the regular members who had come specially and had spent at least 5,000 yuan in the past two years. She personally handed each one a beautifully packaged custom commemorative silk scarf, chatted briefly with them to catch up, and took Polaroid photos together. Several regular customers brought friends along, and the store gradually became lively.

events.name: The all-day celebration activities ran at high intensity.
events.description: From 9 am until closing, soft light music played in the store all day. Song Yajing guided every customer, whether buying or browsing, to take a sticky note and write down a story or wish on the message wall, and gave handmade low-sugar mung bean cakes as gifts along with shopping bags. During this time, her college friend Zhao Min came to help greet customers and take photos. The most touching moment came when a regular customer called Sister Wang wrote on a note: “I've shopped here from girlhood to motherhood. Thank you for being with me, Yajing.” Song Yajing's eyes welled up after reading it. That day they sold quite a few of the season's new items, and Song Yajing estimated the day's revenue would be several times the usual amount.

events.name: Post-celebration wrap-up and review
events.description: After closing at 9 p.m., Song Yajing cleaned the shop floor together with Xiaomei and her capable helper Zhao Min, and counted the remaining silk scarves and mung bean cakes (only about a dozen were left). They carefully took down the sticky notes from the message wall, arranged them in numerical order, and took a panoramic photo. Song Yajing photographed the messages that moved her most individually for safekeeping, and counted the remaining materials for future use. The three sat on the fitting room floor drinking cold drinks and reviewing the day's work. Xiaomei suggested that next time they could invite regular customers to share their feelings in the community group. Song Yajing noted this suggestion in her phone memo.

events.name: Organized celebration receipts in preparation for accounting
events.description: Returning home late at night, her husband had already coaxed Xuanxuan to sleep. Song Yajing sat at her desk, sorted all the receipts from the fifth anniversary celebration into categories with clips, used a calculator to get a rough total, and wrote it on the flyleaf of her notebook—she would not enter it into the system for now, and would do the formal accounting tomorrow when she had a clear head. Outside the window, the moonlight was bright; the tension and excitement of September 15 finally subsided at that moment.

start_state.mood: Excited and focused—today all the preparations will be revealed.

end_state.mood: Tired but incredibly happy and fulfilled—an impeccable team and I reached a milestone.

state.daily_exercise: Morning jog for 15 minutes; station work involved high-intensity standing and moving all day, about 15,000 steps; stretched before bed.

2025-09.daily_overview: Today was the first day back to the daily routine after the fifth anniversary celebration, but it unexpectedly became a special day of witnessing a friend's vulnerability and deepening friendship. After finishing the live stream in the morning, Zhao Li came over with autumn-themed decorations, and the two of them worked together to create a creative, autumn-filled display in front of the shop window. In the evening, Zhao Li's heartfelt outpouring in the group chat broke the calm, and Song Yajing gave her firm support right away; the community became an emotional harbor as well. In the gaps between busy tasks, she bought baking ingredients for the community good-neighbor festival and spent a lot of time carefully calculating the various costs of the celebration. The day handled both business accounts and the weight of friendship.

events.name: Morning preparations and livestream.
events.description: Got up at 6:45 in the morning, prepared breakfast for my daughter Xuanxuan and took her to school, then rode an electric scooter to the shop. At 9:30, I started the regular Tuesday livestream "A Cup of Coffee After Dropping Off the Kid" on time, sharing autumn outfit inspiration and warm moments from the shop's fifth anniversary celebration. Online viewer numbers stayed stable at around 20, and a regular customer left a message saying she regretted missing the celebration.

events.name: Zhao Li coordinated the design of the autumn window display and completed the setup.
events.description: Because her mother's condition had stabilized, Zhao Li proactively contacted Song Yajing through WeChat and offered to design the autumn window display for the store for free, to thank Song Yajing for helping at the flower studio every evening for two consecutive weeks. The two agreed to meet at the store that afternoon. In the afternoon, Zhao Li brought homemade pressed leaf specimens and warm-toned decorations (dried flowers, twine, wooden letter signs), and worked with Song Yajing on a creative window display under the theme "Autumn Whispers," creating a warm, artistic autumn atmosphere that made passersby stop and take photos. During the decorating, Zhao Li occasionally seemed distracted. Song Yajing noticed she had something on her mind but didn't ask. They finished around 5 p.m.

events.name: Zhao Li opened up in the community about her confusion over her divorce, and Song Yajing gave her firm support
events.description: In the evening, Zhao Li, for the first time, publicly expressed in the shared WeChat group “Girlfriends' Time” her confusion and helplessness about divorce, stemming from her husband's long-term absence and a marriage that existed in name only. Her tone was vulnerable and candid as she sought comfort from group members. After seeing the message, Song Yajing immediately replied, “Whatever decision you make, we all support you; you are not alone,” offering unconditional and steadfast support, which moved Zhao Li to tears in the group. Other group members (Li Meiling, Wang Jia, etc.) also spoke up to encourage Zhao Li and shared their own thoughts on marriage, making her feel the power of acceptance and the support of female friendship.

events.name: Purchase baking ingredients for the Good Neighbor Festival
events.description: To participate in the community Good-Neighbor Festival baking contest on September 17, Song Yajing, after finishing the window display arrangement with Zhao Li, went to a nearby supermarket to buy ingredients such as cake flour, red dates, xylitol, and eggs.

events.name: Calculate the costs for the fifth anniversary event
events.description: After dinner, at the workbench in the store, Song Yajing carried out a detailed financial check. First, based on the custom scarf contract and the actual quantity received, she checked the custom unit price (45 yuan per scarf) and the total quantity (80 scarves) item by item, confirming the cost was 3,600 yuan. Second, she took out the purchase lists and receipts and calculated the total cost of the ingredients for the low-sugar mung bean cakes, including flour, butter, sugar, and so on, as well as the cost of gift boxes and gift bags, totaling about 2,200 yuan. Next, she counted the quantity and face value of the coupons actually used and redeemed by customers during the event, and calculated the total discount amount and printing cost at about 800 yuan. Finally, she checked the additional costs on the day of the celebration, including lighting, audio equipment rental, promotional posters, roll-up banner production, and temporary helpers' wages, totaling about 1,400 yuan. After verifying every detail, she confirmed the total event cost was about 8,000 yuan, entered the items one by one into the store's financial software, and generated a special expenditure report. She filed the original receipts, handwritten drafts, and electronic reports by category in the financial folder for safekeeping in case they were needed later, and wrote in her business notes: though the cost is high, the emotional connection is priceless.

events.name: Recalling past events during the evening skincare routine.
events.description: While doing her regular nighttime facial care routine, Song Yajing looked at herself in the mirror and thought back to Zhao Li’s confidences earlier today, silently reflecting on how friendship supported her life. She sent her husband Chen Zhiqiang a WeChat message: “Thank you for always being by my side,” and received a warm reply. This little moment let her fall asleep at 22:50 with emotion and peace.

start_state.mood: Energetic and reassured to be back in the daily rhythm.

end_state.mood: Tired but satisfied, moved by Zhao Li's trust and the depth of their friendship, and relieved that the accounts were clear, but slightly worried about her friend's troubles.

2025-09.daily_overview: Today was the Community Good Neighbor Festival baking competition day and a turning point for the shop's product innovation. Early in the morning, Song Yajing made a test batch of low-sugar jujube paste cake in the shop's back kitchen for final preparation, then took the finished product to the competition venue. Although she won no award, she unexpectedly received sincere praise from an elderly person, and that remark took root in her heart like a seed. After briefly returning to the shop to take care of things in the afternoon, she began the first round of R&D on "Minnan pastries from memory" in the back kitchen in the evening. At night, she started her English speaking workshop learning journey, taking a substantial step toward her dream of traveling abroad. Switching among competition, R&D, and study during the day, she felt fulfilled and energized.

events.name: Morning run
events.description: Got up at 6:50 in the morning, and after taking my daughter Xuanxuan to school, completed my first morning run of the week in Zhongshan Park, a 20-minute jog at a pace of about 8 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer, with heart rate well controlled. After the run, did some simple stretching and rode a kick scooter to the store.

events.name: Try making low-sugar jujube cake
events.description: After arriving at the store, Song Yajing did a trial run of low-sugar jujube paste cake in the back kitchen, making final preparations for the upcoming Good Neighbor Festival baking competition. She carefully weighed the ingredients, adjusted the oven temperature, confirmed that the color and texture of the finished product were at their best, and while still hot, packed the jujube paste cake into an exquisite food box and attached a handwritten card.

events.name: Participate in the community Good Neighbor Festival baking competition.
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., Song Yajing took the low-sugar jujube cake she had made that morning to the community Good Neighbor Festival to compete in a baking contest with more than 20 residents. Her entry was elegantly plated, with a handwritten card reading “A low-sugar pastry made for my father.” After tasting it, the judges said it “has a fine texture and moderate sweetness,” but in the end she did not win. After the contest, a community newspaper reporter interviewed her briefly, asking what had made her enter. An elderly man of about seventy, after taking a bite, sighed, “This tastes like what my grandma made when I was little.” Deeply touched, Song Yajing realized that food carries memories and emotions across generations, and she felt the idea for a “Memories of Southern Fujian Pastries” series begin to grow in her mind.

events.name: Returned to the shop to tidy up and serve customers.
events.description: After the competition, she returned to the store and, together with Xiaomei, received several regular customers who came in during the afternoon, sharing amusing stories from the Good Neighbor Festival. When a customer tasted the jujube paste cake she had brought back and said, 'If only I could buy this,' it further strengthened Song Yajing's intention to develop the product. A brief afternoon shower reduced pedestrian traffic on Zhongshan Road, so she took the opportunity to organize the display of autumn new arrivals.

events.name: Launch the first round of development for “Minnan Cake in Memory”.
events.description: In the evening, after arranging for Xiaomei to watch the store, Song Yajing went into the back kitchen alone and began the first round of formal product development. Based on the original low-sugar date paste cake recipe, she increased the proportion of red date paste, lowered the baking temperature from 170°C to 160°C to extend the baking time and let the date aroma fully develop, and tried adding a small amount of dried longan to enhance the flavor layers. She recorded every change and tasting impression in a dedicated notebook, and initially confirmed a recipe direction closer to the "taste of childhood."

events.name: Sign up for the English speaking workshop and test the equipment.
events.description: After returning home in the evening and putting her daughter to bed, Song Yajing searched an online platform and chose a four-week intensive English speaking workshop (focused on travel topics, with evening classes every Wednesday and Friday), completed the online payment (980 yuan), then set up the computer camera and microphone, confirmed the network was stable, and prepared for the first class. In her phone memo, she wrote, 'For the overseas trip three years from now, keep going!'

start_state.mood: A little nervous, feeling both eager and anxious about the baking competition.

end_state.mood: Energized and full of motivation; the elder's words and the initial success of the research and development made her feel she had found a new direction.

2025-09.daily_overview: Today was a day of harvesting the results of community operations and intensively advancing Minnan cake development. After finishing the livestream in the morning, Song Yajing focused on organizing customer stories. In the afternoon, she officially released the story collection in the community and announced the winners; the group interaction was enthusiastic, hitting a new monthly high and taking emotional connection to a new level. Meanwhile, development work in the back kitchen continued steadily in between. She tried low-sugar adaptations of five traditional Minnan cakes. It was a full workload, but filled with the joy of exploration. The day achieved a satisfying balance between warm online connection and solid offline work.

events.name: Light morning activity and livestream.
events.description: Woke up at 6:55 in the morning, took her daughter to school, then commuted by kick scooter as light activity. At 9:30, she held her regular Thursday livestream and shared what she saw and heard at yesterday's Good Neighbor Festival baking competition, as well as the old man's moving remark. Fans left messages encouraging her to "be sure to make the Minnan cake," and the livestream atmosphere was especially heartwarming.

events.name: Compile and publish a collection of customer stories.
events.description: After the morning livestream ended, Song Yajing sat at the store workbench to filter and lay out the more than ten customer stories collected earlier. She selected five of the most representative and sincere stories (covering themes such as “From Young Girl to Mother,” “A Must-Visit When Returning from Another City,” and “Wedding Dresses Bought Here”), designed the community post copy and coupon images. At 3 p.m., she officially released the compiled customer story collection in the “Yajing Life House” community, announced the five winning story authors, and attached the redemption instructions for a 100 yuan coupon. She then personally sent the electronic coupons one by one via WeChat and thanked them for their sincere sharing. The winning customers thanked her spontaneously in the group, and other members, moved by the atmosphere, also left messages recalling their first encounters with the store or sharing shopping experiences, pushing community activity to a monthly high (that day saw over 200 messages in the group). Song Yajing tallied the new interaction volume, coupon redemption intent, and potential customer feedback, recorded the event experience in her business notes, and concluded that “story marketing is the most effective engine for community engagement.”

events.name: Minnan cake development: sugar-reduction experiments on five traditional pastries
events.description: During breaks in community operations and after closing in the evening, Song Yajing kept developing recipes in the back kitchen, trying to make the basic cake bases for five traditional Minnan pastries: fa gao (adjusting the yeast ratio and steaming time), rice cake (comparing the proportions of glutinous rice and indica rice), bowl cake, crushed-peanut cake, and an upgraded jujube paste cake. All incorporated a modern low-sugar concept, using xylitol to partially replace white sugar. She recorded the appearance, texture, sweetness, and shelf life of each trial one by one, accumulating 5 pages of recipe notes. She eliminated 2 of them (the bowl cake was too dry, and the sweetness of the fa gao was hard to control) and kept 3 for further optimization.

events.name: Late-night community interactions led to staying up late
events.description: She had originally planned to go to bed early, but the community kept buzzing over the released story collection. Song Yajing couldn't help replying to customer comments multiple times, and before she knew it, it was 23:15 before she put down her phone. Though a bit tired, seeing how engaged the customers were filled her with a sense of accomplishment.

start_state.mood: Energetic and looking forward to the new day's livestream and community posts.

end_state.mood: Filled with a sense of accomplishment. The warm feedback from the community and the product development progress made her feel the store was on the right track.

2025-09.daily_overview: Today was a day that combined refinement and breakthrough. In the morning, at the shop, she finalized the final recipe proportions for the 'Minnan Cakes in Memory' series, and the three cakes were officially established as a complete product line. In the afternoon, she received customers while also handling the shop's daily operations. In the evening came the first online session of the English workshop, themed 'Self-Introduction for Travel.' From being unable to speak to trying to repeat after the audio, she took a key step despite being nervous. The day brought substantial progress on both fronts: product development and personal growth.

events.name: Morning run
events.description: Got up at 6:45 in the morning, after taking my daughter to school I kept up my Friday morning run, jogged for 20 minutes in Zhongshan Park, felt my leg strength improving, with a pace of about 8 minutes 10 seconds per kilometer.

events.name: Completed the final recipe proportions for the Minnan Cake in Memory series.
events.description: After arriving at the store in the morning, Song Yajing made final combinations and fine adjustments based on her earlier trials. She confirmed that the “Minnan Cake in My Memory” series would include three products: low-sugar date paste cake (keeping the taste her father preferred, with a slight adjustment to the longan ratio), old-fashioned rice cake (using a 3:2 ratio of glutinous rice to indica rice, soft and chewy), and steamed cake with crushed peanuts (sprinkled with freshly ground peanuts on top to enhance aroma and texture). She weighed each cake precisely, recorded the final recipes, photographed the finished products for archiving, and decided to officially launch a limited sale at the store the next day (September 20). She also hand-drew a design sketch for the product introduction sign.

events.name: Attend the first online class of the English speaking workshop
events.description: At 8:00 pm, Song Yajing attended the first online session of the English speaking workshop on time from her home study, with the theme of self-introduction in travel scenarios. The class had about 15 students, and the teacher required each learner to unmute and introduce themselves and their travel preferences in English. When it was Song Yajing's turn, she was so nervous that her palms sweated and her pronunciation faltered, but she still insisted on saying I'm from Xiamen, I want to travel to Italy with my family, and received the teacher's encouragement Good try, keep going! After the class, she briefly reviewed the five core words learned that day and repeated them three times, greeted other learners in the course group, and felt that she had truly started her learning journey.

start_state.mood: Calm and confident, with a clear idea for finalizing the product.

end_state.mood: Both tired and excited. The English class was intense, but she took the first step and is full of anticipation for the new product launch.

2025-09.daily_overview: Today was a day of both harvest and broadening horizons. In the morning, I finished putting the Minnan cake series on the shelves, sold them, and released a short video; the three new products quickly stirred customers' curiosity. At the same time, I discussed fall replenishment with supplier Susan and selected New Chinese-style design samples. In the afternoon came the most important personal learning event of the month—I went alone to the International Convention Center to attend a fashion forum, got in touch with cutting-edge ideas, and met designer Lin Yue. In the evening, when I shared the forum experience in the community group, the enthusiastic feedback from regular customer Vivian unexpectedly ignited the creative spark for a co-branded collection.

events.name: “Memories of Southern Fujian Cakes” series officially launched.
events.description: After arriving at the shop in the morning, Song Yajing first did a final round of trial production and quality control, confirming that the texture, appearance, and room-temperature storage method of the three cakes all met the standards, and completing all remaining development work. She then launched the low-sugar jujube paste cake (18 yuan per piece), old-fashioned rice cake (15 yuan per piece), and crushed peanut steamed cake (12 yuan per piece) for limited sales in the shop (20 pieces of each in the first batch). She placed them in a prominent spot on the counter and handwrote wooden introduction signs, labeling them "Minnan Cakes from Memory · Limited Handmade" along with the inspiration behind each one. Customers who came in were curious about the new products. Most of the first batch was sold within half a day, and many people said they "taste truly Minnan."

events.name: Communicated with supplier Susan about autumn restocking and selected sample images.
events.description: After finishing the morning shelving work, Song Yajing contacted the supplier Susan via WeChat to discuss restocking new Chinese-style seasonal products for autumn. She pulled up sample images she had saved earlier and discussed the styles and quantities of items such as new Chinese-style ceramic tea sets and bamboo-woven storage baskets with Susan. In the end, she selected three new Chinese-style sample designs as references for the first round of restocking, and agreed to place a small trial order next week.

events.name: Record and publish a short video about the behind-the-scenes R&D story.
events.description: Around noon, Song Yajing took advantage of the quiet period in the store to record a 2-minute short video on her phone, sincerely telling the behind-the-scenes story of how she was moved by the elderly at the Neighborhood Festival and came up with the idea of developing the “Minnan Rice Cake in Memory”. The video showed photos from the competition day, handwritten development notes from the kitchen, and the actual new product. She posted the video to the store's WeChat group and Moments with the caption “Some flavors are a gift of time”, which soon drew a flood of likes and comments. Many customers said they were “moved” and that they “must come buy some tomorrow”.

events.name: Attended a fashion forum and met designer Lin Yue.
events.description: On the afternoon of September 20, after settling her daughter (who was accompanied by her husband Chen Zhiqiang to the community library), Song Yajing went alone to the Xiamen International Conference and Exhibition Center and entered the opening forum of the International Fashion Week using the invitation sent by her former colleague Zheng Kai. The forum theme was "New Chinese Style and Local Culture." The speakers shared cases such as the application of Southern Fujian architectural elements in clothing design and the combination of Taiwanese local handicrafts with modern fashion. Song Yajing carefully noted keywords such as "local culture exploration," "sustainable fabrics," "community-based retail," and "revitalization of intangible cultural heritage." It was the first time she heard the concept of "product as content," and she deeply felt that a small shop could also carry cultural expression. During the tea break, she took the initiative to talk with Lin Yue, an independent accessory designer wearing an exquisite pressed-flower brooch in the next seat. Lin Yue praised that the brooch on Song Yajing's chest was a handmade pressed-flower brooch by Zhao Li. The two had a pleasant conversation, exchanged WeChat, and agreed to follow up later.

events.name: Sharing forum experiences in the community group to build anticipation for the co-branded collection
events.description: On the evening of September 20, Song Yajing sent a 5-minute voice message in the 'Yajing Lifestyle Club' community, sharing her forum impressions in an excited yet slightly nervous tone: 'So Neo-Chinese style can be very everyday—it's not just qipaos!' She also mentioned, 'Maybe in the future, our store can also have our own Minnan designs.' Before she finished, many customers expressed anticipation, and regular customer Vivian even commented directly, 'You could make modernized qipaos—I'll be the first to buy one.' This voice message unexpectedly became the starting point for the subsequent co-branded product's community warm-up, and the discussion in the group about 'how to incorporate Minnan elements into everyday outfits' lasted late into the night.

events.name: The excitement from the forum experience led to a late night.
events.description: Due to the intellectual impact from the forum and the heated community discussions, Song Yajing lay in bed unable to sleep for a long time, continuously envisioning possibilities for the store's future. She finally fell asleep at 23:30. She realized that she was opening a new door.

start_state.mood: After resting a bit on Saturday, still full of energy, with high hopes for both the new product launch and the forum.

end_state.mood: Her mind was filled with new ideas, and she was too excited to fall asleep, feeling that the store's future direction was becoming clearer and more ambitious.

2025-09.daily_overview: Today was a Sabbath belonging to family and faith, and also a natural combination of going out for inspiration and fine-tuning products. In the morning she took her daughter to Sunday Mass, and at church briefly exchanged family news with fellow parishioner Aunt Lin Xiuying. In the afternoon the family of three went for a walk in Zhongshan Park, and the sight of her daughter Xuanxuan chasing butterflies on the lawn filled Song Yajing with contentment. In the evening, taking advantage of the break after the rain, she fine-tuned the plating and packaging details of the Minnan cakes in the shop, warming up for the increase in orders next week. The day found a balanced Sunday rhythm among faith, family, and light work.

events.name: Attend Sunday Mass.
events.description: At 9:00 a.m., Song Yajing took her daughter Xuanxuan to the parish for Sunday Mass. Father Wang Mingde shared 'gratitude in daily life' in his sermon. During the prayers, Song Yajing especially prayed for peace concerning Zhao Li's marital difficulties and the smooth promotion of the store's new products. After Mass, she had a brief conversation with Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow parishioner, at the church entrance. Aunt Lin tasted the jujube cake Song Yajing had brought, praised it as 'delicious and healthy,' and suggested she bring the pastries to next month's parish gathering to share.

events.name: Family afternoon time: walking in Zhongshan Park
events.description: In the afternoon the weather was still pleasant, so Song Yajing, her husband Chen Zhiqiang, and their daughter Xuanxuan went to Zhongshan Park. They strolled by the lake and fed fish, while Xuanxuan ran on the lawn chasing butterflies with crisp laughter. The couple sat on a bench and talked about the shop's recent busyness and their daughter's adjustment at school. Chen Zhiqiang suggested that they could also promote the Minnan cake in his colleagues' group chat to expand sales channels. The family of three spent about two enjoyable hours in the park and went home around 4 p.m.

events.name: Using the time after the rain to fine-tune the product and packaging.
events.description: Around 5 p.m., after a thunderstorm, the weather turned cooler. Song Yajing went to the store alone (about a 15-minute drive from home) to check the condition of the Minnan cakes stored at room temperature and confirmed that the taste and texture had not been affected. She replaced the labels on the three kinds of pastries with more delicate handwritten labels, adding emotional phrases such as 'inspired by the taste of our parents' generation,' and tied thin hemp rope around the packaging boxes to enhance the gift-giving feel. After posting a preview in the community group, 'Tomorrow is Monday, limited Minnan cakes will continue to be available,' she gradually received several reservation messages. About an hour later, she closed the store and went home to have dinner with her family.

start_state.mood: Peaceful and calm, looking forward to Mass and family time.

end_state.mood: Grateful and content, with the double joy brought by family warmth and product optimization

state.daily_exercise: None (Sunday is a rest day, replaced by a walk)

2025-09.daily_overview: Today was an important milestone for team building. After finishing the Monday morning run and shop-opening preparations in the early morning, Song Yajing signed a long-term labor contract with Xiaomei in the shop, formally bringing this capable assistant into the long-term development track. The hands-on training after signing, the afternoon observation of customer reception, and the late-night journal writing together traced her complete journey from entering the workforce in 2009 to becoming a team leader today. In the evening, she compiled and posted her forum takeaways to the community group, once again sparking regular customer Vivian's interest in the New Chinese-style concept. The day alternated between institutional building and personal reflection, and the shop's team-based era officially began.

events.name: Morning run and shop preparation
events.description: Got up at 6:50 in the morning. After taking her daughter to school, she completed her Monday morning run in Zhongshan Park (20 minutes, pace about 8 min/km). After arriving at the shop, she prepared for opening with Xiaomei, cleaning the window, organizing shelves, and checking weekend sales data for new products. A total of 48 pieces of the Minnan cake series were sold over the weekend (originally planned to make 60), and the replenishment needs to be scheduled for Wednesday.

events.name: Signed a long-term labor contract with Xiaomei.
events.description: Before opening the store, Song Yajing prepared the long-term labor contract documents she had drafted at home the previous evening (including monthly salary adjustment, social insurance payment rules, year-end profit sharing ratio, and paid annual leave clauses), and fully communicated and confirmed the signing details with Xiaomei. Around 10 a.m., in the quiet area at the back of the store, the two officially signed the long-term labor contract, clarifying both parties' rights and responsibilities and the year-end profit sharing clause (stipulating that 5% of the annual net profit would be used for employee dividends). After signing, Song Yajing personally taught Xiaomei how to use the financial software for daily store bookkeeping, and explained in detail the specific process of ordering from suppliers—from filling out order forms, confirming via WeChat, tracking logistics, to inspection and warehousing. Xiaomei took careful notes and said, "I will definitely learn it well."

events.name: Watching Xiaomei handle customers on her own brought on a mix of emotions.
events.description: In the afternoon, customer traffic gradually increased. Song Yajing let Xiaomei, who had just finished learning bookkeeping, receive customers independently at the front desk while she stepped aside to observe. Xiaomei skillfully recommended the new autumn styles, offered styling suggestions, collected payments, and packed purchases, chatting and laughing with regular customers with the aplomb of her mentor. Watching this, Song Yajing recalled her own days in early 2009 when she first joined a clothing company in Xiamen as a sales assistant — at that time, a senior colleague like Sun Li had also guided her carefully. Now she herself had become a guide for others, and deep thoughts about time and growth welled up inside her.

events.name: Writing the diary 'Ten Years'.
events.description: Back home that night, Song Yajing opened her diary in the study and wrote an entry titled "Ten Years." She looked back on her naivety when she came from Quanzhou to Xiamen in 2009, her marriage in 2015, the courage to quit her job and open the shop in 2020, and her decision that day to formally include Xiaomei in the shop's long-term plan. She wrote: "From nervously saying 'Welcome' behind the counter to sitting in the shop watching another girl greet customers, this path has taken 16 years. From today on, the word 'team' has taken on a concrete shape." It was late by the time she finished writing, but her heart felt especially clear.

events.name: Organized forum insights and published them to the community; regular customer Vivian responded
events.description: Before writing in her diary, Song Yajing organized her notes from the fashion forum she attended on September 20 into a richly illustrated community post (including photos from the forum, excerpts of guests' memorable quotes, and her own reflections), and published it to the 'Yajing Lifestyle Club' community. She ended with: 'Maybe our shop can also try making clothes with a Minnan flavor.' Regular customer Vivian saw it and commented, 'Finally you've brought up this direction!', and said she was willing to participate in the follow-up discussion. This interaction laid the groundwork for the upcoming co-branding discussion on September 23.

start_state.mood: Feeling uplifted for the start of the new week, also with a slight sense of solemnity about the signing ceremony.

end_state.mood: A mix of emotions: joy that the team has taken shape, nostalgia looking back at the past, and confidence in the future.

The live stream ended in a relaxed atmosphere.

events.name: Held an in-depth discussion with regular customer Vivian about a New Chinese-style joint collaboration
events.description: At around 3 p.m., Vivian, a regular customer, came to the store specially. As soon as she entered, she said, "I thought about your co-branded collection all night last night." Song Yajing brought out two cups of fruit tea, and the two had an in-depth discussion for about an hour in the tea seating area in the corner of the store. She volunteered to be one of the first fitting models and said she would be willing to help try on clothes and take photos for community warm-up. Deeply moved, Song Yajing wrote down in her notebook: "Direction: New Chinese style for everyday wear · modernized qipao · floral tile patterns," and agreed to contact designer Lin Yue, whom she had met on a forum, in early October to discuss the possibility of collaboration. The two also agreed to visit a local intangible cultural heritage exhibition together next time to seek inspiration.

events.name: Communicated with supplier Susan about autumn restocking and testing the waters of the New Chinese-style direction.
events.description: Before closing in the evening, Song Yajing had a video call with Guangzhou supplier Susan via WeChat to restock the new autumn styles. Susan said that several factories had recently launched modified qipao and shirts with frog-button elements, and sent over several sample photos. Song Yajing initially selected three styles for a trial order (five pieces each) and agreed to have them shipped next week. After hanging up, she wrote in her business notes: “Supply chain extension: initial trial of modified qipao in new Chinese style.”

Customer traffic was light in the morning because of the rain, so she organized recent accounts and confirmed that the Minnan cake series had cumulative sales of about 1,800 yuan in the five days since launch, with a profit margin far higher than clothing—this strengthened her determination to increase promotion.

events.name: Had a quarterly video call with fellow church member Lin Wei and gained inspiration for packaging design.
events.description: During the lunch break, Song Yajing had a WeChat video call with her fellow church member Lin Wei in the store's back storage area, fulfilling their quarterly creative exchange agreement. Lin Wei showed a set of watercolor flower works she had just completed (themed “Minnan Four Seasons”), with soft, poetic colors. Song Yajing in turn shared photos of the new Minnan cakes and the autumn window display design. After admiring them, Lin Wei suggested, “If your pastries could be packaged in a hand-painted style, they would be more special, like gift souvenirs.” She recommended incorporating watercolor flowers or line drawings of Minnan architecture into the pastry wrapping paper and gift box design, giving the products added artistic value. Deeply inspired, Song Yajing immediately recorded the suggestion in her notebook after the call and sketched out the possibility of a cross-disciplinary collaboration with Lin Wei in the future.

events.name: Second session of the English speaking workshop: Transportation and asking for directions
events.description: At 8:00 PM, the class started on time in the study at home, with the topic of transportation and asking-for-directions scenarios ("How do I get to the museum?" "Is there a bus to the city center?" etc.). During the class, the teacher had the students practice in pairs. Song Yajing was paired with a classmate who was also from Fujian, and they practiced in simulated scenarios of asking for directions, taking buses, and buying tickets. She felt increasingly comfortable speaking English spontaneously. Although she still got stuck sometimes and made grammar mistakes, she managed to complete the entire dialogue. The teacher commented, "Fluency is improving, keep practicing." After class, she reviewed the core vocabulary related to buses, subways, and taxis, and tried to retell the class dialogue in front of her daughter. Xuanxuan laughed uproariously and said, "Mom speaking English is so fun."
