2025-09.daily_overview: Today was a day full of warmth and farewell. After attending Sunday Mass in the morning, she suddenly received news that her elementary school classmate Liu Fang had arrived in Xiamen, and the afternoon became precious time for a long-awaited reunion—shopping, eating shacha noodles, taking photos, and a late-night Moments post. The mutual empathy between middle-aged wanderers brought a deep sense of healing. In the evening, she and her husband had a preliminary discussion about the destination and rough plans for the National Day trip. The day ended amid the warmth of reuniting with an old friend and the anticipation of a family outing, rich and full of emotion.

events.name: Attended Sunday Mass and prayed for Zhao Li and the store.
events.description: At 9:00 a.m., Song Yajing took her daughter to the parish for Sunday Mass. During the Mass, Father Wang Mingde mentioned that “friends are companions given by God.” Song Yajing silently prayed for Zhao Li's marital difficulties and the growth of store clerk Xiao Mei, and also gave thanks for the store's fifth anniversary and the success of the Minnan cake series. After Mass, she exchanged homemade baked goods with fellow parishioner Aunt Lin Xiuying — the aunt gave her a recipe for fig soft cookies she had just learned, and Song Yajing gave her two pieces of Minnan jujube paste cake in return.

events.name: Hosted Liu Fang, an elementary school classmate who dropped by unexpectedly.
events.description: At noon, Liu Fang, a primary school classmate, told Song Yajing via WeChat that she was on a business trip passing through Xiamen and had a short free window in the afternoon, so they agreed to meet at the store that afternoon and catch up. Around 3 p.m., Liu Fang found Shop No. 36 on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street by the address. Song Yajing warmly welcomed her long-lost friend, showed her around the store, and shared stories and business insights since opening the shop—from resigning and starting her own business in 2020 to the inspiration behind developing Minnan cake. Liu Fang listened with great interest and also talked about her current work and stress as a product manager at an internet company in Shenzhen. Afterwards, Song Yajing took Liu Fang to a nearby time-honored satay noodle shop to taste Minnan-style satay noodles. The two talked about their respective experiences of drifting away from home—from Quanzhou to Xiamen, and from Quanzhou to Shenzhen. Liu Fang sighed, "Our generation is growing old in a foreign land," which gave voice to their shared sense of displacement and complex feelings toward their hometown. They resonated with each other on a deep emotional level. After the meal, they took a walk along Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to help digestion. They took a selfie together in front of the store, their smiles warm yet tinged with melancholy. That evening, Liu Fang had to catch a high-speed train back to Shenzhen. The two said a reluctant goodbye at the Zhongshan Road metro station entrance and promised to meet in Shenzhen next time.

events.name: Post on WeChat Moments to commemorate the reunion.
events.description: That evening, Song Yajing posted a status on Moments with a selfie of the two of them and an old childhood photo: “Childhood companion, still sharing a stretch of the journey as adults, is already a blessing. May you be well in that faraway place.” This was her solemn commemoration of the warm reunion. Within minutes it received dozens of likes and comments. Her best friend Li Meiling commented, “I want to see you too!” and Wang Jia said, “Next time the Three Musketeers must all get together.”

events.name: Preliminary discussion with her husband about National Day travel plans.

They were leaning toward Zhangpu Volcano Island Resort, planning a two-day, one-night trip from October 1 to 2. Based on a recommendation from the moms' group, Song Yajing mentioned a cost-effective guesthouse, and Chen Zhiqiang suggested saving it first and booking another day. The two roughly planned the itinerary: set off in the morning of the first day, arrive and check in at noon, play on the beach in the afternoon, and visit the Volcanic Geology Museum in the evening; on the second day, attend the resort's parent-child activities in the morning and return home after lunch. Song Yajing made a list of items to bring, including clothes, sunscreen, snacks, toys, a first-aid kit, and reminded her husband to remember to check the car the day after tomorrow. Detailed booking arrangements were planned for later.

start_state.mood: A peaceful and quiet Sunday morning, with no preset plans for the time after Mass.

events.name: Morning activities and the last livestream of the month
events.description: Got up at 6:50 in the morning, took her daughter to school, then rode a scooter to the shop (no morning run on Tuesday; the commute served as daily exercise). Back at the shop, she held the regular Tuesday livestream “A Cup of Coffee After the School Drop-off” at 9:30, with today's theme being “September Review and October Preview.” While drinking fruit tea, she shared with her fans what she had gained in September: the touching fifth-anniversary celebration, the launch of the Minnan-style cake series, new insights from the forum, and completion of the English course. She also previewed that in October she would try to contact a designer to discuss co-branded pieces, and wished her fans a happy National Day. The stream had a warm atmosphere, with about 25 viewers online. Several customers left comments like “Thank you for sharing; you keep getting better every month.”

events.name: Organizing notes on the co-branded collaboration framework
events.description: On the morning after the livestream ended, Song Yajing, based on her discussion with Vivian and Lin Wei's suggestions, drafted a preliminary co-branding framework in her notebook at the store's workbench: target designer (Lin Yue — accessories and print design), product direction (modernized qipao, frog-button shirts, silk scarves with floral tile patterns), collaboration model (profit sharing or design licensing to be discussed), and timeline (initial contact before mid-October). She also drew a simple mood board in the notes, clipping images of Chinese elements cut from fashion magazines. When finished, she put the notes into the "2025 Brand Upgrade" folder and planned to contact Lin Yue in the first week after National Day.

events.name: Monthly review of dietary structure adjustments
events.description: At noon, she ate lunch alone in the storage room behind the store (homemade vegetable salad with chicken breast). She opened the food tracking app on her phone to review the past three weeks of dietary adjustments: adding oatmeal and fruit to breakfast had worked well, eating out at lunch had decreased and was mainly replaced by homemade healthy meals, and staple food at dinner was controlled to half a bowl. Her weight, which had fluctuated steadily from 47.3 kg at the beginning of the month, had now recovered to around 48.2 kg. She felt stronger and the soreness in her shoulders and neck had clearly eased. In the app, she noted, "Keep it up in October and try to increase protein intake," then took a screenshot and sent it to her mother Lin Xiuying to share the "results of supervision."

events.name: Reserve a dinner for the wedding anniversary and prepare a gift.
events.description: Returning home in the evening, Song Yajing called one day ahead to book a table for two on the evening of October 1 at a French bistro in Siming District that both she and her husband loved (this was the dinner for their wedding anniversary; considering that they would be at Volcano Island during the day on October 1, they would come back in the evening to have the anniversary dinner), and left a note: “Tenth wedding anniversary, please arrange a quiet corner.” Then she took out a gift she had prepared in advance from the back of the bedroom closet—a carefully selected men's cashmere scarf (suitable for autumn, in the camel color Chen Zhiqiang liked). She wrapped it in elegant wrapping paper and attached a handwritten card: “Ten years, thank you for being by my side. For the next ten years, I will still have you.” She put the gift in the closet drawer, waiting to give it to him after returning home tomorrow night. In her diary she wrote: “Tomorrow is our tenth wedding anniversary and also the first day of the National Day trip. May all good things arrive as promised.”

start_state.mood: Full of energy; the last day of September carries a special sense of ritual and the satisfaction of wrapping things up.

end_state.mood: Heart full and grateful — September brought abundant rewards, October is just around the corner, and our wedding anniversary and National Day trip are woven together into beautiful anticipation.

state.daily_exercise: None (Tuesday is not a morning-run day; the day mainly consisted of commuting by cycling and standing during livestreams).
